doi:10.1002/aepp.70079.abstract: Prior research analyzes the economic effects of Voluntary Sustainability Standards (VSS)—such as Fairtrade, Organic, and GlobalGAP—but little is known about the stability of these effects over time. Using a nationally representative farm survey of Peru (2015–2019), this study analyzes whether VSS certification is associated with reduced inter‐annual price and yield volatility. Applying pooled OLS, matching, and internal instruments, we find that certification is associated with 27% lower price volatility and 17% lower yield volatility, particularly benefiting family farms, translating into an 81% reduction in their net farm revenue volatility. The results highlight VSS' potential to enhance revenue stability.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70079.abstract_zh: 已有研究分析了自愿性可持续标准（VSS）——如公平贸易、有机认证和全球良好农业规范——的经济效应，但关于这些效应随时间稳定性的认知仍十分有限。本研究利用秘鲁全国代表性农户调查数据（2015-2019年），分析VSS认证是否与降低的年际价格波动和产量波动相关。通过混合OLS回归、匹配法和内部工具变量法，我们发现认证与价格波动降低27%、产量波动降低17%显著相关，其中家庭农场受益尤为突出，其净农场收入波动降幅达81%。研究结果凸显了VSS在增强收入稳定性方面的潜力。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70079.title: Certified and Stable? Price and Yield Volatility Under Voluntary Sustainability Standards in Peru
doi:10.1002/aepp.70079.title_zh: 认证与稳定？秘鲁自愿性可持续标准下的价格与产量波动

doi:10.1002/aepp.70080.abstract: Index insurance, while heralded as a potential solution to alleviate poverty and food insecurity among agricultural households, has its own set of challenges, notably basis risk. Basis risk is the discrepancy between the insurance payout and losses incurred, posing a significant deterrent to the adoption of index insurance. This study investigates the effect of basis risk training on the uptake of rainfall index insurance among rural farmers in Senegal, employing an educational simulation game as a pedagogical tool. Our results suggest that a lack of transparency and a misunderstanding of basis risk contribute to low participation and a lack of trust in index insurance.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70080.abstract_zh: 指数保险虽被誉为缓解农业家庭贫困与粮食安全的潜在解决方案，但其自身存在一系列挑战，尤其是基差风险。基差风险是指保险赔付与实际损失之间的差异，这成为阻碍指数保险推广的重要因素。本研究通过教育模拟游戏作为教学工具，探讨基差风险培训对塞内加尔农村农民购买降雨指数保险的影响。结果表明，透明度不足以及对基差风险的误解，是导致参与率低且对指数保险缺乏信任的原因。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70080.title: Why Didn't I Get a Payout? Understanding Farmer Choices, Index Insurance, and Basis Risk
doi:10.1002/aepp.70080.title_zh: 为什么我没有获得赔付？理解农户选择、指数保险与基差风险

doi:10.1002/aepp.70081.abstract: Increased frequency of extreme weather events, particularly droughts, threatens grassland farming by destabilizing yields and farms' economic viability. We examine, theoretically and through numerical simulations, how sown plant diversity (natural insurance) influences the attractiveness of indemnity and drought index insurance (formal insurance) in grassland systems across Europe. Our analysis shows that higher sown diversity reduces farmers' willingness to pay for indemnity insurance, suggesting adverse selection. In contrast, drought index insurance remains equally attractive regardless of diversity. These effects hold across different insurance designs and risk preferences. Our findings offer valuable insights for farmers, insurers, and policymakers aiming to build resilient, sustainable agricultural systems.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70081.abstract_zh: 极端天气事件（尤其是干旱）频率的增加，通过破坏产量和农场的经济可行性，威胁着草地农业。我们通过理论分析和数值模拟，研究了欧洲草地系统中播种植物多样性（自然保险）如何影响赔偿保险和干旱指数保险（正式保险）的吸引力。分析表明，较高的播种多样性降低了农民对赔偿保险的支付意愿，这表明存在逆向选择。相比之下，无论多样性如何，干旱指数保险的吸引力保持不变。这些效应在不同的保险设计和风险偏好下均成立。我们的研究结果为农民、保险公司和政策制定者提供了宝贵见解，旨在构建具有韧性和可持续性的农业系统。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70081.title: Coping With Production Risk: Effects of Sown Plant Diversity on the Attractiveness of Crop Insurance in Grasslands
doi:10.1002/aepp.70081.title_zh: 应对生产风险：播种植物多样性对草地作物保险吸引力的影响

doi:10.1002/aepp.70082.abstract: Eggs are an inexpensive and sustainable source of proteins, but volatility in the U.S. egg prices has intensified in recent years, raising concerns over food affordability and market stability. This study examines the drivers of U.S. egg price dynamics over 2004–2025 using a two‐stage framework that combines LASSO‐based variable selection with an ARIMAX forecasting model. The results reveal strong price persistence, together with significant impacts of energy, feed costs and seasonal demand. The influence of avian influenza is strongly time‐dependent, with limited effects in full‐sample averages but significant impacts during high‐intensity outbreak periods, particularly in the mid‐2010s and after 2022. Out‐of‐sample forecasts indicate that the LASSO‐ARIMAX model reduces forecast errors by more than 60% relative to a univariate ARIMA benchmark. These findings suggest that stabilizing key input costs, strengthening timely epidemiological surveillance, and proactively managing predictable seasonal demand pressures are more effective than relying on any single explanatory factor.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70082.abstract_zh: 鸡蛋是一种廉价且可持续的蛋白质来源，但近年来美国鸡蛋价格波动加剧，引发了对食品可负担性和市场稳定性的担忧。本研究采用两阶段框架，结合基于LASSO的变量选择与ARIMAX预测模型，考察了2004-2025年间美国鸡蛋价格动态的驱动因素。结果显示，价格具有强持续性，同时能源、饲料成本和季节性需求的影响显著。禽流感的影响具有强烈的时间依赖性：在全样本平均值中影响有限，但在高强度疫情暴发期（尤其是2010年代中期及2022年后）影响显著。样本外预测表明，相较于单变量ARIMA基准模型，LASSO-ARIMAX模型将预测误差降低了60%以上。这些发现表明，稳定关键投入成本、加强及时流行病学监测以及主动管理可预测的季节性需求压力，比依赖任何单一解释因素更为有效。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70082.title: Understanding Egg Price Volatility and Policy Implications in the U.S. With Machine Learning
doi:10.1002/aepp.70082.title_zh: 美国鸡蛋价格波动理解与机器学习政策启示

doi:10.1002/aepp.70083.abstract: We provide a comprehensive review of the U.S. Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS), synthesizing nearly two decades of program evolution, market outcomes, and economic analysis. The RFS mandates minimum volumes of renewable fuel blending through a nested structure based on life‐cycle greenhouse gas reductions, enforced via tradeable Renewable Identification Numbers (RINs). Actual implementation diverged substantially from statutory targets, reaching only 20 billion gallons in 2022 versus the intended 36 billion, primarily due to failure to scale cellulosic biofuel production. RIN prices exhibit extraordinary volatility but follow rational economic fundamentals. Total inflation‐adjusted compliance costs are estimated to be $252.1 billion over 2011 through 2025.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70083.abstract_zh: 本文全面回顾了美国可再生燃料标准（RFS），综合梳理了近二十年的政策演变、市场结果及经济分析。RFS通过基于生命周期温室气体减排量的嵌套结构，强制规定最低可再生燃料掺混量，并借助可交易的可再生识别码（RINs）执行。实际执行情况与法定目标存在显著偏差，2022年仅达到200亿加仑，远低于预期的360亿加仑，主要原因是纤维素生物燃料生产未能实现规模化。RIN价格表现出异常波动性，但遵循理性的经济基本面。经通胀调整后，2011年至2025年间的总合规成本估计为2521亿美元。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70083.title: The Biofuels Blueprint: Understanding the U.S. Renewable Fuel Standard
doi:10.1002/aepp.70083.title_zh: 生物燃料蓝图：理解美国可再生燃料标准

doi:10.1002/aepp.70084.abstract: This study examines how rising food prices affected household welfare in The Gambia using nationally representative data from the 2015/16 Integrated Household Survey (IHS‐3). The analysis reflects household consumption behavior and market conditions prevailing during that period and provides a structural benchmark for understanding vulnerability in an import‐dependent economy. Using data from 5443 households, we estimate price and expenditure elasticities for four key food groups—cereals, animal products, roots and tubers, and fruits and vegetables through a censored Quadratic Almost Ideal Demand System (QUAIDS) model that accounts for zero consumption and nonlinear expenditure effects. Results reveal substantial heterogeneity across income groups and geographic locations. Poor urban households are most vulnerable to food price increases due to greater market dependence and limited substitution options, while rural households are particularly sensitive to cereal price shocks. Compensating variation estimates indicate that poor urban households require significantly higher income compensation to maintain welfare following price increases. Although structural conditions have evolved since 2015, the findings provide baseline evidence on household demand responses and distributional impacts of food price shocks in The Gambia.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70084.abstract_zh: 本研究利用冈比亚2015/16年度综合住户调查（IHS-3）的全国代表性数据，考察粮食价格上涨对家庭福利的影响。分析反映了该时期家庭消费行为与市场状况，为理解进口依赖型经济体的脆弱性提供了结构性基准。基于5443户家庭数据，我们通过考虑零消费和非线性支出效应的删失二次近乎理想需求系统（QUAIDS）模型，估算了四大关键食品类别（谷物、动物产品、块根块茎类、果蔬）的价格弹性与支出弹性。结果显示，不同收入群体和地理区域存在显著异质性。城市贫困家庭因市场依赖度更高且替代选择有限，对粮食价格上涨最为脆弱；而农村家庭对谷物价格冲击尤为敏感。补偿变分估计表明，价格上涨后，城市贫困家庭需获得显著更高的收入补偿才能维持原有福利水平。尽管2015年以来结构性条件已发生变化，但本研究为冈比亚家庭需求响应及粮食价格冲击的分配效应提供了基线证据。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70084.title: Assessing Household Welfare in Response to Rising Food Prices in The Gambia
doi:10.1002/aepp.70084.title_zh: 评估冈比亚食品价格上涨对家庭福利的影响

doi:10.1002/aepp.70085.abstract: We unpack the impact of expansions in ethanol production—as measured by proximity to newly constructed ethanol plants and capacity expansions—on farmland values using land transaction data from Kansas in combination with modern causal inference techniques. We first show that Two‐Way Fixed Effects (TWFE) estimation with data aggregated to the county and township level leads to an average land value effect ranging from 4% to 9% for parcels located within 50 km of an ethanol plant. However, using a modern difference‐in‐difference estimator, we find no evidence of a statistically significant effect on farmland values. Furthermore, our analysis reveals no indication that land value proximity premiums rose following the 2005 Energy Policy Act. We find evidence that the average treatment effect detected by conventional TWFE is largely driven by land transactions in the proximity of ethanol plants that were established prior to the 2005 Energy Policy Act. Proximity to ethanol plants established after the 2005 Energy Policy Act has a smaller and less robust effect on land values.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70085.abstract_zh: 我们利用堪萨斯州的土地交易数据，结合现代因果推断技术，揭示了乙醇产量扩张（以新建乙醇工厂及产能扩张的邻近程度衡量）对农田价值的影响。首先，将数据汇总至县和乡镇层面后，采用双向固定效应（TWFE）估计发现，位于乙醇工厂50公里范围内的地块，其土地价值平均影响幅度在4%至9%之间。然而，使用现代双重差分估计器后，我们未发现乙醇工厂对农田价值具有统计上显著影响的证据。此外，分析表明，2005年《能源政策法案》实施后，土地价值并未因邻近乙醇工厂而出现溢价上升的迹象。我们找到证据表明，传统TWFE方法检测到的平均处理效应主要源于2005年《能源政策法案》之前已建立的乙醇工厂周边土地交易。而2005年《能源政策法案》之后建立的乙醇工厂，其邻近性对土地价值的影响较小且稳健性较弱。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70085.title: Unpacking the Farmland Capitalization Effect of Ethanol Establishment
doi:10.1002/aepp.70085.title_zh: 乙醇设施对农地资本化效应的解析

doi:10.1002/aepp.70086.abstract: Presenting pesticide dosages in range formats (e.g., 10–40 g) is presumed to offer farmers flexibility to adjust dosage application based on pest or disease pressure, and thereby facilitating precise use. However, this conventional practice may unintentionally encourage pesticide overuse. Based on a lab‐in‐the‐field experiment, this study finds that approximately 65% of farmers disregard the minimum dosage when exposed to range‐based labels, anchoring instead on the upper bound. A nudge‐based label design, featuring reference points and brief explanatory cues, can significantly reduce pesticide use without restricting farmers' autonomy. These findings reveal both the hidden risks and promising potential of label‐based interventions, suggesting that thoughtfully designed labels can serve as a low‐cost, scalable policy tool for mitigating excessive chemical use problem in agriculture.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70086.abstract_zh: 以范围形式呈现农药剂量（如10–40克）被认为能为农户提供灵活性，使其根据病虫害压力调整施药量，从而促进精准用药。然而，这一常规做法可能无意中助长农药过度使用。基于一项田间实验室实验，本研究发现约65%的农户在面对范围标签时会忽略最低剂量，反而以上限为锚定标准。一种基于助推设计的标签方案，通过设置参考点并辅以简要解释性提示，能在不限制农户自主权的前提下显著减少农药使用量。这些发现揭示了标签干预措施既存在潜在风险，也蕴含巨大潜力，表明精心设计的标签可作为低成本、可推广的政策工具，用于缓解农业中化学品过度使用问题。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70086.china_reason: 本地后台人工确认：中国相关
doi:10.1002/aepp.70086.china_relevance_reason: 本地后台人工确认：中国相关
doi:10.1002/aepp.70086.title: The Label Trap: Unintended Consequences of Pesticide Labeling and the Power of Nudges
doi:10.1002/aepp.70086.title_zh: 标签陷阱：农药标签的意外后果与助推的力量

doi:10.1002/aepp.70087.abstract: The United States spends billions annually on crop insurance premium subsidies, yet the prevailing distance‐based guarantee design unintentionally rewards risk‐taking by linking subsidies to yield variability. We consider a simple redesign: define guarantees in terms of probability so that coverage reflects a consistent likelihood of indemnity. Using US data, this probability‐based approach would reallocate about $3.3 billion in annual subsidies from high‐risk to low‐risk production, reducing regional disparities by two‐thirds without changing total subsidies. Because most publicly subsidized crop insurance programs around the world share this structure, adopting probability‐based guarantees could help realign agricultural production toward more resilient and sustainable regions and practices.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70087.abstract_zh: 美国每年在农作物保险保费补贴上投入数十亿美元，然而现行基于距离的保障设计因将补贴与产量波动挂钩，无意中激励了风险承担行为。我们提出一种简单的重新设计方案：以概率定义保障，使保险覆盖范围反映一致的赔付可能性。基于美国数据的测算表明，这种概率导向方法每年可将约33亿美元补贴从高风险生产重新分配至低风险生产，在不改变补贴总额的情况下将区域差异减少三分之二。由于全球大多数公共补贴农作物保险计划均采用类似结构，采纳概率型保障有助于引导农业生产向更具韧性和可持续性的区域及实践模式转型。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70087.title: Crop Insurance Design and On‐Farm Risk Adaptation
doi:10.1002/aepp.70087.title_zh: 农作物保险设计与农场风险适应

doi:10.1002/aepp.70088.abstract: Providing nutritious meals in institutional settings with financial constraints, such as military dining facilities, is challenging. The US Department of War (DoW) and US Department of Agriculture (USDA) collaborated to modernize the Basic Daily Food Allowance (BDFA) using an optimization model that incorporates service members' consumption patterns and nutritional standards. The model estimated optimal diets for four demographic groups, producing costs similar to the 2019 BDFA but with greater food variety. This first application of the USDA Food Plan to military purchase data demonstrates a flexible approach for improving cost estimates in military and other institutional food programs.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70088.abstract_zh: 在资金受限的机构环境（如军队餐饮设施）中提供营养餐食颇具挑战。美国战争部与美国农业部合作，通过引入优化模型对基本每日食品津贴进行现代化改革，该模型整合了军人的消费模式与营养标准。模型为四个不同人口群体估算出最优膳食方案，其成本与2019年基本每日食品津贴相当，但食物种类更为丰富。此次将美国农业部食品计划首次应用于军购数据，展示了提升军队及其他机构食品项目成本估算灵活性的可行路径。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70088.title: The Cost of a Nutritious Diet in Cafeterias: Evidence From US Military Dining Facilities
doi:10.1002/aepp.70088.title_zh: 食堂营养膳食的成本：来自美国军队餐饮设施的证据

doi:10.1002/aepp.70089.abstract: This paper presents an economic analysis of US agricultural policy, building on a modified version of Gardner's efficient redistribution. We argue that agricultural policy is motivated as an attempt to implement an efficient redistribution scheme that redistributes income toward farmers who, as a group, have been adversely affected by agricultural productivity growth. We show how this approach helps explain why subsidies are more common in agriculture than in other sectors of the economy. We explore how our analysis provides new and useful insights into the design and implementation of US agricultural policy.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70089.abstract_zh: 本文基于加德纳有效再分配理论的修正版本，对美国农业政策进行了经济分析。我们认为，农业政策的动机在于试图实施一种有效的再分配方案，将收入重新分配给那些因农业生产率增长而受到不利影响的农民群体。我们展示了这一方法如何有助于解释为何补贴在农业领域比在经济其他部门更为普遍。我们探讨了我们的分析如何为美国农业政策的设计与实施提供新颖且有益的见解。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70089.title: On the Economics of US Agricultural Policy
doi:10.1002/aepp.70089.title_zh: 美国农业政策的经济学分析

doi:10.1002/aepp.70090.abstract: This study examines the main drivers influencing the adoption of two types of precision farming technologies in the viticultural sector: Decision Support Systems (DSSs) and Variable Rate Technologies (VRTs). We apply a partial proportional odds model and find that socio‐demographic characteristics are not significant determinants of adoption, whereas farm structural features and a general positive attitude toward technology significantly increase the likelihood of uptake. Environmental concern plays a role only with respect to the intention to adopt, but not in explaining actual adoption behavior. Moreover, farmers' perceptions of the usefulness of digital technologies and the difficulties associated with their use emerge as key factors shaping adoption intentions among non‐adopters. These results suggest that targeted training initiatives and strengthened advisory services could play a crucial role in fostering the diffusion of precision farming technologies in viticulture.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70090.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了影响葡萄种植业采纳两类精准农业技术的主要驱动因素：决策支持系统（DSSs）与变量施肥技术（VRTs）。通过应用部分比例优势模型，本研究发现社会人口特征并非技术采纳的显著决定因素，而农场结构特征及对技术的普遍积极态度则显著提升了采纳概率。环境关注仅在采纳意愿层面发挥作用，但无法解释实际采纳行为。此外，农户对数字技术实用性的认知及使用困难程度，成为影响非采纳者采纳意愿的关键因素。这些结果表明，针对性的培训计划与强化咨询服务可在促进葡萄种植业精准农业技术推广中发挥关键作用。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70090.title: Drivers of Precision Agriculture Adoption in Italian Viticulture
doi:10.1002/aepp.70090.title_zh: 意大利葡萄栽培中精准农业采纳的驱动因素

doi:10.1002/aepp.70091.abstract: This paper investigates how lenders' costs of funds affect agricultural loan interest rates. We use a matched sample of US farm‐loan data and lender‐specific cost of funds, and a farm fixed effects design, to estimate pass‐through, conditioning on borrower characteristics. We find modest average pass‐through of funding costs to farm loan interest rates, with meaningful differences across lender types and local market conditions. Our findings suggest that borrower characteristics and common macroeconomic trends remain central to agricultural loan pricing, but lender business models and local credit market structure also shape how changes in funding costs affect farm borrowing costs.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70091.abstract_zh: 本文研究了贷款机构的资金成本如何影响农业贷款利率。我们利用美国农场贷款数据与贷款机构特定资金成本的匹配样本，并采用农场固定效应模型，在控制借款人特征的情况下估计传导效应。研究发现，资金成本向农场贷款利率的平均传导程度较为温和，且在不同贷款机构类型和当地市场条件下存在显著差异。我们的结果表明，借款人特征和共同宏观经济趋势仍是农业贷款定价的核心因素，但贷款机构的商业模式和当地信贷市场结构同样影响着资金成本变化对农场借贷成本的作用路径。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70091.title: How Lender Cost of Funds and Market Structure Shape Agricultural Interest Rates
doi:10.1002/aepp.70091.title_zh: 贷款资金成本与市场结构如何塑造农业贷款利率

doi:10.1002/aepp.70093.abstract: Countries are accelerating actions to reduce food loss and waste to ensure global food security and sustainable development. Cooperatives are considered important channels for promoting the use of agricultural technologies and improving farmers' skills, which are regarded as key factors in reducing harvest losses. However, owing to data limitations, few systematic assessments of the effects of cooperative membership on food losses exist. On the basis of survey data from 703 maize growers in three major maize production areas in China, propensity score matching (PSM) and endogenous switching regression (ESR) were used in this study to evaluate the effects of cooperative membership on the maize harvest losses of households. The results revealed that membership significantly reduced maize harvest losses by 68%, saving farmers an average of 238.05 kg per ha, which is worth $91.92 per ha. Membership also contributed to minor pest attacks and better working attitudes during the harvest stage. Cooperative membership is critically important for China's food security, resource conservation, and environmental protection. If the average maize harvest loss reaches the level of loss observed among member households, then it is possible to meet the food consumption needs of 13.61 million people, saving 0.74 million ha of land and 0.29 million tons of fertilizer used for maize production and reducing carbon emissions by 4.04 million tons and the water footprint by 6.43 billion m 3 .
doi:10.1002/aepp.70093.abstract_zh: 各国正加速行动减少粮食损失与浪费，以保障全球粮食安全与可持续发展。合作社被视为推广农业技术、提升农户技能的重要渠道，而这两者被认为是降低收获损失的关键因素。然而，受数据限制，关于合作社成员身份对粮食损失影响的系统性评估仍较为匮乏。本研究基于中国三大玉米主产区703户玉米种植户的调查数据，采用倾向得分匹配（PSM）与内生转换回归（ESR）方法，评估合作社成员身份对农户玉米收获损失的影响。结果表明：成员身份显著降低了68%的玉米收获损失，平均每公顷为农户节省238.05公斤，折合每公顷91.92美元。此外，成员身份还有助于减少收获阶段的虫害侵袭，并改善农户的工作态度。合作社成员身份对中国粮食安全、资源节约与环境保护具有关键意义。若玉米平均收获损失降至成员农户的水平，则可满足1360万人的粮食消费需求，节省74万公顷土地及29万吨玉米生产用化肥，减少404万吨碳排放，并降低64.3亿立方米的水足迹。

doi:10.1002/aepp.70094.abstract: Professional service for digital technology like agricultural drones lowers transaction costs and scope thresholds for smallholders. Meanwhile, perceptual adoption barriers remain underexplored. We conduct a two‐stage choice experiment with a randomized video‐based information treatment among 384 Chinese crop farmers to measure its effect on farmers' willingness to pay (WTP) for agricultural drone services (ADS). While video‐based information significantly reduces farmers' WTP for contracts relative to oral agreements, it increases WTP for overall drone services among farmers who are younger, higher‐income, cultivate larger‐scale farms near tractor roads, have limited access to digital dissemination, and show lower risk preferences. By incorporating perceived uncertainty and risk management into the information‐adoption framework, we provide insights for policy support of digital agriculture service markets.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70094.abstract_zh: 农业无人机等数字技术的专业服务降低了小农户的交易成本和规模门槛。然而，感知层面的采用障碍仍未得到充分研究。我们针对384名中国种植农户开展了一项两阶段选择实验，并采用随机视频信息干预措施，以衡量其对农户农业无人机服务支付意愿的影响。研究发现，与口头协议相比，视频信息显著降低了农户对合同的支付意愿，但提高了年轻、高收入、在机耕道附近经营较大规模农场、数字传播渠道有限且风险偏好较低的农户对整体无人机服务的支付意愿。通过将感知不确定性和风险管理纳入信息采纳分析框架，我们为数字农业服务市场的政策支持提供了启示。

doi:10.1002/aepp.70094.title_zh: 视频信息如何影响农民对无人机服务支付意愿

doi:10.1002/aepp.70095.abstract: This study investigates consumer food responses to Hurricanes Helene and Milton, which affected a swath of the Southeastern U.S. in 2024. Using representative consumer survey data from six affected states, we analyze 10 distinct food responses classified into ex ante and ex post responses, and examine their associations with food insufficiency and diet quality. We find that ex ante food stockpiling is associated with a lower likelihood of food insufficiency and a higher diet quality score. Conversely, the ex post drop in food spending due to income loss is associated with a higher likelihood of food insufficiency and a lower diet quality score. We also examine heterogeneity in food responses across sociodemographic groups. Our results suggest that targeted support for families with children and low‐income households warrant consideration.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70095.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了2024年影响美国东南部地区的飓风海伦和米尔顿对消费者食品应对行为的影响。基于来自六个受灾州的代表性消费者调查数据，我们将10种不同的食品应对行为分为事前应对和事后应对两类，并分析了它们与食品不足和膳食质量之间的关联。研究发现，事前囤积食品与较低的食品不足发生率和较高的膳食质量评分相关。相反，因收入损失导致的事后食品支出下降则与较高的食品不足发生率和较低的膳食质量评分相关。我们还考察了不同社会人口群体在食品应对行为上的异质性。研究结果表明，针对有子女家庭和低收入家庭的有针对性支持值得考虑。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70095.title: Extreme Weather Events and Consumer Food Responses
doi:10.1002/aepp.70095.title_zh: 极端天气事件与消费者食品反应

doi:10.1002/aepp.70096.abstract: Smallholder farmers in developing countries face the twin challenges of improving productivity and managing agricultural risks. One emerging response is outsourcing production tasks to specialized service providers. Using plot‐level data from rice farms in Jiangsu Province, China, and an endogenous treatment‐regression model, this study examines the effects of outsourcing on yields and production risks. Results show that outsourcing increases rice yields by nearly 3%, reduces yield volatility, and lowers the probability of crop failure. These benefits arise from greater access to mechanized services, the substitution of machinery for labor, and more efficient use of inputs. However, outcomes vary by type: machinery‐intensive outsourcing reduces risk, whereas labor‐intensive outsourcing can exacerbate it in weak service markets. Gains are greatest on larger and more fertile plots, underscoring the importance of policies that support mechanization and competitive service markets.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70096.abstract_zh: 发展中国家的农户面临提升生产力和管理农业风险的双重挑战。一种新兴应对策略是将生产任务外包给专业化服务提供商。本研究利用中国江苏省水稻种植的地块层面数据，采用内生处理回归模型，考察了外包对产量和生产风险的影响。结果表明，外包使水稻产量提升近3%，降低了产量波动性，并减少了作物歉收的概率。这些效益源于机械化服务的更易获取、机械对劳动力的替代以及投入要素的更高效利用。然而，不同外包类型的效果存在差异：机械密集型外包降低了风险，而劳动密集型外包在薄弱服务市场中可能加剧风险。在面积更大、土壤更肥沃的地块上，外包效益最为显著，这凸显了支持机械化和竞争性服务市场的政策重要性。

doi:10.1002/aepp.70096.title: Outsourcing Agricultural Services and Risk Reduction in Smallholder Rice Farming: Evidence From China and Global Implications
doi:10.1002/aepp.70096.title_zh: 农业服务外包与小农户水稻种植中的风险降低：来自中国的证据及全球启示

doi:10.1002/aepp.70097.abstract: To increase farmer adoption of green practices, the EU Common Agricultural Policy includes both mandatory (conditionality) and voluntary instruments (eco‐schemes–ECS– and more demanding, multi‐annual agri‐environment‐climate measures –AECM–). Building on the experiment of Barreiro‐Hurle et al. (2023), which focused on eco‐schemes, this paper analyses farmers' stated willingness to voluntarily adopt AECM. Using a framed experiment with 600 farmers in Spain, Germany, and Poland, we compared two policy interventions—higher mandatory environmental requirements and an equivalent reduction in income linked to CAP direct payments—and varied their intensity. Higher mandatory environmental requirements and an equivalent income reduction reduce the willingness to voluntarily adopt AECM. We also find a positive conditional association between the intensity of ECS adoption and the willingness to adopt AECM, suggesting potential spillover effects. We further show that behavioral factors, particularly perceived fairness of compensation, environmental concern, confidence in the environmental program, and CAP entitlement, explain substantially more variation in willingness to adopt AECM than standard structural and socio‐demographic characteristics (farm and farmer features). These results have implications for the upcoming envisaged CAP green architecture.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70097.abstract_zh: 摘要 为提升农民对绿色实践的采纳率，欧盟共同农业政策同时包含强制性（条件性）与自愿性工具（生态计划——ECS——以及要求更高、多年期的农业环境气候措施——AECM）。本文基于Barreiro‐Hurle等人（2023）聚焦生态计划的实验研究，进一步分析农民自愿采纳AECM的陈述意愿。通过对西班牙、德国和波兰600名农民开展框架实验，我们比较了两种政策干预——提高强制性环境要求与等额削减CAP直接支付相关的收入——并调整其强度。结果表明，更高的强制性环境要求与等额收入削减均会降低农民自愿采纳AECM的意愿。同时，我们发现ECS采纳强度与AECM采纳意愿之间存在正向条件关联，暗示潜在溢出效应。进一步分析显示，行为因素（尤其是补偿公平感知、环境关切、对环保项目的信心及CAP权益认知）对AECM采纳意愿的解释力显著高于标准的结构性与社会人口特征（农场与农民属性）。这些发现对即将实施的CAP绿色架构具有政策启示。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70097.title:
What Really Drives Agri‐Environment‐Climate Measures' Adoption? Mandatory Requirements, Behavioral Traits, and Structural Factors in the
                    <scp>CAP</scp>

doi:10.1002/aepp.70097.title_zh: 真正驱动农业-环境-气候措施采纳的因素是什么？CAP绿色架构中的强制性要求、行为特征与结构性因素

doi:10.1002/aepp.70098.abstract: Growing demand for healthier beverages is driving innovation in the wine sector, with dealcoholized wine emerging as a promising alternative. However, little is known about the contextual conditions under which consumers would choose dealcoholized wine, particularly in countries with strong wine traditions. To fill this gap, this work examines how situational factors and information treatments influence consumers' willingness to switch from traditional to dealcoholized wine in Italy and Croatia, two countries with different wine consumption traditions. Using a vignette‐based experiment administered to 1600 wine consumers, this study analyses how consumption context and product information affect the likelihood of choosing dealcoholized wine over conventional alternatives. The results show that, although conventional wine remains the preferred option under standard conditions, the likelihood of switching to dealcoholized wine increases when a driving constraint is introduced. Informational treatments significantly affect choices in Italy, whereas Croatian consumers appear to respond more to functional constraints than to calorie or health messages. The findings have implications for producers and policymakers seeking to promote dealcoholized wines.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70098.abstract_zh: 对更健康饮料的需求增长正推动葡萄酒行业创新，无醇葡萄酒正成为一种有前景的替代选择。然而，关于消费者在何种情境条件下会选择无醇葡萄酒，尤其是在具有深厚葡萄酒传统的国家，目前仍知之甚少。为填补这一空白，本研究考察了情境因素和信息处理如何影响意大利和克罗地亚（两个具有不同葡萄酒消费传统的国家）消费者从传统葡萄酒转向无醇葡萄酒的意愿。通过对1600名葡萄酒消费者进行基于情境实验的分析，本研究探讨了消费情境和产品信息如何影响选择无醇葡萄酒而非传统替代品的可能性。结果表明，尽管传统葡萄酒在标准条件下仍是首选，但当引入驾驶限制条件时，转向无醇葡萄酒的可能性增加。信息处理显著影响意大利消费者的选择，而克罗地亚消费者似乎对功能性限制的反应强于对卡路里或健康信息的反应。这些发现对寻求推广无醇葡萄酒的生产商和政策制定者具有启示意义。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70098.title: Promoting Healthier Drinking: Evidence From a Vignette Experiment on Contextual and Informational Drivers of Dealcoholized Wine Choices
doi:10.1002/aepp.70098.title_zh: 促进健康饮酒：情境与信息因素对无醇葡萄酒选择影响的场景实验证据

doi:10.1002/aepp.70099.abstract: This study examines the ecosystem benefits of expanding hemp cultivation by assessing its impact on crop diversity. Using scenario‐based simulations and fixed‐effect panel regressions with county‐level data in Kentucky, we find that increased hemp acreage tends to enhance crop diversity, improving water quality and bird diversity. While agricultural policies aimed at small‐scale farmers align with improving farm profitability, broader ecological benefits may remain limited unless they reach a sufficient scale. Our findings suggest that hemp‐induced crop diversification can generate measurable non‐market economic benefits through improvements in water quality and bird diversity, highlighting the need for practical and proactive policy measures that promote smallholder participation.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70099.abstract_zh: 本研究通过评估工业大麻种植对作物多样性的影响，探讨其带来的生态系统效益。基于肯塔基州县级数据的场景模拟与固定效应面板回归分析发现，工业大麻种植面积的增加倾向于提升作物多样性，进而改善水质与鸟类多样性。尽管面向小规模农户的农业政策与提升农场盈利能力的目标相契合，但若未达到足够规模，其更广泛的生态效益可能仍十分有限。研究结果表明，工业大麻引致的作物多样化可通过水质改善与鸟类多样性提升产生可量化的非市场经济效益，这凸显了制定切实可行且积极主动的政策措施以促进小农户参与的必要性。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70099.title: Hemp Cultivation and Crop Diversification: Implications for Ecosystem Services in Kentucky
doi:10.1002/aepp.70099.title_zh: 大麻种植与作物多样化：对肯塔基州生态系统服务的影响

doi:10.1002/aepp.70100.abstract: This article examines whether Latin American countries are keeping pace with global trends in trade agreement depth or falling behind. Using 681 agreements (1970–2019), we develop the Depth Index of Trade Agreements (DITA) to weight provisions endogenously through factor analysis based on co‐occurrence patterns. Results show that the Pacific Alliance and Central America lag one decade behind North American standards, whereas South America and the Caribbean lag by two to three decades. Partner selection is critical: countries negotiating extensively with developed partners tend to incorporate similar provisions into South–South agreements, suggesting North–South spillover effects. These findings suggest that regional lag reflects policy choices rather than inherent constraints.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70100.abstract_zh: 本文考察拉丁美洲国家在全球贸易协定深度趋势中是同步跟进还是落后。基于681项协定（1970-2019年），我们通过因子分析依据条款共现模式内生性加权，构建了贸易协定深度指数（DITA）。结果显示，太平洋联盟和中美洲落后于北美标准约十年，而南美洲和加勒比地区则落后二至三十年。合作伙伴选择至关重要：与发达国家进行广泛谈判的国家，倾向于将类似条款纳入南南协定中，这表明存在南北溢出效应。这些发现表明，区域滞后反映的是政策选择而非固有约束。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70100.title: Keeping Pace or Falling Behind? The Depth of Latin American Trade Agreements
doi:10.1002/aepp.70100.title_zh: 保持同步还是落后？拉丁美洲贸易协定的深度

doi:10.1002/aepp.70101.abstract: How food prices affect diet quality is an important question to design policies that can improve the nutrition and health of all Americans. This study investigates the association between food‐at‐home diet quality and aggregate food prices to understand if price movements compromise nutrition, and where price‐based policies could be an effective tool to improve population health. Using detailed household purchase data from 2015 to 2018, our findings suggest three insights. First, consumers make substitutions that largely preserve their given level of diet quality, though that level remains poor relative to recommendations for health. Second, we find minimal evidence of heterogeneous responsiveness to prices by diet quality or sociodemographic characteristics. Third, we find evidence that the substitutions consumers make in their protein choices when prices rise increase the healthfulness of their food baskets. Taken together, our study suggests that encouraging healthier diets probably requires more than pricing policies but that price‐based policies targeted at protein may be more effective than other food groups. That we fail to find evidence of differential responsiveness of diet quality to prices suggests that universal (untargeted) policies can be recommended to improve diets across the population. JEL Classification: D12, I12, Q18
doi:10.1002/aepp.70101.abstract_zh: 食品价格如何影响膳食质量，是设计改善全体美国人营养与健康政策的关键问题。本研究探究家庭食品膳食质量与总体食品价格之间的关联，以理解价格波动是否损害营养状况，以及基于价格的政策能否成为改善人口健康的有效工具。利用2015年至2018年的详细家庭购买数据，我们的发现揭示了三个要点。首先，消费者进行的替代行为大体上维持了其既有的膳食质量水平，尽管该水平相对于健康建议而言仍然较差。其次，我们几乎没有发现膳食质量或社会人口特征对价格存在异质性响应程度的证据。第三，我们发现证据表明，当价格上涨时，消费者在蛋白质选择上进行的替代行为提高了其食品篮子的健康程度。综合来看，我们的研究表明，鼓励更健康的膳食可能不仅需要定价政策，但针对蛋白质的基于价格的政策可能比其他食品类别更有效。我们未能发现膳食质量对价格存在差异化响应程度的证据，这表明可以推荐普遍性（非针对性）政策来改善全体人口的膳食。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70101.title: What Happens to Diet Quality When Food Prices Rise? Revealed Preference From National Household Scanner Data, 2015–2018
doi:10.1002/aepp.70101.title_zh: 食品价格上涨时膳食质量如何变化？基于2015–2018年全国家庭扫描数据的显示性偏好分析

doi:10.1002/aepp.70102.abstract: China's accession to the World Trade Organization in 2001 reshaped global trade, reducing U.S. demand for Mexican manufactured goods and weakening Mexico's manufacturing employment. This study estimates how this trade‐induced decline affected migration and employment decisions among rural Mexicans. Using individual‐level panel data from the Mexican National Rural Household Survey (ENHRUM) and a long‐difference framework, we instrument manufacturing employment with regional exposure to Chinese import competition. Results show that a 10‐percentage‐point decline in manufacturing employment increased the probability of U.S. migration by 24 percentage points and U.S. nonagricultural employment by 17 points, with no significant effects on agricultural employment.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70102.abstract_zh: 2001年中国加入世界贸易组织重塑了全球贸易格局，导致美国对墨西哥制成品的需求下降，进而削弱了墨西哥制造业的就业水平。本研究旨在估算这一贸易冲击引发的制造业就业萎缩对墨西哥农村人口迁移及就业决策的影响。基于墨西哥国家农村家庭调查（ENHRUM）的个体层面面板数据，采用长期差分框架，以各地区对中国进口竞争的暴露度作为制造业就业的工具变量。结果表明：制造业就业率每下降10个百分点，农村人口迁移至美国的概率增加24个百分点，在美国从事非农就业的概率上升17个百分点，而对农业就业未产生显著影响。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70102.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1002/aepp.70102.title: Chinese Trade Competition and Rural Mexican Migration
doi:10.1002/aepp.70102.title_zh: 中国贸易竞争与墨西哥农村移民

doi:10.1002/aepp.70103.abstract: Large ad hoc assistance programs have returned to U.S. farm policy since 2017, operating alongside a more developed safety net built around federally subsidized crop insurance, Title I commodity programs, and standing disaster assistance. This paper reviews the renewed use of ad hoc assistance, documents its recent scale using USDA data, and examines its implications for producers and policy design. Repeated ad hoc programs may create expectations of future support while leaving uncertainty about timing, eligibility, and payment formulas. They also raise questions about crop insurance incentives, targeting, transparency, taxpayer exposure, and coordination across safety‐net tools.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70103.abstract_zh: 摘要 自2017年以来，美国农业政策中重新出现了大规模临时援助计划，这些计划与围绕联邦补贴作物保险、第一标题商品计划及常设灾害援助构建的更为完善的安全网并行运作。本文回顾了临时援助的重新启用情况，利用美国农业部数据记录了其近期规模，并探讨了其对生产者及政策设计的影响。反复实施的临时计划可能形成对未来支持的预期，同时却在时间安排、资格认定及支付公式方面留下不确定性。此外，这些计划还引发了关于作物保险激励、目标定位、透明度、纳税人风险敞口以及安全网工具间协调性的问题。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70103.title: Temporary Programs, Lasting Questions: Ad Hoc Assistance in the U.S. Farm Safety Net
doi:10.1002/aepp.70103.title_zh: 临时项目，持久问题：美国农业安全网中的临时援助

doi:10.1002/aepp.70104.abstract: Some rural counties remain dependent on agricultural or manufacturing jobs, but an increasing proportion have diversified economics. Rural counties also differ in their abilities to commute to an urban market characterized by higher wages and labor productivity. National changes in immigration and trade policies have had heterogeneous effects on rural labor markets, with counties dependent on agriculture or food processing facing rising input costs and shrinking international output markets. Increased commuting will help some rural communities adapt, while more remote counties will face outmigration, population loss, and reduced capacity to sustain public services.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70104.abstract_zh: 部分农村县仍依赖农业或制造业就业，但越来越多的农村县已实现经济多元化。不同农村县在通勤至工资水平与劳动生产率更高的城市市场的能力方面也存在差异。国家移民与贸易政策的变化对农村劳动力市场产生了异质性影响，依赖农业或食品加工业的县面临投入成本上升与国际产出市场萎缩的双重压力。通勤便利性的提升将有助于部分农村社区适应变化，而更为偏远的县则将面临人口外迁、规模缩减以及公共服务维持能力下降的困境。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70104.title: Rural Labor Supply and Economic Opportunities: Commuting, Migration, Tariffs, and Immigration
doi:10.1002/aepp.70104.title_zh: 农村劳动力供给与经济机会：通勤、迁移、关税与移民

doi:10.1002/aepp.70105.abstract: We examine the impact of US–China trade policy announcements on corn and soybean markets. Using time‐series models, our results show that prospective tariff announcements significantly increased implied volatility (IV), especially during the 2018–2019 trade war. Our results show that corn and soybean markets responded to both countries' announcements. We observe the strongest volatility impacts at the 90% and 95% strikes. Our results indicate that higher IV raised hedging costs for producers, further constricting farm margins– a 7.5% rise in IV increased soybean option premiums by approximately 3.75%. These findings highlight the financial burden imposed by trade policy uncertainty beyond its impact on commodity prices.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70105.abstract_zh: 本文研究了美中贸易政策公告对玉米和大豆市场的影响。基于时间序列模型，我们的结果表明，预期关税公告显著提高了隐含波动率（IV），尤其是在2018–2019年贸易战期间。研究显示，玉米和大豆市场对两国的公告均有反应。我们在90%和95%执行价处观察到最强的波动率影响。结果指出，更高的隐含波动率提高了生产者的对冲成本，进一步压缩了农场利润——隐含波动率每上升7.5%，大豆期权溢价约增加3.75%。这些发现凸显了贸易政策不确定性在影响商品价格之外所带来的财务负担。
