doi:10.1002/aepp.70105.title: The Cost of Uncertainty: US–China Tariff Effects on Agricultural Commodity Markets
doi:10.1002/aepp.70105.title_zh: 不确定性的代价：美中关税对农产品市场的影响

doi:10.1002/aepp.70106.abstract: Since 2014, the number of schools offering universal free meals to all enrolled children without requiring annual meal applications has increased meaningfully. Using USDA's Purchase to Plate Crosswalk, a difference‐in‐differences framework, and a nationwide consumer panel, the effect of universal‐free‐meal exposure on the diet quality of food‐at‐home purchases is assessed in terms of the Healthy Eating Index (HEI). Consistent with earlier findings, households exposed to universal free meals reduce grocery spending by over 6%. There is no deleterious overall effect of universal‐free‐meal exposure on the diet quality of food‐at‐home purchases as measured by the HEI.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70106.abstract_zh: 摘要 自2014年以来，无需年度餐食申请即可向所有在校儿童提供免费餐食的学校数量显著增加。本研究利用美国农业部的"从采购到餐盘"数据转换工具、双重差分框架以及全国消费者面板数据，以健康饮食指数（HEI）为衡量标准，评估了普及免费餐食政策对家庭食品购买中居家饮食质量的影响。与早期研究结果一致，受普及免费餐食政策影响的家庭，其食品杂货支出减少了6%以上。以HEI为衡量指标，普及免费餐食政策对居家食品购买的整体饮食质量并未产生不利影响。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70106.title: Do Universal Free School Meals Improve the Dietary Quality of Food‐At‐Home Purchases?
doi:10.1002/aepp.70106.title_zh: 全民免费校餐能否改善家庭食品购买的膳食质量？

doi:10.1002/aepp.70107.abstract: Gene editing (GE) is gaining momentum worldwide, but limited data on UK farmers' preferences hinders our understanding of its potential impact amid deregulation debates. Based on a survey of 200 English arable farmers, we employ a Latent Class Analysis and Multinomial Logit regressions to investigate current preferences for GE crops. The analysis reveals a high willingness of adoption, outlines three preference profiles, including eager, wary, and hesitant adopters, and identify factors influencing such preferences. Results spot a possible substitution effect among GE crops and agricultural insurance, and suggest farmers may adopt GE in response to growing public demand for sustainable practices.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70107.abstract_zh: 摘要 基因编辑技术在全球范围内发展迅速，但关于英国农民偏好的数据有限，这阻碍了我们在放松管制辩论中理解其潜在影响。基于对200名英格兰耕地农民的调查，我们采用潜在类别分析和多项逻辑回归模型，研究当前对基因编辑作物的偏好。分析显示农民采用意愿较高，勾勒出三种偏好类型，包括积极采纳者、谨慎采纳者和犹豫采纳者，并识别出影响这些偏好的因素。结果揭示了基因编辑作物与农业保险之间可能存在的替代效应，并表明农民可能因公众对可持续实践日益增长的需求而采纳基因编辑技术。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70107.title: Farmers' Preferences for Gene Editing Crops and Influencing Factors
doi:10.1002/aepp.70107.title_zh: 农民对基因编辑作物的偏好及其影响因素

doi:10.1002/aepp.70108.abstract: This paper examines the relationship between participation in the EU Rural Development Program and the economic performance of Italian olive farms using a finite‐mixture model with inverse‐probability‐weighted regression adjustment. Based on 2010–2022 FADN panel data, it estimates heterogeneous treatment effects while correcting for selection bias. Results suggest that RDP participation is associated with higher net income, by about EUR 280/ha on average. Two farm clusters emerge, also reflecting different typologies of rural development program measure packages: family‐run farms in disadvantaged areas are often associated with agro‐climatic environmental commitments and related packages and gain about €265/ha. By contrast, more profitable and labor‐intensive farms are more frequently linked to less adopted measures and benefit only marginally. A Monte Carlo simulation assesses the estimator's performance under a controlled data‐generating process. The study highlights the need to account for structural heterogeneity in policy evaluation and supports data‐driven rural development strategies.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70108.abstract_zh: 本文采用有限混合模型与逆概率加权回归调整方法，探究欧盟农村发展计划参与对意大利橄榄农场经济绩效的影响。基于2010-2022年FADN面板数据，在纠正选择偏差的同时估计异质性处理效应。结果表明，参与农村发展计划与净收入提升相关，平均每公顷约增加280欧元。研究识别出两类农场集群，分别对应不同的农村发展计划措施组合类型：位于欠发达地区的家庭经营农场通常与农业气候环境承诺及相关措施包相关联，每公顷增收约265欧元；而利润更高、劳动密集型的农场则更多与采用率较低的措施相关，仅获得边际收益。通过蒙特卡洛模拟在受控数据生成过程中评估了估计量的表现。本研究强调政策评估中需考虑结构性异质性，并为数据驱动的农村发展战略提供支撑。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70108.title:
Differentiated Impacts of
                    <scp>EU</scp>
                    Rural Development Measures: A Finite Mixture Evaluation of Italian Olive Farms
doi:10.1002/aepp.70108.title_zh: 欧盟农村发展措施的差异化影响：意大利橄榄农场的有限混合评估

doi:10.1002/aepp.70109.abstract: We conducted two framed field economic experiments with citrus farmers in Florida, United States and soybean farmers in Argentina to investigate their willingness to coordinate pest and weed management efforts. Despite the contrast between these two agricultural contexts, we find striking behavioral commonalities. In both countries, farmers display aversion to strategic uncertainty, rely heavily on beliefs about their neighbors' actions when deciding whether to participate, and systematically underestimate the probability of successful coordination even when opportunity costs are low. These common findings across such different settings suggest that the underlying mechanisms are not context‐specific but instead reflect more general features of decision‐making under strategic interdependence, lending support to the external validity of our findings. The results highlight key psychological and economic barriers to cooperation and offer policy‐relevant insights for designing interventions to enhance participation in voluntary area‐wide pest management programs. While voluntary coordination can enhance pest management effectiveness and be pareto‐optimal, the success of the collective action depends on overcoming farmers' reluctance to participate. The evidence that farmers systematically underestimate the probability of successful coordination even when opportunity costs are low highlights a key behavioral barrier that can lead to coordination failures. Interventions that mitigate strategic uncertainty and build trust among participants—such as targeted subsidies or technical assistance—could encourage participation among farmers who would otherwise be unwilling to engage in coordinated efforts. Beyond the immediate application to pest and weed resistance management, our findings contribute to a broader understanding of cooperative behavior among farmers in the presence of strategic uncertainty.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70109.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们与美国佛罗里达州柑橘种植户及阿根廷大豆种植户合作开展了两项框架田野经济实验，旨在探究农户参与病虫害与杂草协同治理的意愿。尽管两国农业情境存在显著差异，但研究发现惊人的行为共性：两国农户均表现出对战略不确定性的规避倾向，其参与决策高度依赖对邻居行为的信念，且即便机会成本较低时仍系统性低估协同成功的概率。这些跨情境的共性发现表明，潜在机制并非情境特异性，而是反映了战略依存条件下决策的普遍特征，从而支持了研究结论的外部有效性。研究结果揭示了阻碍合作的关键心理与经济壁垒，为设计提升自愿性区域病虫害协同治理项目参与度的干预措施提供了政策启示。尽管自愿协同能提升病虫害治理效率并实现帕累托最优，但集体行动的成功取决于能否克服农户的参与惰性。农户在机会成本较低时仍系统性低估协同成功概率的证据，凸显了导致协同失灵的关键行为障碍。通过定向补贴或技术援助等缓解战略不确定性、建立参与者信任的干预措施，可促使原本不愿参与协同行动的农户加入。除直接应用于病虫害抗性治理外，本研究还为理解战略不确定性下农户合作行为提供了更广泛的理论视角。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70109.title: Voluntary Collective Action to Address Growing Agricultural Challenges in Two Countries: Experimental Insights and Commonalities
doi:10.1002/aepp.70109.title_zh: 两国应对日益严峻农业挑战的自愿集体行动：实验洞见与共性

doi:10.1002/aepp.70110.abstract: Federally subsidized crop insurance is a cornerstone of U.S. farm risk management, yet policies with the greatest share of participation only trigger indemnities after losses exceed 15%. Supplemental insurance was introduced to cover part of this deductible, but participation remains largely unchanged. Using 1,005,245 sub‐county aggregated insurance observations and applying novel calibration and simulation methods, we show that low participation in supplemental coverage limits risk reduction potential. While basic insurance provides a foundation, adding supplemental policies meaningfully improves downside risk reduction and income transfer. Although these gains involve higher premiums, a benefit‐per‐premium analysis still favors broader use. These results reflect potential program impacts conditional on adoption, recognizing that actual participation depends on farmer preferences, risk perceptions, and institutional constraints.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70110.abstract_zh: 联邦补贴作物保险是美国农业风险管理的基石，但参与率最高的保单仅在损失超过15%后才触发赔付。补充保险旨在覆盖部分免赔额，但参与率基本未变。利用1,005,245个次县级汇总保险观测数据，并应用新型校准与模拟方法，我们发现补充保险的低参与率限制了风险降低潜力。虽然基础保险提供了保障基础，但增加补充保单能显著改善下行风险降低和收入转移效果。尽管这些收益伴随更高保费，但每单位保费收益分析仍支持更广泛使用。这些结果反映了在采用条件下的潜在项目影响，同时认识到实际参与取决于农户偏好、风险感知和制度约束。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70110.title: Low Participation and Risk Reduction Potential of Supplemental Crop Insurance in the United States
doi:10.1002/aepp.70110.title_zh: 美国补充性农作物保险的低参与率与风险降低潜力

doi:10.1002/aepp.70111.abstract: Biosecurity trade restrictions are commonly framed as preventive measures, yet in many settings they function primarily as policies of delay: they impose immediate market costs while only postponing the arrival of biological risks. This paper evaluates that intertemporal tradeoff using the 2024–2025 US suspension of live cattle imports from Mexico in response to the northward spread of New World Screwworm (NWS). We estimate a vector autoregression (VAR) using monthly data from 2004 to 2025 to characterize pre‐ban dynamics in feeder cattle prices, Mexican import volumes, fed cattle prices, and feed costs, and construct counterfactual forecasts for prices and trade flows absent the border closures. Translating these costs into a simple break‐even framework shows that under an annual endemic‐loss assumption of $10 billion, each additional month of border closure would need to delay endemic NWS establishment by approximately 4 months to be welfare improving.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70111.abstract_zh: 摘要 生物安全贸易限制通常被视为预防性措施，但在许多情境下，它们主要发挥延迟政策的作用：这些限制在施加即时市场成本的同时，仅能推迟生物风险的到来。本文利用2024-2025年美国因新世界螺旋蝇（NWS）向北蔓延而暂停从墨西哥进口活牛的案例，评估了这一跨期权衡。我们基于2004年至2025年的月度数据，估计了一个向量自回归（VAR）模型，以刻画禁运前架子牛价格、墨西哥进口量、育肥牛价格及饲料成本之间的动态关系，并构建了无边境关闭情形下价格与贸易流的反事实预测。将这些成本转化为简单的盈亏平衡框架后显示，在每年10亿美元的地方性损失假设下，边境关闭每延长一个月，需将NWS地方性建立推迟约4个月，才能实现福利改善。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70111.title: Delaying the Inevitable? U.S. Screwworm Closures and Feeder Cattle Market Dynamics
doi:10.1002/aepp.70111.title_zh: 推迟不可避免之事？美国螺旋蝇检疫封锁与架子牛市场动态

doi:10.1002/aepp.70112.abstract: Using an enhanced Computable General Equilibrium (CGE) model (GTAP‐BIO), this study assesses how the expansion in demand for Electric Vehicles (EVs) and the reduction in exports of agricultural products induced by trade disputes negatively affect US agriculture. It then evaluates the extent to which producing Sustainable Aviation Fuels (SAFs) from corn and soybeans could mitigate these effects. Results show that EV expansion reduces gasoline demand, suppresses corn production, lowers farm incomes, and generates idled capacity, including increases in uncultivated cropland. Export tariffs further amplify these effects. Expansion in SAF produced from corn and soybean could partially limit these consequences.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70112.abstract_zh: 本研究采用增强型可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型（GTAP-BIO），评估电动汽车（EV）需求扩张及贸易争端导致的农产品出口减少对美国农业的负面影响，并进一步分析利用玉米和大豆生产可持续航空燃料（SAFs）在多大程度上能够缓解这些影响。结果表明，电动汽车扩张降低了汽油需求，抑制了玉米生产，减少了农业收入，并导致产能闲置，包括未耕种农田面积的增加。出口关税进一步放大了这些效应。扩大以玉米和大豆为原料的可持续航空燃料生产可在一定程度上限制上述后果。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70112.title: U.S. Agriculture, Biofuel Markets, and Trade: Challenges and Opportunities
doi:10.1002/aepp.70112.title_zh: 美国农业、生物燃料市场与贸易：挑战与机遇

doi:10.1002/aepp.70114.abstract: This study analyzed post‐COVID‐19 trends in food prices in Brazil and projected changes through 2026. Time series from the 2017/2018 Household Budget Survey, the National System of Consumer Price Indexes, and the Continuous National Household Sample Survey were analyzed using Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (SARIMA) models. Between 2018 and 2024, prices of ultra‐processed food products (UPFP) decreased by 16%, while unprocessed or minimally processed foods and culinary ingredients increased, narrowing the price gap. The nominal prices of food groups rose more than nominal household income between 2018 and 2024, particularly for unprocessed or minimally processed foods and culinary ingredients. Projections indicate that UPFP will remain the cheapest group by 2026, reinforcing barriers to healthy diets and supporting tax policies.
doi:10.1002/aepp.70114.abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究分析了巴西在新冠疫情后的食品价格趋势，并预测了截至2026年的变化。研究利用2017/2018年家庭预算调查、国家消费者价格指数体系以及连续全国住户抽样调查的时间序列数据，采用季节性自回归积分滑动平均模型（SARIMA）进行分析。2018年至2024年间，超加工食品（UPFP）价格下降了16%，而未加工或 minimally 加工食品及烹饪原料的价格则有所上涨，从而缩小了价格差距。2018年至2024年间，各类食品的名义价格涨幅超过了名义家庭收入，尤其是未加工或 minimally 加工食品及烹饪原料。预测显示，到2026年，超加工食品仍将是最便宜的类别，这加剧了健康饮食的障碍，并为税收政策提供了支持依据。
doi:10.1002/aepp.70114.title: Food Price Trends and Projections in Brazil (2018–2026): Implications for Access to Adequate and Healthy Food
doi:10.1002/aepp.70114.title_zh: 巴西食品价格趋势与预测（2018-2026年）：对获取充足健康食品的影响

doi:10.1002/ajae.70072.abstract: Irrigation is widely recognized as a key driver of agricultural productivity and rural economic development, yet credible evidence on its impacts, mechanisms, and long‐term economic returns remains limited due to endogenous irrigation investments. Leveraging the timing of government irrigation investments and longitudinal household survey data spanning 15 years, we investigate how irrigation affects agricultural productivity. We find that irrigation investment increased the share of irrigated farmland by 11.0 percentage points, which in turn raised per‐area output by 14.9%, net agricultural income by 15.6%, agricultural total factor productivity by 13.7%, and per‐labor output by 36.2%. These effects are driven by four key mechanisms: increased use of high‐productivity inputs, expanded cultivation area, labor reallocation from farm work to off‐farm work, and mitigation of drought damage. The induced land expansion and labor reallocation explain the substantially larger increase in per‐labor output. A cost‐effectiveness analysis suggests a high return to irrigation investment, with approximately half of the return stemming from labor reallocation that increased off‐farm income. These results provide strong evidence that irrigation investment plays an important role in improving agricultural productivity and accelerating rural transformation, with benefits extending beyond the farm by influencing labor markets.
doi:10.1002/ajae.70072.abstract_zh: 灌溉被广泛认为是农业生产力与农村经济发展的关键驱动力，然而由于灌溉投资的内生性问题，关于其影响、机制及长期经济回报的可靠证据仍然有限。利用政府灌溉投资的时机以及跨越15年的纵向农户调查数据，我们研究了灌溉如何影响农业生产力。研究发现，灌溉投资使灌溉农田比例提高了11.0个百分点，进而使单位面积产出增加14.9%，农业净收入增加15.6%，农业全要素生产率提高13.7%，人均产出增加36.2%。这些效应由四个关键机制驱动：高生产率投入品使用增加、种植面积扩大、劳动力从农业向非农就业重新配置，以及干旱损害缓解。土地扩张和劳动力重新配置共同解释了人均产出更大幅度的增长。成本效益分析表明，灌溉投资回报率较高，其中约一半的回报来自劳动力重新配置所增加的非农收入。这些结果有力证明，灌溉投资在提升农业生产力和加速农村转型中发挥重要作用，其效益通过影响劳动力市场而延伸至农业领域之外。
doi:10.1002/ajae.70072.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1002/ajae.70072.title: Irrigation investments and agricultural productivity in Northern China
doi:10.1002/ajae.70072.title_zh: 中国北方灌溉投资与农业生产力

doi:10.1002/ajae.70076.abstract: This paper derives a firm‐level threshold, the Herfindahl Neutral Point, from the standard concentration index used in merger review. At this threshold, a marginal expansion leaves the index unchanged. Firms below the threshold reduce concentration when they expand; firms above it increase concentration. We derive exact formulas for discrete capacity additions and define bridging amounts that measure how far each firm sits from the threshold. Applying this framework to monthly federally inspected hog slaughter data from 2004 to 2024, we show that the sharp rise in concentration in 2016 is driven by acquisitions at firms that were near the threshold and then crossed it, while the subsequent partial decline reflects sustained growth among mid‐tier packers operating below it. The 2015 acquisition of Cargill's pork business illustrates how bridging amounts organize merger analysis within a standard concentration screen. Reallocating the $34.7 million in federal capacity grants awarded to hog‐sector processors under a targeting rule based on this threshold lowers the 2024 national hog packing Herfindahl–Hirschman Index by about 147 points relative to the pre‐award baseline. The framework requires only market shares and the baseline concentration index.
doi:10.1002/ajae.70076.abstract_zh: 本文从并购审查中使用的标准集中度指数出发，推导出一个企业层面的阈值——赫芬达尔中性点。在该阈值处，边际扩张不会改变指数值。低于该阈值的企业扩张时会降低集中度；高于该阈值的企业扩张则会提高集中度。我们推导出离散产能增加的确切公式，并定义了衡量每个企业距离该阈值远近的“桥梁量”。将该分析框架应用于2004年至2024年联邦月度生猪屠宰数据，我们发现2016年集中度的急剧上升是由接近阈值并随后跨越该阈值的企业收购所驱动，而随后的部分下降则反映了在该阈值以下运营的中型加工企业的持续增长。2015年嘉吉猪肉业务的收购案例展示了“桥梁量”如何在标准集中度筛查框架内组织并购分析。基于该阈值的目标规则，将联邦向生猪行业加工商提供的3470万美元产能拨款重新分配，可使2024年全国生猪屠宰赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数相较于拨款前基线降低约147点。该框架仅需市场份额和基线集中度指数。
doi:10.1002/ajae.70076.title: The Herfindahl neutral point: A firm‐level threshold for managing market concentration with evidence from US hog packing
doi:10.1002/ajae.70076.title_zh: 赫芬达尔中性点：基于美国生猪加工企业数据的市场集中度管理阈值

doi:10.1002/ajae.70077.abstract: Preferential trade agreements (PTAs) contain various non‐tariff provisions, yet identifying their trade effects remains challenging because these commitments are high‐dimensional and strongly correlated within agreements. We estimated a theory‐consistent structural gravity model with domestic flows for 26 agricultural subsectors over 1988–2017 and employed a plug‐in Elastic Net‐penalized PPML approach to isolate the provisions that systematically shape agricultural trade. The procedure identifies 13 provisions that are particularly important for agricultural trade, spanning trade facilitation, SPS/TBT disciplines, and rules on competition and subsidies. After accounting for the impact of preferential tariff rates, a generic PTA indicator is still estimated to increase trade by 20%. This effect is absorbed once the identified provision bundle is included, demonstrating that trade patterns under PTAs are primarily shaped by specific non‐tariff commitments. The results point to clear channels: facilitation and transparency provisions are trade‐promoting, whereas stronger reliance on international standards is associated with lower trade, consistent with compliance‐cost mechanisms.
doi:10.1002/ajae.70077.abstract_zh: 优惠贸易协定（PTAs）包含多种非关税条款，但由于这些承诺具有高维特征且在同一协定内高度相关，识别其贸易效应仍具挑战性。我们基于1988-2017年26个农业子部门数据，采用包含国内贸易流的理论一致性结构引力模型，并运用插件式弹性网络惩罚泊松伪最大似然估计法，筛选出系统性影响农产品贸易的条款。该程序识别出13项对农产品贸易尤为重要的条款，涵盖贸易便利化、卫生与植物卫生措施/技术性贸易壁垒（SPS/TBT）纪律以及竞争与补贴规则。在控制优惠关税税率影响后，通用PTA指标仍显示贸易增长20%。当纳入已识别的条款组合后，该效应被完全吸收，表明PTA下的贸易模式主要由特定非关税承诺塑造。研究结果揭示了明确的作用渠道：便利化与透明度条款促进贸易，而对国际标准的更强依赖则与贸易下降相关，这与合规成本机制相一致。
doi:10.1002/ajae.70077.title: Preferential trading in agriculture: New insights from a structural gravity analysis and machine learning
doi:10.1002/ajae.70077.title_zh: 农业优惠贸易：基于结构引力分析与机器学习的新见解

doi:10.1002/ajae.70078.abstract: Common‐pool resources—such as collectively‐owned grasslands—are often overused and depleted until effective conservation strategies are put into place. We conducted a lab‐in‐the‐field experiment to examine the performance of different management strategies on the sustainability of common‐pool grassland management in China. We designed three experimental interventions—reward, punishment, and communication—to evaluate how to cost‐effectively promote grassland conservation. Results reveal that the communication treatment is as effective as the reward and punishment treatments in promoting grassland conservation. However, unlike the reward treatment, communication does not require external funding or create income inequality among herders, and unlike the punishment treatment, it avoids undesirable impacts such as reducing herders' net payoffs. A mechanism analysis suggests that our communication treatment shifts herders' focus from exploitation to conservation. Our results indicate that incorporating communication interventions into grassland management strategies could improve their overall performance.
doi:10.1002/ajae.70078.abstract_zh: 公共池资源——例如集体所有的草原——往往因过度使用而枯竭，直至有效的保护策略得以实施。我们开展了一项实地实验室实验，考察不同管理策略对中国公共池草原管理可持续性的影响。我们设计了三种实验干预措施——奖励、惩罚和沟通——以评估如何以成本有效的方式促进草原保护。结果表明，沟通干预在促进草原保护方面与奖励和惩罚干预同样有效。然而，与奖励干预不同，沟通干预无需外部资金支持，也不会在牧民之间造成收入不平等；与惩罚干预不同，它避免了降低牧民净收益等不良影响。机制分析表明，我们的沟通干预将牧民的关注点从开发利用转向保护。研究结果表明，将沟通干预纳入草原管理策略可提升其整体绩效。
doi:10.1002/ajae.70078.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1002/ajae.70078.title: Performance of reward, punishment, and communication in common‐pool resource management: Evidence from grassland conservation in China
doi:10.1002/ajae.70078.title_zh: 奖励、惩罚与沟通在公共池塘资源管理中的绩效：来自中国草原保护的证据

doi:10.1002/ajae.70079.abstract: Individual Fishing Quotas (IFQs) have the potential to lead to higher ex‐vessel prices by reducing market gluts and improving product quality. While IFQs have been introduced in a number of fisheries in recent decades, few causal studies investigate their price effects. Using synthetic control methods on US reef‐fish fisheries, we show that IFQs significantly increase prices for red snapper, red grouper, gag grouper, yellowedge grouper, scamp grouper, and tilefish. We also find significant positive price spillovers to adjacent, untreated fisheries. A primary challenge to unbiased estimation using synthetic control is treatment spillover, which can contaminate both never‐treated units in the donor pool and to‐be‐treated units in a staggered implementation. When control (donor) units are subject to these spillovers, this can lead to either attenuation or divergence of the causal estimate, depending on the empirical setting. To address this estimation challenge, we propose a framework relying on economic theory (market arbitrage and product substitution) and empirical analysis (e.g., market integration or demand estimation) to inform both donor selection and the timing of the treatment start date. As a result, our proposed structure improves the accuracy of synthetic control estimates, as shown by a small Monte Carlo experiment. Furthermore, by pre‐identifying contaminated units, our framework allows for the direct measurement of the spillover effects themselves.
doi:10.1002/ajae.70079.abstract_zh: 个人捕捞配额（IFQs）可能通过减少市场过剩和改善产品质量来提高离岸价格。尽管近几十年来多个渔业已引入IFQs，但关于其价格效应的因果研究仍较为匮乏。通过在美国礁石鱼类渔业中应用合成控制方法，我们发现IFQs显著提高了红鲷鱼、红石斑鱼、黑斑石斑鱼、黄边石斑鱼、斑纹石斑鱼和方头鱼的价格。同时，我们还发现IFQs对邻近未受政策影响的渔业产生了显著的正向价格溢出效应。使用合成控制方法进行无偏估计的主要挑战在于处理溢出效应——这种效应可能污染供体池中从未受处理的单元，以及在分阶段实施中即将受处理的单元。当控制（供体）单元受到这些溢出效应影响时，因果估计可能产生衰减或发散，具体取决于实证环境。为应对这一估计挑战，我们提出一个基于经济理论（市场套利与产品替代）和实证分析（如市场整合或需求估计）的框架，以指导供体选择和处理起始时间的确定。通过小型蒙特卡洛实验验证，我们提出的结构显著提升了合成控制估计的准确性。此外，通过预先识别受污染的单元，该框架还能直接测量溢出效应本身。
doi:10.1002/ajae.70079.title: An economic approach to mitigating spillover bias in synthetic control methods: An application to the price effects of fishing quotas
doi:10.1002/ajae.70079.title_zh: 减轻合成控制法中溢出偏差的经济学方法：以捕捞配额价格效应为例

doi:10.1002/ajae.70080.abstract: Dark sky conservation is increasingly popular, requiring facility upgrades and community cooperation. This study assesses its economic benefits at Great Sand Dunes National Park and Preserve, a Gold Tier International Dark Sky Park. Through on‐site surveys, we collected data on visitor behaviors, expenditures, and night sky perceptions. We introduced a continuum of contingent night sky brightness levels based on visitors' home locations and measured changes in visitation. Our Travel Cost‐Contingent Behavior analysis shows that each unit increase in nightlight decreases visitation by 0.05 days over 5 years. Using a weighted Latent Class Negative Binomial (LCNB) model, we estimate consumer welfare losses under escalating nightlight pollution scenarios. If the park's night skies matched an average rural, suburban, or urban area, visitors' consumer surplus would fall by about 3%, 23–24%, and 42–44%, respectively. These results underscore the substantial economic value of preserving dark skies.
doi:10.1002/ajae.70080.abstract_zh: 暗夜保护日益受到重视，这需要设施升级和社区协作。本研究评估了大沙丘国家公园与保护区（国际金级暗夜公园）暗夜保护的经济效益。通过实地问卷调查，我们收集了游客行为、消费支出及夜空感知数据。基于游客居住地的光污染水平，我们构建了连续性的条件夜间天空亮度梯度，并测量了游客量的变化。旅行成本-条件行为分析显示，夜间灯光每增加一个单位，五年内游客量将减少0.05天。采用加权潜类负二项模型，我们估算了夜间灯光污染加剧情景下的消费者福利损失。若公园夜空亮度分别达到普通乡村、郊区或城市水平，游客消费者剩余将分别下降约3%、23-24%和42-44%。这些结果凸显了保护暗夜天空的巨大经济价值。
doi:10.1002/ajae.70080.title: Contingent behavior modeling for dark skies valuation at Great Sand Dunes National Park
doi:10.1002/ajae.70080.title_zh: 大沙丘国家公园暗夜天空评估中的条件行为建模

doi:10.1002/ajae.70081.abstract: This paper examines how a natural disaster, the Dust Bowl, shapes occupational choices in farm households across generations. Using full‐count US census data, I find that young adult sons shift away from self‐employed farming toward wage farm work and nonagricultural sectors after the Dust Bowl. Younger children with affected farming parents are more likely to leave agriculture and earn higher income. Migration and schooling serve as mechanisms, and New Deal relief spending mitigates the Dust Bowl's effects. Overall, the Dust Bowl accelerated occupational reallocation among younger children of farmers and contributed to US mid‐20th century structural change.
doi:10.1002/ajae.70081.abstract_zh: 本文考察了自然灾害“沙尘暴”如何跨代塑造农户家庭的职业选择。利用美国人口普查全量数据，我发现沙尘暴后，年轻成年儿子从自营农业转向雇佣农业劳动和非农部门。受影响的农民家庭中，年幼子女更可能离开农业并获得更高收入。迁移与教育是作用机制，而新政救济支出缓解了沙尘暴的影响。总体而言，沙尘暴加速了农民年轻子女的职业再配置，并推动了美国20世纪中期的结构性变革。
doi:10.1002/ajae.70081.title:
Natural disaster and intergenerational occupational choice in agriculture: Evidence from the
                    <scp>US</scp>
                    Dust Bowl
doi:10.1002/ajae.70081.title_zh: 自然灾害与农业代际职业选择：来自美国沙尘暴的证据

doi:10.1002/ajae.70082.abstract: Voluntary agricultural land retirement programs are widely recognized for their environmental benefits, yet their economic effects, particularly on labor markets and land tenure, remain less understood. This paper examines the short‐ and long‐term impacts of the first large‐scale US land retirement initiative, the historical Conservation Reserve Program, introduced under the 1956 Set‐Aside Act. Between 1957 and 1960, the program enrolled more than 30 million acres under 3‐, 5‐, or 10‐year contracts, which then expired gradually through 1970. Using a newly digitized Conservation Reserve Program enrollment database linked to agricultural census data from the 1950s through the 1970s, we find that counties with medium and high enrollment intensity experienced statistically significant declines in tenant‐cultivated land relative to low‐enrollment counties during the program's active years. In medium‐enrollment counties, tenant‐operated land declined by roughly 0.6 percentage points, while high‐enrollment counties experienced declines of approximately 1.6 percentage points nationally. The proportion of tenant farm operators also fell in both medium‐ and high‐enrollment counties. These effects were larger and more persistent in the South, especially in counties with higher shares of nonwhite farm operators and sharecropping.
doi:10.1002/ajae.70082.abstract_zh: 自愿性农业土地休耕项目因其环境效益而广受认可，但其经济影响——特别是对劳动力市场和土地保有权的影响——仍鲜为人知。本文考察了美国首个大规模土地休耕计划——1956年《预留法案》下设立的历史性保护储备计划——的短期与长期影响。1957年至1960年间，该计划以3年、5年或10年合同形式纳入了超过3000万英亩土地，这些合同随后于1970年前逐步到期。通过将新数字化的保护储备计划登记数据库与20世纪50年代至70年代的农业普查数据相关联，我们发现：在项目活跃期，中等和高强度登记县相对于低登记县，租佃耕地面积出现了统计上显著的下降。在全国范围内，中等登记县的租佃经营土地面积下降约0.6个百分点，而高登记县则下降约1.6个百分点。中等和高登记县的租佃农场经营者比例也同步下降。这些效应在南方地区更为显著且持久，尤其在非白人农场经营者及分成制佃农比例较高的县份表现突出。
doi:10.1002/ajae.70082.title: Consequences of land retirement policies on agricultural labor and land tenure: Evidence from the historical Conservation Reserve Program in the United States
doi:10.1002/ajae.70082.title_zh: 土地休耕政策对农业劳动力和土地保有权的影响：来自美国历史性保护储备计划的证据

doi:10.1002/ajae.70083.abstract: To evaluate the role played by startup companies in the innovation ecosystem of US agriculture, we compile a unique dataset of 6024 new entrants founded 1987–2019 that details their financing lifecycles, annual economic performance, and patenting activities. One‐third of the firms in the sample have observable signs of contributing to innovation, including patenting and external financing such as grants and venture capital, thus characterizing them as startups. Such startups and their financing have grown substantially over the period studied. We use discrete‐time survival analysis to test factors related to firms receiving venture financing as well as to firms achieving successful financial exits. We find those firms that file for patents have higher likelihood of receiving financing than those that do not. Patent filings also increase the relative probability of a successful financial exit, which takes place primarily through mergers and acquisitions. In about a third of such exits, startups are acquired by corporate incumbents in agriculture well positioned to scale up and commercialize those startups' innovations for US agriculture. Importantly, a substantial portion of firms in the sample are still too young to have attained venture financing let alone a financial exit.
doi:10.1002/ajae.70083.abstract_zh: 为评估初创企业在美国农业创新生态系统中的作用，我们构建了一个包含1987-2019年间成立的6024家新企业的独特数据集，详细记录了其融资生命周期、年度经济绩效及专利活动。样本中三分之一的公司展现出可观测的创新贡献迹象，包括专利申请及获得赠款、风险投资等外部融资，从而被界定为初创企业。此类初创企业及其融资规模在研究期间显著增长。我们采用离散时间生存分析法，检验影响企业获得风险融资及实现成功财务退出的因素。研究发现，提交专利申请的企业获得融资的可能性高于未申请企业。专利申请同时提高了企业成功实现财务退出的相对概率，此类退出主要通过并购完成。在约三分之一的退出案例中，初创企业被农业领域具备规模化推广及商业化能力的现有企业收购，从而将其创新成果应用于美国农业。值得注意的是，样本中相当比例的企业仍处于发展初期，尚未获得风险融资，更遑论实现财务退出。
doi:10.1002/ajae.70083.title: The role of venture‐financed startups in innovation for US agriculture
doi:10.1002/ajae.70083.title_zh: 风险投资支持的初创企业在美国农业创新中的作用

doi:10.1002/ajae.70084.abstract: We introduce a fully nonparametric estimator to estimate willingness to pay (WTP) using contingent valuation (CV) data. Traditional methods such as the probit model are used because of their roots in utility theory as well as their ease to implement. However, they are limited by their reliance on strict parametric assumptions, such as linearity and the requirement that the researcher pre‐select important covariates. While these methods are widely used, they may fail to capture complex relationships, particularly in situations involving nonlinearity or interactions among variables. This paper introduces Bayesian Additive Regression Trees (BART) as a flexible, nonparametric way to estimate WTP from CV studies. Using a simulation study, we demonstrate that BART is competitive with traditional models under strict data‐generating assumptions. When the underlying data‐generating process is more complex, BART outperforms traditional models and even other machine‐learning models. Moreover, BART automatically incorporates individual heterogeneity into estimation, making it more informative than traditional nonparametric estimators. We illustrate the breadth of the model's benefits with an empirical application estimating WTP to develop an Invasive Species Rapid Response Fund in the Hawaiian Islands. We find WTP distributional differences along the margins of gender, age, and income. We also construct willingness to pay curves out of Monte Carlo Markov Chain (MCMC) draws and calculate posterior means and credible intervals using empirical cumulative distribution functions (CDFs). We find these WTP to be lower than those from the probit. Future natural extensions of BART make this method a compelling alternative for estimating WTP in CV experiments.
doi:10.1002/ajae.70084.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种完全非参数估计方法，利用条件价值评估（CV）数据来估计支付意愿（WTP）。传统方法如probit模型因其植根于效用理论且易于实施而被广泛使用。然而，这些方法受限于严格的参数假设，例如线性关系以及研究者需预先选择重要协变量的要求。尽管这些方法应用广泛，但在涉及非线性或变量间交互作用的复杂情境中，可能无法捕捉真实关系。本文引入贝叶斯加性回归树（BART）作为一种灵活的非参数方法，用于从CV研究中估计WTP。通过模拟研究，我们证明在严格的数据生成假设下，BART与传统模型表现相当。当底层数据生成过程更为复杂时，BART优于传统模型甚至其他机器学习模型。此外，BART自动将个体异质性纳入估计，使其比传统非参数估计器更具信息量。我们通过一项实证应用展示了该模型的广泛优势，该应用估计了夏威夷群岛建立入侵物种快速响应基金的支付意愿。研究发现，WTP在性别、年龄和收入边际上存在分布差异。我们还利用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）抽样构建了支付意愿曲线，并通过经验累积分布函数（CDFs）计算后验均值和可信区间。结果显示，这些WTP估计值低于probit模型的结果。BART未来的自然扩展使其成为CV实验中估计WTP的有力替代方法。
doi:10.1002/ajae.70084.title: Not just a random forest: Using Bayesian additive regression trees to estimate willingness to pay to protect critical habitat
doi:10.1002/ajae.70084.title_zh: 不仅仅是随机森林：使用贝叶斯加性回归树估计保护关键栖息地的支付意愿

doi:10.1002/ajae.70085.abstract: This paper examines the causal effects of a school feeding program on maternal empowerment and household consumption in rural China. Exploiting the staggered implementation of the Student Nutrition Improvement Program, we find that the program significantly reduces maternal time spent on housework, improves maternal labor market performance, and enhances maternal decision‐making power within nuclear households. The augmented bargaining power translates into shifts in household consumption toward female‐prioritized goods, including more nutritious foods, clothing, and housework‐related appliances. However, these positive effects on maternal empowerment are diminished in multigenerational families, where grandparents can assist with childcare responsibilities.
doi:10.1002/ajae.70085.abstract_zh: 本文考察了学校供餐计划对中国农村地区女性赋权及家庭消费的因果效应。利用学生营养改善计划的分阶段实施，我们发现该计划显著减少了母亲的家务劳动时间，改善了母亲在劳动力市场的表现，并增强了母亲在核心家庭中的决策权。这种议价能力的提升促使家庭消费转向女性优先商品，包括更营养的食品、衣物及家务相关电器。然而，在多代同堂的家庭中，由于祖父母可协助承担育儿责任，这些对女性赋权的积极影响有所减弱。
doi:10.1002/ajae.70085.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1002/ajae.70085.title: School feeding, maternal empowerment, and household consumption
doi:10.1002/ajae.70085.title_zh: 学校供餐、女性赋权与家庭消费

doi:10.1002/ajae.70086.abstract: Lifting smallholder farmers out of poverty depends largely on boosting their agricultural operating incomes, a persistent challenge despite numerous efforts. This study evaluates the impact of China's “E‐Commerce into the Countryside” (ECC) program—the first and largest e‐commerce initiative in the developing world—on both the level and distribution of smallholders' farm earnings. Employing a quasi‐experimental design, we find that the ECC program significantly increases household per capita agricultural operating income. We show that this gain is driven by expanded market access through online sales, which facilitate income growth via three primary mechanisms: operational scale expansion, higher output prices, and a shift toward high‐value‐added crops. However, these benefits are unevenly distributed. The program also widens the income gap among smallholders, a disparity largely attributable to pre‐existing differences in human, productive, and digital capital. Our findings highlight that e‐commerce policies, while potent for income generation, require complementary measures to mitigate disparities that arise from heterogeneous initial endowments.
doi:10.1002/ajae.70086.abstract_zh: 使小农户摆脱贫困在很大程度上取决于提高其农业经营收入，尽管付出了诸多努力，这仍是一项长期挑战。本研究评估了中国"电子商务进农村"（ECC）计划——发展中国家首个也是规模最大的电子商务举措——对小农户农业收入水平及分布的影响。采用准实验设计，我们发现ECC计划显著提高了家庭人均农业经营收入。研究表明，这一增长源于通过在线销售扩大市场准入，并通过三种主要机制促进收入增长：经营规模扩大、产出价格提高以及向高附加值作物转型。然而，这些收益的分配并不均衡。该计划还扩大了小农户之间的收入差距，这种差距在很大程度上可归因于人力资本、生产资本和数字资本的既有差异。我们的研究结果表明，电子商务政策虽能有效促进收入增长，但需要配套措施来缓解因初始禀赋异质性而产生的差距。
doi:10.1002/ajae.70086.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1002/ajae.70086.title: When e‐commerce meets smallholders: Boosting incomes and widening gaps in rural China's anti‐poverty policy
doi:10.1002/ajae.70086.title_zh: 电子商务遇上小农户：中国农村扶贫政策中的收入提升与差距扩大

doi:10.1002/jae.70057.abstract: Double/debiased machine learning (DML) uses for estimating an average treatment effect (ATE) a double‐robust score function that relies on the prediction of nuisance functions, such as the propensity score, which is the probability of treatment assignment given covariates. Estimators relying on double‐robust score functions are highly sensitive to errors in propensity score predictions. Machine learning algorithms have been found to produce models that often overestimate or underestimate these probabilities. Several calibration approaches have been proposed to improve probabilistic forecasts of machine learners. This paper explores their integration into the DML framework, showing via simulations that using calibrated propensity scores significantly reduces the root mean squared error of ATE estimates in finite samples while preserving DML's asymptotic properties.
doi:10.1002/jae.70057.abstract_zh: 双重/去偏机器学习（DML）利用双稳健得分函数来估计平均处理效应（ATE），该函数依赖于对干扰函数的预测，例如倾向得分——即在给定协变量条件下接受处理的概率。依赖双稳健得分函数的估计量对倾向得分预测中的误差高度敏感。研究发现，机器学习算法生成的模型往往高估或低估这些概率。已有多种校准方法被提出以改进机器学习模型的概率预测。本文探讨了将这些方法整合到DML框架中的可行性，并通过模拟实验证明：在校准倾向得分后，有限样本中ATE估计的均方根误差显著降低，同时DML的渐近性质得以保持。
doi:10.1002/jae.70057.title: Improving the Finite Sample Estimation of Average Treatment Effects Using Double/Debiased Machine Learning With Propensity Score Calibration
doi:10.1002/jae.70057.title_zh: 使用倾向得分校准的双重/去偏机器学习改进平均处理效应的有限样本估计

doi:10.1002/jae.70058.abstract: This paper revisits the empirical analysis of Nakamura and Steinsson (2014). I reconstructed and extended the original dataset to cover the period 1966–2019, harmonizing two major sources of data: the Defense Contract Action Data System (DCADS) and USAspending.gov. I discuss how to aggregate these contract‐level data to better capture spending more directly tied to domestic stimulus. Estimated multipliers are slightly lower in narrow replications but increase when incorporating later fiscal episodes. I also assess the validity and stability of cross‐sectional estimates. While some heterogeneity exists, dispersion in state‐level responses remains within reasonable boundaries, especially when accounting for dynamic persistence.
doi:10.1002/jae.70058.abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了Nakamura与Steinsson（2014）的实证分析。我重构并扩展了原始数据集，将研究时段覆盖至1966-2019年，整合了两大主要数据来源：国防合同行动数据系统（DCADS）与USAspending.gov。我探讨了如何聚合这些合同级数据，以更精准地捕捉与国内刺激直接相关的支出。在狭义复制中，估计乘数略低，但纳入后期财政事件后有所上升。我还评估了横截面估计的有效性与稳定性。尽管存在一定异质性，但各州层面响应的离散程度仍处于合理范围内，尤其是在考虑动态持续性之后。
doi:10.1002/jae.70058.title: Reassessing the Cross‐Sectional Fiscal Multiplier: Evidence From U.S. Defense Procurement, 1966–2019
doi:10.1002/jae.70058.title_zh: 重新评估横截面财政乘数：来自美国国防采购的证据（1966–2019）

doi:10.1002/jae.70059.abstract: A common VAR approach is to identify responses to TFP news shocks by maximizing the variance share of TFP over a long horizon. We find that these TFP max share estimators tend to be biased in large samples when applied to data generated from DSGE models with shock processes that match TFP moments in the data, especially in the presence of TFP measurement error. We propose an alternative max share news estimator that reduces this bias and the RMSE of the impulse response estimates, even when there is sizable measurement error in the news variable. When applying this estimator to U.S. data, we find that news shocks are slower to diffuse to TFP and have a smaller effect on real activity than implied by the TFP max share estimator.
doi:10.1002/jae.70059.abstract_zh: 常见的VAR方法是通过最大化全要素生产率（TFP）在长期内的方差份额来识别对TFP新闻冲击的响应。我们发现，当将这种TFP最大份额估计量应用于由DSGE模型生成的数据时（该模型的冲击过程与数据中的TFP矩相匹配），尤其是在存在TFP测量误差的情况下，这些估计量在大样本中往往存在偏误。我们提出了一种替代性的最大份额新闻估计量，该估计量能够减少这种偏误以及脉冲响应估计的均方根误差（RMSE），即使新闻变量存在显著的测量误差。当将此估计量应用于美国数据时，我们发现新闻冲击对TFP的扩散速度比TFP最大份额估计量所隐含的更慢，且对实际经济活动的影响更小。
doi:10.1002/jae.70059.title: Estimating Macroeconomic News and Surprise Shocks
doi:10.1002/jae.70059.title_zh: 估算宏观经济新闻与意外冲击

doi:10.1002/jae.70061.abstract: This paper studies estimation of causal effects in a panel data setting. We introduce a new estimator, the Triply Robust Panel (TROP) estimator, that combines a flexible model for the potential outcomes based on a low‐rank factor structure on top of a two‐way‐fixed effect specification, with unit weights intended to upweight units similar to the treated units and time weights intended to upweight time periods close to the treated time periods. We study the performance of the estimator in a set of simulations designed to closely match several commonly studied real data sets. We find that there is substantial variation in the performance of the estimators across the settings considered. The proposed estimator outperforms Two‐Way‐Fixed‐Effect (TWFE) or Difference‐In‐Differences (DID), Synthetic Control (SC), Matrix Completion (MC) and Synthetic‐Difference‐In‐Differences (SDID) estimators. We investigate what features of the data generating process lead to this superior performance and assess the relative importance of the three components of the proposed estimator. We have two recommendations. Our preferred strategy is that researchers use simulations closely matched to the data they are interested in, along the lines discussed in this paper, to investigate which estimators work well in their particular setting. A simpler approach is to use more robust estimators such as SDID or the new TROP estimator, which we find to substantially outperform TWFE/DID estimators in many empirically relevant settings.
doi:10.1002/jae.70061.abstract_zh: 本文研究面板数据设定下的因果效应估计问题。我们提出一种新的估计量——三重稳健面板（TROP）估计量，该估计量结合了基于低秩因子结构的灵活潜在结果模型（该模型建立在双向固定效应规范之上），并引入旨在提升与处理单元相似性的单元权重，以及旨在强化接近处理时间段的时期权重。我们通过一系列与多个常用真实数据集高度匹配的模拟实验，评估该估计量的表现。研究发现，不同设定下各估计量的表现存在显著差异。所提出的估计量优于双向固定效应（TWFE）或双重差分（DID）、合成控制（SC）、矩阵补全（MC）及合成双重差分（SDID）估计量。我们进一步探究数据生成过程中哪些特征导致了这种优越表现，并评估该估计量三个组成部分的相对重要性。我们提出两项建议：首选策略是研究者应按照本文讨论的思路，针对其关注的数据进行高度匹配的模拟实验，以确定在特定设定下表现良好的估计量；更简便的方法是采用SDID或新型TROP估计量等更具稳健性的估计量，我们发现这些估计量在许多实证相关设定中显著优于TWFE/DID估计量。
doi:10.1002/jae.70061.title: Triply Robust Panel Estimators

doi:10.1002/jae.70063.abstract: The external validity of regression discontinuity designs is crucial for informing policy but is rarely examined in applied work. To advance empirical practice, we propose a joint inference procedure for the treatment effect and its local external validity, captured by the treatment effect derivative (TED), within a robust bias correction framework. We further introduce a locally linear treatment effects assumption, which extends the scope of the TED and enables identification and the construction of a uniform confidence band for extrapolated effects. These methods apply to most empirical studies. Empirical illustrations demonstrate their practical usefulness.
doi:10.1002/jae.70063.abstract_zh: 断点回归设计的外部有效性对于政策制定至关重要，但在应用研究中却鲜少被检验。为推进实证实践，我们提出了一种在稳健偏差校正框架内，对处理效应及其局部外部有效性（由处理效应导数TED衡量）进行联合推断的方法。我们进一步引入局部线性处理效应假设，该假设扩展了TED的适用范围，并能够识别外推效应并构建其一致置信带。这些方法适用于大多数实证研究。实证案例展示了其实际应用价值。
doi:10.1002/jae.70063.title: Joint Inference for the Regression Discontinuity Effect and Its External Validity
doi:10.1002/jae.70063.title_zh: 断点回归效应及其外部有效性的联合推断

doi:10.1002/jae.70064.abstract: I provide a precision‐sampler‐based replication of the multivariate unobserved component stochastic volatility outlier‐adjusted model of Stock and Watson (2016) applied to inflation in the United States and the Euro Area (EA). I find a substantial post‐2020 increase in trend inflation for both the United States and the EA, and estimate end‐2024 trend inflation at 2.3 and 2.0 percent, respectively.
doi:10.1002/jae.70064.abstract_zh: 本文基于Stock与Watson（2016）提出的多变量不可观测成分随机波动异常值调整模型，采用精确采样器方法进行复制，并将其应用于美国和欧元区的通胀分析。研究发现，2020年后美国和欧元区的趋势通胀均出现显著上升，预计2024年底的趋势通胀率分别为2.3%和2.0%。
doi:10.1002/jae.70064.title: Multivariate Trend Inflation in the United States and the Euro Area
doi:10.1002/jae.70064.title_zh: 美国和欧元区的多元趋势通胀

doi:10.1002/jae.70065.abstract: We examine how parental income and family structure during childhood and adolescence affect adult income, emphasizing the timing of these effects. Using an ordered multinomial probability model with functional covariates, we find that these familial influences are strongest in middle childhood and adolescence. We also uncover a complementary relationship in the effects of income and family structure trajectories during key developmental periods. By flexibly controlling for personal and family characteristics using nonparametric methods, our approach effectively handles high‐dimensional covariates. The results advance the understanding of intergenerational income mobility and highlight the long‐term importance of early‐life familial conditions for adult economic success.
doi:10.1002/jae.70065.abstract_zh: 本文考察了童年及青少年时期的父母收入与家庭结构如何影响成年后的收入水平，并重点分析了这些影响的时间节点。通过采用含函数协变量的有序多项概率模型，本研究发现这些家庭因素在童年中期及青少年时期的影响最为显著。同时，研究揭示了关键发育阶段中收入与家庭结构轨迹的互补效应。借助非参数方法灵活控制个人及家庭特征，本模型有效处理了高维协变量问题。研究结果深化了对代际收入流动性的理解，并凸显了早期家庭环境对成年后经济成就的长期重要性。
doi:10.1002/jae.70065.title: The Effects of Parental Income and Family Structure on Intergenerational Mobility: A Trajectories‐Based Approach
doi:10.1002/jae.70065.title_zh: 父母收入与家庭结构对代际流动的影响：基于轨迹的方法

doi:10.1002/jae.70066.abstract: This paper introduces a novel method to adaptively design randomized experiments. For randomized experiments with a pilot stage, or multistage experiments, Hahn et al. (2011) propose an adaptive experimental design that adjusts the next stage's propensity score based on data from the previous stages. This paper discusses how the discretization of covariates affects the precision of the estimation of the average treatment effect (ATE) through the estimated propensity score for the next stage. Also, this paper proposes an algorithm using the bootstrap technique to find the optimal level of discretization of covariates. Monte Carlo simulations and an application with actual data show that the suggested method performs well.
doi:10.1002/jae.70066.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种自适应设计随机实验的新方法。针对包含预实验阶段或多阶段随机实验，Hahn等人（2011）提出了一种自适应实验设计，该设计基于前一阶段的数据调整下一阶段的倾向得分。本文探讨了协变量离散化如何通过下一阶段估计的倾向得分影响平均处理效应（ATE）估计的精度。同时，本文提出了一种基于自助法（bootstrap）技术的算法，用于确定协变量的最优离散化水平。蒙特卡洛模拟及实际数据应用表明，所建议的方法表现良好。
doi:10.1002/jae.70066.title: Optimal Covariate Discretization in Adaptive Randomized Experiments
doi:10.1002/jae.70066.title_zh: 自适应随机实验中的最优协变量离散化

doi:10.1002/jae.70067.abstract: This paper studies heterogeneous mixed‐frequency panel data models, focusing on linear specifications that allow heterogeneity in both aggregation weights and slope coefficients. To address potential correlations between the heterogeneity and the covariates, we first show that, under additional normalization conditions, the mean‐group estimator delivers consistent and asymptotically normal slope estimates but biased weights estimators. As an alternative, we propose a correlated random effects estimator using a generalized Mundlak specification. We further discuss the implementation of these two estimators when covariates are observed at substantially higher sampling frequencies. Monte Carlo simulations are conducted to assess their finite‐sample properties. As an empirical illustration, we revisit the impact of temperature fluctuations on economic growth using the proposed framework.
doi:10.1002/jae.70067.abstract_zh: 本文研究异质性混频面板数据模型，重点关注允许聚合权重和斜率系数均存在异质性的线性设定。为应对异质性与协变量之间的潜在相关性，我们首先证明：在额外标准化条件下，均值组估计量能够获得一致且渐近正态的斜率估计，但权重估计量存在偏误。作为替代方案，我们提出采用广义Mundlak设定的相关随机效应估计量。进一步讨论了当协变量以显著更高采样频率被观测时，这两种估计量的实施方法。通过蒙特卡洛模拟评估其有限样本性质。作为实证例证，我们运用该框架重新考察了气温波动对经济增长的影响。
doi:10.1002/jae.70067.title: Estimation of Heterogeneous Panel Data Models With Mixed Sampling Frequencies
doi:10.1002/jae.70067.title_zh: 混合采样频率下异质性面板数据模型的估计

doi:10.1002/jae.70068.abstract: We introduce an overidentification test of two alternative assumptions to identify the average treatment effect on the treated in a two‐period panel data setting: unconfoundedness and common trends. Under unconfoundedness, treatment assignment and post‐treatment outcomes are independent, conditional on control variables and pre‐treatment outcomes, which motivates including the pre‐treatment outcomes in the set of controls. Under common trends, the trend and the treatment assignment are independent, conditional on control variables, motivating a Difference‐in‐Differences (DiD) approach. Given the non‐nested nature of these assumptions and their often ambiguous plausibility in empirical settings, we propose a joint test using a doubly robust statistic that can be combined with machine learning to control for observed confounders in a data‐driven manner. We discuss causal models satisfying either common trends, unconfoundedness, or both assumptions. Applying the proposed method to publicly available datasets, we find that the test rejects the null hypothesis in two out of four cases.
doi:10.1002/jae.70068.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种过度识别检验方法，用于评估两期面板数据中识别处理组平均处理效应的两种替代假设：无混杂性与共同趋势。在无混杂性假设下，处理分配与处理后结果在控制变量和处理前结果条件下相互独立，这促使将处理前结果纳入控制变量集。在共同趋势假设下，趋势与处理分配在控制变量条件下相互独立，这推动了双重差分法的应用。鉴于这两种假设的非嵌套性质及其在实证情境中常存的模糊合理性，我们提出一种联合检验方法，采用双重稳健统计量，可结合机器学习以数据驱动方式控制观测混杂因素。我们讨论了满足共同趋势、无混杂性或两者兼具的因果模型。将所提方法应用于公开数据集后，发现检验在四个案例中有两个拒绝了原假设。
doi:10.1002/jae.70068.title: A Joint Test of Unconfoundedness and Common Trends
doi:10.1002/jae.70068.title_zh: 无混淆性与共同趋势的联合检验

doi:10.1002/jae.70069.abstract: Peer influence on effort devoted to some activity is often studied when effort is unobserved, and the researcher instead observes an outcome that combines effort with other shocks. For instance, in education, achievement measures such as GPA reflect both effort and idiosyncratic GPA shocks. We propose an alternative approach that circumvents this approximation. Our framework distinguishes unobserved shocks to GPA that do not affect effort from preference shocks that do affect effort levels. We show that peer effects estimates obtained using our approach can differ significantly from classical estimates (where effort is approximated) if the network includes isolated students. Applying our approach to data on high school students in the United States, we find that peer effect estimates relying on GPA as a proxy for effort are 40% lower than those obtained using our approach.
doi:10.1002/jae.70069.abstract_zh: 摘要 当努力程度不可观测，而研究者仅能观察到结合了努力与其他冲击的最终结果时，关于同伴效应对某项活动投入程度的影响研究往往面临挑战。例如在教育领域，GPA等学业成就指标既反映努力程度，也包含个体特有的GPA冲击。本文提出一种规避此类近似处理的新方法。我们的分析框架将不影响努力程度的不可观测GPA冲击与确实影响努力水平的偏好冲击进行区分。研究表明，当社交网络中存在孤立学生时，采用本方法获得的同伴效应估计值可能与经典方法（将努力程度近似处理）存在显著差异。通过将本方法应用于美国高中生数据，我们发现，以GPA作为努力程度代理变量的同伴效应估计值，比采用本方法获得的估计值低40%。
doi:10.1002/jae.70069.title: Identifying Peer Effects in Networks with Unobserved Effort and Isolated Students
doi:10.1002/jae.70069.title_zh: 识别未观测努力与孤立学生网络中的同伴效应

doi:10.1002/jae.70070.abstract: Instrumental variables are a popular tool to infer causal effects under unobserved confounding, but choosing suitable instruments is challenging in practice. We propose gIVBMA, a Bayesian model averaging procedure that addresses this challenge by averaging across different sets of instrumental variables and covariates in a structural equation model. This allows for data‐driven selection of valid and relevant instruments and provides additional robustness against invalid instruments. Our approach extends previous work through a scale‐invariant prior structure and accommodates non‐Gaussian outcomes and treatments, offering greater flexibility than existing methods. The computational strategy uses conditional Bayes factors to update models separately for the outcome and treatments. We prove that this model selection procedure is consistent. In simulation experiments, gIVBMA outperforms current state‐of‐the‐art methods. We demonstrate its usefulness in two empirical applications: the effects of malaria and institutions on income per capita and the returns to schooling. A software implementation of gIVBMA is available in Julia.
doi:10.1002/jae.70070.abstract_zh: 工具变量是在存在未观测混杂因素时推断因果效应的常用方法，但在实践中选择合适的工具变量颇具挑战性。我们提出gIVBMA方法，这是一种通过结构方程模型中对不同工具变量集和协变量集进行平均化的贝叶斯模型平均程序。该方法能够基于数据驱动选择有效且相关的工具变量，并增强对无效工具变量的稳健性。我们的方法通过尺度不变先验结构扩展了先前研究，并兼容非高斯结果变量和处理变量，比现有方法具有更高灵活性。计算策略采用条件贝叶斯因子分别更新结果方程和处理方程的模型。我们证明该模型选择程序具有一致性。模拟实验表明，gIVBMA优于当前最先进方法。我们在两个实证应用中验证其实用价值：疟疾与制度对人均收入的影响，以及教育回报率。gIVBMA的软件实现已发布于Julia平台。
doi:10.1002/jae.70070.title: Bayesian Model Averaging in Causal Instrumental Variable Models
doi:10.1002/jae.70070.title_zh: 因果工具变量模型中的贝叶斯模型平均

doi:10.1002/jae.70071.abstract: We propose a unified framework for interpreting and comparing a broad class of synthetic control (SC) methods. Our framework is built on an analysis of a mean‐squared prediction error (MSPE) bound for the counterfactual predicted by a generic SC method, without imposing a specific outcome model. Using this framework, we develop a generalized SC method that provides a more comprehensive regularization of the MSPE bound than several existing SC methods. Through simulation studies and placebo analyses, we demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in predicting the counterfactual.
doi:10.1002/jae.70071.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个统一框架，用于解释和比较广泛类别的合成控制（SC）方法。该框架基于对通用SC方法预测的反事实均方预测误差（MSPE）边界的分析，且无需设定特定结果模型。利用此框架，我们开发了一种广义合成控制方法，相较于现有多种SC方法，该方法对MSPE边界实现了更全面的正则化。通过模拟研究与安慰剂分析，我们验证了所提方法在反事实预测中的有效性。
doi:10.1002/jae.70071.title: Regularization of Synthetic Controls for Policy Evaluation
doi:10.1002/jae.70071.title_zh: 政策评估中合成控制法的正则化

doi:10.1002/jae.70072.abstract: We build on Modestino et al., who analysed “opportunistic upskilling” during the 2007 recession in the US, by extending their approach to European labour markets following recent economic shocks. Using a comprehensive dataset of online job postings (2019–2023) and an instrumental variable approach leveraging Ukrainian refugee inflows, we find that increases in labour supply have a significant positive effect on both education and experience requirements. Our findings reinforce the idea that employers opportunistically upskill labour demand in different but challenging macroeconomic contexts. The identification of such patterns, however, depends on the presence of a plausibly exogenous shock to labour markets.
doi:10.1002/jae.70072.abstract_zh: 我们基于Modestino等人对2007年美国经济衰退期间“机会性技能提升”的研究，将其方法拓展至近期经济冲击后的欧洲劳动力市场。利用2019-2023年在线招聘信息的综合数据集，并采用以乌克兰难民流入为工具变量的方法，我们发现劳动力供给增加对教育及经验要求均产生显著正向影响。研究结果进一步印证了雇主在不同但严峻的宏观经济背景下会机会性地提升劳动力需求技能水平的观点。然而，此类模式的识别依赖于劳动力市场是否存在合理外生冲击。
doi:10.1002/jae.70072.title: Opportunistic Upskilling in European Labour Markets—Evidence From a Wide Replication
doi:10.1002/jae.70072.title_zh: 欧洲劳动力市场中的机会性技能提升——基于广泛复制的证据

doi:10.1002/jae.70073.abstract: We estimate the first time‐varying, county‐level index of housing supply elasticities across the United States, using a structural vector autoregression model with sign restrictions to identify the effect of a positive demand shock. This index reveals four features of the supply curve in different local housing markets. First, supply elasticities are low, on average, generating faster price growth than housing unit growth for most of the country. Second, there is significant variation in elasticities across counties, both urban and rural. Third, elasticities have declined in more counties than they have risen over time, particularly in large urban markets. Fourth, these new estimates predict housing quantity growth better than previous models in the literature.
doi:10.1002/jae.70073.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们利用带有符号约束的结构向量自回归模型识别正向需求冲击效应，首次估算了美国各县级住房供给弹性的时变指数。该指数揭示了不同地方住房市场供给曲线的四个特征：第一，平均而言供给弹性较低，导致全国大部分地区房价增速快于住房单元增速；第二，城乡各县之间的弹性存在显著差异；第三，随时间推移，弹性下降的县数量多于上升的县，尤其是在大型城市市场；第四，相较于文献中的既有模型，这些新估计值能更准确地预测住房数量增长。
doi:10.1002/jae.70073.title: Housing Supply Elasticities: A Structural Vector Autoregression Approach
doi:10.1002/jae.70073.title_zh: 住房供给弹性：结构向量自回归方法

doi:10.1002/jae.70074.abstract: We analyse fiscal policy in resource‐rich economies using a novel Bayesian regime‐switching panel model. The identified regimes capture pro‐ or countercyclical fiscal behaviour by allowing regime‐specific shifts in the average fiscal stance, while the switches between the regimes have the interpretation of changes in fiscal policy. Applying the model to a panel of sixteen oil‐producing economies, we show that fiscal policy has alternated between a procyclical and countercyclical regime multiple times over the sample. Furthermore, we find that fiscal policy is more volatile in the procyclical regime and that the probability of being in the procyclical regime is higher for OPEC countries than for non‐OPEC countries. We also show that following either an increase or decrease in oil revenues, the growth in government expenditures is mostly increasing, suggesting an upward bias in expenditures in oil‐producing countries. These are new findings in the literature.
doi:10.1002/jae.70074.abstract_zh: 我们采用一种新颖的贝叶斯体制转换面板模型，分析了资源丰富经济体的财政政策。通过允许平均财政立场发生体制特定转变，识别出的体制捕捉了顺周期或逆周期的财政行为，而体制间的转换则被解释为财政政策的变化。将该模型应用于由16个石油生产经济体组成的面板数据，我们发现在样本期内，财政政策多次在顺周期与逆周期体制之间交替。此外，我们发现顺周期体制下的财政政策波动性更大，且石油输出国组织（OPEC）国家处于顺周期体制的概率高于非OPEC国家。我们还表明，无论石油收入增加还是减少，政府支出的增长大多呈上升趋势，这暗示石油生产国存在支出向上偏倚。这些是文献中的新发现。
doi:10.1002/jae.70074.title: Fiscal Policy Regimes in Resource‐Rich Economies
doi:10.1002/jae.70074.title_zh: 资源丰富经济体的财政政策体制

doi:10.1002/jae.70075.abstract: Lévy processes are widely used in financial modeling due to their ability to capture discontinuities and heavy tails, which are common in high‐frequency asset return data. However, parameter estimation remains a challenge when associated likelihoods are unavailable or costly to compute. We propose a fast and accurate method for Lévy parameter estimation using the neural Bayes estimation (NBE) framework—a simulation‐based, likelihood‐free approach that leverages permutation‐invariant neural networks to approximate Bayes estimators. We contribute new theoretical results, showing that NBE results in consistent estimators whose risk converges to that of the Bayes estimator under mild conditions. Moreover, through extensive simulations across several Lévy models, we show that NBE outperforms traditional methods in both accuracy and runtime, while also enabling two complementary approaches to uncertainty quantification. We illustrate our approach on a challenging high‐frequency cryptocurrency return dataset, where the method captures evolving parameter dynamics and delivers reliable and interpretable inference at a fraction of the computational cost of traditional methods. We investigate nearly a decade of high‐frequency Bitcoin returns, requiring less than one minute to estimate parameters under the proposed approach.
doi:10.1002/jae.70075.abstract_zh: 摘要 莱维过程因其能够捕捉高频资产收益数据中常见的间断性和厚尾特征，在金融建模中得到广泛应用。然而，当相关似然函数不可用或计算成本高昂时，参数估计仍面临挑战。我们提出了一种基于神经贝叶斯估计（NBE）框架的快速精确莱维参数估计方法——这是一种基于模拟的无似然方法，利用置换不变神经网络来近似贝叶斯估计量。我们贡献了新的理论成果，证明在温和条件下，NBE可得到一致估计量，其风险收敛至贝叶斯估计量的风险水平。此外，通过针对多个莱维模型的大量模拟实验，我们表明NBE在精度和运行时间上均优于传统方法，同时还能实现两种互补的不确定性量化方法。我们以具有挑战性的高频加密货币收益数据集为例进行方法验证，该方法能够捕捉动态变化的参数特征，并以传统方法计算成本的一小部分提供可靠且可解释的推断。我们研究了近十年高频比特币收益数据，在提出的方法下，参数估计耗时不足一分钟。
doi:10.1002/jae.70075.title: Fast Likelihood‐Free Parameter Estimation for Lévy Processes
doi:10.1002/jae.70075.title_zh: 莱维过程的快速无似然参数估计

doi:10.1002/jae.70076.abstract: This study proposes specification tests for interference structure in causal inference with spillovers. We focus on experimental settings in which the treatment assignment mechanism is known. To test whether a given exposure mapping adequately summarizes the true interference structure, we develop conditional randomization tests by utilizing the hierarchical relationship between the null and alternative exposure mappings. When there are multiple candidate exposure mappings of interest, we propose a sequential specification testing procedure that controls the false discovery rate. Through extensive simulation exercises, we demonstrate that our tests have desirable size properties and satisfactory power. To illustrate the proposed methods, we revisit two existing social network experiments: One on farmers' insurance adoption and another on anti‐conflict education programs.
doi:10.1002/jae.70076.abstract_zh: 本研究针对存在溢出效应的因果推断中的干扰结构，提出了设定检验方法。我们聚焦于处理分配机制已知的实验场景。为检验给定的暴露映射是否充分概括了真实的干扰结构，我们利用零假设与备择假设暴露映射之间的层级关系，开发了条件随机化检验。当存在多个感兴趣的候选暴露映射时，我们提出了一种序贯设定检验程序，该程序能够控制错误发现率。通过大量模拟实验，我们证明所提出的检验具有理想的尺度性质与令人满意的检验功效。为说明所提方法的应用，我们重新审视了两项现有社交网络实验：一项关于农民保险采纳行为，另一项关于反冲突教育项目。
doi:10.1002/jae.70076.title: Conditional Randomization Tests for the Specification of Interference Structure
doi:10.1002/jae.70076.title_zh: 干扰结构设定的条件随机化检验

doi:10.1002/jae.70077.abstract: This paper proposes a simple smooth specification test for the propensity score in the spirit of Neyman (1937). We derive a particular restriction on the propensity score and construct the specification test based on it. Using the density‐weighting method, we transform the original specification testing problem into a test of the joint significance of the generalized Fourier coefficients. We propose a novel projection method to eliminate the parameter estimation effect arising from estimating unknown nuisance parameters. The proposed test is shown to follow a standard distribution under the null hypothesis and to possess nontrivial asymptotic power against local alternatives that converge to the null at the parametric rate , where is the sample size. To enhance the practical applicability of the procedure, we further introduce a data‐driven selection method for determining the testing order, enabling automatic selection based on the observed data. Compared to existing methods, our test does not suffer from the “curse of dimensionality” faced by Shaikh et al. (2009); at the same time, our test is both asymptotically pivotal and more computationally efficient than that of Sant'Anna and Song (2019). Extensive simulations demonstrate that the proposed test yields satisfactory empirical size and power. Compared with previous tests, our test exhibits comparable overall performance and delivers clear improvements in some cases, especially for high‐frequency alternatives. Two empirical applications further illustrate the practical applicability of our proposal, examining propensity score specifications in the Soviet 156 Program and the US Job Corps Program.
doi:10.1002/jae.70077.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于Neyman（1937）思想的倾向得分平滑设定检验方法。我们推导出倾向得分的一个特定约束条件，并据此构建设定检验。通过密度加权方法，将原始设定检验问题转化为广义傅里叶系数联合显著性检验。我们提出一种新颖的投影方法，以消除未知冗余参数估计带来的参数估计效应。所提出的检验在原假设下服从标准分布，并对以参数速率收敛于原假设的局部备择假设具有非平凡渐近功效（其中为样本量）。为增强方法的实际应用性，我们进一步引入数据驱动的检验阶数选择方法，实现基于观测数据的自动选择。与现有方法相比，本检验不存在Shaikh等（2009）面临的"维度灾难"问题；同时，本检验既具有渐近枢轴性质，又比Sant'Anna和Song（2019）的方法计算效率更高。大量模拟表明，所提检验具有令人满意的经验水平和功效。与以往检验相比，本检验在整体表现上相当，并在某些情形下（尤其是高频备择假设）展现出明显改进。两项实证应用（苏联156工程和美国职业训练团项目）进一步验证了本方法的实际适用性。
doi:10.1002/jae.70077.title: A Smooth Specification Test for the Propensity Score
doi:10.1002/jae.70077.title_zh: 倾向得分的平滑设定检验

doi:10.1002/jae.70078.abstract: How do labor market institutions shape the transmission of government spending shocks and macroeconomic volatility? We develop a theoretical model in which labor market institutions affect fiscal transmission through their effect on wage rigidity, job separation, and matching frictions. We estimate an interacted panel vector autoregressive model for 16 OECD economies and study how macroeconomic responses to government spending shocks vary with institutional labor market characteristics. In line with our theoretical predictions, we show that institutions that stabilize employment and wages tend to reduce output volatility and attenuate the response of output and employment to government spending shocks.
doi:10.1002/jae.70078.abstract_zh: 劳动力市场制度如何影响政府支出冲击的传导机制及宏观经济波动？我们构建了一个理论模型，其中劳动力市场制度通过影响工资刚性、岗位分离和匹配摩擦来作用于财政传导机制。基于16个OECD经济体的交互面板向量自回归模型估计，我们研究了宏观经济对政府支出冲击的反应如何随劳动力市场制度特征而变化。与理论预测一致，我们发现稳定就业和工资的制度倾向于降低产出波动，并削弱产出和就业对政府支出冲击的反应。
doi:10.1002/jae.70078.title: Labor Market Institutions, Fiscal Multipliers, and Macroeconomic Volatility
doi:10.1002/jae.70078.title_zh: 劳动力市场制度、财政乘数与宏观经济波动

doi:10.1002/jae.70079.abstract: This paper explores the existence of network externalities in link formation games of incomplete information. It extends the structural estimation method in Leung (2015) to games where links are undirected and proposals are only partially observed. We provide an econometric characterization of the proposed two‐step estimator and document its performance through a simulation exercise. When the estimation method is applied to data on risk‐sharing arrangements in a Tanzanian village, results indicate that indirect connections matter.
doi:10.1002/jae.70079.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文探讨了不完全信息链接形成博弈中网络外部性的存在性。我们将Leung（2015）的结构估计方法扩展至链接无向且提议仅部分可观测的博弈场景。我们提出了所设计的两步估计量的计量经济学特征，并通过模拟实验验证其性能。将该估计方法应用于坦桑尼亚某村庄风险分担安排的数据后，结果表明间接连接具有显著影响。
doi:10.1002/jae.70079.title: Estimating Network Externalities in Undirected Link Formation Games
doi:10.1002/jae.70079.title_zh: 无向链接形成博弈中的网络外部性估计

doi:10.1002/jae.70080.abstract: While existing work shows COVID‐19 stay‐at‐home (SAH) policies decreased mobility on average, we lack evidence regarding heterogeneity in policy effectiveness across US counties. To uncover potential heterogeneity, we implement a novel two‐stage approach. First, we employ recent advances in synthetic control estimation and inference to obtain and bound both time‐average and county‐specific treatment effects. Next, we use a local linear forest to explain observed heterogeneity using county‐level predictors. This procedure reveals substantial variation in policy effectiveness and identifies predictors of policy effectiveness which can be used to target future SAH policies.
doi:10.1002/jae.70080.abstract_zh: 现有研究表明，新冠疫情居家令政策平均降低了人口流动性，但关于该政策在美国各县间有效性的异质性证据尚不充分。为揭示潜在异质性，我们采用了一种新颖的两阶段方法。首先，利用合成控制估计与推断的最新进展，获取并界定了时间平均效应及县级特定处理效应的边界。其次，通过局部线性森林模型，运用县级预测变量解释观测到的异质性。该流程揭示了政策有效性的显著差异，并识别出可用于未来居家令政策精准施策的预测变量。
doi:10.1002/jae.70080.title: Deniers and Compliers: Unpacking the Heterogeneous Effectiveness of U.S. Stay‐at‐Home Mandates During the COVID‐19 Pandemic
doi:10.1002/jae.70080.title_zh: 否认者与遵从者：解析美国COVID-19疫情期间居家令的异质性效果

doi:10.1002/jae.70081.abstract: We propose a method to identify the anticipated components of macroeconomic shocks in a structural VAR. We include empirical forecasts about each time series in the VAR. This introduces enough linear restrictions to identify every structural shock and to further decompose each one into “news” and “surprise” shocks. We estimate a VAR on U.S. time series using forecast data from the SPF, CBO, Federal Reserve, and asset prices. Unanticipated fiscal stimulus and monetary policy shocks have typical effects that match existing evidence. In our news‐surprise decomposition, we find that news drives around one quarter of U.S. business cycle volatility. News explains a larger share of the variance due to fiscal shocks than for monetary policy shocks. Finally, we use the news structure of the shocks to estimate counterfactual policy rules, and compare the ability of fiscal and monetary policy to moderate output and inflation. We find that coordinated fiscal and monetary policy are substantially more effective than either individually.
doi:10.1002/jae.70081.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文提出一种在结构向量自回归（VAR）中识别宏观经济冲击预期成分的方法。我们将各时间序列的经验预测纳入VAR模型，由此引入足够的线性约束，从而识别所有结构性冲击，并进一步将每个冲击分解为“新闻”冲击与“意外”冲击。我们利用美国国会预算办公室（CBO）、美联储、资产价格及专业预测者调查（SPF）的预测数据，对美国时间序列进行VAR估计。研究发现，未预期的财政刺激与货币政策冲击的典型效应与既有证据一致。在新闻-意外分解中，新闻冲击解释了美国经济周期波动约四分之一的方差。相较于货币政策冲击，新闻冲击对财政冲击方差的解释份额更大。最后，我们利用冲击的新闻结构估计反事实政策规则，并比较财政政策与货币政策在平抑产出与通胀方面的效力。结果表明，财政与货币政策的协调配合比单一政策显著更有效。
doi:10.1002/jae.70081.title: Identifying News Shocks From Forecasts
doi:10.1002/jae.70081.title_zh: 从预测中识别新闻冲击

doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01169-9.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01169-9.title: Lives, livelihoods, and learning: A global perspective on the well-being impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic
doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01169-9.title_zh: 生命、生计与学习：新冠疫情对福祉影响的全球视角

doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01172-0.abstract: Using the 2003 ban of female genital cutting in Benin as a natural experiment, I estimate the effect of the ban on women’s human capital accumulation. The ban decreases the likelihood of a woman undergoing genital cutting despite inconsistent enforcement. Banning female genital cutting has a counter-intuitive effect on women’s education. A difference-in-differences estimation indicates that the ban decreases women’s years of education, the probability of completing primary school, and the probability of starting secondary school. I show that the decrease in educational outcomes is accompanied by an increase in marriage and increased spousal match quality. The negative effect on women’s education dissipates following the implementation of free primary education in Benin.
doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01172-0.abstract_zh: 以2003年贝宁禁止女性割礼作为自然实验，本文评估了该禁令对女性人力资本积累的影响。尽管执法力度不一，该禁令仍降低了女性接受割礼的可能性。禁止女性割礼对女性教育产生了反直觉效应。双重差分估计表明，该禁令减少了女性受教育年限、完成小学教育的概率以及进入中学的概率。本文发现，教育成果的下降伴随着婚姻缔结率的上升和配偶匹配质量的提升。随着贝宁免费初等教育的实施，该禁令对女性教育的负面效应逐渐消失。
doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01172-0.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01172-0.title: Education, marriage, and banning female genital cutting: evidence from Benin
doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01172-0.title_zh: 教育、婚姻与禁止女性割礼：来自贝宁的证据

doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01173-z.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01173-z.title: From sons to daughters: international marriage migration and sex imbalances at birth
doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01173-z.title_zh: 从儿子到女儿：国际婚姻迁移与出生性别失衡

doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01174-y.abstract: Following the 2022 US Supreme Court decision Dobbs v Jackson, many states adopted early-term abortion (ETA) bans that prohibit abortions before the age of viability and often before sex determination is technologically feasible. We analyze the effect of ETA bans on the sex ratio at birth among first-generation Chinese, Korean, and Indian (CKI) immigrants using difference-in-differences and triple differences methodologies. While our estimates across higher parity children sometimes indicate a decrease in the sex ratio at birth, they are also generally small and statistically insignificant, which is consistent with continued access to sex selection under ETA bans. In contrast, we find that ETA bans are associated with a large and statistically significant increase in the sex ratio at birth among first-parity children to immigrant CKI women. As elevated sex ratios have not been previously documented on first-parity children, this may indicate that ETA bans shift sex-selective behavior to earlier parities by placing additional emphasis on having a boy now, before any further restrictions on abortions occur. Our estimates suggest that ETA bans caused 139 missing, first-born girls in 2023 alone.
doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01174-y.abstract_zh: 2022年美国最高法院对多布斯诉杰克逊案作出裁决后，许多州通过了早期堕胎禁令，禁止在胎儿存活期之前（且通常在技术无法确定胎儿性别之前）实施堕胎。我们采用双重差分法和三重差分法，分析了早期堕胎禁令对第一代华裔、韩裔和印度裔移民出生性别比的影响。尽管对较高胎次子女的估算有时显示出生性别比下降，但这些结果普遍较小且统计上不显著，这与早期堕胎禁令下仍可继续实施性别选择的情况一致。相反，我们发现早期堕胎禁令与移民华裔、韩裔和印度裔女性第一胎子女的出生性别比大幅且统计上显著上升相关。由于此前未发现第一胎子女存在性别比偏高现象，这可能表明早期堕胎禁令通过强调在进一步堕胎限制实施前优先生育男孩，将性别选择行为提前至更早胎次。我们的估算显示，仅2023年，早期堕胎禁令就导致139名第一胎女婴缺失。

doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01175-x.abstract: This paper explores the relationship between geographic mortality differentials and human capital investment patterns in the Malthusian setup of 19th-century Armenia. We examine how variations in altitude are associated with mortality rates, human capital accumulation, and fertility decisions. Using detailed historical census and parish records, we document that higher-altitude areas tend to have lower population density, lower respiratory disease mortality, and lower overall mortality. Our empirical analysis also shows that individuals in these environments tend to display better numeracy skills and lower fertility rates. These findings align with the Ben-Porath hypothesis, suggesting that longer life horizons encourage shifting from child quantity to quality. Furthermore, these patterns are not driven by income differences or increased female autonomy arising from pastoral agriculture.
doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01175-x.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了19世纪亚美尼亚马尔萨斯式环境下，地理死亡率差异与人力资本投资模式之间的关系。我们研究了海拔变化如何与死亡率、人力资本积累及生育决策相关联。利用详细的历史人口普查和教区记录，我们发现高海拔地区往往具有较低的人口密度、较低的呼吸系统疾病死亡率以及较低的总体死亡率。实证分析还表明，这些环境中的个体通常表现出更好的计算能力和较低的生育率。这些发现与Ben-Porath假说一致，表明更长的生命预期鼓励从子女数量向质量的转变。此外，这些模式并非由收入差异或牧业农业带来的女性自主权增强所驱动。

doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01176-w.abstract: Voluntary turnover imposes substantial costs on organizations, yet we know little about whether workers’ fundamental orientations toward work shape their mobility decisions. In this paper, we distinguish between job, career, and calling orientations, defined as the long-term beliefs about the role of work in one’s life. Using original survey data from the Dutch LISS panel, we show that work orientations are strong predictors of quit intentions and on-the-job search, even after controlling for socio-demographic characteristics, personality traits, job characteristics, and job satisfaction. Career-oriented individuals exhibit significantly higher quit intentions and search activity, particularly when perceived promotion opportunities are limited. Calling-oriented individuals report substantially lower quit intentions and on-the-job search. By contrast, having a job orientation is not systematically associated with turnover-related outcomes. The associations between work orientations and actual job quits one and two years later are weaker, suggesting that work orientations primarily shape turnover intentions and preparatory search behavior, while actual working conditions more strongly influence mobility. Overall, our findings identify work orientations as a novel and quantitatively important determinant of turnover-related behavior and highlight the role of workers’ underlying motivations in shaping mobility beyond standard economic predictors.
doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01176-w.abstract_zh: 自愿离职给组织带来巨大成本，然而我们对工作者对工作的基本取向是否影响其流动决策知之甚少。本文区分了工作取向、职业取向和使命取向，这些取向被定义为关于工作在生活中角色的长期信念。利用荷兰LISS面板的原始调查数据，我们发现即使在控制社会人口特征、人格特质、工作特征和工作满意度后，工作取向仍是离职意向和在职求职的强预测因子。职业取向个体表现出显著更高的离职意向和求职活动，尤其在感知晋升机会有限时。使命取向个体报告的离职意向和在职求职显著较低。相比之下，工作取向与离职相关结果并无系统性关联。工作取向与一年及两年后实际离职的关联较弱，表明工作取向主要塑造离职意向和预备性求职行为，而实际工作条件对流动性的影响更强。总体而言，我们的研究将工作取向识别为离职相关行为的新颖且数量上重要的决定因素，并强调工作者潜在动机在标准经济预测因子之外对流动性塑造的作用。

doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01178-8.abstract: This paper examines whether adverse childhood economic shocks affect fertility in adulthood. Using Finnish administrative data and plant closures during the 1991–93 recession as exogenous parental job loss, I estimate long-run effects on children’s fertility. Paternal job loss reduces sons’ probability of parenthood by age 43 by 1.7 percentage points, while maternal job loss is positively associated with sons’ fertility and accelerates daughters’ childbearing without affecting completed fertility. Paternal displacement persistently lowers sons’ education, employment, and earnings; mediation analysis suggests that these socioeconomic scarring effects explain about half of the fertility decline. The remaining effect appears to operate through non-pecuniary mechanisms, such as family stress. Maternal job loss does not affect children’s socioeconomic outcomes, pointing to non-pecuniary channels, including changes in parent–child relationships. Overall, the findings indicate that economic shocks in adolescence have lasting intergenerational consequences for demographic behavior.
doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01178-8.abstract_zh: 本文考察了童年时期的经济冲击是否会影响成年后的生育决策。利用芬兰行政数据以及1991-1993年经济衰退期间企业倒闭作为外生性父母失业事件，本文估算了其对子女生育率的长期影响。父亲失业使儿子在43岁前成为父母的概率降低1.7个百分点，而母亲失业则与儿子生育率呈正相关，并加速女儿的生育进程，但未影响其最终生育数量。父亲失业持续降低儿子的教育水平、就业率和收入；中介分析表明，这些社会经济创伤效应解释了约一半的生育率下降。剩余效应似乎通过非金钱机制（如家庭压力）发挥作用。母亲失业不影响子女的社会经济状况，这表明其影响渠道为非金钱机制，包括亲子关系的变化。总体而言，研究结果表明，青少年时期的经济冲击对人口行为具有持久的代际影响。

doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01179-7.abstract: While international knowledge transfer drives structural transformation, the diffusion of tacit knowledge—the complex skills and procedures essential for sophisticated production—remains constrained by the need for face-to-face interaction. This paper identifies outbound business travel as a distinct channel for overcoming this friction. Exploiting a panel of 113 countries (1995–2020) and a System GMM framework to address endogeneity, I document a robust positive association between business travel and economic complexity. I show that this relationship is conditional on domestic political institutions: the returns to travel are amplified in inclusive, open political environments but vanish in highly centralized systems. Furthermore, I find evidence of diminishing marginal returns, suggesting that the benefits of travel moderate as connectivity channels saturate. I conclude that inclusive institutions function as a critical “absorptive filter” mechanism, enabling the tacit knowledge acquired abroad to translate effectively into national productive capabilities.
doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01179-7.abstract_zh: 尽管国际知识转移推动着结构转型，但隐性知识——复杂生产所需的关键技能与流程——的扩散仍受制于面对面互动的需求。本文指出，出境商务旅行是克服这一摩擦的独特渠道。基于113个国家（1995-2020年）的面板数据，并采用系统GMM框架处理内生性问题，我证实了商务旅行与经济复杂性之间存在稳健的正向关联。研究表明，这种关系取决于国内政治制度：在包容、开放的政治环境中，旅行的回报效应被放大，而在高度集权的体制下则完全消失。此外，我发现了边际收益递减的证据，表明随着连通渠道趋于饱和，旅行的收益效应逐渐减弱。结论认为，包容性制度作为关键的"吸收过滤"机制，使海外获取的隐性知识能够有效转化为国家生产能力。

doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01180-0.abstract: This paper examines the causal impact of cannabidiol (CBD) product availability on workplace injuries, exploiting Italy’s unintended liberalization of low-THC cannabis as a natural experiment. We use a staggered difference-in-differences approach, leveraging variation in the timing of CBD retailer entries across provinces. We find that CBD availability leads to a reduction in workplace injury rates by 2.5%, with larger effects among young and prime-age workers. Robustness checks confirm these findings, and placebo tests rule out confounding trends. These effects are stronger in provinces with higher pre-existing use of pharmaceuticals commonly prescribed for stress, anxiety, sleep disorders, and chronic therapies. We interpret this pattern as suggestive of a substitution-based channel in which CBD products may represent an additional source of pain and stress management.
doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01180-0.abstract_zh: 本文利用意大利低THC大麻意外合法化作为自然实验，考察大麻二酚（CBD）产品可及性对工伤的因果影响。我们采用交错双重差分法，利用各省CBD零售商进入时间的差异。研究发现，CBD可及性使工伤率降低2.5%，其中对青年和壮年劳动者的影响更为显著。稳健性检验证实了上述结论，安慰剂检验排除了混杂趋势的影响。在那些此前常用于缓解压力、焦虑、睡眠障碍及慢性治疗的药物使用率较高的省份，这种效应更为突出。我们将这一模式解读为替代效应渠道的佐证，即CBD产品可能成为疼痛与压力管理的额外来源。

doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01181-z.abstract: Using data from the German Socio-Economic Panel, we provide a comprehensive investigation of the relationship between workplace co-determination in the form of works councils and income satisfaction. Controlling for a wide range of individual, job-related, and firm-level characteristics in OLS and fixed effects specifications, we observe that employees working in establishments with a works council report significantly higher income satisfaction compared to their counterparts in non-co-determined firms. Rank in the income distribution, perceived fairness of the wage, and working conditions emerge as quantitatively relevant factors in explaining the positive correlation.
doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01181-z.abstract_zh: 基于德国社会经济面板数据，本文全面考察了以企业职工委员会为形式的职场共同决策与收入满意度之间的关系。在控制个体、岗位及企业层面广泛特征变量的OLS与固定效应模型中，我们发现：相较于非共同决策企业，设有职工委员会企业的员工报告的收入满意度显著更高。收入分配位次、工资公平感知及工作条件是解释这一正向关联的关键量化因素。

doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01182-y.abstract: This paper contributes to the understanding of alcohol consumption in adulthood by investigating the impact of a specific life event: the transition to an empty nest, when adult children move out of the parental home. Our findings using English data show a significant increase in alcohol consumption in an empty nest, characterised by more regular drinking patterns and a moderate increase in daily intake. The most affected groups include couples, high-income individuals, those actively employed, and respondents aged 45–60. We also provide evidence on the mechanisms underlying this relationship, supporting a key role of relaxation and changes in time use.
doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01182-y.abstract_zh: 本文通过研究特定生活事件——成年子女搬离父母家后的“空巢”过渡期——对成年期饮酒行为的影响，深化了对该问题的理解。基于英国数据的分析表明，空巢期饮酒量显著增加，表现为饮酒频率更趋规律，且日均摄入量适度上升。受影响最显著的群体包括夫妻、高收入者、在职人员及45-60岁受访者。本研究还揭示了这一关联的内在机制，证实放松需求与时间利用变化在其中发挥关键作用。

doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01184-w.abstract: This paper examines whether traditional gender norms are associated with well-being penalties for the rising share of women who are more educated than their husbands (hypogamy). Using panel data from the Japanese Panel Survey of Consumers (JPSC) covering the period of 1993 to 2020, the results show that women in hypogamous marriages report lower life satisfaction than other married women. The negative association is less pronounced for more recent marriage cohorts, as well as for women with less traditional norms. Moreover, the association shows stronger negative well-being implications for hypogamous women whose intra-household role is not in line with norm-based expectations.
doi:10.1007/s00148-026-01184-w.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了传统性别规范是否与日益增多的“妻强夫弱”（即妻子受教育程度高于丈夫）婚姻中女性的幸福感损失相关。基于1993年至2020年日本消费者面板调查（JPSC）的面板数据，结果显示，处于“妻强夫弱”婚姻中的女性报告的生活满意度低于其他已婚女性。这种负向关联在较晚近的婚姻队列中以及传统观念较弱的女性中不那么显著。此外，对于家庭内部角色不符合规范预期的“妻强夫弱”女性，这种关联表现出更强的负面幸福感影响。
