doi:10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113113.abstract: Short-term reversal appears to have weakened in international equity markets because standard measures mix firm-specific and industry-wide returns. When evaluated relative to industry peers, the reversal persists. Using data from 64 countries, the conventional strategy delivers negligible returns, whereas an industry-adjusted strategy earns 0.53% per month with a Sharpe ratio of 0.74. The effect reflects the reversal of firm-specific shocks masked by persistent industry components. A regret-based signal captures the same industry-relative variation, adding no incremental return. Reversal did not disappear; it was mismeasured.
doi:10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113113.abstract_zh: 短期反转效应在国际股票市场中似乎有所减弱，这是因为标准指标混淆了公司特定回报与行业整体回报。当以行业同行作为基准进行评估时，反转效应依然存在。基于64个国家的数据，传统策略带来的回报微乎其微，而经行业调整后的策略每月可获得0.53%的收益，夏普比率为0.74。这一效应反映了被持续性行业成分掩盖的公司特定冲击的反转。基于遗憾的信号捕捉到了相同的行业相对变化，但并未带来额外回报。反转效应并未消失，而是被错误衡量了。

doi:10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113121.abstract: Researchers often include unit-specific (e.g., state-specific) trends in difference-in-differences (DiD) specifications. Under standard DiD assumptions, these specifications still yield consistent estimates of dynamic treatment effects (i.e., separate effects for each post-treatment time period) but the pooled post-treatment coefficient is not consistent for the average treatment effect. This single coefficient is a weighted average of the dynamic coefficients, but some weights are often negative. This occurs even without a staggered rollout of treatment. Instead of estimating a pooled coefficient, researchers can estimate the average treatment effect as the mean of the dynamic effects. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
doi:10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113121.abstract_zh: 研究者常在双重差分（DiD）设定中纳入单位特定（如州特定）趋势。在标准DiD假设下，这些设定仍能得出动态处理效应（即每个处理后期对应的独立效应）的一致估计，但合并处理后期系数并非平均处理效应的一致估计量。该单一系数是动态系数的加权平均值，但部分权重常为负值——即便在非交错式处理推行情况下亦如此。研究者可通过计算动态效应均值来估计平均处理效应，而非采用合并系数。

doi:10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113124.abstract: This note studies a pure fertility-timing reform in a three-period OLG model. Holding completed fertility fixed, shifting births from middle age to youth raises the balanced-growth factor if N > 1 , lowers it if N < 1 , and leaves it unchanged if N = 1 . The same positive balanced-growth root λ determines cohort growth, the cohort ratio, and the steady-state PAYG support ratio λ 2 + λ . Thus the long-run support-ratio effect, and under an exogenous wage the pension-benefit effect, are positive in growing populations and negative in shrinking ones.
doi:10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113124.abstract_zh: 本文在三期OLG模型中研究了一项纯粹的生育时机改革。在保持终身生育率不变的前提下，将生育行为从中年阶段提前至青年阶段，若N>1则会提高平衡增长因子，若N<1则会降低该因子，若N=1则保持不变。相同的正平衡增长根λ决定了队列增长、队列比率以及稳态现收现付制抚养比λ²+λ。因此，长期抚养比效应以及在外生工资条件下的养老金待遇效应，在人口增长型社会中为正，在人口收缩型社会中为负。

doi:10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113125.abstract: Does proximity to the natal family protect women against intimate partner violence (IPV)? Leveraging Uzbekistan as a natural laboratory and an original list experiment among 835 married women, we find that women near their parents show a list-experiment prevalence estimate of 9.4% and no detectable reporting gap, whereas those far from their parents report only 8.5% in direct surveys, against a list-experiment estimate of 36.2%. Standard surveys do not merely undercount these victims — they invert the ranking of risk, making the most vulnerable women appear the safest. A parallel attitude experiment supports neither preference falsification nor cultural selection.
doi:10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113125.abstract_zh: 靠近原生家庭能否保护女性免受亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）侵害？以乌兹别克斯坦为自然实验场，通过对835名已婚女性开展原始列表实验，我们发现：与父母同住的女性在列表实验中遭受暴力的估计比例为9.4%，且未发现可检测的报告偏差；而远离父母的女性在直接调查中仅报告8.5%的暴力发生率，但列表实验估计值却高达36.2%。传统调查不仅低估了这些受害者的数量——更彻底颠倒了风险排序，使最脆弱的女性反而显得最安全。平行态度实验的结果既不支持偏好伪装假说，也不支持文化选择假说。

doi:10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113130.abstract: This study examines how politically driven trade-threat signals affect global equity markets. Using a Large Language Model (LLM), we construct a measure of trade-threat intensity from U.S. president Donald J. Trump’s posts on Truth Social and identify extreme threat events based on the upper tail of the score distribution. We find that these events are associated with significantly negative abnormal returns in global equity markets, concentrated within a short window around the event date. The effect exhibits substantial regional heterogeneity, with weaker responses in the Americas and stronger reactions in European, Asian, and Pacific markets. Our findings suggest that LLM-based measures of political communication capture economically meaningful signals associated with short-horizon movements in asset prices, highlighting the role of real-time political rhetoric in shaping global financial market dynamics.
doi:10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113130.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了政治驱动的贸易威胁信号如何影响全球股票市场。通过运用大语言模型（LLM），我们基于美国前总统唐纳德·J·特朗普在Truth Social平台上的帖子构建了贸易威胁强度指标，并根据得分分布的上尾部分识别出极端威胁事件。研究发现，这些事件与全球股票市场显著为负的异常收益率相关，且该效应集中在事件日期前后的短窗口期内。该影响表现出显著的区域异质性：美洲市场反应较弱，而欧洲、亚洲及太平洋市场反应更为强烈。我们的研究结果表明，基于大语言模型的政治沟通指标能够捕捉与资产价格短期波动相关的经济意义信号，凸显了实时政治言论在塑造全球金融市场动态中的作用。

doi:10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113144.abstract: A representative chooses policy on behalf of a group with heterogeneous preferences. Group members differ in voice (their salience to the representative). The representative maximizes perceived welfare based on a voice-weighted signal. The resulting policy distortion is proportional to the covariance between voice and preferences. When agents choose voice effort endogenously, equilibrium voice is U-shaped (quadratic in distance between preferences and policy). The equilibrium distortion is approximately one-third of a standard deviation times the skewness coefficient. It is non-zero only when the preference distribution is skewed. Combining the voice-weighted signal with a random sample can reduce the expected welfare loss. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
doi:10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113144.abstract_zh: 一位代表代表一个偏好异质性的群体制定政策。群体成员在话语权（即其对代表的重要性）上存在差异。代表基于话语权加权的信号最大化感知福利。由此产生的政策扭曲与话语权和偏好之间的协方差成正比。当代理人内生地选择话语努力时，均衡话语呈U形（即偏好与政策距离的二次函数）。均衡扭曲约为标准差的三分之一乘以偏度系数。只有当偏好分布呈偏态时，该扭曲才非零。将话语权加权信号与随机样本相结合，可以减少预期福利损失。

doi:10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113151.abstract: Systemic importance has two dimensions, a bank’s contribution to system-wide tail risk ($\Delta$CoVaR) and its exposure to it (marginal expected shortfall, MES). Using daily $\Delta$CoVaR and MES for 24 publicly traded Global Systemically Important Banks over 2012–2025, we show the two rankings move on different clocks. Contribution rankings reorder at the same rate in calm times, the pandemic, and after. Exposure rankings survive the pandemic but re-anchor sharply at the 2022–2023 interest-rate regime change, as euro-area banks fall and US and Japanese banks rise. Shocks rotate which banks contribute to systemic risk; only regime changes move which are exposed.
doi:10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113151.abstract_zh: 系统重要性具有两个维度：银行对系统性尾部风险的贡献度（$\Delta$CoVaR）及其风险暴露程度（边际预期损失，MES）。基于2012-2025年间24家上市全球系统重要性银行的日度$\Delta$CoVaR与MES数据，我们发现两种排名遵循不同的时间节奏。贡献度排名在平稳时期、疫情期间及疫情后均以相同速率重新排序；而风险暴露排名虽经受住疫情冲击，却在2022-2023年利率制度转换时发生剧烈锚定调整——欧元区银行排名下降，美日银行排名上升。冲击会改变哪些银行构成系统性风险贡献者，唯有制度变迁才能改变哪些银行面临风险暴露。

doi:10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113155.abstract: We document a growing link between university R&D expenditures and patenting activity in surrounding metropolitan statistical areas (MSAs) since 1980: the patents-per-capita gap between MSAs with and without a research university has doubled, and the elasticity of patents with respect to university R&D has tripled. We present several pieces of evidence showing that this trend reflects growing spillovers from universities: it is robust to MSA and university characteristics; local invention tracks the content of nearby university research; and the link is stronger where universities do more basic research. Thus, universities may increasingly shape the geography of innovation.
doi:10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113155.abstract_zh: 我们记录了自1980年以来，大学研发支出与周边大都市统计区（MSA）专利活动之间日益增强的联系：拥有研究型大学的MSA与没有研究型大学的MSA之间的人均专利差距扩大了一倍，且专利对大学研发的弹性增长了两倍。我们提供了多项证据表明，这一趋势反映了大学溢出效应的增强：该联系对MSA和大学特征具有稳健性；本地发明活动与邻近大学的研究内容相吻合；且在大学从事更多基础研究的地区，这种联系更为显著。因此，大学可能日益塑造着创新的地理格局。

doi:10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101773.abstract: This paper examines how acute pollution exposure in historical London (1892–1919) affected child health. I proxy acute, extreme pollution exposure using daily data on fog events, which reflect meteorological conditions where pollution emitted in the city was not dispersed across space leading to a sharp spike in pollution. I also use rich individual-level data on child health drawn from the Queen Charlotte Hospital, a maternity hospital, and the Foundling Hospital, an orphanage. I find no effect of pollution exposure at birth on birth or growth outcomes or on upper respiratory morbidity. However, exposure on the day of birth had persistent effects on health, increasing mortality risk in childhood and adolescence from respiratory diseases and raising incidence, prevalence and sickness duration of influenza and measles. There was no persistent effect of in utero and postnatal pollution exposures. These mixed results show that extreme pollution at birth had lasting impacts on specific, but also limited, dimensions of child health.
doi:10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101773.abstract_zh: 本文研究了历史时期伦敦（1892-1919年）急性污染暴露对儿童健康的影响。我利用每日雾天事件数据作为急性极端污染暴露的代理变量——这些雾天反映了城市排放的污染物因无法扩散而导致污染浓度急剧飙升的气象条件。同时，我采用来自夏洛特女王医院（一家妇产医院）和弃婴医院（一家孤儿院）的丰富个体层面儿童健康数据。研究发现，出生时的污染暴露对出生结局、生长发育指标或上呼吸道疾病发病率无显著影响。然而，出生当日的污染暴露对健康产生了持续性影响：它增加了儿童期及青少年期因呼吸系统疾病导致的死亡风险，并提高了流感与麻疹的发病率、患病率及病程持续时间。宫内暴露和产后暴露则未发现持续性影响。这些混合结果表明，出生时的极端污染暴露对儿童健康的特定维度（但范围有限）产生了持久影响。

doi:10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101774.abstract: The Panic of 1825 was a significant crisis in British financial history. We document how this crisis spread from London banks to England’s real economy. England’s correspondent banking network propagated trouble in sovereign debt markets to small banks outside of London and ultimately to non-financial firms. Using exogenous variation in district-level exposure to the crisis, we show that bank failures led to a substantial number of bankruptcies among non-financial firms. We discuss two potential mechanisms by which the financial system affected the real economy: a fall in aggregate demand and a credit supply shock.
doi:10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101774.abstract_zh: 1825年恐慌是英国金融史上一次重大危机。本文记录了这场危机如何从伦敦银行蔓延至英格兰实体经济。英格兰的代理银行网络将主权债务市场的困境传导至伦敦以外的小型银行，并最终波及非金融企业。利用各地区危机暴露程度的外生差异，我们证明银行倒闭导致非金融企业破产数量大幅增加。本文探讨了金融体系影响实体经济的两种潜在机制：总需求下降与信贷供给冲击。

doi:10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105425.abstract: We model the interaction between shareholder trading and voting on firm policies that create externalities for which investors have heterogenous preferences, and we test the model’s equilibrium predictions in the laboratory. The model suggests, and laboratory results confirm, that low policy costs favor policy adoption while intermediate costs lead to a lower policy adoption rate under dispersed preferences than under polarized preferences. Observed share prices are higher than equilibrium predictions when the policy is adopted and are close to the fundamental value of the firm had the policy not been adopted. We conclude that the adoption of costly policies with externalities may be less burdensome to shareholders than predicted.
doi:10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105425.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，用以分析股东交易与投票在制定具有外部性的公司政策时的相互作用，其中投资者对这些外部性存在异质性偏好，并通过实验室实验检验了模型的均衡预测。模型表明（且实验结果证实）：低政策成本有利于政策采纳，而在中等成本条件下，分散偏好下的政策采纳率低于极化偏好。当政策被采纳时，观察到的股价高于均衡预测值，且接近未采纳政策时公司的基本面价值。我们得出结论：具有外部性的高成本政策对股东的负担可能低于理论预测。

doi:10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105427.abstract: New importers increase their conditional survival rate and import share over time. However, a model of multi-input firms with an import entry cost and stochastic import costs cannot replicate these dynamics. I show that an extended model can be reconciled with the data. I calibrate both models and use them to identify the effects of trade shocks. The simulations show that a decrease in import prices with the new importer dynamics generates lower productivity gains, but these gains are more widespread across firms.
doi:10.1016/j.euroecorev.2026.105427.abstract_zh: 新进口商的存活率和进口份额随时间推移而提高。然而，一个包含进口进入成本和随机进口成本的多投入企业模型无法复现这些动态特征。本文证明，扩展后的模型能够与数据相吻合。我对两个模型进行了校准，并利用它们识别贸易冲击的影响。模拟结果表明，在新进口商动态特征下，进口价格下降带来的生产率提升幅度较小，但这些提升在企业间的分布更为广泛。

doi:10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103137.abstract: The ways in which governments legitimize and promote plant-rich eating remain underexplored, particularly in contexts where animal-based foods retain strong cultural and political significance. Focusing primarily on nutritional governance, this study examines the institutional mechanisms through which plant foods and plant-rich practices have been framed as objects of public intervention in Portugal since the inception of the National Program for the Promotion of Healthy Eating in 2012. Adopting a qualitative, discourse-oriented, and semiotically informed approach, the study conceptualizes public intervention as a dispositif that actively shapes meanings and norms around food. Findings show that the legitimization of plant-rich eating relies on strategically cautious discourse emphasizing health, sustainability, and heritage, while avoiding explicit advocacy of vegetarianism. The Mediterranean diet emerges as the primary legitimizing model, enabling plant foods without challenging the centrality of meat and fish. Risk prevention and responsibilization further structure these discourses, framing citizens as self-monitoring consumers. Ultimately, plant-rich eating is cautiously legitimized yet continually negotiated, absorbed into broader narratives of health, sustainability, and national identity. As the first European country to legally require the availability of vegetarian meals in public canteens, Portugal offers insights for other national contexts, particularly regarding discursive strategies, risk-based governance, the symbolic status of animal and plant products, and the role of institutional environments in normalizing plant-rich eating. These findings also resonate with developments elsewhere while highlighting context-specific dynamics.
doi:10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103137.abstract_zh: 政府如何合法化并推广植物性饮食仍是一个研究不足的领域，尤其是在动物性食品仍具有深厚文化及政治意义的背景下。本研究聚焦营养治理，考察自2012年葡萄牙启动《促进健康饮食国家计划》以来，植物性食品及植物性饮食实践被构建为公共干预对象的制度机制。采用定性、话语导向及符号学分析路径，本研究将公共干预概念化为一个积极塑造食品意义与规范的"装置"。研究发现，植物性饮食的合法化依赖于策略性谨慎话语，强调健康、可持续性与传统遗产，同时避免明确倡导素食主义。地中海饮食模式成为主要的合法化模型，既推广植物性食品又不挑战肉类与鱼类的主导地位。风险预防与责任化进一步构建了这些话语，将公民塑造为自我监控的消费者。最终，植物性饮食虽被谨慎合法化，却持续处于协商状态，被吸纳进健康、可持续性与国家认同的宏大叙事中。作为首个通过法律要求公共食堂提供素食的欧洲国家，葡萄牙为其他国家的实践提供了启示，尤其在话语策略、风险治理、动植物产品的象征地位以及制度环境对植物性饮食常态化的作用方面。这些发现亦与其他地区的发展相呼应，同时凸显了特定情境的动态特征。

doi:10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103138.abstract: Technology adoption is an important farm management decision and is frequently made using information that is unavailable to the researcher. Aside from their own experiences, producers often rely on extension services to inform their adoption decisions. Here, we propose a novel instrumental variable (IV) approach to identify the effect that a new technology, genetically modified (GM) corn, has on farm yield using instruments constructed from extension information. The proposed approach allows us to explore the degree to which endogeneity bias is present in the GM adoption effect on farm productivity. Candidate instruments are constructed from variety trial data to resemble information acquired by producers from university extension variety trial reports and are spatially merged with on-farm production data. We find that failure to account for the endogeneity of the adoption decision does indeed result in an upward bias in the estimated productivity gains. After correcting for this bias through our IV approach, GM corn results in large on-farm yield gains of 19.6 bushels per acre. We demonstrate that variety trial data can be used to estimate the on-farm impact of new technology, and this approach is general enough to be applied to additional contexts (i.e., technologies, crops, and/or locations).
doi:10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103138.abstract_zh: 技术采纳是农场管理中的一项重要决策，且通常基于研究者无法获取的信息进行。除自身经验外，生产者常依赖推广服务来指导其采纳决策。本文提出一种新的工具变量（IV）方法，利用推广信息构建的工具变量，识别转基因玉米这一新技术对农场产量的影响。该方法使我们能够探究转基因采纳效应中内生性偏差对农场生产率影响的程度。候选工具变量基于品种试验数据构建，以模拟生产者从大学推广品种试验报告中获取的信息，并与农场生产数据进行空间匹配。研究发现，若未考虑采纳决策的内生性，确实会导致估计的生产率提升出现向上偏差。通过IV方法纠正这一偏差后，转基因玉米使农场产量实现每英亩19.6蒲式耳的大幅提升。我们证明，品种试验数据可用于估算新技术对农场的影响，且该方法具有足够普适性，可应用于其他情境（如不同技术、作物或地区）。

doi:10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103141.abstract: Sustainable public procurement (SPP) is increasingly recognized as a policy tool to improve the environmental performance of food systems, yet there is limited empirical evidence on how procurement strategies influence environmental outcomes. This study assesses the environmental implications of municipal food procurement in a rural Swedish region using life cycle assessment (LCA). Procurement data from Östersund Municipality were used to construct baseline and alternative scenarios that reflect policy targets and objectives, including increased sourcing of organic and local foods, substitution of beef with game or legumes, and reductions in plate waste. Environmental impacts were evaluated using the Impact World + method across multiple indicators, including climate change, eutrophication, biodiversity, toxicity, and resource use. The results show that procurement strategies have differing effects across impact categories. Measures targeting food composition and consumption, such as reducing beef consumption and plate waste, lead to consistent reductions across several indicators, whereas strategies focused on sourcing and production methods, such as organic and local, yield more mixed outcomes, with improvements in some categories but increases in others. Substituting minced beef with local game and reducing food waste result in the largest overall reductions, while increasing organic procurement leads to relatively small changes across most indicators. These findings highlight the importance of multi-indicator assessments and show that focusing on a single indicator, or target, risks overlooking trade-offs. The study provides empirical evidence supporting more targeted, evidence-based procurement strategies and highlights the need for improved life cycle inventory data.
doi:10.1016/j.foodpol.2026.103141.abstract_zh: 可持续公共采购（SPP）日益被视为改善食品系统环境绩效的政策工具，然而关于采购策略如何影响环境结果的实证证据仍然有限。本研究采用生命周期评估（LCA）方法，评估瑞典某农村地区市政食品采购的环境影响。基于厄斯特松德市采购数据，构建了反映政策目标与指标的基准情景与替代情景，包括增加有机食品和本地食品采购、以野味或豆类替代牛肉、以及减少餐盘浪费。采用Impact World+方法，从气候变化、富营养化、生物多样性、毒性和资源利用等多个指标评估环境影响。结果表明，不同采购策略在各影响类别中产生差异化效果。针对食品构成与消费的措施（如减少牛肉消费和餐盘浪费）在多个指标上实现持续减排，而聚焦于采购与生产方式（如有机和本地化）的策略则呈现混合结果——部分指标改善，另一些指标恶化。以本地野味替代碎牛肉和减少食物浪费带来最大整体减排，而增加有机采购在多数指标上仅产生较小变化。这些发现凸显了多指标评估的重要性，并表明仅关注单一指标或目标可能忽视权衡取舍。本研究为制定更具针对性和循证性的采购策略提供了实证支持，并强调改进生命周期清单数据的必要性。

doi:10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103877.abstract: This paper studies the effects of the Green Revolution, one of the largest development projects in the late 20th-Century, on individualism. We use a difference-in-differences approach to investigate how rapid technological and organizational changes in traditional agriculture reshaped cultural norms in Indonesia, where Green Revolution rollout was largely driven by centralized government interventions. Regions with greater exposure to Green Revolution policies experienced significant and persistent increases in individualism (as measured by a higher prevalence of infrequent names) decades after the end of the program. Results are not driven by pre-trends and hold across a battery of robustness checks. We further document suggestive, correlational evidence of a persistent fall in community funding for public goods, a key measure of collective action. Our findings suggest that technical change can lead to rapid and persistent changes in culture.
doi:10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103877.abstract_zh: 本文研究20世纪末最大规模发展项目之一——绿色革命对个人主义的影响。我们采用双重差分法，探究传统农业中快速的技术与组织变革如何重塑印度尼西亚的文化规范。在该国，绿色革命的推广主要由中央政府干预驱动。研究显示，在项目结束数十年后，受绿色革命政策影响较大的地区，其个人主义（以罕见名字出现频率升高为衡量指标）显著且持续增强。该结果不受事前趋势影响，并通过了一系列稳健性检验。我们进一步发现具有提示性的相关证据：作为集体行动关键指标的公共品社区资金投入持续下降。研究结果表明，技术变革能够引发文化快速且持久的变迁。

doi:10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103880.abstract: We study how the Trans-Regional Jurisdiction reform (TRJ) affects corporate investment. The reform moves administrative lawsuits to courts outside the defendant government's home jurisdiction, which limits local government influence over the courts. We use a stacked difference-in-differences design that draws on the staggered rollout of the reform across cities. We find that the reform raises corporate investment by about 28.7 percent of the sample mean. Complementary evidence shows that the reform improves court outcomes for firms, has stronger effects where pre-reform trust in local institutions is higher, and is associated with lower institutional transaction costs and financing constraints. The effect is larger for firms with more irreversible investment, lower state ownership, and better access to finance. The reform also leads firms to acquire more land and take on more risk, although part of the higher investment appears as overinvestment. These results show how a focused judicial reform can change firm behavior where legal institutions are weak.
doi:10.1016/j.jdeveco.2026.103880.abstract_zh: 本文研究跨区域司法管辖改革（TRJ）如何影响企业投资。该改革将行政诉讼案件转移至被告政府所在地之外的法院审理，从而限制了地方政府对法院的影响力。我们采用堆叠双重差分法，利用改革在各城市分阶段推行的特征进行分析。研究发现，改革使企业投资水平较样本均值提升约28.7%。补充证据表明：改革改善了企业面临的司法结果；在改革前对地方制度信任度更高的地区效果更显著；改革降低了制度性交易成本与融资约束。对于投资不可逆性更高、国有持股比例更低、融资渠道更畅通的企业，改革效应更为突出。改革还促使企业增加土地购置并承担更高风险，但部分投资增长表现为过度投资。这些结论揭示了在法律制度薄弱的环境下，聚焦性的司法改革如何改变企业行为。

doi:10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107676.abstract: This study examines the causal effect of P M 2.5 air pollution exposure on premature mortality in Southern European cities from 2010 to 2018. We leverage local variations in precipitation and wind speed as a source of random variation in P M 2.5 exposure. Using the Two-Sample Two-Stage Least Squares (TS2SLS) estimator to reconcile monitoring station-level and city-level data, our findings reveal a statistically significant increase in premature mortality caused by P M 2.5 . According to our preferred specification, a 1% increase in P M 2.5 causes a 0.82% rise in the under-65 mortality rate and a 0.93% rise in the infant mortality rate. The results are robust to alternative specifications. The most affected populations are those residing in urban areas (relative to suburban areas) and those living in cities located in richer regions (as opposed to poorer ones). We also examine the role of additional pollutants, finding further evidence for the importance of particulate matter.
doi:10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107676.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了2010年至2018年南欧城市PM2.5空气污染暴露对过早死亡率的因果效应。我们利用降水和风速的局部变化作为PM2.5暴露的随机变异来源。通过采用两样本两阶段最小二乘估计量（TS2SLS）协调监测站点级与城市级数据，研究结果表明PM2.5暴露显著增加了过早死亡率。根据我们的首选模型设定，PM2.5浓度每增加1%，会导致65岁以下死亡率上升0.82%，婴儿死亡率上升0.93%。该结果在替代模型设定下依然稳健。受影响最严重的人群包括城市地区（相对于郊区）居民，以及位于较富裕地区（相对于较贫困地区）城市的居民。我们还考察了其他污染物的作用，进一步证实了颗粒物的重要性。

doi:10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107679.abstract: We examine whether preventive health care uptake varies with cultural background related to patience and risk-taking. We combine individual-level survey data on preventive care use from 27 European countries with country-level preference measures from the Global Preferences Survey. To reduce confounding from institutional and economic correlates of culture, we focus on second-generation immigrants, who were born and currently reside in the same country – and thus face the same health care system and broad economic environment – but differ in inherited cultural background through their parents’ countries of origin. We find that respondents from more patient cultural backgrounds are more likely to use preventive services, while those from more risk-tolerant backgrounds are less likely to do so. These patterns appear across multiple preventive care outcomes.
doi:10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107679.abstract_zh: 本文考察预防性医疗服务的利用是否因与耐心和风险偏好相关的文化背景而异。我们将来自27个欧洲国家的个体层面预防性护理使用调查数据，与全球偏好调查中的国家层面偏好指标相结合。为减少文化与制度、经济因素之间的混杂效应，我们聚焦于第二代移民——他们出生并居住在同一国家，因此面临相同的医疗体系与宏观经济环境，但通过父母的原籍国继承了不同的文化背景。研究发现，来自更具耐心文化背景的受访者更倾向于使用预防性服务，而来自更具风险容忍背景的受访者则较少使用。这一模式在多种预防性护理结果中均得到体现。

doi:10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107680.abstract: We study the effect of commitment on threats in adversarial bargaining—situations in which a proposer (prosecutor) demands payment from a responder (defendant) under the threat of conflict if the demand is rejected. We focus on plea bargaining, where a prosecutor files charges against a defendant before a round of plea bargaining. The charges affect payoffs if an agreement is not reached, and the case proceeds to trial. The expected benefit for the prosecutor at trial is maximized at a lower charge than that which maximizes the defendant’s loss. Just before the trial starts, the prosecutor can reduce the charges up to a certain point depending on their level of commitment power. The experimental data show that participants with sufficient commitment power used it to gain bargaining power by overcharging the defendant. However, they do so more conservatively than the theory predicts.
doi:10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107680.abstract_zh: 本文研究承诺能力如何影响对抗性谈判中的威胁。在此类情境中，提议方（检察官）向回应方（被告）提出要求，并以要求遭拒后发生冲突作为威胁。本文聚焦辩诉交易：检察官在谈判前先对被告提出指控；若双方未达成协议，案件进入审判，指控将影响双方收益。检察官在审判中的预期收益在较低指控水平达到最大，而使被告损失最大化的指控水平更高。审判开始前，检察官可依据其承诺能力，在一定范围内降低指控。实验数据显示，具备足够承诺能力的参与者会通过提出过高指控来增强谈判能力，但其行为比理论预测更为保守。

doi:10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107685.abstract: We study the effect of communication on beliefs, behavior, and efficiency in the context of trust games with a punishment option, which have the structure of hold-up problems. We apply a novel behavioral motivation, frustration-dependent anger, that links unmet payoff expectations with the willingness to forgo material payoffs to punish others, and we conjecture that communication works through this mechanism to raise expectations about the likelihood of belief-dependent costly punishment and to increase trust, cooperation, and efficiency. Promises drive the effect of communication on beliefs and broken promises lead to costly punishment. In an experiment we allow communication in the form of a single pre-play message. We measure beliefs and our design permits the observation of promises and deception. The results are consistent with the theory.
doi:10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107685.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在具有惩罚选项的信任博弈中，沟通对信念、行为及效率的影响，这类博弈具有敲竹杠问题的结构。我们引入了一种新颖的行为动机——基于挫败感的愤怒，该动机将未实现的收益预期与牺牲物质收益惩罚他人的意愿联系起来，并推测沟通通过这一机制发挥作用，提升对信念依赖性高成本惩罚可能性的预期，从而增强信任、合作与效率。承诺驱动了沟通对信念的影响，而违背承诺则导致高成本惩罚。在实验中，我们允许以单一事前信息的形式进行沟通，测量了信念，并通过实验设计观察了承诺与欺骗行为。实验结果与理论预测一致。

doi:10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107699.abstract: This paper asks whether authors’ ability to manipulate AI referees necessarily undermines peer review, or whether it can sometimes improve it. We model a journal in which authors privately know quality, referees choose between costly manual review and cheap AI delegation, and editors may investigate suspicious recommendations. Hidden prompts can force AI to recommend acceptance, but prompt detection is imperfect. With the baseline referee incentives and sequentially rational, non-committed investigation, manual-only review is unsustainable once AI is available, and there is no robust pure-strategy AI-only equilibrium with manipulation. Most notably, under the welfare criterion studied here, prompt injection can be welfare improving on an open set of primitives: in certain monitoring equilibria, manipulation makes positive AI reports more suspicious or more exposed to audit, induces editor investigation, and helps sustain manual review where prompt-free standard inspection would fail. Stronger prompt detection is, therefore, not unconditionally better; within the focal equilibrium menu, it can eliminate a monitoring regime without replacing it with a higher-welfare one. doi:10.1016/j.jebo.2026.107699.abstract_zh: 本文探讨作者操纵AI审稿人的能力是否必然损害同行评审，抑或有时能改进评审机制。我们构建了一个期刊模型：作者私下知晓论文质量，审稿人可在高成本人工评审与低成本AI委托之间选择，编辑则可能对可疑推荐展开调查。隐藏提示可强制AI推荐接收，但提示检测并不完美。在基准审稿人激励与序贯理性、非承诺调查条件下，一旦AI可用，纯人工评审便不可持续，且不存在稳健的纯策略AI均衡（含操纵行为）。尤为值得注意的是，在所研究的福利标准下，提示注入可在开集参数上改善福利：在某些监控均衡中，操纵行为使正面AI报告更可疑或更易受审计，促使编辑展开调查，并在无提示的标准审查失效时维持人工评审。因此，更强的提示检测并非无条件更优；在焦点均衡集合内，它可能消除一种监控机制，却未代之以更高福利的机制。

doi:10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.105949.abstract: In this paper we consider the simulation-based Bayesian analysis of stochastic volatility in mean (SVM) models. Extending the highly efficient Markov chain Monte Carlo mixture sampler for the SV model proposed in Kim et al. (1998) and Omori et al. (2007), we develop an accurate approximation of the logarithm of the non-central chi-squared distribution as a mixture of thirty normal distributions . Under this mixture representation, we sample the parameters and latent volatilities in one block. We also detail a correction of the small approximation error by using additional Metropolis–Hastings steps. The proposed method is extended to the SVM model with leverage. The methodology and models are applied to excess holding yields and S&P500 returns in empirical studies, and the SVM models are shown to outperform other volatility models based on marginal likelihoods.
doi:10.1016/j.jeconom.2025.105949.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了基于模拟的贝叶斯分析在随机波动率均值（SVM）模型中的应用。通过扩展Kim等人（1998）及Omori等人（2007）提出的针对SV模型的高效马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛混合抽样方法，我们开发了一种精确近似非中心卡方分布对数的方法，将其表示为三十个正态分布的混合形式。在此混合表示下，我们实现了参数与潜在波动率的联合分块抽样。同时，我们详细阐述了通过附加Metropolis-Hastings步骤来修正微小近似误差的方法，并将所提方法扩展至包含杠杆效应的SVM模型。在实证研究中，我们将该方法与模型应用于超额持有收益率及标普500指数收益率，结果表明基于边际似然比较，SVM模型优于其他波动率模型。

doi:10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106297.abstract: This paper studies the introduction of causal conditional heteroskedasticity in noncausal autoregressive (AR) models. We demonstrate that, in this framework, large shocks to the innovation process driving the GARCH error term of a noncausal AR model result in heightened volatility immediately before and after a bubble crash. The non-coincidence of the σ -fields generated by past observations and past values of the GARCH process makes statistical inference nonstandard. In particular, the full quasi-maximum likelihood estimator (QMLE) is generally inconsistent. We investigate the asymptotic properties of three-step weighted least squares estimators of the AR coefficient and the QMLE of the volatility parameters. Our findings are illustrated by Monte Carlo experiments and an empirical application to financial data.
doi:10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106297.abstract_zh: 本文研究在非因果自回归（AR）模型中引入因果条件异方差性的方法。我们证明，在该框架下，驱动非因果AR模型GARCH误差项的创新过程中的大幅冲击，会导致泡沫崩溃前后波动性显著加剧。由于过去观测值生成的σ域与GARCH过程过去值生成的σ域不重合，统计推断变得非标准。具体而言，完全拟极大似然估计量（QMLE）通常不一致。我们研究了AR系数的三步加权最小二乘估计量以及波动率参数的QMLE的渐近性质。通过蒙特卡洛实验和对金融数据的实证应用，本文验证了上述发现。

doi:10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106302.abstract: This paper presents an inference method for the local average treatment effect (LATE) in the presence of high-dimensional covariates, regardless of the strength of identification. We propose an orthogonalized Anderson-Rubin test statistic that maintains uniformly valid asymptotic size. We provide an easy-to-implement algorithm for inferring the high-dimensional LATE by inverting our test statistic and employing the double/debiased machine learning method. Simulation results show that our test achieves better size control under both weak identification and high dimensionality, outperforming conventional alternatives. Applying the proposed method to railroad and population data to study the effect of railroad access on urban population growth, we observe wider confidence intervals than those obtained using conventional methods.
doi:10.1016/j.jeconom.2026.106302.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种在高维协变量存在下，无论识别强度如何，对局部平均处理效应（LATE）进行推断的方法。我们构建了一个正交化的安德森-鲁宾检验统计量，该统计量能保持均匀有效的渐近规模。通过反转该检验统计量并采用双重/去偏机器学习方法，我们提供了一种易于实现的算法来推断高维LATE。模拟结果表明，在弱识别和高维性条件下，我们的检验在规模控制方面优于传统替代方法。将所提方法应用于铁路与人口数据以研究铁路通达对城市人口增长的影响时，我们观察到比传统方法更宽的置信区间。

doi:10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105393.abstract: In this paper, we assess how the stability of financial networks is affected by interconnectedness considering its tiniest variation: the edge. We compute the impact of edges as the percentage difference in the systemic risk (SR) of the whole network caused by the inclusion of that edge. We apply this framework to a thorough Brazilian dataset to compute the impact of bank-firm edges. After observing that (i) edges are heterogeneous regarding their impact on the SR, and (ii) the fraction of edges whose impact on the SR is non-positive increases with the level of the initial shock, we use machine learning techniques to try to predict two variables: the criticality of the edges (defining as critical an edge whose impact on SR is significantly greater than that of the others) and the sign of the edge impact. The level of accuracy obtained in these prediction exercises was very high. These results have important implications for the development macroprudential policies aimed at financial stability. Our framework allows to identify, based on features related to the origin and destination nodes of the edge (i.e., the lending bank and the borrowing firm), whether an additional loan will have a significant and positive impact on the SR.
doi:10.1016/j.jedc.2026.105393.abstract_zh: 本文评估了金融网络稳定性如何受互联性影响，重点关注其最细微的变化：边。我们通过计算某条边加入后对整个网络系统性风险（SR）造成的百分比差异，来衡量该边的影响。我们将这一框架应用于详尽的巴西数据集，以计算银行-企业边的影响。在观察到以下两点后：（i）各边对系统性风险的影响具有异质性；（ii）对系统性风险影响为非正值的边所占比例随初始冲击水平上升而增加，我们运用机器学习技术尝试预测两个变量：边的关键性（将系统性风险影响显著高于其他边的边定义为关键边）以及边影响的符号。这些预测练习的准确度非常高。上述结果对旨在维护金融稳定的宏观审慎政策制定具有重要启示。我们的框架能够基于边起点与终点节点（即贷款银行与借款企业）的相关特征，识别新增贷款是否会对系统性风险产生显著正向影响。

doi:10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103391.abstract: Residential land prices are highly sensitive to new information, particularly when pollution disclosures highlight potential health risks. Following the 2020 disclosure of nationwide government survey results, extensive contamination from per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances, or PFAS, commonly known as “forever chemicals,” was revealed, leading to intensified media coverage and heightened public awareness. This study applies a staggered difference-in-differences approach to quantify the impact of PFAS pollution disclosures on Japanese residential land prices. Using property-level panel data from the Land Market Value Publication, we compare treated properties to control properties within varying distance radii. In the 5 km radius analysis, statistically significant average post-treatment declines range from approximately 1.3% when Tokyo is excluded to 2.4% when Osaka and Okinawa, which had received PFAS-related disclosures earlier, are also excluded. Across the distance-buffer specifications, dynamic event-study effects reach approximately 4.4–6.4% by the fourth year after disclosure. Notably, significant price declines emerged only after media coverage intensified around 2023, highlighting the critical role of information salience in translating environmental disclosures into market responses. A heterogeneity analysis suggests that high-value properties tend to exhibit larger and earlier price responses, consistent with buyers in higher-value market segments being more sensitive to environmental risk information. These findings indicate that pollution disclosures can reduce residential asset values, underscoring the economic costs of environmental information disclosure and the need for complementary policy measures to mitigate capitalized losses borne by affected property owners.
doi:10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103391.abstract_zh: 住宅用地价格对新信息高度敏感，尤其是当污染披露揭示潜在健康风险时。2020年全国政府调查结果公布后，全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS，俗称“永久化学品”）的广泛污染被曝光，导致媒体报道加剧和公众意识提升。本研究采用交错双重差分法，量化PFAS污染披露对日本住宅用地价格的影响。利用《地价公示》中的物业层面面板数据，我们在不同距离半径内将受处理物业与对照物业进行比较。在5公里半径分析中，统计上显著的平均处理后降幅约为1.3%（排除东京时）至2.4%（进一步排除此前已收到PFAS相关披露的大阪和冲绳时）。在不同距离缓冲区的设定下，动态事件研究效应在披露后第四年达到约4.4%至6.4%。值得注意的是，显著的价格下降仅在2023年左右媒体报道加剧后才出现，凸显了信息显著性在将环境披露转化为市场反应中的关键作用。异质性分析表明，高价值物业往往表现出更大且更早的价格反应，这与高价值市场细分中的买家对环境风险信息更为敏感一致。这些发现表明，污染披露可能降低住宅资产价值，凸显了环境信息披露的经济成本，以及需要采取补充政策措施来减轻受影响物业所有者承担的资本化损失。

doi:10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103392.abstract: We study the interplay between individuals’ voluntary contributions to environmental protection and public environmental policy in a dynamic general-equilibrium model. To capture the observed discrepancy between the willingness of individuals to contribute privately versus publicly to environmental protection, we treat the quality of the environment as a public good and assume that voluntary contributions are motivated by a ‘warm glow’ of giving. We show that in the laissez-faire scenario without government intervention, the strength of warm glow negatively affects aggregate output and positively affects environmental quality in the long run. However, when the government intervenes and decides on environmental policy in the interests of individuals, the warm-glow strength has a negative long-run effect on both variables. Thus, our results suggest that advocating for private actions to ensure a better environment in the future may be counterproductive in the presence of public environmental policies.
doi:10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103392.abstract_zh: 本文在一个动态一般均衡模型中研究个体对环境保护的自愿贡献与公共环境政策之间的相互作用。为捕捉个体在私下与公开场合对环境保护贡献意愿的差异，我们将环境质量视为公共品，并假设自愿贡献源于“温暖光辉”的利他动机。研究表明：在无政府干预的自由放任情景下，长期中温暖光辉强度会抑制总产出但提升环境质量；然而当政府以个体利益为出发点制定环境政策时，温暖光辉强度对这两个变量均产生长期负面影响。因此，我们的结论表明，在存在公共环境政策的情况下，倡导通过私人行动确保未来环境改善可能适得其反。

doi:10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103393.abstract: This paper provides novel firm-level estimates of the economic damages caused by temperature shocks to European firms. I rely on a panel data analysis to show wide heterogeneities in the impact of temperature shocks, which depend on firm characteristics. This paper reveals the importance of micro-level data for quantifying climate damages estimates, as the average relationship between temperature and economic outcomes masks firms’ different susceptibilities to weather shocks. These create both winners and losers, harming less productive firms, particularly those in warmer regions, while benefiting more productive ones. Compared with the pooled marginal effect, the least-productive firms experience negative effects roughly ten times as large, while the most-productive firms experience positive effects roughly three times as large. I highlight the distributional effects of climate change, and offer insights for adaptation policies.
doi:10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103393.abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于温度冲击对欧洲企业造成经济损失的新型企业层面估计。我采用面板数据分析，揭示了温度冲击影响的广泛异质性，这种异质性取决于企业特征。本文揭示了微观数据在量化气候损害估计中的重要性，因为温度与经济结果之间的平均关系掩盖了企业对天气冲击的不同敏感性。这既创造了赢家也创造了输家，损害了生产率较低的企业（尤其是位于较暖地区的企业），同时使生产率较高的企业受益。与合并边际效应相比，生产率最低的企业受到的负面效应大约是其十倍，而生产率最高的企业获得的正面效应大约是其三倍。我强调了气候变化的分配效应，并为适应政策提供了见解。

doi:10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103396.abstract: While the global space economy continues to rapidly grow, and public policy challenges related to satellites and debris in orbit emerge, there is surprisingly little evidence connecting theoretical economic frameworks with observed orbital usage. Using a state-of-the-science integrated assessment model combining economic modeling with physical models of the space environment, we find the observed distribution of satellite orbits is well-explained by profit-maximizing satellite operator behavior. Furthermore, we find strong evidence that collision risk plays a key deterrence role. Finally, the observed location of the largest satellite constellation, Starlink, is consistent with a “sole owner” over particularly economically desirable altitudes.
doi:10.1016/j.jeem.2026.103396.abstract_zh: 全球太空经济继续快速增长，与轨道卫星和碎片有关的公共政策挑战不断显现，但将理论经济学框架与实际轨道使用联系起来的证据却出人意料地稀少。本文使用一个结合经济模型与太空环境物理模型的前沿综合评估模型，发现观测到的卫星轨道分布可以由卫星运营商利润最大化行为很好地解释。进一步结果表明，碰撞风险发挥了重要的威慑作用。最后，最大卫星星座 Starlink 的实际部署位置，与其在经济价值尤其高的轨道高度上表现为“单一所有者”的行为相一致。

doi:10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104336.abstract: We evaluate private equity (PE) performance using investor-specific stochastic discount factors, and examine whether investors could benefit from changing their allocation to PE.Plans invest in PE funds with higher average risk-adjusted performance.This is mainly due to access to successful PE managers, not superior selection skill.Decomposing returns into risk-compensation and "alpha", we find that some plans obtain higher PE returns by taking more risk without earning higher, and in some cases earning lower, risk-adjusted returns, broadly consistent with agency problems within plans.
doi:10.1016/j.jfineco.2026.104336.abstract_zh: 我们采用投资者特定的随机贴现因子评估私募股权（PE）业绩，并考察投资者是否能够通过调整PE配置获益。投资计划倾向于选择平均风险调整后业绩更高的PE基金，这主要得益于接触成功的PE管理人，而非卓越的筛选能力。通过将收益分解为风险补偿和“阿尔法”，我们发现部分投资计划通过承担更高风险获取更高PE收益，但并未获得更高（某些情况下甚至更低）的风险调整后收益，这与投资计划内部的代理问题基本一致。

doi:10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103272.abstract: We introduce a new family of power indices for nodes in graphs with classes. We provide an axiomatic characterization of this family and prove the independence of the axioms. Furthermore, we show that these indices coincide with the Shapley values of a family of subadditive transferable-utility games defined on such graphs. These normative results yield a general framework for quantifying structural influence in complex networks. In particular, we identify the normative conditions under which power in technological sharing networks can be represented by our family of indices. Importantly, the proposed axiomatic framework also applies to influence flows that generate negative effects.
doi:10.1016/j.jmateco.2026.103272.abstract_zh: 我们针对带有类别属性的图节点引入了一类新的权力指数族，给出了该指数族的公理化刻画，并证明了各公理之间的独立性。进一步地，我们证明这些指数与定义在此类图上的次可加可转移效用博弈族中的沙普利值一致。这些规范性结论为量化复杂网络中的结构性影响提供了通用框架。特别地，我们识别出技术共享网络中权力可由本指数族表征的规范性条件。重要的是，所提出的公理化框架同样适用于产生负效应的影响力流动。

doi:10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103964.abstract: How do import tariffs affect retail prices? We combine daily product-level posted prices from seven major Canadian retailers with product-level tariff exposure to estimate tariff effects in a difference-in-differences framework. Prices of tariffed goods rose gradually, peaking at 6% after three months, implying pass-through of roughly one quarter of the 25% tariff. We find little spillover to untariffed substitutes and a rapid reversal of price effects after tariff removal. Adjustment occurred mainly through the frequency of price changes. Pass-through shifted with trade-policy news and was larger for products labeled “Tariffed”, showing that tariff-induced inflation depends on policy expectations and tariff salience.
doi:10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103964.abstract_zh: 进口关税如何影响零售价格？我们整合了加拿大七家主要零售商的每日产品层面标价数据与产品层面的关税暴露程度，在双重差分框架下估算关税效应。受关税影响商品的价格逐步上升，三个月后达到6%的峰值，这意味着约四分之一的25%关税被传导至价格。我们未发现对未征税替代品产生显著溢出效应，且关税取消后价格效应迅速逆转。价格调整主要通过调价频率实现。传导效应随贸易政策新闻动态变化，且对标注"征税"标签的产品更为显著，这表明关税引发的通胀取决于政策预期与关税显著性。

doi:10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103964.title_zh: 加拿大报复性关税的价格影响

doi:10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103965.abstract: In this paper, we study optimal monetary policy in an economy where firms’ price-setting decisions are distorted by a signal-extraction problem: they cannot perfectly distinguish aggregate from idiosyncratic shocks based on noisy local information. This systematic misattribution of aggregate shocks to firm-specific factors generates an additional price response, implying that strict price stability is no longer optimal. Instead, the optimal policy fully stabilizes the output gap, which necessarily requires accommodating fluctuations in the price level. The cyclicality of the optimal price level depends on the source of firms’ incomplete information: learning from local demand signals implies a procyclical price level, whereas learning from local productivity signals yields a countercyclical one.
doi:10.1016/j.jmoneco.2026.103965.abstract_zh: 本文研究企业在价格设定决策中因信号提取问题而扭曲的经济环境下的最优货币政策：企业无法基于含噪的局部信息完美区分总体冲击与异质性冲击。这种将总体冲击系统性误归因于企业特定因素的现象，会引发额外的价格反应，意味着严格的价格稳定不再是最优选择。相反，最优政策应完全稳定产出缺口，这必然要求容忍价格水平的波动。最优价格水平的周期性取决于企业不完全信息的来源：从局部需求信号中学习会导致价格水平呈顺周期性，而从局部生产率信号中学习则会产生逆周期性。

doi:10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105711.abstract: Quantitative evidence on the extent of paternalism within families is scant. We provide a novel measure to study whether and how parents interfere paternalistically in their children’s intertemporal decision-making. In an experiment with over 2000 members from 610 families in Bangladesh, we find that more than half of all parents are willing to pay money to override their children’s choices in order to mitigate the (correctly anticipated) level of children’s present bias. The extent of parental paternalism is strongly related to parenting styles and we discuss how it interacts with the intergenerational transmission of patience.
doi:10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105711.abstract_zh: 关于家庭内部家长主义程度的定量证据十分匮乏。我们提出了一种新颖的衡量方法，用以研究父母是否以及如何以家长主义方式干预子女的跨期决策。通过对孟加拉国610个家庭中2000多名成员进行的实验，我们发现超过半数的父母愿意支付金钱来推翻子女的选择，以减轻子女（被正确预期的）现时偏向程度。父母家长主义的程度与教养方式密切相关，我们进一步探讨了其如何与耐心的代际传递相互作用。

doi:10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105718.abstract: This paper asks whether, and under which circumstances, rent subsidies to low-income households increase rents. We study a reform of the Finnish housing allowance system that caused large quasi-random variation in housing allowances. Using register data spanning five years before and after the reform, we find that large increases in allowances for affected housing units had little or no effect on their rents relative to other units. The effect of a one-euro increase in housing allowance on rent is roughly 0.036 euros with a standard error of 0.028. We provide novel evidence on the underlying demand- and supply-side responses that drive the rent effects. The reform led to only small changes in recipients’ housing choices, and at most modest changes in rental supply. Our interpretation is that rent subsidies can be effective in helping recipient households even in supply-constrained contexts, if recipients’ housing choices are unresponsive to the subsidy. doi:10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105718.abstract_zh: 本文探讨租金补贴在何种情况下会提高低收入家庭的租金水平。我们以芬兰住房补贴制度改革为研究对象，该改革导致住房补贴出现准随机大幅波动。基于改革前后五年的登记数据，我们发现受改革影响的住房单元在获得大幅补贴增加后，其租金相对于其他单元几乎没有变化。每增加1欧元住房补贴对租金的影响约为0.036欧元，标准误差为0.028。我们提供了关于驱动租金效应的需求侧与供给侧反应的新证据。改革仅导致受助者住房选择发生微小变化，租赁供给的调整幅度也极为有限。我们的解释是：若受助者的住房选择对补贴不敏感，即使面临供给约束，租金补贴仍能有效帮助受助家庭。

doi:10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105720.abstract: I examine behavioral responses to inheritance and gift taxes in a setting where individuals knew the tax would increase three months before the new tax code took effect. Using tax microdata from Brazil, I employ bunching and difference-in-differences (DD) methods and find that individuals significantly retime their wealth transfers to avoid taxes. Retimed gifts resulted in smaller inheritances for nearly three years. Moreover, I find that responses are sensitive to changes in top gift marginal tax rates and tax design (flat rates vs progressive brackets). Finally, evasion increased in the medium run in reform states, particularly among small inheritances.
doi:10.1016/j.jpubeco.2026.105720.abstract_zh: 本文考察了在个人知晓遗产税与赠与税将在三个月后上调的背景下，其行为反应。利用巴西的税收微观数据，采用聚束分析与双重差分法，发现个人显著调整财富转移时间以规避税负。调整后的赠与行为导致近三年内遗产规模缩小。此外，研究显示，行为反应对最高赠与边际税率变动及税制设计（统一税率与累进税率）具有敏感性。最后，改革州的中期逃税行为有所增加，尤以小额遗产为甚。

doi:10.1016/j.jue.2026.103891.abstract: Many communities in the U.S. have programs that make financial assistance available to families with low incomes who are struggling to pay rent. In this paper, we examine the average and distributional impacts of reducing wait times for emergency housing assistance on evictions. Taking advantage of administrative data from Franklin County, Ohio and exploiting exogenous changes in application processing times in two complementary empirical approaches, we find that each additional week of delay in receiving assistance increases the probability of an eviction filing within 12 months by 19–29%. A substantial share of the additional filings result in judgments against tenants. Our results have important implications for the design and implementation of emergency rental assistance programs. More broadly, our findings speak to the downstream impacts of passive compliance costs in social safety net programs.

doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108193.abstract: Maladaptive land use change at forest margins presents a persistent governance challenge under climate and policy pressures. This paper introduces the concept of rule erosion to explain how the gradual and uneven weakening of institutional rules drives land use change. While institutional analyses have treated rule change as adaptive flexibility or as macro-level drift, the cumulative weakening of operational rules-in-use at the community level remains under-theorised. Drawing on the Upland Saddang watershed, Indonesia, we examine how the weakening of boundary, scope and payoff rules within multi-level governance has shaped farmers' decisions and narrowed adaptation pathways. The two study villages were selected from those in the watershed that were identified as experiencing persistent drought. In the two villages data was gathered from 35 farmer interviews covering 129 land plots, 10 stakeholder interviews, focus group discussions and participatory GIS. Using the Institutional Analysis and Development (IAD) framework, these findings show that maize cultivation (62.6% of plots) has become the dominant outcome across a wide range of former land uses—converting from paddy, cocoa, forest and grasslands—a pattern closely linked to repeated cycles of maize seed assistance rather than autonomous adaptation. Weakened boundary rules made maize seed assistance effectively open-access; loose scope rules have pushed it onto steep slopes and forest margins; and payoff rules have favoured short-cycle returns, narrowing available options and creating the conditions for what we term assistance-led maladaptation. The analysis extends the concept of erosion from constitutional and international-norms scholarship to community-level resource governance and calls for graduated multi-level safeguards that preserve local adaptive flexibility.
doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108193.abstract_zh: 森林边缘的适应性不良土地利用变化在气候与政策压力下构成了持续性的治理挑战。本文引入规则侵蚀概念，阐释制度规则渐进且不均衡的弱化如何驱动土地利用变化。尽管制度分析将规则变化视为适应性弹性或宏观层面的漂移，但社区层面操作性使用规则的累积性弱化仍缺乏理论化探讨。以印度尼西亚高地萨达河流域为案例，我们考察了多层级治理中边界规则、范围规则与收益规则的弱化如何影响农户决策并收窄适应路径。两个研究村庄选自流域内持续干旱区域，通过35份农户访谈（覆盖129块土地）、10份利益相关者访谈、焦点小组讨论及参与式地理信息系统收集数据。运用制度分析与发展（IAD）框架的研究表明，玉米种植（占土地样本62.6%）已成为各类前土地利用类型（包括稻田、可可林、森林与草地）转型后的主导结果——这一模式与玉米种子援助的周期性循环密切相关，而非自主适应行为。弱化的边界规则使玉米种子援助实质上成为开放获取资源；松散的范畴规则将其推向陡坡与森林边缘；收益规则则偏向短周期回报，收窄了可用选择空间，形成了我们称之为援助导向型适应不良的条件。该分析将规则侵蚀概念从宪法与国际规范研究领域拓展至社区层面资源治理，并呼吁建立保留地方适应灵活性的渐进式多层保障机制。

doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108194.abstract: Urban development is perceived as an indicator of economic advancement and opportunity. However, rapid BUA expansion exerts land pressure, acting as a catalyst for land-use and land-cover (LULC) changes. This study examined the role of socio-environmental factors, including landscape types (LTs), geomorphology and topography, in BUA dynamics and LULC changes across urban, peri-urban and rural areas between 1842 and 2019. The spatial analysis for sixty randomly selected study sites (a total of 24,000 ha), located in the Central European region, employed ArcGIS tools, integrating historical cadastral maps (Stable Cadastre, 1842) with CORINE LULC data (2019), and statistical techniques, including Binomial Logistic Regression. Findings revealed that total BUA increased by 84.7%, mainly in warm lowlands, primarily replacing arable land (67.23% of the total LULC changes). The built-up growth encompassed a mixed-sized building ranging from 4 to 32,488 m 2 per unit through infill and edge expansion in urban areas (100–500 m distance from the historical built‑up fabric), and small-sized, clustered (0–50 m distance) BUA expansion around rural settlement cores. The Hot Spot Analysis (Getis-Ord Gi*) of recent BUA shows predominant clustering of large-sized buildings in the lowlands, which together account for 33.15%. Population density across 4–11 categories emerged as the most influential predictor. The study demonstrated that the socio-ecological factors act as opportunities (uniform topography of warm lowlands) and constraints (complex topography of cold highlands) for BUA expansion. From a land‑use policy perspective, the study prioritises spatially adaptive, ecologically integrated land‑use governance and restoration strategies in response to accelerating socio‑environmental change.
doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108194.abstract_zh: 城市发展被视为经济进步与机遇的指标。然而，建成区（BUA）的快速扩张对土地造成压力，成为土地利用与土地覆盖（LULC）变化的催化剂。本研究考察了1842年至2019年间，包括景观类型（LTs）、地貌与地形在内的社会-环境因素在城市、城郊及农村地区的BUA动态与LULC变化中的作用。研究选取中欧地区60个随机样点（总面积24,000公顷），运用ArcGIS工具整合历史地籍图（1842年稳定地籍图）与CORINE LULC数据（2019年），并结合二项逻辑回归等统计方法进行分析。结果显示，BUA总面积增长84.7%，主要集中于温暖低地，其中耕地被替代占LULC总变化的67.23%。建成区扩张包含混合规模建筑（单体面积4至32,488平方米），通过城市区域（距历史建成区100–500米）的填充与边缘扩展，以及农村聚落核心周边小规模、集群式（0–50米距离）BUA扩张实现。近期BUA的热点分析（Getis-Ord Gi*）显示，大型建筑主要聚集于低地，占比达33.15%。人口密度（4–11个类别）成为最具影响力的预测因子。研究表明，社会-生态因素既构成BUA扩张的机遇（温暖低地均匀地形），也形成制约（寒冷高地复杂地形）。从土地利用政策视角，本研究优先提出空间适应性、生态整合的土地利用治理与恢复策略，以应对加速的社会-环境变化。

doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108196.abstract: The European Union promotes the provision of agri-environment-climate public goods (AECPGs) from agriculture and forestry through dedicated policies. Nevertheless, despite long-term efforts and earmarking of significant financial resources for voluntary agri-environmental schemes, the provision of AECPGs from Europe’s agro-ecosystems is continuing to decline. New governance instruments are urgently required to revert this process. Promising new approaches are seen in novel contract solutions promoting result-based payments, collective implementation, and value-chain-based approaches. However, a deeper understanding of the practical design of these novel schemes is needed to achieve acceptance and successful implementation. We systematically examine real-world examples of contract solutions and their design characteristics by analyzing a dataset of 44 case studies from 13 European countries. Data or information from these case studies was collected using a uniform protocol across countries, and a qualitative content analysis was conducted. Our findings show that result-based approaches differ in their design with regard to measuring environmental performance. Successful result-based approaches enable flexible management, include features for knowledge provision, and are often designed as hybrid solutions to enhance uptake, combining action- and result-based elements. Collective contract solutions are based on a common management agreement of the involved group members, but vary in their degree of formalization, often include a coordinator, and foster meetings and exchanges. Value chain-based solutions differ in terms of the relationship between the production of private goods and the provision of AECPGs, their incentive system, value chain characteristics, and marketing, and often comprise an element of cooperation, also representing a hybrid approach. The findings of this research can help shape the design of such alternative approaches and provide inspiration for promoting the voluntary delivery of AECPGs under the Common Agriculture Policy (CAP) and beyond. doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108196.abstract_zh: 欧盟通过专项政策推动农业与林业提供农业-环境-气候公共产品（AECPGs）。然而，尽管长期投入大量财政资源用于自愿性农业环境计划，欧洲农业生态系统提供的AECPGs仍在持续减少。亟需新的治理工具来扭转这一趋势。新型合同方案展现出前景，包括推广基于结果的支付、集体实施以及基于价值链的方法。但为获得认可并成功实施，需深入理解这些新型方案的实际设计。我们通过分析来自13个欧洲国家的44个案例数据集，系统考察了合同方案的真实案例及其设计特征。这些案例的数据或信息采用跨国统一协议收集，并进行了定性内容分析。研究结果表明：基于结果的方法在环境绩效衡量设计上存在差异；成功的基于结果方法允许灵活管理，包含知识供给特征，且常设计为结合行动与结果要素的混合方案以提升采纳率。集体合同方案基于参与群体成员的共同管理协议，但正式化程度各异，通常设有协调人，并促进会议与交流。基于价值链的方案在私人物品生产与AECPGs供给的关系、激励机制、价值链特征及营销方式上存在差异，且常包含合作要素，同样体现混合模式。本研究结果有助于塑造此类替代方案的设计，并为在共同农业政策（CAP）及其他框架下促进AECPGs自愿供给提供启示。

doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108204.abstract: Dryland afforestation is increasingly deployed as a Nature-based Solution (NbS) for climate mitigation and ecosystem restoration, yet its long-term effectiveness remains uncertain because carbon gains may be offset by biophysical trade-offs and water limitations. Existing assessments rarely integrate carbon sequestration, surface albedo, and climate vulnerability, limiting understanding of how these processes interact to determine restoration outcomes. Here we present the first integrated assessment of large-scale afforestation in the South Aral Sea – a region whose near-complete desiccation may have shifted the area from a carbon sink toward a source of emissions. We evaluate the current carbon pool, surface albedo effects, and climate vulnerability to assess both the potential and inherent limits of dryland afforestation as an NbS. By combining field surveys of saxaul (Haloxylon) shrublands, analysis of land cover change, and six decades of regional climate data, we estimate that the vegetated parts of the South Aral Sea (approximately 1.6 million hectares) store 20.4 million tonnes of carbon (74.7 million tonnes CO₂-equivalent) in soil and vegetation, with a mean carbon density of 12.7 Mg C ha⁻¹ . Albedo analysis reveals strongly context-dependent climate trade-offs: vegetation establishment increases surface reflectivity on former water bodies but decreases it on highly reflective salt pans. Over the past six decades, regional temperatures have increased by approximately 0.5°C per decade (more than twice the global average) while drought intensity has increased markedly since the 1990s. Temperature-adjusted drought indices (SPEI-12) indicate substantially stronger drying trends (R² = 0.55) than precipitation-only indices (SPI-12; R² = 0.03), demonstrating that rising temperatures amplify water stress beyond precipitation changes alone and may constrain the vegetation density that can be sustained over time. Our findings show that afforestation can contribute meaningfully to carbon storage and landscape stabilisation in severely degraded drylands, but its long-term viability as an NbS depends on adaptive management that respects water-limited carrying capacity, incorporates drought-resilient species, and optimises planting density. The integrated framework presented here offers empirical guidance for designing climate-resilient NbS in drylands worldwide, where nearly one-fifth of Earth's land surface faces accelerating degradation by the end of this century.
doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108204.abstract_zh: 旱地造林作为基于自然的解决方案（NbS）在气候缓解和生态系统恢复中的应用日益广泛，但其长期有效性仍不确定，因为碳收益可能被生物物理权衡和水资源限制所抵消。现有评估很少整合碳固存、地表反照率和气候脆弱性，限制了对这些过程如何相互作用以决定恢复结果的理解。本研究首次对南咸海地区大规模造林进行综合评估——该地区近乎完全干涸可能已使其从碳汇转变为碳排放源。我们评估了当前碳库、地表反照率效应和气候脆弱性，以探究旱地造林作为NbS的潜力与固有局限。通过结合梭梭灌木林实地调查、土地覆被变化分析及六十年区域气候数据，我们估算南咸海植被覆盖区域（约160万公顷）在土壤和植被中储存了2040万吨碳（7470万吨二氧化碳当量），平均碳密度为12.7 Mg C ha⁻¹。反照率分析揭示了强烈依赖情境的气候权衡：植被建立增加了原水体区域的地表反射率，但降低了高反射盐滩的反射率。过去六十年间，区域气温以每十年约0.5°C的速度上升（超过全球平均水平两倍），而自1990年代以来干旱强度显著加剧。经温度调整的干旱指数（SPEI-12）显示比仅基于降水的指数（SPI-12；R²=0.03）更强的干燥趋势（R²=0.55），表明升温加剧了超出降水变化本身的水分胁迫，并可能限制可持续维持的植被密度。研究结果表明，造林可为严重退化旱地的碳储存和景观稳定做出实质性贡献，但其作为NbS的长期可行性取决于尊重水资源承载能力、采用耐旱物种并优化种植密度的适应性管理。本研究所提出的综合框架为全球旱地设计气候适应性NbS提供了经验指导——到本世纪末，全球近五分之一陆地表面正面临加速退化。

doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108206.abstract: Local communities are widely blamed for the increasing deforestation in Malawi, primarily due to agricultural expansion and the increased use of biomass energy. Yet, there is limited evidence to understand systemic trade-offs that communities face in their land-use decisions. This study examines the drivers of deforestation in Southern Malawi, focusing on community perceptions and the resource Nexus outcomes related to deforestation. We conducted 25 focus group discussions, 22 key informant interviews, and 271 household interviews across Chikwawa, Blantyre, Mwanza, Mulanje, and Thyolo districts. We also conducted seven expert interviews, facilitated five participatory workshops, and employed ethnographic techniques to gather the lived experiences of community members. The study reveals that (1) socio-economic needs for food, energy and income create a vicious cycle of cropland expansion at the direct expense of forest conservation. (2) Community perceptions identify biomass energy production (index=0.0788) as the main driver of deforestation, followed by cropland expansion (0.0769) and energy poverty (0.0746). (3) The dominance of negative ecological outcomes, followed by economic and political outcomes. The socio-cultural dimension reports the least negative outcomes. Nonetheless, positive outcomes are highest in the socio-cultural dimension, followed by the economic and political dimensions. The least positive outcomes are reported in the ecological dimension. The study empirically shows how community perceptions reshape the Resource Nexus and offers geographically specific policy recommendations. It treats deforestation as both socioeconomic and ecological problem, calling for integrated policies that address livelihood needs and structural drivers in Southern Malawi and similar areas in Sub-Saharan Africa.
doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108206.abstract_zh: 当地社区被广泛指责为马拉维森林砍伐加剧的主要原因，这主要源于农业扩张和生物质能源使用的增加。然而，关于社区在土地利用决策中面临的系统性权衡，现有证据十分有限。本研究聚焦马拉维南部森林砍伐的驱动因素，重点关注社区认知及与森林砍伐相关的资源纽带结果。我们在奇夸瓦、布兰太尔、姆万扎、穆兰杰和蒂约洛地区开展了25场焦点小组讨论、22次关键知情人访谈和271户家庭访谈。此外，我们还进行了7次专家访谈、组织了5场参与式研讨会，并运用民族志方法收集社区成员的生活经验。研究表明：（1）对食物、能源和收入的社会经济需求形成了耕地扩张的恶性循环，直接牺牲了森林保护；（2）社区认知将生物质能源生产（指数=0.0788）视为森林砍伐的首要驱动因素，其次是耕地扩张（0.0769）和能源贫困（0.0746）；（3）负面生态结果占主导地位，其次是经济和政治结果，而社会文化维度报告的负面结果最少。尽管如此，正面结果在社会文化维度最高，其次是经济和政治维度，生态维度报告的正面结果最少。本研究实证展示了社区认知如何重塑资源纽带，并提出了具有地理针对性的政策建议。它将森林砍伐视为社会经济与生态的双重问题，呼吁采取综合政策应对马拉维南部及撒哈拉以南非洲类似地区的生计需求和结构性驱动因素。
doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108206.title: Food, fuel, or forest? Interrogating the resource nexus dilemma behind deforestation through community-lived experiences in southern Malawi
doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108206.title_zh: 食物、燃料还是森林？通过马拉维南部社区生活经验审视森林砍伐背后的资源关联困境

doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108207.abstract: Land rights, important dimensions of land tenure, are crucial for smallholder farmers’ land tenure security and climate change adaptation. However, there are knowledge gaps on the nexus between land rights and climate adaptation in Ghana, particularly from a gendered perspective. This study draws on land right frameworks to explore the nexus between gender, land rights and climate change adaptation among men and women smallholder farmers in rural Ghana. Data were collected through a randomized survey administered to 510 smallholder farmers from four purposively selected communities in the Adansi Asokwa District, and analyzed using descriptive and inferential statistics. The results showed that compared to women, more men own more farmlands (averagely 6.8 vs. 5.4 acres for women), have formal land title deeds, and exercise more land rights, particularly exclusion and alienation rights, enhancing their tenure security. Besides frequency of pest invasion, there is no significant differences in men’s and women’s climate change perceptions and experiences. Farmers used multiple climate adaptation strategies, including planting improved crop varieties, changing planting season, climate information services and agrochemical application. We found a significant difference between men’s and women’s adoption of crop diversification, crop-livestock integration and seed storage. Unlike men’s adaptation strategies, those of women are influenced by the number of rights they exercise and farmland size. Also, perceptions about the raining season and temperature intensity as well as marital status, locality, years of farming experience, access to non-farm livelihood activities and credit significantly influence farmers’ climate change adaptation. Gender differentiated policies and incentives for farmers are needed to enhance tenure security and climate change adaptation.
doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108207.abstract_zh: 土地权利作为土地制度的重要维度，对小农户的土地权属保障和气候变化适应能力至关重要。然而，关于加纳土地权利与气候适应之间关系的研究仍存在知识空白，尤其是从性别视角切入的分析。本研究基于土地权利理论框架，探讨加纳农村地区男女小农户在性别、土地权利与气候变化适应之间的关联机制。通过对阿丹西阿索夸地区四个定向选取社区的510名小农户进行随机问卷调查，并运用描述性统计与推断性统计分析数据。结果表明：相较于女性，男性拥有更多农田（平均6.8英亩 vs 女性5.4英亩）、持有正式土地所有权证书，并享有更多土地权利（特别是排他权和转让权），从而增强了其土地权属保障。除虫害侵袭频率外，男女农户在气候变化认知与经历方面无显著差异。农户采用多种气候适应策略，包括种植改良作物品种、调整种植季节、利用气候信息服务及施用农用化学品。研究发现，男女农户在作物多样化、种养结合及种子储存方面的采纳行为存在显著差异。与男性适应策略不同，女性农户的适应行为受其行使权利数量及农田面积的影响。此外，对雨季和气温强度的认知、婚姻状况、居住地、务农年限、非农生计活动参与及信贷获取等因素显著影响农户的气候变化适应能力。需制定性别差异化的农户政策与激励措施，以增强土地权属保障和气候变化适应能力。
doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108207.title: Gender, land rights and climate change adaptation in Ghana: Implications for land tenure, agriculture and rural development
doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108207.title_zh: 加纳的性别、土地权利与气候变化适应：对土地权属、农业和农村发展的影响

doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108208.abstract: Forests are central to rural livelihoods in Zambia’s Miombo landscapes, providing energy, food, materials, and income. Yet forest-use restrictions may affect households differently depending on market access, enforcement, and livelihood opportunities. This study examines how restricted and non-restricted forest management regimes shape household livelihood strategies in Copperbelt, Eastern, and North-Western provinces. Using survey data from 1115 households, cluster analysis identified forest livelihood strategies, while multinomial logit models estimated adjusted probabilities of strategy membership and associated household drivers. Four strategies were identified: Low-Monetisation Unprocessed Forest Products Dependents, Unprocessed Forest Products Subsistence Diversifiers, Charcoal-Oriented Mixed households, and Charcoal-Cash Specialists. Regime effects varied strongly by province. In Eastern Province, restricted landscapes increased Low-Monetisation dependence by 43.76 %age points and reduced Charcoal-Cash specialisation by 29.94 points. In North-Western Province, restrictions increased Low-Monetisation dependence by 35.11 points but reduced Charcoal-Oriented Mixed strategies by 31.40 points. In the Copperbelt, the pattern differed: restricted landscapes increased Charcoal-Cash specialisation by 9.80 points and Charcoal-Oriented Mixed strategies by 14.26 points, while reducing subsistence diversification by 26.03 points. Household education, gender, livestock ownership, landholding, residence duration, road access, and regime interactions also shaped strategy membership. The findings show that forest-use restrictions do not produce uniform livelihood outcomes. Instead, they operate as context-dependent filters, reinforcing subsistence dependence in some settings while coexisting with charcoal commercialisation in market-integrated landscapes. Effective governance requires spatially differentiated policy mixes combining conservation, enforcement, energy alternatives, tenure clarity, and livelihood support.
doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108208.abstract_zh: 森林是赞比亚米奥博林地农村生计的核心，提供能源、食物、材料和收入。然而，森林使用限制可能因市场准入、执法力度和生计机会的不同而对家庭产生差异化影响。本研究考察了限制性与非限制性森林管理制度如何塑造铜带省、东部省和西北省的家庭生计策略。基于1115户家庭的调查数据，聚类分析识别出森林生计策略，而多项逻辑模型则估计了策略归属的调整后概率及其相关家庭驱动因素。研究识别出四种策略：低货币化未加工林产品依赖型、未加工林产品生计多样化型、木炭导向混合型以及木炭现金专业化型。制度效应因省份而异。在东部省，限制性景观使低货币化依赖型策略增加43.76个百分点，同时使木炭现金专业化型策略减少29.94个百分点。在西北省，限制性景观使低货币化依赖型策略增加35.11个百分点，但使木炭导向混合型策略减少31.40个百分点。在铜带省，模式有所不同：限制性景观使木炭现金专业化型策略增加9.80个百分点，木炭导向混合型策略增加14.26个百分点，同时使生计多样化型策略减少26.03个百分点。家庭受教育程度、性别、牲畜拥有量、土地持有量、居住时长、道路通达性及制度交互作用也影响策略归属。研究结果表明，森林使用限制并未产生统一的生计结果，而是作为情境依赖的过滤器，在某些环境中强化生计依赖，同时在市场整合的景观中与木炭商业化共存。有效的治理需要结合保护、执法、能源替代、权属明确和生计支持的空间差异化政策组合。

doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108209.title_zh: 城市可持续性的公共绿地：摩洛哥马拉喀什影响的定量社会生态分析

doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108210.abstract: This study analyses the creation of La Réunion National Park (2002–2007) as a strategic and competitive political process embedded within a formal conservation planning framework. Drawing on Evolutionary Governance Theory (EGT), it shows how boundary delineation functioned as a governance instrument that reconfigured power relations between the French state and the Regional Council within a post-colonial, multi-level European outermost context marked by socio-environmental vulnerability and claims for regional autonomy. Combining GIS-based spatial analysis, archival research, and semi-structured interviews, the study traces the co-evolution of actors, institutions, discourses, knowledge, and material instruments throughout the park’s spatial planning process. Results, structured along five EGT analytical axes, indicate that boundary delineation constituted a strategic governance process rather than a purely technical exercise. Environmental planning emerged as a political arena in which power relations between the French state and the Regional Council were renegotiated. Scientific expertise and digital tools played a central role in legitimising decisions. Simultaneously, they contributed to filtering and hierarchising competing territorial claims. Participatory processes were formally inclusive but tightly managed, enabling consultation without substantially altering predefined outcomes and resulting in limited boundary changes. Finally, despite stated autonomy-oriented objectives, environmental planning contributed to the production of new social and spatial inequalities, highlighting the ambivalent role of conservation policies in island governance: ensuring both protection and external territorial control. More broadly, the study demonstrates how conservation planning operates as a governance instrument that shapes and reveals land values and power distribution. These findings suggest that boundary delineation should be explicitly treated as a political and governance instrument, requiring greater transparency, stronger accountability, and more substantive inclusion of local actors to avoid reinforcing existing power asymmetries in spatial planning.
doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108210.abstract_zh: 本研究分析了留尼汪国家公园（2002–2007年）的创建过程，将其视为嵌入正式保护规划框架中的战略性与竞争性政治进程。基于演化治理理论（EGT），研究揭示了边界划定如何作为一种治理工具，在面临社会-环境脆弱性与区域自治诉求的后殖民、多层级欧洲最外围地区，重构法国国家与地区议会之间的权力关系。通过结合地理信息系统空间分析、档案研究与半结构化访谈，本研究追溯了公园空间规划过程中行动者、制度、话语、知识与物质工具的协同演化。依据EGT五大分析维度呈现的结果表明，边界划定构成了一种战略性治理过程，而非纯粹的技术性操作。环境规划成为法国国家与地区议会重新协商权力关系的政治场域。科学专业知识与数字工具在决策合法化中发挥核心作用，同时亦对相互竞争的领土诉求进行筛选与等级化。参与过程形式上具有包容性，但受到严格管控，允许协商却未实质性改变预设结果，仅导致有限的边界调整。最终，尽管以自治为导向的目标被明确表述，环境规划却催生了新的社会与空间不平等，凸显了保护政策在岛屿治理中的矛盾角色：既确保保护，又强化外部领土控制。更广泛而言，本研究揭示了保护规划如何作为塑造并反映土地价值与权力分配的治理工具。这些发现表明，边界划定应被明确视为政治与治理工具，需要更高的透明度、更强的问责机制以及更实质性的地方行动者参与，以避免在空间规划中强化既有的权力不对称。

doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108218.abstract: Urban flooding poses escalating risks under climate change, requiring planning approaches that integrate technological precision with human and ecological values. This study introduces a Human-Centred Artificial Intelligence (HCAI) framework for adaptive and regenerative flood-resilient urban design. Unlike conventional AI approaches focused on optimisation, HCAI embeds ethical, participatory, and context-sensitive principles into land-use governance. The paper develops a four-pillar analytical framework – technical integration, institutional arrangements, stakeholder engagement, and land-use innovation – operationalised through a document-based comparative analysis of nine cities representing diverse flood typologies, governance regimes, and documented AI/digital flood-resilience activity. Documentary evidence suggests that AI tools such as Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Graph Neural Networks are reported to support flood-risk prediction and response coordination in flood-risk applications, while their planning relevance depends on inclusive decision-making and regenerative land-use strategies. Cities with stronger institutional embedding of AI-enabled or digital tools within adaptive regulatory systems and participatory platforms (e.g., Rotterdam, Copenhagen, Bangkok) show clearer planning-policy pathways, whereas those relying on fragmented or project-based deployments (e.g., Venice, Sydney) show limited continuity. Findings suggest that technical capability alone is insufficient: planning relevance depends on governance maturity, ethical safeguards, civic legitimacy, and linkage to spatial planning instruments. By coupling algorithmic intelligence with participatory and regulatory innovation, the study advances a policy-oriented framework for embedding HCAI into spatial governance and identifying conditions that may support a shift from defensive flood control toward regenerative, socially just urbanism. The framework guides AI institutionalisation within land-use systems and contributes to debates on equitable, data-driven climate adaptation.
doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108218.abstract_zh: 气候变化背景下，城市洪涝风险持续加剧，亟需融合技术精度与人文生态价值的规划路径。本研究提出以人为中心的人工智能（HCAI）框架，用于适应性、再生性防洪韧性城市设计。与侧重优化的传统AI方法不同，HCAI将伦理、参与性和情境敏感性原则嵌入土地利用治理体系。本文构建了包含技术整合、制度安排、利益相关方参与和土地利用创新四大支柱的分析框架，通过对九个代表不同洪涝类型、治理体制及AI/数字防洪韧性实践案例的城市进行文献比较分析加以验证。文献证据表明，机器学习、深度学习、图神经网络等AI工具在洪涝风险应用中可支持风险预测与响应协调，但其规划相关性取决于包容性决策与再生性土地利用策略。在适应性监管体系与参与式平台中实现AI或数字工具制度化嵌入的城市（如鹿特丹、哥本哈根、曼谷），展现出更清晰的规划政策路径；而依赖碎片化或项目式部署的城市（如威尼斯、悉尼）则呈现有限连续性。研究结果表明，单纯技术能力不足：规划相关性取决于治理成熟度、伦理保障、公民合法性及与空间规划工具的衔接。通过将算法智能与参与式及监管创新相结合，本研究提出了将HCAI嵌入空间治理的政策导向框架，并识别出可能推动从防御性洪涝控制向再生性、社会公正城市主义转型的条件。该框架为土地利用系统中的AI制度化提供指引，并推动关于公平、数据驱动气候适应的学术讨论。

doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108219.abstract: Brazil established its National Policy of Payment for Environmental Services (PES) to promote the maintenance, recovery, and enhancement of ecosystems. Yet the diversity, spatial distribution, and effectiveness of existing initiatives remain poorly understood. This study provides the first nationwide synthesis of all PES programs implemented in Brazil since 2000, based on a systematic scoping review of 80 peer-reviewed papers documenting 138 distinct programs. We apply an analytical framework with 11 dimensions to classify and compare programs by ecosystem type, service category, funding source, objectives, and governance mechanisms. Results show initiatives concentrate in the Atlantic Forest (49.3%) and Cerrado (23.2%) biomes, largely targeting regulation services (93.2%) via forest conservation (65.2%) and restoration (61.6%) actions. Watershed (73.9%) and Forest & Carbon (14.8%) programs predominate; 59.4% of initiatives are in Southeast and 17.4% in North. Most programs rely on public funding (94%), while private and market-based mechanisms remain rare. Despite frequent social objectives (65%) and non-monetary benefits (35%), fiscal dependence and regional imbalance constrain scalability and policy sustainability. By comparing Brazil’s experience with international trends in PES governance, we identify structural challenges to design more adaptive, inclusive, and financially diversified mechanisms that strengthen ecosystem protection and social equity across biomes. Explicitly contrasting Brazil with Latin – American benchmarks, we show that – unlike Costa Rica’s centralized national PES and Mexico’s federally coordinated watershed schemes – Brazil’s policy has fostered a decentralized mosaic of municipal and state programs, closely linked to Forest Code compliance and frequent mixed (cash and in-kind) payments, outlining a distinct regional governance model.
doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108219.abstract_zh: 巴西建立了国家生态系统服务付费政策，旨在促进生态系统的维护、恢复与增强。然而，现有举措的多样性、空间分布及有效性仍缺乏充分认知。本研究基于对80篇同行评审论文的系统性范围综述（涵盖138个独立项目），首次对2000年以来巴西实施的所有生态系统服务付费项目进行全国性综合梳理。我们运用包含11个维度的分析框架，从生态系统类型、服务类别、资金来源、目标及治理机制等方面对项目进行分类比较。结果显示：项目集中于大西洋森林（49.3%）和塞拉多（23.2%）生物群落，主要通过森林保护（65.2%）和恢复（61.6%）行动瞄准调节服务（93.2%）；流域项目（73.9%）与森林碳汇项目（14.8%）占主导地位；59.4%的举措分布在东南部，17.4%在北部。多数项目依赖公共资金（94%），私营和市场机制仍属罕见。尽管频繁设定社会目标（65%）并提供非货币收益（35%），财政依赖性与区域失衡制约了可扩展性与政策可持续性。通过将巴西经验与国际生态系统服务付费治理趋势对比，我们识别出设计更具适应性、包容性和财务多元化机制的结构性挑战，以强化跨生物群落的生态保护与社会公平。与拉美基准国家的明确对比表明：不同于哥斯达黎加的中央集权式国家生态系统服务付费和墨西哥的联邦协调流域计划，巴西政策催生了分散化的市州级项目拼图，这些项目与《森林法》合规要求紧密关联，并频繁采用混合支付（现金与实物）模式，勾勒出独特的区域治理范式。

doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108220.abstract: This study quantifies the tax revenue effects of residential land development in Germany. Whereas existing research and policy debates have concentrated on the fiscal returns of commercial land expansion, the tax revenue effects of residential development remain largely unexplored. We estimate the impacts of increases in living space and settlement area on municipal tax revenues using spatial instrumental variable regressions and a nationwide cross-sectional dataset covering all German municipalities. Accounting for spatial spillovers and potential endogeneity, we document a significant positive effect of residential living space expansion on municipal income tax revenues, with substantial heterogeneity between urban and rural municipalities and across regions with differing economic performance. A corresponding analysis of broader settlement area expansion indicates similarly positive effects on total municipal tax revenues. Multiple robustness checks support the validity of these findings. Finally, we outline a simple framework for approximating the fiscal payback period of residential land development by relating estimated revenue effects to average municipal development costs.
doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108220.abstract_zh: 本研究量化了德国住宅用地开发对税收收入的影响。现有研究及政策讨论主要聚焦于商业用地扩张的财政回报，而住宅开发对税收收入的影响在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们利用空间工具变量回归方法，结合覆盖全德所有市镇的全国截面数据集，估算了居住空间与定居面积增加对市镇税收收入的影响。在考虑空间溢出效应与潜在内生性问题后，研究发现住宅居住空间扩张对市镇所得税收入具有显著正向效应，且该效应在城乡市镇及经济绩效不同地区间存在显著异质性。对更广泛定居面积扩张的对应分析表明，其对市镇总税收收入同样具有正向影响。多项稳健性检验支持了这些结论的有效性。最后，我们通过将估计的收入效应与市镇平均开发成本相关联，构建了一个用于近似估算住宅用地开发财政回收期的简易框架。

doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108226.abstract: Assessing land use and land cover dynamics in protected areas (PA) is fundamental to understanding how different conservation strategies influence outcomes across distinct territorial contexts. The present study provided one of the most comprehensive longitudinal assessments of the PAs under the Brazilian System of Nature Conservation Units, through geospatial statistical analysis of land use and cover variations between 1985 and 2022, drawing on an ad hoc Natural Cover Dynamics Index (NCDI). The results revealed persistent conversion of natural areas within Brazilian PAs, including strictly protected categories, with agricultural expansion emerging as the main driver of natural cover loss. Findings also indicated differences in conservation performance among PA categories, reinforcing broader theoretical and political debates around forest transition theory and land sparing versus land sharing strategies. Beyond providing large-scale empirical evidence on conservation outcomes in Brazil, the analytical framework developed in this study contributes to policy-oriented assessments aimed at improving strategic conservation planning and the effectiveness of protected area system. doi:10.1016/j.landusepol.2026.108226.abstract_zh: 评估保护区（PA）的土地利用与土地覆盖动态变化，对于理解不同保护策略如何在特定地域背景下影响保护成效至关重要。本研究基于1985年至2022年间土地利用与覆盖变化的时空统计分析，并借助特设的自然覆盖动态指数（NCDI），对巴西国家自然保护单位体系下的保护区进行了最为全面的纵向评估之一。结果显示，巴西保护区内（包括严格保护类别）的自然区域持续被转化，农业扩张成为自然覆盖丧失的主要驱动因素。研究还发现不同保护区类别在保护绩效上存在差异，这进一步强化了围绕森林转型理论以及土地节约与土地共享策略的广泛理论与政策辩论。除为巴西保护成效提供大规模实证证据外，本研究构建的分析框架还有助于开展面向政策导向的评估，旨在优化战略性保护规划并提升保护区体系的有效性。
