doi:10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107493.abstract: As global change accelerates, Payments for Ecosystem Services (PES) programs have become increasingly important tools for addressing the interconnected challenges of land degradation, biodiversity loss, water scarcity, and climate change. PES programs provide incentives to individuals or communities, conditional on people adopting sustainable natural resource management practices to support or increase ecosystem service provisioning. Although conditionality is considered a “PES-defining feature,” little is known about how conditionality is perceived by community members and how such perceptions influence their participation in and experience with PES programs. To address this gap, we conducted an extensive qualitative study of Watershared, a Bolivian PES program, to investigate (1) how community members perceive conditionality in PES and its two components—monitoring and sanction, and (2) how removing conditionality influences PES participants’ perceptions of the program and relationship with the implementing organization. We found that Watershared participants perceived monitoring as more than just a compliance check mechanism; they saw it as a form of technical support and relationship building, which strengthens their relational values toward both nature and the program itself. Participants were generally unconcerned about sanctioning, with many viewing sanctioning as unnecessary or unenforceable, despite the implementing organization having imposed sanctions previously. Watershared participants with unconditional contracts generally noticed the removal of conditionality, with some interpreting it as a lack of care and reciprocity from the implementing organization. These results highlight how relational values were developed and supported through the two components of conditionality in PES. These results suggest that the role of conditionality in PES may be less about surveillance and penalty to ensure conservation, but more about serving as an avenue to activate and strengthen community members’ relational values toward nature and the PES-implementing organization, which may, in turn, improve program effectiveness and future participation. In the face of intensifying global environmental change, such relational values tied to conditionality in PES, as identified in this research, are critical for fostering and sustaining cooperation, trust, and long-term commitment to conservation.
doi:10.1016/j.worlddev.2026.107493.abstract_zh: 随着全球变化加速，生态系统服务付费（PES）项目已成为应对土地退化、生物多样性丧失、水资源短缺和气候变化等相互关联挑战的重要工具。PES项目向个人或社区提供激励，条件是他们采取可持续自然资源管理实践，以支持或增加生态系统服务供给。尽管条件性被视为“PES的定义性特征”，但关于社区成员如何感知条件性，以及这种感知如何影响他们参与PES项目并形成相关体验，目前知之甚少。为填补这一空白，我们对玻利维亚的Watershared PES项目进行了广泛的定性研究，旨在探究：（1）社区成员如何感知PES中的条件性及其两个组成部分——监测与制裁；（2）取消条件性如何影响PES参与者对项目的看法及其与实施组织的关系。我们发现，Watershared参与者将监测视为不仅仅是合规检查机制，更将其视为一种技术支持和关系建设形式，这强化了他们对自然和项目本身的关联价值。参与者普遍不关心制裁，许多人认为制裁不必要或无法执行，尽管实施组织此前曾施加过制裁。拥有无条件合同的Watershared参与者通常注意到条件性的取消，其中一些人将其解读为实施组织缺乏关怀和互惠。这些结果凸显了关联价值如何通过PES条件性的两个组成部分得以发展和支持。这些结果表明，PES中条件性的作用可能不在于通过监督和惩罚来确保保护，而更多是作为激活和加强社区成员对自然及PES实施组织的关联价值的途径，这进而可能提升项目有效性和未来参与度。面对日益加剧的全球环境变化，本研究所识别的与PES条件性相关的关联价值，对于培养和维持合作、信任以及对保护的长期承诺至关重要。

doi:10.1017/eec.2026.10043.abstract: In a $k$ -replica Edgeworth box economy, we compare outcomes of laboratory markets in which human traders have different visualizations available on their screens. Novel visualizations include a heat map that shows at a glance the value of all feasible portfolios (i.e., final allocations); a geometric display of the order book; and order entry via point-and-click on the heat map. Efficiency metrics focus on allocations, prices and profitability. Compared to the traditional text-oriented trader screen for the continuous double auction, we find that the novel features generally increase all three efficiency metrics.
doi:10.1017/eec.2026.10043.abstract_zh: 在一个$k$重复埃奇沃思盒经济中，我们比较了人类交易者在屏幕上拥有不同可视化选项的实验室市场结果。新颖的可视化功能包括：热力图，可一目了然地显示所有可行投资组合（即最终配置）的价值；订单簿的几何展示；以及通过点击热力图进行订单输入。效率指标侧重于配置、价格和盈利能力。与传统的面向文本的连续双向拍卖交易屏幕相比，我们发现新颖功能通常能提升所有三项效率指标。
doi:10.1017/eec.2026.10043.title: Market visualizations

doi:10.1017/eec.2026.10048.abstract: We present and conduct a novel experiment on a multi-period beauty contest game. Leveraging the multi-period feature, we investigate how participants revise their forecasts in periods when new information—such as shocks or announcements—arrives and how they form their expectations in the absence of new information. We make two key contributions. First, we develop a new method based on forecast revisions to evaluate whether participants behave in a forward-looking manner. The experimental results show that participants do react to anticipated shocks: namely, the announcements of future shocks. Second, we identify a new strategic environment effect during periods without new information; only when the game exhibits strategic complementarity do participants use extrapolation and expect continuously rising prices. This finding suggests that expectation formation is endogenous to the economic environment; and policy design should thus take this endogeneity into account.
doi:10.1017/eec.2026.10048.abstract_zh: 我们设计并开展了一项关于多期选美比赛博弈的新实验。利用多期特征，我们研究了参与者在信息更新时期（如冲击或公告发布时）如何修正其预测，以及在缺乏新信息时如何形成预期。本研究有两项核心贡献：第一，我们基于预测修正开发了一种新方法，用以评估参与者是否具有前瞻性行为。实验结果表明，参与者确实会对预期冲击（即未来冲击的公告）做出反应；第二，我们发现在无新信息时期存在一种新的战略环境效应——只有当博弈呈现战略互补性时，参与者才会采用外推法并预期价格持续上涨。这一发现表明，预期形成内生于经济环境，因此政策设计应考虑这种内生性。
doi:10.1017/eec.2026.10048.title: An experiment on a multi-period beauty contest game
doi:10.1017/eec.2026.10048.title_zh: 多期选美竞赛博弈实验研究

doi:10.1017/eec.2026.10049.abstract: This study investigates how in-game virtual currencies influence consumer spending behaviour. In an incentivized randomized controlled trial with 753 UK participants, we estimate the willingness-to-pay (WTP) for loot boxes represented as risky and ambiguous lotteries. We test the effects of virtual currencies, money illusion, and cognitive-demanding (non-intuitive) exchange rates, three practices commonly used to sell loot boxes. Our results show that WTP is significantly higher when transactions are conducted in virtual currencies with a 1:1 exchange rate compared to British pounds, contributing to the debate on the neutrality of virtual currencies and experimental currency units. Moreover, participants in our study are affected by money illusion distortions, regardless of the exchange rate’s intuitiveness. However, we find no evidence that non-intuitive exchange rates affect participants’ WTP compared to intuitive exchange rates of comparable size. These findings highlight the behavioural distortions induced by common monetization practices in games and provide empirical support for the European Commission’s call for stricter regulation of virtual currencies in digital environments.
doi:10.1017/eec.2026.10049.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了游戏内虚拟货币如何影响消费者支出行为。通过一项包含753名英国参与者的激励性随机对照试验，我们估算了以风险性和模糊性彩票形式呈现的“战利品箱”的支付意愿（WTP）。我们检验了虚拟货币、货币幻觉以及认知负荷（非直观）汇率这三种常用于销售战利品箱的实践效应。结果显示，当交易以1:1汇率的虚拟货币进行时，支付意愿显著高于以英镑计价的情况，这为虚拟货币与实验货币单位的中立性争论提供了新证据。此外，无论汇率是否直观，参与者均受到货币幻觉扭曲的影响。然而，与规模相近的直观汇率相比，我们未发现非直观汇率对参与者支付意愿产生影响的证据。这些发现揭示了游戏中常见货币化实践所引发的行为扭曲，并为欧盟委员会呼吁在数字环境中加强虚拟货币监管提供了实证支持。
doi:10.1017/eec.2026.10049.title: Virtual currencies in online gaming increase the willingness to pay for loot boxes: an experimental analysis
doi:10.1017/eec.2026.10049.title_zh: 网络游戏中的虚拟货币增加对开箱付费意愿：一项实验分析

doi:10.1017/eec.2026.10050.abstract: We build an experiment to uncover the bandit-like nature of consumer behavior usually masked by the product and time aggregation of consumption data. Subjects make repeated choices between musical styles (either all familiar or unfamiliar), and post-choice satisfaction is observed. We estimate Bayesian bandit models of learning taste by consuming with satiation. Our best model features decreasing random exploration, with openness being associated with higher exploration. Early exploration is more intensive in the unfamiliar treatment and persists throughout the experiment in both treatments. Overall, subjects make choices that deviate from their best prediction 61.5% of the time in the unfamiliar treatment versus 44.7% in the familiar treatment. Our model offers a rational interpretation of random utility in discrete consumer choices which does not rest on perception and/or decision errors.
doi:10.1017/eec.2026.10050.abstract_zh: 我们设计了一项实验，以揭示通常被消费数据的产品和时间聚合所掩盖的消费者行为的“类赌博机”本质。受试者在不同音乐风格（全部熟悉或全部不熟悉）之间进行重复选择，并记录选择后的满意度。我们通过消费中的满足感来估计学习品味的贝叶斯赌博机模型。最优模型呈现递减的随机探索特征，其中开放性程度与更高探索水平相关。在不熟悉处理组中，早期探索更为密集，且该探索行为在两个处理组中均贯穿实验全程。总体而言，受试者在61.5%的决策中（不熟悉处理组）偏离其最优预测，而熟悉处理组该比例为44.7%。我们的模型为离散消费者选择中的随机效用提供了理性解释，该解释不依赖于感知和/或决策误差。
doi:10.1017/eec.2026.10050.title: Learning by consuming in the lab

doi:10.1017/eec.2026.10051.abstract: Groups often agree that change is needed, but differing preferences and information may still lead to difficulty coordinating on a particular alternative. In a laboratory experiment, we study coordination and information aggregation in a divided-majority voting game with public information and conflicting preferences. Voters observe private signals and a public signal about whether alternative upper A $A$ A or upper B $B$ B is socially optimal. Unless sufficiently many voters agree, an inferior default upper C $C$ C occurs. When the public signal is more accurate than the private signal and voters have common preferences, most voters coordinate on the public signal. However, when public-signal accuracy is reduced or preferences conflict, voters follow the public signal less frequently. While reduced public-signal accuracy substantially increases the frequency of coordination failure, conflicting preferences between subgroups do not. These results highlight the importance of accurate public information in achieving collective action.
doi:10.1017/eec.2026.10051.abstract_zh: 群体通常认同变革的必要性，但不同的偏好和信息仍可能导致难以就某一特定替代方案达成协调。通过一项实验室实验，我们研究了在存在公共信息和偏好冲突的分裂多数投票博弈中的协调与信息聚合问题。投票者观察私人信号以及关于替代方案A或B何者更优的公共信号。除非有足够多的投票者达成一致，否则将出现较差的默认方案C。当公共信号比私人信号更准确且投票者具有共同偏好时，多数投票者会依据公共信号进行协调。然而，当公共信号准确性降低或偏好存在冲突时，投票者遵循公共信号的频率会下降。尽管公共信号准确性降低会显著增加协调失败的发生频率，但子群体间的偏好冲突并不会产生同样影响。这些结果凸显了准确公共信息在实现集体行动中的重要性。

doi:10.1017/eec.2026.10052.abstract: We experimentally investigate preferences for clumping-versus-separating information in the gain and the loss domains, and also preferences for timing. Our design is motivated by the idea that information preferences may depend on reference points. Subjects participate in two monetary lotteries and choose how to receive the outcome information. For half of the subjects, the lotteries are framed as two gain lotteries; for the other half, as two loss lotteries. Based on Thaler (1985) one can expect that people want to learn the outcomes of the gain lotteries separately and the outcomes of the loss lotteries clumped together (cf. hedonic editing hypothesis). On the other hand, a different reference dependent model by Koszegi and Rabin (2009) relies on expectations-based reference points, and predicts that subjects should prefer clumped information irrespective of the frame. The results of our experiment show a preference for separating information about gains, and no preference for clumping or separating information about losses. Regarding timing, we find a weak overall preference for receiving information sooner. These findings provide new insights into information preferences. We conclude by discussing policy implications, as well as our additional contributions to related literature.
doi:10.1017/eec.2026.10052.abstract_zh: 我们通过实验研究了人们在收益域和损失域中对信息聚合与分离的偏好，以及对信息获取时机的偏好。实验设计基于信息偏好可能依赖于参照点的理论假设。受试者参与两项货币抽奖，并选择如何接收结果信息。其中一半受试者的抽奖被设定为两项收益抽奖，另一半则为两项损失抽奖。根据Thaler（1985）的理论，人们可能倾向于分别了解收益抽奖的结果，而将损失抽奖的结果合并了解（参见享乐编辑假说）。另一方面，Koszegi和Rabin（2009）提出的基于期望参照点的不同参照依赖模型则预测，无论抽奖框架如何，受试者都应偏好信息聚合。实验结果显示，受试者偏好将收益信息分离呈现，而对损失信息则未表现出聚合或分离的明确偏好。在时机方面，我们发现受试者整体上微弱偏好尽早获取信息。这些发现为信息偏好研究提供了新见解。最后，我们讨论了政策含义及对相关文献的额外贡献。
doi:10.1017/eec.2026.10052.title: Information preferences, reference points and hedonic editing: experimental evidence
doi:10.1017/eec.2026.10052.title_zh: 信息偏好、参考点与享乐编辑：实验证据

doi:10.1017/eec.2026.10053.abstract: We design and conduct a real-effort experiment to jointly estimate present bias and sophistication across effort and monetary domains. Unlike prior work (e.g., Augenblick and Rabin, 2019; Fedyk, 2024), we do not assume that these parameters are identical across domains. We explain and empirically demonstrate how assuming identical sophistication across money and effort domains can bias the estimates of key parameters. In our online experiment, participants chose to (predicted to) complete 14% (10%) fewer tasks on the same day than on a future day, leading to an estimated present bias ( beta e $\beta_e$ β e ) over effort of 0.70–0.79, and an estimated sophistication ( beta caret e $\widehat{\beta}_e$ β ^ e ) of 0.80–0.88. For money, aggregate present bias ( beta m $\beta_m$ β m ) is near zero, but there is substantial heterogeneity, with roughly equal numbers of participants exhibiting present bias and future bias. At the individual level, roughly three quarters of all participants correctly anticipate the direction of their bias in both domains, even if not its full magnitude.
doi:10.1017/eec.2026.10053.abstract_zh: 我们设计并实施了一项真实努力实验，以联合估计努力和货币领域中的现时偏向与理性程度。与先前研究（例如Augenblick和Rabin, 2019; Fedyk, 2024）不同，我们并未假设这些参数在不同领域间相同。我们解释并通过实证表明，假设货币与努力领域的理性程度相同会如何导致关键参数估计的偏误。在我们的在线实验中，参与者当天完成的任务比未来某天少14%（预测为10%），由此估计出努力领域的现时偏向（βₑ）为0.70–0.79，理性程度（β̂ₑ）为0.80–0.88。在货币领域，总体现时偏向（βₘ）接近于零，但存在显著的异质性，表现出现时偏向和未来偏向的参与者数量大致相当。在个体层面，约四分之三的参与者能够正确预测自身在两个领域中的偏向方向，尽管未能完全预测其幅度。

doi:10.1017/s0022050726101454.abstract: European fascist regimes have attached great importance to nationalistic families and designed policies to perpetuate them. Most offered policy packages with interest-free loans repayable through childbirth, along with allowances and tax deductions for large families. Using a difference-in-difference approach and Nazi Germany as a case study, we show that these policies may have counterproductive effects due to negative selection mechanisms in the marriage market. The excessive pressure to marry exerted on singles results in lower quality, ultimately less fertile, and more fragile unions. This finding is important as the main European far-right parties today propose reinstating these policy packages.
doi:10.1017/s0022050726101454.abstract_zh: 欧洲法西斯政权高度重视民族主义家庭，并制定了旨在延续这些家庭的政策。多数政权提供了一揽子政策，包括通过生育偿还的无息贷款，以及对大家庭的补贴和税收减免。本文以纳粹德国为案例，采用双重差分法研究发现，由于婚姻市场中的负向选择机制，这些政策可能产生适得其反的效果。对单身者施加的过度婚姻压力导致婚姻质量下降，最终形成生育率更低、关系更脆弱的结合。这一发现具有重要意义，因为当今欧洲主要极右翼政党正提议重新推行此类政策组合。

doi:10.1017/s0022050726101521.abstract: Using data on interbank relationships and note holdings in Pennsylvania, I estimate the probability that a bank will redeem the notes of other banks by the distance separating them. If two banks were separated by 50 miles, there was a 40 percent probability that a bank would hold the notes of another at a given time. At 200 miles, the estimated probability is virtually zero. My analysis of notes discounted by a small-town, Connecticut banknote broker reveals that distant notes were offered by travelers and traders who moved along the era’s principal waterways.

doi:10.1017/s0022050726101533.abstract: How much did France pay for its colonial empire? Did colonies benefit from large transfers from French taxpayers and private investors, or were they, on the contrary, drained of their capital? This paper uses novel budgetary, private investment, and loan data to compute monetary flows between France and the colonies between 1833 and 1962. Public expenditure spent by France on the empire represented only 1.3 percent of its GDP, of which four-fifths was for the military. Trade balance deficits of French colonies were not counterbalanced by large public or private capital transfers from France to the colonies, but by military expenditure from the metropole. Overall, large sums of money were flowing from the colonies to the metropole, a “drain” representing a couple of percentage points of colonial GDP, making French colonies comparable to British India in the twentieth century.
doi:10.1017/s0022050726101533.abstract_zh: 法国为其殖民帝国付出了多少代价？殖民地是否从法国纳税人和私人投资者那里获得了大量转移支付，还是相反，其资本被抽走？本文利用新的预算、私人投资和贷款数据，计算了1833年至1962年间法国与殖民地之间的货币流动。法国在帝国上的公共支出仅占其GDP的1.3%，其中五分之四用于军事。法国殖民地的贸易逆差并未被法国向殖民地的大量公共或私人资本转移所抵消，而是由宗主国的军事支出弥补。总体而言，大量资金从殖民地流向宗主国，这种“抽血”相当于殖民地GDP的几个百分点，使得法国殖民地在20世纪与英属印度具有可比性。

doi:10.1080/00036846.2026.2695915.abstract: Under policy incentives, the digital transformation of the traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) industry has emerged as a critical pathway for overcoming structural upgrading bottlenecks and fostering end-to-end collaborative development. Drawing on panel data from 75 listed TCM manufacturing firms in China from 2015 to 2023, this study examines the impact of digital investment on supply chain resilience in TCM leading firms and explores the mediating role of dual-chain coupling between the capital chain and talent chain. Fixed-effects models, Sobel-Goodman mediation tests, and instrumental variable (2SLS) estimation are employed to test the proposed relationships. The results reveal that digital investment significantly enhances supply chain resilience, and that dual-chain coupling serves as the core transmission mechanism, accounting for over 90% of the total effect. These results offer theoretical insights and practical guidance for TCM enterprises seeking to optimize digital strategies, strengthen supply chain resilience, and achieve sustainable and innovation-driven growth.
doi:10.1080/00036846.2026.2695915.abstract_zh: 在政策激励下，中医药行业数字化转型已成为突破结构性升级瓶颈、推动全链条协同发展的关键路径。本研究基于2015-2023年中国75家上市中医药制造企业面板数据，考察数字投资对中医药龙头企业供应链韧性的影响，并探究资金链与人才链双链耦合的中介作用。采用固定效应模型、Sobel-Goodman中介效应检验及工具变量两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）对假设关系进行验证。结果表明：数字投资显著提升供应链韧性，且双链耦合构成核心传导机制，其解释力占总效应的90%以上。该研究为中医药企业优化数字战略、强化供应链韧性及实现可持续创新增长提供了理论启示与实践指导。

doi:10.1080/00036846.2026.2696483.abstract: Institutional opening has emerged as a significant policy instrument for shaping long-term investment decisions, particularly when the marginal effects of factor-based opening become less pronounced and foreign investment becomes increasingly sensitive to the institutional environment and policy expectations. This paper treats the establishment of a pilot free trade zone (FTZ) in a region with relatively weak institutional foundations as a quasi-natural experiment. Using provincial panel data from 2008 to 2022, this study applies the synthetic control method and the synthetic difference-in-differences method to test the impact of FTZ policies on the total investment of foreign-invested enterprises. The results show that FTZ policies significantly increased the total investment of foreign-invested enterprises in the treated province, with an average policy effect of approximately 34.4%. Further analysis indicates that this effect is primarily reflected in the growth in medium- and long-term investment arrangements rather than increases in current capital inflows alone. This finding suggests that institutional opening can promote foreign investment by enhancing investors’ expectations regarding institutional stability and policy predictability. Comparisons across regions also indicate that the effect is stronger in regions with relatively weak institutional foundations, whereas the marginal effect is smaller in regions with more developed institutional conditions.
doi:10.1080/00036846.2026.2696483.abstract_zh: 制度型开放已成为塑造长期投资决策的重要政策工具，尤其是在要素型开放的边际效应逐渐减弱、外资对制度环境与政策预期日益敏感的背景下。本文将自由贸易试验区在制度基础相对薄弱地区的设立视为准自然实验，利用2008—2022年省级面板数据，采用合成控制法和合成双重差分法检验自贸区政策对外商投资企业投资总额的影响。结果表明，自贸区政策显著提升了处理省份外商投资企业的投资总额，平均政策效应约为34.4%。进一步分析显示，这一效应主要体现在中长期投资安排的增长，而非当期资本流入的增加。这一发现表明，制度型开放能够通过增强投资者对制度稳定性和政策可预期性的预期来促进外商投资。跨区域比较也显示，在制度基础相对薄弱的地区，该效应更为显著，而在制度条件较为完善的地区，边际效应较小。

doi:10.1080/00036846.2026.2698030.abstract: This study examines whether voluntary environmental regulations enhance corporate carbon information disclosure (CID), an underexplored issue in carbon governance. Based on Chinese A-share listed firms from 2010 to 2023, we use green factory certification as a quasi-natural experiment and employ a multi-period difference-in-differences approach. Data were obtained from the CSMAR and CNRDS databases. The final sample consists of 4,966 firms, yielding 40,953 firm-year observations. Results show that certification significantly improves firms’ CID. Mechanism tests reveal three channels: stronger managerial and organizational green awareness, increased investor and media attention, and promoted green investment and innovation. Heterogeneity tests indicate the effect is stronger for firms in non-high-carbon industries, non-key-polluting firms, those in regions with cash incentives and those in areas with weaker low-carbon regulation. Certified firms that receive environmental penalties do not improve CID, verifying the effectiveness of post-certification dynamic monitoring. Furthermore, certification promotes both symbolic and substantive disclosure, reduces greenwashing and cuts real carbon emissions, supporting a ‘talk-and-walk’ governance effect. Certified firms also generate positive spillover effects, motivating industry peers, city peers and downstream supply-chain customers to enhance CID. This study offers causal evidence for voluntary environmental regulation in carbon governance and implications for incentivizing credible carbon disclosure.
doi:10.1080/00036846.2026.2698030.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨自愿性环境规制是否能够提升企业碳信息披露水平，这是碳治理领域中尚未充分探究的问题。基于2010年至2023年中国A股上市公司数据，以绿色工厂认证作为准自然实验，采用多期双重差分法进行分析。数据来源于CSMAR和CNRDS数据库，最终样本包含4,966家企业，共计40,953个公司-年度观测值。结果表明，认证显著提升了企业的碳信息披露水平。机制检验揭示了三条路径：管理层与组织绿色意识的增强、投资者与媒体关注度的提升，以及绿色投资与创新的促进。异质性检验显示，在非高碳行业企业、非重点污染企业、位于现金激励政策地区以及低碳规制较弱地区的企业中，该效应更为显著。获得认证但受到环境处罚的企业并未改善碳信息披露，这验证了认证后动态监管的有效性。此外，认证同时促进了象征性披露与实质性披露，减少了“漂绿”行为，并降低了实际碳排放，支持了“言行一致”的治理效应。获得认证的企业还产生了正向溢出效应，激励同行业企业、同城市企业以及下游供应链客户提升碳信息披露水平。本研究为自愿性环境规制在碳治理中的因果效应提供了证据，并对激励可信碳信息披露具有政策启示。

doi:10.1080/00036846.2026.2698856.abstract: The ‘Broadband China’ policy, a series of digital infrastructure modernization projects starting in 2014, greatly expanded and improved local Internet access. This study utilizes the 2011–2016 firm-level data in a staggered difference-in-differences model to examine the energy efficiency gain from the policy. The findings show that the policy-covered enterprises reduced their energy intensity by 2.34% more than their uncovered counterparts, comprising 11.2% of the total Five-Year-Plan target in the sample period. This effect was more pronounced among firms in manufacturing, in eastern and central regions, in non-resource-based cities and among non-state-owned or large-scale firms. Mechanism analysis indicates that the policy reduces energy consumption and emissions by enhancing managerial efficiency and stimulating green innovation. This study shows that digital infrastructure promotes firms’ low-carbon transitions and also advances corporate social responsibility and sustainable development.
doi:10.1080/00036846.2026.2698856.abstract_zh: 宽带中国”政策是自2014年起实施的一系列数字基础设施现代化项目，显著扩大并改善了地方互联网接入。本研究利用2011-2016年企业层面数据，采用交错双重差分模型，考察该政策带来的能效提升效应。研究发现，受政策覆盖的企业能源强度比未覆盖企业多降低2.34%，占样本期内整个五年计划目标的11.2%。这一效应在制造业企业、东部和中部地区、非资源型城市以及非国有或大型企业中更为显著。机制分析表明，该政策通过提升管理效率和激发绿色创新来降低能源消耗与排放。本研究显示，数字基础设施不仅推动企业低碳转型，还促进了企业社会责任与可持续发展。

doi:10.1080/00036846.2026.2699452.abstract: Using the full text of invention patents filed by Chinese listed firms, we construct a firm-level innovation-quality index by pre-training and fine-tuning a deep learning language model, and link this measure to National Tax Survey records and disclosed supplier – customer dyads. From a value-chain coordination perspective, we examine bilateral labour-demand spillovers associated with focal firms’ innovation-quality upgrading. The results show that innovation-quality upgrading at focal firms significantly increases labour demand among upstream and downstream suppliers. A one-standard-deviation increase in innovation quality raises upstream and downstream employment by 0.84% and 0.77%, respectively. This study also employs a shift-share instrumental variable (SSIV) design to address potential endogeneity. Mechanism analyses identify two channels: an output-demand channel, whereby innovation quality raises productivity, profitability, and product quality, expanding input demand and downstream market demand; and a trade-credit channel, whereby improved innovation credentials strengthen reputation and balance-sheet capacity, enabling trade credit and guarantees that relax partners’ financing constraints and stimulate hiring. This study provides managers and policymakers with insights into how high-quality innovation stabilizes employment.
doi:10.1080/00036846.2026.2699452.abstract_zh: 本文利用中国上市公司发明专利申请全文，通过预训练与微调深度学习语言模型构建企业层面创新质量指数，并将该指标与全国税收调查记录及公开的供应商-客户配对数据进行关联。从价值链协调视角出发，我们考察了焦点企业创新质量提升对双边劳动力需求的溢出效应。研究发现，焦点企业创新质量升级显著增加了上下游供应商的劳动力需求：创新质量每提高一个标准差，上游和下游就业分别增长0.84%和0.77%。本研究还采用份额转移工具变量（SSIV）设计以应对潜在内生性问题。机制分析识别出两条传导路径：一是产出需求渠道——创新质量通过提升生产率、盈利能力和产品质量，扩大投入需求与下游市场需求；二是贸易信贷渠道——创新资质的改善增强了企业声誉与资产负债表能力，使其能够提供贸易信贷与担保，从而缓解合作伙伴的融资约束并刺激雇佣行为。本研究为管理者与政策制定者提供了高质量创新如何稳定就业的实践启示。

doi:10.1080/00036846.2026.2699940.abstract: This paper examines whether the opening of the China-Europe Railway Express (CRE) affects firms’ cross-regional investment. Using subsidiary-level data of Chinese listed firms from 2003 to 2020, we construct a firm-destination city-year panel and find that CRE openings significantly increase firms’ subsidiary establishment in connected cities. Mechanism analyses suggest that the CRE promotes firms’ cross-regional investment primarily by improving access to European markets and enhancing cross-border supply-chain efficiency. The effect is stronger for export-oriented firms and is more pronounced in coastal cities and cargo-origin hub cities with higher logistical importance. Evidence from textual classification of subsidiary business scopes further shows that the CRE has a stronger effect on embedded-oriented subsidiaries engaged in production, R&D, and manufacturing than on transit-oriented subsidiaries engaged in trading, logistics, and warehousing. Moreover, the investment response is amplified in cities with stronger industrial agglomeration and higher levels of marketization, highlighting the role of local absorptive capacity. Overall, this paper provides firm-level evidence that cross-border transport infrastructure can reshape firms’ spatial organization layout, and that the related investment exhibits certain features of organizational embeddedness rather than being limited to transit functions.
doi:10.1080/00036846.2026.2699940.abstract_zh: 本文考察中欧班列（CRE）开通是否影响企业跨区域投资。基于2003-2020年中国上市公司子公司层面数据，构建企业-目的地城市-年度面板数据后发现，中欧班列开通显著增加了企业在沿线城市的子公司设立数量。机制分析表明，中欧班列主要通过改善欧洲市场准入和提升跨境供应链效率促进企业跨区域投资。该效应在出口导向型企业中更为显著，且在物流重要性更高的沿海城市和货源枢纽城市表现更突出。基于子公司经营范围文本分类的证据进一步显示，相较于从事贸易、物流和仓储的转运导向型子公司，中欧班列对从事生产、研发和制造的嵌入导向型子公司具有更强的促进作用。此外，在产业集聚程度更高、市场化水平更强的城市，企业投资响应更为显著，凸显了地方吸收能力的关键作用。总体而言，本文提供了跨境交通基础设施能够重塑企业空间组织布局的微观证据，并揭示相关投资呈现组织嵌入性特征而非局限于转运功能。

doi:10.1080/00036846.2026.2699943.abstract: In the minimum wage literature, much of the focus has been on the effects of minimum wage changes on employment, wages, earnings of labour market participants, and income. However, through its influence on parents’ income, time allocation, and capacity for health investment, a change in minimum wage can also affect child health. In this study, I examine the effect of the minimum wage introduced by the 1966 Fair Labor Standards Act on child health. The study uses intergenerational survey data from US households in the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) and employs a difference-in-differences research design. The results show that the introduction of a minimum wage increases the likelihood of a healthy childhood. The effect is not homogeneous across states; it is stronger in states without prior minimum wage policies, where the Act represented a larger shock. The results further reveal significant gender heterogeneity, indicating that the health improvement effect of the minimum wage policy is substantially stronger for girls than for boys. The findings are robust to a range of additional validation exercises, including event-study specifications, spillover analyses, and placebo tests.
doi:10.1080/00036846.2026.2699943.abstract_zh: 在最低工资文献中，研究重点多集中于最低工资变动对就业、工资、劳动力市场参与者收入及总体收入的影响。然而，最低工资变动通过影响父母的收入、时间分配及健康投资能力，也可能对儿童健康产生作用。本研究考察了1966年《公平劳动标准法》引入的最低工资制度对儿童健康的影响。研究采用美国收入动态追踪调查（PSID）中的跨代际家庭数据，并运用双重差分研究设计。结果表明，最低工资的引入提高了儿童拥有健康童年的可能性。该效应在各州间并非同质：在未实施过最低工资政策的州（该法案带来的冲击更大）中，效应更为显著。结果进一步揭示了显著的性别异质性，表明最低工资政策对女孩的健康改善效应明显强于男孩。上述发现在一系列额外验证测试中保持稳健，包括事件研究设定、溢出效应分析及安慰剂检验。

doi:10.1086/733049.abstract: Many workers are evaluated on their ability to engage with customers. We measure the impact of gender-based customer discrimination on the productivity of online sales agents in sub-Saharan Africa. Using a novel framework that randomly varies the gender of names presented to customers without changing worker behavior, we find the assignment of a female-sounding name leads to 50 percent fewer purchases. Customers also lag in responding, are less expressive, and avoid discussing purchases. We show similar results for customers around the world and across workers. Removing customer bias, we find women would be more productive than their male coworkers.
doi:10.1086/733049.abstract_zh: 许多工人的工作表现取决于其与客户互动的能力。本研究衡量了基于性别的客户歧视对撒哈拉以南非洲地区在线销售代理生产率的影响。通过采用一种新颖的实验框架——在不改变工人实际行为的前提下，随机向客户展示不同性别的姓名——我们发现，使用女性化姓名会导致购买量减少50%。客户不仅回复延迟、表达更不积极，还会回避讨论购买事宜。全球范围内的客户及不同工人群体均呈现类似结果。若消除客户偏见，女性工人的生产率将高于其男性同事。
doi:10.1086/733049.title: Customer Discrimination in the Workplace: Evidence from Online Sales
doi:10.1086/733049.title_zh: 职场中的顾客歧视：来自在线销售的证据

doi:10.1086/733051.abstract: We characterize the joint evolution of cross-sectional inequality in earnings, other sources of income and consumption across generations in the U.S. To account for cross-sectional dispersion, we estimate a model of intergenerational persistence and separately identify the influences of parental factors and of idiosyncratic life-cycle components. We find evidence of family persistence in earnings, consumption and saving behaviours, and marital sorting patterns. However, the quantitative contribution of idiosyncratic heterogeneity to cross-sectional inequality is significantly larger than parental effects. Our estimates imply that intergenerational persistence is not high enough to induce further large increases in inequality over time and across generations.
doi:10.1086/733051.abstract_zh: 本文刻画了美国跨代际收入、其他收入来源及消费截面不平等性的联合演变特征。为解释截面离散程度，我们构建了代际持续性模型，并分别识别了父母因素与个体生命周期异质性成分的影响。研究发现，收入、消费与储蓄行为存在家族持续性特征，同时婚姻匹配模式亦呈现代际传递性。然而，个体异质性对截面不平等的量化贡献显著大于父母效应。我们的估计表明，代际持续性尚未达到足以引发跨时期与跨代际不平等进一步大幅加剧的程度。
doi:10.1086/733051.title: Consumption and Income Inequality across Generations
doi:10.1086/733051.title_zh: 代际消费与收入不平等

doi:10.1086/733226.abstract: We analyze trends in labor-market returns to psychological traits using data from half a million Finnish men from 2001 to 2015. Cognitive skills' value declined, while noncognitive skills' value increased. Our novel findings show that extraversion drives this rise, while conscientiousness remains stable. Extraversion's rising returns are most pronounced for lower earners and those on the employment margin. These traits predict different labor market paths: extraversion predicts lower education and more work experience, while cognitive ability and conscientiousness lead to higher education and high-paying jobs.
doi:10.1086/733226.abstract_zh: 我们利用2001年至2015年50万芬兰男性的数据，分析了劳动力市场对心理特质的回报趋势。认知技能的价值下降，而非认知技能的价值上升。我们的新发现表明，外向性推动了这一上升趋势，而尽责性则保持稳定。外向性回报率的上升在低收入者和就业边缘人群中最为显著。这些特质预测了不同的劳动力市场路径：外向性预示着较低的教育水平和更多的工作经验，而认知能力和尽责性则导向更高的教育水平和高薪工作。
doi:10.1086/733226.title: Beyond IQ: The Rising Value of Extraversion
doi:10.1086/733226.title_zh: 超越智商：外向性的价值上升

doi:10.1086/733490.abstract: Using Danish registry data linked to the Labor Force Survey, we provide the first rigorous evidence with external validity on the hours-career nexus (positive association between hours and career success). Guided by three theories (human capital; rat race; tournament), we unpack the hours-career nexus through examining: the differential effect of hours in the present firm and elsewhere; hours relative to peers’ hours; standard vs. evening/night/weekend hours; and the importance of sustaining long hours. Supplemented by the time use survey, we show the gender gap in hours and career success is due mostly to gendered division of labor in household production.
doi:10.1086/733490.abstract_zh: 利用丹麦登记数据与劳动力调查的关联，我们首次提供了关于工时与职业发展关联（即工时与职业成功之间的正相关关系）且具有外部效度的严谨证据。基于三种理论（人力资本理论、竞争性工作理论、锦标赛理论），我们通过以下维度解析工时与职业发展的关联：当前企业内工时与其他企业工时的差异化效应；工时相对于同行的相对水平；标准工时与晚间/夜间/周末工时的差异；以及持续超长工时的重要性。结合时间使用调查数据，我们揭示工时与职业成功中的性别差异主要源于家庭生产中的性别分工。
doi:10.1086/733490.title: Working Hours, Top Management Appointments, and Gender: Evidence from Linked Employer-Employee Data

doi:10.1086/733493.abstract: Using full count US census data, we study the impact of early twentieth-century state-industry-specific minimum wage laws that primarily targeted female employees. Our triple-difference estimates suggest a null impact of the minimum wage laws, potentially reflecting disemployment effects and the positive selection bias of the workers remaining in the labor force. When comparing county-industry trends between counties straddling state borders, female employment is lower by around 3.1% in affected county-industry cells. We further investigate the implications for own-wage elasticity of labor demand as a function of cross-industry concentration, the channels of substitution between men and women, and heterogeneity by marital status.
doi:10.1086/733493.abstract_zh: 利用美国人口普查全量数据，本文研究了20世纪初主要针对女性雇员的州-行业特定最低工资法的影响。三重差分估计结果表明，最低工资法的影响为零，这可能反映了就业抑制效应以及留在劳动力队伍中的工人存在的正向选择偏差。通过比较州界两侧县-行业层面的趋势，受影响县-行业单元的女性就业率下降约3.1%。我们进一步探讨了劳动力需求的自工资弹性如何随跨行业集中度变化、男女替代渠道以及婚姻状况异质性。

doi:10.1086/734087.abstract: Firstborns, on average, complete more education than laterborns. We study whether individuals’ endowments measured by genetic information amplify this effect. Our familyfixed effects approach allows exploiting exogenous variation in birth order and genetic endowments among 14,850 siblings in the UK Biobank. We find that those with higher genetic endowments benefit disproportionately more from being firstborn compared to those with lower endowments, providing a clean example of how nature and nurture interact in producing human capital. Since parental investments are a dominant channel driving birth order effects, our results are consistent with complementarity between endowments and investments in human capital formation.
doi:10.1086/734087.abstract_zh: 平均而言，头胎子女比后生子女完成更多教育。我们研究以遗传信息衡量的个体禀赋是否会放大这一效应。通过采用家庭固定效应方法，我们利用英国生物银行中14,850名兄弟姐妹在出生顺序和遗传禀赋上的外生变异进行分析。研究发现，与低遗传禀赋者相比，高遗传禀赋者从作为头胎子女中获得的收益显著更大——这为先天禀赋与后天培养如何相互作用以形成人力资本提供了清晰例证。由于父母投资是驱动出生顺序效应的主导渠道，我们的结果与禀赋与人力资本形成投资之间的互补性假说一致。

doi:10.1086/741602.abstract: Policy makers frequently champion information provision about carbon impact on the premise that consumers are willing to mitigate their emissions but are poorly informed about how to do so. We empirically test this argument and reject it. We collect an extensive new dataset and find both large misperceptions of the carbon impact of different consumption behaviors and clear preferences for mitigation. Yet, in two separate experiments, we show that correcting beliefs has no effect on consumption in large representative samples. Our null results are well-powered and informative, as we target information for maximal impact. These results call into question the potential of correcting carbon footprint misperceptions as a tool to fight climate change.
doi:10.1086/741602.abstract_zh: 政策制定者常以消费者愿意减少碳排放但缺乏相关知识为前提，主张提供碳影响信息。我们通过实证检验了这一论点并予以否定。通过收集大量新数据集，我们发现消费者对不同消费行为的碳影响存在严重认知偏差，同时具有明确的减排偏好。然而，在两项独立实验中，我们证明纠正认知偏差对大规模代表性样本的消费行为并无影响。我们的零结果具有充分统计效力且富有信息量，因为所提供的信息针对的是最大影响目标。这些结果对将纠正碳足迹认知偏差作为应对气候变化工具的有效性提出了质疑。

doi:10.1086/741830.abstract: We estimate the effect of competition on incumbent firm pricing by using high frequency price data and the precise geographic location for all gas stations in California. Using an event study design, we find that the entry of a new station is associated with a 2.5 cent decrease in prices at incumbent stores, which equates to a 7% reduction in estimated retail markups. The effects are immediate, persistent, and show no sign of deterrence or limit pricing behavior. In contrast, nearby exit results in precisely estimated null effects on prices with no evidence of predatory pricing in the lead up to the station departure. The results are consistent across all fuel blends and dissipate with station distance. Finally, we explore the asymmetric effects, showing that the difference cannot be attributed to difference in branding, proximity to highway, or data quality idiosyncrasies, although we find suggestive evidence that exit tends to happen in more competitive markets and amongst less heavily trafficked stations.
doi:10.1086/741830.abstract_zh: 我们利用高频价格数据和加利福尼亚州所有加油站的精确地理位置，估算了竞争对现有企业定价的影响。通过事件研究设计，我们发现新加油站的进入导致现有门店价格下降2.5美分，相当于零售加价幅度减少7%。这种影响是即时且持久的，没有表现出任何威慑或限制性定价行为的迹象。相比之下，附近加油站的退出对价格产生了精确估计的零效应，且在退出前未发现掠夺性定价的证据。所有燃料混合物的结果均一致，并随距离增加而减弱。最后，我们探讨了非对称效应，表明这种差异不能归因于品牌差异、高速公路邻近性或数据质量特性，尽管我们发现了暗示性证据，即退出往往发生在竞争更激烈的市场以及交通流量较少的加油站中。
