doi:10.1093/ej/ueag054.abstract: This paper investigates whether tax evasion opportunities can increase tax revenue. Past theoretical discussions have presented mixed outcomes as to whether allowing taxpayers to opt into uncertainty could indeed enhance overall tax revenues. In this study, we conducted a series of original real-effort experiments in an online setting with almost 6,000 participants to test this hypothesis empirically. Our findings show significant positive labour supply responses to the opportunity to evade (increased labour supply by 30%). More importantly, the expected tax revenue significantly and substantially increased by up to 40%. Strikingly, this effect persists when comparing effective tax rates: Lowering effective tax rates through probabilistic enforcement (the opportunity to evade) is more efficient than simply lowering statutory tax rates. Our findings suggest that the opportunity for tax evasion can increase tax revenues beyond what a corresponding decrease in nominal rates would achieve.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag054.abstract_zh: 本文探讨逃税机会能否增加税收收入。以往的理论讨论对于允许纳税人选择不确定性是否确实能提高整体税收收入，得出了相互矛盾的结果。在本研究中，我们通过在线环境开展了一系列原创的真实努力实验，涉及近6000名参与者，以实证检验这一假设。研究结果显示，逃税机会显著激发了劳动供给的正向反应（劳动供给增加30%）。更重要的是，预期税收收入显著且大幅增长，增幅高达40%。引人注目的是，在比较有效税率时，这一效应依然存在：通过概率性执法（即逃税机会）降低有效税率，比单纯降低法定税率更为高效。我们的发现表明，逃税机会带来的税收收入增长，可能超过相应名义税率下调所能实现的效果。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag054.title: The Bright Side of Tax Evasion

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag055.abstract: Partisan vitriol has become a defining feature of American politics, evident in survey responses and social media discourse. Conventional wisdom holds that these expressions reflect deeply rooted hostility. Yet they may also function as social signals, reinforcing loyalty and conformity within partisan groups. In this view, animosity is less about entrenched ideological divisions and more about fostering cohesion among co-partisans. We test this proposition in two settings. First, using the 2012 American National Election Studies, which recorded interviewer partisanship, we exploit within-interviewer variation to examine whether respondents adjusted their reported hostility depending on the partisan identity of their interviewer. Respondents expressed significantly more animosity when interviewed by a co-partisan and less when facing an opposing-partisan interviewer. Second, in an online experiment with 1,510 participants, we find that revealing a partner’s partisan alignment—when it matched the participant’s—encouraged more frequent out-group attacks and in-group promotion. These behaviours were strongly shaped by social norms: participants were substantially more likely to attack when their partner had done so in the previous round. Together, these findings suggest that partisan hostility is contingent on immediate social context, not solely on deeply held animus.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag055.abstract_zh: 党派恶语相向已成为美国政治的一个显著特征，在调查反馈和社交媒体讨论中随处可见。传统观点认为，这些言论反映了根深蒂固的敌意。然而，它们也可能发挥社会信号的作用，强化党派内部的忠诚与从众心理。按照这种观点，敌意更多源于促进同党成员间的凝聚力，而非固化的意识形态分歧。我们在两个场景中检验了这一命题。首先，利用记录了访谈者党派归属的2012年美国全国选举研究数据，我们通过分析同一访谈者面对不同受访者时的差异，考察受访者是否会根据访谈者的党派身份调整其表达的敌意程度。结果显示，当受访者面对同党访谈者时，其表达的敌意显著增强；而面对对立党派访谈者时，敌意则明显减弱。其次，在一项包含1510名参与者的在线实验中，我们发现：当参与者得知搭档的党派立场与自己一致时，他们会更频繁地攻击外群体并推崇内群体。这些行为深受社会规范的影响——若搭档在前一轮中发起攻击，参与者发动攻击的可能性会显著提高。综合来看，这些发现表明，党派敌意取决于即时的社会情境，而非仅仅源于根深蒂固的敌视情绪。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag055.title: Animosity is for the Audience: How Social Context Shapes Expressions of Political Hostility
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag055.title_zh: 敌意是给观众看的：社会情境如何塑造政治敌意的表达

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag057.abstract: Exploiting a 1960s government trial in Copenhagen, we study the long-run effects of preventive health care for toddlers. We combine administrative data with handwritten nurse records to document universal treatment take-up. Treated children enjoy a five percent of a standard deviation increase in a good adult health index. While initial trial cohorts experience positive health and labour market impacts, those are absent for the final cohorts. Impacts are largest for children with initial health disadvantage and females, and we identify childhood health improvements as a core mechanism. The heterogeneity of trial effects across individuals’ initial health status and cohorts documents that universal toddler care can alleviate health inequalities at low costs, and that the counterfactual policy environment matters.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag057.abstract_zh: 利用20世纪60年代在哥本哈根开展的一项政府试验，我们研究了幼儿预防性医疗保健的长期影响。我们将行政数据与手写护士记录相结合，记录了普遍的治疗接受情况。接受治疗的儿童在成年健康综合指数上提高了0.05个标准差。尽管最初的试验队列在健康和劳动力市场方面产生了积极影响，但最终队列并未观察到这些影响。对于初始健康状况较差的儿童和女性，影响最为显著，并且我们确定儿童期健康状况改善是核心机制。试验效果因个体初始健康状况和队列而异，这表明普遍的幼儿保健能够以低成本缓解健康不平等，且反事实政策环境至关重要。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag057.title: Universal Investments in Toddler Health. Learning from a Large Government Trial
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag057.title_zh: 幼儿健康的普遍投资：来自一项大型政府试验的启示

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag059.abstract: Dominant platforms like Booking.com have often imposed Price Parity Clauses to prevent lower prices on alternative sales channels. We provide quasi-experimental evidence on the removal of these price restrictions in France in 2015 for three major global hotel groups. Our analysis reveals limited and non-significant price effects for rooms sold through consumer-visible channels, such as hotels’ websites or online travel agencies. However, we document a significant price reduction on sales channels not visible to consumers, such as direct offline bookings. Additionally, we identify a significant shift in the share of bookings from online travel agencies to the hotels’ direct offline channels.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag059.abstract_zh: 像Booking.com这样的主导平台经常实施价格一致性条款，以防止替代销售渠道出现更低价格。我们针对2015年法国三大全球酒店集团取消这些价格限制的情况，提供了准实验证据。分析显示，对于通过消费者可见渠道（如酒店官网或在线旅行社）销售的客房，价格影响有限且不显著。然而，我们发现，在消费者不可见的销售渠道（如直接线下预订）上，价格显著下降。此外，我们还发现预订份额从在线旅行社显著转向酒店的直接线下渠道。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag059.title: The Price Effects of Prohibiting Price Parity Clauses: Evidence from Global Hotel Chains
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag059.title_zh: 禁止价格平价条款的价格效应：来自全球连锁酒店的证据

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag061.abstract: Direct public funding of R&D investment to stimulate technological innovation has a strong theoretical case and has gained renewed attention in recent times as a way to address the long-term challenges of modern society, such as economic growth, climate change, energy independence, and national security. We estimate the dynamic macroeconomic effects of government R&D investment and we find that it is very effective in fostering the national innovation effort by crowding in private R&D investment and raising aggregate output in the long run, but also that it stimulates a strong expansion from the outset, in particular through anticipation effects.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag061.abstract_zh: 直接公共资助研发投资以刺激技术创新具有坚实的理论依据，近年来作为应对现代社会长期挑战（如经济增长、气候变化、能源独立和国家安全）的手段重新受到关注。我们估算了政府研发投资的动态宏观经济效应，发现其通过挤入私人研发投资并在长期内提高总产出，对促进国家创新努力非常有效，同时从初期就激发了强劲的经济扩张，尤其是通过预期效应发挥作用。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag061.title: Macroeconomic Effects of Public R&D
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag061.title_zh: 公共研发的宏观经济效应

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag062.abstract: How does polarisation — as measured by mistreatment of political rivals — spread? In an online experiment, participants choose between splitting financial resources equally or discriminating against a supporter of the opposing political party. We vary the information subjects receive about others’ choices and justifications for discrimination. Exposure to extreme justifications for discrimination increases discrimination — particularly in a polarized environment, when many others are already discriminating — and it leads participants to adopt more extreme justifications themselves. Our findings suggest a self-reinforcing dynamic that may fuel polarisation: Exposure to extreme statements increases polarisation and the prevalence of extreme reasoning.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag062.abstract_zh: 极化——以政治对手遭受不公对待为衡量标准——是如何扩散的？在一项在线实验中，参与者在平均分配财务资源与歧视对立政党支持者之间做出选择。我们调整了受试者接收到的关于他人选择及歧视理由的信息。接触极端的歧视理由会增加歧视行为——尤其是在极化环境中，当许多人已经实施歧视时——并且会导致参与者自身采用更极端的理由。我们的研究结果表明，一种可能加剧极化的自我强化动态：接触极端言论会加剧极化，并增加极端推理的普遍性。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag062.title: Extreme justifications fuel polarisation

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag063.abstract: We study the intergenerational impact of birth-control policies on fertility and examine whether and how these policies reduce fertility, even after their abolition. We develop a model that integrates the endogenous evolution of fertility norms. Birth-control policies, through the reduction of mothers’ fertility, establish new norms that shape the fertility decisions of subsequent generations. Consequently, daughters’ fertility is lower due to these new norms, even when the policies are no longer in force. To test the model’s implications, we leverage a quasi-experimental setting provided by China’s One-Child Policy, which was implemented in a staggered manner starting in 1979 and gradually phased out beginning in 2014. Based on the recently released 2020 population census, our results reveal that the policy has an impact on reducing fertility and affects generations no longer subject to its regulations. This study is the first to provide causal evidence of birth-control policies from an intergenerational perspective and highlights the role of norms in shaping fertility outcomes.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag063.abstract_zh: 本文研究生育控制政策对生育率的代际影响，并探讨这些政策在废除后是否以及如何持续降低生育率。我们构建了一个融合生育规范内生演化的模型。生育控制政策通过降低母亲的生育率，建立了影响后代生育决策的新规范。因此，即使政策不再实施，女儿这一代的生育率也会因这些新规范而降低。为检验模型推论，我们利用中国独生子女政策提供的准实验环境——该政策自1979年起分阶段实施，并于2014年开始逐步退出。基于最新公布的2020年人口普查数据，研究结果表明，该政策不仅降低了生育率，还影响了不再受其约束的世代。本研究首次从代际视角为生育控制政策提供了因果证据，并揭示了规范在塑造生育结果中的关键作用。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag063.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag063.title: The Intergenerational Impact of Birth-Control Policies on Fertility: The Role of Norms
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag063.title_zh: 生育控制政策的代际影响：规范的作用

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag064.abstract: Reducing gender-specific commuting barriers in developing countries can have heterogeneous effects on women’s labor outcomes. We study a program that offers free bus rides for women in several Indian states (the Pink Slip program) using a synthetic difference-in-differences approach to examine impacts on transportation expenditures, time use, and labor supply. We find that the program substantially reduces bus-related expenditures. However, when considering all women together, we find no significant changes in travel time, household production, or labor supply. Beneath these aggregate effects, responses vary sharply by employment, marital status, and education. Unmarried women employed prior to the policy increase labor supply, while married women with low and medium levels of education reallocate time away from paid work toward household chores. Overall employment rates remain unchanged in the short run, highlighting that reducing commuting costs does not uniformly improve women’s labor market outcomes.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag064.abstract_zh: 在发展中国家，减少性别特定的通勤障碍可能对女性劳动结果产生异质性影响。我们利用合成双重差分法，研究了一项为印度多个邦女性提供免费公交乘车服务的项目（“粉红车票”计划），评估其对交通支出、时间利用和劳动供给的影响。研究发现，该项目显著降低了公交相关支出。然而，当将所有女性作为一个整体考虑时，我们未发现出行时间、家庭生产或劳动供给发生显著变化。在这些总体效应之下，不同就业状况、婚姻状况和教育水平的女性反应差异显著。政策实施前已有工作的未婚女性增加了劳动供给，而低学历和中等学历的已婚女性则将时间从有偿工作重新分配至家务劳动。短期内总体就业率保持不变，这表明降低通勤成本并不能一致地改善女性的劳动力市场结果。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag064.title: Gender-Specific Transportation Costs and Female Time Use: Evidence from India’s Pink Slip Program
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag064.title_zh: 性别特定交通成本与女性时间利用：来自印度“粉色车票”项目的证据

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag065.abstract: Can participation in safety net programs have long-lasting negative effects across multiple generations? We take advantage of a 1993 Dutch disability insurance reform which tightened requirements and lowered benefits for participants. We study the third generation 25 years after the reform, finding that grandchildren of individuals whose DI eligibility and benefits were reduced are less likely to be born premature, have low birthweight, or experience complicated deliveries. They also have better health and schooling outcomes during early childhood. These early-life improvements are consequential, as they have been linked to better health, education, and labor market outcomes in adulthood.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag065.abstract_zh: 参与安全网项目是否会对多代人产生长期负面影响？我们利用1993年荷兰伤残保险改革这一契机，该改革收紧了参保条件并降低了福利水平。我们研究了改革25年后的第三代群体，发现其伤残保险资格和福利被削减的个体的孙辈，早产、低出生体重或出现分娩并发症的概率更低。他们在幼儿期的健康和教育成果也更为优异。这些早期生命阶段的改善具有深远影响，因为已有研究表明其与成年后更佳的健康、教育及劳动力市场表现相关联。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag065.title: Persistent Effects of Social Program Participation on the Third Generation
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag065.title_zh: 社会项目参与对第三代的持续影响

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag066.abstract: We study gender differences in the response to losing competitions using an online experiment (N=2,086). We find that both genders reduce tournament entry rates in response to losses that are unequivocally meritocratic. However, when the winner is not necessarily determined by merit—a setting perceived as less fair than the meritocratic tournament—female losers are relatively more discouraged. These results suggest that women are more negatively affected by competitions perceived as unfair than men. Exploratory machine learning analysis indicates that risk preferences, age and sports participation in adolescence are associated with a reduced impact of losing competitions.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag066.abstract_zh: 我们通过一项在线实验（N=2,086）研究性别在应对竞争失败时的差异。研究发现，在明确基于能力的竞争中，男女两性均会因失败而降低参赛率。然而，当获胜者并非必然由能力决定——这种情境被认为不如能力型竞争公平——女性失败者相对更受挫。这些结果表明，相较于男性，女性对被认为不公平的竞争会产生更消极的反应。探索性机器学习分析显示，风险偏好、年龄及青少年时期参与体育运动与竞争失败影响的减弱相关。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag066.title: Does Unfairness Hurt Women? The Effects of Losing Unfair Competitions
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag066.title_zh: 不公平会伤害女性吗？输掉不公平竞争的影响

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag067.abstract: Much economic analysis derives policy recommendations based on social welfare criteria intended to model policymakers’ preferences. Yet, little is known about policymakers’ normative views suitable for this use. Our behavioural experiment elicits German legislators’ welfare criteria. When resolving preference conflicts across individuals, they place substantially more importance on least-favoured alternatives than on most-favoured alternatives, contrasting with common aggregation mechanisms and the equal weighting inherent in utilitarianism. When resolving preference conflicts within individuals, politicians choose inconsistently with behavioural economists’ most common approach to welfare analysis with time-inconsistent preferences. In distribution, politicians largely support the same welfare criteria as the public.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag067.abstract_zh: 许多经济分析基于社会福利标准推导政策建议，旨在模拟政策制定者的偏好。然而，关于适合此用途的政策制定者规范观点，我们知之甚少。我们的行为实验揭示了德国立法者的福利标准。在解决个体间的偏好冲突时，他们赋予最不利选项的重要性远高于最有利选项，这与常见的聚合机制及功利主义中固有的平等加权形成对比。在解决个体内部的偏好冲突时，政治家的选择与行为经济学家在时间不一致偏好福利分析中最常用的方法不一致。在分配问题上，政治家与公众所支持的福利标准基本一致。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag067.title: Politicians’ Social Welfare Criteria An Experiment With German Legislators
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag067.title_zh: 德国立法者政治家的社会福利标准实验

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag068.abstract: We conduct a meta-analysis of distributional preferences, examining 297 estimates of sensitivity to inequality from 41 articles that structurally estimate the Fehr and Schmidt (1999) model. Our analysis indicates that individuals are inequality averse: mean sensitivity to disadvantageous and advantageous inequality are, respectively, 0.533 and 0.326. We also uncover systematic heterogeneity: aversion to advantageous (disadvantageous) inequality is smaller (larger) in strategic environments. Finally, we examine 98 estimates of altruism and attitude towards equity versus efficiency from 17 studies structurally estimating the Andreoni and Miller (2002) model. The representative individual displays Cobb–Douglas preferences with roughly 1/3 weight on others’ earnings.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag068.abstract_zh: 我们对分配偏好进行了一项元分析，考察了来自41篇文献的297个不平等敏感度估计值，这些文献均采用结构估计方法对Fehr和Schmidt（1999）模型进行估计。分析表明，个体具有不平等厌恶倾向：对不利不平等和有利不平等的平均敏感度分别为0.533和0.326。我们还发现了系统性异质性：在策略性环境中，对有利（不利）不平等的厌恶程度较小（较大）。最后，我们考察了来自17项研究的98个利他主义及公平与效率态度的估计值，这些研究均采用结构估计方法对Andreoni和Miller（2002）模型进行估计。代表性个体表现出柯布-道格拉斯偏好，其中他人收益的权重约为1/3。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag068.title: Meta-Analysis of Distributional Preferences

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag069.abstract: Chamley and Judd argued that optimal taxation dictates zero long-run taxes on capital income, but Straub and Werning found that these taxes may be positive in the steady state. These models feature a ‘period-zero problem’ because the Ramsey formulation omits past commitments but includes future ones. Chari, Nicolini, and Teles (2020) add commitments to the representative household’s wealth in utility units. Then a nonzero capital levy may apply in period 1, future tax rates on asset income equal zero, and tax rates on consumption are constant. Time-consistency fails if future policymakers are unconstrained but holds if wealth commitments in each period are strict enough to motivate each policymaker to choose zero capital levies. Then a timeless perspective applies where period 1 is not special, tax rates on asset income are always zero, and tax rates on consumption are constant. In the neoclassical growth model with utility depending on the log of consumption, the level of the wealth commitment is constant in the steady state. Extensions allow for uncertainty and heterogeneity and for a form of partial commitment.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag069.abstract_zh: Chamley与Judd认为最优税收理论要求资本收入长期税率为零，但Straub与Werning发现稳态下此类税收可能为正。这些模型存在"第零期问题"，因为拉姆齐框架忽略了历史承诺却包含未来承诺。Chari、Nicolini与Teles（2020）将代表性家庭以效用单位衡量的财富承诺纳入模型。此时第一期可能征收非零资本税，后续各期资产收入税率均为零，消费税率保持恒定。若未来政策制定者不受约束则时间一致性失效，但若每期财富承诺严格到足以激励每位政策制定者选择零资本税，则时间一致性成立。此时适用无时间视角：第一期不再特殊，资产收入税率始终为零，消费税率保持恒定。在消费对数效用的新古典增长模型中，稳态财富承诺水平保持恒定。该框架可扩展至包含不确定性、异质性及部分承诺形式。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag069.title: Taxation of Capital–Capital Levies and Commitment
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag069.title_zh: 资本课税——资本征收与承诺

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag070.title: Special Issue: Climate Change and Inequality
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag070.title_zh: 特刊：气候变化与不平等

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag071.abstract: Savings behavior is governed by innate predispositions (nature) and environmental conditions (nurture); yet prior research largely examines these forces in isolation. Leveraging China’s send-down movement—a policy shock that exposed urban youths to adversity—and a twins design exploiting genetic differences between monozygotic and dizygotic pairs, we identify nature-nurture interplay. Applying extended twin-based variance components models to representative data, we find that adversity more than triples genetic influence on savings, increasing its variance share from 15.2 percent among the unexposed to 53.4 percent among the exposed. Results challenge conventional fixed-effects models which assume time-invariant unobserved traits (e.g., genetic endowments) exert linearly additive effects, and demonstrate policy effectiveness hinges on interactions with such traits.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag071.abstract_zh: 储蓄行为受先天禀赋（天性）与后天环境（教养）共同支配，然而既有研究多将二者割裂分析。本研究借助中国"上山下乡"运动——一项使城市青年暴露于逆境的政策冲击——结合双胞胎设计（利用同卵与异卵双胞胎的遗传差异），识别天性-教养的交互作用。通过将扩展的双胞胎方差成分模型应用于代表性数据，我们发现逆境使储蓄行为的遗传影响提升逾两倍，其方差占比从未经历逆境群体的15.2%跃升至经历逆境群体的53.4%。该结果挑战了传统固定效应模型（该模型假设未观测特质如遗传禀赋呈线性可加效应），并证明政策有效性取决于其与这类特质的交互作用。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag071.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag071.title: How Nurture Activates Nature in Determining Savings Behavior: Evidence from China’s Send-Down Movement and Twins Data
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag071.title_zh: 后天如何激发先天以决定储蓄行为：来自中国上山下乡运动与双胞胎数据的证据

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag072.abstract: This study examines the willingness to engage with others who hold opposing views, a key and understudied step for reducing polarization. A sample of 2,507 Americans is offered the opportunity to listen to opposing views on immigration, abortion and gun ownership. We find that, at baseline, a large fraction of participants are willing to listen, even without incentives and with an easy way out. Emphasizing common ground increases the willingness to engage and reconsider views on abortion and immigration. We discuss possible mechanisms that can explain increased engagement. We propose that emphasizing common ground increases the value of communication as a means to reason through an issue. These findings point to promising directions for interventions aimed at fostering dialogue across ideological divides.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag072.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了人们与持对立观点者进行交流的意愿，这是减少极化过程中一个关键但尚未充分研究的环节。通过对2507名美国民众进行抽样调查，我们提供了倾听关于移民、堕胎和枪支管制等议题对立观点的机会。研究发现，在基线条件下，即使没有激励措施且存在便捷的退出途径，仍有相当比例的参与者愿意倾听。强调共同立场能够提升参与者就堕胎和移民议题进行交流并重新审视自身观点的意愿。我们探讨了可能解释这种参与度提升的潜在机制，并提出强调共同立场能够增强沟通作为理性探讨议题工具的价值。这些发现为旨在促进跨意识形态对话的干预措施指明了有前景的方向。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag072.title: Breaking Echo Chambers: An Experimental Study on the Willingness to Listen to Opposite Views
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag072.title_zh: 打破回音室：倾听对立观点意愿的实验研究

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag073.abstract: I investigate the macroeconomic impact of money-financed fiscal stimuli when they are financed by interest-paying central bank reserves. I do so in New Keynesian models where government bonds and reserves are imperfect substitutes. Despite reducing funding costs for the consolidated government, I analytically show for several models that there is zero impact from money-financed fiscal stimuli on inflation and the real economy (relative to debt-financed stimuli). Afterwards, I relax the conditions behind this ‘irrelevance result’, and show that money-financed fiscal stimuli barely increase inflation and output.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag073.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在由付息央行储备融资的情况下，货币融资型财政刺激对宏观经济的影响。我在新凯恩斯模型中展开分析，其中政府债券与储备为不完全替代品。尽管降低了合并政府的融资成本，我通过多个模型的分析表明，货币融资型财政刺激对通胀和实体经济的影响（相对于债务融资型刺激）为零。随后，我放宽了这一“无关性结论”背后的条件，并证明货币融资型财政刺激几乎不会推高通胀和产出。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag073.title: Monetary financing produces neither high inflation nor miraculous fiscal multipliers
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag073.title_zh: 货币融资既不会导致高通胀，也不会产生奇迹般的财政乘数

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag074.abstract: We experimentally implement security-bid auctions, which are used around the world to sell projects that generate large, stochastic future cash flows. Buyers make bids with debt and equity, linking payments to the project’s ex-post revenue. Contrary to the theoretical predictions, we find that debt auctions generate more revenue than equity auctions. This is explained by overbidding in debt auctions. Furthermore, we find that second-price equity auctions generate slightly more surplus than other treatments. We also implement informal auctions and find that buyers use equity more often than theory predicts, and that sellers successfully choose dominant bids.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag074.abstract_zh: 我们通过实验实施了担保竞价拍卖，这类拍卖在全球范围内被用于出售产生大规模、随机未来现金流的项目。买家以债务和股权形式出价，将支付与项目的事后收入挂钩。与理论预测相反，我们发现债务拍卖比股权拍卖产生更高的收入。这一现象可通过债务拍卖中的过度出价来解释。此外，我们发现第二价格股权拍卖产生的剩余略高于其他处理方式。我们还实施了非正式拍卖，发现买家使用股权的频率高于理论预测，且卖家成功选择了占优出价。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag074.title: Experimental Auctions with Securities

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag075.abstract: Following Sargent and Wallace’s ‘Some Unpleasant Monetarist Arithmetic,’ we study different ways to implement monetary and fiscal policy. In one case, monetary policy pegs the path of the money supply, while fiscal policy adjusts endogenously to balance the budget. In another, fiscal policy pegs the deficit path, while money adjusts to balance the budget. We ask which is more prone to instability – i.e., more likely to have multiple equilibria, endogenous dynamics, or volatile responses to news? The answer depends on whether inflation (equivalently, the deficit) is positive or negative in the long run. This is consistent with cross-country data.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag075.abstract_zh: 遵循萨金特和华莱士的《令人不快的货币主义算术》，我们研究了货币与财政政策的不同实施方式。一种情形下，货币政策锚定货币供给路径，财政政策内生调整以实现预算平衡；另一种情形下，财政政策锚定赤字路径，货币供给则通过调整实现预算平衡。我们探究哪种政策组合更易引发不稳定性——即更可能产生多重均衡、内生动态或对新闻的剧烈反应？答案取决于长期通胀（等价于赤字）为正还是为负。这一结论与跨国数据相吻合。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag075.title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy: Some New Monetarist Arithmetic
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag075.title_zh: 货币与财政政策：新货币主义算术

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag076.abstract: Robo-advisors are tools in financial markets that provide investors with low-cost financial advice, typically based on individual characteristics such as risk attitudes. We study the benefits of robo-advice in a ten-week portfolio choice experiment. Depending on treatment, investors either receive robo-advice, have a robo-advisor implement recommendations by default, or invest on their own. While we observe no effect of robo-advice on initial market participation, we find positive effects on continued participation. Robo-advisors also help investors avoid mistakes, increase rebalancing, and yield portfolios closer to the utility-maximising benchmark. Default implementation of recommendations performs significantly better than advice alone.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag076.abstract_zh: 机器人投顾是金融市场中为投资者提供低成本财务建议的工具，通常基于风险态度等个人特征。我们通过一项为期十周的投资组合选择实验，研究了机器人投顾的益处。根据实验处理方式的不同，投资者或接受机器人投顾建议，或由机器人投顾默认执行推荐方案，或自行投资。虽然我们未观察到机器人投顾对初始市场参与的影响，但发现其对持续参与具有积极效应。机器人投顾还能帮助投资者避免错误、增加再平衡操作，并使投资组合更接近效用最大化的基准水平。相较于仅提供建议，默认执行推荐方案的效果显著更优。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag076.title: On the Benefits of Robo-Advice in Financial Markets
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag076.title_zh: 论机器人投顾在金融市场中的益处

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag077.abstract: Populism has been on the rise, posing a threat to liberal democracy. Existing evidence suggests that globalization, economic shocks, and concerns over cultural change increase support for populist agendas. Yet less is known about interventions that can empower individuals to critically evaluate populist messaging. We argue that tailored exposure to financial markets can reduce support for populist policies because it can encourage learning about the gains of economic complementarity and the costs of nativism and isolationism. We test this argument with an RCT implemented in the run-up to the Brexit referendum. We randomly assigned British citizens to hold and trade complementary financial assets from the UK, EU and the US for six weeks. We show that this intervention increased citizens’ willingness to vote to remain in the European Union during the Brexit Referendum, and particularly so when exposed to companies that exemplify EU-UK economic complementarity. Countering populist narratives, treated participants instead came to associate the EU with economic prosperity, rather than a threat to their cultural identity or a waste of money. Overall, the effects are stronger among swing participants and those originally more open to a European cultural identity.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag077.abstract_zh: 民粹主义持续抬头，对自由民主制度构成威胁。现有证据表明，全球化、经济冲击以及对文化变迁的担忧会增强民众对民粹主义议程的支持。然而，关于哪些干预措施能够帮助个人批判性评估民粹主义信息的研究仍显不足。本文认为，有针对性的金融市场参与能够降低民众对民粹主义政策的支持，因为这种参与可以促使人们认识到经济互补性的收益以及本土主义与孤立主义的代价。我们通过在英国脱欧公投前夕实施的一项随机对照试验验证了这一论点。我们随机分配英国公民在六周内持有并交易来自英国、欧盟和美国的互补性金融资产。研究表明，这一干预措施提高了民众在脱欧公投中投票支持留欧的意愿，尤其是当参与者接触体现欧盟-英国经济互补性的企业时效果更为显著。与民粹主义叙事相反，受试者转而将欧盟与经济繁荣相联系，而非视其为文化认同的威胁或资金浪费。总体而言，这种效应在摇摆参与者及原本对欧洲文化认同持更开放态度的人群中更为显著。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag077.title: Resisting Populism through Financial Market Exposure: Experimental Evidence from Brexit
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag077.title_zh: 通过金融市场暴露抵制民粹主义：来自英国脱欧的实验证据

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag078.abstract: Rising polarisation heightens concerns about politicising regulatory agencies, prompting reassessment of the accountability–independence trade-off. We study whether perceived out-group oversight affects trust in regulation and market behaviour. Using US television transcripts, we show that media link agencies with presidents. We then conduct a field experiment (N=5,566) using a case where the EPA endorsed antibiotic spraying on citrus crops during both Trump’s and Biden’s presidencies. Holding science constant, out-group oversight reduces support for spraying by 26%, lowers trust in EPA’s evaluation, and increases donations to an opposing NGO by 15%. In an obfuscated follow-up, citrus demand is unchanged, but effects differ by consumption habits.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag078.abstract_zh: 日益加剧的两极分化加剧了人们对监管机构政治化的担忧，促使学界重新审视问责与独立之间的权衡。本文研究感知到的外群体监督是否会影响对监管的信任及市场行为。利用美国电视转录文本，我们发现媒体将机构与总统关联。随后，我们以美国环保署（EPA）在特朗普和拜登总统任期内均批准对柑橘作物喷洒抗生素的案例开展实地实验（N=5,566）。在保持科学依据不变的情况下，外群体监督使喷洒支持率降低26%，对EPA评估的信任度下降，并向对立非政府组织的捐款增加15%。在后续模糊化实验中，柑橘需求未发生变化，但影响因消费习惯而异。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag078.title: Politics of Food: An Experiment on Trust in Expert Regulation and Economic Costs of Political Polarisation
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag078.title_zh: 食品政治：专家监管信任与政治极化经济成本的实验研究

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag079.abstract: The well-known cashless-limiting result in Woodford (1998) has become the theoretical foundation for a large body of work that treats the costs and benefits of holding money as irrelevant for monetary transmission. I reexamine this result and find that it relies on a peculiar credit-market structure consisting of perfectly competitive, zero-interest deferred payment arrangements. I show that the result breaks down when the microstructure is generalized to allow for an endogenous interest rate and market power in credit intermediation. The tenuousness of this influential result should give pause to the widespread practice of basing monetary policy advice on models without money.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag079.abstract_zh: Woodford（1998）中著名的无现金限制结果已成为大量研究的理论基础，这些研究将持有货币的成本与收益视为与货币政策传导无关。本文重新审视了这一结果，发现其依赖于一种特殊的信贷市场结构，即完全竞争、零利率的延期支付安排。研究表明，当微观结构被推广至允许内生利率和信贷中介市场势力时，该结果不再成立。这一具有影响力的结果存在脆弱性，应促使学界对基于无货币模型提供货币政策建议的普遍做法进行反思。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag079.title: onetary Economics at 30: A Reexamination of the Relevance of Money in Cashless Limiting Monetary Economies
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag079.title_zh: 货币经济学30年：无现金极限货币经济中货币相关性的再审视

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag080.abstract: Consider the transition out of a stagnant Malthusian system spearheaded by high-human-capital people. Individuals with a stronger preference for offspring quality may be the first to escape the Malthusian regime and adopt modern fertility behaviours (Galor and Moav 2002). To test this hypothesis, we examine the relationship between family size and human capital among academics in Northern Europe in the two centuries before the Industrial Revolution. We measure the human capital of academics using a novel approach based on their publications. We find that scholars with a higher number of publications than the median shifted from having more siblings to having fewer siblings in the first half of the 18th century. Estimating the parameters of an evolutionary growth model by indirect inference, we show how Malthusian constraints initially led the high human capital families to reproduce more, before being endogenously replaced by Beckerian constraints with a tradeoff between child quality and quantity. Our results support an extension of Galor and Moav’s (2002) approach, in which the decline of Malthusian constraints is linked to the accumulation of human capital during the 18th century.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag080.abstract_zh: 考虑由高人力资本个体引领的马尔萨斯停滞体系转型。对后代质量偏好更强的个体可能率先摆脱马尔萨斯体制，并采纳现代生育行为（Galor and Moav 2002）。为检验这一假说，我们考察了工业革命前两个世纪北欧学者家庭规模与人力资本的关系。我们采用基于学术发表的新方法衡量学者的人力资本。研究发现，在18世纪上半叶，发表数量高于中位数的学者从拥有更多兄弟姐妹转变为拥有更少兄弟姐妹。通过间接推断法估计演化增长模型参数，我们揭示了马尔萨斯约束最初如何导致高人力资本家庭生育更多后代，随后被内生的贝克尔约束（子女质量与数量权衡）所取代。研究结果支持对Galor and Moav（2002）理论的拓展，即马尔萨斯约束的衰退与18世纪人力资本积累密切相关。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag080.title: The Emergence of the Child Quantity-Quality Tradeoff - insights from early modern academics
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag080.title_zh: 儿童数量与质量权衡的出现——来自近代早期学术界的洞见

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag081.abstract: Ten years of idiosyncratic variation in school closure dates for all secondary schools in England are combined with administrative records of educational and criminal trajectories linked at the individual level to study the impact of the school schedule on the dynamics of youth crime. When school is not in session, students commit more property offences, more serious violent offences and fewer minor violent offences. Increased thefts, robberies and violent assaults drive these effects. This is novel evidence of strong multiple crime effects that arise from the protective factor of schooling and which affect not only the incidence of violence, but also its severity and its targets.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag081.abstract_zh: 本文利用英格兰所有中学十年间因特殊原因导致的停课日期变化，结合个体层面关联的教育与犯罪轨迹行政记录，研究学校作息安排对青少年犯罪动态的影响。当学校停课时，学生实施的财产犯罪、严重暴力犯罪增加，而轻微暴力犯罪减少。盗窃、抢劫和暴力袭击的增加是导致这些效应的主要原因。本研究首次提供了强有力的多重犯罪效应证据，这些效应源于学校教育的保护性因素，不仅影响暴力犯罪的发生率，还影响其严重程度及目标对象。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag081.title: Youth Crime and Delinquency In And Out Of School
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag081.title_zh: 青少年犯罪与逃学及在校行为

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag082.abstract: I combine newly digitized data on confidence votes, party switches, and tax returns of Italian MPs from 2001 to 2022 to study how tenure-dependent benefits influence politicians’ behaviour and government stability. Using a difference-in-discontinuities design, I find that a tenure requirement for parliamentary pensions introduced in 2008 increased confidence votes for the government, switches to majority parties, and legislative effort. Consistent with agency model predictions, the policy discouraged internal party defiance that could jeopardize reelection chances and pension eligibility for a second term. Tenure requirements increase government stability but also strengthen party control, with ambiguous effects on voters’ welfare.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag082.abstract_zh: 我整合了2001年至2022年意大利议员的信任投票、政党转换及纳税申报单的新数字化数据，研究任期相关福利如何影响政治人物行为及政府稳定性。通过断点回归设计，我发现2008年引入的议会养老金任期要求增加了对政府的信任投票、向多数党的转换以及立法努力。与委托代理模型预测一致，该政策抑制了可能危及连任机会及第二任期养老金资格的内部政党反抗。任期要求提升了政府稳定性，但也强化了政党控制，对选民福利产生模糊影响。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag082.title: The Impact of Tenure-Dependent Benefits on Government Stability
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag082.title_zh: 任期相关福利对政府稳定性的影响

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag084.abstract: We examine child mental health treatment surrounding three school milestones in Taiwan: Middle school entry, high stakes testing for high school entrance, and college entrance exams. Using age cutoffs for school entry, we compare August-born to September-born children since the August-born reach each milestone one year earlier. Comparing adjacent cohorts of children born in the same month yields similar estimates. We find that entry into middle school increases mental health prescribing of antidepressant, anti-anxiety, and antipsychotic medications. Use of psychiatric medications falls sharply following high-stakes tests. Effects are stronger in counties where parents and children have higher educational aspirations.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag084.abstract_zh: 我们考察了台湾地区三个学校关键节点前后的儿童心理健康治疗情况：初中入学、高中入学高利害考试以及大学入学考试。利用入学年龄截止日期，我们比较了八月出生与九月出生的儿童，因为八月出生的儿童在每个关键节点上比九月出生的儿童早一年。对同月出生的相邻队列进行比较，得出了相似的估计结果。我们发现，进入初中增加了抗抑郁药、抗焦虑药和抗精神病药等精神药物的处方量。高利害考试后，精神药物的使用量急剧下降。在父母和子女教育期望更高的县市，这种效应更为显著。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag084.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag084.title: School milestones impact child mental health in Taiwan
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag084.title_zh: 台湾学龄里程碑对儿童心理健康的影响

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag085.abstract: This paper develops a framework for monetary policy normalization in which liquidity conditions shape aggregate demand through a liquidity channel. The model implies that central bank balance sheet operations can stabilize demand even away from the zero lower bound, making reserves an independent policy instrument alongside interest rates. Optimal balance sheet size therefore depends not only on private reserve demand, but also on fiscal interactions and liquidity management. Following shocks that generate a liquidity trap, optimal policy expands reserves at the lower bound, initiates quantitative tightening before rate liftoff, and normalizes rates and reserves together, clarifying balance sheets’ stabilization role.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag085.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个货币政策正常化框架，其中流动性状况通过流动性渠道影响总需求。模型表明，即使远离零利率下限，央行资产负债表操作也能稳定需求，使准备金与利率并列为独立政策工具。因此，最优资产负债表规模不仅取决于私人准备金需求，还受财政互动与流动性管理的影响。在引发流动性陷阱的冲击发生后，最优政策在零利率下限扩大准备金，在加息启动前实施量化紧缩，并同步推进利率与准备金正常化，从而阐明资产负债表的稳定作用。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag085.title: Managing Monetary Policy Normalization

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag086.abstract: We study the relationship between interpersonal trust and political stability in democratic countries. Using an annual country-level panel dataset covering six decades, we find that recessions are more likely to cause political turnover in countries with lower levels of generalised interpersonal trust. The effect is present in democracies and not autocracies, for turnovers occurring through regular procedures and not coups, and during regularly scheduled election years. We find an analogous connection between trust and leader turnover during recessions when looking across sub-national regions in Europe, across counties in the United States, and across individuals in U.S. counties. Our results highlight the crucial role of generalised trust in ensuring political stability during times of economic turmoil.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag086.abstract_zh: 我们研究了民主国家中人际信任与政治稳定性之间的关系。利用涵盖六十年间的年度国家层面面板数据，我们发现，在普遍人际信任水平较低的国家，经济衰退更易引发政治更迭。这一效应存在于民主国家而非专制国家，体现在通过常规程序而非政变实现的更迭中，且发生在定期选举年份。在考察欧洲次国家区域、美国各县以及美国各县个体层面时，我们发现了经济衰退期间信任与领导人更迭之间的类似关联。我们的研究结果凸显了普遍信任在经济动荡时期确保政治稳定性的关键作用。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag086.title: Trust and Democracy: Political Stability in Times of Economic Crisis
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag086.title_zh: 信任与民主：经济危机时期的政治稳定

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag087.abstract: Dispute resolution in low-income countries is typically done by either a costly and slow formal court or an informal institution without state-sanctioned enforcement powers. Can access to justice be increased by combining the best aspects of formal and informal institutions? We evaluate the effects of “Village Courts” (VCs) in rural Bangladesh using a large-scale field experiment. The introduction of VCs more than doubles the share of disputes resolved in state-sanctioned courts, but an informal institution called shalish remains dominant. There is some substitution from shalish to VCs, but congestion in higher-level courts, village social dynamics, and economic activity remain unaffected.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag087.abstract_zh: 低收入国家的纠纷解决通常依赖成本高昂且效率低下的正式法院，或缺乏国家强制执行力保障的非正式机构。能否通过融合正式与非正式机构的最佳特性来提升司法可及性？我们通过一项大规模实地实验，评估了孟加拉国农村地区"村级法院"（VCs）的实施效果。村级法院的引入使国家认可法院解决的纠纷比例提升了一倍以上，但名为"沙利什"的非正式机构仍占据主导地位。虽然存在从沙利什向村级法院的部分替代效应，但上级法院的案件积压、村庄社会动态及经济活动均未受到显著影响。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag087.title: Formalizing Dispute Resolution: Effects of Village Courts in Bangladesh
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag087.title_zh: 正式化争端解决：孟加拉国村级法庭的影响

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag088.abstract: Restrictive immigration policies can force organisations to alter their workforce composition, with unclear effects on organisational performance. We study the effects of the 2016 Brexit referendum, which reduced the share of EU-nationality nurses in English hospitals. Using administrative patient-level data and a continuous difference-in-differences design, exploiting hospitals’ pre-referendum exposure, we estimate the causal impact of a negative labour supply shock on care quality. Hospitals with higher pre-referendum EU nurse shares experienced higher post-referendum emergency patient mortality, equivalent to 1,238 additional deaths annually in the three years after the referendum. Consistent with theoretical predictions, hospitals responded to labour shortages by relaxing hiring standards: foreign nurses recruited after the referendum were appointed to lower salary grades, suggesting lower skills and experience.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag088.abstract_zh: 限制性移民政策可能迫使组织改变其劳动力构成，但对组织绩效的影响尚不明确。我们研究了2016年英国脱欧公投的影响，该公投减少了英国医院中欧盟籍护士的比例。利用行政层面的患者数据以及连续双重差分设计，通过分析医院在公投前的暴露程度，我们估算了负面劳动力供给冲击对护理质量的因果影响。公投前欧盟护士比例较高的医院，在公投后急诊患者死亡率更高，相当于公投后三年内每年额外增加1238例死亡。与理论预测一致，医院通过放宽招聘标准来应对劳动力短缺：公投后招聘的外籍护士被分配到较低的薪资等级，这表明其技能和经验较低。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag088.title: Immigration, Workforce Composition, and Organisational Performance: The Effect of Brexit on NHS Hospital Quality
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag088.title_zh: 移民、劳动力构成与组织绩效：英国脱欧对NHS医院质量的影响

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag089.abstract: We construct a continuous-time, monetary model with frictional goods and labour markets to revisit the long-run relationship between inflation and unemployment. By endogenising the value of consumers’ outside options and market power in accordance with standard consumer search theory, we generate novel predictions for the slope of the long-run Phillips curve, optimal monetary policy, and outcomes at the frictionless limit. The relationship between inflation and unemployment is non-monotone and, at low inflation rates, an increase in inflation reduces unemployment. The Friedman rule is suboptimal when firms’ average bargaining power across markets is low. Markups and markdowns vanish as frictions disappear.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag089.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含商品市场与劳动力市场摩擦的连续时间货币模型，重新审视通胀与失业之间的长期关系。通过依据标准消费者搜寻理论内生化消费者外部选择价值与市场势力，我们为长期菲利普斯曲线的斜率、最优货币政策以及无摩擦极限下的均衡结果提出了新的理论预测。通胀与失业之间的关系呈现非单调特征：在低通胀水平下，通胀上升会降低失业率。当企业在各市场的平均议价能力较低时，弗里德曼规则并非最优。随着摩擦消失，加成率与折价率趋于零。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag089.title: Inflation and Unemployment in the Long Run Revisited
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag089.title_zh: 长期视角下通货膨胀与失业关系的再探讨

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag090.abstract: We study how an agent evaluates an action when she observes a sample of its outcomes rather than its outcome-generating distribution. We propose a model where the agent’s estimated value for the action is a convex combination of her average utility over the sample outcomes and an ex ante utility reflecting her prior information. The weight put on the average utility increases with sample size, reflecting the inferential advantages of larger samples. The model nests certain forms of Bayesian behaviour and, more generally, identifies parameters quantifying departures from Bayesian updating, such as conservatism and the Law of Small Numbers.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag090.abstract_zh: 本文研究当代理人观察到某行动的结果样本而非其结果生成分布时，如何评估该行动。我们提出一个模型，其中代理人对该行动的估计价值是样本结果平均效用与反映其先验信息的事前效用的凸组合。平均效用的权重随样本量增加而增加，这反映了更大样本的推断优势。该模型涵盖了某些形式的贝叶斯行为，并更一般地识别出量化偏离贝叶斯更新的参数，例如保守主义和小数定律。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag090.title: Learning by Convex Combination,

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag091.abstract: Social norms that are costly for individuals are held in place because of social pressure to conform. Historical examples include duelling in Europe and footbinding in China; contemporary examples include female genital cutting and wasteful consumption. Such norms exhibit varied dynamics. Some collapse after staying unchanged for centuries, while others erode gradually. Still others escalate gradually before collapsing. This paper develops a theoretical framework that explains these patterns in terms of different forces of social influence and lends itself to empirical estimation. The analysis can guide the design of policies aimed at mitigating or eliminating costly norms, and shows that some interventions can be counterproductive.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag091.abstract_zh: 对个体而言代价高昂的社会规范之所以得以维系，是因为存在要求遵从的社会压力。历史上的例子包括欧洲的决斗和中国的缠足；当代的例子则包括女性割礼和浪费性消费。此类规范呈现出不同的演变动态：有些在历经数百年不变后突然瓦解，有些则逐渐消解，还有些在崩溃前会逐步升级。本文构建了一个理论框架，通过不同的社会影响力机制解释这些模式，并适用于实证估计。该分析可为旨在减轻或消除代价高昂规范的政策设计提供指导，同时表明某些干预措施可能适得其反。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag091.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag091.title: The dynamics of costly norms

doi:10.1093/ej/ueag094.abstract: Climate change is predicted to have large and heterogeneous impacts on agricultural yields. I use a model of production, consumption, and trade of 24 crops between 271 regions across sub-Saharan Africa to simulate the effects of climate change and explore how trade mediates these effects. I estimate a continent-wide welfare loss equivalent to 2.4% of GDP using median yield changes across 5 climate models, with country-level losses up to 60% of GDP in the worst model. The continent-wide welfare loss is 19% smaller with lower trade costs and over 7 times larger if trade flows are capped at current levels.
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag094.abstract_zh: 气候变化预计将对农业产量产生巨大且异质性的影响。本文利用一个涵盖撒哈拉以南非洲271个地区、24种作物生产、消费与贸易的模型，模拟气候变化的影响，并探讨贸易如何调节这些效应。基于5个气候模型的中位产量变化，我估算出全大陆福利损失相当于GDP的2.4%，而在最差模型下，国家层面的损失高达GDP的60%。当贸易成本较低时，全大陆福利损失减少19%；若贸易流量被限制在当前水平，损失则扩大7倍以上。
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag094.title: Agricultural trade and adaptation to climate change in sub-Saharan Africa
doi:10.1093/ej/ueag094.title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的农业贸易与气候变化适应

doi:10.1093/erae/jbag004.abstract: We examine the economic impact of regulating new genomic techniques on investment decisions in the EU. Using a real options model, we compare five major regulatory options (nine including sub-options) with the status quo and analyse their effects on plant breeders’ investments. Using the current authorization process for genetically modified organisms for NGTs presents a high investment barrier for companies. The findings indicate that all alternative five options offer opportunities to reduce investment hurdles, depending on the design of the authorization process. Our model and its calibration serve as an example for further advancing the application of real options for regulatory policy analysis.
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag004.abstract_zh: 我们研究了欧盟对新基因组技术进行监管对投资决策的经济影响。通过使用实物期权模型，我们比较了五种主要监管方案（含子方案共九种）与现状的差异，并分析了它们对植物育种者投资的影响。将当前转基因生物授权流程应用于新基因组技术，对企业构成了较高的投资门槛。研究结果表明，所有五种替代方案均提供了降低投资障碍的机会，具体效果取决于授权流程的设计。我们的模型及其校准为推进实物期权在监管政策分析中的应用提供了范例。
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag004.title: Comparing the effects of regulating new genomic techniques on investment decisions in the European Union
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag004.title_zh: 比较欧盟监管新基因组技术对投资决策的影响

doi:10.1093/erae/jbag005.abstract: Market integration is critical for food security in developing economies facing socio-political instability. Using weekly price data from ninety-seven Nigerian markets, this study investigates how violent conflict influences price dynamics between market pairs. Results reveal that frequent violent events have limited short-term effects on price transmission, and changes in conflict intensity do not significantly disrupt price adjustments. Markets with stronger trade connections demonstrate greater resilience by leveraging alternative trade routes. These findings highlight the role of market connectivity in maintaining trade efficiency, suggesting that policies that enhance market networks can strengthen resilience and improve food security.
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag005.abstract_zh: 市场整合对于面临社会政治动荡的发展中经济体的粮食安全至关重要。本研究利用尼日利亚97个市场的周度价格数据，考察暴力冲突如何影响市场对之间的价格动态。结果显示，频繁的暴力事件对价格传导的短期影响有限，冲突强度的变化并未显著干扰价格调整。贸易联系较强的市场通过利用替代贸易路线展现出更强的韧性。这些发现凸显了市场连通性在维持贸易效率中的作用，表明增强市场网络的政策能够强化韧性并改善粮食安全。
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag005.title: Market integration and the impact of violence on trade networks: Evidence from Nigeria
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag005.title_zh: 市场整合与暴力对贸易网络的影响：来自尼日利亚的证据

doi:10.1093/erae/jbag006.abstract: Agent-based models are valuable tools for agricultural policy evaluation. They can represent the heterogeneity of farmers and farmer interactions and are especially useful when behavioural and social factors are integrated to represent farmers’ decision-making. We assess the potential of agent-based models by conducting a review of forty-eight agent-based models developed for European agriculture and a survey with twenty-six modellers and twenty-four policy stakeholders. We find that while agent-based models provide nuanced representations of farmers’ decision-making processes, there is a gap between what is currently implemented in models, what modellers consider important and what policymakers expect.
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag006.abstract_zh: 基于智能体的模型是农业政策评估的重要工具。这类模型能够刻画农户的异质性及其互动关系，尤其在整合行为与社会因素以表征农户决策过程时具有独特价值。我们通过梳理48个针对欧洲农业开发的智能体模型，并对26位建模者及24位政策利益相关方开展问卷调查，评估了此类模型的潜力。研究发现：尽管智能体模型能细致呈现农户决策过程，但当前模型的实际应用、建模者认为重要的要素与政策制定者的预期之间仍存在显著差距。
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag006.title: Behavioural and social factors in farm-level agent-based models for European agricultural policy evaluations
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag006.title_zh: 欧洲农业政策评估中农场层面基于主体模型的行为与社会因素

doi:10.1093/erae/jbag007.abstract: Agriculture accounts for 11 per cent of EU greenhouse gas emissions, yet sectoral emissions have stagnated over the past two decades. This paper evaluates carbon pricing in EU agriculture by integrating stochastic yield variability into the CAPRI model. We assess how different carbon price levels affect emissions and outcome uncertainty. Results show that carbon pricing reduces emissions, and higher price levels are associated with lower uncertainty in policy outcomes. While expected results remain similar to deterministic simulations, stochastic modeling reveals greater regional and sectoral heterogeneity. These findings highlight the importance of accounting for production risk when designing agricultural climate policies.
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag007.abstract_zh: 农业占欧盟温室气体排放的11%，但过去二十年间该行业排放量停滞不前。本文通过将随机产量波动纳入CAPRI模型，评估了欧盟农业碳定价政策。我们分析了不同碳价水平对排放量及结果不确定性的影响。研究表明，碳定价能够减少排放，且更高的碳价水平与更低的政策结果不确定性相关。尽管预期结果与确定性模拟相似，但随机模型揭示了更大的区域和行业异质性。这些发现凸显了在制定农业气候政策时考虑生产风险的重要性。
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag007.title: Beyond determinism: Accounting for weather variability in the carbon pricing debate for EU agriculture
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag007.title_zh: 超越决定论：欧盟农业碳定价辩论中天气变率的考量

doi:10.1093/erae/jbag008.abstract: The European Union Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) seeks to reduce deforestation by restricting market access to deforestation-embodied soy products in the EU market. The main concern is that such restrictions could shift the soy trade to unregulated non-EU markets. To shed light on this issue, we employ a gravity model, treating the EUDR compliance costs as additional trade costs for exports to the EU. We find that stricter compliance costs reallocate soy exports from South America toward non-EU markets, mainly China, divert the EU imports toward North America, and increase the prices of soy faced by EU soy users. Under the counterfactual scenario in which South America does not comply with the regulation, EU consumers face even larger price increases, while South American countries experience minimal terms-of-trade losses. Our analysis suggests that trade reallocation to an unregulated market could potentially dilute the impact of the EUDR, making it less effective in directly reducing deforestation linked to soy production.
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag008.abstract_zh: 欧盟毁林法规（EUDR）旨在通过限制含有毁林成分的大豆产品进入欧盟市场来减少森林砍伐。主要担忧在于此类限制可能导致大豆贸易转向不受监管的非欧盟市场。为阐明这一问题，我们采用引力模型，将EUDR合规成本视为对欧盟出口的额外贸易成本。研究发现：更严格的合规成本促使南美大豆出口向非欧盟市场（主要是中国）转移，导致欧盟进口转向北美市场，并推高欧盟大豆用户面临的价格。在反事实情景中，若南美不遵守该法规，欧盟消费者将面临更大的价格上涨，而南美国家仅遭受微小的贸易条件损失。我们的分析表明，贸易向未受监管市场的重新配置可能削弱EUDR的效果，使其在直接减少与大豆生产相关的毁林方面效力降低。
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag008.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag008.title: Costly regulation, minimal results: The EU’s deforestation regulation effect on global soy trade
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag008.title_zh: 高成本监管，低效成果：欧盟毁林法规对全球大豆贸易的影响

doi:10.1093/erae/jbag010.abstract: We examine how pesticide expenditure relates to the probability distribution of yield and revenue per hectare in apple production in northern Italy. Using a flexible moment-based approach, we find that pesticide expenditure is negatively associated with downside risk in yield and revenue, whereas late frosts are positively associated with downside risk in yield. Sensitivity analyses show that mean-equation estimates are robust to unobserved confounders, while negative semi-variance models are less robust overall. Only the pesticide–expected outcome relationship appears plausibly causal. Therefore, conclusions about pesticides as risk-increasing or risk-decreasing inputs should be made with caution.
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag010.abstract_zh: 本文考察了意大利北部苹果生产中农药支出与每公顷产量及收益概率分布之间的关系。采用灵活的基于矩的方法，我们发现农药支出与产量和收益的下行风险呈负相关，而晚霜则与产量的下行风险呈正相关。敏感性分析表明，均值方程估计对未观测到的混杂因素具有稳健性，而负半方差模型整体稳健性较弱。只有农药与预期结果之间的关系似乎具有合理的因果性。因此，关于农药作为风险增加或风险减少投入的结论应谨慎得出。
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag010.title: The relationship between pesticides and risk in apple production
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag010.title_zh: 农药与苹果生产风险的关系

doi:10.1093/erae/jbag011.abstract: Using matched employer–employee data, we examine how workforce knowledge characteristics relate to firm productivity in the equine sector. Using panel data on Swedish equine firms from 2010 to 2022, we construct measures of workforce composition, including occupation-specific education, accumulated work experience and knowledge diversity. The results show that access to occupation-specific human capital is positively associated with productivity, with substantial heterogeneity across firms. Knowledge effects are stronger among firms specializing in horse racing than in breeding, highlighting differences in the role of human capital across production orientations. The findings have implications for policy and firms’ investment decisions.
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag011.abstract_zh: 利用匹配的雇主-雇员数据，我们研究了马业部门劳动力知识特征与企业生产率之间的关系。基于2010年至2022年瑞典马业企业的面板数据，我们构建了劳动力构成指标，包括职业特定教育、累积工作经验及知识多样性。结果表明，职业特定人力资本的获取与生产率呈正相关，且企业间存在显著异质性。相较于育种企业，赛马专营企业的知识效应更为显著，凸显了人力资本在不同生产导向中的差异化作用。该发现对政策制定及企业投资决策具有启示意义。
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag011.title: The role of specialized knowledge and ‘know-how’ for firm productivity: Evidence from the equine sector
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag011.title_zh: 专业化知识与“诀窍”对企业生产率的作用：来自马业部门的证据

doi:10.1093/erae/jbag012.abstract: We analyze alternative agricultural carbon border adjustment mechanism (CBAM) designs across three dimensions (participating countries, emission intensity, and carbon price). We find that an agricultural CBAM by the European Union (or an expanded climate club consisting of the EU and other countries) has minor global agricultural GHG emission implications but protects the most emission intensive domestic production. Nevertheless, having a larger climate club imposing CBAM tariffs and applying exporters’ emission intensities are more effective in lowering global emissions. Compared to national carbon prices, harmonized carbon prices at climate club level can reduce trade disruptions while attaining similar emission reduction outcomes.
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag012.abstract_zh: 我们从三个维度（参与国、排放强度与碳价格）分析了农业碳边境调节机制（CBAM）的替代设计方案。研究发现，欧盟（或由欧盟及其他国家组成的扩大版气候俱乐部）实施的农业CBAM对全球农业温室气体排放影响较小，但能有效保护国内排放强度最高的生产活动。然而，由更大规模的气候俱乐部征收CBAM关税并采用出口国排放强度的方案，在降低全球排放方面更为有效。相较于各国自主设定的碳价格，在气候俱乐部层面统一碳价格既能减少贸易扭曲，又能实现相近的减排效果。
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag012.title: Alternative Agricultural Carbon Border Adjustment and Climate Club Designs : a Quantitative Assessment
doi:10.1093/erae/jbag012.title_zh: 替代性农业碳边境调节与气候俱乐部设计：一项量化评估

doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag023.abstract: States sometimes back rebellions abroad to signal resolve. We study this reputation-building logic in international relations, focusing on co-ethnic links between countries as an objective source of variation in a state‚s incentives to demonstrate resolve. We formally derive two interconnected predictions from the mechanism: (a) a state is more likely to endorse the uprising of a foreign group when facing a larger audience, resulting in (b) greater political inclusion for the group. We build a comprehensive panel dataset of co-ethnic rebellion sponsorship, and find evidence consistent with both predictions.
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag023.abstract_zh: 国家有时会支持国外的叛乱以展示其决心。我们研究国际关系中的这种声誉构建逻辑，重点关注国家间基于同族裔联系这一客观因素，如何影响国家展示决心的动机。我们通过形式化推导得出两个相互关联的预测：（a）当面对更广泛的受众时，国家更可能支持外国群体的起义，从而（b）该群体获得更大的政治包容性。我们构建了关于同族裔叛乱赞助的全面面板数据集，并发现了与这两个预测一致的证据。
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag023.journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag023.title: Building Reputation: State-Sponsored Rebellions and Transnational Identities,
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag023.title_zh: 构建声誉：国家支持的叛乱与跨国身份

doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag025.abstract: This paper develops a dynamic equilibrium model of crime with heterogeneous agents and human capital accumulation. Agents decide whether to commit crimes by comparing potential gains with the expected punishment. Public security policies are defined as pairs of a size of the police force and an average sentence length. We propose a micro-founded public security technology linking expenditures on police to the probability of apprehension of a criminal. We illustrate the relevance of this theoretical framework by using an estimated version of the model using US data to (i) characterize the socially optimal public security policy; (ii) explore potential complementarities across public security and educational policies; and (iii) show that comparative statics exercises often lead, under reasonable parameter values, to recommendations that differ from those obtained in a global optimality analysis. These results highlight the relevance of equilibrium considerations in the economic analysis of crime. The paper gives a methodological first step towards building a manageable model of crime that can bring together different pieces of evidence—and equilibrium considerations—when evaluating the trade-offs across policy alternatives.
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag025.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个包含异质性主体与人力资本积累的动态均衡犯罪模型。行为人通过比较潜在收益与预期惩罚来决定是否实施犯罪。公共安全政策被定义为警力规模与平均刑期长度的组合。我们提出了一种基于微观基础的公共安全技术，将警务支出与罪犯被捕概率相关联。通过使用美国数据对模型进行参数估计，我们阐明了该理论框架的适用性，具体用于：（i）刻画社会最优公共安全政策；（ii）探索公共安全政策与教育政策之间的潜在互补性；（iii）证明在合理参数取值下，比较静态分析得出的政策建议往往与全局最优性分析结果存在差异。这些结论凸显了均衡考量在犯罪经济学分析中的重要性。本文为构建一个可操作的犯罪模型提供了方法论基础，该模型能够在评估不同政策方案的权衡时，整合多元实证证据与均衡分析视角。
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag025.journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag025.title: Socially Optimal Crime and Punishment
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag025.title_zh: 社会最优的犯罪与惩罚

doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag026.abstract: Health matters for marital outcomes, but health information may remain concealed until marriage. Our matching model, which incorporates socioeconomic status (SES) and health, predicts that the removal of health information should shift sorting toward SES, potentially reducing child health and welfare, particularly for those with low SES. We empirically examine this in the context of rural China, following the repeal of compulsory premarital health examinations (PHE). Our difference-in-differences estimation, which compares provinces with varying levels of exposure based on pre-policy PHE rates, confirms a larger shift in sorting patterns in provinces with higher treatment intensity. The decrease in health-based assortative matching negatively affects child health outcomes, which is followed by a decline in postmarital subjective well-being. Women and low-SES individuals experience larger losses than their counterparts within the same highly affected provinces, highlighting persistent gender and socioeconomic disparities.
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag026.abstract_zh: 健康对婚姻结果至关重要，但健康信息可能在婚前仍处于隐匿状态。我们的匹配模型纳入了社会经济地位（SES）与健康因素，预测健康信息的消除将促使婚配模式转向以SES为基础，这可能降低儿童健康与福利水平，尤其对低SES群体影响显著。我们以中国农村地区为背景，在强制婚前健康检查（PHE）制度取消后展开实证研究。基于政策实施前各省PHE覆盖率差异，采用双重差分法比较不同暴露程度的省份，证实治疗强度较高的省份婚配模式转变幅度更大。基于健康指标的选型匹配减少对儿童健康结果产生负面影响，进而导致婚后主观幸福感下降。在同一高影响省份内，女性和低SES群体相比其他群体遭受更大损失，凸显了持续存在的性别与社会经济不平等。
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag026.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag026.journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag026.title: Ignorance is Whose Bliss: The Repeal of Compulsory Premarital Health Examinations and Marital Outcomes in Rural China
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag026.title_zh: 无知是谁的福气：中国农村强制婚前体检的废除与婚姻结果

doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag027.abstract: At the aggregate level, the observation that deviations from purchasing power parity (PPP) are too persistent to be accounted for solely by nominal rigidities has long been a puzzle (Rogoff 1996). In addition, microeconomic evidence suggests that deviations from the law of one price (LOP) are less persistent than PPP deviations. To reconcile these two empirical anomalies, we incorporate the behavioral inattention approach of Gabaix (2014) into a two-country sticky-price model. Our model shows that firms’ behavioral inattention to the aggregate component of real marginal costs generates an endogenous dependence of LOP deviations on PPP deviations. We find strong supporting evidence for this particular formulation of behavioral inattention. Calibrating our model with the estimated degree of attention, we show that our model can fully account for the two empirical anomalies. PPP deviations are more than twice as persistent as those implied by nominal rigidities alone, while the persistence of LOP deviations is about two-thirds that of PPP deviations.
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag027.abstract_zh: 在总体层面，购买力平价偏离的持续性远超名义刚性所能解释的范围，这一现象长期以来被视为一个谜题（Rogoff 1996）。此外，微观经济证据表明，一价定律偏离的持续性低于购买力平价偏离。为调和这两个实证异常，我们将Gabaix（2014）的行为疏忽方法引入两国粘性价格模型。模型表明，企业对实际边际成本中总体成分的行为疏忽，会内生地导致一价定律偏离对购买力平价偏离的依赖。我们找到了支持这一特定行为疏忽公式的有力证据。通过使用估计的注意力程度校准模型，我们证明该模型能够完全解释这两个实证异常：购买力平价偏离的持续性比仅由名义刚性所隐含的持续性高出两倍以上，而一价定律偏离的持续性约为购买力平价偏离的三分之二。
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag027.journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag027.title: A Behavioral Explanation for the Puzzling Persistence of the Aggregate Real Exchange Rate
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag027.title_zh: 实际汇率持续之谜的行为解释

doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag028.abstract: This paper studies electoral competition over redistributive taxation between a safe incumbent and a risky opponent. With reference-dependent preferences, economically disappointed voters become risk lovers, and hence are attracted by the more risky candidate. We show that the equilibrium can display policy divergence: the intrinsically more risky candidate proposes lower taxes and is supported by a coalition of very rich and very disappointed voters, while the safe candidate proposes higher taxes. This can explain why right-wing populist parties are often supported by economically dissatisfied voters and yet they run on policy platforms of low redistribution.
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag028.abstract_zh: 本文研究安全在任者与风险挑战者之间围绕再分配税收的选举竞争。在参照依赖偏好下，经济上失望的选民会变成风险偏好者，因而更倾向于支持风险较高的候选人。我们证明，均衡状态可能呈现政策分化：内在风险较高的候选人提出较低税率，并得到由极富裕和极失望选民组成的联盟支持，而安全候选人则提出较高税率。这可以解释为何右翼民粹主义政党常获得经济不满选民的支持，却推行低再分配的政策纲领。
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag028.journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag028.title: The Political Implications of Reference-Dependent Preferences,
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag028.title_zh: 参考依赖偏好的政治含义

doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag029.abstract: We examine the rise of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) in wartime China. Using a spatial regression discontinuity design and several measures as proxies for the rise of the Party during the Sino-Japanese War (middle- to upper-rank party cadres, grassroots party organization, and guerrilla bases), we find that it grew significantly more in counties occupied by the Japanese Army. However, despite its popularity before the war, the same markers were not statistically significant at that time. We identify two primary channels behind the political ascendancy of the CCP. First, the communists took advantage of the militarily weaker “puppet troops” in charge of administering the loosely held occupied areas. Second, support for the CCP was fueled by a strong anti-Japanese sentiment spurred by war suffering, using civilian casualties and rape cases as proxies for the harm inflicted. Finally, the CCP’s wartime influence persisted after the war: former Japanese Occupied Areas exhibited a significantly higher density of party membership between 1950 and 1980.
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag029.abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国共产党在战时中国的崛起。利用空间断点回归设计，并以多项指标（中高级党员干部、基层党组织及游击根据地）作为党在抗日战争期间崛起的代理变量，我们发现党在日军占领的县域中发展显著更快。然而，尽管战前该党已具声望，但同一指标在战前并不具有统计显著性。我们识别出中共政治崛起的两个主要渠道：首先，共产党利用了负责管理松散占领区的军事上较弱的“伪军”；其次，以平民伤亡和强奸案件作为战争伤害的代理变量，由战争苦难激发的强烈抗日情绪推动了民众对中共的支持。最后，中共的战时影响力在战后持续存在：1950年至1980年间，原日军占领区的党员密度显著更高。

doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag030.abstract: We study the interaction between monetary policy and labor supply decisions at the household level. We uncover evidence of heterogeneous responses and a strong countercyclicality of hours worked in the left tail of the income distribution following a monetary policy shock in the US. Specifically, while aggregate hours and labor earnings decline after a monetary tightening, individuals at the bottom of the income distribution increase their hours worked. Moreover, this positive labor supply response is quantitatively significant, substantially dampening the decline in aggregate hours worked. We show that the empirical patterns are consistent with a standard one-asset HANK model featuring endogenous labor supply. The model reveals that strong income effects at the bottom of the distribution can account for the observed countercyclical labor responses, highlighting how labor supply adjustments act as an additional margin through which households smooth consumption. Comparing this specification to a model with a homogeneous labor supply, we find that labor supply heterogeneity reduces the aggregate MPC and attenuates the transmission of monetary policy through aggregate demand. As a result, the output cost of disinflation is lower in economies where poorer households can flexibly adjust their labor effort, easing the trade-off faced by the central bank.
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag030.abstract_zh: 本文研究了货币政策与家庭层面劳动供给决策之间的相互作用。我们发现了美国货币政策冲击后劳动供给的异质性反应证据，以及收入分布左尾工作时长的强逆周期性特征。具体而言，当货币紧缩导致总工时和劳动收入下降时，收入分布底层的个体反而增加了工作时长。此外，这种正向劳动供给反应在数量上具有显著性，显著缓解了总工时的下降幅度。我们证明，这些实证特征与包含内生劳动供给的标准单资产HANK模型一致。模型揭示，收入分布底层的强收入效应可以解释所观察到的逆周期劳动反应，凸显了劳动供给调整作为家庭平滑消费的额外渠道。将该设定与同质劳动供给模型对比发现，劳动供给异质性降低了总边际消费倾向，并削弱了货币政策通过总需求的传导效应。因此，在贫困家庭能灵活调整劳动投入的经济体中，通胀抑制的产出成本更低，从而缓解了央行面临的权衡取舍。
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag030.journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag030.title: A Tail of Labor Supply and a Tale of Monetary Policy
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag030.title_zh: 劳动供给的尾部与货币政策的故事

doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag031.abstract: We study the feasibility of opening new mines in ethnically diverse countries without escalating the risk of conflict. We propose a theoretical model in which ethnic groups can organize themselves to fight at the national or the local level. Our model yields two key insights. First, peace cannot be guaranteed in the presence of ethnic segregation and spatial resource inequality. Second, once the peace-maximizing policies are implemented, local conflict risks depend on local resource rents and local ethnic groups as well as the country’s entire ethnic and mining geography. We validate key concepts from our model using granular spatial data from Sierra Leone and the rest of sub-Saharan Africa and employing a shift-share identification strategy. We then apply these concepts to simulate the potential impact of planned mining projects in Sierra Leone and confirm that projects in the right locations can promote peace. We offer policy recommendations for making the mining industry a facilitator of peace and prosperity.
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag031.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在多民族国家中开设新矿而不加剧冲突风险的可行性。我们构建了一个理论模型，其中各民族群体可在国家或地方层面组织起来进行斗争。该模型得出两个关键结论：第一，在存在民族隔离与空间资源不平等的情况下，无法保障和平；第二，一旦实施最大化和平的政策，地方冲突风险不仅取决于地方资源租金和地方民族群体，还取决于整个国家的民族与矿业地理格局。我们利用塞拉利昂及撒哈拉以南非洲其他地区的精细空间数据，并采用份额转移识别策略，验证了模型中的核心概念。随后，我们运用这些概念模拟了塞拉利昂计划中采矿项目的潜在影响，证实选址得当的项目能够促进和平。最后，我们提出政策建议，旨在使采矿业成为和平与繁荣的推动者。
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag031.journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag031.title: Mining for Peace,

doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag032.abstract: Most comparative analyses explaining the 1970s and 1990s/2000s inflation performance, focusing on good/bad policy versus good/bad luck, assume that price and wage-setting institutions remained constant. While studies acknowledge institutional changes, they typically overlook sources of intrinsic persistence of wage and price inflation. This paper contributes to this ongoing debate by revisiting the U.S. business cycle. We account for time variations in pricing and wage-setting behavior due to institutional changes and for switches in inflation-intrinsic persistence, which we formally represent as changes in the shape of the hazard function. By analyzing how policy and shocks interact within different institutional settings in our model economy, we trace the existing contrasting evidence back to an identification problem that biases regime estimates and leads to misleading interpretations. Once we account for persistence switches, the empirical outcomes strongly support, but refine, the luck interpretation over the policy interpretation. The 1970s were characterized not only by larger shocks but also by more pronounced transmission mechanisms of supply shocks, driven by the price- and wage-setting institutions of the time. Additionally, the data suggest to reinterpret the monetary regimes more in line with the central bankers’ view and show that structural changes in price and wage adjustments play essential and opposite roles in the Great Inflation. Finally, our analysis yields two important general findings. First, it emphasizes the critical role that changes in price and wage-setting institutions play in influencing the propagation of shocks. Second, it validates the use of a generalized time-dependent rule to represent nominal rigidities.
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag032.abstract_zh: 大多数比较分析在解释1970年代与1990年代/2000年代的通胀表现时，聚焦于政策优劣与运气好坏之争，均假设价格与工资设定制度保持不变。尽管部分研究承认制度变迁的存在，但通常忽略了工资与价格通胀内在持续性的根源。本文通过重新审视美国商业周期，为这一持续争论做出贡献。我们考虑了因制度变迁导致的定价与工资设定行为的时间变化，以及通胀内在持续性的转变——这种转变在形式上表现为风险函数形态的变化。通过分析政策与冲击在我们模型经济中不同制度环境下的交互作用，我们将现有相互矛盾的证据追溯至一个识别问题：该问题导致对制度区间的估计产生偏差，并引发误导性解读。一旦我们纳入持续性转变因素，实证结果便强烈支持（但修正了）运气解释优于政策解释的结论。1970年代不仅面临更大的冲击，更因当时的价格与工资设定制度，导致供给冲击的传导机制更为显著。此外，数据表明应重新解读货币制度，使其更符合央行官员的视角，并揭示价格与工资调整的结构性变化在大通胀中扮演了关键且对立的作用。最后，我们的分析得出两项重要的一般性结论：第一，强调价格与工资设定制度变迁在影响冲击传导中的关键作用；第二，验证了使用广义时间依赖规则来表征名义刚性的有效性。
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag032.journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag032.title: The U.S. Economic Dynamics and Inflation Persistence: A Regime-Switching Perspective
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag032.title_zh: 美国经济动态与通胀持续性：基于体制转换视角

doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag033.abstract: We introduce a Generalized Nested Logit model of demand for bundles that can be estimated sequentially, eliminating the challenge of dimensionality due to large choice sets. We use it to investigate quantity discounts for carbonated soft drinks by simulating a counterfactual with linear pricing. The prices of small-volume UPCs (<2L) decrease by −29.2% while those of large-volume UPCs (≥2L) increase by +16.8%. Purchased quantities decrease by −19.5% and industry profit by −6.3%. Consumer surplus however reduces only moderately, suggesting that a ban on quantity discounts on sugary drinks may be a simple and effective policy to limit added sugar intake. Our calculations confirm that such a ban would be as effective as a sugar tax of 1.5/oz of added sugar and reduce added sugar intake by −17.4%. A nested logit model that mistakenly ignores joint purchases of UPCs within shopping trips would instead simulate a reduction in added sugar intake of only −3.9%.
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag033.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种广义嵌套Logit需求模型，用于估计捆绑商品的需求，该模型可通过序贯估计方法解决因选择集过大带来的维度问题。我们利用该模型研究碳酸饮料的数量折扣问题，通过模拟线性定价的反事实情景发现：小容量UPC（<2升）价格下降29.2%，而大容量UPC（≥2升）价格上涨16.8%。购买量减少19.5%，行业利润下降6.3%，但消费者剩余仅温和下降，这表明禁止含糖饮料的数量折扣可能是限制添加糖摄入的简单有效政策。我们的计算证实，该禁令的效果相当于对每盎司添加糖征收1.5美分的糖税，可使添加糖摄入量减少17.4%。若错误采用忽略购物行程中UPC联合购买的嵌套Logit模型，则模拟得出的添加糖摄入量降幅仅为3.9%。
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag033.journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag033.title: An Empirical Model of Quantity Discounts with Large Choice Sets
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag033.title_zh: 大选择集下数量折扣的实证模型

doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag034.abstract: We study how job mobility, firms, and firm-ladder climbing can shape immigrants’ labor market success. Our context is the mass migration of former Soviet Union Jews to Israel during the 1990s. Once in Israel, these immigrants faced none of the legal barriers that are typically posed by migration regulations around the world, offering a unique backdrop to study undistorted immigrants’ job mobility and resulting unconstrained assimilation. Rich administrative data allows us to follow immigrants for up to three decades after arrival. Immigrants experienced large initial wage gaps relative to natives—57% for men and 47% for women—and 12%–20% of these gaps are explained by differential sorting across firms and differential pay-setting within firms. The wage gap closes only after 27–29 years, and much of this convergence is driven by immigrants’ differential climbing of the firm ladder: immigrants are more mobile and experience faster upward moves, even in the long term. As such, firm-to-firm mobility is a key driver of these immigrants’ long-run prosperity. Lastly, we quantify a previously undocumented job utility gap when accounting for non-wage amenities. Upon arrival, immigrants’ non-pay amenities were lower by 0.38 (men) and 0.94 (women) native standard deviations. As such, amenities exacerbate immigrant-native disparities based on pay alone.
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag034.abstract_zh: 本文研究职业流动性、企业以及企业阶梯攀升如何影响移民在劳动力市场中的成功。我们的研究背景是20世纪90年代前苏联犹太人向以色列的大规模移民。抵达以色列后，这些移民未面临全球移民法规通常设置的法律障碍，这为研究不受扭曲的移民职业流动性及其导致的无约束同化提供了独特背景。丰富的行政数据使我们能够追踪移民抵达后长达三十年的情况。移民最初面临相对于本地人的巨大工资差距——男性为57%，女性为47%——其中12%至20%的差距可由企业在不同群体间的差异化配置以及企业内部差异化薪酬设定解释。工资差距需27至29年才能弥合，而这一趋同过程很大程度上源于移民在企业阶梯上的差异化攀升：移民流动性更强，且即使在长期内也能实现更快的向上流动。因此，企业间流动性是这些移民长期经济繁荣的关键驱动力。最后，我们在考虑非工资福利后，量化了此前未被记录的职位效用差距。抵达时，移民的非薪酬福利比本地人低0.38（男性）和0.94（女性）个标准差。因此，福利因素加剧了仅基于薪酬的移民与本地人之间的差距。
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag034.journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag034.title: The Role of Firms and Job Mobility in the Assimilation of Immigrants: Former Soviet Union Jews in Israel 1990–2019,
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag034.title_zh: 企业与工作流动性在移民融入中的作用：1990–2019年以色列的前苏联犹太人

doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag035.abstract: How will future climate change affect Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) in terms of migration and welfare? Can policymakers help SSA adapt to this process? I answer these questions with a quantitative framework that, coupled with rich spatial data and forecasts for the future climate, projects millions of climate migrants and unequal welfare losses across SSA. Investigating migration and trade liberalization as policy tools, I find persistent inequality in welfare losses if only migration barriers in SSA are reduced. Relaxing trade barriers addresses these distributional concerns, as do both policies combined. Yet, the policy mix is less effective in reducing aggregate losses due to inefficiencies arising from congestion externalities.
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag035.abstract_zh: 未来气候变化将如何影响撒哈拉以南非洲地区的移民与福利？政策制定者能否帮助该地区适应这一过程？本文通过构建一个量化分析框架，结合丰富的空间数据与未来气候预测，揭示了撒哈拉以南非洲地区将出现数百万气候移民及不均衡的福利损失。在将移民与贸易自由化作为政策工具进行研究时发现，若仅降低撒哈拉以南非洲地区的移民壁垒，福利损失的不平等现象将持续存在。放松贸易壁垒能够解决这些分配问题，而两项政策组合实施亦能达到同样效果。然而，由于拥挤外部性导致的效率损失，政策组合在减少总体损失方面的有效性有所降低。
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag035.journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag035.title: Climate Change and Migration: The Case of Africa,
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag035.title_zh: 气候变化与移民：以非洲为例

doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag036.abstract: This paper examines how monetary policy committee announcements and inflation surprises affect Turkish firms’ inflation expectations and FX management decisions during the 2015-2024 period–a time characterized by both relatively stable and highly volatile inflation. Using survey data, we define monetary policy (inflation) surprises as the unexpected component of interest rate (inflation) forecasts measured within a narrow window around policy announcements. First, we show that firms’ aggregate inflation expectations change significantly in response to monetary policy shocks, but their response is highly state-dependent: In relatively stable inflation environments, firms react in line with standard theory, anticipating a decline in prices while becoming pessimistic about the economic outlook. By contrast, in volatile settings, firms adopt a supply-side interpretation, revising their expectations upward amid pessimism. Second, inflation surprises increase inflation expectations and heighten pessimism regardless of the state, providing additional evidence for the supply-side view. Third, a positive inflation surprise induces an increase in FX holdings-reflecting concerns about potential currency depreciation-whereas an unexpected policy rate hike prompts firms to reduce FX positions in anticipation of currency appreciation. Our findings demonstrate that in a high-inflation environment, firms are especially attentive to macroeconomic developments, revising their inflation expectations and adjusting their financial strategies accordingly. These results underscore the importance of monetary policy communication and inflation news in shaping firm-level decisions, particularly when inflation is elevated and volatile.
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag036.abstract_zh: 本文研究了2015-2024年间货币政策委员会公告与通胀意外如何影响土耳其企业的通胀预期及外汇管理决策——这一时期既包含相对稳定的通胀阶段，也涵盖高度波动的通胀时期。基于调查数据，我们将货币政策（通胀）意外定义为政策公告前后短时间窗口内利率（通胀）预测中未预期的成分。首先，我们发现企业总体通胀预期会因货币政策冲击而发生显著变化，但其反应具有高度状态依赖性：在相对稳定的通胀环境下，企业的反应符合标准理论，预期价格下降的同时对经济前景持悲观态度；相反，在波动环境下，企业采取供给侧解读，在悲观情绪中上调通胀预期。其次，无论处于何种状态，通胀意外均会推高通胀预期并加剧悲观情绪，这为供给侧观点提供了额外证据。第三，正向通胀意外导致企业增加外汇持有量——反映出对潜在货币贬值的担忧——而意外的政策利率上调则促使企业因预期货币升值而减少外汇头寸。我们的研究结果表明，在高通胀环境下，企业尤其关注宏观经济动态，并据此调整通胀预期与财务策略。这些结果凸显了货币政策沟通与通胀新闻在塑造企业层面决策中的重要性，尤其是在通胀高企且波动剧烈的时期。

doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag036.title: How Do Monetary Policy and Inflation Announcements Affect Firm Expectations in High Inflation?
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag036.title_zh: 货币政策和通胀公告如何影响高通胀环境下的企业预期？

doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag037.abstract: This paper develops a novel method to estimate inequality within a country based on what the country imports. If preferences are non-homothetic, rich and poor individuals of a country have different consumption profiles. Imports can thus inform about the income distribution in a country. The global availability of trade data allows us to estimate inequality using a single transparent and comparable method for a large sample of countries over time. Compared to conventional data, we feature an especially good coverage of developing countries. We provide a number of robustness checks and cross-validation exercises that show the good performance of our method.
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag037.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于国家进口数据估算国内不平等程度的新方法。若偏好具有非位似性，一国富人与穷人的消费结构将存在差异，因此进口数据可反映该国的收入分配状况。利用全球可获取的贸易数据，我们能够通过单一透明且可比的方法，对大量国家在时间序列上的不平等程度进行估算。与传统数据相比，本方法尤其能覆盖更多发展中国家。我们通过多项稳健性检验和交叉验证，证实了该方法具有良好的表现。
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag037.journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag037.title: Recovering Within-Country Inequality From Trade Data,
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag037.title_zh: 从贸易数据中恢复国内不平等程度

doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag038.abstract: This paper empirically examines the idea that the increasing return to college is reducing intergenerational mobility by differentially impacting the investments in children by parents across education groups. A larger return to college will create stronger incentives to invest in children by parents with more education, if educated parents have a comparative advantage in producing human capital in children. Given the importance of a two-parent household on childhood development, marital status is a critical investment decision that parents consider. Relative to less-educated mothers, the analysis shows that educated mothers in states with a larger increase in the return to education are more likely to be married, less likely to divorce, have a more educated spouse, and own more valuable houses. Their children also have relatively higher test scores in 8th grade and rates of college completion. These results are consistent with the increasing return to college differentially affecting the incentives for parental investments in children, which in turn, creates greater disparities in childhood conditions and reduces intergenerational mobility in education.
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag038.abstract_zh: 本文实证检验了如下观点：大学教育回报率的上升正通过不同教育背景父母对子女投资行为的差异化影响，降低代际流动性。若受教育程度较高的父母在子女人力资本培育方面具有比较优势，则更高的大学教育回报将激励其增加对子女的投资。鉴于双亲家庭对儿童发展的重要性，婚姻状况是父母考虑的关键投资决策。分析表明，相较于低学历母亲，在受教育回报率增幅较大的州，高学历母亲更可能处于已婚状态、离婚概率更低、配偶受教育程度更高、且拥有更高价值的房产。其子女在八年级的学业测试成绩及大学完成率也相对更高。这些结果印证了大学教育回报率上升会差异化影响父母对子女的投资激励，进而加剧儿童成长环境的不平等，并削弱教育代际流动性。
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag038.journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag038.title: The Return to College, Marriage, and Intergenerational Mobility
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag038.title_zh: 大学教育、婚姻与代际流动的回报

doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag039.abstract: Political polarization is a growing concern in many countries. Are mass protests merely a sign of increasing cleavages, or do they polarize societies? In this paper, we estimate the impact of Nazi marches in 1932 Hamburg, using granular data from 622 voting precincts during 6 elections. We show propaganda can persuade – but it does by raising the share of areas with high levels of Nazi support. Importantly, marches can also backfire, repelling voters. Thus, protest marches lead to polarization. These effects diffused through social networks, measured as contagion patterns across neighborhoods from the 1918 Spanish flu outbreak.
