The electoral effects of social spillovers are of similar importance as direct exposure, and grow over time.
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag039.abstract_zh: 政治极化是许多国家日益严峻的问题。大规模抗议仅仅是社会裂痕加剧的表现，还是会导致社会极化？本文利用1932年汉堡622个投票区在6次选举中的微观数据，估算了纳粹游行的影响。研究表明，宣传具有说服力——但这是通过提高纳粹支持率较高地区的占比来实现的。重要的是，游行也可能适得其反，使选民产生排斥。因此，抗议游行导致了极化。这些效应通过社会网络扩散，以1918年西班牙流感爆发期间社区间的传染模式为衡量标准。社会溢出效应对选举的影响与直接接触同等重要，且随时间推移而增强。
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag039.journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag039.title: Going Viral: Protests and Polarization in 1932 Hamburg,
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag039.title_zh: 病毒式传播：1932年汉堡的抗议与极化

doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag040.abstract: Can markets discipline socially costly misbehavior abroad? We explore the market penalty associated with major human rights violations—specifically, the assassination of mining activists, a context where formal legal recourse is rare and events often do not involve counterparties. We show that firms featured in media coverage of these incidents experience significant, negative abnormal stock returns. Whereas reactions to related forms of corporate misconduct may be transitory or muted, we find that the market responses are both substantial and persistent, with a median 10-day loss exceeding USD 100 million. Since formal legal sanction is exceedingly rare, we consider the role of market penalties. We highlight three mechanisms that are consistent with reputational costs: (1) Media attention magnifies the market response. (2) Information-sensitive institutional investors systematically divest following assassination events. (3) Events reduce future trade, leading to a 19% decline in new contracts with counterparties. Despite these costs, events persist. We find that assassinations increase with dependence on mining royalties, suggesting that local rents sustain conflict despite market pressure. Thus, reputational sanctions may be significant—even in weakly institutionalized settings—yet may not fully deter misbehavior when local and global incentives diverge.
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag040.abstract_zh: 市场能否约束企业在海外的高成本不当行为？我们探讨了与重大人权侵犯相关的市场惩罚——具体而言，即针对采矿活动人士的暗杀事件。在此类情境下，正式法律救济极为罕见，且事件往往不涉及交易对手。研究表明，媒体报道中提及这些事件的企业会经历显著且负面的异常股票回报。尽管针对相关形式的企业不当行为的市场反应可能是短暂或微弱的，但我们发现市场反应既显著又持久，其中位10天损失超过1亿美元。由于正式法律制裁极为罕见，我们考察了市场惩罚的作用。我们强调了与声誉成本一致的三种机制：（1）媒体关注放大了市场反应；（2）信息敏感的机构投资者在暗杀事件后系统性地撤资；（3）事件减少了未来交易，导致与新交易对手的合同数量下降19%。尽管存在这些成本，事件仍持续发生。我们发现，暗杀事件随对采矿特许权使用费的依赖程度增加而增加，这表明尽管存在市场压力，地方租金仍维持冲突。因此，声誉制裁可能意义重大——即使在制度薄弱的环境中——但当地方与全球激励不一致时，可能无法完全遏制不当行为。
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag040.journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag040.title: The Value of Names: Civil Society, Information, and Governing Multinationals,
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag040.title_zh: 名称的价值：公民社会、信息与跨国公司的治理

doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag041.abstract: We study how political parties engage in political targeting of resources by coordinating politicians across multiple levels of government. We combine thousands of election outcomes from the Indian state of West Bengal with 300 million payments from a welfare scheme jointly controlled by state and local governments. We show that the state government gives disproportionate funding to co-partisan local councils, which target payments to raise votes for national candidates. Welfare payments are diverted to reward local councilors who successfully deliver votes, and to recruit opposition councilors. The ruling party recruits candidates only where it lacks a majority, systematically expanding its control.
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag041.abstract_zh: 我们研究了政党如何通过协调多级政府中的政治家来实施政治资源定向。我们将印度西孟加拉邦数千个选举结果与一项由邦政府和地方政府共同控制的福利计划中3亿笔支付记录相结合。研究显示，邦政府向同党地方议会提供不成比例的资金，这些资金被用于定向支付以提升国家层面候选人的得票率。福利支付被挪用，用于奖励成功拉票的地方议员，并招募反对党议员。执政党仅在未获得多数席位的地方招募候选人，从而系统性地扩大其控制范围。
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag041.journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag041.title: Party Organizations and Complementary Political Control,
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag041.title_zh: 党组织与互补性政治控制

doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag042.abstract: This paper studies how large firms’ synchronized lumpy investments endogenously shape an economy’s fragility to negative TFP shocks. I develop a heterogeneous-firm real business cycle model that matches the empirical interest rate elasticities of investment for both large and small firms. In the model, large firms’ lumpy investments become persistently synchronized due to their low sensitivity to general equilibrium effects, generating investment surges. Following these surges, TFP-induced recessions are particularly severe, and the semi-elasticity of aggregate investment drops significantly, consistent with the data.
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag042.abstract_zh: 本文研究大型企业同步化的大额投资如何内生地塑造经济对负向全要素生产率冲击的脆弱性。我构建了一个异质性企业真实商业周期模型，该模型与大型和小型企业投资的经验利率弹性相匹配。在该模型中，大型企业的大额投资由于对一般均衡效应的敏感性较低而持续同步化，从而产生投资激增。在这些激增之后，全要素生产率引发的衰退尤为严重，且总投资的半弹性显著下降，这与数据一致。
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag042.journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag042.title: Striking While the Iron Is Cold: Fragility after a Surge of Lumpy Investments,
doi:10.1093/jeea/jvag042.title_zh: 趁热打铁：大宗投资激增后的脆弱性

doi:10.1093/jleo/ewag015.abstract: We provide quasi-experimental evidence of the effects of municipal budget rules on the level of local economic activity exploiting the fact that, in 1999, the Italian government imposed a balanced-budget fiscal rule on all municipal governments but in 2001 exempted municipalities below 5,000 inhabitants. Municipalities which remained subject to budget rules increased taxes but also experienced a significant increase in the number of firms and workers. The increase in taxes was largely financed through issuing more building permits, which led to higher urban revenues. To support the claim that building permits is a plausible mechanism which attracts more firms, in the face of higher taxes, we show that the positive impact of budget rules on employment growth and firms’ entry is concentrated in municipalities with no physical constraints to urban planning and development. (JEL D73, H72, R52, R31, R33)
doi:10.1093/jleo/ewag015.abstract_zh: 我们利用1999年意大利政府对所有市级政府实施平衡预算财政规则、但2001年豁免5000人以下市镇的准自然实验，提供了市政预算规则对地方经济活动水平影响的准实验证据。受预算规则约束的市镇在增加税收的同时，企业数量和工人数量也显著增长。税收增长主要通过发放更多建筑许可证来弥补，这带来了更高的城市财政收入。为论证建筑许可是在税收增加背景下吸引更多企业的合理机制，我们证明预算规则对就业增长和企业进入的积极影响，集中体现在城市规划与发展不受物理条件限制的市镇。（JEL分类号：D73, H72, R52, R31, R33）
doi:10.1093/jleo/ewag015.title: The effects of fiscal rules on building permits and economic activity: quasi-experimental evidence
doi:10.1093/jleo/ewag015.title_zh: 财政规则对建筑许可和经济活动的影响：准实验证据

doi:10.1093/jleo/ewag019.abstract: Considerable evidence suggests that people are internally motivated to keep their promises. But it is unclear whether such internal motivations create a meaningful level of commitment in economically relevant situations where promisors have strong self-interested reasons to break their promises. Self-interested incentives to break promises compete with—and so may overcome—the moral motivations of those who are internally motivated to keep them. We experimentally investigate the willingness of third parties to altruistically punish promise breaking. Participants observe a transaction between a potential promisor and promisee and can incur personal costs to punish the promisor for uncooperative actions. Our results suggest that the same moral reasons that motivate promisors to keep their promises make third-party observers more likely to punish promise breaking. This suggests that the same underlying promissory norms drive both (i) promise-keeping behavior in the absence of second- and third-party enforcement mechanisms and (ii) non-legal enforcement mechanisms that arise when third parties can punish potential promisors in a decentralized fashion. This makes it more likely that promissory norms support cooperative behavior
doi:10.1093/jleo/ewag019.abstract_zh: 大量证据表明，人们内心有遵守承诺的动机。但在承诺方有强烈自利动机违背承诺的经济相关情境中，这种内在动机能否形成有意义的承诺约束尚不明确。违背承诺的自利激励与内在道德动机相互竞争——甚至可能压倒后者。我们通过实验研究第三方利他性惩罚违背承诺行为的意愿。参与者观察潜在承诺方与受诺方之间的交易，并可通过承担个人成本来惩罚承诺方的不合作行为。研究结果表明，促使承诺方信守承诺的道德理由同样会使第三方观察者更倾向于惩罚违背承诺行为。这意味着相同的承诺规范同时驱动着：（i）在缺乏第二方与第三方执行机制时的信守承诺行为；（ii）当第三方能够以分散化方式惩罚潜在承诺方时产生的非法律执行机制。这使得承诺规范更有可能支持合作行为。
doi:10.1093/jleo/ewag019.title: Norm-based enforcement of promises

doi:10.1093/jleo/ewag022.abstract: Several studies have underscored the significance of familiarity and collegiality in shaping judicial behavior in US federal courts. However, the distinct features of the US judicial system limit the ability to formulate a general theory. This research draws on 84,335 appellate decisions from Taiwanese courts to examine the role of familiarity in a career judge system. In Taiwan, lower court judges are transitorily promoted to appellate courts for 3 years, after which they typically return to their district courts before some of them are permanently promoted. By comparing their reversal patterns during temporary and subsequent permanent promotions to those of permanent appellate judges, we find that transitorily promoted judges reverse less frequently, and judges generally favor district courts where they have previously served. Social identity is likely a key explanatory factor. The size, diversity, and random allocation of cases in our dataset strengthens the generality of judicial behavior theories.
doi:10.1093/jleo/ewag022.abstract_zh: 多项研究强调了熟悉度与同僚关系在美国联邦法院司法行为中的重要性。然而，美国司法体系的独特性限制了构建普适性理论的能力。本研究基于台湾法院的84,335份上诉判决，探讨职业法官体系中熟悉度的作用。在台湾，地方法院法官会临时晋升至上诉法院任职三年，之后通常返回原审法院，其中部分法官最终获得永久晋升。通过比较这些法官在临时晋升与后续永久晋升期间与常任上诉法官的改判模式，我们发现：临时晋升法官的改判频率较低，且法官普遍倾向于偏袒其曾任职的地方法院。社会认同可能是关键解释因素。本数据集在规模、多样性及案件随机分配方面的优势，增强了司法行为理论的普适性。
doi:10.1093/jleo/ewag022.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1093/jleo/ewag022.title: How judges’ social identity impacts reversal decisions: evidence from the transitory promotion of judges
doi:10.1093/jleo/ewag022.title_zh: 法官社会身份如何影响改判决定：来自法官临时晋升的证据

doi:10.1093/jleo/ewag028.abstract: This study examines how changes in judicial discretion influence ideological decision-making in the federal courts. Leveraging a pair of unanimous Supreme Court decisions that expanded district judges’ discretion to award attorney’s fees in patent litigation, we investigate whether this procedural reform led to substantive shifts in outcomes. Our differences-in-differences design reveals that conservative judges became significantly more likely to award fees after 2014 while more liberal ones did not. We observe no similar pattern in copyright cases, which experienced no comparable expansion of discretion. This patent-specific effect is driven by accused infringers seeking fees after defeating patent claims, consistent with conservative preferences for deterring frivolous litigation. Even unanimous, procedurally focused appellate rulings can lead to asymmetric ideological effects. These findings have implications for understanding how changes in discretionary authority—including the Court’s recent abandonment of Chevron deference—may systematically empower certain ideological preferences in the federal judiciary.
doi:10.1093/jleo/ewag028.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨司法裁量权的变化如何影响联邦法院的意识形态决策。借助两起一致通过的最高法院判决（这些判决扩大了地区法官在专利诉讼中裁定律师费的裁量权），我们考察了这一程序性改革是否导致了判决结果的实质性转变。采用双重差分法分析发现，2014年后保守派法官裁定律师费的可能性显著增加，而自由派法官则未呈现类似趋势。在版权案件中（其裁量权未经历同等扩张），我们未观察到相似模式。这种专利特有的效应主要由败诉方在专利主张被驳回后寻求律师费补偿所驱动，这与保守派偏好遏制滥诉行为的立场一致。即使是全体一致通过、聚焦程序问题的上诉裁决，也可能引发非对称的意识形态效应。这些发现对于理解裁量权变化——包括最高法院近期放弃雪佛龙尊重原则——如何系统性地强化联邦司法体系中特定意识形态偏好具有启示意义。
doi:10.1093/jleo/ewag028.title: Ideology and the scope of judicial discretion: evidence from the federal district courts
doi:10.1093/jleo/ewag028.title_zh: 意识形态与司法裁量范围：来自联邦地区法院的证据

doi:10.1093/qje/qjag023.abstract: We present a theory of choice in which attention to the features of options is determined by the decision maker’s categorization of the current problem in a set of problems she solved in the past. Categorization depends on goal-relevant and contextual problem-level features. The model yields heterogeneity in attention and choice in a given problem based on different past experiences and instability when changes in irrelevant context cause re-categorization. We show that heterogeneous and unstable representations of a choice problem unify major biases in judgment and decision making.
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag023.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种选择理论，其中决策者对选项特征的关注取决于其将当前问题归类于过去解决过的一组问题中的方式。分类过程依赖于与目标相关的问题层面特征及情境特征。该模型表明，在给定问题中，基于不同的过往经历会产生注意力与选择的异质性；而当无关情境的变化引发重新分类时，则会导致不稳定性。我们证明，选择问题表征的异质性与不稳定性统一了判断与决策中的主要偏差。
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag023.title: A Cognitive Theory of Reasoning and Choice
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag023.title_zh: 推理与选择的认知理论

doi:10.1093/qje/qjag024.abstract: This article examines how the American Medical Association (AMA) helped shape the development of the U.S. health insurance system in the critical period after World War II. Working with the political public relations firm Campaigns, Inc., the AMA launched a nationwide campaign to weaken support for national health insurance by framing it as “socialized medicine,” while simultaneously enrolling people in private health insurance plans to shift demand away from a public alternative. Drawing on newly assembled archival data, we find that greater exposure to the campaign explains about 20% of the rise in private health insurance enrollment and a comparable decline in public support for a national program. The campaign also appears to have influenced policy making through coordinated messaging, resolutions passed by civic organizations, congressional rhetoric, and political donations. These findings suggest that the rise of private health insurance in the United States was not solely due to macroeconomic forces or collective bargaining; rather, it was also enabled by a strategic, interest group–financed effort to shape citizen views and influence policy.
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag024.abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国医学会（AMA）在二战后关键时期如何影响美国医疗保险体系的发展。通过与政治公关公司Campaigns, Inc.合作，AMA发起了一场全国性运动，将国家医疗保险框架定义为“社会化医疗”以削弱其支持度，同时引导民众加入私人医疗保险计划，从而将需求从公共替代方案转移。基于新整理的档案数据，我们发现，该运动对私人医疗保险参保率上升的贡献约为20%，并对国家医保计划公众支持率的下降产生了同等程度的影响。该运动还通过协调信息传递、民间组织通过的决议、国会言论以及政治捐款，对政策制定产生了影响。这些发现表明，美国私人医疗保险的兴起并非仅由宏观经济力量或集体谈判驱动，而是由利益集团资助的战略性努力所推动，旨在塑造公民观点并影响政策。
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag024.title: Why Doesn’t the United States Have National Health Insurance? The Political Role of the American Medical Association
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag024.title_zh: 美国为何没有全民医保？美国医学会的政治角色

doi:10.1093/qje/qjag025.abstract: This article investigates how a government should manage international reserves when it faces the risk of a rollover crisis. We ask: Should the government accumulate reserves or reduce debt to make itself less vulnerable? We show that the optimal policy entails initially reducing debt, followed by a subsequent increase in both debt and reserves as the government approaches a safe zone. Furthermore, we find that issuing additional debt to accumulate reserves can lead to a reduction in sovereign spreads. Evidence from a panel of emerging economies is consistent with these predictions: increases in reserves financed by public external borrowing are associated with lower spreads, and reserve holdings are not systematically drawn down during crisis episodes.
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag025.abstract_zh: 本文研究政府面临展期危机风险时应如何管理国际储备。我们提出的问题是：政府应通过积累储备还是减少债务来降低自身脆弱性？研究表明，最优政策路径是先减少债务，随后在政府接近安全区域时同步增加债务与储备。此外，我们发现通过增发债务来积累储备可降低主权利差。来自新兴经济体的面板数据与这些预测一致：由公共外部借款融资的储备增加与利差下降相关，且危机期间储备持有量并未系统性减少。
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag025.title: International Reserve Management Under Rollover Crises
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag025.title_zh: 滚动危机下的国际储备管理

doi:10.1093/qje/qjag026.abstract: We study rainmaking as an instrumental religious belief. We present a model in which a religious leader tries to persuade people to believe. Praying for rain can persuade only where the hazard of rainfall during a dry spell is increasing over time, so that prayer is most likely to succeed when people most want rain. We present evidence from prayers for rain in Murcia, Spain, where the hazard rate is increasing, that the church’s prayers for rain predict rainfall over two centuries. To generalize this finding, we gather an original data set of whether ethnic groups around the world traditionally prayed for rain. We find that ethnic groups facing an increasing rainfall hazard are 47% more likely to pray for rain, consistent with our model’s prediction that societies are more likely to pray for rain where prayer is persuasive.
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag026.abstract_zh: 我们研究求雨作为一种工具性宗教信仰。我们构建了一个模型，其中宗教领袖试图说服人们相信求雨的有效性。只有当干旱期内降雨风险随时间递增时，求雨祈祷才具有说服力——这意味着祈祷最可能在人们最渴望降雨时成功。我们以西班牙穆尔西亚地区的求雨祈祷为证据，该地区降雨风险率呈递增趋势，发现教堂的求雨祈祷在两个世纪中持续预测了实际降雨。为推广这一发现，我们收集了全球各民族是否传统上举行求雨祈祷的原始数据集。研究发现，面临递增降雨风险的民族举行求雨祈祷的可能性高出47%，这与模型预测一致：在祈祷更具说服力的社会中，人们更可能进行求雨祈祷。
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag026.title: Praying for Rain

doi:10.1093/qje/qjag027.abstract: How does proximity to coworkers affect training and productivity? We study software engineers at a Fortune 500 firm from 2019 to 2024, leveraging two shocks to proximity: (i) the office closures in 2020 and (ii) the subsequent return-to-office mandates in 2022 and 2023. In both cases, co-located teams experienced bigger changes in proximity than distributed ones, facilitating difference-in-differences designs. We find that sitting near teammates increases coding feedback by 18.3% and improves code quality. Gains are concentrated among less-tenured and younger employees, who are building human capital. However, there is a tradeoff: experienced engineers write less code when sitting near teammates. In national US data, we find evidence that the rise of remote work has had scarring effects on young college graduates. In remotable jobs, young graduates’ unemployment rate increased relative to older graduates’ post-pandemic (2022−2024) compared to pre-pandemic (2017−2019), a pattern we do not observe in non-remotable jobs.
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag027.abstract_zh: 与同事的邻近性如何影响培训与生产力？我们以2019至2024年间某《财富》500强企业的软件工程师为研究对象，利用两次邻近性冲击：（i）2020年办公室关闭，以及（ii）随后2022至2023年重返办公室的强制要求。在这两种情形下，同地办公团队比分布式团队经历了更大的邻近性变化，这为双重差分设计提供了便利。研究发现，与队友相邻而坐可使编码反馈增加18.3%，并提升代码质量。这些收益主要集中于资历较浅和较年轻的员工，他们正处于人力资本积累阶段。然而，存在一个权衡：经验丰富的工程师在邻近队友就座时编写的代码量会减少。在全美数据中，我们发现远程办公的兴起对年轻大学毕业生产生了持续影响。在可远程办公的岗位中，年轻毕业生在疫情后时期（2022-2024年）的失业率相较于疫情前（2017-2019年）高于年长毕业生，而这一模式在不可远程办公的岗位中并未出现。
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag027.title: The Power of Proximity to Coworkers

doi:10.1093/qje/qjag028.abstract: Theory predicts that outsourcing public services to the private sector can reduce costs and improve efficiency, but can also induce cost-cutting and compromise quality. We assess the Brazilian “Organizações Sociais de Saude” model (OSS), which outsources management of public hospital services to the private sector while the state remains the residual claimant. We show that this enhances hospital production and operational efficiency without adverse effects on hospital quality and equity. Increased inpatient production addresses previously unmet demand, expanding local access to hospital care and reducing population mortality. Performance gains arise from improved operational efficiency achieved through increased hospital management capacity. This facilitates staffing adjustments, favoring higher-skilled personnel, dismissing lower-productivity staff, and adopting flexible, performance-tied employment contracts. Effects are larger among private organizations with more management experience, underscoring returns to managerial capacity. Our findings show that incentive-ownership structures can address the quantity-quality trade-off in public service delivery, even when contracts are incomplete and quality is hard to measure.
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag028.abstract_zh: 理论预测，将公共服务外包给私营部门可降低成本并提高效率，但也可能引发成本削减并损害服务质量。我们评估了巴西的"健康社会组织"（OSS）模式——该模式将公立医院管理服务外包给私营部门，而国家仍保留剩余索取权。研究表明，该模式提升了医院产出与运营效率，且未对医院质量与公平性产生负面影响。住院服务量的增加满足了此前未被满足的需求，扩大了当地医院服务的可及性，并降低了人口死亡率。绩效提升源于医院管理能力增强带来的运营效率改善，这促进了人员结构调整——优先雇佣高技能人员、解雇低生产率员工，并采用灵活且与绩效挂钩的雇佣合同。在管理经验更丰富的私营组织中，效果更为显著，凸显了管理能力的回报。我们的发现表明，即使合同不完善且质量难以衡量，激励性所有权结构仍能解决公共服务供给中的数量-质量权衡问题。
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag028.title: Public Services Under Private Management
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag028.title_zh: 私营管理下的公共服务

doi:10.1093/qje/qjag029.abstract: Stock markets play a dual role: they provide information about firms’ fundamentals, which improves resource allocations, and they provide liquidity. We propose a setting in which these two roles interact: if stocks are used more intensively for liquidity, then prices reveal less information about fundamentals. We structurally estimate stock price informativeness for several countries and show that it declines when alternative liquidity sources, such as banks, are in distress. To study the real effects of this mechanism, we devise a strategy to integrate our stock-trading module into a dynamic general equilibrium model with heterogeneous firms. We calibrate the model to the US and simulate recessions with and without banking distress. In a stand-alone recession, prices become more informative, and allocation improves, mitigating output losses by 4.4%. If the recession coincides with banking distress, agents rely more on stock markets to obtain liquidity, prices become less informative, and allocation deteriorates, magnifying output losses by 22%.
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag029.abstract_zh: 股票市场具有双重作用：一方面提供企业基本面信息以优化资源配置，另一方面提供流动性。我们构建了一个两种作用相互影响的框架：若股票被更密集地用于获取流动性，则价格所反映的基本面信息将减少。我们通过结构估计测度了多国股票价格的信息含量，发现当银行等替代性流动性来源陷入困境时，股价信息含量会下降。为研究该机制的实际经济效应，我们设计策略将股票交易模块嵌入包含异质性企业的动态一般均衡模型。基于美国数据校准模型后，我们模拟了有无银行业困境伴随的经济衰退情景。在独立衰退中，价格信息含量提升，资源配置改善，使产出损失降低4.4%；若衰退伴随银行业困境，经济主体将更依赖股票市场获取流动性，导致价格信息含量下降与资源配置恶化，使产出损失扩大22%。
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag029.title: Business, Liquidity, and Information Cycles
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag029.title_zh: 商业、流动性与信息周期

doi:10.1093/qje/qjag030.abstract: This paper uses labor force surveys from 160 countries to build a new microdatabase on hours worked covering 97% of the world population in cross section. We also construct time series spanning over 20 years in 86 countries. Hours worked per adult slightly decline with GDP per capita but are weakly correlated with development overall. Hours worked by the young (aged 15-19) and elderly (aged 60+) fall with development, driven entirely by growing school attendance and public pension coverage. Hours worked among prime-age adults (aged 20-59) are stable with development but undergo a great gender reshuffling: falling male hours per worker have been exactly offset by increases in female labor force participation in many countries. Labor income taxes are strongly negatively related to hours worked across countries. This correlation is attenuated when controlling for social spending and disappears when further controlling for working hours regulations. Both social spending and working hours regulations are associated with lower hours worked.
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag030.abstract_zh: 本文利用来自160个国家的劳动力调查，构建了一个覆盖全球97%人口横截面数据的新工作时长微观数据库。我们还构建了86个国家超过20年的时间序列数据。成年人平均工作时长随人均GDP略有下降，但与整体发展水平的关联较弱。青年（15-19岁）和老年（60岁以上）人群的工作时长随发展水平下降，这完全由入学率和公共养老金覆盖率的提高所驱动。壮年（20-59岁）人群的工作时长随发展水平保持稳定，但经历了显著的性别重组：在许多国家，男性人均工作时长的下降恰好被女性劳动参与率的上升所抵消。跨国数据显示，劳动所得税与工作时长呈显著负相关。在控制社会支出后，这种相关性减弱；进一步控制工作时长法规后，相关性消失。社会支出和工作时长法规均与较低的工作时长相关。
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag030.title: Global Working Hours

doi:10.1093/qje/qjag031.abstract: We test for stereotyping—the exaggeration of representative traits—in a high-stakes economic environment. Using both surveys administered among undergraduates at the Ohio State University and large-scale nationally representative data, we measure how US freshmen perceive the relationship between college majors and occupations. We show that students greatly overestimate the likelihood that majors lead to their representative jobs (e.g., counselor for psychology, journalist for journalism). Using an implicit association test, we show that students associate majors with their representative careers and that these associations strongly predict belief biases, in line with a stereotyping mechanism. A simple equilibrium model of the labor market predicts that stereotyping reduces welfare by increasing misallocation, which correlational evidence on job/major mismatch corroborates. In a field experiment, we test a light-touch policy to reduce stereotyping and find significant effects on students’ intentions about what to study as well as the classes and majors they enroll in.
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag031.abstract_zh: 我们检验了高风险经济环境中的刻板印象——即对代表性特征的夸大。通过俄亥俄州立大学本科生调查和大规模全国代表性数据，我们衡量了美国新生对大学专业与职业之间关系的认知。结果显示，学生严重高估了专业导向其代表性职业的可能性（例如心理学专业对应咨询师、新闻学专业对应记者）。通过内隐联想测试，我们发现学生将专业与其代表性职业相关联，且这些关联强烈预测了信念偏差，这与刻板印象机制一致。一个简单的劳动力市场均衡模型预测，刻板印象通过加剧资源错配降低社会福利，而关于职业/专业错配的相关证据支持了这一结论。在一项实地实验中，我们测试了一种轻触式政策以减少刻板印象，发现该政策对学生关于学习意向、所选课程及专业产生了显著影响。
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag031.title: What Jobs Come to Mind? Stereotypes About Fields of Study
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag031.title_zh: 想到什么工作？关于学科领域的刻板印象

doi:10.1093/qje/qjag032.abstract: We study how people’s beliefs about the economy covary with household-level events, utilizing a unique link between Danish administrative data and a large-scale survey of consumer expectations. We find that compared to actual inflation, people’s inflation forecasts covary much more strongly (and negatively) with both recently realized household income changes and measures of expected future household income changes. We formally establish that these findings are stark deviations from the Bayesian rational expectations benchmark. Similar results hold for perceptions of past inflation (“backcasts” ), suggesting that imperfect recall is a key mechanism for biased forecasts. Building on this, a series of additional tests, some of which utilize data on adverse health events, suggests that the forecast biases are at least partly due to affect-cued recall. That is, negative (positive) household-level events cue negative (positive) recollections, which lead to pessimistic (optimistic) forecasts.
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag032.abstract_zh: 我们利用丹麦行政数据与大规模消费者预期调查之间的独特关联，研究了人们对经济的信念如何随家庭层面事件而变化。研究发现，相较于实际通胀率，人们的通胀预测与近期已实现的家庭收入变化以及预期的未来家庭收入变化指标之间存在显著更强的负向协动关系。我们正式证明，这些发现与贝叶斯理性预期基准存在显著偏离。类似结果也适用于对过去通胀的感知（"回溯预测"），表明不完美回忆是导致预测偏差的关键机制。在此基础上，一系列附加检验（部分利用不良健康事件数据）表明，预测偏差至少部分源于情感线索回忆——即负面（正面）家庭层面事件会触发负面（正面）回忆，进而导致悲观（乐观）预测。
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag032.title: Beliefs About the Economy are Excessively Sensitive to Household-Level Shocks: Evidence from Linked Survey and Administrative Data
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag032.title_zh: 家庭层面冲击对经济信念的过度敏感：基于关联调查与行政数据的证据

doi:10.1093/qje/qjag033.abstract: We explore the mechanics of empathy. We show that information about an outgroup can activate and magnify empathy when presented in conjunction with an experience simulating their struggles. This response increases the willingness to help the struggling group. We provide evidence for this effect in an immersive virtual reality experiment where participants (“witnesses”) experience a simulation of the struggle of unauthorized migrants (“protagonists”), then replicate these results in a series of controlled lab experiments. We show that information enhances the witnesses’ empathetic response and drives them to engage in more prosocial behavior when it increases their perceived interpersonal similarity, or relatability to the protagonist — an effect we trace to attention: eye-tracking data reveals that information provision concentrates witnesses’ gaze on the struggles of the protagonist instead of searching through peripheral elements of the scene. Conversely, only information packages that strengthen perceived relatability — an effect that can vary across subgroups with heterogeneous attributes — magnify empathy. Together, our evidence suggests that the ability to put oneself in the shoes of another person or group can be enhanced by activating empathy through simple, targeted, information provision.
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag033.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了共情的运作机制。研究表明，当关于外群体的信息与模拟其困境的体验相结合时，能够激活并放大共情。这种反应会提升帮助困境群体的意愿。我们通过一项沉浸式虚拟现实实验为这一效应提供了证据——参与者（“见证者”）体验了未经授权移民（“主角”）困境的模拟场景，随后在一系列受控实验室实验中复现了这些结果。我们发现，当信息增强了见证者感知到的人际相似性或与主角的关联性时，信息会强化见证者的共情反应，并促使他们采取更多亲社会行为——我们将这一效应归因于注意力：眼动追踪数据显示，信息提供将见证者的目光集中在主角的困境上，而非搜索场景中的外围元素。相反，只有那些能够增强感知关联性的信息包——这一效应可能因具有异质性特征的子群体而异——才会放大共情。综合来看，我们的证据表明，通过简单、有针对性的信息提供激活共情，可以增强个体设身处地理解他人或群体的能力。
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag033.title: In their Shoes: Empathy Through Information
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag033.title_zh: 感同身受：信息中的共情

doi:10.1093/qje/qjag034.abstract: If unions raise worker wages, who pays? We provide a comprehensive assessment of firm responses to increased unionization, using changes in the tax deductibility of union dues in Norway as a quasi-exogenous source of variation in firm-level union density. In the average private sector firm, higher union density raises labor costs and leads firms to contract employment and production, lowering profits without increasing the labor share. The incidence is shared: consumers bear part of the cost through higher prices, shareholders through lower profits, and the remainder is offset by productivity improvements. The total wage bill falls, with losses concentrated among less-attached “outsider” workers. Firm responses vary systematically by the degree of market competition. In manufacturing, where firms operate in less competitive product and labor markets, the response is reversed: the average firm expands employment and production, reduces labor markdowns, and does not experience profit declines. Instead, higher labor costs are largely passed on to consumers through higher prices, with the remainder offset by productivity gains. Workers benefit as both wages and employment rise. These patterns suggest that unions can offset employer monopsony power and that firm responses–and therefore who ultimately bears the cost-depend importantly on market structure. Overall, unionization in this setting primarily redistributes from consumers rather than shareholders and has effects that differ sharply across firms, including a reallocation toward larger and more productive firms. We rationalize these patterns using a partial-equilibrium model of union bargaining with product- and labor-market power.
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag034.abstract_zh: 如果工会提高工人工资，谁来买单？我们利用挪威工会会费税收抵扣政策的变化作为企业层面工会密度的准外生变动来源，对企业应对工会化程度提高的反应进行了全面评估。在一般私营企业中，工会密度上升会提高劳动力成本，导致企业收缩就业和生产规模，在降低利润的同时并未提高劳动份额。成本负担由多方分摊：消费者通过更高价格承担部分成本，股东通过更低利润承担部分，其余部分则被生产率提升所抵消。总工资支出下降，损失主要集中在关联度较低的“外部”工人群体。企业反应因市场竞争程度不同而呈现系统性差异。在制造业中，由于企业面临竞争程度较低的产品和劳动力市场，其反应截然相反：一般企业会扩大就业和生产规模，降低劳动力市场垄断压价能力，且利润并未下降。相反，更高的劳动力成本主要通过提高价格转嫁给消费者，其余部分被生产率提升所抵消。工人因工资和就业同时上升而获益。这些模式表明，工会能够抵消雇主的买方垄断势力，而企业反应——进而最终由谁承担成本——关键取决于市场结构。总体而言，在此背景下工会化主要实现从消费者而非股东的收入再分配，且对不同企业的影响差异显著，包括资源向规模更大、生产率更高的企业重新配置。我们通过一个包含产品市场与劳动力市场势力的工会谈判局部均衡模型对这些模式进行了合理化解释。
doi:10.1093/qje/qjag034.title: Who Pays for Unions?

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag021.abstract: How do regional productivity shocks or transportation infrastructure improvements affect aggregate welfare? In a general class of spatial equilibrium models, we provide a formula for aggregate welfare changes, decomposed into terms associated with (i) technology [Fogel (1964), Railroads and American Economic Growth (Baltimore: Johns Hopkins Press), Hulten (1978) “Growth Accounting with Intermediate Inputs”, The Review of Economic Studies, 45, 511–518], (ii) spatial dispersion of marginal utility, (iii) fiscal externalities, (iv) technological externalities, and (v) redistribution. We further use this decomposition to derive a general formula for optimal spatial transfers and show that, whenever optimal transfers are in place, the technology term alone captures the aggregate welfare effects of technological shocks. We apply our framework to study welfare gains from improving the US highway network. We find that changes in the spatial dispersion of marginal utility are as important as technological externalities in accounting for the deviations from the Fogel-Hulten benchmark to assess welfare gains.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag021.abstract_zh: 区域生产率冲击或交通基础设施改善如何影响总体福利？在一类通用的空间均衡模型中，我们推导出总体福利变化的分解公式，该公式包含以下组成部分：(i) 技术效应 [Fogel (1964), 《铁路与美国经济增长》(巴尔的摩：约翰·霍普金斯出版社)；Hulten (1978)《中间投入的增长核算》，《经济研究评论》，第45卷，511–518页]；(ii) 边际效用的空间分散程度；(iii) 财政外部性；(iv) 技术外部性；以及(v) 再分配效应。我们进一步利用该分解推导出最优空间转移支付的一般公式，并证明当最优转移支付机制存在时，仅技术效应项即可完全捕捉技术冲击对总体福利的影响。我们将该分析框架应用于评估美国高速公路网络改善带来的福利收益，发现边际效用空间分散程度的变化与技术外部性在解释福利收益偏离Fogel-Hulten基准时具有同等重要性。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag021.title: Unpacking Aggregate Welfare in a Spatial Economy
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag021.title_zh: 解析空间经济中的总体福利

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag024.abstract: What are the effects of supply-side climate policies in the oil market? We use global company-level data to estimate the impact of 84 reforms of production taxes between 2000 and 2019 on oil production, exploration, and discoveries. We find that higher taxes primarily reduce companies’ exploration expenditures and oil discoveries, and also reduce short-term production of unconventional oil. We then quantify the implications for the oil market using a short- and medium-term dynamic model extending until the end of the century. Imposing a global climate royalty surcharge of 20 percentage points on oil producers reduces average annual emissions from oil by 5–7% in the first 5 years, and 9–20% in the medium term. If only OECD countries adopt this policy, 47–73% of the total emission reductions would be offset by increased production in non-OECD countries in the medium term.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag024.abstract_zh: 供给侧气候政策对石油市场有何影响？我们利用全球企业层面数据，估算了2000年至2019年间84项生产税改革对石油产量、勘探及发现量的影响。研究发现，提高税率主要降低了企业的勘探支出和石油发现量，同时减少了非常规石油的短期产量。随后，我们通过一个延伸至本世纪末的短期与中期动态模型，量化了这些影响对石油市场的含义。若对石油生产商征收20个百分点的全球气候特许权附加费，前五年内石油年均排放量将减少5%至7%，中期内减少9%至20%。若仅由经合组织国家实施该政策，中期内47%至73%的减排总量将被非经合组织国家的产量增长所抵消。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag024.title: Quantifying Supply-Side Climate Policies

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag025.abstract: We propose a simple and general model of experimentation in which reaching untried levels of a stock variable may, after a stochastic delay, lead to a catastrophe. Hence, at any point in time a catastrophe might well be under way, due to past experiments. We show how to measure this legacy of the past from prior beliefs and the chronicle of stock levels. We characterize the optimal policy as a function of the legacy and show that it leads to a new protocol for planning that applies to a general class of problems, encompassing the study of pandemics or climate change. Several original policy predictions follow, e.g. experimentation can stop but resume later.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag025.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个简洁且通用的实验模型，在该模型中，当存量变量达到未经尝试的水平时，经过随机延迟后可能引发灾难。因此，在任何时间点，由于过去的实验，灾难可能已经在酝酿之中。我们展示了如何根据先验信念和存量水平的历史记录来衡量这种过去的遗留影响。我们将最优政策刻画为遗留影响的函数，并表明该政策导向一种适用于一般问题类别的新规划协议，涵盖流行病或气候变化研究。由此得出若干原创性政策预测，例如实验可能停止但随后重启。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag025.title: Catastrophes, Delays, and Learning

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag026.abstract: Multiple hypothesis testing (MHT) practices vary widely, without consensus on which are appropriate when. This article provides an economic foundation for these practices designed to capture leading examples, such as regulatory approval on the basis of clinical trials. MHT adjustments are appropriate in our framework to the extent that research costs are invariant to the number of hypotheses. Control of average size, as for example via a Bonferroni correction, emerges in the limit case where all costs are fixed; in the opposite limit, where costs vary in proportion to the hypothesis count, no correction is needed. We illustrate implications by calculating explicit critical values using data on actual costs in the drug approval process and in program evaluation research; these suggest that some MHT adjustment is warranted in these applications, but not as much as implied by standard practice.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag026.abstract_zh: 多重假设检验（MHT）的实践方法差异显著，且对于何种情境下应采用何种方法尚未形成共识。本文为这些实践方法提供了经济学基础，旨在涵盖典型案例（如基于临床试验的监管审批）。在我们的框架中，当研究成本不随假设数量变化时，MHT调整是适当的。在成本完全固定的极限情形下，平均检验规模的控制（例如通过邦费罗尼校正）得以实现；而在另一极端情形下，当成本与假设数量成比例变化时，则无需进行校正。我们通过利用药品审批流程及项目评估研究中实际成本数据计算显式临界值，阐释了相关含义：这些结果表明，在上述应用中需进行一定程度的MHT调整，但调整幅度不应如标准实践所暗示的那样大。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag026.title: A Model of Multiple Hypothesis Testing
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag026.title_zh: 多重假设检验的一个模型

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag029.abstract: Linear instrumental variable estimators, such as two-stage least squares (TSLS), are commonly interpreted as estimating non-negatively weighted averages of causal effects, referred to as local average treatment effects (LATEs). We examine whether the LATE interpretation actually applies to the types of TSLS specifications that are used in practice. We show that if the specification includes covariates—which most empirical work does—then the LATE interpretation does not apply in general. Instead, the TSLS estimator will, in general, reflect treatment effects for both compliers and always/never-takers, and some treatment effects for the always/never-takers will necessarily be negatively weighted. We show that the only specifications that have a LATE interpretation are “saturated” specifications that control for covariates nonparametrically, implying that such specifications are both sufficient and necessary for TSLS to have a LATE interpretation, at least without additional parametric assumptions. This result is concerning because, as we document, empirical researchers almost never control for covariates nonparametrically, and rarely discuss or justify parametric specifications of covariates. We apply our results to thirteen empirical studies and find strong evidence that the LATE interpretation of TSLS is far from accurate for the types of specifications actually used in practice. We offer concrete recommendations for practice motivated by our theoretical and empirical results.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag029.abstract_zh: 线性工具变量估计量（如两阶段最小二乘法，TSLS）通常被解释为对因果效应的非负加权平均，即局部平均处理效应（LATE）。本文考察了LATE解释是否实际适用于实践中使用的TSLS设定形式。研究表明，若设定中包含协变量（多数实证研究均如此），则LATE解释通常不再适用。此时，TSLS估计量将同时反映依从者与始终/从不接受治疗者的处理效应，且始终/从不接受治疗者的部分处理效应必然被赋予负权重。我们证明，唯一具有LATE解释的设定是“饱和”设定——即通过非参数方式控制协变量，这意味着此类设定既是TSLS获得LATE解释的充分条件也是必要条件（至少在没有额外参数假设的情况下）。这一结论令人担忧，因为据我们记录，实证研究者几乎从未采用非参数方式控制协变量，且极少讨论或论证协变量的参数设定形式。我们将研究结果应用于13项实证研究，发现对于实践中实际使用的设定类型，TSLS的LATE解释远非准确。基于理论与实证结果，我们为实践操作提供了具体建议。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag029.title: When is TSLS Actually LATE?

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag031.abstract: We study the effect of risk on how firms organize their supply chains. We use transaction-level data on U.S. manufacturing imports to construct a novel measure of input sourcing risk based on the historical volatility of ocean shipping times. Our measure isolates the unexpected component of shipping times that is induced by weather conditions along more than 331,000 maritime routes. We first document that unexpected shipping delays significantly reduce importers’ sales, profits, and employment. We then show that firms actively diversify weather risk by using more routes and foreign suppliers, although their import values decline. To rationalize these findings, we introduce shipping time risk into a general equilibrium model of importing with firm heterogeneity. Our quantitative analysis predicts substantial costs for the U.S. economy associated with supply chain risk.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag031.abstract_zh: 本文研究风险如何影响企业供应链组织方式。我们利用美国制造业进口的交易层面数据，基于海运时间的历史波动性构建了投入品采购风险的新测度指标。该指标通过分析超过33.1万条海运航线的天气条件，分离出运输时间中由天气因素引发的意外波动。首先，我们证实运输时间的意外延迟会显著降低进口商的销售额、利润和就业水平。其次，我们发现企业会通过增加航线数量和海外供应商来主动分散天气风险，尽管其进口总额有所下降。为解释这些发现，我们将运输时间风险引入具有企业异质性的进口一般均衡模型。定量分析预测，供应链风险将给美国经济带来巨大成本。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag031.title: Input Sourcing under Climate Risk: Evidence from U.S. Manufacturing Firms
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag031.title_zh: 气候风险下的投入品采购：来自美国制造业企业的证据

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag032.abstract: We show that the financial sector’s asset supply elasticities are sufficient statistics summarizing its macroeconomic effects for a large class of financial frictions. These elasticities are crucial for a wide range of policy questions, ranging from the size of fiscal multipliers to the relative effectiveness of asset purchases targeting the financial sector versus tax cuts targeting households. Workhorse macroeconomic models imply different values of these elasticities, generating output responses to policies that differ by orders of magnitude. We construct empirical measures of these elasticities and evaluate their policy implications in a quantitative model with household heterogeneity and illiquidity.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag032.abstract_zh: 我们证明，对于一大类金融摩擦而言，金融部门的资产供给弹性是概括其宏观经济效应的充分统计量。这些弹性对于广泛的政策问题至关重要，涵盖从财政乘数的大小到针对金融部门的资产购买与针对家庭的减税政策相对有效性的比较。主流宏观经济模型对这些弹性赋予了不同的数值，导致政策对产出的影响幅度相差数个数量级。我们构建了这些弹性的实证度量指标，并在包含家庭异质性与非流动性的量化模型中评估其政策含义。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag032.title: Financial Intermediation and Aggregate Demand: A Sufficient Statistics Approach
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag032.title_zh: 金融中介与总需求：一个充分统计量方法

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag033.abstract: When employers face a trade-off between being large and paying low wages—and in this sense have monopsony power—some productive employers decide against building large business networks, forgo sales, and remain small. These decisions have adverse consequences for aggregate labour productivity. Using high-quality administrative data from Germany, we document that East German plants (compared to West German ones) face steeper size-wage curves, invest less in their business networks, remain smaller, and are less productive. A model with labour market monopsony, product market power, and business network investments matching these features of the data predicts a 10% lower aggregate labour productivity in East Germany.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag033.abstract_zh: 当雇主面临规模扩张与低工资之间的权衡——即在此意义上拥有买方垄断势力时，部分高生产率雇主会选择放弃构建庞大的商业网络、牺牲销售额并维持小规模经营。这些决策对总体劳动生产率产生不利影响。基于德国高质量行政数据，我们证实东德工厂（相较于西德工厂）面临更陡峭的规模-工资曲线，商业网络投资更少，企业规模更小，且生产率更低。一个包含劳动力市场买方垄断、产品市场势力及商业网络投资特征（与数据特征相匹配）的模型预测，东德总体劳动生产率将因此降低10%。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag033.title: Monopsony Makes Firms Not Only Small but Also Unproductive: Why East Germany has Not Converged
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag033.title_zh: 买方垄断不仅使企业规模变小，还导致其低效率：东德为何未能实现经济趋同

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag035.abstract: Manager pay has increased considerably since 1980, and so has inequality in manager pay. Over the same period, there has been a sharp rise in market power. We start from the premise that the role of managers is to increase firm productivity. When markets are imperfectly competitive, productivity not only helps firm grow in size, productivity also affects market power. We model how imperfect competition in product markets affects manager pay, and break down the contributions of firm size and market power to compensation. We find that market power, on average, accounts for 45.2% of total manager pay. Notably, there is substantial variation across managers. Top managers are disproportionately employed by firms with market power, and they benefit from it: in 2019, 80.3% of top manager pay is attributable to market power. Our main conclusion is that rise of market power explains half of the increase in average manager pay, and nearly all of the increase in manager pay inequality.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag035.abstract_zh: 自1980年以来，管理者薪酬大幅增长，管理者薪酬不平等程度也随之加剧。同期，市场势力急剧上升。我们基于管理者职责在于提升企业生产率这一前提展开研究。当市场处于不完全竞争状态时，生产率不仅有助于企业规模扩张，还会影响市场势力。我们构建模型分析产品市场不完全竞争对管理者薪酬的影响机制，并分解企业规模与市场势力对薪酬的贡献度。研究发现，市场势力平均占管理者总薪酬的45.2%。值得注意的是，不同管理者之间存在显著差异。高层管理者不成比例地受雇于具有市场势力的企业，并从中获益：2019年，高层管理者薪酬的80.3%可归因于市场势力。我们的主要结论是：市场势力的上升解释了平均管理者薪酬增长的一半，以及管理者薪酬不平等加剧的几乎全部原因。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag035.title: Manager Pay Inequality and Market Power
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag035.title_zh: 经理薪酬不平等与市场势力

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag037.abstract: I study racial disparities in the criminal justice system by analysing abnormal bunching in the distribution of crack-cocaine amounts used in federal sentencing. I compare cases sentenced before and after the Fair Sentencing Act, a 2010 law that changed the 10-year mandatory minimum threshold for crack-cocaine from 50 g to 280 g. First, I find that after 2010, there is a sharp increase in the fraction of cases sentenced at 280 g (the point that now triggers a 10-year mandatory minimum), and that this increase is disproportionately large for black and Hispanic offenders. I then explore several possible explanations for the observed racial disparities, including racial discrimination that occurs after entry into the criminal justice system. I analyse data from multiple stages in the criminal justice system and find that the increased bunching for minority offenders is driven by prosecutorial discretion, specifically as used by about 20–30% of prosecutors. Moreover, the fraction of cases at 280 g falls in 2013 when evidentiary standards become stricter. Finally, the racial disparity in the increase cannot be explained by differences in education, sex, age, criminal history, seized drug amount, or other elements of the crime, but it can be largely explained by a measure of state-level racial animus. These results shed light on the role of prosecutorial discretion and racial discrimination as causes of racial disparities in sentencing.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag037.abstract_zh: 本文通过分析联邦量刑中快克可卡因数量分布的异常聚集现象，研究刑事司法体系中的种族差异。我将2010年《公平量刑法》实施前后判决的案件进行对比——该法案将触发10年强制最低刑期的快克可卡因门槛从50克调整为280克。首先发现，2010年后以280克（当前触发10年强制最低刑期的临界点）量刑的案件比例急剧上升，且黑人及西班牙裔罪犯在此增幅中占比显著偏高。随后探讨了导致观察到的种族差异的几种可能解释，包括进入刑事司法体系后发生的种族歧视。通过分析刑事司法体系多个阶段的数据，发现少数族裔罪犯的聚集现象加剧源于检察官的自由裁量权，具体表现为约20-30%检察官的裁量行为。此外，当2013年证据标准趋严时，280克量刑案件比例出现下降。最后，这种增幅中的种族差异无法通过教育程度、性别、年龄、犯罪前科、毒品查获数量或其他犯罪要素来解释，但可在很大程度上由州级种族敌意指标解释。这些研究结果揭示了检察官自由裁量权与种族歧视作为量刑种族差异成因的作用机制。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag037.title: Racial Disparities in Federal Sentencing: Evidence from Drug Mandatory Minimums
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag037.title_zh: 联邦量刑中的种族差异：来自毒品强制最低刑期的证据

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag038.abstract: The seminal paper by Baron and Ferejohn (1989) leaves significant gaps in our understanding of open rule bargaining. We aim to fill these gaps by providing a fresh analysis of open rule bargaining. Our approach relies on an appealing class of stationary equilibria. In this class, we show that delays tend to be longer and allocations tend to be less egalitarian than originally predicted by Baron and Ferejohn. Our results shed new light on the efficiency and fairness implications of using an open vs. closed rule in legislatures and of bargaining processes in general.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag038.abstract_zh: Baron与Ferejohn（1989）的开创性论文在开放规则谈判领域留下了显著的研究空白。本文旨在通过提供对开放规则谈判的全新分析来填补这些空白。我们的研究方法依赖于一类具有吸引力的稳态均衡。在该均衡类别中，我们证明谈判延迟往往比Baron与Ferejohn最初预测的更久，而资源分配则更不平均。这一发现为立法机构中开放规则与封闭规则的使用效率及公平性影响，以及更广泛的谈判过程提供了全新视角。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag038.title: Open Rule Legislative Bargaining

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag039.abstract: Discrete choice data allow researchers to recover differences in utilities, but these differences may not suffice to identify policy-relevant counterfactuals of interest. In fact, in the case of dynamic discrete choice models, only a narrow set of counterfactuals are point-identified. In this paper, we explore how much one can learn about counterfactual outcomes of interest within this framework. We focus on the partial identification of counterfactuals, while allowing for (mild) model restrictions that can gradually shrink the identified set. We derive bounds for low-dimensional objects (such as average welfare) as arguments of optimization programmes, along with a uniformly valid inference procedure. Furthermore, we develop new and tractable computational tools and algorithms suitable for dealing with high-dimensional problems like this. Finally, we illustrate in Monte Carlos, as well as an empirical exercise of firms’ export decisions, the informativeness of the identified sets, and we assess the impact of (common) model restrictions on results.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag039.abstract_zh: 离散选择数据使研究者能够恢复效用差异，但这些差异可能不足以识别政策相关的反事实结果。事实上，在动态离散选择模型中，仅有一小部分反事实结果能被点识别。本文探讨了在此框架下，我们能对感兴趣的反事实结果了解到何种程度。我们聚焦于反事实的部分识别，同时允许（温和的）模型约束逐步缩小识别集。我们推导了低维对象（如平均福利）作为优化问题参数的边界，并提供了统一有效的推断方法。此外，我们开发了适用于处理此类高维问题的新型可计算工具与算法。最后，通过蒙特卡洛模拟以及企业出口决策的实证研究，我们展示了识别集的信息量，并评估了（常见）模型约束对结果的影响。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag039.title: Counterfactual Analysis for Structural Dynamic Discrete Choice Models
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag039.title_zh: 结构动态离散选择模型的反事实分析

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag040.abstract: An agent samples projects over time, observing quality for each, while a principal can select at most one. The principal values quality, whereas the agent only wants a project chosen. Transfers are unavailable, but the principal can verify quality by paying a cost. We fully characterize the dynamics of verification by determining optimal mechanisms for this problem. With a low verification cost and a long horizon, the optimal mechanism involves a deterministic selection rule that initially discriminates on quality but chooses a project irrespective of its quality at a deadline. Verification occurs with an intermediate probability before the deadline, declining over time. We show how these conclusions change if the verification cost is high or the horizon is short, and under certain forms of imperfect commitment. Our analysis provides guidelines on how dynamics interact with the benefits of verification.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag040.abstract_zh: 代理人随时间推移对项目进行抽样，并观察每个项目的质量，而委托人最多只能选择一个项目。委托人重视项目质量，而代理人只希望项目被选中。虽然无法进行转移支付，但委托人可以通过支付成本来验证质量。我们通过确定该问题的最优机制，全面刻画了验证的动态特征。在验证成本较低且时间跨度较长的情况下，最优机制包含一个确定性选择规则：该规则最初根据质量进行区分，但在截止日期前会忽略质量选择项目。验证行为在截止日期前以中等概率发生，且随时间推移而递减。我们展示了当验证成本较高或时间跨度较短时，以及在特定形式的不完全承诺条件下，这些结论如何发生变化。我们的分析为动态因素如何与验证收益相互作用提供了指导原则。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag040.title: The Dynamics of Verification when Searching for Quality
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag040.title_zh: 质量搜寻中的验证动态

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag041.abstract: We document dramatic changes in euro area interbank money markets during the financial and sovereign debt crises: unsecured borrowing declined across the euro area, while secured market haircuts on sovereign bonds increased, and bank borrowing from the European Central Bank rose in southern countries. We construct a quantitative general equilibrium model to assess the macroeconomic impact of these developments and the associated policy response. Our model features heterogeneous banks and sovereign bonds, secured and unsecured money markets, and a central bank. We compare a benchmark policy—the central bank providing collateralized lending to banks at haircuts lower than the market—with an alternative policy that maintains a constant central bank balance sheet. We show that the fall in output, investment, and capital would have been twice as high under the alternative policy.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag041.abstract_zh: 本文记录了欧元区银行间货币市场在金融危机和主权债务危机期间的剧烈变化：欧元区无担保借贷普遍下降，主权债券的担保市场折扣率上升，而南部国家银行从欧洲中央银行的借款增加。我们构建了一个定量一般均衡模型，以评估这些变化及其相关政策应对的宏观经济影响。该模型包含异质性银行与主权债券、有担保与无担保货币市场，以及中央银行。我们将基准政策——中央银行以低于市场的折扣率向银行提供抵押贷款——与维持中央银行资产负债表不变的替代政策进行比较。研究表明，在替代政策下，产出、投资和资本的下降幅度将是基准政策的两倍。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag041.title: Money Markets, Collateral, and Monetary Policy
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag041.title_zh: 货币市场、抵押品与货币政策

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag042.abstract: What are the channels through which monetary policy affects financial stability? Can (and should) central banks prevent financial crises by deviating from price stability? To what extent may monetary policy itself unintentionally breed financial vulnerabilities? We answer these questions using a New Keynesian model with capital accumulation and endogenous financial crises due to adverse selection and moral hazard in credit markets. Our findings are threefold. First, monetary policy affects the probability of a crisis both in the short run (via aggregate demand) and in the medium run (via capital accumulation). Second, the central bank can reduce the incidence of crises in the medium run by tolerating higher inflation volatility in the short run. Third, prolonged periods of loose monetary policy followed by a sharp tightening can lead to financial crises.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag042.abstract_zh: 货币政策通过哪些渠道影响金融稳定？中央银行能否（且是否应当）通过偏离价格稳定目标来预防金融危机？货币政策本身在多大程度上可能无意中滋生金融脆弱性？我们通过构建一个包含资本积累以及信贷市场中逆向选择与道德风险所引发内生金融危机的新凯恩斯模型来回答这些问题。研究结论有三点：第一，货币政策既在短期（通过总需求渠道）也在中期（通过资本积累渠道）影响危机发生概率；第二，中央银行可通过容忍短期通胀波动率上升来降低中期危机发生率；第三，长期宽松货币政策后骤然收紧可能引发金融危机。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag042.title: Monetary Policy and Endogenous Financial Crises
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag042.title_zh: 货币政策与内生金融危机

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag043.abstract: Despite the increasing importance of multiple priors in various domains of economics, choice-based incentive-compatible multiple-prior elicitation remains an open problem. This paper develops a solution, comprising a preference-based identification of a subject’s probability interval for an event, and a method for eliciting it. The method applies under weak decision-theoretic assumptions, with no need for probabilistic sophistication. To demonstrate its feasibility, we implement it in three incentivized experiments on artificial and natural sources of uncertainty. Intervals elicited by our method are sensitive to the direction and amount of information and are typically consistent with “objective” probabilities where available. We find a predominance of non-degenerate probability intervals, with intervals being wider when there is less information or predictability. The probability intervals elicited with our method are similar to those stated by subjects on aggregate, suggesting that the method can provide behavioural foundations for the use of stated probability-interval techniques in the field.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag043.abstract_zh: 尽管多重先验在经济学各领域的重要性日益凸显，基于选择的激励相容多重先验启发仍是一个未解难题。本文提出一套解决方案，包含基于偏好的个体事件概率区间识别方法及其启发技术。该方法在弱决策理论假设下适用，无需概率精炼性假设。为验证可行性，我们针对人工与自然不确定性来源开展三项激励实验。实验表明：该方法启发的概率区间对信息方向与信息量敏感，且在存在客观概率时通常与之吻合。我们发现非退化概率区间占主导地位，当信息量较少或可预测性较低时区间宽度更大。该方法启发的概率区间与受试者整体陈述的区间相似，表明该技术可为实地研究中陈述概率区间方法提供行为基础。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag043.title: Eliciting Multiple Prior Beliefs

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag044.abstract: Do periods of persistently loose monetary policy increase financial fragility and the likelihood of a financial crisis? This is a central question for policymakers, yet the literature does not provide systematic empirical evidence about this link at the aggregate level. In this article, we fill this gap by analysing long-run historical data. We find that when the stance of monetary policy is accommodative over an extended period, the likelihood of financial turmoil in the medium term increases considerably. We investigate the causal pathways that lead to this result and argue that credit creation and asset price overheating are important intermediating channels.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag044.abstract_zh: 持续宽松的货币政策时期是否会加剧金融脆弱性并增加金融危机的可能性？这是政策制定者面临的核心问题，然而现有文献并未在宏观层面提供关于这一关联的系统性实证证据。本文通过分析长期历史数据填补了这一空白。研究发现，当货币政策在较长时期内保持宽松立场时，中期内发生金融动荡的可能性显著上升。我们进一步探究了导致这一结果的因果路径，并论证信贷创造与资产价格过热是重要的中介传导渠道。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag044.title: Loose Monetary Policy and Financial Instability
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag044.title_zh: 宽松货币政策与金融不稳定

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag045.abstract: We analyse discontinuous Markovian strategies for differential games. The best response correspondence uniquely maps almost all profiles of opponents’ strategies back to the strategy space. We thus make Markov-perfect equilibria in a wide class of differential games well-behaved, resolving a long-standing open problem. We provide a readily applicable necessary and sufficient condition for best responses and Markov-perfect Nash equilibria. We demonstrate our methods in a canonical model of non-cooperative mitigation of climate change. Our approach provides novel, economically important results: we obtain the entire set of symmetric Markov-perfect equilibria and demonstrate that the best equilibria can yield a major welfare improvement over the equilibrium which previous literature has focused on. International climate negotiations can be seen as being about coordination on good equilibria, rather than about bargaining over the limited surplus available in a dynamic prisoner’s dilemma.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag045.abstract_zh: 我们分析了微分博弈中的不连续马尔可夫策略。最优反应对应将几乎所有对手策略的剖面唯一映射回策略空间。由此，我们使广泛一类微分博弈中的马尔可夫完美均衡具有良好的性质，解决了一个长期存在的开放性问题。我们给出了一个易于应用的最优反应与马尔可夫完美纳什均衡的充要条件。我们通过一个非合作减缓气候变化的经典模型展示了该方法。我们的方法提供了新颖且具有重要经济意义的结果：我们得到了全部对称马尔可夫完美均衡集，并证明最优均衡相较于以往文献所关注的均衡能够带来显著的福利改善。国际气候谈判可被视为关于良好均衡的协调，而非在动态囚徒困境的有限剩余上进行讨价还价。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag045.title: Markov-Perfect Equilibria in Differential Games—With an Application to Climate Policy
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag045.title_zh: 微分博弈中的马尔可夫完美均衡——兼论其在气候政策中的应用

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag046.abstract: This article reconsiders the question of optimal labour income taxes for the very rich in the context of a flexible moral hazard model. In this setting, risk is not exogenous. Rather, each agent can affect the probabilities of all possible income outcomes by allocating a fixed time endowment across a variety of distinct tasks. I prove that the optimal income tax rates on high-end earners and the optimal Pareto tail index of the pre-tax labour income distribution are both endogenously determined by agent preferences. In particular, a society with less risk-averse agents will find it optimal to impose a lower tax rate on the rich, even though its members’ choices give rise to a smaller Pareto right tail index. In contrast, this kind of negative co-movement between inequality and optimal tax rates is a suboptimal response in the classical Mirrlees (1971)–Diamond (1998)–Saez (2001) setup to changes in the exogenous distribution of skills.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag046.abstract_zh: 本文在灵活的道德风险模型框架下重新审视了针对极高收入者的最优劳动所得税问题。在此设定中，风险并非外生变量。相反，每个行为人可通过将固定时间禀赋分配至多种不同任务，影响所有可能收入结果的发生概率。本文证明，高收入者的最优所得税率与税前劳动收入分布的最优帕累托尾部指数均由行为人偏好内生决定。具体而言，在行为人风险厌恶程度较低的社会中，即使其成员的选择导致更小的帕累托右尾指数，最优政策仍倾向于对富人征收更低的税率。与之形成对比的是，在经典的Mirrlees（1971）–Diamond（1998）–Saez（2001）框架下，这种不平等程度与最优税率之间的负向联动关系，实为对外生技能分布变化的次优反应。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag046.title: Optimal Labour Income Taxation: A Flexible Moral Hazard Approach
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag046.title_zh: 最优劳动收入税：一种灵活的道德风险方法

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag047.abstract: This paper studies the long-term effects of technology and know-how transfers on structural transformations. In the 1950s, the Soviet Union supported the construction of the 156 Projects, which were large-scale, capital-intensive industrial clusters in China. These projects included a technology transfer, consisting of state-of-the-art Soviet machinery and equipment, and a know-how transfer, via the training of Chinese engineers, production supervisors, and high-skilled technicians by Soviet experts. We use newly assembled data that follow steel plants for over four decades, and we exploit natural variation in the transfers they eventually received. We find that, while production advantages stemming from Soviet technology faded away if not complemented with training, the know-how transfer had a long-lasting impact on plant performance, stimulated technology upgrade when China was a closed economy, and increased exports to the Western world when China engaged in international trade. The know-how transfer also generated productivity and technology spillovers onto complementary establishments.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag047.abstract_zh: 本文研究了技术与知识转移对结构转型的长期影响。20世纪50年代，苏联援建了156项工程，这些工程是中国境内大规模、资本密集型的工业集群。这些项目包含技术转移（通过提供苏联最先进的机械设备）和知识转移（通过苏联专家培训中国工程师、生产主管及高级技工）。我们利用新汇编的跨越四十余年的钢铁厂数据，并借助这些工厂最终获得转移项目的自然差异进行分析。研究发现：若缺乏配套培训，源自苏联技术的生产优势会逐渐消退；而知识转移对工厂绩效具有持久影响，在中国封闭经济时期推动了技术升级，并在中国融入国际贸易后增加了对西方世界的出口。此外，知识转移还对配套企业产生了生产率与技术溢出效应。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag047.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag047.title: Technology Transfer and Early Industrial Development: Evidence from the Sino-Soviet Alliance
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag047.title_zh: 技术转移与早期工业发展：来自中苏联盟的证据

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag048.abstract: This article combines personnel records of the U.S. government with census data to study how exposure to greater female representation at work can persistently reduce intergenerational gender gaps in labour market outcomes. Exploiting city-by-department variation in the sudden expansion of female employment during World War I, we find that daughters of civil servants exposed to female co-workers are more likely to work later in life. This intergenerational effect operates through exposed fathers and extends beyond the public sector, reducing the earnings gap by 12%. Consistent with a broader shift in attitudes towards working women, exposure to female co-workers also made male civil servants more likely to marry working women. We show that cities exposed to larger increases in female federal workers saw persistently higher female labour force participation in both the public and the private sector. Increasing gender representation within the public sector can thus have broader labour market implications.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag048.abstract_zh: 本文结合美国政府人事档案与人口普查数据，研究工作中女性代表性提升如何持续缩小劳动力市场结果的代际性别差距。利用第一次世界大战期间女性就业突然扩张的城市-部门差异，我们发现，接触过女性同事的公务员的女儿在日后更有可能进入职场。这种代际效应通过受影响的父亲发挥作用，并延伸至公共部门之外，使收入差距缩小12%。与对职业女性态度整体转变相一致的是，接触女性同事也使男性公务员更有可能与职业女性结婚。研究表明，接触女性联邦雇员数量增长更大的城市，其公共与私营部门的女性劳动参与率均持续提高。因此，提升公共部门内的性别代表性可能对更广泛的劳动力市场产生深远影响。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag048.title: Closing Gender Gaps Through Workplace Diversity: The Intergenerational Effects of World War I
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag048.title_zh: 通过职场多样性缩小性别差距：第一次世界大战的代际效应

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag049.abstract: We propose a new model of internal migration, based on persistent and spatially correlated idiosyncratic utility. The model is motivated by a new fact in the data that simple moving cost models struggle to match: the t-year interstate migration rate is proportional to the square root of t. The new model maintains the tractability and flexibility of standard migration models, but better matches the dynamics of migration, including the new fact. It has substantially different welfare implications and makes different counterfactual predictions, especially in terms of dynamic adjustment and long-run responses.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag049.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于持久且空间相关的异质性效用的内部迁移新模型。该模型的提出源于数据中一个简单迁移成本模型难以匹配的新事实：t年跨州迁移率与t的平方根成正比。新模型保留了标准迁移模型的易处理性和灵活性，但能更好地匹配迁移的动态特征，包括这一新事实。该模型在福利含义上具有显著差异，并得出不同的反事实预测，尤其是在动态调整和长期响应方面。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag049.title: The Dynamics of Internal Migration: A New Fact and its Implications
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag049.title_zh: 内部迁移的动态：一个新事实及其启示

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag050.abstract: This article presents a theoretical case for replacement of conventional heteroskedasticity-consistent and cluster-robust variance estimators with jackknife variance estimators, in the context of linear regression with heteroskedastic and/or cluster-dependent observations. We examine the bias of variance estimation and the coverage probabilities of confidence intervals. Concerning bias, we show that conventional variance estimators have full downward worst-case bias, while our jackknife variance estimator is never downward biased. Concerning confidence intervals, we show that intervals based on conventional standard errors have worst-case coverage equalling zero, while the jackknife-based confidence interval has coverage probability bounded by the Cauchy distribution, under the auxiliary assumption of normal errors. We also extend the Bell and McCaffrey (2002) student t approximation to our jackknife t-ratio, resulting in confidence intervals with improved coverage probabilities. Our theory holds under broad assumptions, allowing arbitrary cluster sizes, regressor leverage, within-cluster correlation, heteroskedasticity, regression with a single treated cluster, fixed effects, and delete-cluster invertibility failures. Our theoretical findings are consistent with the extensive simulation literature investigating heteroskedasticity-consistent and cluster-robust variance estimation.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag050.abstract_zh: 本文在异方差和/或聚类相关观测的线性回归背景下，从理论上论证了用刀切法方差估计量替代传统异方差一致性和聚类稳健方差估计量的合理性。我们考察了方差估计的偏差以及置信区间的覆盖概率。关于偏差，我们证明传统方差估计量具有完全向下的最坏情况偏差，而我们的刀切法方差估计量从未出现向下偏差。关于置信区间，我们证明基于传统标准误的区间在最坏情况下覆盖概率为零，而在正态误差辅助假设下，基于刀切法的置信区间覆盖概率受柯西分布约束。我们还将Bell和McCaffrey（2002）的学生t近似方法推广到我们的刀切法t比率，从而得到覆盖概率改进的置信区间。我们的理论在广泛假设下成立，允许任意聚类规模、回归变量杠杆、聚类内相关性、异方差性、单一处理聚类的回归、固定效应以及删除聚类可逆性失效的情况。我们的理论发现与大量关于异方差一致性和聚类稳健方差估计的模拟研究文献一致。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag050.title: Jackknife Standard Errors for Clustered Regression
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag050.title_zh: 聚类回归的刀切标准误

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag051.abstract: We implement Pigovian transport pricing in a field experiment in urban agglomerations of Switzerland over the course of 8 weeks. Our pricing considers the external costs from climate damages, health outcomes from pollution, accidents and physical activity, and congestion. It varies across time, space and mode of transport and is deducted from a budget provided to GPS-tracked participants. The treatment significantly reduces the external costs of transport during the course of the experiment. The main underlying mechanism is a shift away from driving towards other modes, such as public transport, walking and cycling. Providing information about the external costs of transport alone is insufficient to change the transport behavior for the sample majority. A time-invariant tax on CO2 and health-related externalities would capture most of the welfare gains associated with the first-best policy.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag051.abstract_zh: 我们在瑞士城市群开展了一项为期8周的实地实验，实施了庇古式交通定价方案。该定价体系综合考虑了气候变化损害、污染导致的健康影响、交通事故、体力活动以及交通拥堵等外部成本，并根据时间、空间和交通方式动态调整。定价金额从提供给GPS追踪参与者的预算中扣除。实验期间，该干预措施显著降低了交通的外部成本。其主要作用机制是促使参与者从驾车出行转向公共交通、步行和骑行等其他交通方式。仅提供交通外部成本信息不足以改变样本中多数人的出行行为。对二氧化碳和健康相关外部性征收时间不变的税收，将能获取与最优政策相关的大部分福利收益。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag051.title: Pigovian Transport Pricing in Practice

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag052.abstract: For many technologies and behaviors, an agent’s benefit from adopting depends on his contacts adopting, and the benefit to his contacts of adopting depends on their contacts adopting. This paper examines how the architecture of these connections shapes the success or failure of the diffusion of innovations. We start with a standard model of diffusion with the key addition that some agents can coordinate their decisions. This captures the idea that people often talk and make decisions together with friends or family to adopt technologies. We show that insularity of connections, that is, the extent to which agents tend to concentrate their connections to a narrow set of other agents, determines contagion. However, whether insularity helps or hinders depends on the technology being diffused. For technologies that are valuable even without many contacts adopting, we find insular connections hinder adoption, but for technologies that are valuable only when many contacts adopt, insular connections facilitate adoption.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag052.abstract_zh: 对于许多技术及行为而言，个体采纳的收益取决于其社交圈中他人的采纳情况，而他人采纳的收益又取决于其自身社交圈的采纳状况。本文探讨了这些连接结构如何影响创新扩散的成败。我们以标准扩散模型为基础，关键创新在于允许部分主体协调其决策。这反映了人们常与亲友共同商议并决定是否采纳技术的现实。研究表明，连接的封闭性——即个体将连接集中于狭窄群体的程度——决定了传染效应。然而，封闭性对扩散的促进或阻碍作用取决于技术特性：对于无需大量社交圈采纳即可产生价值的技术，封闭性会抑制采纳；而对于需依赖大量社交圈采纳才能体现价值的技术，封闭性反而促进采纳。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag052.title: The Architecture of Social Networks and the Diffusion of Innovations
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag052.title_zh: 社交网络结构与创新扩散

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag053.abstract: We propose a novel channel through which rising income inequality affects job creation and macroeconomic outcomes. High-income households save relatively more in stocks and bonds but less in bank deposits. A rising top income share thereby increases the relative financing cost for bank-dependent firms, which in turn create fewer jobs compared to other firms. Exploiting variation in top income shares across US states and an instrumental variable strategy, we provide evidence for this channel. We then build a general equilibrium macroeconomic model with heterogeneous households and heterogeneous firms and calibrate it to our empirical estimates. The model shows that the secular rise in top incomes accounts for 13% of the decline in the employment share of small firms since 1980. Through the new channel, rising inequality also reduces the labor share and aggregate output. Model experiments show that ignoring the link between inequality and job creation understates welfare effects of income redistribution.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag053.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新的传导渠道，通过该渠道，收入不平等加剧会影响就业创造和宏观经济结果。高收入家庭将更多储蓄配置于股票和债券，而较少存入银行存款。因此，顶层收入份额的上升提高了依赖银行融资的企业的相对融资成本，导致这些企业创造的就业岗位少于其他企业。利用美国各州顶层收入份额的差异以及工具变量策略，我们为这一传导渠道提供了证据。随后，我们构建了一个包含异质性家庭和异质性企业的一般均衡宏观经济模型，并根据实证估计结果对其进行校准。模型显示，自1980年以来，顶层收入份额的长期上升解释了小企业就业份额下降的13%。通过这一新渠道，收入不平等加剧还降低了劳动收入份额和总产出。模型实验表明，忽视不平等与就业创造之间的关联会低估收入再分配的福利效应。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag053.title: Income Inequality and Job Creation
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag053.title_zh: 收入不平等与就业创造

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag054.abstract: We investigate optimal monetary and macroprudential policies in an open economy with aggregate demand externalities and an occasionally binding zero lower bound constraint. Our analysis highlights that the optimal policy balances output stabilization and capital flow management. When macroprudential policy is available, monetary policy stabilizes the output gap. By contrast, when macroprudential policy is not available, monetary policy is used prudentially. However, contrary to a widespread view, raising the interest rate is not necessarily the optimal prudential policy. Finally, we show that international spillovers operate through the world real rate, but macroprudential policies provide insulation from the adverse effects of foreign policies.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag054.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在存在总需求外部性和零下限约束偶尔生效的开放经济体中，最优货币政策和宏观审慎政策的制定。我们的分析强调，最优政策需要在产出稳定与资本流动管理之间取得平衡。当宏观审慎政策可用时，货币政策用于稳定产出缺口。相反，当宏观审慎政策不可用时，货币政策被审慎地使用。然而，与普遍观点相反，提高利率并非最优的审慎政策。最后，我们表明国际溢出效应通过世界实际利率传导，但宏观审慎政策能够抵御外国政策的不利影响。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag054.title: Liquidity Traps, Prudential Policies and International Spillovers
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag054.title_zh: 流动性陷阱、审慎政策与国际溢出效应

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag055.abstract: We exploit Germany’s temporary three-percentage-point VAT cut in the second half of 2020 to study the spending response to unconventional fiscal policy. We use survey and scanner data on household consumption expenditures and their perceived pass-through of the tax change into prices, and a HANK model to quantify the effects of this VAT policy. The survey and scanner data show that the temporary VAT reduction led to a relative increase in durable and, to a lesser extent, semi-durable spending for individuals with high perceived pass-through. According to the HANK model, the VAT policy increased total aggregate consumption spending by 4.4 percent on impact.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag055.abstract_zh: 本文利用德国2020年下半年临时性下调增值税三个百分点的政策，研究非传统财政政策对消费支出的影响。我们采用家庭消费支出的调查与扫描数据，以及消费者对税改价格传导的感知程度，并借助HANK模型量化该增值税政策的效果。调查与扫描数据显示，对于感知传导程度较高的群体，临时性增值税下调显著提升了耐用品支出，半耐用品支出也有较小幅度的增长。根据HANK模型测算，该增值税政策在实施初期使总消费支出增加了4.4%。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag055.title: A Temporary VAT Cut as Unconventional Fiscal Policy
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag055.title_zh: 作为非常规财政政策的临时增值税减免

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag056.abstract: We study the labor market effects of permanent 30-64% reductions in unemployment insurance benefits available in seven states. Leveraging linked firm-establishment data, we find that establishments based in reform states experience employment increases that are 0.8-1.3% larger than those of the same firm's establishments in other states. Using a similar multi-state firm design, starting salaries are 1.2-5.5% lower in reform states and posted salaries for the same job fall by 3.2-3.5%. The negative co-movement of employment and wages after the reform suggests a labor supply shock, and mitigates against confounding changes in labor demand driving the results. Our findings are consistent with workers lowering their reservation wages as outside options fall, and employers taking advantage of this by offering lower wages and increasing employment.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag056.abstract_zh: 我们研究了七个州将失业保险金永久性削减30%-64%对劳动力市场的影响。利用关联的企业-机构数据，我们发现，位于改革州的机构，其就业增长比同一企业在其他州的机构高出0.8-1.3%。采用类似的多州企业设计，改革州的起薪降低了1.2-5.5%，同一职位的公布薪资下降了3.2-3.5%。改革后就业与工资的负向联动表明存在劳动力供给冲击，并排除了劳动力需求变化作为驱动结果的混淆因素。我们的发现与以下结论一致：随着外部选择减少，工人降低保留工资，雇主借此提供更低工资并增加就业。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag056.title: Unemployment Insurance, Starting Salaries, and Jobs: Evidence from Multi-state Firms
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag056.title_zh: 失业保险、起薪与就业：来自多州企业的证据

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag057.abstract: We build a quantitative spatial model in which some workers can substitute on-site effort with work done from home. Ability and propensity to telecommute vary by education and industry. We quantify our framework to match the distribution of jobs and residents across 4,502 U.S. locations. Then we simulate permanent increases in the attractiveness and productivity of telework that lead to greater adoption of hybrid and fully remote work. To validate our model, we show that our results are positively correlated with local changes in residents, jobs, and housing costs since 2019. The rise of telework results in a rich non-monotonic pattern of reallocations of residents and jobs within and across cities. Workers who can telecommute experience welfare gains, and those who cannot suffer losses. Broader access to jobs reduces wage inequality across residential locations, and heralds a partial reversal in the spatial concentration of talent and spending power known as the “Great Divergence.”
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag057.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个量化空间模型，其中部分劳动者可以用居家办公替代现场工作。远程办公的能力与倾向因教育水平和行业类型而异。我们通过量化该框架，使其匹配美国4502个地区的工作岗位与居民分布。随后模拟了远程办公吸引力与生产率永久性提升的情景，这些变化促使混合办公与完全远程办公模式得到更广泛采用。为验证模型有效性，我们展示了研究结果与2019年以来各地区居民、就业岗位及住房成本的本地变化呈正相关。远程办公的兴起导致城市内部及城市间居民与工作岗位出现丰富的非单调性重新配置模式。具备远程办公能力的劳动者获得福利提升，而无法远程办公的劳动者则遭受损失。更广泛的就业机会获取缩小了不同居住地间的工资不平等，预示着被称为"大分化"的人才与消费力空间集聚趋势将出现部分逆转。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag057.title: Spatial Implications of Telecommuting

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag058.abstract: This paper studies competition under information heterogeneity in selection markets and examines the impact of public information regulations aimed at reducing information asymmetries between competing firms. We develop a novel model and introduce new empirical strategies to analyze imperfect competition in markets where firms have heterogeneous information about consumers, vary in cost structures, and offer differentiated products. Using data from the Italian auto insurance market, we find substantial differences in the precision of risk ratings across insurers, and those with less accurate risk-rating algorithms tend to have more efficient cost structures. We assess the equilibrium effects of giving firms equal access to aggregated risk information from a centralized bureau. This policy significantly reduces prices by increasing competition, leading to a 15.7% boost in consumer surplus, almost reaching the efficiency benchmark where firms have full knowledge of consumers’ true risk. Aggregating information through the bureau favors low-risk consumers and reduces average costs by 12 euros per contract through more efficient insurer-insuree matching.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag058.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在选择性市场中信息异质性下的竞争问题，并探讨了旨在减少竞争企业间信息不对称的公共信息监管政策的影响。我们构建了一个新颖的模型，并引入了新的实证策略，以分析企业在消费者信息掌握程度、成本结构差异及产品差异化方面存在异质性的不完全竞争市场。利用意大利汽车保险市场的数据，我们发现不同保险公司的风险评级精度存在显著差异，而风险评级算法精度较低的公司往往拥有更高效的成本结构。我们评估了赋予企业平等获取中央机构汇总风险信息这一政策的均衡效应。该政策通过增强竞争显著降低了价格，使消费者剩余提升15.7%，几乎达到企业完全掌握消费者真实风险时的效率基准。通过中央机构汇总信息有利于低风险消费者，并通过更高效的保险公司与投保人匹配，使每份合同平均成本降低12欧元。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag058.title: Competing under Information Heterogeneity: Evidence from Auto Insurance
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag058.title_zh: 信息异质性下的竞争：来自汽车保险的证据

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag059.abstract: We develop a general model of discrete choice that incorporates peer effects in preferences and consideration sets. We characterize the equilibrium behavior and establish conditions under which all parts of the model can be recovered from a sequence of choices. We allow peers to affect preferences, consideration, or both. We show that these peer-effect mechanisms have different behavioral implications in the data. This allows us to recover the set and the type of connections between the agents in the network. We then use this information to recover each agent’s preferences and consideration mechanisms. These nonparametric identification results allow for general forms of heterogeneity across agents and do not rely on the variation of either exogenous covariates or the set of available options (menus). We apply our results to model expansion decisions by tea chains and find evidence of limited consideration. We simulate counterfactual predictions and show how limited consideration slows market penetration and competition.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag059.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含偏好与考虑集同群效应的离散选择一般模型。我们刻画了均衡行为特征，并建立了可从选择序列中恢复模型所有组成部分的条件。我们允许同群效应影响偏好、考虑集或两者兼有。研究表明，这些同群效应机制在数据中具有不同的行为含义，从而能够识别网络中各主体之间的连接集合与类型。基于此信息，我们进一步恢复每个主体的偏好与考虑机制。这些非参数识别结果允许主体间存在一般形式的异质性，且不依赖于外生协变量或可选方案集（菜单）的变化。我们将模型应用于茶饮连锁店的扩张决策分析，发现了有限考虑的证据。通过反事实预测模拟，我们揭示了有限考虑如何减缓市场渗透与竞争。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag059.title: Peer Effects in Consideration and Preferences
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag059.title_zh: 考虑与偏好中的同伴效应

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag060.abstract: Business dynamism -- the process of firm entry, growth and exit -- lies at the heart of modern endogenous growth models. While productivity differences have traditionally been seen as the main driving forces of business dynamism, a growing body of evidence suggests that customer acquisition is at least as important. In light of this evidence, we propose a novel endogenous growth model in which innovating firms must first acquire customers to sell their products. Estimating our model with aggregate and firm-level data, we find that expansions of firms' customer bases (market sizes) boost their incentives to innovate and shift resources towards high-growth businesses (“gazelles”). Combined, these effects explain over 40% of aggregate growth and substantially change predictions about the efficacy of growth policies. Finally, we document support for key model predictions using firm-level micro-data.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag060.abstract_zh: 商业活力——企业进入、成长与退出的过程——是现代内生增长模型的核心。尽管生产率差异传统上被视为商业活力的主要驱动力，但越来越多的证据表明，客户获取至少同样重要。基于这一证据，我们提出了一种新颖的内生增长模型，其中创新企业必须首先获取客户才能销售其产品。通过使用总体数据和企业层面数据估计该模型，我们发现企业客户基础（市场规模）的扩张会增强其创新激励，并将资源转向高增长企业（“瞪羚企业”）。综合来看，这些效应解释了超过40%的总体增长，并显著改变了关于增长政策有效性的预测。最后，我们利用企业层面微观数据为模型的关键预测提供了支持证据。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag060.title: Customer Acquisition, Business Dynamism and Aggregate Growth
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag060.title_zh: 客户获取、商业活力与总体增长

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag061.abstract: We investigate how technologies that reduce the costs of monitoring by central authorities have shaped the historical transition from small patrimonial states to large bureaucratic organizations. Our analysis is based on a novel dataset that traces changes in the organizational structure and geographic presence of the U.S. federal government over the nineteenth century. To identify causal effects, we develop a new identification strategy that exploits the expansion of the railroad network as a source of variation in the travel time–and thus monitoring costs–between Washington D.C. and other locations. We present three main findings. First, reductions in travel time to Washington D.C. significantly increased the likelihood of federal government presence in a location. Second, this effect is stronger for occupations and tasks characterized by more severe agency problems. Third, decreases in travel time to Washington D.C. are associated with a decline in patrimonial features of the federal government in the location, in line with enhanced monitoring capacity reducing dependence on personal trust and connections.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag061.abstract_zh: 我们研究了中央机构降低监控成本的技术如何塑造了从小型世袭国家向大型官僚组织的历史转型。我们的分析基于一个新颖的数据集，该数据集追踪了19世纪美国联邦政府组织结构与地理分布的变化。为识别因果效应，我们开发了一种新的识别策略，利用铁路网络的扩张作为华盛顿特区与其他地点之间旅行时间（即监控成本）变化的来源。我们提出三项主要发现：第一，前往华盛顿特区旅行时间的缩短显著增加了联邦政府在某一地点设立机构的可能性；第二，这种效应在代理问题更严重的职业和任务中更为显著；第三，前往华盛顿特区旅行时间的减少与当地联邦政府世袭特征的减弱相关，这与监控能力增强减少了对个人信任和关系依赖的结论一致。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag061.title: State Capacity as an Organizational Problem
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag061.title_zh: 组织能力作为一个组织问题

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag062.abstract: We consider an oligopoly model in which each firm chooses not only its price but also its advertising strategy regarding how much, and what, product information to provide.
