To highlight firms' strategic incentives, we impose no structural restrictions on feasible advertising content, so that each firm can disclose or conceal any information. We obtain a comprehensive characterization of the equilibrium advertising strategy and provide some sufficient conditions for the existence of symmetric pure-price equilibria. We show that intense competition induces firms to provide accurate product information; firms usually obfuscate consumers' relatively low or high values; and requiring firms to provide more product information can reduce social surplus and also be harmful to consumers.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag062.abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个寡头垄断模型，其中每个企业不仅选择其价格，还选择其广告策略，即提供多少以及何种产品信息。为突出企业的策略性激励，我们对可行的广告内容不施加任何结构性限制，因此每个企业可以披露或隐瞒任何信息。我们全面刻画了均衡广告策略的特征，并给出了对称纯价格均衡存在的一些充分条件。研究表明，激烈的竞争会促使企业提供准确的产品信息；企业通常会模糊消费者相对较低或较高的价值；而要求企业提供更多产品信息可能会减少社会剩余，并对消费者造成损害。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag062.title: Competitive Advertising and Pricing

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag063.abstract: We study the role of public risk-sharing in markets where firms face substantial cost uncertainty, focusing on public reinsurance in health insurance. We develop a model where insurers internalize cost uncertainty through risk charges that raise effective marginal costs, and create a role for reinsurance. Public reinsurance lowers both expected costs and cost volatility, particularly for smaller insurers, reducing prices and enhancing competition. Using an event study of staggered state-level reinsurance programs, we show that public reinsurance leads insurers to lower prices and private reinsurance purchases, benefiting financially constrained insurers the most. Structural estimates indicate that risk charges account for a substantial share of the premium-cost wedge, and highlight public reinsurance's comparative advantage over premium subsidies by providing risk protection and enhancing competition. Our results underscore the importance of accounting for firms’ risk exposure in policy design and provide a general framework for understanding public risk-sharing policies.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag063.abstract_zh: 我们研究了企业在面临巨大成本不确定性时，公共风险分担的作用，重点关注健康保险中的公共再保险。我们构建了一个模型，其中保险公司通过风险费用将成本不确定性内部化，这提高了有效边际成本，并为再保险创造了作用空间。公共再保险降低了预期成本和成本波动性，尤其对小型保险公司而言，从而降低了价格并增强了竞争。通过一项针对各州级再保险项目交错实施的事件研究，我们证明公共再保险促使保险公司降低价格和私人再保险购买量，其中财务受限的保险公司受益最大。结构估计表明，风险费用在保费与成本差额中占很大比重，并凸显了公共再保险相较于保费补贴的比较优势，因为它能提供风险保护并增强竞争。我们的研究结果强调了在政策设计中考虑企业风险暴露的重要性，并为理解公共风险分担政策提供了一个通用框架。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag063.title: Insurer Risk and Public Risk-Sharing: Quantifying the Value of Reinsurance
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag063.title_zh: 保险公司风险与公共风险分担：再保险价值的量化

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag064.abstract: In many markets, buyers make discrete choices between differentiated products and negotiate prices that are specific to the choice. We develop for estimation a model for this class of markets which is consistent with non-cooperative models of bargaining between a buyer and competing sellers. We show that when the buyer's utility has GEV disturbances, the model has a tractable likelihood function which can be used with transaction-level data giving the selected product and its price. We estimate the model using data from the UK brick industry and use it to measure market power and analyze mergers. We analyze how spatial differentiation and ownership concentration affect the distribution of market power across transactions. In counterfactuals we find that switching from individually-negotiated to uniform pricing causes markups, and merger price effects, to increase on average but to decrease for a minority of transactions.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag064.abstract_zh: 在许多市场中，买家在差异化产品之间进行离散选择，并协商与选择相关的特定价格。我们针对这类市场开发了一个用于估计的模型，该模型与买家与竞争卖家之间非合作议价模型保持一致。我们证明，当买家效用具有广义极值（GEV）扰动时，该模型具有易于处理的似然函数，可结合提供所选产品及其价格的交易层面数据进行使用。我们利用英国砖业行业的数据对该模型进行估计，并以此衡量市场势力及分析并购。我们研究了空间差异化和所有权集中度如何影响交易间市场势力的分布。在反事实分析中，我们发现从单独协商定价转向统一定价会导致平均加成率及并购价格效应上升，但少数交易的加成率及并购价格效应反而下降。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag064.title: Competition in a Spatially-Differentiated Product Market with Negotiated Prices
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag064.title_zh: 谈判价格下的空间差异化产品市场竞争

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag065.abstract: I develop a unified theoretical framework with schools and residential choices to study the welfare consequences of public schools’ switching from the traditional neighborhood assignment to the deferred acceptance mechanism. I find that when families receive higher priorities at neighborhood schools, the deferred acceptance mechanism creates higher aggregate or utilitarian welfare than neighborhood assignment. Under a common school ranking assumption, I also show that the deferred acceptance creates higher aggregate welfare with neighborhood priorities than without them.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag065.abstract_zh: 我构建了一个包含学校与居住选择的统一理论框架，用以研究公立学校从传统学区分配转向延迟接受机制所带来的福利影响。研究发现，当家庭在学区学校获得更高优先级时，延迟接受机制相较于学区分配能产生更高的总体或功利主义福利。在共同学校排名假设下，我还证明，相较于无学区优先级的情形，带有学区优先级的延迟接受机制能创造更高的总体福利。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag065.title: School Choice and the Housing Market

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag066.abstract: We study empirically and theoretically the effects of international financial flows on resource allocation. Using the universe of firms in Hungary, we show that removing capital controls lowers firms’ cost of capital and increases household consumption, with the latter playing a dominant role. The consumption channel leads to reallocation of resources toward high expenditure elasticity activities – such as services – promoting both the expansion of incumbents and firm entry. A multi-sector heterogeneous firm model replicates these dynamics. Our model shows that non-homotheticity in consumption can quantitatively account for the reallocation of resources towards services and successfully replicates the dynamics of aggregate productivity following episodes of financial openness.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag066.abstract_zh: 我们通过实证与理论研究国际金融流动对资源配置的影响。利用匈牙利全部企业数据，我们发现取消资本管制降低了企业的资本成本并增加了家庭消费，其中消费渠道起主导作用。消费渠道导致资源向高支出弹性活动（如服务业）重新配置，既促进了现有企业的扩张，也推动了新企业进入。一个多部门异质性企业模型复现了这些动态变化。我们的模型表明，消费中的非位似性能够从数量上解释资源向服务业重新配置的现象，并成功复现了金融开放后全要素生产率的动态变化。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag066.title: The Micro and Macro Dynamics of Capital Flows
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag066.title_zh: 资本流动的微观与宏观动态

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag067.abstract: We explore the power that precise information about consumers’ preferences grants an intermediary in shaping competition. We think of an intermediary as an information designer who chooses what information to reveal to firms, which then compete à la Bertrand in a differentiated product market. We analyze the information designs that maximize consumer and producer surplus and uncover systematic differences in how information can be used to intensify or soften competition. Our analysis demonstrates the power that users’ data can endow intermediaries with and speaks directly to current regulatory debates regarding digital marketplaces.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag067.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了关于消费者偏好的精确信息赋予中间商在塑造竞争中的力量。我们将中间商视为信息设计者，由其选择向企业披露何种信息，随后企业在差异化产品市场中展开伯特兰式竞争。我们分析了最大化消费者剩余和生产者剩余的信息设计，揭示了信息在强化或缓和竞争方面可被系统性运用的差异。我们的分析表明，用户数据能够赋予中间商巨大力量，并直接回应了当前关于数字市场的监管辩论。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag067.title: Market Segmentation through Information
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag067.title_zh: 基于信息分割的市场细分

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag068.abstract: I propose a model of skill-replacing routine-biased technological change (SR-RBTC). In this model, technology substitutes for the use of skill in routine tasks, in contrast to standard RBTC models, which assume that technology replaces the workers themselves. The SR-RBTC model explains three key trends that are inconsistent with standard RBTC models: 1) why specifically middle wages declined even though workers in routine occupations are dispersed across the entire bottom half of the wage distribution, 2) why middle wages stopped declining while technological change continued, and 3) why there is no substantial decline in the average wage of workers in routine occupations. I derive two new testable predictions from the model: a decrease in the return to skill and a decrease in skill level in routine occupations. I use an interactive fixed-effects model to confirm both predictions. Since SR-RBTC violates the ignorability assumption required by standard decomposition methods, I introduce a “skewness decomposition” to show that SR-RBTC is the main driver of bottom-half inequality trends.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag068.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个技能替代型常规偏向技术变革（SR-RBTC）模型。在该模型中，技术替代了常规任务中的技能使用，这与标准RBTC模型（假设技术替代工人本身）形成对比。SR-RBTC模型解释了与标准RBTC模型不一致的三个关键趋势：1）尽管常规职业的工人分散于工资分布整个下半部分，但为何中位数工资出现下降；2）为何在技术持续变革的背景下，中位数工资停止下降；3）为何常规职业工人的平均工资未出现显著下降。基于该模型，我推导出两个可检验的新预测：常规职业的技能回报率下降以及技能水平下降。通过交互固定效应模型，这两个预测均得到验证。由于SR-RBTC违背了标准分解方法所需的可忽略性假设，我引入“偏度分解”方法，证明SR-RBTC是下半部分工资不平等趋势的主要驱动因素。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag068.title: Skill-Replacing Technology and Bottom-Half Inequality
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag068.title_zh: 技能替代型技术与底层收入不平等

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag070.abstract: We introduce a survey instrument to measure earnings risk allowing for the possibility of quitting or being fired from the current job. We find these transitions to be the key drivers of subjective risk. A link with administrative data provides multiple credibility checks and reveals that subjective earnings risk varies systematically across the population. It is also many times smaller than traditional estimates even when conditioning richly on demographics and job history. We show that subjective earnings risk can help explain why many hold limited liquid assets.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag070.abstract_zh: 我们引入了一种调查工具，用于衡量允许当前工作辞职或被解雇可能性的收入风险。我们发现，这些工作转换是主观风险的关键驱动因素。通过与行政数据的关联，我们进行了多项可信度检验，并揭示出主观收入风险在人群中存在系统性差异。即使在对人口统计特征和工作历史进行丰富条件控制后，主观收入风险仍远小于传统估计值。我们证明，主观收入风险有助于解释为何许多人持有有限的流动资产。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag070.title: Subjective Earnings Risk

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag071.abstract: This paper studies the impact of income-based criminal punishments on crime. In Finland, speeding tickets become income-dependent if the driver’s speed exceeds the speeding limit by more than 20 km/h, leading to a substantial jump in the size of the speeding ticket. Contrary to predictions of a traditional Becker model, individuals do not bunch below the fine hike. Instead, the speeding distributions are smooth at the cutoff. However, I demonstrate that the size of the realized speeding ticket has sizable, but short-lived, impacts on reoffending. I use a regression discontinuity design to show that fines that are, on average, 200 euros larger decrease reoffending by 15 percent in the following six months. The drop in reoffending is driven by high-income individuals facing the highest fine at the cutoff. I estimate that a fixed fine hike that matches the current deterrence effect would raise the fine increase faced by the bottom income quartile by about 300% at the cutoff, relative to the increase they face under the current income-based schedule. My empirical results are consistent with an explanation that people operate under information frictions. To illustrate this, I construct a Becker model with misperception and learning that can explain all the empirical findings.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag071.abstract_zh: 本文研究了基于收入的刑事处罚对犯罪的影响。在芬兰，当驾驶员超速超过限速20公里/小时以上时，罚单金额与收入挂钩，导致罚款数额大幅跃升。与传统贝克尔模型的预测相反，个体并未在罚款激增点以下聚集，超速分布在该临界点处平滑。然而，本文证明实际罚单金额对再犯行为具有显著但短暂的影响。利用断点回归设计，本文发现平均高出200欧元的罚款使随后六个月的再犯率降低15%。再犯率的下降主要由临界点处面临最高罚款的高收入群体驱动。本文估算，若采用固定罚款增幅以匹配当前威慑效果，则相对于现行基于收入的罚款方案，底层收入四分位群体在临界点面临的罚款增幅将提高约300%。实证结果与个体存在信息摩擦的解释一致。为阐明这一点，本文构建了包含认知偏差与学习机制的贝克尔模型，该模型能够解释所有实证发现。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag071.title: How Do People React to Income-Based Fines? Evidence from Speeding Tickets Discontinuities
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag071.title_zh: 人们如何应对基于收入的罚款？来自超速罚单断点回归的证据

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag074.abstract: In a data economy, transactions of goods and services generate data, which is stored, traded and depreciates. How are the economics of this economy different from traditional production economies? How do these differences matter for measurement of GDP, firm values, depreciation rates, welfare and externalities? We incorporate active experimentation and data as an intangible asset to devise a tractable recursive representation of the data economy. The model rationalizes why apps are often “free” and why even non-digital economic activity might be greater than GDP suggests. Calibrating the model using a combination of macroeconomic and financial moments suggests that the mis-measurement in U.S. GDP due to missing value of data has been as high as 6% in 2018.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag074.abstract_zh: 在数据经济中，商品和服务的交易会产生数据，这些数据被存储、交易并发生折旧。这种经济体的经济学原理与传统生产经济体有何不同？这些差异如何影响GDP、企业价值、折旧率、福利和外部性的衡量？我们将主动实验和数据作为无形资产纳入考量，构建了一个易于处理的数据经济递归表示模型。该模型解释了为何应用程序通常“免费”，以及为何即使是非数字经济活动也可能大于GDP所显示的水平。通过结合宏观经济和金融时刻对模型进行校准，结果表明，由于数据价值缺失，2018年美国GDP的测量误差高达6%。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag074.title: A Model of the Data Economy

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag075.abstract: We study structural change in production networks for intermediate inputs (inputoutput network) and new capital (investment network). For each network, we document that the share of output produced by services (relative to goods) is rising over time. While the relative prices of services that produce intermediates and consumption are rising, we find that the relative price of services that produce investment is falling over time. We then develop a multi-sector growth model to study these trends and their implications for economic growth. To match the relative price trends, inputs to intermediates production are complements and inputs to investment production are substitutes. Hence, structural change endogenously reallocates resources to the slowest growing intermediates producers and the fastest growing investment producers. Growth accounting exercises reveal that investment-specific technical change accounts for an increasing share of U.S. aggregate growth, with 20% of aggregate growth since 2000 due to investment structural change. Growth projections from our model show that structural change within investment networks alone can offset stagnating or declining growth in other sectors due to Baumol’s cost disease.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag075.abstract_zh: 本文研究了中间投入品生产网络（投入产出网络）与新资本生产网络（投资网络）中的结构变迁。针对每个网络，我们记录到服务业（相对于商品）的产出份额随时间推移而上升。尽管生产中间品和消费品的服务业相对价格在上升，但我们发现生产投资品的服务业相对价格却在下降。随后，我们构建了一个多部门增长模型来研究这些趋势及其对经济增长的影响。为匹配相对价格趋势，中间品生产的投入要素具有互补性，而投资品生产的投入要素具有替代性。因此，结构变迁内生地将资源重新配置给增长最慢的中间品生产部门与增长最快的投资品生产部门。增长核算分析表明，投资专用型技术变革在美国总体增长中的占比持续上升，自2000年以来总体增长的20%归因于投资结构变迁。模型增长预测显示，仅投资网络内部的结构变迁即可抵消因鲍莫尔成本病导致的其他部门增长停滞或下降的影响。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag075.title: Structural Change in Production Networks and Economic Growth
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag075.title_zh: 生产网络中的结构变化与经济增长

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag076.abstract: We conduct an experimental analysis of selective disclosure in communication. In the model, an informed sender aims to influence a receiver by disclosing verifiable evidence that is selected from a larger pool of available evidence. Our experimental design leverages this model’s rich comparative statics, allowing us to systematically quantify the effects of selection relative to concealment. Our findings confirm the key qualitative predictions of the theory, suggesting that selection, rather than concealment, is often the dominant distortion in communication. We also identify deviations from the theory: Some senders are “deception averse” and overcommunicate relative to predictions; receivers respond too optimistically to both concealed and selected evidence, with errors of similar magnitude. Yet selection generates greater overall distortion in receiver behavior because it is far more prevalent than concealment.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag076.abstract_zh: 我们针对沟通中的选择性披露进行了实验分析。在该模型中，掌握信息的发送者旨在通过披露从更大可用证据池中筛选出的可验证证据来影响接收者。我们的实验设计利用了该模型丰富的比较静态分析特性，从而能够系统量化选择相对于隐瞒的影响。研究结果证实了理论的关键定性预测，表明在沟通中，选择而非隐瞒往往是主导性扭曲。同时，我们也发现了与理论的偏离：部分发送者存在“欺骗厌恶”倾向，其沟通程度高于理论预测；接收者对隐瞒和选择证据的反应均过于乐观，且误差幅度相近。然而，由于选择比隐瞒更为普遍，它在接收者行为中造成了更大的整体扭曲。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag076.title: The Selective Disclosure of Evidence: An Experiment
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag076.title_zh: 证据的选择性披露：一项实验

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag077.abstract: We show that the formalization of representativeness (Kahneman and Tversky (1972)) developed by Gennaioli and Shleifer (2010) features an intrinsic connection between uncertainty and overreaction. In the time series domain, we develop this connection in a smooth version of Diagnostic Expectations (DE), where overreaction varies smoothly with uncertainty. Intuitively, under smoothness, lower uncertainty leaves less room for representativeness to distort beliefs. Smooth DE provides a joint, parsimonious micro-foundation for key features of survey data: overreaction to news, stronger overreaction at longer horizons, overconfidence in subjective uncertainty, and a new stylized fact documented here—overreaction intensifies with higher uncertainty. An analytical Real Business Cycle model with Smooth DE accounts for survey overreaction and overconfidence, as well as three salient business cycle properties: asymmetry, countercyclical macro volatility, and countercyclical micro volatility.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag077.abstract_zh: 我们证明，由Gennaioli和Shleifer（2010）发展的代表性启发式形式化（Kahneman和Tversky（1972））具有不确定性与过度反应之间的内在联系。在时间序列领域，我们通过平滑版本的诊断预期（DE）来发展这一联系，其中过度反应随不确定性平滑变化。直观而言，在平滑条件下，较低的不确定性为代表性启发式扭曲信念留下了更少空间。平滑DE为调查数据的关键特征提供了简洁统一的微观基础：对新闻的过度反应、更长预测期限下更强的过度反应、主观不确定性中的过度自信，以及本文记录的新典型事实——过度反应随不确定性升高而加剧。基于平滑DE的分析性真实商业周期模型不仅解释了调查中的过度反应与过度自信，还解释了三个显著的商业周期特征：非对称性、逆周期的宏观波动性以及逆周期的微观波动性。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag077.title: Smooth Diagnostic Expectations

doi:10.1093/restud/rdag079.abstract: Racial covenants in housing deeds were widely used in the United States during the early 20th century to segregate neighborhoods. In 1948, the Supreme Court decision in Shelley v. Kraemer made racial covenants unenforceable in court, stopping short of prohibiting them entirely. We surmise that even after losing their judicial enforceability, such covenants could have shaped segregation if they served as a focal point for coordination on an initial equilibrium in neighborhood formation, a context characterized by investment durability and path dependency. To test this hypothesis, we assemble novel parcel-level data on racial covenants and develop a quasi-experimental design that exploits delays between covenant execution and housing construction to isolate exposure to enforceable covenants at the time neighborhoods were built. Covenant enforceability indeed affected early-stage neighborhood formation in terms of housing characteristics, public infrastructure placement, and the composition of initial residents. These early differences proved durable: Enforceable covenants account for 6–24% of the observed neighborhood racial segregation from 1980 to 2020 and 3.1–4.4% of housing price differentials in the 21st century. We conclude that by coordinating beliefs and decisions during neighborhood formation, the law generated spatial inequality that has long outlived racial covenants themselves.
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag079.abstract_zh: 20世纪初，美国住房契约中的种族限制条款被广泛用于实施社区隔离。1948年，最高法院在谢利诉克雷默案中裁定此类条款在法庭上不可强制执行，但并未完全禁止其存在。我们推测，即便失去司法强制力，这些条款仍可能通过充当社区形成初期均衡协调的焦点机制（在投资耐久性与路径依赖特征显著的背景下）影响种族隔离格局。为验证这一假说，我们构建了包含种族限制条款的新型宗地级数据集，并利用条款执行与住房建设之间的时间差设计准实验框架，以识别社区建设时期可执行条款的暴露程度。研究发现，条款的可执行性确实影响了社区形成初期的住房特征、公共基础设施布局及首批居民构成。这些早期差异展现出持久性：可执行条款可解释1980-2020年间观测到的社区种族隔离现象的6-24%，以及21世纪房价差异的3.1-4.4%。我们得出结论：法律通过协调社区形成过程中的信念与决策，催生了远超种族限制条款存续期的空间不平等。
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag079.title: The Long Shadow of Housing Discrimination: Evidence from Racial Covenants
doi:10.1093/restud/rdag079.title_zh: 住房歧视的长期阴影：来自种族契约的证据

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhaf079.abstract: We examine how macroeconomic expectations affect consumer decisions, using an experiment with 2,872 credit card customers at a large commercial bank. In the experiment, participants are randomized into receiving expert forecasts of inflation and the nominal exchange rate. We find that forecasts shift inflation and exchange rate expectations, but do not change spending or self-reported consumption plans as predicted by standard models of intertemporal choice. Results from a supplementary survey experiment suggest that consumers are sophisticated enough to anticipate nominal rigidities and reduce spending on durables for precautionary reasons, counteracting the effects predicted by standard models of intertemporal optimization.
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhaf079.abstract_zh: 我们通过一项涉及某大型商业银行2872名信用卡客户的实验，考察宏观经济预期如何影响消费者决策。实验中，参与者被随机分配接收专家对通胀率和名义汇率的预测。研究发现，预测信息会改变通胀率和汇率预期，但并未如标准跨期选择模型所预测的那样改变支出或自我报告的消费计划。一项补充调查实验的结果表明，消费者足够成熟，能够预见到名义刚性，并出于预防性动机减少耐用品支出，从而抵消了标准跨期优化模型所预测的影响。
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhaf079.title: Macroeconomic Expectations and Credit Card Spending
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhaf079.title_zh: 宏观经济预期与信用卡支出

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag013.abstract: A core responsibility of the Federal Reserve is to ensure financial stability by acting as the lender of last resort through its Discount Window (DW). The DW, however, has not been effective because its usage is stigmatized. In this paper, we use theory and experiments to study how such stigma can be cured. We find that behavioral inertia makes it difficult to fix a stigmatized DW, but adding a new backstop facility can help mitigate stigma. These results are consistent with the Federal Reserve’s experience. (JEL E58, G01, C92)
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag013.abstract_zh: 美联储的核心职责之一是通过贴现窗口（DW）履行最后贷款人职能，以维护金融稳定。然而，由于使用贴现窗口存在污名化问题，其实际效果并不理想。本文通过理论分析与实验研究，探讨如何消除此类污名化现象。研究发现，行为惯性使得修复污名化的贴现窗口面临困难，但增设新的后备融资工具有助于缓解污名化问题。这一结论与美联储的实际经验相吻合。（JEL分类号：E58, G01, C92）
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag013.title: Can Discount Window Stigma Be Cured? An Experimental Investigation
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag013.title_zh: 贴现窗口污名能被消除吗？一项实验研究

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag020.abstract: We examine the informativeness of fund risk disclosure by combining fund returns and textual data. We develop a novel measure, INF, to capture the explanatory power of disclosed risks for fund returns. Average INF is 55% after controlling for market risk and remains 26–29% after excluding risks related to fund name or strategy. We explain variations in INF through disclosure costs and benefits: (1) Funds with less informative disclosures face SEC comment letters and reduced flow, (2) informative disclosures attract institutional flows, and (3) performance concerns may disincentivize disclosure. Overall, funds face trade-offs between transparency and maintaining their competitive advantage. (JEL G12)
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag020.abstract_zh: 我们通过结合基金收益与文本数据，考察了基金风险披露的信息含量。我们构建了一个新颖的指标INF，用以衡量已披露风险对基金收益的解释力。在控制市场风险后，平均INF为55%；在剔除与基金名称或策略相关的风险后，该指标仍保持在26%至29%之间。我们通过披露成本与收益来解释INF的差异：（1）信息披露含量较低的基金会收到美国证券交易委员会的意见函，并面临资金流入减少；（2）信息含量高的披露能吸引机构资金流入；（3）业绩担忧可能抑制披露意愿。总体而言，基金在透明度与维持竞争优势之间面临权衡。（JEL G12）
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag020.title: Do Mutual Funds Walk the Talk? Evidence from Fund Risk Disclosure
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag020.title_zh: 共同基金是否言行一致？来自基金风险披露的证据

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag021.abstract: This study examines whether mutual fund managers generate alpha through thematic investment strategies that select stocks poised to benefit from specific themes. Using textual analysis of 10-K filings, we identify stocks’ thematic exposures and construct each fund’s thematic concentration index (TCI) from its holdings. High-TCI funds significantly outperform, with a top-minus-bottom decile spread of 4.26% in annualized four-factor alpha. Managers’ thematic expertise is related to their undergraduate field of study. Outperformance arises from superior stock selection rather than theme-related timing, with an informational advantage on firm earnings, particularly in stocks exposed to themes related to managers’ undergraduate training.
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag021.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了共同基金经理是否通过主题投资策略（即选择有望从特定主题中受益的股票）创造超额收益。通过对10-K文件进行文本分析，我们识别出股票的主题暴露程度，并根据基金持仓构建了各基金的主题集中指数（TCI）。高TCI基金的表现显著优于其他基金，其最高与最低十分位组合的年化四因子阿尔法差值为4.26%。基金经理的主题专长与其本科专业领域相关。超额收益源于卓越的选股能力而非主题相关时机选择，且这种优势体现在对公司盈利的信息优势上，尤其当股票暴露的主题与基金经理本科专业背景相关时更为显著。
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag021.title: Thematic Concentration and Mutual Fund Performance
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag021.title_zh: 主题集中度与共同基金业绩

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag023.abstract: We study privatization and corporate ownership in transportation infrastructure, focusing on global airports. Privatization in general does not improve performance. However, private equity (PE) ownership has strong and persistent positive effects on efficiency, volume, and quality, with positive externalities for the local economy. We address selection using close auctions where PE and non-PE firms bid. PE funds expand physical capacity and encourage larger planes while adding low-cost carriers and international routes. They are especially effective in countries with more corruption or state-owned flag carriers. In contrast, the poorer performance of non-PE acquirers may reflect private benefits and historical state ties. (JEL G32, G38, L32, R42, H54)
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag023.abstract_zh: 我们研究了交通基础设施中的私有化与企业所有权问题，重点关注全球机场。总体而言，私有化并未改善绩效。然而，私募股权（PE）所有权对效率、运量及质量产生了显著且持久的积极影响，并对当地经济带来正外部性。我们利用PE与非PE企业竞标的封闭式拍卖来处理选择性问题。PE基金扩大物理容量、鼓励使用更大机型，同时引入低成本航空公司和国际航线。在腐败程度较高或存在国有旗舰航空公司的国家，PE的效果尤为显著。相比之下，非PE收购方的较差表现可能反映了私人收益与历史国有关联。（JEL G32, G38, L32, R42, H54）
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag023.title: All Clear for Takeoff: Evidence from Airports on the Effects of Infrastructure Privatization
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag023.title_zh: 基础设施私有化效应的机场证据：一切就绪，准备起飞

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag024.abstract: We analyze optimal cross-country risk sharing and bank capital requirements amid collective moral hazard by governments and banks. Transfers provide insurance but weaken fiscal discipline. Since lenient fiscal policies amplify banks’ risk-shifting, optimal support must be contingent on banking system health. For fiscally weak countries, support is larger in sovereign crises with solvent banks. For fiscally strong countries, support is larger in joint sovereign and bank crises, requiring deposit insurance mutualization. Optimal contracts feature lower capital requirements than without cross-country transfers, raising the cost of joint sovereign and bank crises to strengthen fiscal discipline and enable greater risk sharing.
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag024.abstract_zh: 本文分析了在政府与银行集体道德风险背景下，跨国风险分担与银行资本要求的最优设计。转移支付虽能提供保险，但会削弱财政纪律。由于宽松的财政政策会加剧银行的风险转移行为，最优支持必须取决于银行体系的健康状况。对于财政薄弱的国家，在主权危机中若银行具备偿付能力，支持力度更大；对于财政强劲的国家，在主权与银行双重危机中支持力度更大，这要求存款保险实现共同化。与无跨国转移支付的情形相比，最优合约设定的资本要求更低，这通过提高主权与银行双重危机的成本来强化财政纪律，并促进更大程度的风险分担。
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag024.title: Collective Moral Hazard, Risk Sharing, and Banking Unions
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag024.title_zh: 集体道德风险、风险分担与银行业联盟

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag034.abstract: This paper introduces a key factor influencing households’ decision to invest in the stock market: how people view stockholders. Using surveys we conducted with nearly 8,500 individuals from 11 countries, we document that a large majority hold negative views of stockholders based on identity-relevant characteristics. Linking survey and administrative data, we find that negative perceptions strongly predict households’ stock market participation. We show that negative perceptions causally influence household decision-making and provide evidence supporting identity concerns as the underlying mechanism. Our findings provide new perspectives on the malleability of financial decision-making and a novel explanation for low stock market participation.
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag034.abstract_zh: 本文揭示了一个影响家庭股市投资决策的关键因素：人们对股票持有者的看法。基于对11个国家近8500名受访者的调查，我们发现绝大多数人对股票持有者持有负面看法，这些看法与身份特征相关。通过将调查数据与行政数据关联分析，我们证实负面看法能显著预测家庭的股市参与行为。研究表明，负面看法对家庭决策具有因果影响，并提供了身份认同关切作为潜在机制的证据。这一发现为金融决策的可塑性提供了新视角，也为股市参与率偏低现象提供了全新解释。
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag034.title: Proud to Not Own Stocks: How Identity Shapes Financial Decisions
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag034.title_zh: 以不持有股票为荣：身份认同如何塑造金融决策

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag040.abstract: We estimate price elasticities of housing supply for U.S. cities by examining the impact of foreign purchases on housing prices and quantities. After other countries introduced foreign-buyer taxes beginning in 2011, both house prices and quantities increased more in locations with high foreign-born populations. A 1% increase in global capital inflows, instrumented with tax policy changes scaled by immigrant exposure, increased prices and quantities by 3% and 0.5%, respectively, over 2011–2018. We combine these estimates to construct new local supply elasticities. Compared to prior estimates, our elasticities are more inelastic and change cities’ relative rankings.
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag040.abstract_zh: 我们通过考察外国购房对美国城市房价和房屋数量的影响，估算了住房供给的价格弹性。自2011年起，其他国家陆续开征外国买家税后，在外来人口比例较高的地区，房价和房屋数量均出现更大幅度的增长。以移民暴露度衡量的税收政策变化作为工具变量，全球资本流入每增加1%，在2011-2018年间房价和房屋数量分别上升3%和0.5%。我们结合这些估算结果构建了新的地方供给弹性。与以往估算相比，我们的弹性系数更缺乏弹性，并改变了各城市的相对排名。
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag040.title: Global Capital and Local Assets: House Prices, Quantities, and Elasticities*
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag040.title_zh: 全球资本与本地资产：房价、数量与弹性*

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag047.abstract: What explains wealth and portfolio differences between black and white Americans? We find that disparities in economic factors explain portfolios well, but only partly explain the wealth gap. In a dynamic setting, economic factors often change optimal saving rates in ways that offset their effects on income and returns. Consequently, their net wealth effect is often limited, making the wealth gap harder to explain. We estimate that differences in income levels, income risk, family structures, mortality, health expenditures, property taxes, mortgage rates, and asset returns explain half of the differential between the racial wealth gap and the racial income gap.
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag047.abstract_zh: 什么因素导致了美国黑人与白人之间的财富和投资组合差异？我们发现，经济因素的差异能够较好地解释投资组合差异，但只能部分解释财富差距。在动态环境中，经济因素常常会改变最优储蓄率，从而抵消其对收入和回报的影响。因此，这些因素的净财富效应往往有限，使得财富差距更难以解释。我们估算，收入水平、收入风险、家庭结构、死亡率、医疗支出、房产税、抵押贷款利率以及资产回报率的差异，解释了种族财富差距与种族收入差距之间差异的一半。
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag047.title: A Dynamic Model of the Racial Wealth Gap
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag047.title_zh: 种族财富差距的动态模型

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag048.abstract: This paper investigates how capital supply from mutual funds affects municipal bond financing, making three key contributions. First, we introduce an identification strategy using the rule-based update of Morningstar ratings for 5-year-old funds, isolating supply-side effects from fund and issuer fundamentals. The results indicate that exogenous fund flows increase bond issuance probability and decrease yields. Second, these fund flows lead to more issuances when funds and issuers are connected through underwriters, highlighting relationship lending in municipal bond financing. Third, municipal issuers leverage favorable financing conditions for new issuance of revenue bonds, which translates into higher local house prices. (JEL G23, G32, H74)
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag048.abstract_zh: 本文研究共同基金资本供给如何影响市政债券融资，并作出三项关键贡献。首先，我们引入一种基于晨星评级规则更新的识别策略（针对成立满五年的基金），从而将供给端效应与基金及发行人的基本面因素相分离。结果表明，外生性基金流入会提高债券发行概率并降低收益率。其次，当基金与发行人通过承销商建立关联时，此类基金流入会带来更多债券发行，凸显了市政债券融资中的关系型借贷特征。第三，市政发行人利用有利融资条件发行收益债券，进而推高当地房价。（JEL分类号：G23, G32, H74）
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag048.title: Mutual Fund Flows and the Supply of Capital in Municipal Financing
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag048.title_zh: 共同基金流动与市政融资中的资本供给

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag049.abstract: We extract information from earnings call transcripts to develop a comprehensive and reliable measure of labor shortage exposure. After validating the measure at the state, industry, and firm levels, we show that firms with labor shortage exposures experience lower earnings call CARs, future stock returns and operating performance. Firms respond to labor shortages by substituting labor with capital and R&D investments, and by producing more production-process patents. Such responses help mitigate the negative effects on future performance. Our measure has broad applicability, and our findings provide new insight into labor-capital substitution in imperfectly competitive labor markets.
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag049.abstract_zh: 我们从财报电话会议记录中提取信息，构建了一个全面且可靠的劳动力短缺暴露度指标。在州、行业和企业层面验证该指标后，我们发现，面临劳动力短缺暴露的企业，其财报电话会议期间的累计异常收益率（CARs）、未来股票回报率及经营业绩均较低。企业通过以资本和研发投资替代劳动力，并增加生产流程专利的产出，来应对劳动力短缺。这些应对措施有助于缓解对未来业绩的负面影响。我们的指标具有广泛适用性，研究结果为不完全竞争劳动力市场中的劳动-资本替代提供了新见解。
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag049.title: Firm-Level Labor Shortage Exposure
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag049.title_zh: 企业层面劳动力短缺暴露度

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag050.abstract: Using a novel measure of investment companies’ reliance on generative artificial intelligence (GenAI), we document a sharp increase in GenAI usage by hedge funds after ChatGPT’s 2022 launch. A difference-in-differences test shows that hedge funds adopting GenAI earn 2-4% higher annualized abnormal returns than nonadopters, while non-hedge funds do not benefit. The outperformance originates from funds’ AI talent and ChatGPT’s strength in analyzing firm-specific information. We conduct a new survey of fund managers’ GenAI usage to provide direct validation of our measure and offer additional new insights on how managers adopt GenAI tools in their practice. (JEL C81, G11, G14, G23)
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag050.abstract_zh: 利用投资公司对生成式人工智能（GenAI）依赖程度的新型度量指标，我们记录了2022年ChatGPT发布后对冲基金对GenAI使用量的急剧增长。双重差分检验表明，采用GenAI的对冲基金相较于未采用者，年化异常收益率高出2-4%，而非对冲基金并未从中获益。这种超额收益源于基金的AI人才储备以及ChatGPT在分析企业特定信息方面的优势。我们通过对基金经理GenAI使用情况的新调查，为这一度量指标提供了直接验证，并就基金经理如何在实践中采用GenAI工具提供了额外的新见解。（JEL分类号：C81, G11, G14, G23）
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag050.title: Generative AI and Asset Management
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag050.title_zh: 生成式人工智能与资产管理

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag051.abstract: We study the interplay between a “one person-one vote” political system and a “one share-one vote” corporate governance regime. If shareholders push firms for more prosocial policies, political backlash may arise, undoing these initiatives. If public policy is frictionless, shareholder democracy becomes irrelevant: the political system fully offsets shareholder influence. With public policy frictions, prosocial corporations can mitigate regulatory shortcomings and enhance corporate public goods provision. Nevertheless, shareholder democracy can hurt citizens due to the representation problem: it favors the preferences of the wealthy. Investor diversification, pass-through voting, and corporate greenwashing have important implications for these trade-offs of shareholder democracy. (JEL D62, D72, G28, G34, G38, H23)
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag051.abstract_zh: 我们研究“一人一票”政治体制与“一股一票”公司治理制度之间的相互作用。如果股东推动企业采取更多亲社会政策，可能引发政治反弹，从而抵消这些举措。若公共政策无摩擦，股东民主便失去意义：政治体制将完全抵消股东的影响力。在存在公共政策摩擦的情况下，亲社会企业能够弥补监管缺陷，提升企业公共品供给。然而，由于代表性问题，股东民主可能损害公民利益：它更偏向富裕阶层的偏好。投资者多元化、传递投票以及企业漂绿行为对股东民主的这些权衡具有重要影响。（JEL D62, D72, G28, G34, G38, H23）
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag051.title: Voting on Public Goods: Citizens vs Shareholders
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag051.title_zh: 公共产品投票：公民与股东

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag052.abstract: During the 2020–2021 “AAPI Hate,” mutual funds led by female managers perceived as East Asian underperformed relative to other female managers. This effect is stronger in states with higher anti-Asian animus, among more actively managed funds, and when these managers hold sole or senior roles. Factors concurrent with COVID-19, including childcare challenges, concerns for overseas families, marketplace and workplace discrimination, and exposure to the Chinese economy, cannot explain the effect. Underperformance is traceable to poor stock picking due to impairments in generating private information. Racial-ethnic animosity, even outside workplace or marketplace, hinders productivity and decision-making in high-skill professions.
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag052.abstract_zh: 在2020-2021年“亚裔美国人仇恨事件”期间，由被视为东亚裔的女性基金经理管理的共同基金，其表现逊于其他女性基金经理。这一效应在反亚裔情绪更强烈的州、主动管理程度更高的基金中更为显著，且当这些基金经理担任唯一或高级管理职务时尤为突出。与新冠疫情同步发生的因素，包括育儿挑战、对海外家人的担忧、职场与市场歧视以及中国经济敞口，均无法解释该效应。业绩不佳可追溯至因私有信息生成能力受损导致的选股失误。种族-民族敌意，即便发生在职场或市场之外，也会阻碍高技能职业的生产力与决策能力。
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag052.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag052.title: The Real Effect of Sociopolitical Racial/Ethnic Animus: Mutual Fund Manager Performance during AAPI Hate
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag052.title_zh: 社会政治种族/民族敌意的真实效应：AAPI仇恨事件期间的共同基金经理表现

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag053.abstract: We develop a dynamic theory of “Partial Equilibrium Thinking” (PET), which micro-founds time-varying return extrapolation: extrapolative beliefs are present at all times, but only sometimes manifest themselves in explosive ways. We formalize the distinction between normal times shocks and “displacement shocks,” and study their interaction with extrapolative beliefs. In normal times, PET generates constant extrapolation and momentum. After a displacement shock that increases uncertainty, PET leads to stronger and time-varying extrapolation, triggering bubbles and endogenous crashes. Our theory sheds light on both market dynamics in normal times and Kindleberger’s narrative of bubbles within a unified framework. (JEL D84, G12, G41)
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag053.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个“局部均衡思维”（PET）的动态理论，该理论为时变回报外推提供了微观基础：外推信念始终存在，但仅在特定时期以爆发性方式显现。我们形式化了正常时期冲击与“位移冲击”之间的区别，并研究了它们与外推信念的相互作用。在正常时期，PET产生持续的外推效应和动量。而在增加不确定性的位移冲击发生后，PET导致更强且时变的外推效应，从而引发泡沫与内生性崩盘。我们的理论在统一框架下，既阐释了正常时期的市场动态，也揭示了金德尔伯格关于泡沫的叙事。（JEL D84, G12, G41）
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag053.title: Partial Equilibrium Thinking, Extrapolation, and Bubbles
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag053.title_zh: 局部均衡思维、外推与泡沫

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag055.abstract: A fundamental concern about green investing is that it may crowd out political support for public policies addressing negative externalities. We examine this concern in a preregistered experiment conducted shortly before a real referendum on a climate law in Switzerland. We find that offering an opportunity to invest in a climate-friendly fund does not reduce individual support for climate regulation, measured by political donations and voting intentions. A replication of the experiment in the United Kingdom yields similar results. Our estimates reject a crowding-out effect, suggesting instead a modest crowding-in effect of green investing on political support for green policies. (JEL D14, H42, G18, P16)
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag055.abstract_zh: 关于绿色投资的一个核心担忧是，它可能会挤占公众对解决负外部性问题的公共政策的政治支持。我们在瑞士一项气候法案全民公投前夕开展了一项预注册实验，对此进行了检验。研究发现，提供投资气候友好型基金的机会，并不会降低个人对气候监管的支持（以政治捐款和投票意向衡量）。在英国重复该实验后得到了类似结果。我们的估计结果否定了挤出效应，反而表明绿色投资对绿色政策的政治支持存在适度的挤入效应。（JEL D14, H42, G18, P16）
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag055.title: Green Investing and Political Behavior

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag056.abstract: There are two major institutional investors in the syndicated loan market: collateralized loan obligations (CLOs) and loan mutual funds. CLOs are closed-end funds while loan funds are open-end funds that issue claims that are redeemable on demand. In this paper, we examine whether CLOs provide arbitrage capital that contributes to the resilience of loan funds. We find that CLOs act as shock absorbers, providing liquidity through par-building trades when loan funds experience large outflows. However, CLO-provided liquidity is limited to par build–eligible loans, leading to potential flow-induced fire sales among par build–ineligible loans. (JEL G23, G38
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag056.abstract_zh: 银团贷款市场中有两类主要机构投资者：担保贷款凭证（CLOs）和贷款共同基金。CLO属于封闭式基金，而贷款基金属于开放式基金，其发行的份额可随时赎回。本文研究CLO是否提供套利资本以增强贷款基金的韧性。我们发现，当贷款基金遭遇大规模资金外流时，CLO通过平价建仓交易提供流动性，起到缓冲器作用。然而，CLO提供的流动性仅限于符合平价建仓条件的贷款，这可能导致不符合条件的贷款因资金外流而被迫折价抛售。（JEL分类号：G23, G38）
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag056.title: Institutional Synergies and the Fragility of Loan Funds
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag056.title_zh: 制度协同与贷款基金的脆弱性

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag057.abstract: We develop a model-free measure of the variance premium by constructing option portfolios whose returns are highly correlated with realized stock variance. This effectively decomposes returns into realized variance minus implied variance. We apply this decomposition to document a novel quarterly cross-sectional continuation pattern in both realized variance and implied variance of individual stocks. Implied variance underanticipates the seasonality of realized variance, so options that performed well at quarterly lags continue to earn high returns in the future. Quarterly periodicity in realized stock variance only occurs on days with analyst earning revisions, suggesting an informational channel for this pattern. (JEL G12, G13, G40)
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag057.abstract_zh: 我们通过构建与已实现股票方差高度相关的期权组合，开发了一种无模型的方差溢价度量方法。该方法有效将收益分解为已实现方差减去隐含方差。我们运用这一分解，揭示了个股已实现方差与隐含方差在季度层面存在新颖的横截面延续模式。隐含方差未能充分预期已实现方差的季节性特征，因此在季度滞后期间表现优异的期权，未来仍能持续获得高收益。已实现股票方差的季度周期性仅出现在分析师盈利修正的交易日，表明该模式存在信息渠道机制。（JEL G12, G13, G40）
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag057.title: The Variance Premium and Seasonal Momentum in Option Returns
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag057.title_zh: 期权收益中的方差溢价与季节性动量

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag058.abstract: Government intervention in the financial market through its own trading fundamentally changes the market’s structure, function, and outcome. I develop a general equilibrium framework to study the impact of government trading on investor welfare. I show that with incompleteness and information asymmetry, the market equilibrium is in general suboptimal, and government intervention can potentially improve investor welfare even with no additional information. However, the actual welfare impact of government intervention is sensitive to the details of the economy and the policy design. Popular policy targets such as price stability, market liquidity, and informational efficiency can have different welfare implications.
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag058.abstract_zh: 政府通过自身交易对金融市场进行干预，从根本上改变了市场的结构、功能与结果。本文构建了一个一般均衡框架，研究政府交易对投资者福利的影响。研究表明，在市场不完备且存在信息不对称的情况下，市场均衡通常并非最优，即便政府不掌握额外信息，其干预也可能改善投资者福利。然而，政府干预的实际福利效应高度依赖于经济体的具体特征及政策设计。诸如价格稳定、市场流动性和信息效率等常见政策目标，可能对福利产生截然不同的影响。
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag058.title: Government Intervention in the Financial Market
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag058.title_zh: 政府对金融市场的干预

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag059.abstract: We show that positive flows to active mutual funds with high recent returns partially reverse at longer horizons. This outcome is robust across a broad range of alternative specifications. Reversal occurs from greater outflows associated with high prior returns, not reduced inflows. We test theories to explain the reversal: investment life cycles, tax loss selling, and a behavioral “disappointment” hypothesis based on investors’ overreaction to positive returns. While both tax loss selling and short investor life cycles can contribute, the evidence supports a role for investor disappointment, whereby investors redeem their capital when return performance fails to meet expectations. (JEL G10, G23)
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag059.abstract_zh: 我们研究发现，近期高回报的主动管理型共同基金所获得的资金净流入，在较长时期内会出现部分逆转。这一结论在多种替代性设定下均保持稳健。逆转现象源于高前期回报引发的更大规模资金流出，而非流入减少。我们检验了三种理论解释：投资生命周期、税收亏损出售以及基于投资者对正回报过度反应的行为"失望"假说。尽管税收亏损出售和短期投资生命周期均可能产生影响，但证据支持投资者失望假说的作用——即当回报表现未达预期时，投资者会选择赎回资本。（JEL分类号：G10, G23）
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag059.title: Mutual Fund Flows at Long Horizons
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag059.title_zh: 长期视角下的共同基金资金流动

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag060.abstract: We study the interaction between firms, which can invest in green technologies, and a government, which can impose emission caps but has limited commitment power. Investment in green technologies generates innovation spillovers, reducing the cost of further investments. Spillovers generate intertemporal strategic complementarities between firms and government, and equilibrium multiplicity. In a “green equilibrium”, firms, anticipating caps, invest in green technologies, which reduces the cost of further investment, making the government willing to cap emissions. In a “brown equilibrium”, firms, anticipating no caps, don’t invest, so green technologies remain costly and the government gives up on emission caps. (JEL Q54, Q55, Q58, H23, O33)
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag060.abstract_zh: 我们研究了企业（可投资于绿色技术）与政府（可设定排放上限但承诺能力有限）之间的互动关系。绿色技术投资会产生创新溢出效应，从而降低后续投资的成本。这种溢出效应在企业与政府之间形成了跨期战略互补性，并导致多重均衡。在“绿色均衡”中，企业预期政府会设定排放上限，因而投资于绿色技术，这降低了后续投资成本，使政府愿意实施排放上限。在“棕色均衡”中，企业预期政府不会设定排放上限，因而放弃投资，导致绿色技术成本居高不下，政府最终放弃排放上限政策。（JEL Q54, Q55, Q58, H23, O33）
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag060.title: Emission Caps and Investment in Green Technologies
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag060.title_zh: 排放上限与绿色技术投资

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag061.abstract: Numerous trading strategies examined in options research exhibit remarkably high mean returns and Sharpe ratios. We show some of these seemingly “good deals” are due to look-ahead biases. These biases stem from using information unavailable at the portfolio formation time to filter out observations suspected of being noisy or erroneous. Our results suggest that elevated Sharpe ratios may serve as potential indicators of such look-ahead biases. Furthermore, deviating from previous literature findings, we show that illiquidity is not strongly priced in stock options and that only a small set of stock characteristics are in fact associated with option expected returns. (JEL G12, G14, G17)
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag061.abstract_zh: 期权研究中检验的众多交易策略呈现出异常高的平均收益率和夏普比率。我们表明，其中一些看似“划算的交易”源于前瞻性偏差。这些偏差源于在投资组合形成时使用了不可获取的信息，以筛选出疑似存在噪声或错误的观测值。我们的结果表明，高夏普比率可能成为此类前瞻性偏差的潜在指标。此外，与以往文献发现不同，我们证明流动性不足在股票期权中并未被强定价，且实际上只有少数股票特征与期权预期收益率相关。（JEL G12, G14, G17）
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag061.title: Too Good to Be True: Look-Ahead Bias in Empirical Options Research
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag061.title_zh: 过于美好而难以置信：实证期权研究中的前瞻性偏差

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag063.abstract: We build a novel data set of time-stamped corporate decarbonization commitments—green pledges—for U.S. public firms by classifying news articles with large language models and human validation. Firms announcing green pledges tend to be larger and browner than other firms, both within and across industries. Green pledges significantly raise stock prices, consistent with a reduction in the carbon premium, and predict sizable declines in future carbon emissions and emission intensities. These effects tend to be strongest for firms in brown industries. Green pledges thus appear credible, convey relevant new information to investors, and provide meaningful financial incentives to decarbonize. (JEL G14, G32, Q54, Q56)
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag063.abstract_zh: 我们通过结合大语言模型分类与人工验证，构建了一个包含美国上市公司脱碳承诺（绿色承诺）时间戳信息的新数据集。发布绿色承诺的企业往往规模更大且碳排放强度更高，这一特征在行业内部及跨行业间均成立。绿色承诺显著推高股价，这与碳溢价降低的预期一致，并预示着未来碳排放总量及排放强度将大幅下降。上述效应在棕色行业企业中最为显著。因此，绿色承诺具有可信度，能向投资者传递相关新信息，并为脱碳行为提供切实的经济激励。（JEL G14, G32, Q54, Q56）
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag063.title: Corporate Green Pledges

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag064.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly consuming and producing huge amounts of data. We propose a social learning model of AI, emphasizing a data-AI feedback loop: data quality affects AI productivity, which influences AI adoption and, consequently, the composition (AI versus human-generated) and quality of future data. Calibrated to evidence on synthetic training loops, the model predicts hump-shaped labor dynamics—short-term displacement that partially reverses as data quality deteriorates. A Grossman–Stiglitz-style externality emerges: AI adopters free-ride on the human-generated actions that supply the novel information on which AI itself relies. In a competitive market, AI should be taxed to correct the data-quality externality; a concentrated AI industry overcorrects, making a subsidy optimal. (JEL O33, D62, D83, J24)
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag064.abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能正日益消耗并产生海量数据。我们提出一个AI的社会学习模型，强调数据与AI之间的反馈循环：数据质量影响AI的生产力，进而影响AI的采用，并最终决定未来数据的构成（AI生成与人类生成）及其质量。基于合成训练循环的证据进行校准后，该模型预测劳动力动态呈驼峰形——短期替代效应会随着数据质量恶化而部分逆转。一种格罗斯曼-斯蒂格利茨式外部性由此产生：AI采用者搭便车利用人类生成的行为，而这些行为提供了AI自身所依赖的新信息。在竞争市场中，应对AI征税以纠正数据质量外部性；而集中的AI行业则会过度纠正，使得补贴成为最优选择。（JEL O33, D62, D83, J24）
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag064.title: Generative AI and Data Quality: Implications for Productivity, Labor Displacement, and Policy
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag064.title_zh: 生成式人工智能与数据质量：对生产率、劳动力替代及政策的影响

doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag065.abstract: Traditionally, fund managers cast votes on behalf of fund investors. Recently, there is a shift toward “pass-through voting,” with funds offering investors a choice: delegate votes to the fund or vote themselves. We develop a framework to study the implications of voting choice. While it helps reflect heterogeneous investor preferences, it also shapes the informational content of the vote, and these forces can conflict. When interests are aligned, voting choice improves information aggregation and investor welfare. With preference heterogeneity or costly information, however, it can make investors worse off by weakening informed. (JEL D72, D82, D83, G34, K22)
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag065.abstract_zh: 传统上，基金经理代表基金投资者行使投票权。近期，一种“穿透式投票”模式逐渐兴起，基金为投资者提供选择：将投票权委托给基金，或自行投票。我们构建了一个分析框架，研究投票选择权的影响。这一机制既能反映投资者异质性偏好，也会塑造投票的信息含量，而这两种力量可能相互冲突。当利益一致时，投票选择权能够改善信息聚合效率并提升投资者福利；然而，在偏好异质性或信息成本存在的情况下，该机制可能因削弱知情投票而降低投资者福利。（JEL D72, D82, D83, G34, K22）
doi:10.1093/rfs/hhag065.title: Voting Choice

doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70108.abstract: China's irrigated heartlands face concurrent pressures of aquifer depletion and grain security. We evaluate Hebei's Substituting Groundwater with Surface Water for Irrigation (SGSWI) project—a medium‐scale, short‐haul program—using county‐level panel data and a staggered difference‐in‐differences design that combines water accounts, monthly deep/shallow groundwater levels, meteorological controls and agricultural statistics, supplemented by village/household surveys. We find that the SGSWI project rebalances irrigation sources without raising total agricultural water use: surface water rises by 3.2%, whereas groundwater falls by 2.3%. The program benefits deep aquifers—deep withdrawals decline 5.3% and the depth to the deep water table recovers by 1.85 m—with no detectable effect on shallow systems. Regarding production, grain output increases 8.3%, driven by a 7.4% expansion in sown area and a 3.7% rise in the multiple‐cropping index; yields per unit area, water‐use efficiency and fertiliser use intensity remain unchanged. Effects are larger where projects connect to inter‐provincial transfers and in severely overdrafted counties; dual‐source counties show the biggest output gains but risk rebound in total water use. A recipient‐side cost–benefit accounting yields an internal rate of return (IRR) of 11.55%, with one‐way sensitivity checks showing only moderate sensitivity to groundwater valuation, operational and maintenance (O&M) costs, and tariffs but strong sensitivity to shortfalls in realised transfer volumes. Sustainability, however, is constrained by supply uncertainty, weak inter‐regional coordination, incomplete infrastructure, underdeveloped operation and maintenance and underpricing. Policy priorities include targeting severe overdraft basins, locking in multi‐year delivery commitments, completing and funding ‘last‐mile’ assets, introducing volumetric and tiered tariffs with safeguards and strengthening aquifer‐specific monitoring and accountability.
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70108.abstract_zh: 中国灌溉核心地带正面临地下水枯竭与粮食安全的双重压力。本文利用县级面板数据，结合水账户、月度深层/浅层地下水水位、气象控制变量及农业统计数据，辅以村庄/家庭调查，采用交错双重差分法评估了河北省"以地表水替代地下水灌溉"（SGSWI）项目——一项中等规模、短距离调水工程。研究发现，SGSWI项目在未增加农业总用水量的前提下实现了灌溉水源再平衡：地表水用量上升3.2%，地下水用量下降2.3%。该项目对深层含水层产生积极效应——深层地下水开采量减少5.3%，深层地下水位埋深恢复1.85米——但对浅层系统无显著影响。在生产方面，粮食产量增长8.3%，其驱动因素为播种面积扩大7.4%和复种指数提高3.7%；单位面积产量、水分利用效率和化肥施用强度均未发生显著变化。在连接跨省调水工程及严重超采的县域，项目效应更为显著；双水源县域产出增幅最大，但存在总用水量反弹风险。基于受水区成本收益核算，项目内部收益率（IRR）为11.55%，单向敏感性检验显示其对地下水估值、运维成本及水价仅呈中度敏感，但对实际调水量缺口高度敏感。然而，项目可持续性受制于供水不确定性、区域协调不足、基础设施不完善、运维机制不健全及水价偏低等因素。政策优先方向包括：聚焦严重超采流域、锁定多年调水承诺、完成并资助"最后一公里"设施建设、引入带保障机制的计量阶梯水价、强化针对特定含水层的监测与问责体系。
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70108.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70108.journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70108.title: Substituting Groundwater With Surface Water for Irrigation in Northern China: Current Status, Effectiveness and Challenges
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70108.title_zh: 中国北方以地表水替代地下水灌溉：现状、成效与挑战

doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70116.abstract: Agriculture is the cornerstone of sub‐Saharan Africa's (SSA) economy, contributing substantially to national income and employing a significant proportion of the labour force. Despite its economic importance, the sector remains dominated by smallholder farmers with low productivity. In response, the African Union launched the Comprehensive African Agricultural Development Program (CAADP) in 2003 to transition African agriculture from subsistence‐based to market‐oriented production through increased public investment. This study examines the impact of fiscal agricultural expenditure on agricultural productivity in the SSA region and investigates convergence in agricultural productivity across countries. Using unbalanced panel data from 30 SSA nations (2003–2023), we employed panel corrected standard errors (PCSE) to address cross‐sectional dependence, with feasible generalised least squares (FGLS) for robustness. Beta‐ and sigma‐convergence tests further assessed disparities in productivity trends. The findings reveal that agricultural expenditure has a significant impact on productivity: A 1% increase leads to a 0.02% rise in total factor productivity, a 0.05% increase in labour productivity and a 0.2% improvement in land productivity following the implementation of CAADP. In addition, the implementation period of CAADP used as a policy dummy also has a positive influence on agricultural productivity when compared to the baseline period. Similarly, the study indicates the persistent existence of absolute and conditional beta‐convergence in three agricultural measures. Meanwhile, sigma‐convergence tests confirm a reduction in dispersion of total factor productivity, but divergent results are observed for labour and land productivities. These findings suggest that heightened public investment is needed to accelerate productivity growth and narrow performance gaps in SSA's agricultural sector.
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70116.abstract_zh: 农业是撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）经济的基石，对国民收入贡献显著，并吸纳了相当比例的劳动力。尽管具有重要经济地位，该地区仍以小农生产为主，生产力水平低下。为此，非洲联盟于2003年启动《非洲农业综合发展计划》（CAADP），旨在通过增加公共投资，推动非洲农业从自给型生产向市场导向型生产转型。本研究考察了撒哈拉以南非洲地区财政农业支出对农业生产力的影响，并探究了各国农业生产力的收敛趋势。基于30个撒哈拉以南非洲国家2003—2023年的非平衡面板数据，我们采用面板校正标准误（PCSE）处理截面相依性，并以可行广义最小二乘法（FGLS）进行稳健性检验。通过β收敛和σ收敛检验进一步评估生产力趋势的差异。研究结果表明：农业支出对生产力具有显著影响——在CAADP实施后，农业支出每增加1%，全要素生产率提升0.02%，劳动生产率提高0.05%，土地生产率改善0.2%。此外，与基准期相比，作为政策虚拟变量的CAADP实施期对农业生产率同样产生正向影响。研究同时显示，三项农业指标均持续存在绝对β收敛和条件β收敛。σ收敛检验证实全要素生产率的离散程度有所降低，但劳动生产率和土地生产率呈现分化结果。这些发现表明，撒哈拉以南非洲地区需加大公共投资力度，以加速生产率增长并缩小绩效差距。
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70116.journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70116.title: Convergence of Agricultural Productivity and the Influence of Fiscal Expenditure in Sub‐Saharan Africa
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70116.title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲农业生产力趋同与财政支出的影响

doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70117.abstract: Cluster farming has been promoted as an institutional strategy to improve smallholder productivity, market access and profitability in developing countries. However, empirical evidence on the association between governance practices and wheat profitability within cluster systems remains limited. This study examines the role of governance practices on the profitability of wheat farmers in Ethiopia, placing particular emphasis on the mediating role of farm‐gate selling prices. Using cross‐sectional data from 759 farmers across 11 clusters, governance dimension indices were constructed using principal component analysis, and effects were estimated using two‐stage least squares, three‐stage least squares and quantile regression. Results show that accountability, participation and conflict resolution have positive and significant effects on wheat profitability, while transparency has a negative association, likely reflecting coordination and compliance costs. Mediation analysis reveals that farm‐gate price explains about 89.5% of governance's total effect on profitability. Governance effects also vary by cluster group, landholding size, input use and profitability levels. Strong governance improves bargaining power, price realisation and economic returns. The findings highlight the importance of institutional quality in cluster farming. Strengthening accountability, participation and conflict resolution can significantly improve profitability and support smallholder livelihoods, offering key policy insights for cluster‐based agricultural development in Ethiopia and similar contexts.
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70117.abstract_zh: 集群农业已被推广为一种制度性策略，旨在提升发展中国家小农户的生产力、市场准入和盈利能力。然而，关于集群体系内治理实践与小麦盈利能力之间关联的实证证据仍然有限。本研究考察了治理实践对埃塞俄比亚小麦农户盈利能力的作用，特别关注农场交货销售价格的中介效应。利用来自11个集群759名农户的横截面数据，通过主成分分析法构建了治理维度指数，并采用两阶段最小二乘法、三阶段最小二乘法及分位数回归估计效应。结果表明，问责制、参与度和冲突解决对小麦盈利能力具有显著正向影响，而透明度则呈现负向关联，这很可能反映了协调与合规成本。中介分析显示，农场交货价格解释了治理对盈利能力总效应的约89.5%。治理效应还因集群组别、土地持有规模、投入品使用及盈利水平而异。强有力的治理能够提升议价能力、价格实现水平及经济回报。研究结果凸显了制度质量在集群农业中的重要性。加强问责制、参与度和冲突解决可显著改善盈利能力并支持小农户生计，为埃塞俄比亚及类似情境下的集群农业发展提供了关键政策启示。
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70117.journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70117.title: Do Governance Practices in Cluster Farming Improve Wheat Farmers' Profitability? Evidence From Ethiopia
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70117.title_zh: 集群农业中的治理实践是否提高了小麦农户的盈利能力？来自埃塞俄比亚的证据

doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70118.abstract: With the increasing risk of global food insecurity, countries have accelerated their efforts to reduce food loss and waste. Moreover, traditional agricultural policies, such as income subsidies, significantly impact farmers' behaviour and grain production and likely food losses. Based on survey data from 1885 maize growers in China, we measured maize harvest losses in China and empirically analysed the impact of income subsidies on such losses. The results showed that on average, 3.02% of the total maize amount was lost at the harvest stage, and the loss per unit area was 17.5 kg/mu (262.5 kg/ha). Income subsidies were significantly correlated with greater maize harvest losses, and this conclusion remained robust after potential endogeneity problems were resolved. A heterogeneity analysis revealed that the impact of income subsidies on maize harvest losses was significant for small‐scale farmers but not for large‐scale farmers. We suggest that the Chinese government should accelerate the transformation of agri‐food systems and the reform of income subsidy policies, which should encourage farmers to increase the scale of their operations, and these subsidies should be transformed into more targeted policies to meet the requirements for reducing food losses.
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70118.abstract_zh: 随着全球粮食不安全风险的加剧，各国纷纷加快减少粮食损失与浪费的步伐。此外，传统农业政策（如收入补贴）显著影响农户行为及粮食生产，并可能加剧粮食损失。基于中国1885户玉米种植户的调查数据，我们测算了中国玉米收获环节的损失，并实证分析了收入补贴对这类损失的影响。结果表明，玉米在收获阶段的平均损失占总产量的3.02%，单位面积损失为17.5公斤/亩（262.5公斤/公顷）。收入补贴与玉米收获损失显著正相关，且在解决潜在内生性问题后，这一结论依然稳健。异质性分析显示，收入补贴对玉米收获损失的影响在小规模农户中显著，但对大规模农户不显著。我们建议中国政府加速农业食品体系转型及收入补贴政策改革，鼓励农户扩大经营规模，并将补贴转化为更具针对性的政策，以满足减少粮食损失的要求。

doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70119.abstract: Recent climate phenomena show that Spain is one of the most vulnerable countries to climate change impacts, with varied regional effects from flash floods to drought. This study assesses the vulnerability of four major crops (cereal, rice, grape and olive) in Catalonia to climate change through a comprehensive vulnerability index incorporating exposure, sensitivity and adaptive capacity indicators. Using farm‐level panel data from 2012 to 2022, we employ a three‐stage analytical approach using a multi‐criteria vulnerability index, correlation analysis and dynamic panel estimation to examine the relationship between vulnerability and total factor productivity (TFP). Results reveal significant differences in vulnerability across crops and provinces, with olive showing the highest vulnerability followed by cereal, whereas grape demonstrates the lowest vulnerability. Lleida province exhibits the highest regional vulnerability, whereas Barcelona shows the lowest. Temperature‐related factors emerge as the dominant vulnerability drivers, with extreme temperature days and temperature variability followed by topographical limitations. System GMM estimation confirms a strong negative relationship between vulnerability and agricultural productivity, with long‐term impacts exceeding immediate effects. These findings provide a foundation for targeted adaptation strategies that address both climate exposure and adaptive capacity constraints, enabling policymakers to prioritise interventions based on crop‐specific vulnerability profiles and key driving factors.
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70119.abstract_zh: 近期气候现象表明，西班牙是受气候变化影响最脆弱的国家之一，其区域效应从山洪暴发到干旱各不相同。本研究通过构建包含暴露度、敏感性和适应能力指标的综合脆弱性指数，评估了加泰罗尼亚地区四种主要作物（谷物、水稻、葡萄和橄榄）对气候变化的脆弱性。利用2012年至2022年的农场层面面板数据，我们采用三阶段分析方法——包括多准则脆弱性指数、相关性分析和动态面板估计——来考察脆弱性与全要素生产率之间的关系。结果显示，不同作物和省份的脆弱性存在显著差异，其中橄榄的脆弱性最高，其次是谷物，而葡萄的脆弱性最低。莱里达省的区域脆弱性最高，而巴塞罗那省最低。温度相关因素成为主要的脆弱性驱动因素，其中极端温度天数和温度变异性影响最大，其次是地形限制。系统GMM估计证实了脆弱性与农业生产力之间存在强烈的负相关关系，且长期影响超过短期效应。这些发现为制定针对性的适应策略提供了基础，这些策略需同时应对气候暴露度和适应能力限制，使政策制定者能够根据作物特定的脆弱性概况和关键驱动因素优先安排干预措施。

doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70119.title: Agricultural Vulnerability Assessment: Climate and Non‐Climate Interactions in Crop Production Systems

doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70120.abstract: Increasing rates of urbanisation, high unemployment and the absence of social security in developing countries are putting pressure on urban households' diets, prompting some to advocate urban agriculture as a fallback. Because households voluntarily choose to engage in urban agriculture, it is important to account for the self‐selection inherent in practising urban agriculture when evaluating the efficacy of urban agriculture in cushioning urban households' diets. Accordingly, we estimate the effects of practising urban agriculture on household dietary diversity using the endogenous switching model with a count outcome (ESMC) based on four pooled annual cross‐section surveys of Zimbabwean households from 2019 to 2023. We employ propensity score matching (PSM) as a secondary robustness check, acknowledging that it addresses selection only on observed characteristics. We offer three major findings. First, large households, and households headed by women, older heads and those that are married and living together with their spouses are ceteris paribus more likely to practise urban agriculture. Second, practising urban agriculture increases the likelihood that urban households will have greater dietary diversity. Third, urban agriculture improves dietary diversity only for the sub‐population of households that do not receive support from rural relatives. The findings of this study confirm the potential role of urban agriculture in improving the food and nutrition security of urban households without support from relatives in rural areas in developing countries.
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70120.abstract_zh: 发展中国家城市化率上升、高失业率及社会保障缺失正对城市家庭膳食结构造成压力，促使部分学者倡导将城市农业作为应对策略。由于家庭自愿选择参与城市农业，在评估其对城市家庭膳食的缓冲作用时，必须考虑参与行为固有的自选择偏差。为此，本研究基于2019至2023年津巴布韦家庭四轮年度截面调查数据，采用计数结果内生转换模型（ESMC）估计城市农业实践对家庭膳食多样性的影响。我们以倾向得分匹配法（PSM）作为稳健性检验的辅助方法，但需承认该方法仅能解决可观测特征导致的选择偏差。研究得出三项主要发现：第一，在其他条件不变的情况下，大家庭、女性户主家庭、年长户主家庭及已婚同居家庭更可能从事城市农业；第二，参与城市农业能显著提升城市家庭膳食多样性的概率；第三，城市农业仅对未获得农村亲属支持的家庭子群体具有改善膳食多样性的效果。本研究证实，在发展中国家缺乏农村亲属支持的城市家庭中，城市农业对改善其粮食与营养安全具有潜在作用。

doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70120.title: Urban Agriculture Adoption, Diet Variety and Rural Support Among Urban Zimbabwe Households

doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70121.abstract: Australia's National Electricity Market (NEM) is undergoing a rapid transition to a weather‐dependent and increasingly distributed system. This article draws on the 2025 NEM Review to examine whether the core energy‐only market design remains fit for purpose. It argues that the principal challenge is not the operation of the spot market, but the weakening of linkages between short‐term dispatch, medium‐term risk management and long‐term investment. The growth of behind‐the‐meter resources has reduced system visibility, the shift to renewable generation has altered the nature of risk, and a structural mismatch between contracting horizons and asset lives has created a ‘tenor gap’. Policy responses should therefore focus on improving visibility, strengthening forward markets and introducing targeted mechanisms to support long‐term investment while preserving market signals.
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70121.abstract_zh: 澳大利亚国家电力市场（NEM）正快速向依赖天气且日益分散的系统转型。本文基于2025年NEM评估报告，探讨核心的纯电能市场设计是否仍适用。研究认为，主要挑战并非现货市场的运行，而是短期调度、中期风险管理与长期投资之间关联的弱化。表计后端资源的增长降低了系统可见性，可再生能源发电的转变改变了风险性质，而合约期限与资产寿命之间的结构性错配形成了"期限缺口"。因此，政策应对应聚焦于提升可见性、强化远期市场，并在保留市场信号的同时引入针对性机制以支持长期投资。

doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70124.abstract: Contracts and ownership structures play a critical role in fostering innovation in the bioeconomy. However, identifying which designs best promote bioresource circularity and collaboration remains challenging, as existing studies use diverse frameworks and are often limited to specific contexts or regions. Therefore, we conducted a review to clarify the types of contracts and ownership structures within bio‐based value chains and evaluate their roles in fostering innovation. To this end, we followed PRISMA‐P guidelines when collecting studies and organised them based on methodologies to facilitate the synthesis. Using a framework of the ownership distribution along the value chain between primary producer and biorefinery, we categorise three main categories of ownership structures: vertical integration, individual ownership and joint ownership. Some literature argues that primary producers prefer low‐risk attributes and therefore shift much of the responsibility onto biorefineries. While such structures can encourage participation, they hinder innovation by concentrating power within the biorefinery. Joint ownership structures, such as cooperatives, emerge as promising alternatives, offering a more balanced and collaborative approach to sharing risks, costs and profits. Our findings highlight the need for future research to explore joint ownership structures and apply different methods to support substantial advancement.
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70124.abstract_zh: 合同与所有权结构在推动生物经济创新中发挥着关键作用。然而，由于现有研究采用不同分析框架且多局限于特定情境或区域，目前仍难以确定何种设计最能促进生物资源循环利用与协作。为此，我们开展系统性综述，旨在厘清生物基价值链中的合同与所有权结构类型，并评估其在促进创新中的作用。本研究遵循PRISMA-P指南进行文献收集，并按方法论分类以促进综合比较。基于初级生产者与生物精炼厂之间价值链所有权分布的分析框架，我们将所有权结构归纳为三类：纵向一体化、个体所有权与联合所有权。部分文献认为初级生产者偏好低风险属性，因此将大部分责任转移至生物精炼厂。此类结构虽能鼓励参与，但通过将权力集中于生物精炼厂而阻碍创新。合作社等联合所有权结构作为更具前景的替代方案，提供了更均衡、协作的风险、成本与利润分担方式。研究结论表明，未来需深入探索联合所有权结构，并采用多元方法推动实质性进展。

doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70124.title_zh: 生物经济中的合同与所有权结构：其设计与创新作用综述

doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70125.abstract: Australia's National Electricity Market (NEM) was established in the late 1990s. The market is an energy only gross pool with zonal (state‐based) pricing. Over the past 15 years, the system has undergone a profound transformation as large coal‐fired power stations have retired and substantial volumes of large‐scale and embedded behind the meter variable renewables have been installed. In this context, Australian governments commissioned a review into the NEM by an expert panel (the ‘NEM Review’). This article provides a summary of the key findings of the Panel across three key timeframes: the short‐term market (spot market) is largely fit for purpose but ‘hidden participants’ are impeding efficient outcomes and there are increasing risks to be managed as the system becomes more weather dependant; the medium‐term derivative market, used to manage risk, requires urgent attention to ensure liquidity and price transparency facilitate efficient management of spot price risk; and a new long‐term integrated market mechanism designed to overcome the ‘tenor gap’ should be introduced to facilitate long‐term investment.
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70125.abstract_zh: 澳大利亚国家电力市场（NEM）成立于20世纪90年代末。该市场是一个仅含能源的集中式现货市场，采用区域（州级）定价机制。过去15年间，随着大型燃煤电厂退役以及大规模集中式与分布式表后可变可再生能源的并网，该电力系统经历了深刻变革。在此背景下，澳大利亚政府委托专家小组对NEM进行审查（即"NEM审查"）。本文总结了该小组在三个关键时间维度的主要发现：短期市场（现货市场）基本满足运行需求，但"隐性参与者"阻碍了效率提升，且随着系统对天气依赖性增强，需管理的风险日益增加；用于风险管理的衍生品中期市场亟需关注，以确保流动性和价格透明度能够有效管理现货价格风险；应引入旨在克服"期限缺口"的新型长期一体化市场机制，以促进长期投资。
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70125.journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70125.title_zh: 改革国家电力市场（NEM）的建议

doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70126.abstract: We apply a household production framework to analyse how changes in cooking skills, waste‐abatement costs and wage rates influence the food waste behaviour of five consumer profiles in Finland. We find that achieving a given reduction in food waste through skill‐enhancing interventions induces larger behavioural adjustments than equivalent reductions in waste‐abatement costs. Higher wage rates, however, counteract efforts to decrease household food waste. Lowering abatement costs at the food preparation stage yields a greater overall reduction in waste than targeting the consumption stage. Our findings indicate that uniform, skill‐based interventions are unlikely to be sustainable without complementary structural support tailored to specific consumer groups. Accordingly, policy measures should combine skill development with targeted reductions in the costs of preventing food waste.
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70126.abstract_zh: 我们运用家庭生产框架，分析烹饪技能变化、减废成本及工资率如何影响芬兰五类消费者群体的食物浪费行为。研究发现，通过技能提升干预实现特定程度的食物浪费减少，比同等程度的减废成本降低更能引发显著的行为调整。然而，更高的工资率会抵消减少家庭食物浪费的努力。相较于针对消费阶段，降低食物准备阶段的减废成本能带来更显著的总体浪费减少。研究结果表明，若缺乏针对特定消费者群体的结构性配套支持，单一化的技能干预措施难以持续。因此，政策制定应将技能培养与定向降低食物浪费预防成本相结合。

doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70126.title: The Feasibility of Household Food Waste Reduction in Finland: Insights From Five Consumer Profiles
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70126.title_zh: 芬兰家庭食物垃圾减量的可行性：基于五种消费者画像的洞见

doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70127.abstract: Productivity growth is essential for securing the long‐term profitability and competitiveness of pasture‐based dairy systems, particularly amid volatile input and output prices and increasing environmental constraints. This paper measures productivity growth using a total factor productivity index (TFPI) tailored to the seasonal, pasture‐based nature of New Zealand dairy farming. We apply a proper‐index approach to enable meaningful comparisons across time and farms. The TFPI is decomposed into key components: technological progress, scale and input‐mix efficiency, technical efficiency, production environment and statistical noise. To account for climate‐related variability, we integrate pasture growth indices as proxies for pasture availability supporting milksolids (fat + protein) production. Between 2012/2013 and 2023/2024, productivity growth plateaued, with the TFPI declining by 1.33% (−0.09% per annum). While technological progress increased by 6.9%, this was offset by declines in scale‐and‐mix efficiency (−4.2%), technical efficiency (−0.63%) and production environment favourability (−1.68%). Moreover, technological progress has stagnated since 2015/2016, suggesting that recent innovations have not translated into measurable productivity gains. These findings underscore the need for a multifaceted response to reverse productivity decline and secure competitiveness: accelerating innovation, strengthening technology adoption and building environmental resilience.
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70127.abstract_zh: 生产率增长对于确保放牧型奶牛养殖系统的长期盈利能力和竞争力至关重要，尤其是在投入品和产出品价格波动加剧以及环境约束日益严格的背景下。本文采用针对新西兰奶牛养殖季节性、放牧型特点的全要素生产率指数（TFPI）来测算生产率增长。我们运用恰当指数方法，以实现跨时间和跨农场的有效比较。TFPI被分解为关键组成部分：技术进步、规模与投入组合效率、技术效率、生产环境以及统计噪声。为考虑气候相关变异性，我们整合了牧草生长指数作为牧草可用性的代理变量，以支持乳固体（脂肪+蛋白质）生产。在2012/2013至2023/2024年间，生产率增长趋于停滞，TFPI下降1.33%（年均下降0.09%）。尽管技术进步增长了6.9%，但被规模与组合效率下降（-4.2%）、技术效率下降（-0.63%）以及生产环境有利性下降（-1.68%）所抵消。此外，自2015/2016年以来技术进步已停滞，表明近期创新并未转化为可衡量的生产率提升。这些发现凸显了需要采取多维度应对措施以扭转生产率下降并确保竞争力：加速创新、强化技术采纳以及构建环境韧性。

doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70127.title: Climate and Feeding Strategies: An Analysis of Productivity Growth in New Zealand Dairy
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70127.title_zh: 气候与饲养策略：新西兰奶牛业生产率增长分析

doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70128.abstract: This paper examines the influence of gender on the adoption of Climate‐Smart Agriculture (CSA) practices in West Africa. An exogenous switching treatment effect regression model with the Oaxaca–Blinder decomposition method is used in the study. Data were collected from the 2018/2019 Harmonized Household Living Conditions Survey across five West African countries. The results indicate that if female plot managers had the same characteristics as their male counterparts, their likelihood of adopting CSA practices would increase, yet it would still be lower than that of men. The decomposition analysis shows a significant gender gap favouring men in Burkina Faso and Senegal, unlike in Ivory Coast and Togo. These gender differences are mainly due to structural factors such as household size, education, access to credit, commercialisation, income, livestock ownership, family labour, pesticide use, soil fertility and the availability of agricultural extension agents and cooperatives. To effectively address gender disparities in CSA adoption, policies could focus on improving these structural conditions rather than solely on ensuring equal access to production resources. This approach would enhance policy effectiveness and empower women to better utilise their agricultural resources.
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70128.abstract_zh: 本文考察了性别对西非气候智慧型农业（CSA）实践采纳的影响。研究采用外生转换处理效应回归模型与奥克萨卡-布林德分解方法，数据来源于2018/2019年五个西非国家的统一家庭生活条件调查。结果表明，若女性地块管理者具备与男性相同的特征，其采纳CSA实践的可能性将有所提升，但仍低于男性。分解分析显示，布基纳法索和塞内加尔存在显著偏向男性的性别差距，而科特迪瓦和多哥则未出现此类差异。这些性别差异主要源于结构性因素，包括家庭规模、教育水平、信贷获取、商业化程度、收入、牲畜所有权、家庭劳动力、农药使用、土壤肥力以及农业推广人员和合作社的可及性。为有效解决CSA采纳中的性别差异，政策应侧重于改善这些结构性条件，而非仅关注生产资源的平等获取。这一方法将提升政策有效性，并增强女性利用农业资源的能力。
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70128.journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70128.title: Gender and Adoption of Climate‐Smart Agricultural Practices in Developing Countries: Evidence From West African Countries
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70128.title_zh: 发展中国家性别与气候智慧型农业实践采纳：来自西非国家的证据

doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70130.abstract: Conservation on working agricultural lands is increasingly recognised as a critical strategy for enhancing the resilience of food systems in the face of climate change. Despite the growing funding worldwide for climate‐smart agriculture and forestry (CSAF) practices, we lack a comprehensive assessment of their economic impacts. Focusing on the impacts of CSAF practices on agricultural productivity and resilience in the United States, we estimate the effects of payments under the Environmental Quality Incentives Program (EQIP) for CSAF on county‐level yields, land rent and measures of production losses for corn, soybean and winter wheat. We also account for the potential confounding effects of land retirement through the Conservation Reserve Program (CRP). Our findings suggest that EQIP payments for CSAF practices are associated with reductions in county‐level corn production losses. In contrast, payments for non‐CSAF practices may increase loss measures. These findings highlight the importance of targeted conservation investments in improving agricultural resilience.
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70130.abstract_zh: 摘要 在应对气候变化的背景下，农业用地上的保护措施日益被视为增强粮食系统韧性的关键策略。尽管全球对气候智慧型农业与林业（CSAF）实践的资助不断增加，但对其经济影响的全面评估仍显不足。本研究聚焦美国CSAF实践对农业生产力和韧性的影响，通过估算环境质量激励计划（EQIP）中CSAF相关补贴对县级玉米、大豆和冬小麦的产量、地租及生产损失指标的作用，同时考虑保护储备计划（CRP）中土地休耕可能带来的混杂效应。研究结果表明，针对CSAF实践的EQIP补贴与县级玉米生产损失减少存在关联；相反，非CSAF实践的补贴可能加剧损失指标。这些发现凸显了定向保护投资在提升农业韧性方面的重要性。

doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70132.abstract: This paper examines the short‐ and long‐run effects of the 2015 Nepal Earthquake on paddy production using a difference‐in‐differences framework and district‐level panel data spanning 2010–2019. We document a 10.95% decline in paddy production and a 6.94% decline in yield in earthquake‐affected districts in the short run, with effects fully dissipating over the long run. Decomposing production losses into intensive and extensive margins reveals that the intensive margin explains the majority of losses. Heterogeneity analysis shows that production losses scale with seismic intensity while yield losses operate as a common behavioural shock uniformly across affected districts. Household survey evidence confirms two reinforcing channels: a contraction in agricultural labour supply during the critical planting season and a reallocation of household resources toward reconstruction of damaged dwellings.
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70132.abstract_zh: 本文采用双重差分框架及2010–2019年区级面板数据，考察2015年尼泊尔地震对水稻生产的短期与长期影响。研究发现，地震受灾地区的水稻产量在短期内下降10.95%，单产下降6.94%，但长期来看这些影响完全消散。将产量损失分解为集约边际与广延边际后发现，集约边际解释了大部分损失。异质性分析表明，产量损失随地震烈度递增，而单产损失则表现为受灾地区普遍存在的共同行为冲击。家户调查证据证实了两种相互强化的传导渠道：关键播种季节农业劳动力供给的收缩，以及家户资源向受损房屋重建的重新配置。

doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70138.abstract: This special issue examines the economics of greenhouse gas (GHG) mitigation in agriculture. The papers in the issue study agricultural mitigation from three broad perspectives: the design of mitigation incentives, the economic benefits of mitigation practices and programmes, and the adoption and behavioural responses by producers, consumers and other stakeholders. The papers span a wide range of countries, production systems and policy contexts, and collectively show that translating mitigation potential into mitigation outcomes depends critically on incentive design, measurement and the actions across producers, consumers, regulators and supply‐chain actors.
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70138.abstract_zh: 摘要 本期特刊探讨农业领域温室气体减排的经济学问题。所收录论文从三大视角研究农业减排：减排激励机制设计、减排实践与项目的经济效益，以及生产者、消费者及其他利益相关方的采纳行为与响应。这些研究覆盖多个国家、生产体系及政策背景，共同表明：将减排潜力转化为实际减排成效，关键取决于激励机制设计、核算方法，以及生产者、消费者、监管机构和供应链参与者的协同行动。

doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70142.abstract: This study examines whether household tap water access affects income‐generating work time among employed rural adults in China. While existing studies have mainly examined the effects of improved water access on employment participation, off‐farm transition and household income, this paper focuses on the intensive margin of labour supply within existing livelihood activities. Drawing on household production and time allocation theory, household tap water access is conceptualised as reducing the time cost of routine domestic production, thereby releasing time that may be reallocated to income‐generating work and other household activities. Using rural panel data from the China Family Panel Studies from 2014 to 2022, the analysis applies individual fixed‐effects models and instrumental variables fixed‐effects (IV‐FE) estimates. The fixed effects results show that household tap water access is associated with approximately one additional hour of income‐generating work per week among employed rural adults. Under the IV identifying assumptions, the IV‐FE estimates suggest a larger positive effect. Additional time‐use analysis indicates that household tap water access reduces daily housework time by about 0.29 h and modestly increases midday nap duration, while no statistically significant changes are found for television watching or leisure reading. Heterogeneity analysis suggests that the increase in work time is concentrated among agricultural workers, self‐employed individuals, prime‐age adults and individuals living in households without young children.
doi:10.1111/1467-8489.70142.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了家庭自来水供应是否影响中国农村就业成年人的创收工作时间。现有研究主要关注改善水资源获取对就业参与、非农转移和家庭收入的影响，而本文聚焦于现有生计活动中劳动力供给的集约边际。基于家庭生产与时间分配理论，家庭自来水供应被概念化为降低日常家务生产的时间成本，从而释放出可能重新分配至创收工作及其他家庭活动的时间。利用2014年至2022年中国家庭追踪调查的农村面板数据，本文采用个体固定效应模型和工具变量固定效应估计。固定效应结果显示，家庭自来水供应与农村就业成年人每周约增加一小时的创收工作时间相关。在工具变量识别假设下，工具变量固定效应估计表明存在更大的正向效应。额外的时间使用分析显示，家庭自来水供应使每日家务时间减少约0.29小时，并适度增加午睡时长，而看电视或休闲阅读的时间未发现统计显著变化。异质性分析表明，工作时间的增加主要集中在农业劳动者、自雇者、壮年成年人以及无幼儿家庭中的个体。
