Local general equilibrium feedback and a decline in bank credit to consumers make up the remaining 24%. We find no contribution of a pure wealth effect in explaining the consumption decline.
doi:10.1111/iere.70086.abstract_zh: 我们利用个体层面数据，量化了家庭金融约束异质性在解释2006年至2009年间总消费下降与房屋价值下降之间关联中的作用。由房屋价值下降触发的约束，以及在房屋价值下降前已面临特别严重约束的一小部分消费者，解释了总消费反应的76%。局部一般均衡反馈和银行对消费者信贷的下降构成了剩余的24%。我们发现，纯财富效应在解释消费下降中并无贡献。
doi:10.1111/iere.70086.title: Housing Wealth and Consumption: The Role of Heterogeneous Credit Constraints
doi:10.1111/iere.70086.title_zh: 住房财富与消费：异质性信贷约束的作用

doi:10.1111/iere.70087.abstract: The gender gap in non‐agricultural employment in developing countries is concentrated among rural married workers. Within‐family specialization is central: Married women spend more time on home production, work fewer market hours, and are less likely to incur fixed costs of entering non‐agriculture. We develop a general equilibrium Roy model with joint household decisions, sector‐neutral gender labor wedges, and entry barriers. Calibrated to China in 2010, the model reproduces the observed gender employment gap. Gender labor wedges explain about 80% of it, amplified by within‐family specialization, while changing entry barriers account for its widening from 2000 to 2010.
doi:10.1111/iere.70087.abstract_zh: 摘要 发展中国家非农就业中的性别差距主要集中在农村已婚劳动者群体。家庭内部分工是核心因素：已婚女性在家务劳动上投入更多时间，市场工作时间更少，且更不愿承担进入非农部门所需的固定成本。我们构建了一个包含联合家庭决策、部门中性性别劳动楔子及进入壁垒的一般均衡罗伊模型。基于2010年中国数据的校准结果显示，该模型能够复现观测到的性别就业差距。其中，性别劳动楔子解释了约80%的差距，并通过家庭内部分工机制被放大；而进入壁垒的变化则解释了2000年至2010年间该差距的扩大趋势。
doi:10.1111/iere.70087.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1111/iere.70087.title: Home Production and Gender Gap in Structural Change
doi:10.1111/iere.70087.title_zh: 家庭生产与结构变迁中的性别差距

doi:10.1111/iere.70088.abstract: We explore implications of social status concerns for redistribution, income inequality, and growth in a political economy framework. Salience of such concerns leads to a propagation mechanism, whereby initial income inequality and reduced willingness to redistribute income reinforce each other, potentially giving rise to multiple steady states. An extension illustrates the possibility of a high redistribution cum low inequality steady state resulting in a higher steady‐state income level. Some of the model features are shown to be consistent with empirical regularities as reflected in survey data on social status attitudes.
doi:10.1111/iere.70088.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文在政治经济学框架下探讨社会地位关注对再分配、收入不平等及经济增长的影响。此类关注的显著性会引发一种传导机制，其中初始收入不平等与再分配意愿的降低相互强化，可能形成多重稳态。扩展分析表明，高再分配与低不平等并存的稳态可能导致更高的稳态收入水平。模型的部分特征与社会地位态度调查数据所反映的实证规律具有一致性。
doi:10.1111/iere.70088.title: Social Status, Inequality, and Redistribution
doi:10.1111/iere.70088.title_zh: 社会地位、不平等与再分配

doi:10.1111/jems.70034.abstract: This paper presents a model of vertical market structure that integrates multiple determinants previously studied in isolation. It shows how the nature of market growth, whether through existing or new applications of an input, and the type of fixed costs, whether exogenous or endogenous, affect the emergence of external suppliers for the input. The role of such suppliers depends on the input's technological generalizability, its potential for improvement, and the breadth and differentiation among downstream applications. Together, these factors shape whether a vertical market structure persists and can potentially drive multiple transitions between vertical integration and outsourcing.
doi:10.1111/jems.70034.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个整合先前孤立研究的多种决定因素的垂直市场结构模型。该模型揭示了市场增长的性质（通过现有应用或新应用实现投入增长）以及固定成本的类型（外生或内生）如何影响投入品外部供应商的出现。此类供应商的作用取决于投入品的技术通用性、其改进潜力，以及下游应用的广度与差异化程度。这些因素共同决定了垂直市场结构是否持续存在，并可能推动垂直整合与外包之间的多重转型。
doi:10.1111/jems.70034.title: The Rise and Fall of Input Suppliers

doi:10.1111/jems.70035.abstract: In this paper, we investigate the contracts offered by a large healthcare purchaser to health service providers. Contracts are based on the DRG principle that all hospitalizations in a diagnosis group are reimbursed at the same rate. This principle is relaxed in practice, as in several cases, the amount reimbursed within each DRG exhibits considerable variability. We build a theoretical model which explains this variability as the attempt of the health authority to ensure appropriate matching between hospitals and patients. We test the model using a very large and detailed administrative data set for the largest region in Italy. In line with our theoretical results, we show that the state funded purchaser offers providers a system of incentives such that, as required by optimality, that providers which treat more patients receive a higher average reimbursement per treatment, suggesting therefore that they treat on average more difficult patients and are compensated for doing so.
doi:10.1111/jems.70035.abstract_zh: 本文研究大型医疗采购方向医疗服务提供者提供的合同。合同基于诊断相关分组（DRG）原则，即同一诊断组内的所有住院治疗均按相同费率报销。然而在实践中，这一原则有所放宽——在多个案例中，每个DRG内的报销金额呈现出显著差异。我们构建了一个理论模型，将这种差异解释为卫生当局为确保医院与患者之间实现恰当匹配的尝试。我们利用意大利最大地区极为详尽的管理数据集对模型进行检验。与理论结果一致，我们发现，国家资助的采购方向提供者提供了一套激励机制：根据最优性要求，治疗患者数量越多的提供者，其每次治疗的平均报销金额越高，这表明他们平均治疗了病情更复杂的患者，并因此获得相应补偿。
doi:10.1111/jems.70035.title: Optimal Healthcare Contracts: Theory and Empirical Evidence
doi:10.1111/jems.70035.title_zh: 最优医疗保健合同：理论与实证证据

doi:10.1111/jems.70037.abstract: We investigate input price discrimination under secret contracting between a manufacturer and competing retailers, whose investment activities exhibit retail effort spillovers. We show that the economic effects of input price discrimination vary with the sign and magnitude of retail effort spillovers according to the contractual structure, namely, linear or two‐part tariffs. Retail effort spillovers and product differentiation affect the pass‐through of input price to retail quantity, which is defined under each contractual structure. Our analysis provides novel insights into the role of retail effort spillovers and into the evaluation of quantity pass‐through in the antitrust scrutiny of input price discrimination.
doi:10.1111/jems.70037.abstract_zh: 本文研究了制造商与竞争性零售商之间秘密合同下的投入品价格歧视问题，其中零售商的投资活动存在零售努力溢出效应。研究表明，投入品价格歧视的经济效应随零售努力溢出的正负及大小而变化，且这种变化取决于合同结构（线性关税或两部收费制）。零售努力溢出与产品差异化会影响投入品价格向零售数量的传导效应，该传导效应在不同合同结构下具有不同定义。本文分析为理解零售努力溢出的作用机制，以及反垄断审查中评估数量传导效应对投入品价格歧视的影响提供了全新视角。
doi:10.1111/jems.70037.title: Input Price Discrimination: The Role of Retail Effort Spillovers
doi:10.1111/jems.70037.title_zh: 投入品价格歧视：零售努力溢出效应的作用

doi:10.1111/jems.70038.abstract: Off‐label use regulation has the potential to change pharmaceutical firms' behavior and—consequently—affect patient welfare. We investigate the impact of changes in off‐label regulation on pharmaceutical firms' behavior in seeking formal marketing approval for supplemental uses. In 2012, a US court decision protected truthful off‐label promotion, providing pharmaceutical companies more leeway to promote off‐label uses of their drug. Using a unique data set of pharmaceutical firms' research and development projects, we exploit this regulatory change to understand how firms react to government policies. Results demonstrate that the hazard of approval declined for supplemental uses, relative to original uses, after the policy change. Patent protection, potential market size, and competition are also important determinants of the hazard of approval. These results have implications not only for innovation policy but for the creation of high‐quality data for certain indications.
doi:10.1111/jems.70038.abstract_zh: 超说明书用药监管可能改变制药企业的行为，进而影响患者福利。本文研究了超说明书用药监管变化对制药企业寻求补充用途正式上市许可行为的影响。2012年美国一项法院裁决保护了真实的超说明书推广行为，使制药公司获得更大空间推广其药物的超说明书用途。我们利用制药企业研发项目的独特数据集，借助这一监管变化来理解企业如何应对政府政策。结果表明，政策变化后，补充用途相较于原始用途的获批风险有所下降。专利保护、潜在市场规模和竞争也是影响获批风险的重要因素。这些发现不仅对创新政策具有启示意义，也对特定适应症高质量数据的生成产生影响。
doi:10.1111/jems.70038.title: Strategic Submissions: An Analysis of Supplemental Drug Approvals
doi:10.1111/jems.70038.title_zh: 策略性提交：补充药物批准的分析

doi:10.1111/jems.70039.abstract: This study empirically examines the effects of High Involvement Management ( HIM ) on establishment productivity. To achieve this it draws on a large‐scale panel data set representative of the German economy. The identification strategy exploits the bracketing property of fixed effects and lagged dependent variable models and supplements this with a selection‐on‐observables approach to estimate causal effects. Descriptive evidence indicates that decision makers value the joint implementation of the pillars of HIM ( Knowledge , Power , Information , and Rewards ), as they tend to cluster and factor analysis confirms that the included management practices reflect a single underlying management orientation. The causal analysis reveals significant productivity gains from HIM and each of its four pillars. These effects materialize for HIM adoption, HIM intensification and the presence of a HIM philosophy. While the results are in line with a monotonically increasing effect as additional pillars are adopted, no synergies between the pillars or underlying practices emerge. Finally, the findings reveal no meaningful differences in the effectiveness of HIM across establishment size, sector, knowledge intensity, or innovation strategy, suggesting that its impact is broadly consistent across organizational contexts.
doi:10.1111/jems.70039.abstract_zh: 本研究利用代表德国经济的大型面板数据集，实证检验了高参与管理（HIM）对机构生产率的影响。识别策略利用固定效应和滞后因变量模型的区间估计特性，并辅以基于可观测变量的选择方法以估计因果效应。描述性证据表明，决策者重视HIM四大支柱（知识、权力、信息与奖励）的协同实施——这些支柱往往呈现聚类特征，且因子分析证实所涵盖的管理实践反映单一潜在管理导向。因果分析揭示HIM及其四大支柱均能带来显著的生产率提升。这些效应体现在HIM的采纳、强化以及HIM理念的存在性上。研究结果与“随支柱采纳数量增加而单调递增”的效应模式一致，但未发现支柱间或基础实践间存在协同效应。最后，研究发现HIM的有效性在机构规模、行业类型、知识密集度或创新战略维度上均无显著差异，表明其影响在不同组织情境中具有广泛一致性。
doi:10.1111/jems.70039.title: The Productivity Effect of High Involvement Management: Causal Evidence From Germany
doi:10.1111/jems.70039.title_zh: 高参与管理的生产率效应：来自德国的因果证据

doi:10.1111/jems.70040.abstract: Using staggered state‐level changes in noncompete enforceability, we document that reduced enforcement increases profitability, valuation, productivity, and plant‐level growth in knowledge‐worker‐intensive firms relative to other firms. Critically, these gains are concentrated among the most productive knowledge‐worker firms, consistent with an assortative matching mechanism in which top firms attract the most productive workers when noncompetes no longer bind. Using inventor‐level data, we find direct evidence of this sorting: more productive inventors migrate toward more productive firms following reductions in enforceability. Consequently, performance dispersion widens across knowledge‐worker‐intensive industries, as the most productive firms pull further ahead of their less productive peers.
doi:10.1111/jems.70040.abstract_zh: 利用各州对竞业限制可执行性的交错调整，我们研究发现：相较于其他企业，降低竞业限制执行力度会提升知识密集型企业的盈利能力、估值、生产率及工厂层面的增长。关键的是，这些收益集中在最具生产力的知识密集型企业中，这与"分类匹配机制"的推论一致——当竞业限制不再具有约束力时，顶尖企业能够吸引最具生产力的劳动者。基于发明者层面的数据，我们发现了这种分类效应的直接证据：在竞业限制执行力度降低后，更具生产力的发明者会向更具生产力的企业迁移。由此，知识密集型行业内的绩效差距持续扩大，最具生产力的企业进一步拉开与低效同行的差距。
doi:10.1111/jems.70040.title: Worker Heterogeneity and the Effect of Noncompetes on Firm Performance
doi:10.1111/jems.70040.title_zh: 工人异质性与竞业限制对企业绩效的影响

doi:10.1111/jmcb.70053.abstract: Applying a wide range of text analysis techniques, we proxy the central bank's loss by extracting the tone of the central bank's qualitative communication and combine it with real‐time quantitative information to estimate the loss function. We find strong and robust evidence of asymmetry in the case of the European Central Bank during 1999–2021: the slope of the loss function was roughly three times steeper when inflation exceeded the target compared to when it was below the target. This represents a significant departure from the quadratic and symmetric monetary policy loss function typically applied in macromodels.
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70053.abstract_zh: 运用多种文本分析技术，我们通过提取央行定性沟通的语调来代理央行的损失，并结合实时定量信息估算损失函数。研究发现，在1999年至2021年期间，欧洲央行存在显著且稳健的非对称性证据：当通胀高于目标时，损失函数的斜率约为低于目标时的三倍。这显著偏离了宏观模型中通常采用的二次对称型货币政策损失函数。
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70053.journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70053.title: Reading between the Lines—Uncovering Asymmetry in the Central Bank Loss Function
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70053.title_zh: 字里行间——揭示中央银行损失函数中的非对称性

doi:10.1111/jmcb.70055.abstract: Understanding how risk factors shape the economic outlook is essential for guiding policy decisions. This paper develops a flexible framework that decomposes distributional risk forecasts of macro‐economic variables into underlying contributions and supports the construction of interpretable risk measures. Multiple modeling strategies, including density and quantile regression, are accommodated underscoring the versatility of the approach. The framework is illustrated using recent U.S. inflation data, showing postpandemic risk forecasts were driven by the business cycle, commodity prices, monetary policy, and inflation expectations. Simulation studies demonstrate robustness, establishing the framework as a general tool for macro‐economic and financial risk assessment.
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70055.abstract_zh: 理解风险因素如何塑造经济前景对于指导政策决策至关重要。本文构建了一个灵活的分析框架，将宏观经济变量的分布风险预测分解为潜在贡献因素，并支持构建可解释的风险度量指标。该框架兼容密度回归与分位数回归等多种建模策略，凸显其方法论的普适性。通过近期美国通胀数据的实证分析表明，后疫情时期的风险预测主要受商业周期、大宗商品价格、货币政策及通胀预期驱动。模拟研究验证了框架的稳健性，确立了其作为宏观经济与金融风险评估通用工具的地位。
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70055.journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70055.title: Mixing It Up: Inflation at Risk
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70055.title_zh: 混合效应：风险中的通胀

doi:10.1111/jmcb.70058.abstract: We consider a payment arrangement in which transfers and holdings of currency, but not of real resources, can be recorded and traced by monitoring technology. We show that this payment arrangement improves upon traditional cash payments, allowing transfers of currency among strangers, which can be interpreted as monetary loans.
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70058.abstract_zh: 我们考虑一种支付安排，其中货币的转移和持有（而非实际资源）可通过监控技术进行记录和追踪。研究表明，这种支付安排优于传统的现金支付，允许陌生人之间进行货币转移，这可以理解为货币贷款。
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70058.journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70058.title: Optimal Payment Arrangement in a Cash‐Less Monetary Economy
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70058.title_zh: 无现金货币经济中的最优支付安排

doi:10.1111/jmcb.70059.abstract: We develop an open‐economy heterogeneous household model with incomplete markets to quantitatively evaluate the welfare and distributional effects—both within and across countries—of the corporate tax cut (Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, TCJA) implemented in the U.S. in 2017. The model allows for examining outcomes under various possibilities including the tax cut in the U.S. being permanent versus temporary and potential fiscal responses of other countries to the TCJA. We find that the TCJA is regressive in the U.S. and has relatively more regressive outcomes in other countries. Whether the wealth‐poor in the U.S. benefit from the TCJA or not depends on the persistence of the tax cut. Finally, when a small country reduces its corporate tax in response to the TCJA, it has a progressive distributional result in its own economy.
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70059.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含不完全市场的开放经济异质性家庭模型，以定量评估2017年美国实施的企业减税政策（《减税与就业法案》，TCJA）在国内外产生的福利与分配效应。该模型允许考察多种情景下的结果，包括美国减税政策的永久性与临时性差异，以及其他国家可能采取的财政应对措施。研究发现：TCJA在美国具有累退性，且在其他国家产生了更显著的累退效应；美国财富匮乏群体能否从TCJA中获益取决于减税政策的持续性；当小国为应对TCJA而降低本国企业税率时，其国内将呈现累进性的分配结果。
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70059.journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70059.title: The Welfare and Distributional Consequences of Corporate Tax Cuts in Open Economies
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70059.title_zh: 开放经济中企业减税的福利与分配效应

doi:10.1111/jmcb.70060.abstract: We show that carbon pricing and bank credit complement each other in reducing firms' carbon emission intensity. Our identification exploits a reform‐driven carbon price increase in the EU emission trading system (ETS) and administrative microdata, including the Italian credit registry. We find that highly exposed ETS firms increase term‐loan demand, relative to less exposed ETS firms. Such credit channel is associated with larger investment, but not with higher carbon emissions, reducing emission intensity. These effects are significant only among firms undertaking green investments. Moreover, higher credit demand by ETS firms crowds out credit supply to smaller firms in brown sectors.
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70060.abstract_zh: 我们证明，碳定价与银行信贷在降低企业碳排放强度方面具有互补作用。我们的识别策略利用了欧盟排放交易体系（ETS）改革驱动的碳价上涨以及包含意大利信贷登记系统的行政微观数据。研究发现，相较于受ETS影响较小的企业，受ETS影响较大的企业增加了定期贷款需求。这种信贷渠道与更大的投资规模相关，但并未导致碳排放增加，反而降低了排放强度。这些效应仅在进行绿色投资的企业中显著。此外，ETS企业信贷需求的增加挤出了对棕色行业中小企业的信贷供给。
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70060.journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70060.title: Carbon Pricing, Credit Reallocation, and Real Effects
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70060.title_zh: 碳定价、信贷重新配置与实际效应

doi:10.1111/jmcb.70061.abstract: Quantitative easing (QE) introduced during the 2008 financial crisis, has since remained a key monetary policy tool. Our paper studies how QE affects market liquidity using unique data on Swedish government bonds. We find that there is a deterioration in the level of market liquidity from QE. This scarcity effect is nonlinear. Only after QE reaches a certain volume level, it outweighs the improvement in liquidity from boosting market demand. Unlike market prices, which often react to announcements, liquidity does not change when QE is announced. Instead, the liquidity effect occurs in connection with the actual purchases.
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70061.abstract_zh: 2008年金融危机期间引入的量化宽松政策（QE）此后一直是重要的货币政策工具。本文利用瑞典政府债券的独特数据，研究量化宽松如何影响市场流动性。我们发现量化宽松会导致市场流动性水平恶化。这种稀缺效应是非线性的：只有当量化宽松达到一定规模后，其对流动性的负面影响才会超过通过提振市场需求带来的改善效应。与通常对政策公告做出反应的市场价格不同，流动性在量化宽松宣布时并未发生变化，而是与实际购买行为相关联时才产生流动性效应。
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70061.journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70061.title: The Liquidity of the Government Bond Market—What Impact Does Quantitative Easing Have? Evidence from Sweden
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70061.title_zh: 政府债券市场流动性——量化宽松有何影响？来自瑞典的证据

doi:10.1111/jmcb.70062.abstract: This paper draws quantitative implications for certain historical coinage issues by adapting a fiat‐money multiple‐denomination model. The model is parameterized to match some key monetary characteristics of late medieval England. A small coin has a more prominent role than mere small change; thus, a shortage of small coins is very costly for poor people, and when commerce advances, it is very costly for all people. A debasement may effectively supply substitutes for small coins in shortage. But debasements cannot be an ultimate solution because the precious metals used to produce coins are practically indivisible.
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70062.abstract_zh: 本文通过调整一种法定货币多面额模型，对特定历史时期的铸币问题进行了量化分析。该模型参数设定以匹配中世纪晚期英格兰的若干关键货币特征。小面额硬币的作用远不止于小额找零；因此，小面额硬币短缺对穷人而言代价高昂，而当商业发展时，对所有人群均会造成巨大损失。货币贬值可有效提供短缺小面额硬币的替代品。然而，由于用于铸造硬币的贵金属实际上不可分割，货币贬值并不能成为根本解决方案。
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70062.journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70062.title: Debasements and Small Coins: An Untold Story of Commodity Money
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70062.title_zh: 铸币贬损与小面额硬币：商品货币的一段未述往事

doi:10.1111/jmcb.70063.abstract: We analyze risks to bank intermediation following the introduction of a central bank digital currency (CBDC) competing with commercial bank deposits as households' source of liquidity. We revisit the equivalence of payment systems result, introducing a collateral constraint on banks' borrowing from the central bank. Comparing equilibria with and without CBDC, we find that the central bank can ensure the same equilibrium allocation by offering loans to banks. However, to access loans, banks must hold collateral at the expense of extending credit to firms. While CBDC introduction has no real effects, it changes aggregate capital ownership and banks' business models.
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70063.abstract_zh: 我们分析了央行数字货币（CBDC）引入后对银行中介业务的风险，该数字货币与商业银行存款作为家庭流动性来源形成竞争。我们重新审视了支付系统等价性结论，引入了银行从央行借款的抵押约束。通过比较引入CBDC与未引入CBDC的均衡状态，我们发现央行可以通过向银行提供贷款来确保相同的均衡配置。然而，为获得贷款，银行必须以牺牲向企业发放信贷为代价持有抵押品。尽管CBDC的引入没有实际影响，但它改变了总体资本所有权和银行的商业模式。
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70063.journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70063.title: Central Bank Digital Currency with Collateral‐Constrained Banks
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70063.title_zh: 抵押约束银行下的央行数字货币

doi:10.1111/jmcb.70064.abstract: We study how alternative carbon pricing policies, namely carbon taxes and cap‐and‐trade schemes, affect macroeconomic dynamics and the welfare cost of business cycles in a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model with financial frictions (FFs) and pollution externalities. FFs play a critical role in shaping how business cycle shocks propagate across carbon pricing regimes. We find that, with financial frictions, welfare costs are generally lower under cap‐and‐trade schemes than under carbon taxes, as procyclical permit prices dampen financial amplification. The welfare gap between the two policies narrows as credit markets become more efficient or countercyclical macroprudential regulation weakens shock transmission.
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70064.abstract_zh: 本文在包含金融摩擦与污染外部性的动态随机一般均衡模型中，研究了两种替代性碳定价政策——碳税与总量控制与交易机制——如何影响宏观经济动态及经济周期的福利成本。金融摩擦在塑造经济周期冲击跨碳定价机制传导路径中发挥关键作用。研究发现，在存在金融摩擦的情况下，总量控制与交易机制下的福利成本通常低于碳税政策，原因在于其顺周期性的排放配额价格能够抑制金融加速器效应。随着信贷市场效率提升或逆周期宏观审慎监管削弱冲击传导机制，两种政策间的福利差距将逐步收窄。
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70064.journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70064.title: Climate Policies, Macroprudential Regulation, and the Welfare Cost of Business Cycles
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70064.title_zh: 气候政策、宏观审慎监管与商业周期的福利成本

doi:10.1111/jmcb.70065.abstract: I investigate the empirical asset pricing implications of a three‐factor macro model that extends the baseline consumption model Consumption Capital Asset Pricing Model (CCAPM) by adding the innovations in expected long‐run consumption growth (consumption growth news) and expected long‐run consumption variance (variance news) as risk factors. By using a reasonable cross‐section of equity risk premia, such a model is largely rejected (both on statistical and economic grounds), as the factor risk prices are either insignificant and/or economically implausible, whereas the pricing errors are very large. Thus, long‐run consumption risks (LRR) do not rescue the CCAPM, which represents a major challenge for the voluminous LRR literature.
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70065.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个三因子宏观模型的实证资产定价含义，该模型在基准消费模型——消费资本资产定价模型（CCAPM）的基础上，将预期长期消费增长（消费增长新闻）和预期长期消费方差（方差新闻）的冲击作为风险因子。通过使用合理的横截面股权风险溢价，该模型在统计和经济层面均被显著拒绝，因为因子风险价格要么不显著，要么在经济上不合理，而定价误差则非常大。因此，长期消费风险（LRR）未能挽救CCAPM，这对大量LRR文献构成了重大挑战。
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70065.journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70065.title: Another Look at the (Ir)Relevance of Long‐Run Risks for Equity Risk Premia
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70065.title_zh: 长期风险对股权风险溢价的（不）相关性再审视

doi:10.1111/jmcb.70066.abstract: In this paper, we propose incorporating both self‐fundamentals, defined as the fundamentals of two economies in one currency pair, and cross‐fundamentals, defined as the fundamentals of other major economies, to forecast exchange rates in line with the theory of “third‐country effects” of Berg and Mark (2015). We utilize the Mallows model averaging method proposed in Hansen (2007) to optimally combine the predictions provided by fundamental submodels. We find that our approach significantly outperforms the random walk and the alternatives for one‐month‐ahead predictions and that both the self‐ and cross‐fundamentals play important roles in prediction. Furthermore, according to our prediction, we obtain meaningful investment profit trading on currencies and bonds.
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70066.abstract_zh: 本文提出将“自身基本面”（定义为货币对中两个经济体的基本面）与“交叉基本面”（定义为其他主要经济体的基本面）相结合，以预测汇率，这与Berg和Mark（2015）提出的“第三国效应”理论一致。我们采用Hansen（2007）提出的Mallows模型平均方法，对基本面子模型提供的预测进行最优组合。研究发现，该方法在提前一个月的预测中显著优于随机游走模型及其他替代模型，且自身基本面与交叉基本面均在预测中发挥重要作用。此外，基于我们的预测，在货币和债券交易中可获得显著的投资利润。
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70066.journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70066.title: Self‐Fundamentals, Cross‐Fundamentals, and Exchange Rate Predictions
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70066.title_zh: 自我基本面、交叉基本面与汇率预测

doi:10.1111/jmcb.70067.abstract: Activity shortfalls are more costly than strong activity. I consider optimal monetary policy under discretion with an asymmetric (shortfalls) loss function in a natural rate model. The optimal monetary policy exacerbates shortfalls, owing to the adjustment of expectations implied by the natural rate hypothesis, and leads to an inflationary bias. Mandating a central bank objective with greater symmetry lowers activity shortfalls and inflation bias. The model also implies that an optimal monetary policy does not accommodate fluctuations from aggregate demand shocks. The analysis implies that monetary accommodation of strong economic activity requires justifications other than asymmetric costs of shortfalls.
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70067.abstract_zh: 活动缺口比强劲活动代价更高。本文在自然率模型下，考虑具有非对称（缺口）损失函数的相机抉择最优货币政策。由于自然率假说所隐含的预期调整，最优货币政策会加剧活动缺口，并导致通胀偏差。设定更具对称性的央行目标可降低活动缺口与通胀偏差。该模型还表明，最优货币政策不会对总需求冲击引发的波动进行调节。分析表明，对强劲经济活动的货币调节需要以缺口非对称成本之外的理由作为依据。
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70067.journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70067.title: Monetary Policy, Employment Shortfalls, and the Natural Rate Hypothesis
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70067.title_zh: 货币政策、就业缺口与自然率假说

doi:10.1111/jmcb.70068.abstract: The European Union Emissions Trading System (EU ETS) experienced sharp allowance price increases from 2018 onward, prompting claims that rational bubbles were driving the surge. We reassess this hypothesis using expectations based on futures prices. We modify an existing testing approach under risk‐neutrality and show that this version of the test is valid in the presence of a dynamic risk premium and robust when the underlying fundamental exhibits a unit root or mildly explosive behavior. Using weekly spot and futures data from 2013 to 2023, we find no evidence of rational bubbles. The evidence is consistent with shifting allowance‐scarcity expectations.
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70068.abstract_zh: 欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）自2018年起经历了配额价格大幅上涨，引发关于理性泡沫推动价格飙升的论断。我们基于期货价格所反映的预期重新评估了这一假说。通过修正风险中性条件下的现有检验方法，我们证明该检验版本在存在动态风险溢价时依然有效，且当基础基本面呈现单位根或轻度爆炸性行为时具有稳健性。基于2013年至2023年的周度现货与期货数据，我们未发现理性泡沫的证据。研究结果与配额稀缺性预期变化这一解释相一致。
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70068.journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70068.title: EU ETS Market Expectations and Rational Bubbles
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70068.title_zh: 欧盟排放交易体系市场预期与理性泡沫

doi:10.1111/jmcb.70069.abstract: We study the two‐way relationship between fixed‐rate mortgages (FRMs) and monetary policy in a panel of up to 35 countries observed over the last two decades. The data set includes quarterly information on the composition of mortgage flows and stocks by type of rate‐fixation and monetary policy shocks cleaned of information effects. Using instrumental‐variable local projections, we show that FRMs induce both path‐ and state‐dependency in monetary transmission. Changes in policy rates shape mortgage choice, increasing (decreasing) the share of FRMs during easing (tightening) cycles. Over time, this mechanism alters the composition of the outstanding mortgage stock which, in turn, affects the central bank's ability to stabilize the economy ex‐post . A greater (lower) prevalence of FRMs weakens (strengthens) monetary policy transmission to real private consumption and GDP.
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70069.abstract_zh: 本文基于过去二十年间最多35个国家的面板数据，研究了固定利率抵押贷款（FRMs）与货币政策之间的双向关系。数据集包含按利率固定类型划分的抵押贷款流量与存量的季度信息，以及剔除信息效应后的货币政策冲击。通过工具变量局部投影法，我们证明FRMs在货币政策传导中同时引发路径依赖与状态依赖。政策利率的变化会塑造抵押贷款选择：在宽松（紧缩）周期中，FRMs占比上升（下降）。随着时间推移，这一机制改变了未偿还抵押贷款存量的构成，进而影响央行事后稳定经济的能力。FRMs的较高（较低）普及率会削弱（增强）货币政策向实际私人消费与GDP的传导效果。
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70069.journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70069.title: Long‐Term Debt and Short‐Term Rates: Fixed‐Rate Mortgages and Monetary Transmission
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70069.title_zh: 长期债务与短期利率：固定利率抵押贷款与货币政策传导

doi:10.1111/jmcb.70070.abstract: We investigate monetary policy transmission and energy saving incentives in response to rising energy prices. We add energy in consumption and production, and energy conservation capital, to a tractable New Keynesian model with heterogeneous agents, unemployment risk, and nominal asset holdings. We find that monetary policy influences the energy conservation through both unemployment risk and asset returns; energy price shocks intensify monetary policy trade‐offs in terms of stabilizing inflation and output. A weaker policy response is beneficial in terms of agents' welfare despite higher inflation. The Ramsey policy predicts a strong rise in the policy rate with a decline afterward.
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70070.abstract_zh: 本文研究了能源价格上涨背景下货币政策的传导机制与节能激励。我们将能源纳入消费与生产环节，并引入节能资本，构建了一个包含异质性主体、失业风险与名义资产持有的可处理新凯恩斯模型。研究发现：货币政策通过失业风险与资产回报双重渠道影响节能行为；能源价格冲击加剧了货币政策在稳定通胀与产出之间的权衡。尽管通胀水平上升，但较弱的政策响应更有利于提升主体福利。拉姆齐政策预测政策利率将先大幅上升后回落。
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70070.journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70070.title: A Heterogeneous Agent Model of Energy Consumption and Energy Conservation
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70070.title_zh: 能源消费与节能的异质性主体模型

doi:10.1111/jmcb.70072.abstract: This paper argues that lower government debt issuance is equivalent to a central bank–operated asset purchase program, commonly known as quantitative easing (QE), as both reduce anticipated future bond supply. However, as it involves neither asset purchases nor associated reserves creation, it is labeled passive QE. A novel classification scheme of central bank balance sheet policies ranks passive QE as stimulative. Supportive evidence from a temporary lowering of government debt issuance in Denmark suggests that declines in long‐term yields reflected both reduced term premia, consistent with supply‐induced portfolio balance effects, and increased safety premia, consistent with safe assets scarcity effects.
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70072.abstract_zh: 本文认为，政府债务发行减少与央行操作的资产购买计划（即通常所称的量化宽松，QE）具有等效性，因为两者均会降低预期的未来债券供给。然而，由于该过程既不涉及资产购买，也不产生相应的准备金创造，因此被称为**被动型**量化宽松。本文提出了一种新的央行资产负债表政策分类框架，将被动型量化宽松归类为具有刺激效应的政策。来自丹麦临时性降低政府债务发行的实证证据表明，长期收益率下降既反映了期限溢价的降低（与供给驱动的投资组合平衡效应一致），也反映了安全溢价的上升（与安全资产稀缺效应一致）。
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70072.journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70072.title: Passive Quantitative Easing: Bond Supply Effects through Lower Debt Issuance
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70072.title_zh: 被动量化宽松：通过降低债务发行实现的债券供给效应

doi:10.1111/jmcb.70073.abstract: This study investigates the impact of central bank transparency (CBT) on foreign exchange market vulnerability, measured by exchange market pressure (EMP). Using panel autoregressive distributed lag (ARDL) analysis on a sample of 32 countries, the results show that greater CBT significantly reduces EMP. The findings remain robust after controlling for U.S. monetary policy uncertainty, economic policy uncertainty, and financial development. However, no evidence is found that CBT becomes more effective during periods of heightened uncertainty. Further analysis indicates that exchange rate flexibility and financial integration strengthen the mitigating effect of CBT on EMP in emerging markets but not in developed markets.
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70073.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了中央银行透明度（CBT）对外汇市场脆弱性（以汇率市场压力（EMP）衡量）的影响。通过对32个国家的面板自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型分析，结果表明，更高的中央银行透明度显著降低了汇率市场压力。在控制美国货币政策不确定性、经济政策不确定性和金融发展水平后，该结论依然稳健。然而，未发现中央银行透明度在不确定性加剧时期更为有效的证据。进一步分析表明，汇率灵活性和金融一体化增强了中央银行透明度对新兴市场汇率市场压力的缓解效应，但在发达市场中并不显著。
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70073.journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70073.title: Does Central Bank Transparency Curb Foreign Exchange Vulnerability?
doi:10.1111/jmcb.70073.title_zh: 中央银行透明度能否抑制外汇脆弱性？

doi:10.1111/jofi.70040.abstract: Combining a randomized controlled trial with administrative and survey data, this paper shows that credit limit extensions significantly increase total spending and income expectations. By controlling for changes in personal income expectations, the spending response to credit limit extensions weakens by approximately 30%. For financially unconstrained consumers, expectation changes account for around two‐thirds of the spending responses to limit extensions. These findings are consistent with consumers inferring future income from credit supply.
doi:10.1111/jofi.70040.abstract_zh: 本文通过将随机对照试验与行政及调查数据相结合，发现信用额度提升显著增加了总支出和收入预期。在控制个人收入预期变化后，信用额度提升对支出的影响减弱约30%。对于财务不受约束的消费者而言，预期变化解释了约三分之二的额度提升支出反应。这些发现与消费者从信贷供给中推断未来收入的推论一致。
doi:10.1111/jofi.70040.title: Learning in the Limit: Income Inference from Credit Extensions
doi:10.1111/jofi.70040.title_zh: 极限学习：从信贷扩展中推断收入

doi:10.1111/jofi.70042.abstract: Republicans start more firms than Democrats. In a sample of 40 million party‐identified Americans between 2005 and 2017, we find that 5.5% of Republicans and 3.7% of Democrats become entrepreneurs. This partisan entrepreneurship gap is time‐varying—Republicans increase their relative entrepreneurship during Republican administrations and decrease it during Democratic administrations, amounting to a partisan reallocation of 170,000 new firms over our 13‐year sample. We find sharp changes in partisan entrepreneurship around the elections of President Obama and President Trump, with the strongest effects among the most politically active partisans: those that donate and vote.
doi:10.1111/jofi.70042.abstract_zh: 共和党人比民主党人创办了更多企业。在2005年至2017年间4000万有党派归属的美国人的样本中，我们发现5.5%的共和党人和3.7%的民主党人成为企业家。这种党派创业差距具有时变性——共和党人在共和党执政期间相对创业率上升，在民主党执政期间下降，在我们的13年样本期内，这相当于17万家新企业的党派间重新配置。我们发现，在奥巴马总统和特朗普总统当选前后，党派创业行为发生了急剧变化，其中对政治参与度最高的党派成员（即捐款和投票者）影响最为显著。
doi:10.1111/jofi.70042.title: Partisan Entrepreneurship

doi:10.1111/jofi.70043.abstract: Using two decades of French administrative data, we find that post‐leveraged buyout (LBO), target firms reduce within‐firm pay gaps while increasing profitability relative to control firms. Employee turnover drives the pay‐gap reduction. In target and control firms alike, turnovers reduce average pay more at the top of the wage distribution than at the bottom because separated employees are paid more—new joiners less—than similar employees, especially among skilled employees. LBOs amplify this effect through increased turnover among managers. Post‐buyout, p90/p10, gender, age, and managers/non‐managers pay gaps decline by 3%, 9%, 21%, and 4% and the employee pool becomes younger.
doi:10.1111/jofi.70043.abstract_zh: 利用法国二十年的行政数据，我们发现，在杠杆收购（LBO）后，目标企业相较于对照组企业，在提升盈利能力的同时缩小了企业内部薪酬差距。员工流动是薪酬差距缩小的主要驱动因素。在目标企业与对照组企业中，员工流动对工资分布顶端平均薪酬的削减效应均强于底端，这是因为离职员工的薪酬高于同类在职员工，而新入职员工的薪酬则低于同类在职员工——这一现象在技能型员工中尤为显著。杠杆收购通过增加管理层的流动率放大了这一效应。收购完成后，p90/p10薪酬比、性别薪酬差距、年龄薪酬差距及管理层/非管理层薪酬差距分别下降3%、9%、21%和4%，员工队伍呈现年轻化趋势。
doi:10.1111/jofi.70043.title: Private Equity and Pay Gaps Inside the Firm
doi:10.1111/jofi.70043.title_zh: 私募股权与企业内部薪酬差距

doi:10.1111/jofi.70044.abstract: Using information in returns, we identify the stochastic process of consumption. We find that aggregate consumption reacts over multiple quarters to innovations spanned by financial markets. This persistent component accounts for over a quarter of consumption variation. These shocks command a large and significant risk premium, driving a large share of stocks' and a small yet significant fraction of bonds' time‐series variation. Nevertheless, we find no support for stochastic volatility of consumption driving time‐varying risk premia. Finally, an otherwise standard recursive utility model based on our estimated process explains equity premium and risk‐free rate puzzles with low‐risk aversion.
doi:10.1111/jofi.70044.abstract_zh: 利用收益率中的信息，我们识别了消费的随机过程。研究发现，总体消费对金融市场所涵盖的冲击会持续多个季度作出反应。这一持久性成分解释了超过四分之一的消费波动。这些冲击具有显著且规模较大的风险溢价，驱动了股票时间序列变化的主要部分以及债券时间序列变化中虽小但显著的部分。然而，我们并未发现消费的随机波动性驱动时变风险溢价的证据。最后，基于我们估计过程的递归效用模型（在其他方面均为标准设定）在低风险厌恶水平下解释了股权溢价和无风险利率之谜。
doi:10.1111/jofi.70044.title: Consumption in Asset Returns

doi:10.1111/jofi.70045.abstract: We infer risk‐free rates from index option prices to estimate safe asset convenience yields in 10 G11 currencies. Countries' convenience yields increase with the level of their interest rates, with U.S. convenience yields fifth largest. During financial crises, convenience yields grow, but the difference between United States and foreign convenience yields generally does not. Covered interest parity (CIP) deviations using our option‐implied rates are a similar size between the United States and each other country. A model in which convenience yields depend on domestic financial intermediaries, but CIP deviations reflect the funding costs of international arbitrageurs financed with dollar‐denominated debt, explains these results.
doi:10.1111/jofi.70045.abstract_zh: 我们从指数期权价格中推断无风险利率，以估算10种G11货币的安全资产便利收益率。各国的便利收益率随其利率水平上升而增加，其中美国的便利收益率位列第五。在金融危机期间，便利收益率上升，但美国与外国便利收益率之间的差异通常并未扩大。使用我们基于期权隐含利率计算的抛补利率平价（CIP）偏差，在美国与其他国家之间规模相近。一个模型解释了这些结果：便利收益率取决于国内金融中介机构，而CIP偏差则反映了以美元计价债务融资的国际套利者的融资成本。
doi:10.1111/jofi.70045.title: Risk‐Free Rates and Convenience Yields around the World
doi:10.1111/jofi.70045.title_zh: 全球无风险利率与便利收益

doi:10.1111/jofi.70046.abstract: I propose a dynamic equilibrium model of rental markets that endogenously gives rise to defaults on rents and evictions. In the model, eviction protections make it harder to evict delinquent renters, but higher default costs to landlords increase equilibrium rents. I quantify the model using micro data on evictions, rents, and homelessness. I find that stronger eviction protections exacerbate housing insecurity and lower welfare. The key empirical driver of this result is the persistent nature of risk underlying rent delinquencies. Rental assistance reduces housing insecurity and improves welfare because it lowers the likelihood that renters default ex ante.
doi:10.1111/jofi.70046.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个内生产生租金违约与驱逐现象的租赁市场动态均衡模型。模型中，驱逐保护政策提高了驱逐违约租户的难度，但房东承担的更高违约成本会推高均衡租金。我利用关于驱逐、租金和无家可归的微观数据对模型进行量化分析，发现强化驱逐保护会加剧住房不安全并降低社会福利。这一结果的关键实证驱动因素在于租金违约风险的持续性特征。租金援助通过降低租户事前违约概率，有效缓解住房不安全并提升社会福利。
doi:10.1111/jofi.70046.title: The Equilibrium Effects of Eviction Policies

doi:10.1111/jofi.70047.abstract: We introduce a simple measure of informed trading risk, , the residual to liquidity quote‐improvement‐to‐deterioration ratio times . When facing with increased informed trading risk, liquidity providers compete less to provide liquidity, reducing their undercutting activity. Reductions in undercutting leave footprints in trade and quote data that are captured by . Unlike prior measures, is easy to construct, can be computed intraday, and is orthogonal to liquidity. The measure outperforms prominent existing alternatives in reflecting the extent of information asymmetry before earnings announcements, predicting unscheduled press releases, and identifying informed trading spillovers around them.
doi:10.1111/jofi.70047.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种衡量知情交易风险的简易指标，即流动性报价改善与恶化比率乘以的残差。当面临知情交易风险上升时，流动性提供者会减少流动性供给竞争，从而降低其削价行为。削价行为的减少会在交易与报价数据中留下可被该指标捕捉的痕迹。与以往指标不同，该指标易于构建、可日内计算，且与流动性正交。在反映盈余公告前信息不对称程度、预测非计划性新闻发布以及识别其引发的知情交易溢出效应方面，该指标优于现有主流替代指标。
doi:10.1111/jofi.70047.title: Detecting Informed Trading Risk from Undercutting Activity
doi:10.1111/jofi.70047.title_zh: 从压价行为中识别知情交易风险

doi:10.1111/jofi.70048.abstract: Dealer quotes in corporate bonds, though indicative, lower trading costs and increase trading volume. Dealers offering higher quality quotes attract more order flow and execute trades at favorable prices. Dealers advertise quotes to manage their inventories and attract orders from nonrelationship clients. However, quote competition is imperfect. The best quotes often fail to attract orders, and trade‐throughs are common. Nevertheless, quote competition is important as clients exploit quotes from other dealers in negotiations, forcing dealers with lower quality quotes to offer price improvements. Quoting is not a zero‐sum game, as more active bond‐level quoting leads to more bond‐level trading.
doi:10.1111/jofi.70048.abstract_zh: 公司债券中的交易商报价虽为指示性报价，却能降低交易成本并提升交易量。提供更优质报价的交易商能吸引更多订单流，并以有利价格执行交易。交易商通过报价来管理库存并吸引非关系型客户的订单。然而，报价竞争并不完美。最优报价往往未能吸引订单，且"穿透交易"现象普遍存在。尽管如此，报价竞争仍至关重要——客户会在谈判中利用其他交易商的报价，迫使报价质量较低的交易商提供价格改善。报价并非零和博弈，因为更活跃的债券层面报价会带来更多债券层面交易。
doi:10.1111/jofi.70048.title: Quote Competition in Corporate Bonds
doi:10.1111/jofi.70048.title_zh: 公司债券中的报价竞争

doi:10.1111/jofi.70049.abstract: Using granular data covering both regulated (brokerage‐financed) and unregulated (shadow‐financed) margin accounts in China, we provide novel evidence on retail investors' margin trading behavior and its price implications. We first show that retail investors' decisions to lever up in stock trading despite the hefty borrowing cost is related to their lottery preferences. We then show that margin borrowing affects investors' trading behavior—investors are more likely to liquidate their holdings as they approach margin calls. Finally, we show that margin‐induced trading aggregates to affect asset prices and contributes to shock spillovers across stocks (e.g., from lottery stocks to nonlottery stocks).
doi:10.1111/jofi.70049.abstract_zh: 利用涵盖中国受监管（券商融资）和未受监管（影子融资）保证金账户的颗粒化数据，我们提供了关于散户投资者保证金交易行为及其价格影响的新证据。首先，我们证明散户投资者在股票交易中尽管面临高昂的借贷成本仍选择加杠杆的行为，与其博彩偏好相关。其次，我们揭示保证金借贷会影响投资者的交易行为——当投资者接近追加保证金通知时，更倾向于抛售持仓。最后，我们证明由保证金驱动的交易会聚合影响资产价格，并加剧股票间的冲击溢出效应（例如，从博彩类股票向非博彩类股票传导）。
doi:10.1111/jofi.70049.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1111/jofi.70049.title: The Drivers and Implications of Retail Margin Trading
doi:10.1111/jofi.70049.title_zh: 零售保证金交易的驱动因素及其影响

doi:10.1111/jofi.70050.abstract: This paper documents a new stylized fact: the cross‐sectional variation in CEO pay levels has declined precipitously in recent years. We offer one explanation for this decline, namely, firms are increasingly benchmarking CEO compensation to industry peers closest in size, thereby creating pay clusters. Our empirical tests provide support for this explanation and suggest that the rise of industry‐size benchmarking is driven by three institutional factors: the mandatory disclosure of compensation peer groups, proxy advisory influence, and say‐on‐pay regulation. Our findings highlight a consequence of adopting a one‐size‐fits‐all standard in the pay‐setting process.
doi:10.1111/jofi.70050.abstract_zh: 本文揭示了一个新的典型事实：近年来，CEO薪酬水平的截面差异急剧缩小。我们对此现象提出一种解释：企业日益倾向于以行业内规模最接近的同行作为薪酬基准，从而形成薪酬聚类。实证检验支持这一解释，并表明行业规模基准化的兴起由三项制度因素驱动：薪酬对标群体的强制披露、代理投票顾问的影响力以及薪酬话语权监管。研究结果凸显了在薪酬制定过程中采用"一刀切"标准所带来的后果。
doi:10.1111/jofi.70050.title: Why Have CEO Pay Levels Become Less Diverse?
doi:10.1111/jofi.70050.title_zh: 为何CEO薪酬水平变得不那么多样化？

doi:10.1111/jofi.70051.abstract: We examine how digital disruption affects bank competition using the staggered rollout of 3G mobile networks. 3G expansion increased mobile banking adoption among tech‐savvy households, reducing branch networks—especially in younger counties. Banks' strategies diverged: Less branch‐reliant banks closed branches and competed on price, while more branch‐reliant banks maintained branches but raised spreads. A structural model shows that perceived digital service improvements among younger consumers drove these shifts, reducing welfare for older savers. Counterfactuals demonstrate that subsidizing adoption for older savers can cost‐effectively reduce these disparities, facilitating a smoother digital transition.
doi:10.1111/jofi.70051.abstract_zh: 本文利用3G移动网络的分阶段推广，考察数字冲击如何影响银行竞争。3G网络的扩展提升了精通技术的家庭对移动银行的采用率，导致银行分支网络收缩——尤其在人口较年轻的县。银行策略出现分化：对分支依赖度较低的银行关闭网点并展开价格竞争，而对分支依赖度较高的银行则维持网点但提高利差。结构模型表明，年轻消费者对数字服务感知的改善驱动了这些变化，但降低了老年储户的福利。反事实分析显示，为老年储户提供采用补贴可低成本缩小此类差距，从而推动更平稳的数字转型。
doi:10.1111/jofi.70051.title: Bank Competition Amid Digital Disruption: Implications for Financial Inclusion
doi:10.1111/jofi.70051.title_zh: 数字冲击下的银行竞争：对金融包容性的影响

doi:10.1111/jofi.70054.abstract: We show that FX interventions can be effective, particularly in attenuating global financial spillovers. We exploit global financial shocks and Brazilian central bank interventions in FX derivatives using three matched administrative registers: bank credit (to firms), foreign credit to banks, and employer‐employees. After the U.S. Taper Tantrum (followed by emerging markets' FX turbulence), Brazilian banks with more foreign debt cut credit supply, reducing firm‐level employment. A subsequent large policy intervention supplying derivatives against FX risks — hedger of last resort — halved the negative effects. A 2008 to 2015 panel exploiting global FX shocks and local FX interventions confirms the results and the hedging channel. However, the FX policy entails fiscal and moral hazard costs.
doi:10.1111/jofi.70054.abstract_zh: 我们证明外汇干预是有效的，尤其是在缓解全球金融溢出效应方面。我们利用全球金融冲击和巴西央行在外汇衍生品领域的干预措施，结合三组匹配的行政登记数据：银行对企业信贷、银行的外国信贷以及雇主-雇员数据。在美国缩减恐慌（随后引发新兴市场外汇动荡）之后，外债较多的巴西银行削减了信贷供给，导致企业层面的就业减少。随后，一项大规模的政策干预——作为最后对冲者提供外汇衍生品以对冲外汇风险——将负面效应减半。利用2008年至2015年面板数据，结合全球外汇冲击与本地外汇干预的分析，进一步证实了上述结果及对冲渠道的作用。然而，外汇政策也带来了财政成本和道德风险成本。
doi:10.1111/jofi.70054.title: Hedger of Last Resort: Evidence from Brazilian FX Interventions, Local Credit, and Global Financial Cycles
doi:10.1111/jofi.70054.title_zh: 最后避险对冲者：来自巴西外汇干预、本地信贷与全球金融周期的证据

doi:10.1111/jofi.70055.abstract: We study the asset allocation and investment performance of U.S. private foundations that support the charitable sector. Large foundations generated positive risk‐adjusted returns before 2008, driven by early access to private equity and venture capital funds, but have underperformed since. The median foundation underperforms by more than 100 bps. Foundations with concentrated stock holdings achieve higher returns but assume more risk. Due to the constraints imposed by the 5% minimum spending rule and accommodating monetary policy, foundations increase risk‐taking and reach for yield. Over time, a conservative asset allocation decreases real wealth, reducing charitable giving.
doi:10.1111/jofi.70055.abstract_zh: 本文研究美国私人基金会在支持慈善事业中的资产配置与投资绩效。大型基金会在2008年前通过早期进入私募股权和风险投资基金获得了正向风险调整收益，但此后表现不佳。中位数基金会业绩落后超过100个基点。持有集中股票的基金会获得更高收益，但承担更多风险。受5%最低支出规则约束及宽松货币政策影响，基金会增加风险承担并追逐收益。长期来看，保守型资产配置会减少实际财富，进而降低慈善捐赠。
doi:10.1111/jofi.70055.title: Investing with Purpose: Evidence from Private Foundations
doi:10.1111/jofi.70055.title_zh: 有目的的投资：来自私人基金会的证据

doi:10.1111/jofi.70058.abstract: We examine optimal capital requirements in a quantitative general equilibrium model with banks exposed to nondiversifiable borrower default risk. Contrary to standard models of bank default risk, our framework captures the limited upside, but significant downside risk of loan portfolio returns. This helps to reproduce the frequency and severity of twin defaults : simultaneously high firm and bank defaults. Hence, the optimal bank capital requirement, which trades off a lower frequency of twin defaults against restricting credit provision, is higher than under default risk models which underestimate the impact of borrower default on bank solvency.
doi:10.1111/jofi.70058.abstract_zh: 本文在银行面临不可分散的借款人违约风险的量化一般均衡模型中，考察了最优资本要求。与标准的银行违约风险模型不同，我们的框架捕捉了贷款组合收益的有限上行空间，但显著的下行风险。这有助于再现“双重违约”（即企业违约与银行违约同时高发）的频率与严重程度。因此，最优银行资本要求——在降低双重违约频率与限制信贷供给之间进行权衡——高于那些低估借款人违约对银行偿付能力影响的违约风险模型所给出的水平。
doi:10.1111/jofi.70058.title: Twin Defaults and Bank Capital Requirements
doi:10.1111/jofi.70058.title_zh: 双重违约与银行资本要求

doi:10.1111/jofi.70059.abstract: This paper provides novel empirical evidence that cash‐rich firms have higher equity payouts and higher stock prices in response to expansionary monetary policy surprises. Stock prices rise despite weak cash‐flow, investment, and credit responses to monetary policy. I rationalize the empirical evidence in a heterogeneous‐firm New Keynesian model where firms finance investment with cash and equity issuance. Monetary easing weakens precautionary cash demand, leading cash‐rich firms to optimally allocate excess funds to shareholders. Since payouts are procyclical, cash‐rich firms earn higher returns in expansionary periods. My findings highlight a payout channel through which monetary policy impacts asset prices.
doi:10.1111/jofi.70059.abstract_zh: 本文提供了新颖的经验证据，表明在扩张性货币政策冲击下，现金充裕的企业具有更高的股权支付率和更高的股票价格。尽管现金流、投资和信贷对货币政策的反应较弱，股票价格仍出现上涨。我在一个异质性企业新凯恩斯模型中合理化这一经验证据，该模型中企业通过现金和股权发行来为投资融资。货币宽松削弱了预防性现金需求，导致现金充裕的企业将多余资金最优地分配给股东。由于支付具有顺周期性，现金充裕的企业在扩张期获得更高回报。我的发现揭示了货币政策影响资产价格的一个支付渠道。
doi:10.1111/jofi.70059.title: Cash Heterogeneity and the Payout Channel of Monetary Policy
doi:10.1111/jofi.70059.title_zh: 现金异质性与货币政策的支付渠道

doi:10.1111/jofi.70060.abstract: We propose a measure of the valuation gap between debt and equity—debt‐equity spread (DES)—based on the difference between actual and equity‐implied credit spreads. DES predicts cross‐sectional stock and bond returns in opposite directions. This predictability is unique compared to existing mispricing measures and cannot be explained by exposures to various risk factors. High‐DES firms are more likely to issue equity and retire debt, and have more insider equity selling. These findings are consistent with DES capturing relative mispricing between debt and equity, and provide empirical support for the model of partially segmented markets in Greenwood, Hanson, and Liao (2018, Review of Financial Studies 31, 3307–3343).
doi:10.1111/jofi.70060.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种衡量债务与股权估值差距的指标——债务-股权利差（DES），该指标基于实际信用利差与股权隐含信用利差之间的差异。DES能够反向预测股票和债券的横截面收益。这种预测能力相较于现有的错误定价指标具有独特性，且无法通过各类风险因子的暴露来解释。高DES企业更倾向于发行股票并偿还债务，同时内部人股权出售行为更为频繁。这些发现与DES捕捉债务与股权相对错误定价的结论一致，并为Greenwood、Hanson和Liao（2018，《金融研究评论》第31卷，第3307–3343页）提出的部分分割市场模型提供了实证支持。
doi:10.1111/jofi.70060.china_reason: 本地后台人工确认：排除中国相关
doi:10.1111/jofi.70060.china_relevance_reason: 本地后台人工确认：排除中国相关
doi:10.1111/jofi.70060.title: The Debt‐Equity Spread

doi:10.1111/jofi.70061.title: Report of the Editor of The Journal of Finance for the Year 2025

doi:10.1111/jofi.70062.abstract: We present results from a field experiment that introduced digital payroll accounts to unbanked factory workers to examine how inexperienced consumers learn to use a new financial technology. We find that exposure to payroll accounts leads to increased account use, accelerated learning, and avoidance of common consumer protection risks. Those receiving electronic wage payments gradually build trust in the technology, learn to use accounts without assistance, and avoid illicit fees. Using experimental variation in assignment to bank versus mobile money accounts, we show that these impacts are concentrated in mobile money accounts, the newer, more complex, and less trusted financial technology.
doi:10.1111/jofi.70062.abstract_zh: 我们通过一项实地实验，向无银行账户的工厂工人引入数字工资账户，以考察缺乏经验的消费者如何学习使用新型金融技术。研究发现，接触工资账户能提升账户使用率、加速学习进程，并帮助规避常见的消费者保护风险。接受电子工资支付的工人逐渐建立起对该技术的信任，学会独立使用账户，并避免支付非法费用。通过实验性分配银行账户与移动货币账户的差异，我们证明这些影响主要集中在移动货币账户上——这是一种更新颖、更复杂且信任度较低的金融技术。
doi:10.1111/jofi.70062.title: Learning to Navigate a New Financial Technology
doi:10.1111/jofi.70062.title_zh: 学习驾驭新型金融技术

doi:10.1111/joie.70026.abstract: We study RPM and vertical integration in a common agency setting with two differentiated manufacturers and one retailer, where consumer demand depends on both the manufacturers' and retailer's noncontractible efforts. Under vertical separation, the adoption of maximum RPM by both manufacturers is an equilibrium and intensifies competition, since manufacturing margins are positive to incentivize manufacturing effort. This benefits consumers and may lower industry profits relative to a scenario where RPM is not available. Vertical integration between the retailer and one of the manufacturers increases industry profits and, when retail effort is also important, may benefit consumers by mitigating double marginalization.
doi:10.1111/joie.70026.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个包含两家差异化制造商和一家零售商的共同代理框架下的转售价格维持（RPM）与纵向一体化问题，其中消费者需求同时取决于制造商和零售商不可契约化的努力水平。在纵向分离情形下，两家制造商均采用最高转售价格维持构成均衡状态，并加剧了市场竞争——这是因为制造商需维持正利润空间以激励其努力投入。相较于无法实施RPM的情形，这种机制使消费者获益，但可能降低行业整体利润。当零售商与其中一家制造商实现纵向一体化时，行业利润得以提升；若零售努力同样重要，该模式还能通过缓解双重边际化效应使消费者受益。
doi:10.1111/joie.70026.title: RPM and Vertical Integration With Upstream Competition and Noncontractible Efforts
doi:10.1111/joie.70026.title_zh: 上游竞争与非契约努力下的转售价格维持与纵向一体化

doi:10.1111/joie.70027.abstract: In this paper, we investigate how competition among NGOs to attract donations shapes the incentives that NGOs provide to their employees. NGOs hire workers to undertake development projects, which are horizontally and vertically differentiated. Workers perform constructive activities that enhance project quality, but can also engage in non‐observable destructive activities that harm the employing organization. NGOs offer monetary incentives to encourage constructive effort, but also need monitoring to curb destructive behavior. Our analysis yields the following results: (i) a high mission orientation on the part of NGOs makes workers' misconduct harder to eliminate; (ii) increased competition in the market for donations leads to higher constructive effort and project quality, but also to greater destructive effort; (iii) relative to the social optimum, the market outcome entails inadequate monitoring and excessive destructive behavior.
doi:10.1111/joie.70027.abstract_zh: 本文研究了非政府组织（NGO）在吸引捐款的竞争如何影响其向员工提供的激励措施。NGO雇佣工人开展发展项目，这些项目在横向和纵向维度上存在差异。工人从事提升项目质量的建设性活动，但也可能进行损害雇佣组织的不可观测的破坏性活动。NGO通过货币激励鼓励建设性努力，同时需要监督机制遏制破坏性行为。分析得出以下结论：（i）NGO的高使命导向使员工不当行为更难以消除；（ii）捐款市场竞争加剧会提升建设性努力和项目质量，但也会增加破坏性行为；（iii）与社会最优水平相比，市场均衡结果表现为监督不足和过度破坏性行为。
doi:10.1111/joie.70027.title: Bad NGOs? Competition in the Market for Donations and Workers' Misconduct
doi:10.1111/joie.70027.title_zh: 不良非政府组织？捐赠市场竞争与员工不当行为

doi:10.1111/joie.70029.abstract: This paper studies the effect of media market competition on confirmatory bias, the tendency to confirm common priors to appear competent, while accounting for both single‐ and multi‐homing. It finds that competition helps sustain informative reporting when priors are relatively precise, but has the opposite effect when priors are diffuse. The reason is that when competing outlets are perceived as similarly competent, consumers optimally multi‐home. This creates strategic complementarity in informative reporting and helps sustain it when the priors are relatively precise. However, when perceived competencies diverge, consumers single‐home with the outlet they view as most competent, creating incentives for confirmatory reporting when the priors are diffuse.
doi:10.1111/joie.70029.abstract_zh: 本文研究了媒体市场竞争对确认性偏差（即倾向于确认共同先验以显得专业）的影响，同时考虑了单归属与多归属两种情形。研究发现，当先验信息相对精确时，竞争有助于维持信息性报道；但当先验信息模糊时，竞争则产生相反效果。其原因在于：当竞争性媒体被视为具有相似专业能力时，消费者会最优地选择多归属。这种选择在信息性报道中形成策略互补性，并在先验信息相对精确时有助于维持该报道模式。然而，当感知的专业能力存在差异时，消费者会单归属至其认为最专业的媒体，从而在先验信息模糊时产生确认性报道的激励。
doi:10.1111/joie.70029.title: Media Market Structure and Confirmatory News
doi:10.1111/joie.70029.title_zh: 媒体市场结构与确认性新闻

doi:10.1111/joie.70030.abstract: Firms can share data to discover potential synergies between their data sets and algorithms, eventually leading to more efficient mergers and acquisitions (M&A) decisions. However, data sharing also modifies the competitive balance when firms do not merge, and a company may be reluctant to share data with potential rivals. Under general conditions, we show that firms benefit from (partially) sharing data. By doing so, they can merge conditionally based on high synergies. Compared to a laissez‐faire situation, the presence of a regulator allowing or refusing the M&A may increase or decrease data sharing, with a concomitant increase or decrease in consumer surplus. Hence, regulation can reduce the surplus of consumers it is willing to protect. We revisit the Google/Fitbit acquisition through the lens of this interplay between strategic data sharing and antitrust policy.
doi:10.1111/joie.70030.abstract_zh: 企业可以通过共享数据来发现其数据集与算法之间的潜在协同效应，最终促成更高效的并购决策。然而，当企业未进行合并时，数据共享也会改变竞争格局，导致企业可能不愿与潜在竞争对手共享数据。在一般条件下，我们证明企业能从（部分）数据共享中获益。通过这种方式，它们可以基于高协同效应有条件地实施合并。与放任自流的情形相比，允许或拒绝并购的监管机构的存在可能增加或减少数据共享，并随之带来消费者剩余的增加或减少。因此，监管可能反而会降低其本意要保护的消费者剩余。我们通过战略数据共享与反垄断政策之间的这种互动关系，重新审视了谷歌/飞特必收购案。
doi:10.1111/joie.70030.title: Make or Buy Decisions and Data Sharing
doi:10.1111/joie.70030.title_zh: 自制或外购决策与数据共享

doi:10.1111/joie.70031.abstract: This paper analyzes optimal licensing contracts when a licensee faces the risk of future infringement claims by unknown patent holders. In a setting where a noncompeting licensor contracts with a monopolistic manufacturer, fixed‐fee licensing is optimal absent such claims. We show that the possibility of future patent claims makes it optimal to include a per‐unit royalty. The royalty reduces the surplus available to potential third‐party claimants and serves as a rent‐protection device, trading off allocative inefficiency against hold‐up risk. Restrictions on the contracting space can be justified when more realistic features of demand uncertainty or stochastic patent arrival are considered.
doi:10.1111/joie.70031.abstract_zh: 本文分析了当被许可方面临未知专利持有人未来侵权索赔风险时的最优许可合同。在非竞争性许可方与垄断制造商签订合同的背景下，若无此类索赔，固定费用许可为最优选择。研究表明，未来专利索赔的可能性使得引入单位特许权使用费成为最优方案。该使用费降低了潜在第三方索赔方可获得的剩余，并充当租金保护机制，在配置效率损失与敲竹杠风险之间进行权衡。当考虑需求不确定性或专利随机出现等更现实的特征时，对合同空间的限制具有合理性。
doi:10.1111/joie.70031.title: Lurking Patent Claims and Strategic Royalty Contracts
doi:10.1111/joie.70031.title_zh: 潜伏性专利权利要求与战略性许可合同

doi:10.1111/joie.70033.abstract: We propose a new approach to production function estimation that integrates the strengths of the proxy‐variable (PV) and dynamic panel data (DPD) methods. Our framework augments the set of instruments for the level equation in Blundell and Bond [8] with a Berkson‐type instrument motivated by economic theory, following Olley and Pakes [28], Levinsohn and Petrin [24], and Ackerberg et al. [4]. This modification allows unobserved productivity to include both a time‐invariant (“fixed‐effect”) component and a time‐varying component that follows a potentially nonlinear Markov process. Whereas the PV approach accommodates nonlinear Markov dynamics but not fixed effects, and the DPD approach accounts for fixed effects but only with linear Markov dynamics, our method relaxes both restrictions. Our estimator is straightforward to implement using GMM. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that it outperforms the canonical PV and DPD estimators when productivity persistence is low and fixed‐effect heterogeneity is substantial.
doi:10.1111/joie.70033.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种新的生产函数估计方法，融合了代理变量法与动态面板数据法的优势。我们的框架在Blundell和Bond [8]的水平方程工具变量集中，引入了一个基于经济理论的Berkson型工具变量，遵循Olley和Pakes [28]、Levinsohn和Petrin [24]以及Ackerberg等人[4]的思路。这一改进允许不可观测的生产率同时包含时不变（“固定效应”）成分和遵循潜在非线性马尔可夫过程的时变成分。代理变量法虽能处理非线性马尔可夫动态但无法应对固定效应，动态面板数据法则能处理固定效应但仅适用于线性马尔可夫动态，而我们的方法同时放宽了这两项限制。该估计量可通过广义矩估计法简便实现。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，当生产率持续性较低且固定效应异质性显著时，本方法优于经典代理变量法和动态面板数据法估计量。
doi:10.1111/joie.70033.title: A Unified Approach to Estimating Production Functions: Proxy Variables and Dynamic Panel Data
doi:10.1111/joie.70033.title_zh: 生产函数估计的统一方法：代理变量与动态面板数据

doi:10.1111/joie.70034.abstract: This paper examines the joint role of strategic timing, asymmetric private demand and cost information, and common ownership in shaping equilibrium outcomes in oligopolistic markets. We develop a three‐firm model and study Cournot and Stackelberg competition. The main results are as follows. (1) Mover advantages are determined by relative signal precision: the leader benefits most when the second mover has a more precise signal, the second mover benefits most when the last mover has high signal precision, and the last mover benefits when both followers have sufficiently noisy signals. (2) Cournot competition generates greater consumer and total surplus and lower total profits than Stackelberg competition if neither follower has significantly higher signal precision than the leader. (3) Common ownership increases consumer and total surplus but reduces total profits in Stackelberg competition if and only if the last mover is not substantially better informed than the leader. These findings have implications for contests, partnership, network, public good, common resource, and gas emission games with altruistic preferences. Since total profit in oligopoly models can be interpreted as aggregate welfare in these environments, the welfare rankings are reversed.
doi:10.1111/joie.70034.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究了战略时机、非对称私有需求与成本信息以及共同所有权在寡头垄断市场均衡结果中的联合作用。我们构建了一个三企业模型，并分析了古诺竞争与斯塔克伯格竞争。主要结论如下：（1）先动优势取决于相对信号精度：当后动者拥有更精确的信号时，先动者获益最大；当最后动者信号精度较高时，第二动者获益最大；当两个追随者的信号均足够模糊时，最后动者获益最大。（2）若任一追随者的信号精度未显著高于先动者，古诺竞争比斯塔克伯格竞争能带来更高的消费者剩余与总剩余，但总利润更低。（3）在斯塔克伯格竞争中，当且仅当最后动者的信息优势未显著超过先动者时，共同所有权会提升消费者剩余与总剩余，但降低总利润。这些发现对存在利他偏好的竞赛、合伙、网络、公共品、公共资源及气体排放博弈具有启示意义。由于寡头模型中的总利润可被解释为这些环境中的总福利，福利排序将发生逆转。
doi:10.1111/joie.70034.title: Simultaneous and Sequential Competition With Asymmetric Information and Externalities
doi:10.1111/joie.70034.title_zh: 不对称信息与外部性下的同时与序贯竞争

doi:10.1111/joie.70035.abstract: We study how a blockholder who controls a firm should acquire a minority stake in a rival: directly, creating common ownership , or indirectly through the controlled firm, creating cross‐ownership . Common ownership generates stronger internalization of competitive externalities and allows the blockholder to capture the resulting gains without sharing them with dispersed shareholders. However, it may also create conflicts of interest with minority shareholders that can lead to a loss of control. Cross‐ownership avoids this governance risk but internalizes competition less effectively. We characterize how the optimal acquisition mode depends on the nature of product market competition and the strength of corporate governance.
doi:10.1111/joie.70035.abstract_zh: 我们研究控制一家公司的大股东应如何获取竞争对手的少数股权：是直接获取（形成共同所有权），还是通过所控制的公司间接获取（形成交叉所有权）。共同所有权能更有效地内化竞争外部性，并使大股东在不与分散股东分享收益的情况下获取由此产生的收益。然而，这可能会与少数股东产生利益冲突，进而导致控制权丧失。交叉所有权可规避这种治理风险，但内化竞争的效果较差。我们刻画了最优收购模式如何取决于产品市场竞争的性质以及公司治理的强度。
doi:10.1111/joie.70035.title: Strategic Stake Acquisitions in Rival Firms: Common vs. Cross‐Ownership
doi:10.1111/joie.70035.title_zh: 竞争对手企业中的战略性股权收购：共同所有权与交叉所有权

doi:10.1111/joie.70038.abstract: We revisit the standard regularity assumption used to ensure uniqueness of the optimal price in monopoly models, namely that the Virtual Value (VV) function is monotone. This condition is typically imposed through strong distributional assumptions, such as log‐concavity, that restrict the model's flexibility and implicitly discipline the sign of comparative statics. We show that these assumptions can be relaxed without compromising tractability or uniqueness. Our main contribution is to introduce ‐Regularity, a weaker condition that requires monotonicity of the VV only beyond the threshold where marginal revenue becomes nonnegative. We demonstrate that many common non‐regular, unimodal distributions satisfy this local condition. This shift in focus allows standard first‐order methods to remain valid, and it enlarges the set of tractable demand primitives in applied IO. As an implication, when hazard rates are not monotone over the relevant pricing range, comparative statics need not follow the direction imposed by log‐concavity. The framework also reduces the need for ironing when modeling with heavy‐tailed demand.
doi:10.1111/joie.70038.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了垄断模型中用于确保最优价格唯一性的标准正则性假设，即虚拟价值函数单调的条件。这一条件通常通过强分布假设（如对数凹性）来施加，但这些假设限制了模型的灵活性，并隐含地约束了比较静态的方向。我们证明，这些假设可以在不牺牲可处理性或唯一性的前提下被放宽。本文的主要贡献在于引入“局部正则性”这一更弱的条件，该条件仅要求虚拟价值函数在边际收入变为非负的阈值之后保持单调。我们证明，许多常见的非正则单峰分布满足这一局部条件。这一视角的转变使得标准的一阶方法仍然有效，并扩大了应用产业组织中可处理的需求基元集合。其含义在于，当风险率在相关定价范围内不单调时，比较静态的方向不必遵循对数凹性所施加的路径。该框架还减少了在建模重尾需求时进行“熨平”处理的必要性。
doi:10.1111/joie.70038.title: Non‐Regular Distributions, Virtual Values and Monopoly Problems
doi:10.1111/joie.70038.title_zh: 非正则分布、虚拟价值与垄断问题

doi:10.1111/sjoe.70024.abstract: Does financial intermediation affect structural change? We address this question both theoretically and empirically, focusing on whether financial development reinforces structural change during the post‐industrialization phase, where employment, value‐added, and expenditure shares change towards services and away from manufacturing. We build a dynamic general equilibrium model in which structural change may be driven by mutually independent engines – sectoral productivity gaps, asymmetric factor elasticities – as well as by learning‐by‐doing. In all its variants, the model robustly predicts that exogenous reductions in intermediation costs (e.g., deregulation shocks) reinforce structural change. We take this prediction to the data by examining the effects of bank branching deregulation in the United States in the period from the 1960s to the 1990s. Within a staggered difference‐in‐differences framework, we show that bank branching deregulation reinforces the pattern of structural change already underway, leading to an increase in the services share of output and employment in deregulated states.
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70024.abstract_zh: 金融中介是否影响结构变迁？我们从理论与实证两个层面探讨这一问题，重点关注金融发展在后工业化阶段是否强化了结构变迁——即就业、增加值与支出份额从制造业向服务业转移的过程。我们构建了一个动态一般均衡模型，其中结构变迁可能由相互独立的驱动因素——部门生产率差距、非对称要素弹性——以及干中学效应共同推动。在所有模型变体中，该模型稳健地预测：中介成本的外生降低（如放松管制冲击）会强化结构变迁。为验证这一预测，我们考察了美国20世纪60年代至90年代银行分支放松管制的效应。在交错双重差分框架下，我们证明银行分支放松管制强化了已在进行中的结构变迁模式，导致放松管制州的服务业产出与就业份额上升。
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70024.title: Financial intermediation and structural change
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70024.title_zh: 金融中介与结构性变化

doi:10.1111/sjoe.70025.abstract: We analyse the general equilibrium implications of introducing a universal basic income (UBI) for employment and income in an economy characterized by involuntary unemployment. Our framework allows tax revenues and workers' reservation wages to adjust endogenously with employment to satisfy the government's budget constraint. We show that multiple equilibria may emerge and that a UBI can support higher employment when the initial equilibrium is characterized by high taxes. However, in this setting, replacing unemployment benefit schemes with UBI proves less effective at fostering employment, ultimately requiring higher taxes and yielding more limited welfare gains.
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70025.abstract_zh: 我们分析了在存在非自愿失业的经济体中引入全民基本收入（UBI）对就业和收入的一般均衡影响。我们的框架允许税收收入和工人的保留工资随就业内生调整，以满足政府预算约束。研究表明，可能出现多重均衡，且当初始均衡以高税收为特征时，UBI能够支持更高的就业水平。然而，在此设定下，用UBI替代失业救济计划在促进就业方面效果较弱，最终需要更高的税收，且带来的福利收益更为有限。
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70025.title: Basic income and employment

doi:10.1111/sjoe.70026.abstract: In 2018, two compensating‐income variation studies, based on Household, Income and Labour Dynamics in Australia, reported sharply different monetary health values: A$42,000–A$67,000 for a full quality‐adjusted life year (QALY) gain versus A$162,000 for a 0.10 QALY loss (implying A$1.6 million per QALY under linear scaling). We embark on econometric detective work to identify the sources of these discrepancies, carefully aligning samples, cross‐examining methodologies, and uncovering methodological differences that drive the divergent results. Gain–loss framing is the largest margin (consistent with willingness‐to‐accept/willingness‐to‐pay evidence), while estimator choice (instrumental variables versus reduced form) and income equivalization further magnify differences, jointly resulting in the order‐of‐magnitude gaps with implications beyond health.
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70026.abstract_zh: 2018年，两项基于澳大利亚家庭、收入与劳动动态调查的补偿性收入变化研究，报告了截然不同的货币化健康价值：完全质量调整生命年（QALY）增益为42,000–67,000澳元，而0.10 QALY损失则为162,000澳元（在线性缩放下相当于每QALY 160万澳元）。我们展开计量经济学侦探工作，以识别这些差异的来源，仔细对齐样本、交叉检验方法论，并揭示导致结果分歧的方法论差异。得失框架是最大的差异来源（与意愿接受/意愿支付证据一致），而估计量选择（工具变量与简化形式）及收入等值化进一步放大了差异，共同导致了数量级上的差距，其影响超越了健康领域。
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70026.title: Following the money: an econometric investigation into health valuations
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70026.title_zh: 追踪资金流向：健康价值评估的计量经济学研究

doi:10.1111/sjoe.70027.abstract: Public tenders typically involve uncertainty and unforeseen costs, which might not be fully known to the bidders themselves. This uncertainty may also concern adaptation costs to the procurer after the delivery, and information about such adaptation costs may influence the bidding strategies, even though the cost is paid by the procurer. Consequently, the availability of information matters, and if it is obtained by the procurer, withholding information from bidders may be better than sharing all of it. To investigate the methods of gathering information, we consider pre‐qualification stage questionnaires designed to obtain information from the bidders. If suitably designed, they can be used to disclose information of which the bidders are themselves unaware and can thereby serve as a tool for revealing the inherent tendency of the cost for the bidders, so that the unforeseen future cost can be estimated.
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70027.abstract_zh: 公开招标通常涉及不确定性和不可预见的成本，投标人自身可能无法完全了解这些成本。这种不确定性还可能涉及交付后采购方的适应成本，尽管该成本由采购方承担，但有关此类适应成本的信息仍可能影响投标策略。因此，信息的可获得性至关重要。若采购方掌握了信息，对投标人隐瞒信息可能比完全共享更优。为探究信息收集方法，我们考虑在资格预审阶段设计问卷，以获取投标人的信息。若设计得当，此类问卷可用于披露投标人自身尚未意识到的信息，从而成为揭示投标人成本内在趋势的工具，进而对不可预见的未来成本进行估算。
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70027.title: Information disclosure and questionnaires in public tenders
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70027.title_zh: 公开招标中的信息披露与问卷调查

doi:10.1111/sjoe.70028.abstract: People may create or seek out performance‐inhibiting obstacles to avoid negative feedback about their ability. This behavior, called self‐handicapping, allows agents to attribute failures to self‐imposed obstacles rather than to lack of competence. I model rational agents with preferences for maintaining self‐esteem, and provide sufficient conditions under which they engage in rational self‐handicapping behavior. I consider two policy applications: education and tournaments. Exams with noisier questions strictly increase studying. Policies encouraging particular groups to apply for jobs can result in strategic adjustment, decreasing applications from the targeted group.
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70028.abstract_zh: 人们可能会制造或寻求阻碍表现的因素，以避免关于自身能力的负面反馈。这种被称为自我妨碍的行为，使个体能够将失败归因于自我设置的障碍，而非能力不足。本文构建了具有维护自尊偏好的理性主体模型，并给出了其从事理性自我妨碍行为的充分条件。研究涉及两项政策应用：教育与锦标赛。噪声更大的考试题目会显著提升学习投入。鼓励特定群体申请工作的政策可能导致策略性调整，反而降低目标群体的申请率。
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70028.title: Self‐esteem and rational self‐handicapping

doi:10.1111/sjoe.70029.abstract: Public pension and public health care policies – collectively referred to here as social security policies – are costly and increasingly challenged by demographic shifts. Using a two‐period overlapping generations model in which health investment affects both mortality and morbidity, we analytically study the optimal design of social security. Our model incorporates three market imperfections: an intergenerational externality, a constraint on saving for future consumption, and incomplete insurance markets. It also considers three policy instruments: subsidies for health investment, subsidies for health expenditures, and a pay‐as‐you‐go pension replacement rate. We analyze how the imperfections, along with evolving trends in mortality and morbidity, shape the optimal set‐up of social security policies. Our findings show that there is no universal design for optimal social security: the effectiveness of each instrument depends on the others and on market conditions, with stronger prevention policies emerging as key in aging societies and in systems with less generous pensions.
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70029.abstract_zh: 公共养老金与公共医疗政策——统称为社会保障政策——成本高昂，且日益受到人口结构变化的挑战。本文采用一个两期世代交叠模型（其中健康投资同时影响死亡率和发病率），从理论层面分析社会保障的最优设计。模型纳入三种市场不完善因素：代际外部性、未来消费储蓄约束以及不完全保险市场；同时考虑三种政策工具：健康投资补贴、医疗支出补贴以及现收现付制养老金替代率。我们分析了这些市场不完善因素如何与死亡率和发病率的演变趋势共同塑造社会保障政策的最优配置。研究结果表明，最优社会保障并不存在统一模式：每种工具的有效性取决于其他工具及市场条件，在老龄化社会及养老金待遇较低的制度中，强化预防性政策成为关键举措。
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70029.title: On the optimality of social security instruments
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70029.title_zh: 论社会保障工具的最优性

doi:10.1111/sjoe.70030.abstract: In many environmental problems, emissions are hard to monitor and abatement costs are privately known. We study how efficient abatement nevertheless can be induced through market‐like arrangements that condition transfers on verifiable abatement rather than on measured emissions. We characterize the transfer schemes that implement efficient abatement in unique dominant strategies and show that a single scheme, the beneficiaries‐compensate transfer scheme, emerges under two distinct characterizations: one based on equilibrium properties and one grounded in classical fairness axioms. Under the beneficiaries‐compensate transfer scheme, each agent compensates others according to the benefits received from their abatement. We illustrate its usefulness in two applications.
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70030.abstract_zh: 在许多环境问题中，排放难以监测且减排成本属于私人信息。我们研究如何通过类似市场的安排——即依据可验证的减排量而非实测排放量进行转移支付——仍能实现有效减排。我们刻画了在唯一占优策略下实现有效减排的转移方案，并表明一种单一方案——受益者补偿转移方案——可通过两种不同特征化方式得出：一种基于均衡性质，另一种基于经典公平性公理。在受益者补偿转移方案下，每个参与者根据从他人减排中获得的收益对他人进行补偿。我们通过两个应用案例说明其有效性。
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70030.title: Shifting the reference point in environmental regulation: from polluter‐pays to beneficiaries‐compensate
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70030.title_zh: 环境规制中的参照点转移：从污染者付费到受益者补偿

doi:10.1111/sjoe.70031.abstract: The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences awarded the 2025 Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel to Philippe Aghion, Peter Howitt, and Joel Mokyr “for having explained innovation‐driven economic growth”. This paper examines their contributions in the context of the development process as a whole. Aghion and Howitt established the centrality of creative destruction in the growth process of advanced economies, identifying the displacement of existing technologies by superseding ones as a key mechanism in sustaining economic growth. Mokyr highlighted the role of a tightening link between theoretical knowledge and practical application during the Scientific Revolution and the Enlightenment in fostering technological progress in Western Europe on the eve of the Industrial Revolution. These frontier‐centered perspectives transformed our understanding of the causes and consequences of innovation‐driven growth in advanced economies operating near the technological frontier. Yet, throughout much of the development process, the central challenge to growth has depended less on the creation of new technologies than on the emergence of fundamental conditions conducive to skill formation, fertility decline, and societal adaptation, which have shaped the timing of the transition to modern growth, the pace of economic growth thereafter, and the contemporary inequality in the wealth of nations. A comprehensive account of sustained growth and contemporary inequality across societies requires anchoring the growth process in its broader historical arc.
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70031.abstract_zh: 瑞典皇家科学院将2025年瑞典中央银行纪念阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔经济学奖授予菲利普·阿吉翁、彼得·豪伊特和乔尔·莫基尔，以表彰他们“解释了创新驱动的经济增长”。本文从整体发展进程的角度审视了他们的贡献。阿吉翁和豪伊特确立了创造性破坏在发达经济体增长过程中的核心地位，指出新兴技术对现有技术的替代是维持经济增长的关键机制。莫基尔则强调了科学革命和启蒙运动期间理论知识与应用实践之间日益紧密的联系，在工业革命前夕推动西欧技术进步中所发挥的作用。这些以技术前沿为中心的视角，深刻改变了我们对接近技术前沿的发达经济体中创新驱动增长的成因与后果的理解。然而，在整个发展进程中，增长面临的核心挑战与其说取决于新技术的创造，不如说取决于有利于技能形成、生育率下降和社会适应性的基本条件的出现——这些条件塑造了向现代增长转型的时机、此后经济增长的速度，以及当代国家间财富的不平等。要全面解释社会间持续增长与当代不平等现象，就必须将增长进程置于更广阔的历史脉络之中。
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70031.title: Engines of growth and inequality in the wealth of nations
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70031.title_zh: 国家财富增长与不平等的引擎

doi:10.1111/sjoe.70033.abstract: Among economists, the analysis of social mobility and the role of parental background is largely carried out in two separate strands of research. The intergenerational mobility literature estimates parent–child persistence in some outcome of interest, such as income. In contrast, the equality of opportunity literature is rooted in a normative framework, and has only more recently started generating empirical evidence. Intergenerational mobility regressions are relatively straightforward to estimate, but their normative implications are less obvious. Measures of equality of opportunity have a policy‐relevant interpretation, but are very data‐demanding, requiring a large set of observable determinants of socioeconomic status for large samples. But maybe the two approaches capture similar dynamics? We compare the approaches by estimating both equality of opportunity and intergenerational mobility measures – as well as sibling correlations – across 16 birth cohorts and 126 Swedish local labor markets. Using these estimates, we find that the different measures correlate strongly, suggesting that (variation in) intergenerational mobility is indeed informative about equality of opportunity.
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70033.abstract_zh: 在经济学界，对社会流动性和父母背景作用的分析主要分为两个独立的研究方向。代际流动性文献估计了父母与子女在收入等特定结果变量上的持续性关联。相比之下，机会平等文献植根于规范性框架，直到近期才开始产生实证证据。代际流动性回归的估计相对直接，但其规范性含义却不甚明确。机会平等指标具有政策相关的解释意义，但对数据要求极高，需要大样本中大量可观测的社会经济地位决定因素。然而，这两种方法是否捕捉到了相似的动态特征？我们通过估算16个出生队列和126个瑞典地方劳动力市场的机会平等指标、代际流动性指标以及同胞相关性，对这两种方法进行了比较。基于这些估计，我们发现不同指标之间存在强相关性，这表明代际流动性的（变化）确实能够反映机会平等状况。
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70033.title: The relationship between intergenerational mobility and equality of opportunity
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70033.title_zh: 代际流动与机会平等之间的关系

doi:10.1111/sjoe.70034.abstract: In this paper, we investigate changes in time allocated to routine housework around four life events – cohabitation, marriage, first birth, and divorce – to explore the influence of social norms on gendered housework patterns. Using data from the German Socio‐Economic Panel (1991–2019), a timing‐based event study design reveals that gender differences intensify with cohabitation and parenthood. Women's housework hours increase significantly with the first child, while men's decrease. Marriage has no additional impact beyond cohabitation, and divorce leads to a rise in men's and a reduction in women's housework. Couples with higher‐earning women and those in East Germany show weaker adherence to these social roles.
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70034.abstract_zh: 本文通过考察同居、结婚、生育第一个子女和离婚四个人生事件前后日常家务劳动时间的变化，探究社会规范对性别化家务分工模式的影响。基于德国社会经济面板数据（1991-2019年）的时间事件研究设计显示，性别差异在同居和成为父母后加剧。女性家务劳动时间在生育第一个子女后显著增加，而男性则减少。婚姻对家务时间的影响未超出同居效应，离婚则导致男性家务时间上升、女性家务时间下降。女性收入较高的夫妻以及东德地区的夫妻，对社会角色的遵循程度较弱。

doi:10.1111/sjoe.70034.title_zh: 揭示生活的编排：生命转折对性别化家务模式的影响

doi:10.1111/sjoe.70035.abstract: This paper examines the impact of importer dispersion on exchange rate pass‐through. Theoretically, we demonstrate that greater importer dispersion – characterized by larger variations in import size across importers – leads to higher demand elasticity and lower exporter markups, thereby resulting in greater exchange rate pass‐through. Using transaction‐level customs data from Colombia, we provide robust empirical evidence supporting this prediction. The quantitative effect of importer dispersion on exchange rate pass‐through is significant: the importer dispersion channel is at least as important as the traditional exporter heterogeneity channel. Our results are robust to various empirical specifications and become even stronger in the context of the dominant currency paradigm.
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70035.abstract_zh: 本文研究了进口商分散度对汇率传递的影响。理论上，我们证明进口商分散度越高——即各进口商进口规模差异越大——会导致需求弹性上升和出口商加成率下降，从而增强汇率传递效应。基于哥伦比亚交易级海关数据，我们提供了支持这一预测的稳健实证证据。进口商分散度对汇率传递的量化影响显著：该渠道的重要性至少与传统出口商异质性渠道相当。研究结果在多种实证设定下保持稳健，且在主导货币范式背景下效应更为显著。

doi:10.1111/sjoe.70036.abstract: We investigate the existence of a middle‐income trap using finite state Markov chains, constant growth thresholds, and mean first passage times. As well as studying output per head, we examine the dynamics of its proximate determinants: total factor productivity (TFP), the capital–output ratio, and human capital. We find upward mobility in the relative capital–output ratio and human capital, but not in relative TFP. The persistence of relative TFP differences, particularly from intermediate income levels, implies slower progression toward frontier income. A middle‐income trap may therefore reflect asymmetric convergence dynamics near the frontier rather than a universal growth slowdown.
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70036.abstract_zh: 我们利用有限状态马尔可夫链、恒定增长阈值和平均首次通过时间，研究了中等收入陷阱的存在性。除了考察人均产出外，我们还分析了其直接决定因素的动态变化：全要素生产率（TFP）、资本产出比和人力资本。研究发现，相对资本产出比和人力资本呈现向上流动性，但相对全要素生产率并未如此。相对全要素生产率差异的持续性，尤其是从中等收入水平来看，意味着向前沿收入水平的进展更为缓慢。因此，中等收入陷阱可能反映了靠近前沿水平时的不对称趋同动态，而非普遍的增长放缓。
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70036.title: At the threshold: the increasing relevance of the middle‐income trap
