doi:10.1111/sjoe.70037.abstract: The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences awarded the 2025 Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel to Joel Mokyr, Philippe Aghion, and Peter Howitt “for having explained innovation‐driven economic growth”. Mokyr's work explains why sustained growth was historically rare: prosperity required societies capable of generating, diffusing, and applying useful knowledge. The theory of creative destruction established by Aghion and Howitt explains why economic progress is inherently disruptive, as new technologies continuously replace older technologies, firms, and rents. In this paper, I argue that these ideas moved innovation from the periphery to the center of growth economics and recast growth theory as a dynamic process driven by experimentation, rivalry, entry, and reallocation. Recent research has extended these insights in numerous directions, including heterogeneous firms, business dynamism, talent allocation, artificial intelligence, and green innovation. I conclude by arguing that the central challenge of modern growth policy is not simply to accelerate innovation, but to sustain institutions that keep economies open to creative destruction while preserving competition, broad opportunity, and political support for technological change.
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70037.abstract_zh: 瑞典皇家科学院将2025年瑞典中央银行纪念阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔经济学奖授予乔尔·莫基尔、菲利普·阿吉翁和彼得·霍伊特，以表彰他们“解释了创新驱动的经济增长”。莫基尔的研究解释了为何持续增长在历史上极为罕见：繁荣需要社会具备生成、传播和应用有用知识的能力。阿吉翁与霍伊特建立的创造性破坏理论则阐明，经济进步本质上具有颠覆性，因为新技术不断取代旧技术、旧企业和旧租金。本文认为，这些思想将创新从增长经济学的边缘推向核心，并将增长理论重塑为由实验、竞争、进入和重新配置驱动的动态过程。近期研究已将这些洞见拓展至多个方向，包括异质性企业、商业活力、人才配置、人工智能和绿色创新。最后，本文指出现代增长政策的核心挑战并非简单加速创新，而是维持那些使经济对创造性破坏保持开放的制度，同时保护竞争、广泛机遇以及技术变革的政治支持。
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70037.title: Creative destruction in economic growth
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70037.title_zh: 经济增长中的创造性破坏

doi:10.1111/sjoe.70038.abstract: In this paper, we analyze the impact of public dental care coverage – universal versus targeted – on access, pricing, and public spending in a model with two competing dental practices and heterogeneous patient income groups. We evaluate two types of reimbursement schemes: fixed subsidies and cost sharing. Our findings show that public coverage improves access for low‐income patients but increases producer prices due to reduced price elasticity of demand. Targeted coverage provides greater access at lower public cost compared with universal coverage, especially under cost‐sharing schemes. With fixed subsidies, both schemes achieve similar access, but targeted coverage remains more cost‐efficient. The policy that maximizes utilitarian welfare is targeted coverage with a fixed subsidy, balancing improved access for low‐income patients against higher prices for high‐income patients. This trade‐off highlights challenges in implementing targeted policies but provides insights for designing efficient and equitable public dental care systems.
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70038.abstract_zh: 本文通过构建包含两家竞争性牙科诊所与异质性患者收入群体的模型，分析了公共牙科保险覆盖（全民覆盖与定向覆盖）对可及性、定价及公共支出的影响。我们评估了两种报销机制：固定补贴与成本分摊。研究结果表明：公共覆盖改善了低收入患者的可及性，但因需求价格弹性降低导致生产者价格上涨；相较于全民覆盖，定向覆盖能以更低的公共成本实现更高的可及性，尤其在成本分摊机制下更为显著。在固定补贴机制下，两种覆盖方案的可及性效果相近，但定向覆盖仍更具成本效率。实现功利主义福利最大化的政策方案是采用固定补贴的定向覆盖，该方案在改善低收入患者可及性与抑制高收入患者价格上涨之间取得平衡。这一权衡凸显了实施定向政策面临的挑战，但为设计高效且公平的公共牙科医疗体系提供了重要启示。
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70038.title: Public coverage of dental care: universal or targeted?
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70038.title_zh: 牙科护理的公共覆盖：全民还是定向？

doi:10.1111/sjoe.70039.abstract: This paper studies the anchoring of inflation expectations at the individual forecaster level. It proposes a novel measure of anchoring based on both point and density forecasts, and uses data from the European Central Bank Survey of Professional Forecasters to examine its co‐movement with expectations about monetary policy and key cost‐push factors. The anchoring measure is constructed for each forecaster and regressed on expectations regarding the European Central Bank policy rate, crude oil prices, the US dollar/euro exchange rate, and unit labor costs. Although the cross‐sectional mean of long‐term inflation expectations appears largely stable, substantial heterogeneity emerges during periods of heightened macroeconomic uncertainty, with some forecasters exhibiting signs of de‐anchoring. The results show that individual anchoring is systematically related to expectations about future policy rates and unit labor cost changes. In addition, these relationships have strengthened since 2020 and display asymmetries depending on whether inflation expectations lie above or below the target.
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70039.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文从个体预测者层面研究通胀预期的锚定情况。本文提出了一种基于点预测和密度预测的新型锚定度量方法，并利用欧洲央行专业预测者调查数据，考察其与货币政策预期及关键成本推动因素之间的协同变动关系。该锚定度量针对每位预测者构建，并基于其对欧洲央行政策利率、原油价格、美元/欧元汇率及单位劳动力成本的预期进行回归分析。尽管长期通胀预期的截面均值总体保持稳定，但在宏观经济不确定性加剧时期，预测者之间呈现出显著异质性，部分预测者表现出脱锚迹象。结果表明，个体锚定程度与未来政策利率及单位劳动力成本变化的预期存在系统性关联。此外，自2020年以来，这些关联性有所增强，且根据通胀预期高于或低于目标水平而呈现非对称特征。
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70039.title: Anchoring of inflation expectations and the role of monetary policy and cost‐push factors
doi:10.1111/sjoe.70039.title_zh: 通胀预期的锚定及货币政策与成本推动因素的作用

doi:10.1111/twec.70091.abstract: Chinese state‐owned enterprises (SOEs) serve as critical institutional anchors in supply chains. Utilising panel data from 1076 Chinese A‐share listed firms during the period of 2008–2016, this study examines the impact of SOEs on global value chain (GVC) participation of their suppliers. The empirical results from difference‐in‐differences method demonstrate that SOEs significantly enhance their suppliers' GVC participation. Mechanism tests reveal that SOEs boost their suppliers' GVC participation through operational enhancements, supply chain efficiency and FDI attraction improvements. In addition, this study identifies that resource misallocation and coordination costs negatively moderate the effect of SOEs on their suppliers' GVC participation. Heterogeneity analyses reveal that the positive effects of SOEs are stronger for large suppliers and those suppliers without micro and small enterprises (MSEs) as major customers. Notably, SOEs enhance the intensive‐margin of GVCs but have a negligible effect on the extensive‐margin. These findings position SOEs as catalysts for GVC participation, offering policy insights for other economies with SOEs.
doi:10.1111/twec.70091.abstract_zh: 中国国有企业在供应链中扮演着关键的制度锚点角色。本研究利用2008-2016年间1076家中国A股上市公司的面板数据，考察国有企业对其供应商全球价值链参与度的影响。基于双重差分法的实证结果表明，国有企业显著提升了其供应商的全球价值链参与度。机制检验显示，国有企业通过运营优化、供应链效率提升以及外商直接投资吸引力增强等途径，促进了供应商的全球价值链参与。此外，本研究发现资源错配与协调成本会负向调节国有企业对供应商全球价值链参与度的促进作用。异质性分析表明，对于大型供应商以及不以微型和小型企业为主要客户的供应商而言，国有企业的正向效应更为显著。值得注意的是，国有企业主要强化了全球价值链的集约边际，而对扩展边际的影响微乎其微。这些发现将国有企业定位为全球价值链参与的催化剂，为其他拥有国有企业的经济体提供了政策启示。

doi:10.1111/twec.70096.abstract: In this paper, we analyse the determinants of maritime connections, with a special focus on the importance of foreign direct investments (FDI) in improving maritime transportation networks and in restructuring them. We are also interested in how China, in particular, impacts countries' integration to global supply chains through maritime transportation. We work on a heterogeneous panel of bilateral maritime connections as measured by UNCTAD's bilateral liner shipping connectivity index, and we find that FDIs between two partner countries do not significantly impact their maritime connection. However, we do find that Chinese FDIs in countries concerned by the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) reinforce bilateral maritime connections between countries, in general, be they BRI countries or not. The Chinese influence is also significant via their maritime presence: maritime connections between two countries are significantly higher when host countries have strong maritime ties to China. A deeper analysis through several interaction effects also shows the Chinese influence is conditional on host countries' attributes. For instance, a maritime connection with China is more beneficial to developing/poorer host countries, who see their connection to origin countries increase more as compared to developed/richer host countries.
doi:10.1111/twec.70096.abstract_zh: 本文分析了海上连接的决定因素，特别关注外国直接投资在改善海上运输网络及其结构调整中的重要性。我们还重点研究了中国如何通过海上运输影响各国融入全球供应链。基于联合国贸发会议双边班轮航运连接指数衡量的异质性双边海上连接面板数据，我们发现两国之间的外国直接投资并未显著影响其海上连接。然而，中国在“一带一路”倡议相关国家的直接投资普遍加强了各国（无论是否为“一带一路”国家）之间的双边海上连接。中国的海上存在也产生了显著影响：当东道国与中国有紧密的海上联系时，两国之间的海上连接显著更高。通过多种交互效应的深入分析表明，中国的影响取决于东道国的特征。例如，与中国建立海上连接对发展中国家/较贫穷的东道国更为有利，这些国家与来源国的连接提升幅度大于发达国家/较富裕的东道国。

doi:10.1111/twec.70106.abstract: Rising deglobalization has increased external uncertainty for the global economy. This paper develops a China–US Trade Equilibrium (CUTE) model that integrates monetary mechanisms and Hicksian welfare decomposition to examine the effects of U.S. tariff hikes on China and the U.S., as well as China's policy responses. A key contribution is the comparison of policy responses under identical policy costs. The results show that the direct macroeconomic impact of U.S. tariffs on China is modest, reflecting limited trade exposure and strong substitution effects, while broad tariffs generate larger welfare losses for the America through price increases and real income erosion. The reaction directly supporting household income and consumption yield substantially higher welfare returns than trade retaliation, government spending or monetary easing, as tariffs reduce real purchasing power. We suggest within the institutional settings considered, prioritizing household‐based demand support is a more effective response to external tariff shocks than retaliatory trade measures.
doi:10.1111/twec.70106.abstract_zh: 去全球化趋势加剧了全球经济的外部不确定性。本文构建了一个整合货币机制与希克斯福利分解的中美贸易均衡（CUTE）模型，用以考察美国加征关税对中国和美国的影响，以及中国的政策应对。本文的关键贡献在于，在相同政策成本条件下比较了不同政策应对的效果。研究结果表明，美国关税对中国的直接宏观经济影响较为温和，这反映了有限的贸易敞口和较强的替代效应；而广泛性关税则通过价格上涨和实际收入侵蚀，给美国带来更大的福利损失。相较于贸易报复、政府支出或货币宽松政策，直接支持家庭收入和消费的应对措施能产生显著更高的福利回报，原因在于关税削弱了实际购买力。我们建议，在所考虑的体制环境下，优先采取基于家庭的需求支持政策，是应对外部关税冲击比报复性贸易措施更为有效的策略。

doi:10.1111/twec.70107.abstract: U.S. overseas military deployments, as a strategic instrument for maintaining hegemony, structurally reconfigure international capital flows through a security‐economy nexus. While prior studies focus on host‐country perspectives, the third‐party economic spillovers of such deployments remain underexplored. This study investigates how they affect Chinese multinationals' foreign direct investment. The findings reveal a significant negative impact of U.S. military presence on Chinese FDI in host countries. Mechanism tests identify two channels: (1) institutional erosion—U.S. security patronage undermines host‐state governance, elevating political risk premiums that deter Chinese investment; (2) strategic anchoring—military presence strains host countries' relations with China, coupled with deep U.S. economic entrenchment, crowds out Chinese capital through both political and market channels. Heterogeneity analysis reinforces this logic. At the micro level, U.S. deployments heighten Chinese managers' perception of geopolitical risk, reshaping their attention allocation and subsequent investment decisions. These findings suggest that U.S. military retrenchment may reshape the strategic calculus of China's outward investment. By extending traditional FDI risk theory, this paper contributes to a nuanced understanding of the spillover effects of U.S. foreign military strategy amid great‐power competition, offering critical insights into the strategic value of the Belt and Road Initiative and guidance for Chinese firms seeking to reposition their global investment footprint.
doi:10.1111/twec.70107.abstract_zh: 美国海外军事部署作为维护霸权的战略工具，通过安全-经济联动机制结构性重塑国际资本流动。现有研究多聚焦东道国视角，但此类部署的第三方经济溢出效应仍待深入探究。本文考察美国军事部署如何影响中国跨国企业对外直接投资，发现美国军事存在显著抑制中国对东道国的直接投资。机制检验识别出两条传导路径：（1）制度侵蚀效应——美国安全庇护削弱东道国治理能力，抬升政治风险溢价，抑制中国投资；（2）战略锚定效应——军事部署加剧东道国对华关系紧张，叠加美国深度经济嵌入，通过政治与市场双重渠道挤出中国资本。异质性分析进一步印证该逻辑。微观层面，美国军事部署强化中国管理者对地缘政治风险的感知，重塑其注意力配置与后续投资决策。研究表明，美国军事收缩可能重构中国对外投资的战略考量。本文通过拓展传统FDI风险理论，为理解大国竞争背景下美国海外军事战略的溢出效应提供新视角，同时揭示"一带一路"倡议的战略价值，为中国企业优化全球投资布局提供决策参考。

doi:10.1111/twec.70110.abstract: This article examines the impact of the European Union's post‐March 2014 and post‐February 2022 sanctions episodes against Russia on trade between Russia and the Visegrad countries (Czechia, Hungary, Poland and Slovakia) over 2013–2024. Changes are analysed at both the aggregate level and—based on an original identification of EU sanction coverage—across selected sanctioned product chapters and non‐sanctioned reference groups. The empirical framework combines descriptive statistics on the distribution of the selected product groups with two complementary econometric approaches: a gravity‐based Poisson pseudo‐maximum likelihood model (PPML) with fixed effects, estimated in a difference‐in‐differences design relative to control markets, and a PPML interrupted time‐series model used as a robustness check to identify structural breaks and post‐intervention trends. Empirically, the effects of EU sanctions on Visegrad exports to Russia were strongly negative already under the post‐March 2014 sanctions regime, particularly for highly sanctioned manufactured product groups such as machinery and electrical equipment, and intensified further following the substantial expansion of sanctions after February 2022. Import effects were initially weaker but intensified markedly from 2022 onward, most notably for energy sources. The findings point to episode‐specific trade responses, pronounced heterogeneity across product groups, and a clear asymmetry between export and import adjustments.
doi:10.1111/twec.70110.abstract_zh: 本文考察了2013—2024年间，欧盟在2014年3月后及2022年2月后对俄罗斯实施的两轮制裁对俄罗斯与维谢格拉德国家（捷克、匈牙利、波兰和斯洛伐克）之间贸易的影响。分析涵盖总体层面，并基于对欧盟制裁覆盖范围的原创识别，在选定的受制裁产品章节和未受制裁参考组之间展开。实证框架结合了所选产品组分布的描述性统计与两种互补的计量经济学方法：一是基于引力模型的泊松伪最大似然估计（PPML）固定效应模型，采用双重差分设计相对于对照市场进行估计；二是作为稳健性检验的PPML中断时间序列模型，用于识别结构断点和干预后趋势。实证结果显示，早在2014年3月后的制裁体制下，欧盟制裁对维谢格拉德国家向俄罗斯的出口已产生强烈负面影响，尤其对机械和电气设备等受高度制裁的制成品组影响显著，并在2022年2月后制裁大幅扩展后进一步加剧。进口影响最初较弱，但从2022年起显著增强，最突出的是能源类产品。研究结果揭示了针对不同制裁事件的贸易反应差异、产品组间的显著异质性，以及出口与进口调整之间的明显不对称性。
doi:10.1111/twec.70110.title:
Trade Effects of
                    <scp>EU</scp>
                    Sanctions Against Russia: Evidence From the Visegrad Group
doi:10.1111/twec.70110.title_zh: 欧盟对俄制裁的贸易效应：来自维谢格拉德集团的证据

doi:10.1111/twec.70112.abstract: During China's transformation from a quantity‐oriented to a quality‐oriented trading nation, industrial policy consistency (IPC) between central and local governments has been an important driving force for firm exports. We investigate this IPC by extracting information on the preferential industries mentioned in the Chinese 10th to 12th Five‐Year Plans (FYPs) and empirically analyze the relationship between IPC and firm exports on the basis of Chinese firm‐level data from 2001 to 2015. The results indicate that IPC expands the firms' export scales but reduces the quality of products exported. This phenomenon is driven primarily by increasing subsidy reliance, intensifying excessive market competition and weakening innovation incentives. The heterogeneity analysis indicates that IPC has a more profound effect on the export outcomes of state‐owned enterprises, large firms, pillar industries and regions facing high levels of official promotion pressure. We further find that comparative advantages can relatively mitigate the decline in quality caused by policy consistency. Our findings have important policy implications for coordinating regional industrial policies and improving export competitiveness.
doi:10.1111/twec.70112.abstract_zh: 在中国从数量导向型贸易大国向质量导向型贸易大国转型过程中，中央与地方政府间的产业政策一致性（IPC）已成为推动企业出口的重要驱动力。本文通过提取中国第十至第十二个五年规划中提及的优先发展产业信息，基于2001-2015年中国企业层面数据，实证分析了产业政策一致性与企业出口之间的关系。研究结果表明，产业政策一致性扩大了企业出口规模，但降低了出口产品质量。这一现象主要源于补贴依赖度上升、过度市场竞争加剧以及创新激励弱化。异质性分析显示，产业政策一致性对国有企业、大型企业、支柱产业以及面临较高官员晋升压力地区的出口表现影响更为显著。进一步研究发现，比较优势能够相对缓解政策一致性导致的质量下降。本研究对协调区域产业政策、提升出口竞争力具有重要政策启示。

doi:10.1111/twec.70112.title_zh: 政策迎合还是市场选择：产业政策一致性与企业出口

doi:10.1111/twec.70113.abstract: The link between environment and trade has long been the subject of intense policy debate. This study reviews the existing literature and addresses key gaps. We develop a unified framework that incorporates environmental externalities (local versus global), abatement, political competition, and trade. The model shows how producer and consumer/environmentalist lobbying incentives over pollution stringency interact, and how these incentives vary with the nature and magnitude of environmental externalities, the structure of environmental agreements (unilateral versus multilateral), and trade regimes. It also highlights the roles of abatement and terms‐of‐trade effects in shaping the equilibrium outcomes. In a large open economy, cooperative policy internalises the costs of emission leakage induced by lobbying, making it more welfare‐improving than noncooperative policy. Producer and consumer lobbying generally exert countervailing pressures, with their relative influence determined by the weights the government assigns to each group.
doi:10.1111/twec.70113.abstract_zh: 环境与贸易之间的联系长期以来一直是政策辩论的焦点。本研究回顾了现有文献，并填补了关键空白。我们构建了一个统一的分析框架，将环境外部性（本地与全球）、减排措施、政治竞争和贸易纳入其中。该模型揭示了生产者和消费者/环保主义者围绕污染严格程度的游说激励如何相互作用，以及这些激励如何随环境外部性的性质与规模、环境协议的结构（单边与多边）以及贸易体制而变化。模型还强调了减排效应和贸易条件效应在塑造均衡结果中的作用。在大型开放经济体中，合作性政策内化了游说引发的排放泄漏成本，因此比非合作性政策更能提升福利。生产者和消费者的游说通常产生相互抵消的压力，其相对影响力取决于政府赋予各群体的权重。
doi:10.1111/twec.70113.title: Political Economy of Environmental Policy Under Trade
doi:10.1111/twec.70113.title_zh: 贸易条件下环境政策的政治经济学

doi:10.1111/twec.70114.abstract: This study examines how Eco‐industrial Parks (EIPs) in China shape firm green innovation and, furthermore, explores its implications for trade competitiveness. We find that EIPs significantly boost green patent applications, particularly substantive innovations. This effect is stronger in cleaner industries, environmentally stringent cities and firms with high media exposure. Mechanisms include eased financing constraints, and increased R&D investment. Extending the analysis to the trade domain, we further show that EIP‐induced green innovation enhances firms' performance in green exports. Thus, EIPs serve as a pivotal policy that fosters green innovation and cultivates competitive advantages in global green markets.
doi:10.1111/twec.70114.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了中国生态工业园区（EIPs）如何影响企业绿色创新，并进一步探讨其对贸易竞争力的启示。我们发现，生态工业园区显著促进了绿色专利申请，尤其是实质性创新。这一效应在清洁行业、环境规制严格的城市以及媒体曝光度高的企业中更为显著。其作用机制包括缓解融资约束和增加研发投入。将分析拓展至贸易领域后，我们进一步表明，生态工业园区引致的绿色创新提升了企业在绿色出口方面的绩效。因此，生态工业园区作为一项关键政策，能够促进绿色创新，并在全球绿色市场中培育竞争优势。

doi:10.1111/twec.70116.abstract: The study focuses on the analysis of neutral states' exports to the Russian Federation via SDID and their comparison with more diligent enforcers of European sanctions, emphasising thus the changes that took place after the Russian invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. The investigation seeks to identify if the invasion and its subsequent repercussions resulted in significant changes in the commodity structure of trade of the neutral states, indicating their engagement in sanction‐busting behaviour. The research is based on 13 synthetic difference‐in‐difference panel data models for each sampled state using data from the UN Comtrade database. The results highlight an increase in the value of sanctioned commodities exported to Russia in all nine instances, where a significant change occurred solely in Kazakhstan and Türkiye. The findings of the study are consistent with the existing literature, and they reveal several directions for future research.
doi:10.1111/twec.70116.abstract_zh: 本研究聚焦于中立国通过SDID向俄罗斯联邦的出口情况，并将其与更严格执行欧洲制裁的国家进行对比，重点分析了2022年2月俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后发生的变化。研究旨在探究此次入侵及其后续影响是否导致中立国贸易商品结构发生显著变化，从而揭示其参与规避制裁的行为。研究基于联合国商品贸易统计数据库的数据，为每个样本国家构建了13个合成双重差分面板数据模型。结果显示，在所有9个案例中，向俄罗斯出口的受制裁商品价值均有所增加，其中仅哈萨克斯坦和土耳其出现了显著变化。研究结论与现有文献一致，并为未来研究指明了若干方向。
doi:10.1111/twec.70116.title: Friend or Foe? Analysing Neutral States' Exports to the Russian Federation Using Synthetic Difference‐In‐Differences
doi:10.1111/twec.70116.title_zh: 朋友还是敌人？利用合成双重差分法分析中立国对俄罗斯联邦的出口

doi:10.1111/twec.70117.abstract: In recent years, the acceleration of de‐globalization has reconfigured global supply chains. Using listed firm‐level global supplier‐customer relationship data from the FactSet Revere database spanning January 2017 to December 2019, this paper examines whether and how firm‐supplier relationships change after the U.S.–China trade tensions. Our findings indicate that the U.S.–China trade tensions are followed by a significant relative decline in U.S. listed firms' reliance on direct Chinese suppliers. This phenomenon is pronounced in the manufacturing and information industries, especially in high‐tech industries. Mechanism analysis suggests that, following the trade frictions, U.S. firms appear to reduce their reliance on direct Chinese suppliers by diversifying and shortening contracts, while also taking adjustment costs into account. The extended analysis explicitly shows that U.S. firms continue to rely on China indirectly—via upstream inputs embedded in domestic suppliers and through third‐country firms closely tied to Chinese production networks. Additionally, U.S. firms tend to increase supplier links with countries that have higher institutional quality, consistent with a search for greater supply chain ‘security’.
doi:10.1111/twec.70117.abstract_zh: 近年来，去全球化进程加速，全球供应链格局随之重构。本文利用FactSet Revere数据库2017年1月至2019年12月期间美国上市公司层面的全球供应商-客户关系数据，考察中美贸易摩擦是否以及如何改变企业-供应商关系。研究发现，中美贸易摩擦后，美国上市公司对中国直接供应商的依赖程度出现显著相对下降。这一现象在制造业与信息行业尤为突出，特别是高科技领域。机制分析表明，贸易摩擦发生后，美国企业通过多元化供应商选择与缩短合同期限来降低对中国直接供应商的依赖，同时兼顾调整成本。拓展分析进一步揭示，美国企业仍通过嵌入国内供应商的上游投入品以及与华生产网络紧密关联的第三国企业，间接依赖中国。此外，美国企业倾向于增加与制度质量较高国家的供应商联系，这与寻求更高供应链"安全性"的行为一致。

doi:10.1111/twec.70118.abstract: This paper examines the effects of economic sanctions on the taxation of natural resources in targeted countries, distinguishing between de jure and de facto measures of the average effective tax rate (AETR) on resource rents. The analysis relies on a sample of 20 African countries for the de jure AETR and a global panel of 75 developing and developed countries for the de facto AETR over the period 2000–2020. Using a Spatial Durbin Model that accounts for spatial spillovers in both taxation and sanctions, we document three main results. First, both resource taxation (de jure and de facto) and economic sanctions exhibit significant spatial dependence across neighbouring countries. Second, economic sanctions affect de jure rent capture, while their impact on de facto AETR is limited and operates mainly through indirect and spillover channels rather than through a direct strengthening of effective tax enforcement. Third, the effects vary by the type and origin of sanctions, with financial sanctions exerting stronger effects than trade sanctions, and UN and US sanctions proving more influential than EU sanctions. The results are robust to alternative measures of sanction intensity, proxied by the number of sanctions imposed, as well as to alternative estimation strategies addressing endogeneity, and dynamic treatment effects. These findings suggest that sanctioned countries adjust formal tax policy in response to sanctions, which contribute to limit the adverse effect of sanctions on their de facto taxation of the resource rent.
doi:10.1111/twec.70118.abstract_zh: 本文考察了经济制裁对目标国自然资源税收的影响，区分了资源租金平均有效税率（AETR）的法律规定与实际执行指标。分析基于2000-2020年期间两个样本：20个非洲国家的法律规定AETR，以及75个发达国家与发展中国家组成的全球面板数据的实际执行AETR。采用考虑税收与制裁空间溢出效应的空间杜宾模型，我们得出三项主要结论。第一，资源税收（包括法律规定与实际执行）和经济制裁在邻国间均呈现显著的空间依赖性。第二，经济制裁影响法律规定的租金获取，但对实际执行AETR的影响有限，且主要通过间接和溢出渠道发挥作用，而非直接强化有效税收执法。第三，制裁效果因类型和来源而异：金融制裁的影响强于贸易制裁，联合国和美国制裁的影响力超过欧盟制裁。上述结果在采用制裁数量作为制裁强度替代指标、处理内生性的替代估计策略以及动态处理效应检验中均保持稳健。这些发现表明，受制裁国会根据制裁调整正式税收政策，这有助于限制制裁对其资源租金实际征税的不利影响。
doi:10.1111/twec.70118.title: Economic Sanctions and Taxation of Natural Resource Rent: Evidence From Spatial Analysis
doi:10.1111/twec.70118.title_zh: 经济制裁与自然资源租金征税：来自空间分析的证据

doi:10.1111/twec.70121.abstract: This paper examines the environmental consequences of capital goods imports, employing China's subsidy policy as a natural experiment. The policy, which provides reimbursement to firms for the cost of imported capital, has an unintended impact on the environmental outcomes of firms. We employ the difference‐in‐differences methodology to distinguish between firms highly expose to the policy as the treatment group and less exposed ones as the control group. The results indicate that the subsidy policy significantly reduces firms' total chemical oxygen demand emissions by 21.2% and their emission intensity by 21.8%, revealing notable unanticipated environmental benefits of the policy. The reduction in emissions is primarily attributable to improvements in the production process rather than post‐production abatement. State‐owned firms and firms with a higher proportion of skilled workers exhibit more pronounced reductions. Additionally, our findings suggest that the import of capital goods fosters green innovation, a crucial mechanism through which the subsidy policy exerts an influence on emission reductions. This study offers insights into the environmental consequences of trade policies and the combined effects of production and innovation strategies in response to non‐environmental incentives.
doi:10.1111/twec.70121.abstract_zh: 本文考察了资本品进口的环境后果，以中国的补贴政策作为自然实验。该政策为企业进口资本成本提供报销，却意外影响了企业的环境表现。我们采用双重差分法，将受政策影响较大的企业作为处理组，影响较小的企业作为对照组。结果表明，补贴政策显著降低了企业化学需氧量总排放量21.2%，排放强度下降21.8%，揭示了该政策显著且未预期的环境效益。排放减少主要归因于生产过程的改进，而非生产后的末端治理。国有企业及高技能工人比例较高的企业表现出更显著的减排效果。此外，我们的发现表明，资本品进口促进了绿色创新，这是补贴政策影响减排的关键机制。本研究为贸易政策的环境后果以及企业在非环境激励下生产与创新策略的联合效应提供了洞见。

doi:10.1111/twec.70123.abstract: This study analyses weekly port calls from 2019 to 2026 to evaluate the Russia–Ukraine war's impact on maritime trade. The data reveals clear structural shifts that Ukrainian traffic moved from high‐risk areas like Odesa to safer Danube River ports. On the other hand, Russia sustained its maritime activity by navigating sanctions and redirecting exports to Asian markets. The Black Sea Grain Initiative also improved navigation conditions for both countries. Overall, the war caused domestic port substitution within Ukraine and a broader logistical reorganization for Russia.
doi:10.1111/twec.70123.abstract_zh: 本研究分析了2019年至2026年的周度港口停靠数据，以评估俄乌战争对海上贸易的影响。数据揭示了明显的结构性转变：乌克兰的航运从敖德萨等高危地区转移至更安全的多瑙河港口。另一方面，俄罗斯通过规避制裁并将出口转向亚洲市场，维持了其海上活动。黑海谷物倡议也改善了两国的航行条件。总体而言，战争导致了乌克兰国内港口的替代效应，并引发了俄罗斯更广泛的物流重组。
doi:10.1111/twec.70123.title: The Impact of Russia–Ukraine War in Maritime Data
doi:10.1111/twec.70123.title_zh: 俄乌战争对海事数据的影响

doi:10.1111/twec.70124.abstract: Information and communication technology (ICT) goods are central to digital transformation, technological upgrading and participation in global production networks. Yet relatively little is known about whether immigrant networks shape international trade in these knowledge‐intensive goods. Using bilateral panel data for 172 countries over the 2000–2021 period, we estimate gravity‐based specifications, Tobit models and linear fixed‐effects models for ICT goods trade. The results show a positive and statistically significant relationship between immigrant networks and ICT goods trade, especially exports. The export relationship remains positive after controlling for productive capacity, while the import relationship weakens. Interaction models further show that immigrant networks are more strongly related to ICT goods trade when immigrants' home countries have greater ICT export capacity. Marginal‐effect estimates indicate that the relationship operates through both the extensive and intensive margins of trade. The findings suggest that immigrant networks are especially relevant for ICT goods trade when cross‐border social and commercial ties connect destination markets to technologically capable home countries.
doi:10.1111/twec.70124.abstract_zh: 信息与通信技术（ICT）产品是数字化转型、技术升级及参与全球生产网络的核心要素。然而，关于移民网络是否影响这类知识密集型产品的国际贸易，学界认知仍相对有限。本研究基于2000—2021年间172个国家的双边面板数据，采用引力模型设定、Tobit模型及线性固定效应模型对ICT产品贸易进行估计。结果显示，移民网络与ICT产品贸易（尤其是出口）之间存在显著正向统计关系。在控制生产能力后，出口关系仍保持正向，而进口关系则有所减弱。交互模型进一步表明，当移民母国具备更强的ICT出口能力时，移民网络与ICT产品贸易的关联性更为显著。边际效应估计显示，该关系通过贸易的扩展边际与集约边际共同发挥作用。研究结论表明，当跨境社会与商业联系将目的地市场与技术能力较强的母国相连接时，移民网络对ICT产品贸易具有特殊重要性。
doi:10.1111/twec.70124.title:
Immigrant Networks, Productive Capacity and Trade in
                    <scp>ICT</scp>
                    Goods
doi:10.1111/twec.70124.title_zh: 移民网络、生产能力与ICT产品贸易

doi:10.1111/twec.70125.abstract: As globalization faces headwinds from rising geopolitical tensions, the interaction between international politics and trade has become increasingly complex. Moving beyond static gravity models, this paper examines the dynamic co‐evolution of international political relations and the global trade network. Using a Stochastic Actor‐Oriented Model (SAOM) on a dataset of 139 economies from 1996 to 2023, we model the global trade network as an endogenous and evolving system rather than a set of independent dyads. The results show that diplomatic proximity significantly increases the likelihood of trade‐tie formation, and that this effect strengthens markedly after 2016, approaching the explanatory importance of geographic distance. The estimates also reveal strong reciprocity and triadic closure in the trade network, indicating that trade ties emerge within clustered and path‐dependent structures. Overall, the findings suggest that the contemporary trade system is increasingly shaped by the interaction between geopolitical affinity and network embeddedness.
doi:10.1111/twec.70125.abstract_zh: 随着地缘政治紧张局势加剧，全球化面临阻力，国际政治与贸易之间的互动日益复杂。本文超越静态引力模型，考察国际政治关系与全球贸易网络的动态共同演化。基于1996年至2023年139个经济体的数据集，采用随机行动者导向模型（SAOM），我们将全球贸易网络建模为一个内生且不断演化的系统，而非一组独立的双边关系。结果表明，外交亲近度显著提升了贸易联系形成的可能性，且这一效应在2016年后明显增强，其解释力接近地理距离。估计结果还揭示了贸易网络中强烈的互惠性和三角闭合性，表明贸易联系出现在具有聚类和路径依赖特征的结构中。总体而言，研究结果表明，当代贸易体系日益受到地缘政治亲和性与网络嵌入性之间互动的影响。
doi:10.1111/twec.70125.title: The Dynamic Co‐Evolution of International Politics and the Global Trade Network: Evidence From a Stochastic Actor‐Oriented Model
doi:10.1111/twec.70125.title_zh: 国际政治与全球贸易网络的动态共演化：来自随机行动者导向模型的证据

doi:10.1111/twec.70126.abstract: We study the impact of global value chain (GVC) participation on firms' innovation, productivity, and other indicators of technical change. Our dataset encompasses heterogeneous firms from 144 countries at different income levels over the period 2006–2025. Using difference‐in‐differences and matching strategies, we find that GVC participation leads to increased innovation and other technological improvements, with gains driven primarily at the extensive margin and by importing rather than exporting activities. Among innovation types, product innovation responds more strongly than process innovation. Importantly, the nature of innovation differs systematically across development levels: GVC participants in lower‐income countries benefit from access to foreign technology, while those operating in more advanced economies engage more in formal, R&D‐intensive innovation. JEL Classification : C31, F14, F15, O31, O33
doi:10.1111/twec.70126.abstract_zh: 我们研究了全球价值链（GVC）参与对企业创新、生产率及其他技术变革指标的影响。数据集涵盖2006–2025年间来自144个不同收入水平国家的异质性企业。通过双重差分法和匹配策略，我们发现GVC参与促进了创新及其他技术进步，其收益主要源于集约边际，且进口活动的作用强于出口活动。在创新类型中，产品创新的响应程度强于流程创新。重要的是，创新性质在不同发展水平上呈现系统性差异：低收入国家的GVC参与者受益于外国技术获取，而发达经济体的企业则更多从事正式的、研发密集型创新。 JEL分类：C31, F14, F15, O31, O33
doi:10.1111/twec.70126.title: Technical Change Through Global Value Chains: Evidence From Firms Worldwide
doi:10.1111/twec.70126.title_zh: 全球价值链中的技术变革：来自全球企业的证据

doi:10.1111/twec.70127.abstract: Utilising microdata from Chinese A‐share listed firms matched to the China Customs Database over the period 2007–2016, this paper exploits a quasi‐natural experiment based on Google's exit from mainland China and constructs a difference‐in‐differences (DID) model to systematically examine the impact of information access barriers on firms' multi‐dimensional export competitiveness. The results indicate that information access barriers have a significant negative effect on firms' multi‐dimensional export competitiveness, primarily reflected in narrowing export product scope, reducing export technological sophistication and weakening their centrality in the export trade network. Mechanism analyses reveal that information access barriers suppress firms' multi‐dimensional export competitiveness through multiple channels, including increasing transaction costs, constraining technological innovation, weakening capital investment, reducing productivity and aggravating financial constraints. Moreover, heterogeneity tests reveal that the impact of information access barriers on firms' multi‐dimensional export competitiveness varies significantly across regions, industries and firm types. Extending the scope beyond export performance, further analysis shows that restricted information access significantly impairs firms' short‐term profitability and long‐term market valuation. Taken together, this study underscores the critical role of information access barriers in firms' export competitiveness and upgrading, offering important insights for better leveraging information technology to improve export patterns.
doi:10.1111/twec.70127.abstract_zh: 利用2007–2016年中国A股上市公司与海关数据库匹配的微观数据，本文以谷歌退出中国大陆为准自然实验，构建双重差分模型系统考察信息获取壁垒对企业多维出口竞争力的影响。结果表明，信息获取壁垒对企业多维出口竞争力具有显著负向效应，主要表现为缩小出口产品范围、降低出口技术复杂度、削弱其在出口贸易网络中的中心度。机制分析显示，信息获取壁垒通过增加交易成本、抑制技术创新、削弱资本投入、降低生产率及加剧融资约束等多重渠道抑制企业多维出口竞争力。异质性检验表明，信息获取壁垒对不同地区、行业及类型企业的多维出口竞争力影响存在显著差异。将研究范畴拓展至出口绩效之外，进一步分析发现，信息获取受限显著损害企业短期盈利能力和长期市场估值。综上，本研究揭示了信息获取壁垒在企业出口竞争力与升级中的关键作用，为更好利用信息技术优化出口格局提供了重要启示。

doi:10.1111/twec.70130.abstract: This study aims to explore the relationship between trade sophistication and economic development stages, including in the context of digitalization. We employ nonparametric, semiparametric, and parametric methods, covering the period from 2003 to 2024 across 119 countries, categorized into three income groups. Our findings show that GDP per capita has a positive but diminishing relationship with export and import sophistication, suggesting that trade sophistication grows rapidly at lower levels of economic development but slows down as economies become more economically advanced. The evolution patterns of export and import sophistication are relatively similar throughout the stages of economic development; however, the level of export sophistication consistently exceeds that of import sophistication across all income groups. In the context of digital transformation, digitalization is found to positively affect trade sophistication in high and middle‐income countries, while GDP per capita remains positively associated with trade sophistication, but with diminishing marginal effects. For low‐income countries, GDP per capita is the primary driver of increased trade sophistication, while in high‐income countries, digitalization stands out as the dominant factor. These findings remain robust after controlling for human capital, FDI, and institutional quality, highlighting the importance of formulating stage‐specific economic policies to enhance trade sophistication in the rapidly evolving digital era.
doi:10.1111/twec.70130.abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究旨在探讨贸易复杂度与经济发展阶段之间的关系，并纳入数字化背景进行分析。我们采用非参数、半参数及参数方法，覆盖2003年至2024年间119个国家，并将其划分为三个收入组别。研究结果表明，人均GDP与出口及进口复杂度呈正向但边际递减的关系，即贸易复杂度在经济发展水平较低阶段增长较快，但随着经济体日趋成熟而增速放缓。出口与进口复杂度的演变模式在经济发展各阶段相对相似；然而，在所有收入组别中，出口复杂度水平始终高于进口复杂度。在数字化转型背景下，数字化对高收入及中等收入国家的贸易复杂度具有正向影响，而人均GDP仍与贸易复杂度保持正向关联，但边际效应递减。对于低收入国家，人均GDP是提升贸易复杂度的主要驱动力；而在高收入国家，数字化则成为主导因素。在控制人力资本、外商直接投资及制度质量后，上述结论依然稳健，凸显了在快速演变的数字时代制定分阶段经济政策以提升贸易复杂度的重要性。
doi:10.1111/twec.70130.title: Trade Sophistication and Economic Development Stages in the Context of Global Digitalization
doi:10.1111/twec.70130.title_zh: 全球数字化背景下的贸易复杂度与经济发展阶段

doi:10.1111/twec.70131.abstract: In the current confrontational geopolitical climate, countries have intensified the use of selective trade restrictions to exert economic coercion. This paper introduces targeted trade restrictions between a US‐centric bloc and a China‐centric bloc into a general equilibrium trade model that features nonlinear adjustments and input–output connections. We study how micro‐level restrictions—based on data identifying high‐weaponization‐potential products—affect welfare and the macroeconomic structure of global value chains (GVCs). Our findings reveal that while global economic integration is marginally affected, its topology changes: chains become more regional and rely more on non‐aligned countries acting as connectors between opposing blocs, in ways that may be hard to detect in standard trade data.
doi:10.1111/twec.70131.abstract_zh: 在当前对抗性地缘政治气候下，各国强化了选择性贸易限制手段以实施经济胁迫。本文将美国主导集团与中国主导集团之间的针对性贸易限制引入具有非线性调整特征和投入产出关联的一般均衡贸易模型。基于识别高武器化潜力产品的微观数据，我们研究了微观层面的限制措施如何影响福利与全球价值链的宏观经济结构。研究结果表明，尽管全球经济一体化受到轻微影响，但其拓扑结构发生了改变：价值链呈现区域化趋势，并更依赖不结盟国家作为对立集团之间的连接枢纽——这种变化在标准贸易数据中可能难以察觉。

doi:10.1111/twec.70132.abstract: Oil is the lifeblood of industry, serving as the core source of power for the operation of industrial machinery. Ensuring its stable supply is crucial for the smooth production process, which in turn is a key determinant in enhancing the quality of export products for enterprises. This study empirically examines the impact of energy supply on the quality of export products and the mechanism of its effect by using a staggered difference‐in‐differences (DID) method with the implementation of China's West‐to‐East Oil Transportation Project as a quasi‐natural experiment. The empirical results show that a dependable energy supply substantially boosts the quality of goods produced for export by various companies. The mechanism analysis shows that energy supply improves export product quality through enterprise performance improvement effects, industry agglomeration effects and supply chain stabilization effects, and it mainly improves export product quality in energy‐importing regions, technology‐intensive industries, private enterprises, and general trade enterprises. Further analysis reveals that a stable supply of energy helps enhance the sustainability of enterprise exports while helping enterprises realize value chain upgrading, helping China get rid of the curse of locking the bottom of the export value chain. The findings of this study help clarify the intrinsic mechanism between energy supply and export product quality and provide an empirical basis for the cross‐regional energy dispatch strategy to help China's export value chain upgrade.
doi:10.1111/twec.70132.abstract_zh: 摘要 石油是工业的血液，是工业机械运转的核心动力来源。确保其稳定供应对于生产过程的顺利进行至关重要，而这又是提升企业出口产品质量的关键决定因素。本研究以中国“西油东送”工程实施为准自然实验，采用交错双重差分法实证检验了能源供应对出口产品质量的影响及其作用机制。实证结果表明，可靠的能源供应显著提升了各类企业的出口产品质量。机制分析显示，能源供应通过企业绩效提升效应、产业集聚效应和供应链稳定效应改善了出口产品质量，并且主要提升了能源输入地区、技术密集型行业、民营企业和一般贸易企业的出口产品质量。进一步分析发现，稳定的能源供应有助于增强企业出口的可持续性，同时帮助企业实现价值链升级，助力中国摆脱出口价值链低端锁定的困境。本研究结论有助于厘清能源供应与出口产品质量之间的内在机理，并为跨区域能源调度策略助力中国出口价值链升级提供经验依据。

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1768.abstract: This paper uncovers that input tariff reductions result in less domestic innovation, but standard models of trade ensure a positive correlation between importing and innovation. Hence, the paper develops a dynamic framework with a task-specific laboraugmenting productivity and a non-homothetic import demand system to rationalize this finding. The model implies that input liberalization enables firms to use cheaper intermediate imports as a substitute for self-made inputs, a strategy that decreases marginal production costs but also discourages firms from investing in their own inhouse varieties. Finally, the paper compares the effectiveness of trade and innovation policies in boosting aggregate productivity growth.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1768.abstract_zh: 本文发现，投入品关税削减导致国内创新减少，而标准贸易模型却认为进口与创新之间存在正相关关系。为此，本文构建了一个包含任务特定劳动增强型生产率与非同质进口需求体系的动态框架，以解释这一发现。模型表明，投入品自由化使企业能够用更便宜的进口中间品替代自制投入品，这一策略虽降低了边际生产成本，但也抑制了企业对自主开发内部品种的投资。最后，本文比较了贸易政策与创新政策在促进全要素生产率增长方面的有效性。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1768.title: Globalization, Innovation, and Margins of Sourcing
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1768.title_zh: 全球化、创新与采购边际

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1769.abstract: Market power is costly to build and, once established, is typically persistent and difficult to change. This paper investigates the impact of large economic shocks (serious epidemics) on the redistribution of market power in manufacturing industries. Using a model of firms’ dynamic decisions on production, pricing, and inventory holding, we demonstrate the importance of inventory stock and demand uncertainty in understanding market power and propose a new measure of market power. We find that the 2003 SARS shock in China significantly reduced the market power of firms in SARS-impacted areas. This effect is long lasting. SARS also substantially increased the inventory of affected firms, which partially contributed to the redistribution of market power.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1769.abstract_zh: 市场势力的构建成本高昂，且一旦形成便具有显著的持久性和难以改变的特征。本文探究了重大经济冲击（严重流行病）对制造业市场势力再分配的影响。通过构建企业生产、定价与库存持有动态决策模型，我们论证了库存规模与需求不确定性在理解市场势力中的关键作用，并提出了一种新的市场势力测度方法。研究发现，2003年中国非典疫情冲击显著降低了疫区企业的市场势力，且该效应具有长期持续性。非典疫情还大幅增加了受影响企业的库存水平，这在一定程度上推动了市场势力的再分配。

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1769.title_zh: 大型流行病如何重新分配市场力量？来自2003年中国SARS冲击的证据

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1770.abstract: Since 1970, the share of Black individuals living in suburbs of large cities has risen from 16% to 36%. We first show that Black suburbanization has led to major changes in neighborhoods, accounting for the majority of recent increases in both the average Black individual’s neighborhood quality and income segregation within the Black population. We then use an accounting exercise to show that changes in relative suburban amenities and housing prices explain a large share of Black suburbanization, while regional reallocation, changing educational attainment, and gentrification of Black city neighborhoods play only minor roles.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1770.abstract_zh: 自1970年以来，居住在大城市郊区的黑人比例已从16%上升至36%。我们首先表明，黑人郊区化导致了社区的重大变化，这解释了近年来黑人个体平均社区质量提升以及黑人群体内部收入隔离加剧的大部分原因。随后，我们通过核算分析表明，郊区相对便利设施和房价的变化解释了黑人郊区化的很大一部分原因，而区域重新分配、教育程度变化以及黑人城市社区的绅士化仅起到次要作用。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1770.title: Black Suburbanization: Causes and Consequences of a Transformation of American Cities
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1770.title_zh: 黑人郊区化：美国城市转型的原因与后果

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1771.abstract: We study how regional housing market disruptions spill over across US local markets through multimarket firm networks. Using granular barcode-level data linked to producer information, we exploit variation in firms’ exposure to local house price declines. A firm’s local sales respond more strongly to indirect housing price declines in its other markets than to direct local declines. The barcode-level data reveal a novel uniform product replacement mechanism: Firms respond to adverse shocks by replacing higher-value products with lower-value alternatives uniformly across all markets. This propagates regional demand shocks through the supply side, with new implications for regional economics.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1771.abstract_zh: 本文研究区域住房市场冲击如何通过跨市场企业网络在美国地方市场间传导。利用与生产者信息相关联的细粒度条形码级数据，我们考察了企业对当地房价下跌的暴露程度差异。研究发现，企业在其其他市场面临的间接房价下跌对其本地销售的影响，比直接本地房价下跌更为显著。条形码级数据揭示了一种新颖的统一产品替代机制：企业通过在所有市场中统一用低价值产品替代高价值产品来应对不利冲击。这一机制通过供给侧将区域需求冲击进行传导，为区域经济学提供了新的启示。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1771.title: Spillovers through Multimarket Firms: The Uniform Product Replacement Channel
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1771.title_zh: 多市场企业的溢出效应：统一产品替代渠道

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1772.abstract: We document that in response to intensified competition from China in the U.S., poor countries reduce their export prices relative to rich countries, consistent with conventional wisdom. Interestingly, however, the opposite is true for export quantities. To reconcile these facts, we develop and estimate a general equilibrium model of trade featuring (i) cross-country heterogeneity in the ability to produce high-quality goods and (ii) a two-dimensional Bertrand competition on price and quality. Our model explains the empirical facts by showing that rich countries have a comparative advantage in quality upgrading, whereas a nested model without quality cannot do so.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1772.abstract_zh: 我们记录到，面对中国在美国市场竞争加剧的情况，贫困国家相对于富裕国家降低了出口价格，这与传统观点一致。然而有趣的是，出口数量却呈现相反趋势。为调和这些事实，我们构建并估计了一个包含以下特征的贸易一般均衡模型：（i）各国生产高质量产品能力的异质性，以及（ii）价格与质量二维伯特兰竞争。该模型通过揭示富裕国家在质量升级方面具有比较优势来解释实证现象，而嵌套的无质量模型则无法做到这一点。

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1772.title_zh: 跨国竞争反应的异质性：理论与贸易数据的证据

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1773.abstract: How do import tariffs affect employment? We develop an empirical strategy to identify the effects of tariffs using a difference-in-differences strategy, comparing antidumping (AD) investigations resulting in AD tariffs to those not resulting in AD tariffs. We find that an AD tariff decreases imports and increases employment in the protected sector. Moreover, employment in downstream firms decreases, while upstream firms are unaffected because the protected sector sources inputs abroad. Using a model to quantify the aggregate effects, we find that the Brazilian AD policy increased employment by 0.06% at a welfare loss of 2.4%.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1773.abstract_zh: 进口关税如何影响就业？我们采用双重差分策略来识别关税效应，通过比较导致反倾销税的反倾销调查与未导致反倾销税的反倾销调查。研究发现，反倾销税会减少进口并增加受保护部门的就业。此外，下游企业的就业减少，而上游企业未受影响，因为受保护部门从国外采购投入品。通过模型量化总体效应，我们发现巴西的反倾销政策使就业增加0.06%，但福利损失达2.4%。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1773.title: The Employment Consequences of Anti-Dumping Tariffs: Lessons from Brazil
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1773.title_zh: 反倾销关税的就业后果：来自巴西的教训

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1774.abstract: Against a backdrop of sharply rising inequality, the Tokyo Round of the GATT resulted in a 1.6 percentage point reduction in average US tariffs – larger than CUSFTA, NAFTA, and the liberalization accompanying the granting of PNTR to China. We construct a novel IV based on the so-called “Swiss formula” that governed the Tokyo Round tariff liberalization to provide evidence of its effects on imports and inequality. Instrumented tariff reductions explain approximately 20% of the rise in income inequality between non-production and production workers between 1979 and 1988. This effect is largest among women, workers in routine occupations, and workers in more technology-intensive industries, suggesting a complementarity between trade liberalization and skill-biased technological change.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1774.abstract_zh: 在收入不平等急剧加剧的背景下，关贸总协定东京回合使美国平均关税降低了1.6个百分点——这一降幅大于美加自由贸易协定、北美自由贸易协定以及给予中国永久正常贸易关系地位时的贸易自由化幅度。我们基于指导东京回合关税自由化的所谓"瑞士公式"构建了一个新的工具变量，以证明其对进口和不平等的影响。工具变量估计的关税削减解释了1979年至1988年间非生产工人与生产工人之间收入不平等上升的约20%。这一效应在女性、从事常规职业的工人以及技术密集型行业的工人中最为显著，表明贸易自由化与技能偏向型技术进步之间存在互补性。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1774.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1774.title: Trade and U.S. Inequality in the Tokyo Round
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1774.title_zh: 东京回合中的贸易与美国不平等

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1775.abstract: We provide the first estimates of intergenerational income mobility using tax data for a large developing country, namely Brazil. We measure formal income from tax and payroll data, and we train machine learning models on census and survey data to predict informal income. We quantify the estimation bias resulting from income imputation and other sources of measurement error, and show that such bias remains negligible in our context. A 10 percentile increase in parental income rank is associated on average with a 5.5 percentile increase in child income rank, with considerable variation across sociodemographic groups and geographical areas.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1775.abstract_zh: 我们利用巴西这一大型发展中国家的税收数据，首次估算了代际收入流动性。通过税收和工资数据衡量正规收入，并基于人口普查和调查数据训练机器学习模型以预测非正规收入。我们量化了因收入估算及其他测量误差导致的估计偏差，并证明此类偏差在我们的研究中可忽略不计。父母收入排名每提高10个百分位，子女收入排名平均上升5.5个百分位，且不同社会人口群体和地理区域之间存在显著差异。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1775.title: Intergenerational Mobility in the Land of Inequality
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1775.title_zh: 不平等之地中的代际流动性

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1776.abstract: Urban forests are ubiquitous, yet their impacts and values remain largely unknown. We study a massive urban afforestation policy in Beijing that planted 1/3 of a million acres of greenery in less than a decade. We conduct a remote-sensing audit of the program, finding that it contributes to a substantial greening up of the city. This causes significant downwind air quality improvement, reducing average PM2.5 concentration at city population hubs by 4.2%. Rapid vegetation growth unexpectedly led to a 7.4% increase in pollen exposure. Analysis of medical claims data shows that increased aeroallergens triggered emergency room visits, mirroring pollution effects though much less severe. Monetized net health benefits of the program amount to 1.5% of the city’s GDP. Urban forests are only partially capitalized in housing values, with buyers mainly appreciating proximity to green spaces but not the air quality improvements they bring.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1776.abstract_zh: 城市森林无处不在，但其影响和价值在很大程度上仍不为人知。我们研究了北京一项大规模的城市造林政策，该政策在不到十年内种植了33万英亩的绿地。通过对该项目的遥感审计，我们发现它显著提升了城市的绿化水平。这带来了显著的下风向空气质量改善，使城市人口聚集区的平均PM2.5浓度降低了4.2%。然而，植被的快速生长意外导致花粉暴露量增加了7.4%。对医疗索赔数据的分析显示，空气过敏原的增加引发了急诊就诊，其影响与污染类似，但严重程度远低于污染。该政策的货币化净健康效益相当于该市GDP的1.5%。城市森林仅部分资本化于住房价值中，购房者主要看重靠近绿地的便利性，而非其带来的空气质量改善。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1776.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1776.title: Urban Forests: Environmental Health Values and Risks
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1776.title_zh: 城市森林：环境健康价值与风险

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1777.abstract: Pharmacy benefit managers dominate the U.S. pharmaceutical market but are controversial and poorly understood. We analyze PBMs as market intermediaries that operate formulary contests in which on-patent brand-drug makers compete for favorable placement by offering rebates off list price. These formulary contests deliver efficiency gains compared to drug makers selling directly to consumers; PBMs capture some of these gains. Our approach answers key questions regarding the determinants of efficiency, rebates, list prices, and PBM market power in the pharmaceutical market. Our analysis also explains how common contracting practices, federal regulations, and incentives within formulary contests can undermine market efficiency.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1777.abstract_zh: 药品福利管理公司主导着美国药品市场，但颇具争议且认知度较低。我们将PBM视为市场中介机构，其运作处方集竞争机制——专利品牌药制造商通过提供标价折扣来争夺有利的处方集地位。相较于药企直接面向消费者销售的模式，这种处方集竞争机制能带来效率提升；PBM则从中获取部分收益。我们的分析框架解答了关于药品市场效率决定因素、折扣机制、标价形成及PBM市场势力的关键问题。研究同时揭示了处方集竞争中的常见合同实践、联邦监管规定及激励机制如何可能削弱市场效率。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1777.title: Common Agent or Double Agent? Pharmacy Benefit Managers in the Prescription Drug Market
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1777.title_zh: 共同代理人还是双重代理人？处方药市场中的药品福利管理者

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1778.abstract: Nonprofit organizations rely on donations from large competitive marketplaces to provide key social service goods. Most research focuses on competition in output markets without considering philanthropic markets where nonprofits make decisions about how much effort to put into fundraising. We develop and estimate a model that highlights the strategic nature of fundraising, showing that rival NP’s fundraising responses can be strategic complements or substitutes. We find evidence of strategic substitutes. NPs demonstrate nontrivial strategic responses to rival’s fundraising and, in totality, the across sector impacts are important to consider. Counterfactual exercises show that reducing competition decreases equilibrium fundraising levels.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1778.abstract_zh: 非营利组织依赖大型竞争性市场的捐赠来提供关键的社会服务产品。现有研究大多关注产出市场的竞争，而未考虑非营利组织在慈善市场中决定投入多少募捐努力的问题。我们构建并估计了一个模型，该模型凸显了募捐的战略性质，表明竞争对手非营利组织的募捐反应可能是战略互补或战略替代的。我们发现了战略替代的证据。非营利组织对竞争对手的募捐表现出不可忽视的战略反应，总体而言，跨部门的影响值得重视。反事实模拟表明，减少竞争会降低均衡募捐水平。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1778.title: Competition and Nonprofit’s Strategic Responses: Evidence from Fundraising in Donative Markets
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1778.title_zh: 竞争与非营利组织的战略回应：来自捐赠市场筹款的证据

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1779.abstract: We investigate the role financial conditions play in the composition of U.S. growth-at-risk. We document that, by a wide margin, growth-at-risk is investment-at-risk. That is, if financial conditions indicate U.S. real GDP growth will be in the lower tail of its conditional distribution, we know that quantitatively, the main contributor is a decline in investment. Consumption contributes under extreme financial stress. Government spending and net exports do not play a role. We show that leverage plays a key role in determining both consumption- and investment-at-risk, which provides support to the financial accelerator mechanism proposed by Bernanke et al. (1999).
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1779.abstract_zh: 我们研究了金融状况在美国增长风险构成中的作用。实证表明，增长风险在很大程度上即为投资风险。也就是说，若金融状况预示美国实际GDP增长将处于条件分布的下尾端，从量化角度看，其主要贡献因素来自投资下降。消费仅在极端金融压力下有所贡献，而政府支出与净出口则未发挥显著作用。我们进一步发现，杠杆水平在决定消费风险与投资风险中均扮演关键角色，这为Bernanke等（1999）提出的金融加速器机制提供了实证支持。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1779.title: Growth-at-Risk Is Investment-at-Risk

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1780.abstract: This paper provides novel evidence on how dietary habits – a key health behavior – are transmitted across generations, exploiting unique grocery transaction data linked with administrative records. We document strong intergenerational persistence in dietary habits, exceeding that of income, and consider several channels that might explain this pattern. Specifically, we find that socioeconomic status and geography account for only a small share of the transmission. Combined with the absence of a dietary response following a parent’s unexpected lifestyle-related death, these findings underscore the importance of early-life influences and habit formation.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1780.abstract_zh: 本文利用与行政记录相关联的独特杂货交易数据，提供了关于饮食习惯——这一关键健康行为——如何代际传递的新证据。我们记录了饮食习惯中显著的代际持续性，其程度超过收入，并考察了可能解释这一模式的若干渠道。具体而言，我们发现社会经济地位和地理因素仅能解释传递中的一小部分。结合父母因生活方式相关意外死亡后饮食行为未发生变化的发现，这些结果强调了早期生活影响和习惯形成的重要性。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1780.title: The Apple Does Not Fall Far From the Tree: Intergenerational Persistence of Dietary Habits
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1780.title_zh: 苹果不会落在离树太远的地方：饮食习惯的代际持续性

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1781.abstract: This paper investigates the long-term impacts of China’s nationwide public health campaigns targeting malaria, measles, and meningitis between the 1960s and 1980s. Exploiting regional variation in precampaign disease prevalence across birth cohorts, we show that these interventions generated sizable improvements in education, cognition, health, and income. As an illustrative case, individuals from high-malaria regions who were fully exposed to the eradication campaign attained about 0.5 additional years of schooling and earned over 10% higher income in adulthood, with cognitive and schooling gains explaining a substantial share of the income effects. Extending the same approach to measles and meningitis vaccination campaigns reveals comparably large benefits, with internal rates of return ranging from 21% to 34%. Together, these findings highlight the lasting socioeconomic returns to early-life health interventions and underscore the role of public health as a foundation for human capital accumulation and long-run economic growth.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1781.abstract_zh: 本文研究了20世纪60至80年代中国针对疟疾、麻疹和脑膜炎开展的全国性公共卫生运动的长期影响。利用不同出生队列在运动前疾病流行率的地区差异，我们证明这些干预措施显著改善了教育、认知、健康和收入水平。以疟疾为例，来自高疟疾地区且完全暴露于根除运动的个体，其受教育年限平均增加约0.5年，成年后收入提高超过10%，其中认知能力和教育水平的提升解释了收入效应的很大一部分。将相同方法应用于麻疹和脑膜炎疫苗接种运动后，同样发现了可观的收益，内部收益率介于21%至34%之间。这些发现共同凸显了早期健康干预的持久社会经济回报，并强调了公共卫生作为人力资本积累和长期经济增长基础的关键作用。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1781.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1781.title: Public Health, Human Capital, and Economic Growth: The Lasting Effects of Disease Control in China
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1781.title_zh: 公共卫生、人力资本与经济增长：中国疾病控制的持久影响

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1782.abstract: We examine firm responses to state hiring and investment subsidies. We leverage institutional features of the California Competes Tax Credit (CCTC), a large-scale business incentive program that incorporates best practices from prior job creation policies. The CCTC award selection procedure combines formula-based and discretionary components. Leveraging applicant score eligibility cutoffs in a regression discontinuity design and taking advantage of rich longitudinal microdata on establishments and their parent firms, we find that businesses expand employment in California in response to CCTC awards. There is little evidence that these expansions come at the expense of firms’ operations in other states. Our results suggest that targeted and audited hiring and investment subsidies can be effective in promoting local business expansions without inducing significant cross-state displacement effects.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1782.abstract_zh: 本文考察了企业对州级雇佣与投资补贴的响应。我们利用加州竞争税收抵免（CCTC）的制度特征——这一大规模商业激励计划整合了以往就业创造政策的最佳实践。CCTC奖项评选程序结合了公式化与自由裁量两种机制。通过运用断点回归设计，基于申请者评分资格临界值，并借助涵盖企业及其母公司的丰富纵向微观数据，我们发现企业因获得CCTC奖项而在加州扩大了就业规模。几乎没有证据表明这种扩张是以牺牲企业在其他州的运营为代价。我们的研究结果表明，经过精准定位与审计的雇佣及投资补贴，能够有效促进本地企业扩张，且不会引发显著的跨州替代效应。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1782.title: Firm Responses to Hiring and Investment Subsidies: Regression Discontinuity Evidence from the California Competes Tax Credit
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1782.title_zh: 企业应对招聘与投资补贴的反应：来自加州竞争税收抵免的断点回归证据

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1783.abstract: We study the role of war bonds and inflation in post-WWII federal elections. After WWII, major bouts of inflation in 1946-48 and 1950-51 depressed the real returns of the bonds sold to households during the war. In a difference-in-differences framework, we find that counties with higher war bond purchases shifted their votes towards the Republican Party in postwar elections. To address the endogeneity of war bond purchases, we use an instrumental variables design, and obtain similar results. Bond ownership raised the saliency of inflation, and the severe rise in prices after the war triggered a backlash against the incumbent Democrats.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1783.abstract_zh: 我们研究了二战后的战争债券与通货膨胀在联邦选举中的作用。二战后，1946-48年和1950-51年的两次重大通胀压低了战争期间向家庭出售债券的实际回报。在双重差分框架下，我们发现战争债券购买量更高的县在战后选举中投票转向共和党。为解决战争债券购买的内生性问题，我们采用工具变量设计，并得到类似结果。债券持有提高了通胀的显著性，战后物价的急剧上涨引发了选民对在任民主党人的强烈反对。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1783.title: Inflation, War Bonds, and Voter Backlash in the 1950s
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1783.title_zh: 20世纪50年代的通胀、战争债券与选民反弹

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1784.abstract: This study explores the relationship between legalized sports gambling, unexpected emotional cues stemming from NFL home team upset losses and reported intimate partner violence (IPV). Using 1995–2022 crime data from NIBRS, replicating and extending Card and Dahl (2011)’s model, we find that legalized gambling increases the impact of upset losses on IPV by 10 percentage points. The e!ect is larger in states with mobile betting, where higher bets were placed, around paydays, and for teams on a winning streak. These results suggest that financial losses from gambling amplify emotional reactions to unexpected team losses.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1784.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了合法化体育博彩、NFL主队爆冷失利引发的意外情绪线索与亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）报告之间的关系。利用1995-2022年NIBRS犯罪数据，复制并扩展了Card和Dahl（2011）的模型，我们发现合法化博彩使爆冷失利对IPV的影响增加了10个百分点。在允许移动投注的州、投注金额较高的地区、发薪日前后以及处于连胜状态的球队中，这一效应更为显著。这些结果表明，博彩带来的经济损失放大了对球队意外失利的情绪反应。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1784.title: Sports Betting Legalization Amplifies Emotional Cues and Intimate Partner Violence
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1784.title_zh: 体育博彩合法化加剧情绪线索与亲密伴侣暴力

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1785.abstract: Counterfactuals in quantitative trade and spatial models are functions of the current state of the world and the model parameters. Common practice treats the current state of the world as perfectly observed, but there is good reason to believe that it is measured with error. This paper provides tools for quantifying uncertainty about counterfactuals when the current state of the world is measured with error. I recommend an empirical Bayes approach to uncertainty quantification, and show that it is both practical and theoretically justified.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1785.abstract_zh: 定量贸易与空间模型中的反事实分析依赖于当前世界状态与模型参数。现有研究通常将当前世界状态视为完全可观测的，但实际测量中很可能存在误差。本文提供了当当前世界状态存在测量误差时，量化反事实分析不确定性的工具。我推荐采用经验贝叶斯方法进行不确定性量化，并证明该方法兼具实用性与理论合理性。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1785.title: Measurement Error and Counterfactuals in Quantitative Trade and Spatial Models
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1785.title_zh: 定量贸易与空间模型中的测量误差与反事实分析

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1786.abstract: We use administrative data to measure sibling spillovers on academic performance before and after the introduction of Free Secondary Education (FSE) in Tanzania. Prior to FSE, students whose older siblings narrowly passed the secondary school entrance exam were less likely to go to secondary school themselves; with FSE, the effect became positive. A triple-differences analysis, using geographic variation in FSE exposure, shows that FSE caused the reversal. Mechanism analyses suggest that changes in parental investments were a more likely channel for this reversal than direct sibling interactions. By alleviating financial constraints, FSE allowed households to invest in more children.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1786.abstract_zh: 我们利用行政数据，衡量坦桑尼亚实施免费中等教育（FSE）前后，兄弟姐妹对学业表现的溢出效应。在FSE实施前，其兄姐以微弱优势通过中学入学考试的学生，自身升入中学的可能性反而更低；而FSE实施后，这一效应转为正向。通过利用FSE覆盖范围的地理差异进行三重差分分析，结果表明FSE导致了这一逆转。机制分析表明，相较于直接的兄弟姐妹互动，父母投资的变化更可能是这一逆转的传导渠道。通过缓解经济约束，FSE使家庭能够对更多子女进行教育投资。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1786.title: Sibling Spillovers and Free Schooling
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1786.title_zh: 兄弟姐妹溢出效应与免费教育

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1787.abstract: This paper connects changes in employer characteristics through job transitions to employee earnings following mergers and acquisitions. Using firm balance sheet data linked to individual earnings data in Canada and a matched difference-in-differences design, we find that earnings of workers at target firms decrease after M&As relative to control workers, largely driven by those who move to other firms. Workers leaving targets move to larger and more profitable firms, but still experience wage declines. These decreased earnings are also concentrated among workers with longer tenure. These results are consistent with workers losing valuable match-specific premia after M&A-induced job transitions.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1787.abstract_zh: 本文通过工作转换将雇主特征的变化与并购后员工收入联系起来。利用加拿大企业资产负债表数据与个人收入数据的关联，并采用匹配双重差分法，我们发现目标企业员工在并购后的收入相对于对照组员工有所下降，这主要源于那些跳槽至其他企业的员工。离开目标企业的员工虽转向规模更大、盈利能力更强的公司，但仍经历工资下降。这些收入下降现象还集中在任职时间较长的员工群体中。研究结果与员工在并购引发的职业转换中失去有价值的岗位特定溢价这一解释相一致。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1787.title: Job Transitions and Employee Earnings after Acquisitions: Linking Corporate and Worker Outcomes
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1787.title_zh: 收购后的职位转换与员工收入：企业绩效与员工结果的关联

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1788.abstract: This paper investigates fairness perceptions of extreme income inequality generated in winner-take-all competitions. Two large-scale experiments with more than 7,000 participants from the general population of the U.S. show that extreme earnings inequality is widely accepted, even when the winner only slightly outperforms the runner-up. The effect of the winning margin on inequality acceptance is modest compared to the effect of shifting the source of inequality from luck to winning by the smallest possible margin. The experimental choices are systematically associated with broader fairness attitudes and policy preferences, including support for higher taxation of top earners and redistributive economic policy.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1788.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在赢家通吃竞争中所产生的极端收入不平等现象的公平感知问题。两项涵盖美国普通民众超过7000名参与者的大规模实验表明，极端收入不平等被广泛接受，即便获胜者仅以微弱优势领先亚军。与将不平等来源从运气转向最小可能获胜差距的影响相比，获胜差距对不平等接受程度的影响相对较小。实验选择与更广泛的公平态度及政策偏好存在系统性关联，包括支持对高收入者征收更高税率及再分配经济政策。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1788.title: Fairness in Winner-Take-All Competitions
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1788.title_zh: 赢者通吃竞争中的公平性

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1789.abstract: In 2001, Germany abolished public occupational disability insurance (ODI)—the second tier of its public DI system—for cohorts born after 1960. Using administrative data, we first document that, in the long run, overall DI inflows declined by roughly one-third. Second, using representative survey data, we document at best modest ODI insurance take-up responses in the private individual, risk-rated market, which lacks guaranteed issue. Third, an equilibrium model incorporating interactions between the public safety net, the first-tier public DI, and the private market reveals that coverage denials and weak insurance demand, driven by complementary social insurance, can explain the modest private ODI take-up response. Coverage gradients by income and health are thus substantial. Finally, counterfactual simulations highlight the limited scope of incremental reforms.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1789.abstract_zh: 2001年，德国废除了针对1960年后出生群体的公共职业伤残保险（ODI）——其公共伤残保险体系的第二层级。基于行政数据，我们首先发现，从长期来看，总体伤残保险流入量下降了约三分之一。其次，利用代表性调查数据，我们发现在缺乏保证承保条款的风险评级私人市场中，ODI保险的参保反应充其量仅为温和水平。第三，通过构建包含公共安全网、第一层级公共伤残保险与私人市场之间相互作用的均衡模型，我们发现：由补充性社会保险驱动的承保拒绝与疲弱的保险需求，可以解释私人ODI参保反应的温和特征。由此，按收入与健康水平划分的保障梯度差异显著。最后，反事实模拟凸显了渐进式改革的有限空间。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1789.title: Fundamentally Reforming the DI System: Evidence from Germany
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1789.title_zh: 从根本上改革伤残保险体系：来自德国的证据

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1790.abstract: After remaining flat for decades, labor productivity at U.S. restaurants surged 15% during the COVID pandemic. The surge has persisted. We explore this using mobile phone data tracking visits and spending at 100,000 limited-service restaurants. It cannot be explained by scale economies, market power, or mechanical consequences of COVID demand fluctuations. However, restaurants’ productivity growth is strongly correlated with the share of their customers visiting for 10 minutes or less, which rose considerably during COVID and persisted. This restaurant-level relationship between labor productivity and customer dwell time is large enough to explain most of the aggregate productivity increase.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1790.abstract_zh: 美国餐饮业的劳动生产率在数十年间保持平稳，却在新冠疫情期间骤增15%，且这一增长态势持续至今。我们利用追踪10万家有限服务餐厅客流量与消费额的手机数据展开研究。这种增长无法用规模经济、市场势力或疫情需求波动的机械效应来解释。然而，餐厅生产率增长与其顾客停留时间不超过10分钟的占比高度相关——该比例在疫情期间显著上升并持续保持。这种餐厅层面劳动生产率与顾客停留时间的关联强度，足以解释大部分总体生产率增长。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1790.title: The Curious Surge of Productivity in U.S. Restaurants
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1790.title_zh: 美国餐饮业生产率的神秘激增

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1813.abstract: This paper theoretically and empirically examines the role of information in pharmaceutical detailing (promotional interactions between drug representatives and physicians). We start with a theoretical framework in which pharmaceutical firms target detailing visits to physicians who learn about drug quality and prescribe accordingly. We derive several predictions about the role of information in these visits, which we then test empirically using prescriptions and pharmaceutical detailing visit data. We find limited empirical support of learning as the dominant mechanism, though cannot rule it out completely. We conclude with discussing alternative models that may be more consistent with the observed empirical patterns.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1813.abstract_zh: 本文从理论与实证角度探讨信息在药品推广拜访（即医药代表与医生之间的促销互动）中的作用。我们首先构建了一个理论框架，其中制药企业针对医生进行定向推广拜访，医生通过此类拜访了解药品质量并据此开具处方。基于此框架，我们推导出关于信息在推广拜访中作用的若干预测，并利用处方数据与药品推广拜访数据进行了实证检验。研究发现，学习机制作为主导解释的实证支持有限，但无法完全排除其可能性。最后，我们讨论了与观察到的实证模式更为一致的替代模型。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1813.title: The Role of Information in Pharmaceutical Advertising: Theory and Evidence
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1813.title_zh: 信息在药品广告中的作用：理论与证据

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1814.abstract: We examine the effect of investments by large technology firms on innovation by AI startups. Large technology firms have substantial advantages in data, a key non-rival input for developing AI technology. We assemble a unique dataset containing approximately 9,800 AI-inventing startups in China. Using a triple-differences strategy, we find that AI startups receiving investments from large technology firms file more AI patent applications and develop more software products following the investment, relative to their counterparts receiving investments from other firms without data advantages. Finally, we provide novel evidence that the innovation effect works mainly through sharing non-rival data.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1814.abstract_zh: 我们考察了大型科技企业的投资对人工智能初创企业创新的影响。大型科技企业在数据这一人工智能技术开发的关键非竞争性投入方面具有显著优势。我们构建了一个包含约9800家中国人工智能初创企业的独特数据集。采用三重差分策略，我们发现，相较于接受其他不具备数据优势企业投资的同类初创企业，获得大型科技企业投资的人工智能初创企业在投资后提交了更多人工智能专利申请，并开发了更多软件产品。最后，我们提供了新的证据表明，这种创新效应主要通过共享非竞争性数据实现。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1814.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1814.title: Investments and Innovation with Non-Rival Inputs: Evidence from Chinese Artificial Intelligence Startups
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1814.title_zh: 非竞争性投入下的投资与创新：来自中国人工智能初创企业的证据

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1815.abstract: Predictive algorithms inform consequential decisions in settings with selective labels: outcomes are observed only for units selected by past decision makers. This creates an identification problem under unobserved confounding — when selected and unselected units differ in unobserved ways that affect outcomes. We propose a framework for robust design and evaluation of predictive algorithms that bounds how much outcomes may differ between selected and unselected units with the same observed characteristics. These bounds formalize common empirical strategies including proxy outcomes and instrumental variables. Our estimators work across bounding strategies and performance measures such as conditional likelihoods, mean squared error, and true/false positive rates. Using administrative data from a large Australian financial institution, we show that varying confounding assumptions substantially affects credit risk predictions and fairness evaluations across income groups.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1815.abstract_zh: 预测算法在存在选择性标签的情境中为关键决策提供依据：结果仅对过去决策者选中的单位可观测。当被选中与未被选中的单位在影响结果的未观测因素上存在差异时，这会在未观测混杂条件下产生识别问题。我们提出一个用于预测算法稳健设计与评估的框架，该框架限定了具有相同观测特征的单位之间结果可能存在的差异程度。这些界限将常见的经验策略（包括代理结果和工具变量）形式化。我们的估计方法适用于多种边界策略和性能指标，如条件似然、均方误差以及真/假阳性率。利用澳大利亚某大型金融机构的行政数据，我们证明改变混杂假设会显著影响不同收入群体的信用风险预测与公平性评估。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1815.title: Robust Design and Evaluation of Predictive Algorithms under Unobserved Confounding
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1815.title_zh: 未观测混杂下预测算法的稳健设计与评估

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1816.abstract: As manufacturing firms expand globally, business services such as advertising and legal support become essential for entering new markets. Exploiting exogenous demand shocks, we document that French manufacturers increasingly outsource market-access services as they enter more destinations. We develop a theory of market-access costs in which firms weigh the managerial strain of internal provision against adaptation costs of outsourcing—a mechanism that receives empirical sup-port. Further explorations reveal that outsourcing market-access services helps explain variation in access costs related to gravity and extended gravity, affects both sunk and fixed export costs, and substantially amplifies the variety gains from trade liberalization.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1816.abstract_zh: 随着制造业企业全球扩张，广告和法律支持等商业服务成为进入新市场的关键。利用外生需求冲击，我们发现法国制造商在进入更多目的地市场时，会越来越多地将市场准入服务外包。我们构建了一个市场准入成本理论，其中企业需权衡内部提供的管理压力与外包的适应成本——这一机制得到了实证支持。进一步研究表明，外包市场准入服务有助于解释与引力模型及扩展引力模型相关的准入成本差异，同时影响出口的沉没成本和固定成本，并显著放大了贸易自由化带来的品种增益。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1816.title: Managing Export Complexity: The Role of Service Outsourcing
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1816.title_zh: 管理出口复杂性：服务外包的作用

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1817.abstract: No. Elite institutions offer high salaries because they hire the most valued faculty. Moreover, in contrast to the broader labor market, faculty are equally likely to move up and down the prestige ladder, and they increase their salary either way. We speculate that these facts reflect the visible nature of faculty productivity and the sporadic nature of academic job openings.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1817.abstract_zh: 不。精英机构之所以提供高薪，是因为它们聘用了最有价值的教师。此外，与更广泛的劳动力市场不同，教师在声望阶梯上向上和向下流动的可能性相同，且无论哪种流动方向，他们的薪资都会增加。我们推测，这些事实反映了教师生产力的可见性以及学术职位空缺的偶发性。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1817.title: Do Elite Universities Overpay Their Faculty?
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1817.title_zh: 精英大学是否向其教师支付过高薪酬？

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1818.abstract: We document a series of stylized facts about how firms seek to protect the rents from innovation, using a large nationally representative survey of U.S. businesses over the period 2008-2015. Just 1.4 percent of firms obtain patents, but these patenting firms account for 87 percent of R&D investment. Firms consider utility patents less important than other forms of IP protection, like trade secrets, trademarks, and copyrights. Firm industry and size are strongly correlated with firms’ use of all types of intellectual property, but firm-age is not. Implications for innovation research and policy are discussed.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1818.abstract_zh: 本文利用2008-2015年间美国企业的大规模全国代表性调查数据，系统记录了企业如何寻求保护创新租金的一系列典型事实。仅有1.4%的企业获得专利，但这些专利企业却占据了研发投资的87%。企业认为实用专利的重要性低于其他形式的知识产权保护，如商业秘密、商标和版权。企业所属行业和规模与其使用各类知识产权的行为高度相关，但企业年龄则不然。本文讨论了这些发现对创新研究与政策制定的启示。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1818.title: Innovation, Patenting and Appropriability: Survey Evidence from a Nationally Representative Sample of U.S. Firms
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1818.title_zh: 创新、专利与专有性：基于美国企业全国代表性样本的调查证据

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1819.abstract: We examine the impact of firearm violence on newborn health in the U.S. using two approaches. First, we analyze the “beltway sniper” attacks in 2002, leveraging both temporal and spatial variation to compare birth outcomes of exposed children to those unexposed. Second, we investigate in-utero exposure to mass shootings using national data. We find that exposure to these incidents during pregnancy increases the likelihood of very low-birthweight and very premature birth. These events carry a significant economic burden, with the beltway sniper attacks costing at least $155 million and mass shootings resulting in annual costs exceeding $75 million.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1819.abstract_zh: 本文采用两种方法考察美国枪支暴力对新生儿健康的影响。首先，我们以2002年"环城狙击手"袭击事件为研究对象，利用时间与空间双重变异，比较受暴露儿童与未受暴露儿童的出生结局。其次，我们运用全国数据探究产前接触大规模枪击事件的影响。研究发现，孕期暴露于此类事件会显著增加极低出生体重和极早产的发生概率。这些事件带来沉重的经济负担——"环城狙击手"袭击事件至少造成1.55亿美元损失，而大规模枪击事件每年产生的成本超过7500万美元。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1819.title: The Hidden Cost of Firearm Violence on Infants in Utero
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1819.title_zh: 枪支暴力对胎儿期婴儿的隐性成本

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1820.abstract: Court capture in developing countries is pervasive, yet its economic effects remain underexplored. We study a Chinese reform that transferred financial and personnel authority over local courts from local to provincial governments. Exploiting the staggered roll-out, we find a 7.3% decline in local defendants’ win rates against non-local plaintiffs, alongside improved judicial quality. The reform encouraged smaller non-local firms to litigate and attracted non-local investment, potentially raising GDP by 1.9%. Yet favoritism toward politically connected firms and inter-provincial protectionism remain, and centralization itself promotes less qualified judges— revealing both its promise and limits.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1820.abstract_zh: 发展中国家法院被俘获的现象普遍存在，但其经济影响尚未得到充分研究。本文研究了中国一项将地方法院财政与人事管理权从地方政府转移至省级政府的改革。利用该改革分阶段推行的特点，我们发现本地被告对非本地原告的胜诉率下降7.3%，同时司法质量得到提升。改革鼓励小型非本地企业提起诉讼并吸引非本地投资，可能使GDP增长1.9%。然而，对政治关联企业的偏袒及省际保护主义依然存在，且集权化本身导致资质较弱的法官晋升——这既揭示了改革的成效，也暴露了其局限性。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1820.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1820.title: Court Capture, Local Protectionism, and Economic Integration: Evidence from China
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1820.title_zh: 法院俘获、地方保护主义与经济一体化：来自中国的证据

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1821.abstract: Televised debates between presidential candidates are often regarded as the exemplar of persuasive communication. Yet, recent evidence from Le Pennec and Pons (2023) indicates that they may not sway voters as strongly as popular belief suggests. We revisit their findings through the lens of the persuasion rate and introduce a robust framework that does not require exogenous treatment, parallel trends, or credible instruments. Instead, we leverage plausible monotonicity assumptions to partially identify the persuasion rate and related parameters. Our results reaffirm that the sharp upper bounds on the persuasive effects of TV debates remain modest.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1821.abstract_zh: 总统候选人之间的电视辩论常被视为说服性传播的典范。然而，Le Pennec与Pons（2023）的最新证据表明，这类辩论对选民的影响可能远不及普遍认知的那么强烈。我们通过说服率视角重新审视其研究发现，并引入一个无需外生处理、平行趋势或可信工具变量的稳健分析框架。取而代之的是，我们利用合理的单调性假设对说服率及相关参数进行部分识别。研究结果再次证实，电视辩论说服效应的严格上界仍然较为有限。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1821.title: Bounding the Effect of Persuasion with Monotonicity Assumptions: Reassessing the Impact of TV Debates
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1821.title_zh: 单调性假设下说服效应的边界：重新评估电视辩论的影响

doi:10.1162/rest.a.1822.abstract: This paper develops a semiparametric sieve approach to estimate impulse response functions of nonlinear time series models within a broad class of structural autoregressive specifications. A two-step procedure flexibly captures nonlinearities without imposing fixed parametric forms. We establish uniform estimation guarantees and propose an iterative algorithm that makes impulse response computation straightforward. Simulation results show robustness to misspecification with only modest efficiency losses. In an application to U.S. monetary policy, we find larger GDP responses to interest rate hikes than in linear models. We also examine oil supply news shocks of varying magnitudes to assess limitations when analyzing large shocks.
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1822.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种半参数筛分方法，用于在广泛的结构自回归模型类别中估计非线性时间序列模型的脉冲响应函数。该两步法无需设定固定参数形式，即可灵活捕捉非线性特征。我们建立了均匀估计保证，并提出一种迭代算法，使脉冲响应计算变得简便。模拟结果表明，该方法对模型误设具有稳健性，且仅带来适度的效率损失。在应用于美国货币政策时，我们发现利率上调对GDP的影响大于线性模型的结果。此外，我们考察了不同幅度的石油供给新闻冲击，以评估分析大规模冲击时的局限性。
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1822.title: Impulse Response Analysis of Structural Nonlinear Time Series Models
doi:10.1162/rest.a.1822.title_zh: 结构非线性时间序列模型的脉冲响应分析

doi:10.1162/rest_a_01405.abstract: This paper explores whether and why a maternal child penalty to earnings would emerge even without changes in employment and hours worked. Using a matched event study design, we trace monthly changes in determinants of wages (job performance, human capital accumulation, and promotions). Data come from a usefully unusual setting with required multiyear employment and detailed personnel data: the US Marine Corps. Mothers’ job performance initially declines, and gaps in promotion grow through 24 months postbirth. Fathers’ physical fitness performance drops somewhat but recovers. These patterns lead mothers to earn relatively lower wages, even absent changes in employment postbirth.
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01405.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了即使在就业和工作时长不变的情况下，母亲因育儿导致的收入惩罚是否会出现及其成因。通过匹配事件研究设计，我们追踪了工资决定因素（工作表现、人力资本积累和晋升）的月度变化。数据来源于一个具有特殊研究价值的场景——美国海军陆战队，该场景要求多年连续就业并提供详细人事数据。研究发现，母亲的工作表现最初出现下降，且晋升差距在产后24个月内持续扩大。父亲的身体素质表现虽有短暂下滑但随后恢复。这些模式导致母亲在产后即使就业状态未变，其相对工资水平仍有所降低。
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01405.title: Baby Bumps in the Road: The Impact of Parenthood on Job Performance, Human Capital, and Career Advancement
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01405.title_zh: 育儿路上的坎坷：为人父母对工作绩效、人力资本及职业晋升的影响

doi:10.1162/rest_a_01414.abstract: We study treatment-effect estimation using panel data. The treatment may be nonbinary, nonabsorbing, and the outcome may be affected by treatment lags. We make a parallel-trends assumption and propose event-study estimators of the effect of being exposed to a weakly higher treatment dose for ℓ periods. We also propose normalized estimators that estimate a weighted average of the effects of the current treatment and its lags. We also analyze commonly used two-way, fixed-effects regressions. Unlike our estimators, they can be biased in the presence of heterogeneous treatment effects. A local-projection version of those regressions is biased even with homogeneous effects.
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01414.abstract_zh: 本文利用面板数据研究处理效应估计。处理变量可能为非二元、非吸收性，且结果可能受到处理滞后期的影响。我们基于平行趋势假设，提出事件研究估计量，用于估计暴露于弱更高处理剂量持续ℓ期的效应。同时，我们提出标准化估计量，以估计当前处理效应及其滞后效应的加权平均值。此外，我们分析了常用的双向固定效应回归模型。与我们的估计量不同，这些模型在存在异质性处理效应时可能产生偏误。即使处理效应具有同质性，这些回归的局部投影版本仍存在偏误。
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01414.title: Difference-in-Differences Estimators of Intertemporal Treatment Effects
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01414.title_zh: 跨期处理效应的双重差分估计量

doi:10.1162/rest_a_01426.abstract: We study the influence of workplace peers on a high-stakes, irreversible retirement plan choice. Midcareer U.S. military personnel choose between higher future pension payouts or an immediate bonus plus lower future payouts. With peers defined as those who have locked in their choices and personnel assignment rules ensuring that peer groups are exogenously formed, we capture the causal impact of peers.
