Greater peer take-up of the bonus, which is difficult to compare to the alternative plan but often extremely costly over one’s lifetime, discourages choosers from selecting the bonus. Peers have special impact within professional, race, and gender groups.
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01426.abstract_zh: 我们研究了工作场所同伴对一项高风险的、不可逆的退休计划选择的影响。美国军队中的职业生涯中期人员需要在更高的未来养老金支付与即时奖金加较低的未来支付之间做出选择。我们将同伴定义为那些已经锁定自己选择的人员，并且由于人员分配规则确保了同伴群体是外生形成的，我们捕捉到了同伴的因果影响。同伴对奖金的接受率更高——尽管这种奖金与替代计划难以比较，且通常在一生中代价极高——会抑制选择者选择奖金。同伴在职业、种族和性别群体内具有特殊影响。
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01426.title: Information Transmission in Groups: Peer Influence in High-Stakes, Irreversible Financial Decisions
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01426.title_zh: 群体中的信息传递：高风险不可逆财务决策中的同伴影响

doi:10.1162/rest_a_01427.abstract: The US tax system allows taxpayers to deduct local taxes from their taxable incomes. Using school district referendum results, we employ a continuous treatment two-way fixed-effects framework to provide causal evidence of a positive relation between the demand for local public goods and the share of residents deducting local taxes. We find that a 1 percentage point decrease in the share of residents deducting property taxes reduces tax and bond referendum approval rates by approximately 0.97 percentage points. Because these federal tax deductions disproportionately benefit higher-income individuals, they potentially widen disparities in public service provision across jurisdictions.
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01427.abstract_zh: 美国税收制度允许纳税人从其应税收入中扣除地方税。利用学区公投结果，我们采用连续处理双向固定效应框架，为地方公共产品需求与居民地方税扣除比例之间的正相关关系提供了因果证据。研究发现，居民房产税扣除比例每下降1个百分点，税收和债券公投的通过率将降低约0.97个百分点。由于这些联邦税收扣除对高收入群体的惠及程度不成比例，它们可能加剧不同辖区之间公共服务供给的差距。
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01427.title: Federal Tax Deductions and the Demand for Local Public Goods
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01427.title_zh: 联邦税收减免与地方公共物品需求

doi:10.1162/rest_a_01428.abstract: This paper reports causal evidence on how the extent of hybrid work—the number of days worked from home relative to days worked from office—affects employee attitudes and performance. Workers who spent around two days in the office each week on average self-reported greater work-life balance, more job satisfaction, and lower isolation from colleagues compared to workers who spent more or fewer days in the office. Employees in the intermediate hybrid condition received no different performance ratings compared to peers who spent more or fewer days in the office.
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01428.abstract_zh: 本文报告了关于混合办公程度（即居家办公天数与办公室办公天数的比例）如何影响员工态度与绩效的因果证据。与每周在办公室工作天数更多或更少的员工相比，平均每周在办公室工作约两天的员工自我报告的工作与生活平衡度更高、工作满意度更高，且与同事的隔离感更低。处于中等混合办公条件下的员工，其绩效评级与每周在办公室工作天数更多或更少的同事相比并无显著差异。
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01428.title: Is Hybrid Work the Best of Both Worlds? Evidence from a Field Experiment
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01428.title_zh: 混合办公模式是否两全其美？来自田野实验的证据

doi:10.1162/rest_a_01438.abstract: This study examines the impact of school choice on academic achievement. I use differences in the number of schools across similar Romanian towns, generating variation in school choice for local students, who compete for seats via test scores. I find that more school choice results in increased sorting of students by admission scores across different schools. Sorting widens achievement gaps between high- and low-admission score students. High-scorers having access to better teachers and peer effects are the primary factors explaining these widening gaps. Last, between-school competition via school choice does not increase average achievement levels.
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01438.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨学校选择对学业成就的影响。利用罗马尼亚相似城镇间学校数量的差异，当地学生通过考试成绩竞争入学名额，由此产生学校选择的变化。研究发现，更多学校选择导致学生按录取分数在不同学校间的分层加剧。这种分层扩大了高、低录取分数学生之间的成就差距。高分数学生能够获得更优质的教师资源和同伴效应，这是解释差距扩大的主要因素。最后，学校间通过择校机制形成的竞争并未提升平均学业成就水平。
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01438.title: School Choice, Student Sorting, and Academic Performance
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01438.title_zh: 学校选择、学生分类与学业表现

doi:10.1162/rest_a_01441.abstract: This paper describes how to reparametrize low-dimensional factor models with one or two factors to fit weak identification theory developed for generalized method of moments models. Some identification-robust tests, here called “plug-in” tests, require a reparametrization to distinguish weakly identified parameters from strongly identified parameters. The reparametrizations in this paper make plug-in tests available for subvector hypotheses in low-dimensional factor models with one or two factors. Simulations show that the plug-in tests are less conservative than identification-robust tests that use the original parametrization. An empirical application to a factor model of parental investments in children is included.
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01441.abstract_zh: 本文阐述了如何对含有一个或两个因子的低维因子模型进行重新参数化，以适配为广义矩估计模型开发的弱识别理论。部分识别稳健性检验（此处称为"插件式"检验）需要通过重新参数化来区分弱识别参数与强识别参数。本文提出的重新参数化方法使得插件式检验能够应用于含有一个或两个因子的低维因子模型中的子向量假设。模拟结果表明，相较于使用原始参数化的识别稳健性检验，插件式检验的保守性更低。文中还包含一个关于父母对子女投资因子模型的实证应用案例。
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01441.title: Weak Identification in Low-Dimensional Factor Models with One or Two Factors
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01441.title_zh: 一或两个因子低维因子模型中的弱识别问题

doi:10.1162/rest_a_01442.abstract: We propose a quantitative spatial model featuring heterogeneous worker groups and their travel to consume nontradable goods and services. We consider the opening of the Downtown Line in Singapore, which connected regions where high-income households have residential amenities to where nontraded sectors are productive. Leveraging transit farecard data, we show that high-income workers saw large welfare gains but low-income workers gained little. Everyone enjoyed improved access to consumption opportunities, but low-income jobs in nontradables moved to less attractive workplaces. Abstracting from consumption travel understates the disparate impact across worker groups threefold.
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01442.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含异质性工人群体及其通勤消费非贸易商品与服务的定量空间模型。以新加坡市区线的开通为研究对象，该线路将高收入家庭享有居住便利性的区域与非贸易部门具有生产优势的区域相连接。基于交通票务数据，我们发现高收入工人获得了显著的福利提升，而低收入工人获益甚微。所有群体均享受到消费机会改善，但非贸易部门的低收入岗位转移至吸引力较低的工作场所。若忽略消费通勤因素，不同工人群体间的差异化影响将被低估三倍。
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01442.title: Urban Transit Infrastructure and Inequality
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01442.title_zh: 城市交通基础设施与不平等

doi:10.1162/rest_a_01444.abstract: Addressing climate change requires individual behavior change and voter support for pro-climate policies, yet surprisingly little is known about how to achieve these outcomes. In this paper, we estimate causal effects of additional education on pro-climate outcomes using new compulsory schooling law data across 20 European countries. We analyze effects on pro-climate beliefs and behaviors, as well as novel data on policy preferences and voting for green parties. Results show that a year of education substantially increases pro-climate beliefs, behaviors, and policy preferences.
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01444.abstract_zh: 应对气候变化需要个体行为改变以及选民对亲气候政策的支持，然而令人惊讶的是，关于如何实现这些目标的研究甚少。本文利用20个欧洲国家的新义务教育法数据，估算了额外教育对亲气候结果的因果效应。我们分析了教育对亲气候信念和行为的影响，并纳入了关于政策偏好和投票支持绿党的新数据。结果表明，每增加一年教育会显著提升亲气候信念、行为和政策偏好。
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01444.title: Human Capital and Climate Change

doi:10.1162/rest_a_01445.abstract: Does monetary policy influence who becomes a homeowner? Lower-income home buyers may be more sensitive to interest rates, at least in part because they more frequently come up against binding payment-to-income ratio constraints in credit decisions. Exploiting the timing of high-frequency observations of individual mortgage rate locks around monetary policy shocks, I find that a 1 percentage point policy-induced increase in mortgage rates lowers the presence of lower-income households in the population of home buyers by 1 to 2 percentage points immediately following the shock. Effects are substantially stronger among first-time home buyers and persist for approximately one year.
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01445.abstract_zh: 货币政策是否影响谁会成为房主？低收入购房者可能对利率更为敏感，至少部分原因在于他们在信贷决策中更频繁地面临严格的偿债收入比约束。利用货币政策冲击前后个人抵押贷款利率锁定的高频观测时机，我发现政策导致的抵押贷款利率每上升1个百分点，在冲击发生后立即会使购房者群体中低收入家庭的比例下降1至2个百分点。这一效应在首次购房者中尤为显著，并持续约一年时间。
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01445.title: Monetary Policy and Home Buying Inequality
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01445.title_zh: 货币政策与购房不平等

doi:10.1162/rest_a_01446.abstract: Between 1883 and 1919, Andrew Carnegie funded the construction of more than 1,500 public libraries across the United States, reducing the costs of accessing knowledge for millions. We study the effect of these libraries on innovation. Patenting in recipient places increased on average by 10%–12% in the 20 years following library construction relative to a novel control group of cities that applied for but did not build libraries. We show that access to scientific knowledge and increased collaboration opportunities are possible mechanisms.
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01446.abstract_zh: 1883年至1919年间，安德鲁·卡内基在美国资助建造了超过1500座公共图书馆，降低了数百万人获取知识的成本。我们研究了这些图书馆对创新的影响。与一组申请建造但未建成图书馆的新颖对照组城市相比，受资助地区在图书馆建成后的20年间，专利数量平均增长了10%–12%。研究表明，获取科学知识的机会增加以及合作机会的增多是可能的机制。
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01446.title: Knowledge Access: The Effects of Carnegie Libraries on Innovation
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01446.title_zh: 知识获取：卡内基图书馆对创新的影响

doi:10.1162/rest_a_01447.abstract: Women are underrepresented in patenting. In this study, we consider differential responsiveness to rejection as a contributor to the gender gap in invention. Leveraging the prosecution histories of almost one million U.S. patent applications and the quasirandom assignment of applications to examiners, we show that women are 3.6–6.9 percentage points less likely to continue in the application process following an early-stage rejection. Conditional on applying for a patent, male-female disparities in the propensity to abandon applications account for more than half of the overall gender gap in issued patents. We provide suggestive evidence that institutional support can help reduce the attrition gap.
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01447.abstract_zh: 女性在专利申请中的代表性不足。本研究将差异化的拒绝应对机制视为发明领域性别差距的一个促成因素。利用近百万份美国专利申请的审查历史以及申请案件准随机分配给审查员的机制，我们发现，在早期阶段遭遇驳回后，女性继续申请流程的可能性低3.6至6.9个百分点。在已提交专利申请的条件下，放弃申请倾向的性别差异解释了已授权专利总体性别差距的一半以上。我们提供的初步证据表明，制度性支持有助于缩小这一退出差距。
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01447.title: Attrition and the Gender Patenting Gap
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01447.title_zh: 流失率与性别专利差距

doi:10.1162/rest_a_01451.abstract: In markets with asymmetric information between sellers and buyers, feedback mechanisms are important to increase market efficiency and reduce the informational disadvantage of buyers. Feedback mechanisms might work because of self-selection of more trustworthy sellers into markets with such mechanisms or because of reputational concerns of sellers. We show in a field experiment how to disentangle self-selection from reputation effects. Based on 476 taxi rides with four different types of taxis, we find strong evidence for reputation effects but little support for self-selection effects. We discuss policy implications of our findings.
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01451.abstract_zh: 在卖方与买方信息不对称的市场中，反馈机制对于提升市场效率、减少买方信息劣势至关重要。反馈机制的有效性可能源于更值得信赖的卖方主动选择进入具备此类机制的市场（自选择效应），也可能源于卖方对声誉的考量（声誉效应）。我们通过一项实地实验，展示了如何区分自选择效应与声誉效应。基于对四种不同类型出租车进行的476次乘车实验，我们发现了支持声誉效应的有力证据，但几乎没有证据支持自选择效应。我们进一步讨论了研究结论的政策启示。
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01451.title: Disentangling Reputation from Selection Effects in Markets with Informational Asymmetries: A Field Experiment
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01451.title_zh: 信息不对称市场中声誉效应与选择效应的分离：一项田野实验

doi:10.1162/rest_a_01453.abstract: In 2001 a large and sustained supply shock halted a heroin epidemic in Australia. We use drug offenses to identify individual opioid users and examine how the shock affected their mortality risks and criminal activity over the next eight years. Initially, gains from fewer overdoses are offset by drug substitution and more crime, including homicides. Most adverse effects dissipate over time, whereas persistent mortality reductions save the lives of around one in 48 individuals in our sample. Our results demonstrate that reducing the supply of illicit opioids can lead to meaningful longer-term improvements, even when the short-term effects are ambiguous.
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01453.abstract_zh: 2001年，一场大规模且持续的供给冲击终结了澳大利亚的海洛因流行。我们利用毒品犯罪数据识别个体阿片类药物使用者，并考察了该冲击如何影响他们在随后八年间的死亡风险与犯罪活动。最初，过量用药减少带来的收益被药物替代及更多犯罪（包括凶杀案）所抵消。大多数不利影响随时间消散，而持续性的死亡率降低则挽救了样本中约每48人中的1条生命。我们的结果表明，即使短期效果尚不明确，减少非法阿片类药物的供给仍能带来有意义的长期改善。
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01453.title: Opioid Use, Mortality Risks and Crime: Insights from a Rapid Reduction in Heroin Supply
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01453.title_zh: 阿片类药物使用、死亡风险与犯罪：海洛因供应快速减少的启示

doi:10.1162/rest_a_01456.abstract: P-hacking is prevalent in reality but absent from classical hypothesis-testing theory. We therefore build a model of hypothesis testing that accounts for p-hacking. From the model, we derive critical values such that, if they are used to determine significance, and if p-hacking adjusts to the new significance standards, then spurious significant results do not occur more often than intended. Because of p-hacking, such robust critical values are larger than classical critical values. In the model calibrated to medical science, the robust critical value is the classical critical value for the same test statistic but with one-fifth of the significance level.
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01456.abstract_zh: P-hacking在现实中普遍存在，但经典假设检验理论却未将其纳入考量。为此，我们构建了一个考虑P-hacking的假设检验模型。基于该模型，我们推导出临界值：若以此临界值判定统计显著性，且P-hacking行为随新的显著性标准调整，则虚假显著结果的出现频率不会超过预期水平。由于P-hacking的存在，此类稳健临界值大于经典临界值。在基于医学科学校准的模型中，稳健临界值相当于同一检验统计量在显著性水平降至五分之一时的经典临界值。
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01456.title: Critical Values Robust to P-hacking

doi:10.1162/rest_a_01466.abstract: We present a new data set we built based on Swiss rich lists going back to 1989. We show, among other things, that 60% of the super-rich are heirs—a fraction twice as large as in the United States—and that wealth mobility at the very top has declined significantly. We find that top 0.01% wealth shares are higher than what previous estimates based on wealth tax statistics suggest. At the same time, we argue that rich list data lead to overestimating wealth inequality. Although rich lists are valuable to study the super-rich, we recommend using reported wealth figures with caution.
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01466.abstract_zh: 我们基于1989年以来的瑞士富豪榜单构建了一个全新数据集。研究发现，60%的超级富豪为继承财富者——这一比例是美国的两倍——且顶层财富流动性显著下降。我们发现，最富有的0.01%人群的财富份额高于此前基于财富税统计数据的估算结果。同时，我们认为富豪榜单数据会导致财富不平等程度被高估。尽管富豪榜单对研究超级富豪群体具有重要价值，但我们建议谨慎使用所报告的财富数据。
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01466.title: Using Rich Lists to Study the Super-Rich and Top Wealth Inequality: Insights from Switzerland
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01466.title_zh: 利用富豪榜研究超级富豪与顶层财富不平等：来自瑞士的启示

doi:10.1162/rest_a_01519.abstract: Using Chicago police data, we train a machine learning model to predict the risk of being shot in the next 18 months. Out-of-sample accuracy is strikingly high. A central concern with using police data is “baking in” bias, or overestimating risk for groups likelier to interact with police conditional on behavior. Our predictions, however, accurately recover risk across demographic groups. Legal, ethical, and practical barriers should prevent using victimization predictions to target law enforcement. But using them to target social services could increase both the potential for interventions to reduce shootings and the available statistical power to detect those reductions.
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01519.abstract_zh: 利用芝加哥警方数据，我们训练了一个机器学习模型，用于预测未来18个月内被枪击的风险。样本外预测准确度惊人地高。使用警方数据的一个核心担忧是“固化”偏见，即在行为条件相同的情况下，高估更可能与警方互动的群体的风险。然而，我们的预测准确还原了不同人口群体的风险水平。法律、伦理及实践障碍应阻止将受害风险预测用于执法目标锁定。但将其用于社会服务目标锁定，既能提升干预措施减少枪击事件的潜力，也能增强检测此类减少效果的统计效能。
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01519.title: Machine Learning Can Predict Shooting Victimization Well Enough to Help Prevent It
doi:10.1162/rest_a_01519.title_zh: 机器学习能够足够准确地预测枪击受害风险以助预防

doi:10.1257/aer.116.7.2299.title: Nobel Lecture: The Past and Future of Innovation: Can Progress Be Sustained?
doi:10.1257/aer.116.7.2299.title_zh: 诺贝尔演讲：创新的过去与未来——进步能否持续？

doi:10.1257/aer.116.7.2324.title: Nobel Lecture: The Economics of Creative Destruction
doi:10.1257/aer.116.7.2324.title_zh: 诺贝尔演讲：创造性破坏的经济学

doi:10.1257/aer.116.7.2357.title: Nobel Lecture: Creative Destruction and Economic Growth
doi:10.1257/aer.116.7.2357.title_zh: 诺贝尔演讲：创造性破坏与经济增长

doi:10.1257/aer.20220264.abstract: Most organizations rely on managers to identify talented workers. However, managers who are evaluated on team performance have an incentive to hoard workers. This study provides the first empirical evidence of talent hoarding using personnel records and survey evidence from a large firm. Talent hoarding is self-reported by three-fourths of managers, is detectable in manager ratings of worker talent, and occurs more frequently under stronger hoarding incentives, proxied by performance-related pay, team size, and talent visibility. Using quasi-random exposure to talent hoarding, I show that hoarding deters internal job applications, inhibiting career progression and altering talent allocation in the firm.
doi:10.1257/aer.20220264.abstract_zh: 大多数组织依赖管理者识别有才能的员工。然而，那些以团队绩效为考核标准的管理者，有动机囤积人才。本研究首次利用一家大型企业的人事档案和调查证据，提供了人才囤积的实证依据。四分之三的管理者自报存在人才囤积行为，这一现象在管理者对员工才能的评分中可被察觉，并且在囤积动机更强时（以绩效薪酬、团队规模和人才可见度为衡量指标）更为频繁。通过准随机暴露于人才囤积情境，本研究表明，囤积行为会抑制内部工作申请，阻碍职业发展，并改变企业内的人才配置。
doi:10.1257/aer.20220264.title: Talent Hoarding in Organizations
doi:10.1257/aer.20220264.title_zh: 组织中的人才囤积现象

doi:10.1257/aer.20221351.abstract: This paper develops an asset market-based test for preference for the timing of resolution of uncertainty. Our main theorem provides a characterization of preference for early resolution of uncertainty in terms of the risk premium realized during the period when the informativeness of macroeconomic announcements is resolved. Empirically, we find support for preference for early resolution of uncertainty based on evidence on the dynamics of the implied volatility of S&P 500 index options before Federal Open Market Committee announcements. (JEL D81, D83, G13, G14, G41)
doi:10.1257/aer.20221351.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一种基于资产市场的检验方法，用于评估不确定性解决时机偏好。核心定理表明，偏好不确定性尽早解决的特征可通过宏观经济公告信息释放期间所实现的风险溢价来刻画。基于联邦公开市场委员会公告发布前后标普500指数期权隐含波动率的动态证据，实证结果支持市场参与者存在偏好不确定性尽早解决的倾向。（JEL分类号：D81, D83, G13, G14, G41）
doi:10.1257/aer.20221351.title: Identifying Preference for Early Resolution from Asset Prices
doi:10.1257/aer.20221351.title_zh: 从资产价格中识别对早期解决的偏好

doi:10.1257/aer.20230017.abstract: Policy choices often create trade-offs between workers and consumers. I examine how foreign competition alters the consumer welfare and domestic employment effects of mergers. I construct a model incorporating consumer demand, endogenous product portfolios, and employment decisions. Applying the model to Whirlpool’s acquisition of Maytag in the appliance industry, I compare the observed merger to a counterfactual acquisition by a foreign buyer. Although Whirlpool’s acquisition decreased consumer welfare by $271 million annually, it preserved 797 domestic jobs. These jobs must therefore be valued at more than $344, 000 per year for the domestic employment benefits to offset the consumer harm. (JEL E24, F23, G34, J30, L13, L68, R23)
doi:10.1257/aer.20230017.abstract_zh: 政策选择往往在工人与消费者之间产生权衡。本文考察了外国竞争如何改变并购对消费者福利和国内就业的影响。我构建了一个包含消费者需求、内生产品组合和就业决策的模型。将该模型应用于家电行业惠而浦对美泰克的收购案例，我将实际发生的并购与外国买家收购的反事实情景进行了比较。尽管惠而浦的收购每年使消费者福利减少2.71亿美元，但保留了797个国内就业岗位。因此，要使国内就业收益抵消消费者损失，这些岗位的年价值必须超过34.4万美元。(JEL E24, F23, G34, J30, L13, L68, R23)
doi:10.1257/aer.20230017.title: Mergers, Foreign Competition, and Jobs: Evidence from the US Appliance Industry
doi:10.1257/aer.20230017.title_zh: 并购、外国竞争与就业：来自美国家电行业的证据

doi:10.1257/aer.20230242.abstract: We show that, depending on how the impact of omitted variables is measured, it can be substantially easier for omitted variables to flip coefficient signs than to drive them to zero. This behavior occurs with “Oster's delta” (Oster 2019a), a widely reported robustness measure. Consequently, any time this measure is large—suggesting omitted variables may be unimportant—a much smaller value reverses the sign of the parameter of interest. We propose a modified measure of robustness to address this concern. We illustrate our results in four empirical applications and two meta-analyses. We implement our methods in the companion Stata module “regsensitivity.” (JEL C18, C21, C52)
doi:10.1257/aer.20230242.abstract_zh: 我们证明，根据遗漏变量影响的衡量方式不同，遗漏变量翻转系数符号的难度可能远低于将其驱至零值的难度。这一现象出现在广泛使用的稳健性指标“奥斯特德尔塔”（Oster 2019a）中。因此，每当该指标数值较大（表明遗漏变量可能不重要）时，一个更小的数值即可使关注参数的符号发生反转。我们提出了一种修正的稳健性度量方法以解决此问题。我们在四项实证应用和两项元分析中展示了研究结果，并在配套的Stata模块“regsensitivity”中实现了相关方法。（JEL C18, C21, C52）
doi:10.1257/aer.20230242.title: The Effect of Omitted Variables on the Sign of Regression Coefficients
doi:10.1257/aer.20230242.title_zh: 遗漏变量对回归系数符号的影响

doi:10.1257/aer.20230344.abstract: I study how firm market power and worker bargaining power shape wages and welfare. Using French micro-data, I document patterns linking wages and firm market power that existing models cannot explain. A model in which firms produce vertically differentiated goods and share profits with workers explains those patterns. The model (i) reveals new challenges in estimating monopsony and bargaining power, proposing an alternative approach; (ii) shows that the passthrough of firm-specific shocks to wages depends on the type of shock; (iii) explains how markups shape firm wage premia; and (iv) formalizes how strengthening worker bargaining power affects wages and welfare. (JEL D22, J31, J42, J52, L12, L22)
doi:10.1257/aer.20230344.abstract_zh: 本文研究了企业市场势力与工人议价能力如何共同决定工资与福利。基于法国微观数据，我发现了现有模型无法解释的工资与企业市场势力之间的关联模式。通过构建一个企业生产垂直差异化产品并与工人分享利润的模型，这些模式得以解释。该模型：（i）揭示了估算买方垄断势力与议价能力面临的新挑战，并提出替代性方法；（ii）表明企业特定冲击向工资的传导效应取决于冲击类型；（iii）解释了加成率如何塑造企业工资溢价；（iv）形式化分析了增强工人议价能力对工资与福利的影响。（JEL D22, J31, J42, J52, L12, L22）
doi:10.1257/aer.20230344.title: Understanding High-Wage Firms: Monopoly, Monopsony, and Bargaining Power
doi:10.1257/aer.20230344.title_zh: 理解高工资企业：垄断、买方垄断与议价能力

doi:10.1257/aer.20230376.abstract: We evaluate equity-efficiency trade-offs from admissions quotas by examining effects on output once beneficiaries start producing in the relevant industry. We estimate the impact of abolishing a 40 percent quota for male primary school teachers on their pupils’ long-run outcomes. We combine this reform with the timing of union-bargained teacher retirements to isolate quasi-random variation in male quota teachers. Pupils exposed to male quota teachers transition more smoothly to postcompulsory education and have higher educational attainment and labor force attachment at age 25. Evidence suggests the quota improved the allocation of talent by mending imperfections in the unconstrained selection process. (JEL I21, I23, I28, J16, J24, J45)
doi:10.1257/aer.20230376.abstract_zh: 我们通过考察招生配额受益者在相关行业开始生产后的产出效应，评估了配额政策带来的公平与效率权衡。我们估算了废除小学男教师40%配额制度对学生长期发展的影响。通过将这项改革与工会协商的教师退休时间相结合，我们分离出配额制男教师的准随机变动。接触配额制男教师的学生在义务教育后阶段的过渡更为顺畅，且在25岁时拥有更高的教育成就和劳动力市场参与度。证据表明，该配额通过弥补无约束选拔过程中的缺陷，改善了人才配置效率。（JEL I21, I23, I28, J16, J24, J45）
doi:10.1257/aer.20230376.title: Quota versus Quality? Long-Term Gains from an Unusual Gender Quota
doi:10.1257/aer.20230376.title_zh: 配额还是质量？一项特殊性别配额的长期收益

doi:10.1257/aer.20230448.title: The Unequal Economic Consequences of Carbon Pricing
doi:10.1257/aer.20230448.title_zh: 碳定价的不平等经济后果

doi:10.1257/aer.20230541.abstract: This paper examines the effects of privatizing social health insurance. We exploit a natural experiment in Medicaid, wherein nearly 100,000 enrollees were randomly assigned between a publicly operated fee-for-service system and private managed care. Managed care reduced costs by 5.6 percent via cost-effective substitutions among prescription drugs and via lower prices for outpatient services. We present evidence that pharmacy utilization management was the key mechanism reducing overuse and encouraging substitution to lower-cost drugs without decreasing observed quality. In contrast, privatizing medical benefits led to only modest savings and was associated with decreased health care quality and consumer satisfaction. (JEL G22, H41, I13, I18, I38)
doi:10.1257/aer.20230541.abstract_zh: 本文研究了社会医疗保险私有化的影响。我们利用医疗补助计划中的一项自然实验，将近10万名参保者随机分配至公共运营的按服务收费体系与私人管理式医疗体系中。管理式医疗通过处方药的成本效益替代以及降低门诊服务价格，使成本降低了5.6%。我们提供的证据表明，药房利用管理是减少过度用药、鼓励替代为低成本药物且不降低可观测质量的关键机制。相比之下，医疗福利的私有化仅带来适度节约，且与医疗质量下降及消费者满意度降低相关。（JEL分类号：G22, H41, I13, I18, I38）
doi:10.1257/aer.20230541.title: The Private Provision of Public Services: Evidence from Random Assignment in Medicaid
doi:10.1257/aer.20230541.title_zh: 公共服务的私人提供：来自医疗补助随机分配的证据

doi:10.1257/aer.20230766.abstract: Item-level transactions data yield cost-of-living indices that can account for quality change and consumer substitution. Transactions data require confronting the rapid turnover of items because prices of new and existing products are interrelated in equilibrium. This paper evaluates multiple approaches to measuring quality change at scale. It shows that a hedonic superlative approach—using econometrics or machine learning for hedonic estimation combined with index formulas that require simultaneous observation of item-level price and expenditure—yields improved measures of the cost of living. Accounting for ubiquitous quality change and for consumer substitution yields lower measures of inflation than traditional, official methods. (JEL C43, C45, E31, L15, L81)
doi:10.1257/aer.20230766.abstract_zh: 基于项目级交易数据编制的居民消费价格指数，能够反映质量变化与消费者替代行为。由于均衡状态下新旧产品价格相互关联，交易数据需应对项目快速更替的挑战。本文评估了多种大规模质量变化测算方法，研究表明：采用计量经济学或机器学习进行特征价格估计，并结合需同步观测项目级价格与支出的指数公式，所构建的特征价格超优指数能更精准地衡量生活成本。相较于传统官方统计方法，将普遍存在的质量变化与消费者替代行为纳入考量后，通胀测算结果显著降低。（JEL分类号：C43, C45, E31, L15, L81）
doi:10.1257/aer.20230766.title: Quality Adjustment at Scale: Hedonic versus Exact Demand-Based Price Indices
doi:10.1257/aer.20230766.title_zh: 大规模质量调整：享乐指数与精确需求价格指数

doi:10.1257/aer.20230768.abstract: Designing public transport networks involves trade-offs between coverage, service frequency, and direct service. We use the expansion of the bus system in Jakarta, Indonesia, to study these trade-offs. We analyze how new direct connections, changes in bus travel time, and wait time reductions affect bus ridership and aggregate flows, and estimate a transit network demand model by matching the route launch events. Commuters in Jakarta are 2-3 times more sensitive to wait time than bus time, and inattentive to long routes. We develop a flexible framework to characterize optimal networks. A less concentrated network would increase ridership and commuter welfare.
doi:10.1257/aer.20230768.abstract_zh: 设计公共交通网络需要在覆盖范围、服务频率与直达服务之间进行权衡。我们以印度尼西亚雅加达公交系统的扩张为例，研究这些权衡关系。通过分析新增直达线路、公交出行时间变化以及等待时间缩短对公交客流量和总体客流的影响，并利用线路开通事件匹配数据估算交通网络需求模型。研究发现：雅加达通勤者对等待时间的敏感度是公交行驶时间的2-3倍，且对长距离线路关注度较低。我们构建了一个灵活的分析框架来刻画最优网络特征，结果表明：降低网络集中度将有助于提升客流量与通勤者福利。
doi:10.1257/aer.20230768.title: Optimal Public Transportation Networks: Evidence from the World’s Largest Bus Rapid Transit System in Jakarta
doi:10.1257/aer.20230768.title_zh: 最优公共交通网络：来自雅加达全球最大快速公交系统的证据

doi:10.1257/aer.20230802.abstract: Do elite colleges help talented students join the social elite or help incumbent elites retain their positions? We combine intergenerationally linked data from Chile with a regression discontinuity design to show that, looking across generations, elite colleges do both. Lower-status individuals who gain admission to elite college programs transform their children’s social environment. Children become more likely to attend high-status private schools and colleges and to live near and befriend high-status peers. In contrast, academic achievement is unaffected. Simulations combining descriptive and quasi-experimental findings show that elite colleges tighten the link between social and human capital while decreasing intergenerational social mobility. (JEL I23, I26, J24, J62, O15, Z13)
doi:10.1257/aer.20230802.abstract_zh: 精英大学是帮助有才华的学生跻身社会精英阶层，还是帮助现有精英维持其地位？我们结合智利的代际关联数据与断点回归设计发现，从代际视角来看，精英大学同时发挥了这两种作用。获得精英大学项目录取资格的低社会地位个体，其子女的社会环境发生了转变：子女更有可能进入高地位私立学校与大学，并与高地位同龄人居住相邻或建立友谊。相比之下，学业成绩并未受到影响。结合描述性与准实验研究结果的模拟分析表明，精英大学在降低代际社会流动性的同时，强化了社会资本与人力资本之间的关联。（JEL I23, I26, J24, J62, O15, Z13）
doi:10.1257/aer.20230802.title: Elite Universities and the Intergenerational Transmission of Human and Social Capital
doi:10.1257/aer.20230802.title_zh: 精英大学与人力资本和社会资本的代际传递

doi:10.1257/aer.20230849.abstract: We use firm-level data to document that private businesses experience large fluctuations in their profit shares. These are due to large, fat-tailed, and transitory changes in output that are not fully accompanied by changes in their inputs. We interpret this evidence using a model of entrepreneurial dynamics. Because firms can limit their exposure to risk by operating at a smaller scale, our model predicts large macroeconomic losses from uninsurable business risk, much larger than those stemming from credit constraints. While self-financing allows entrepreneurs to quickly overcome credit constraints, even wealthy entrepreneurs remain considerably exposed to risk. (JEL D33, E02, E44, G32, L25, L26)
doi:10.1257/aer.20230849.abstract_zh: 我们利用企业层面数据证明，私营企业的利润份额存在大幅波动。这种波动源于产出的大规模、厚尾且暂时性的变化，而这些变化并未完全伴随投入要素的同步调整。我们通过构建企业家动态模型来解释这一现象。由于企业可通过缩小经营规模来限制风险敞口，模型预测不可保商业风险将导致巨大的宏观经济损失——其规模远超信贷约束造成的损失。虽然自我融资能使企业家快速克服信贷约束，但即便是富裕的企业家仍面临显著的风险敞口。（JEL分类号：D33, E02, E44, G32, L25, L26）
doi:10.1257/aer.20230849.title: The Aggregate Costs of Uninsurable Business Risk
doi:10.1257/aer.20230849.title_zh: 不可保险商业风险的总体成本

doi:10.1257/aer.20231344.abstract: We examine how social interactions and friendships shape students’ political opinions in a natural experiment at Sciences Po, a leading French university specializing in social and political sciences. The quasi-random assignment of students into short-term integration groups before their academic curriculum reduces political opinion gaps and fosters friendship formation. Using same-group membership as an instrumental variable for friendship, we find that friendship reduces opinion differences by 44 percent of the mean opinion gap. Our evidence supports a homophily-enforced mechanism: Friendships form among initially politically similar students, leading them to join political associations together, reinforcing their similarity. (JEL C93, D72, Z13)
doi:10.1257/aer.20231344.abstract_zh: 我们通过法国顶尖社会科学与政治学府——巴黎政治学院的一项自然实验，考察社会互动与友谊如何塑造学生的政治观点。学生在学术课程开始前被准随机分配至短期融合小组，这一机制缩小了政治观点差距并促进了友谊形成。以同组归属作为友谊的工具变量，我们发现友谊使观点差异缩小了平均差距的44%。研究证据支持一种同质性强化机制：友谊最初在政治立场相近的学生间形成，促使他们共同加入政治社团，从而进一步强化其观点相似性。（JEL C93, D72, Z13）
doi:10.1257/aer.20231344.title: Friendship Networks and Political Opinions

doi:10.1257/aer.20231368.abstract: We study racial disparities in promotions in a setting in which promotions are formulaic: the US patent office. Using detailed administrative data that allow us to observe who is eligible for promotion when, we document that Black patent examiners experience delays in promotions they are entitled to, slowing their climb to the top of the career ladder by a year and reducing career earnings by 2.9%. Institutional features rule out statistical discrimination with accurate priors. Slow promotions even under Black supervisors argue against taste-based animus. Instead, the patterns fit models of belief-based discrimination.
doi:10.1257/aer.20231368.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在晋升流程高度程式化的情境——美国专利局——中存在的种族晋升差异。利用详尽的行政数据，我们得以观察特定时间点符合晋升条件的群体，发现黑人专利审查员在应得晋升中遭遇延迟，导致其职业阶梯顶端晋升速度放缓一年，职业生涯收入减少2.9%。制度特征排除了基于准确先验信息的统计性歧视。即使在黑人主管领导下仍存在晋升缓慢现象，这否定了基于偏好的歧视解释。相反，这些模式符合基于信念的歧视模型。
doi:10.1257/aer.20231368.title: Racial Promotion Gaps

doi:10.1257/aer.20231414.abstract: Relative to remote work, working downtown facilitates valuable interactions with other in-office workers, but entails commuting costs. The resulting coordination mechanism can lead to multiple stationary equilibria with varying levels of remote work. Temporary reductions in commuters, as in the COVID-19 pandemic, can then lead to persistently large fractions of remote workers. Cellphone- based mobility data for the U.S. shows that commuting trips in the largest cities, which are more likely to exhibit multiplicity, have stabilized at only 60% of pre-pandemic levels, while they are fully back in smaller cities. Cities with permanently low commuting experience average welfare losses of 2.3%.
doi:10.1257/aer.20231414.abstract_zh: 相较于远程办公，市中心工作虽能促进与其他在岗员工的有价值互动，但需承担通勤成本。由此产生的协调机制可能导致远程办公比例不同的多重稳态均衡。如同新冠疫情期间出现的通勤者暂时性减少，可能引发远程工作者比例持续高企的现象。基于美国手机信令数据的流动性研究表明，更易呈现多重均衡特征的大型城市通勤出行量仅恢复至疫情前水平的60%，而小型城市已完全恢复。通勤量持续低迷的城市平均福利损失达2.3%。
doi:10.1257/aer.20231414.title: Remote Work and City Structure

doi:10.1257/aer.20231415.abstract: Moretti (2021) reports a positive elasticity between technology cluster size and patenting, and uses an event study and instrumental variables regressions to justify a causal interpretation. The event study does not use the variation generated by inventors moving across cities, and the instrument is constructed incorrectly due to a coding error. I run a corrected event study and fix the coding error, and find null effects. The reported elasticity may not be causal. (JEL J24, L60, O31, O34, R32)
doi:10.1257/aer.20231415.abstract_zh: Moretti（2021）报告了技术集群规模与专利产出之间的正向弹性，并通过事件研究和工具变量回归论证了因果解释。然而，该事件研究未利用发明人在城市间流动产生的变异，且由于编码错误导致工具变量构建有误。我重新进行了修正的事件研究并纠正了编码错误，发现效应为零。因此，所报告的弹性可能并非因果关系。（JEL J24, L60, O31, O34, R32）
doi:10.1257/aer.20231415.title: The Effect of High-Tech Clusters on the Productivity of Top Inventors: Comment
doi:10.1257/aer.20231415.title_zh: 高科技集群对顶尖发明者生产率的影响：评论

doi:10.1257/aer.20231486.abstract: In general, finding the optimal combination among N items requires evaluating all 2^N possibilities. We develop a method applicable whenever items are complements or substitutes that uses this structure to discard suboptimal combinations without evaluation and extends to heterogeneous-agent environments. In a calibrated general equilibrium model of multinational firms choosing interdependent production locations, we show the method is orders of magnitude faster than incumbent approaches and avoids error from discretizing firm heterogeneity. Quantitatively, whether production locations are complements or substitutes determines whether welfare gains from multinational production concentrate in the most productive countries or accrue more broadly.
doi:10.1257/aer.20231486.abstract_zh: 一般而言，从N个选项中寻找最优组合需要评估全部2^N种可能性。我们提出了一种适用于互补品或替代品情形的方法，该方法利用这种结构在不进行评估的情况下剔除次优组合，并可推广至异质性主体环境。在跨国企业选择相互依赖的生产地点的校准一般均衡模型中，我们证明该方法比现有方法快数个数量级，且避免了因离散化企业异质性而产生的误差。从定量角度看，生产地点是互补品还是替代品，决定了跨国生产带来的福利收益是集中于最具生产力的国家，还是更广泛地惠及各国。
doi:10.1257/aer.20231486.title: Combinatorial Discrete Choice: Theory and Application to Multinational Production
doi:10.1257/aer.20231486.title_zh: 组合离散选择：理论与跨国生产中的应用

doi:10.1257/aer.20231521.abstract: Preschool-aged children get sick frequently and spread disease to other family members. Despite the universality of this experience, there is limited causal evidence on the magnitudes and consequences of these externalities, especially for infant siblings with developing immune systems and brains. We show in Danish administrative data that during infancy, younger siblings have two to three times higher hospitalization rates for respiratory conditions than older siblings. We combine birth order and within-municipality variation in respiratory disease prevalence among young children, finding lasting differential impacts of early-life respiratory disease exposure on younger siblings' earnings, educational attainment, chronic respiratory health, and mental health-related outcomes. (JEL D13, D62, I12, J12, J13, J24, J31)
doi:10.1257/aer.20231521.abstract_zh: 学龄前儿童易患疾病，并会将疾病传播给其他家庭成员。尽管这一经历具有普遍性，但关于这些外部性的程度和后果的因果证据仍然有限，尤其是对于免疫系统和大脑正在发育的婴儿兄弟姐妹而言。我们利用丹麦行政数据发现，在婴儿期，弟弟妹妹因呼吸系统疾病的住院率是哥哥姐姐的两到三倍。我们结合出生顺序以及学龄前儿童呼吸系统疾病患病率的市内差异，发现早期呼吸系统疾病暴露对弟弟妹妹的收入、教育程度、慢性呼吸系统健康以及心理健康相关结果产生了持久的差异化影响。（JEL D13, D62, I12, J12, J13, J24, J31）
doi:10.1257/aer.20231521.title: Germs in the Family: The Short- and Long-Term Consequences of Intrahousehold Disease Spread
doi:10.1257/aer.20231521.title_zh: 家庭中的病菌：家庭内部疾病传播的短期与长期后果

doi:10.1257/aer.20231613.abstract: Lack of market transparency can impair the liquidity provision of nonstandard liquidity suppliers and make liquidity demand increasing in illiquidity. This can yield strategic complementarities and induce multiple equilibria. Then an initial dearth of liquidity may degenerate into a liquidity rout (as in a “flash crash”), and traders faced with the largest cost of trading are those trading more intensely at equilibrium. An increase in order flow transparency and/or in the mass of dealers who are in the market at all times has a positive impact on total welfare. (JEL G12, G14, G41)
doi:10.1257/aer.20231613.abstract_zh: 市场透明度不足会削弱非标准化流动性供应商的流动性供给能力，并导致流动性需求随非流动性程度上升而增加。这可能产生策略互补性并引发多重均衡。此时，初始流动性匮乏可能恶化为流动性崩溃（如"闪崩"现象），而均衡状态下交易最频繁的交易者反而面临最高的交易成本。提高订单流透明度和/或增加始终活跃于市场的交易商数量，将对总福利产生积极影响。（JEL分类号：G12, G14, G41）
doi:10.1257/aer.20231613.title: Market Opacity and Fragility: Why Liquidity Evaporates When It Is Most Needed
doi:10.1257/aer.20231613.title_zh: 市场不透明性与脆弱性：为何流动性在最需要时消失

doi:10.1257/aer.20231696.abstract: We study how public sector workers balance their professional motivations with private economic concerns, focusing on police arrests. Arrests made near the end of an officer's shift typically require overtime work, and officers respond by reducing arrest frequency but increasing arrest quality. Days in which an officer works a second job after their police shift have higher opportunity cost, also reducing late-shift arrests. Combining our estimates in a dynamic model identifies officer preferences over workplace activity and overtime work. Our results indicate that officers' private costs of arrests have a first-order impact on the quantity and quality of enforcement.
doi:10.1257/aer.20231696.abstract_zh: 我们研究公共部门工作人员如何在职业动机与个人经济考量之间取得平衡，重点关注警察逮捕行为。在警官轮班临近结束时进行的逮捕通常需要加班，而警官对此的应对方式是降低逮捕频率但提高逮捕质量。当警官在警察轮班后还需从事第二份工作的日子里，机会成本更高，这同样减少了轮班末段的逮捕数量。通过将我们的估计结果纳入动态模型，可以识别出警官对工作场所活动及加班工作的偏好。研究结果表明，警官的私人逮捕成本对执法的数量与质量具有首要影响。
doi:10.1257/aer.20231696.title: Professional Motivations in the Public Sector: Evidence from Police Officers
doi:10.1257/aer.20231696.title_zh: 公共部门的职业动机：来自警察的证据

doi:10.1257/aer.20231699.abstract: Conflict along transportation routes during Somalia’s al-Shabaab insurgency significantly increases maize prices at distant locations, decreasing food security, health, and education. Estimated conflict risk has strong price effects independently of realized conflict, highlighting the importance of safety concerns. A model of least-cost route choice in the presence of conflict reveals that more and shorter alternative routes to circumvent conflict can lower prices but their effectiveness diminishes as violence becomes more correlated across routes. Alternatively, securing key transportation routes would alleviate price increases. A market access approach suggests spatial spillovers of conflict also matter for prices of more general baskets of food and nonfood items. (JEL D74, I15, I25, O15, O17, Q11, R41)
doi:10.1257/aer.20231699.abstract_zh: 索马里青年党叛乱期间，运输路线上的冲突显著抬高了偏远地区的玉米价格，进而削弱了粮食安全、健康与教育水平。冲突风险的估计值独立于已发生的冲突本身，对价格产生强烈影响，凸显了安全关切的重要性。基于冲突环境下最低成本路线选择模型的分析表明：增加更多且更短的替代路线以规避冲突可降低价格，但随着暴力事件在路线间的相关性增强，其效果逐渐减弱。另一种方案是保障关键运输路线的安全，这将有效缓解价格上涨。市场准入分析进一步揭示，冲突的空间溢出效应同样影响更广泛的食品与非食品类商品价格。（JEL分类号：D74, I15, I25, O15, O17, Q11, R41）
doi:10.1257/aer.20231699.title: Spatial Spillovers of Conflict in Somalia
doi:10.1257/aer.20231699.title_zh: 索马里冲突的空间溢出效应

doi:10.1257/aer.20240056.abstract: This paper studies how managers plan under uncertainty. In a new panel survey of German manufacturing firms, we observe both forecasts of sales growth and a quantitative measure of subjective uncertainty. We show that subjective uncertainty reflects change experienced by firms: it is high when growth is either unusually low or unusually high. Subjective uncertainty is more than conditional volatility: while more volatile firms are typically more uncertain, experienced change alone increases uncertainty, consistent with a model of learning. Uncertainty over our sample is mostly idiosyncratic but varies substantially over time and leads managers to plan lower employment and prices.
doi:10.1257/aer.20240056.abstract_zh: 本文研究管理者如何在不确定性下进行规划。基于一项针对德国制造业企业的新面板调查，我们同时观测到销售增长预测与主观不确定性的量化指标。研究表明，主观不确定性反映了企业经历的变化：当增长率异常低或异常高时，不确定性均会上升。主观不确定性不仅体现为条件波动性：尽管波动性较高的企业通常面临更大不确定性，但仅凭经历的变化本身就会加剧不确定性，这与学习模型的理论预测一致。样本期间的不确定性主要呈现异质性特征，但随时间显著波动，并促使管理者制定更低的就业与价格计划。
doi:10.1257/aer.20240056.title: Uncertainty and Change: Survey Evidence of Firms’ Subjective Beliefs
doi:10.1257/aer.20240056.title_zh: 不确定性与变化：企业主观信念的调查证据

doi:10.1257/aer.20240094.abstract: Natural gas has replaced coal as the dominant fuel for U.S. electricity generation. However, utilities in regulated U.S. states have retired coal more slowly than others. We build a structural model of rate-of-return regulation during an energy transition where utilities face tradeoffs between lowering costs and maintaining and using legacy capacity. A regulated utility facing carbon taxes lowers short-run coal generation 48% as much as a cost minimizer would. Thirty years after a sudden energy transition, a cost minimizer has retired 71% more coal capacity than the regulated utility. Alternative regulations may jeopardize affordability and reliability goals during energy transitions.
doi:10.1257/aer.20240094.abstract_zh: 天然气已取代煤炭成为美国发电的主要燃料。然而，受监管的美国各州公用事业公司淘汰煤炭的速度慢于其他地区。我们构建了一个能源转型期间回报率监管的结构模型，其中公用事业公司在降低成本与维持及使用遗留产能之间面临权衡。面对碳税的受监管公用事业公司，其短期煤炭发电量降幅仅为成本最小化公司的48%。在突发能源转型30年后，成本最小化公司淘汰的煤炭产能比受监管公用事业公司多71%。替代性监管措施可能在能源转型期间危及可负担性与可靠性目标。
doi:10.1257/aer.20240094.title: Energy Transitions in Regulated Markets
doi:10.1257/aer.20240094.title_zh: 监管市场中的能源转型

doi:10.1257/aer.20240179.title: Residential Segregation and Unequal Access to Local Public Services in India: Evidence from 1.5 Million Neighborhoods
doi:10.1257/aer.20240179.title_zh: 印度居住隔离与地方公共服务获取不平等：来自150万邻里的证据

doi:10.1257/aer.20240393.title: Fighting for Growth: Labor Scarcity and Technological Progress During the British Industrial Revolution
doi:10.1257/aer.20240393.title_zh: 为增长而战：英国工业革命时期的劳动力稀缺与技术进步

doi:10.1257/aer.20240404.abstract: We study the effects of the largest corporate income tax cut in U.S. history on firms and workers. To identify causal effects, we use employer-employee matched tax records and event studies comparing similarly sized firms in the same industry that faced divergent tax changes due to their pre-existing legal status. Tax cuts cause increases in firms’ investment, sales, profits, employment, and payrolls, with earnings gains concentrated among highly paid workers. In the short-run, 87% of private income gains flow to the top 10% of the income distribution.
doi:10.1257/aer.20240404.abstract_zh: 我们研究了美国历史上最大规模的企业所得税削减对企业和工人的影响。为识别因果效应，我们使用了雇主-雇员匹配的税务记录，并通过事件研究法比较同一行业中规模相近但因既有法律地位不同而面临不同税收变化的企业。减税导致企业投资、销售额、利润、就业和工资总额增加，但收入增长主要集中在高薪工人群体。短期内，私人收入增长的87%流向了收入分布前10%的人群。
doi:10.1257/aer.20240404.title: Corporate Tax Cuts, Firm Growth, and Workers’ Earnings
doi:10.1257/aer.20240404.title_zh: 企业减税、企业增长与工人收入

doi:10.1257/aer.20240497.abstract: We document the effects of a comprehensive set of mergers of US consumer packaged goods manufacturers on prices, quantities, and product assortment. Across specifications, we find a small average price effect of mergers (-0.5% to 1.1%) but substantial heterogeneity in effects, with a standard deviation between 3.9–7.6 pp. Through a model of enforcement, we find that agencies act as if they challenge mergers they expect would increase prices more than 4.8–6.3%. Increases in stringency would reduce prices and the prevalence of completed price-increasing mergers, with minimal impacts on blocked price-decreasing mergers, at a significantly greater agency burden.
doi:10.1257/aer.20240497.abstract_zh: 本文记录了一组美国消费品制造商全面并购对价格、数量及产品组合的影响。在多种实证设定下，我们发现并购的平均价格效应较小（-0.5%至1.1%），但效应存在显著异质性，标准差介于3.9至7.6个百分点之间。通过执法模型分析，我们发现监管机构的行为模式表明，它们倾向于挑战预期价格涨幅超过4.8%至6.3%的并购。提高执法严格程度将降低价格水平及已完成的价格上涨型并购的普遍性，同时对被阻止的价格下降型并购影响甚微，但会显著增加监管机构的负担。
doi:10.1257/aer.20240497.title: Merger Effects and Antitrust Enforcement: Evidence from US Consumer Packaged Goods
doi:10.1257/aer.20240497.title_zh: 并购效应与反垄断执法：来自美国包装消费品行业的证据

doi:10.1257/aer.20240576.abstract: A designer employs a dynamic protocol to elicit private information. Protocols produce a set of contextual privacy violations— information learned that may be superfluous given the context. A protocol is maximally contextually private if there is no protocol that produces a proper subset of the violations it produces, while implementing the choice rule. Contextual privacy violations arise when a choice rule makes some agents collectively, but not individually, pivotal. In auctions, designing for contextual privacy requires choosing an initial question posed to each agent and the order for querying agents. Ascending-join protocols are maximally contextually private for k-item Vickrey auctions.
doi:10.1257/aer.20240576.abstract_zh: 设计者采用动态协议来获取私人信息。协议会产生一系列情境性隐私侵犯——即在特定情境下可能属于多余的信息被获知。若不存在其他协议能在实现选择规则的同时，产生该协议所引发侵犯行为的真子集，则该协议具有最大情境隐私性。当选择规则使某些代理人集体成为关键角色（而非个体关键角色）时，便会产生情境性隐私侵犯。在拍卖中，实现情境隐私性设计需要确定向每位代理人提出的初始问题及询问代理人的顺序。对于k物品维克里拍卖而言，升序接入协议具有最大情境隐私性。
doi:10.1257/aer.20240576.title: Contextually Private Mechanisms

doi:10.1257/aer.20240617.abstract: We study the problem of designing a dynamic reassignment mechanism when agents’ preferences over objects change over time. In the context of Norway’s system for (re)assigning patients to general practitioners (GPs), we provide direct evidence of misallocation under the current mechanism—patients waiting for each others’ GPs, but who cannot trade—and estimate a structural model of GP switching behavior to evaluate alternatives. Introducing Top Trading Cycles (TTC) would, on average, reduce waiting times and increase patient welfare. However, patients endowed with less desirable GPs would be harmed. Prioritizing these patients can avoid these harms while preserving most of the gains from TTC.
doi:10.1257/aer.20240617.abstract_zh: 本文研究当主体对对象的偏好随时间变化时，如何设计动态再分配机制。以挪威全科医生（GP）患者（重新）分配系统为背景，我们提供了当前机制下资源错配的直接证据——患者相互等待对方的全科医生却无法进行交换——并估计了全科医生转换行为的结构模型以评估替代方案。引入顶级交易循环（TTC）机制平均而言将缩短等待时间并提高患者福利。然而，被分配到较不理想全科医生的患者将受到损害。优先考虑这些患者可以避免此类损害，同时保留TTC机制的大部分收益。
doi:10.1257/aer.20240617.title: Designing Dynamic Reassignment Mechanisms: Evidence from GP Allocation
doi:10.1257/aer.20240617.title_zh: 设计动态再分配机制：来自全科医生分配的实证证据

doi:10.1257/aer.20240642.abstract: We show that in heterogeneous agent New Keynesian (HANK) economies with countercyclical risk, the natural interest rate is endogenous and co-moves with output, leaving the economy susceptible to self-fulfilling fluctuations. Unlike in representative agent New Keynesian models, the Taylor principle is not sufficient to guarantee uniqueness of equilibrium in HANK if risk is even mildly countercyclical: Multiple bounded equilibria exist, no matter how strongly monetary policy responds to changes in inflation. For an active monetary policy to eliminate self-fulfilling fluctuations, it must stabilize the endogenous natural rate fluctuations. Alternatively, a passive monetary and active fiscal regime can also eliminate equilibrium multiplicity. (JEL E12, E23, E31, E32, E43, E52, E62)
doi:10.1257/aer.20240642.abstract_zh: 我们证明，在具有逆周期风险的异质性代理人新凯恩斯（HANK）经济体中，自然利率是内生的，并与产出共同变动，从而使经济容易受到自我实现的波动影响。与代表性代理人新凯恩斯模型不同，如果风险即使只是轻微逆周期，泰勒原理不足以保证HANK中均衡的唯一性：无论货币政策对通胀变化的反应有多强烈，都存在多个有界均衡。要使积极的货币政策消除自我实现的波动，必须稳定内生的自然利率波动。或者，被动的货币政策和积极的财政政策体制也能消除均衡的多重性。（JEL E12, E23, E31, E32, E43, E52, E62）
doi:10.1257/aer.20240642.title: Self-Fulfilling Fluctuations in HANK Economies
doi:10.1257/aer.20240642.title_zh: HANK经济中的自我实现波动

doi:10.1257/aer.20240651.abstract: This paper develops a dynamic model of the attention economy featuring two interlinked markets: a product market, where consumers have limited awareness of firms, and an attention market, where platforms attract attention by investing in free services (e.g., social media, streaming, podcasts) and sell targeted ads using data on consumer preferences. The model provides a tractable framework in which platform investment, ad-driven discovery, product demand, and ad revenue are jointly determined. The effects of data and interoperability policies can reverse over time, platform quality may be inefficiently high or low, and the rise of data-rich digital advertising can coincide with a declining ad revenue-to-GDP ratio.
doi:10.1257/aer.20240651.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个注意力经济的动态模型，该模型包含两个相互关联的市场：产品市场（消费者对企业的认知有限）和注意力市场（平台通过投资免费服务（如社交媒体、流媒体、播客）吸引注意力，并利用消费者偏好数据销售定向广告）。该模型提供了一个易于处理的框架，其中平台投资、广告驱动的发现、产品需求和广告收入是共同决定的。数据与互操作性政策的效果可能随时间逆转，平台质量可能处于低效的高或低水平，而数据丰富的数字广告的兴起可能与广告收入占GDP比重的下降同时发生。
doi:10.1257/aer.20240651.title: A Model of the Attention Economy: Data, Platforms, and Discovery
doi:10.1257/aer.20240651.title_zh: 注意力经济模型：数据、平台与发现

doi:10.1257/aer.20240664.abstract: Efficient risk-sharing implies a simple factor structure for marginal utilities of expenditure (MUEs): Pareto weights divided by a common price. The standard approach infers MUEs from total expenditures, implicitly assuming homothetic preferences, unitary income elasticities, and identical price elasticities. Risk-sharing tests using total expenditures work for idiosyncratic shocks (budgets change, but not prices), but not “covariate” shocks (prices change). We describe all preferences which permit one to infer MUEs from expenditures, and estimate nonhomothetic MUEs to test whether covariate shocks are shared efficiently in Uganda. This delivers sensible results; the standard approach suggests that droughts, floods, and pests are beneficial.
doi:10.1257/aer.20240664.abstract_zh: 有效风险分担意味着支出边际效用（MUEs）存在一个简单的因子结构：帕累托权重除以共同价格。标准方法通过总支出推断MUEs，隐含假设了同质性偏好、单位收入弹性以及相同的价格弹性。基于总支出的风险分担检验适用于异质性冲击（预算变化，但价格不变），但不适用于“协变量”冲击（价格变化）。我们描述了所有允许从支出推断MUEs的偏好类型，并估计了非同质性MUEs，以检验乌干达的协变量冲击是否得到有效分担。这一方法得出了合理的结果；而标准方法则暗示干旱、洪水和虫害是有益的。
doi:10.1257/aer.20240664.title: Risk Sharing Tests and Covariate Shocks: Drought, Floods, and Pests in Uganda
doi:10.1257/aer.20240664.title_zh: 风险分担检验与协变量冲击：乌干达的干旱、洪涝与虫害

doi:10.1257/aer.20240666.title: Durables and the Marginal Propensity to Spend
doi:10.1257/aer.20240666.title_zh: 耐用品与边际消费倾向

doi:10.1257/aer.20240673.abstract: The implementation of evidence-based policies hinges on the dissemination of evidence to policymakers, a process influenced by the attributes of the sender. We conducted a nationwide RCT with ideologically opposite think tanks, major newspapers, and a research institution with nonsalient ideology to communicate a nonideological, cost-effective policy to local policymakers. Results show a 65 percent increase in policy adoption when informing institutions align ideologically with policymakers. We compare the impact of think tanks versus media outlets on implementation, finding both equally effective when ideologically aligned. We explore three actions where ideology may influence adoption: information exposure, belief updating and implementation. (JEL C93, D72, D78, D83, I23)
doi:10.1257/aer.20240673.abstract_zh: 循证政策的实施依赖于将证据传递给政策制定者，这一过程受到信息发送方特征的影响。我们开展了一项全国性随机对照试验，由意识形态对立的智库、主流报纸以及一家意识形态不显著的研究机构，向地方政策制定者传达一项非意识形态、具有成本效益的政策。结果显示，当信息传递机构与政策制定者的意识形态一致时，政策采纳率提高了65%。我们比较了智库与媒体机构对政策实施的影响，发现两者在意识形态一致时效果相当。我们探讨了意识形态可能影响政策采纳的三个环节：信息暴露、信念更新与实施。（JEL C93, D72, D78, D83, I23）
doi:10.1257/aer.20240673.title: Ideological Alignment and Evidence-Based Policy Adoption
doi:10.1257/aer.20240673.title_zh: 意识形态一致性对循证政策采纳的影响

doi:10.1257/aer.20240701.abstract: We document how deepening resource scarcity results in rationing on the basis of race in a highstakes setting: health care. Using detailed, time-stamped data on 107,000 inpatient admissions to a large health system, we find that in-hospital mortality increases for Black, but not White, patients as hospitals reach capacity. These findings are not explained by differential patient selection. We identify rationing by wait times as a mechanism, documenting that sicker Black patients wait longer for care than healthier White patients at almost all capacity levels. Text analysis of unstructured clinical notes reveals rationing of provider effort as another mechanism.
doi:10.1257/aer.20240701.abstract_zh: 我们记录了资源稀缺加剧如何在高风险场景——医疗保健中——导致基于种族的配给。利用涵盖某大型医疗系统107,000例住院患者的详细时间戳数据，我们发现当医院达到容量上限时，黑人患者的院内死亡率上升，而白人患者则未出现此现象。这些发现无法通过患者选择的差异来解释。我们识别出等待时间配给机制，并记录到在几乎所有容量水平下，病情更重的黑人患者比病情较轻的白人患者等待更长时间。对非结构化临床记录的文本分析揭示了医护人员努力程度的配给是另一机制。
doi:10.1257/aer.20240701.title: Rationing by Race

doi:10.1257/aer.20240712.abstract: The random utility model (RUM), a cornerstone in economics, is typically studied under the assumption that choice frequencies of all alternatives are observable. In practice, however, some alternatives have unobservable choice frequencies and are commonly aggregated into a single category called an outside option. We study RUM in such environments and derive a finite, nonredundant system of inequality constraints on observed choice frequencies that characterizes RU-rationalizability. We show that the conventional practice of aggregating unobserved alternatives can miss key information leading to incorrect conclusions such as that observed choices are rationalizable, even when no RUM is consistent with them.
doi:10.1257/aer.20240712.abstract_zh: 随机效用模型（RUM）作为经济学的重要基石，通常在假设所有备选方案的选择频率均可观测的条件下进行研究。然而在实践中，部分备选方案的选择频率无法观测，通常被合并为单一类别，即外部选项。我们在此类环境下研究RUM，推导出关于可观测选择频率的有限且无冗余的不等式约束系统，该系统刻画了RU可理性化的特征。研究表明，将不可观测备选方案进行合并的传统做法可能遗漏关键信息，导致即使不存在任何RUM与观测数据一致时，仍会得出观测选择具有可理性化的错误结论。
doi:10.1257/aer.20240712.title: Random Utility with Unobservable Alternatives
doi:10.1257/aer.20240712.title_zh: 不可观测选项下的随机效用

doi:10.1257/aer.20240756.abstract: Digital platforms reduce geographic frictions, enabling better matching between service providers and users. I quantify reallocation gains in Swedish online healthcare, using nationwide time-conditional random assignment between patients and physicians. Matching high-risk patients with doctors effective at reducing Emergency Room visits lowers such visits by 4.4% (s.e. 1.3); reallocations also reduce counter-guideline antibiotics by 3.1% (1.4). I find limited trade-offs in matching: horizontal differentiation among doctors and varied patient needs allow improvement in multiple outcomes simultaneously. Efficiency-enhancing reallocations also affect equity. The findings highlight the potential for care reorganization aligning provider heterogeneity with patient needs when geographic constraints are lifted.
doi:10.1257/aer.20240756.abstract_zh: 数字平台降低了地理摩擦，使服务提供者与用户之间的匹配更加高效。本文利用瑞典在线医疗中全国范围内基于时间的条件随机分配机制，量化了患者与医生重新匹配带来的收益。将高风险患者与能有效降低急诊就诊次数的医生匹配后，急诊就诊次数减少了4.4%（标准误1.3）；此类重新匹配还使违反指南的抗生素使用减少了3.1%（标准误1.4）。研究发现匹配中的权衡有限：医生间的横向差异化与患者需求的多样性使得多项指标可同时改善。提升效率的重新匹配也会影响公平性。研究结果凸显了在地理约束消除后，根据患者需求调整医疗服务提供者异质性的组织重组潜力。
doi:10.1257/aer.20240756.title: Defying Distance? The Provision of Medical Services in the Digital Age
doi:10.1257/aer.20240756.title_zh: 超越距离？数字时代的医疗服务供给

doi:10.1257/aer.20240766.title: Union Bargaining Power and the Amenity-Wage Tradeoff
doi:10.1257/aer.20240766.title_zh: 工会谈判力与舒适性-工资权衡

doi:10.1257/aer.20241001.abstract: We provide experimental evidence on the intergenerational impacts of secondary education subsidies in a low-income context, leveraging a randomized controlled trial and 15-year longitudinal follow-up. Secondary school scholarships delay fertility, reduce unwanted pregnancies and change partner selection. Under-one mortality is reduced by half. We also document cognitive development gains of 0.24 standard deviations of test scores by age 5 among children of female scholarship recipients. Means-tested secondary school scholarships are a high return investment, with a conservatively estimated $4.1 in benefits for each $1 the policy would cost the government in the long-run.
doi:10.1257/aer.20241001.abstract_zh: 我们基于随机对照试验和15年纵向追踪数据，提供了低收入环境下中等教育补贴代际影响的实验证据。中学奖学金推迟了生育年龄，减少了意外怀孕并改变了伴侣选择。一岁以下儿童死亡率降低了一半。我们还发现，女性奖学金获得者子女在5岁时的认知发展测试得分提高了0.24个标准差。经经济状况调查的中学奖学金是一项高回报投资，保守估计每1美元政策长期成本可为政府带来4.1美元收益。
doi:10.1257/aer.20241001.title: Intergenerational Impacts of Secondary Education: Experimental Evidence from Ghana
doi:10.1257/aer.20241001.title_zh: 中等教育的代际影响：来自加纳的实验证据

doi:10.1257/aer.20241007.abstract: This paper studies the productivity of nurse practitioners (NPs) and physicians, two professions performing overlapping tasks but with starkly different backgrounds, training, and pay. Using quasi-experimental variation in patient assignment to NPs versus physicians in Veterans Health Administration emergency departments, we find that, on average, NPs use more resources and exhibit a higher 30-day preventable hospitalization rate than physicians. However, the NP-physician performance difference varies by case complexity and severity. Importantly, even larger productivity variation exists within each profession, leading to substantial overlap between the productivity distributions of the two professions; NPs outperform physicians in 38 percent of random pairs.
doi:10.1257/aer.20241007.abstract_zh: 本文研究了执业护士与医生这两类职业的生产力差异。二者虽承担重叠性工作任务，但背景、培训经历及薪酬水平存在显著差异。利用退伍军人健康管理局急诊科患者随机分配至执业护士或医生的准实验变异，我们发现：平均而言，执业护士消耗更多医疗资源，且30天内可预防住院率高于医生。然而，执业护士与医生的绩效差异随病例复杂程度和严重程度而变化。值得注意的是，两类职业内部的生产力差异更为显著，导致二者生产力分布存在大量重叠——在38%的随机配对中，执业护士的表现优于医生。
doi:10.1257/aer.20241007.title: The Productivity of Professions: Evidence from the Emergency Department
doi:10.1257/aer.20241007.title_zh: 职业的生产力：来自急诊科的证据

doi:10.1257/aer.20241087.abstract: An increasing number of decisions are guided by machine learning algorithms. But when consequential decisions are encoded in algorithms, individuals may strategically alter their behavior to achieve desired outcomes. This paper develops an empirical approach that adjusts decision algorithms to anticipate manipulation. By explicitly modeling incentives to manipulate, our approach produces decision rules that are stable under manipulation, even when the rules are fully transparent. We stress test this approach through a large field experiment in Kenya. When implemented, linear strategy-robust decision rules outperform standard linear models such as LASSO.
doi:10.1257/aer.20241087.abstract_zh: 越来越多的决策由机器学习算法指导。然而，当具有重大影响的决策被编码为算法时，个体可能会策略性地改变自身行为以达成预期结果。本文开发了一种实证方法，通过调整决策算法来预判操纵行为。通过明确建模操纵动机，我们的方法能够产生即使在完全透明规则下也能在操纵中保持稳定的决策规则。我们通过在肯尼亚开展的大规模实地实验对该方法进行了压力测试。实施结果表明，线性策略稳健决策规则的表现优于LASSO等标准线性模型。
doi:10.1257/aer.20241087.title: Manipulation-Robust Prediction

doi:10.1257/aer.20241404.abstract: We study cultural integration as an equilibrium outcome of marital matching along cultural and education lines and intra-household investment decisions regarding fertility and cultural socialization. Our model allows us to identify cultural-ethnic group specific investment parameters and spousal preferences for marital matching. Structural estimates reveal a strong demand to preserve cultural identity on the part of immigrants and limited acceptance of the immigrants’ cultural diversity on the part of natives. Furthermore, these estimates reveal a substantial heterogeneity of the parental value of children’s education across cultures. Nonetheless, our estimates simulate substantial - though heterogeneous- cultural integration rates across immigrant groups.
doi:10.1257/aer.20241404.abstract_zh: 我们将文化融合视为婚姻匹配在文化与教育维度上的均衡结果，以及家庭内部关于生育与文化社会化的投资决策。我们的模型能够识别特定文化族群的投资参数及配偶对婚姻匹配的偏好。结构估计显示，移民群体对保持文化身份具有强烈诉求，而本土居民对移民文化多样性的接纳程度有限。此外，这些估计揭示了不同文化背景下父母对子女教育价值的显著异质性。尽管如此，我们的模拟结果表明，各移民群体间存在显著但具有异质性的文化融合率。
doi:10.1257/aer.20241404.title: Marriage, Fertility, and Cultural Integration in Italy
doi:10.1257/aer.20241404.title_zh: 意大利的婚姻、生育与文化融合

doi:10.1257/aer.20241561.title: Inequality and Racial Backlash: Evidence from the Reconstruction Era and the Freedmen’s Bureau
doi:10.1257/aer.20241561.title_zh: 不平等与种族反弹：来自重建时期与自由民局的证据

doi:10.1257/aer.20241596.abstract: Using administrative data from Scandinavian countries, we provide evidence on international migration responses to wealth taxes and evaluate their aggregate economic implications. We find significant migration responses among the wealthy: a 1pp increase in the top wealth tax rate decreases the stock of wealthy taxpayers by about 2%. A large fraction of the wealthy are business owners, and their businesses are negatively affected by owner out-migration. The aggregate effects are nevertheless modest: the migration responses to a 1pp increase in the top wealth tax rate reduce employment by 0.02%, investments by 0.07%, and value-added by 0.10%.
doi:10.1257/aer.20241596.abstract_zh: 利用斯堪的纳维亚国家的行政数据，我们提供了关于国际移民对财富税反应的证据，并评估了其总体经济影响。我们发现富裕群体存在显著的移民反应：最高财富税率每提高1个百分点，富裕纳税人存量约减少2%。大部分富裕群体为企业主，其企业因所有者外迁而受到负面影响。然而，总体效应较为温和：最高财富税率每提高1个百分点所引发的移民反应，导致就业减少0.02%，投资减少0.07%，增加值减少0.10%。
doi:10.1257/aer.20241596.title: Taxing Top Wealth: Migration Responses and their Aggregate Economic Implications
doi:10.1257/aer.20241596.title_zh: 对顶层财富征税：迁移反应及其总体经济影响

doi:10.1257/aer.20241765.abstract: We study the relationship between corporate income taxation and carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions in the U.S. We show that CO2-intensive firms benefit more from the tax advantage of debt, and pay lower income taxes on their capital income. Building on these new facts, we provide evidence that a cut in the corporate income tax rate leads to a larger expansion of clean firms. We develop a multi-sector general equilibrium model that accounts for our evidence and quantify the impact of corporate tax reforms on aggregate emissions. A policy that eliminates the tax advantage of debt could reduce aggregate emissions without affecting GDP.
doi:10.1257/aer.20241765.abstract_zh: 我们研究了美国企业所得税与二氧化碳排放之间的关系。研究表明，二氧化碳密集型企业在债务税收优惠中获益更多，且其资本收入缴纳的所得税更低。基于这些新发现，我们提供了证据表明企业所得税税率下调会促使清洁企业实现更大规模的扩张。我们构建了一个多部门一般均衡模型来解释这一现象，并量化了企业税制改革对总排放量的影响。一项消除债务税收优惠的政策可在不影响GDP的情况下减少总排放量。
doi:10.1257/aer.20241765.title: The Environmental Bias of Corporate Income Taxation
doi:10.1257/aer.20241765.title_zh: 企业所得税的环境偏向

doi:10.1257/aer.20241925.abstract: This paper studies the implications of central bank credibility for long-run inflation and inflation dynamics. We introduce central bank lack of commitment into a standard nonlinear New Keynesian economy with sticky-price monopolistically competitive firms. Inflation is driven by the interaction of lack of commitment and the economic environment. We show that long-run inflation increases following an unanticipated permanent increase in the labor wedge or decrease in the elasticity of substitution across varieties. In the transition, inflation overshoots and then gradually declines. Quantitatively, inflation overshooting is persistent, and the welfare loss from lack of commitment relative to inflation targeting is large. (JEL D43, E12, E23, E24, E31, E52, E58)
doi:10.1257/aer.20241925.abstract_zh: 本文研究了央行可信度对长期通胀及通胀动态的影响。我们将央行缺乏承诺引入一个具有粘性价格垄断竞争企业的标准非线性新凯恩斯经济体中。通胀由缺乏承诺与经济环境之间的相互作用驱动。研究表明，当劳动楔子出现未预期的永久性上升或品种间替代弹性下降时，长期通胀将上升。在过渡期内，通胀先过度上升，随后逐渐回落。从量化角度看，通胀过度上升具有持续性，且相较于通胀目标制，缺乏承诺导致的福利损失较大。（JEL D43, E12, E23, E24, E31, E52, E58）
doi:10.1257/aer.20241925.title: Monetary Policy without Commitment

doi:10.1257/aer.20250064.abstract: What is the optimal response of a resource exporter when a price cap is imposed on its main export? This paper develops a dynamic framework incorporating stochastic prices, financial frictions, and market power to study this novel tool of statecraft. With the right design, a price cap can incentivize increased extraction, stabilizing prices in the global market. But the stabilizing effects diminish when there is leakage outside the cap. Consequently, weak enforcement of the policy worsens the trade-off faced by the sanctioning policymaker. We provide a systematic approach to setting and enforcing an optimal cap level in these circumstances. (JEL F12, F14, F51, L71, P28, P33, Q35)
doi:10.1257/aer.20250064.abstract_zh: 当资源出口国的主要出口产品被施加价格上限时，其最优应对策略是什么？本文构建了一个包含随机价格、金融摩擦和市场势力的动态框架，以研究这一新型国家治理工具。若设计得当，价格上限可激励增加开采量，从而稳定全球市场价格。但当存在上限之外的泄漏时，这种稳定效应会减弱。因此，制裁政策制定者面临的政策执行不力将加剧其权衡困境。我们为在此类情形下设定并执行最优上限水平提供了系统性方法。（JEL分类号：F12, F14, F51, L71, P28, P33, Q35）
doi:10.1257/aer.20250064.title: A Theory of Price Caps on Nonrenewable Resources
doi:10.1257/aer.20250064.title_zh: 非可再生资源价格上限理论

doi:10.1257/aer.20250115.title: Who Marries Whom? The Role of Segregation by Race and Class
doi:10.1257/aer.20250115.title_zh: 谁与谁结婚？种族与阶级隔离的作用

doi:10.1257/aer.20250166.abstract: We study the welfare impacts of 96 climate-related tax and spending policies. We extend and apply the marginal value of public funds (MVPF) framework, most notably providing a new method for incorporating learning-by-doing spillovers. We find subsidies for the production of clean energy (such as wind production tax credits) have higher MVPFs than all other subsidies in our sample, including EV subsidies. Conservation nudges have large MVPFs when targeting regions with dirty grids. Fuel taxes and cap-and-trade policies are highly efficient means of raising revenue. We also construct traditional cost-per-ton estimates and compare and contrast the lessons they provide. (JEL D83, H23, H25, L62, Q42, Q54, Q58)
doi:10.1257/aer.20250166.abstract_zh: 我们研究了96项与气候相关的税收和支出政策的福利影响。我们对公共资金边际价值（MVPF）框架进行了扩展和应用，尤其提出了一种纳入干中学溢出效应的新方法。研究发现，清洁能源生产补贴（如风电生产税收抵免）的MVPF高于样本中所有其他补贴，包括电动汽车补贴。针对高污染电网地区实施的节能引导政策具有较高的MVPF。燃油税和总量控制与交易政策是高效的财政收入筹集手段。我们还构建了传统的每吨成本估算，并比较了这些估算所提供的政策启示。（JEL D83, H23, H25, L62, Q42, Q54, Q58）
doi:10.1257/aer.20250166.title: A Welfare Analysis of Policies Impacting Climate Change
doi:10.1257/aer.20250166.title_zh: 气候变化政策的福利分析

doi:10.1257/aer.20250206.title: Screening and Segmenting: A Consumer Surplus Perspective
doi:10.1257/aer.20250206.title_zh: 筛选与细分：消费者剩余视角

doi:10.1257/aer.20250295.abstract: Mechanisms that aim to reduce environmental degradation at low cost can be undermined when participants’ conservation actions are not marginal to the incentive — or “additional” — as the lowest-cost participants may not be the highest social value. We investigate this challenge in the Conservation Reserve Program’s auction mechanism for ecosystem services, linking bids to satellite-derived land use. Three-quarters of marginal auction winners are not additional. The heterogeneity in counterfactual land use introduces adverse selection. We develop a model of bidding and additionality to quantify welfare implications. Alternative auctions increase efficiency by using scoring rules that incorporate expected land use impacts.
doi:10.1257/aer.20250295.abstract_zh: 旨在以低成本减少环境退化的机制，当参与者的保护行为并非激励的边际效应——即“额外性”——时，可能会被削弱，因为成本最低的参与者可能并非社会价值最高的。我们在保护储备计划的生态系统服务拍卖机制中研究这一挑战，将投标与卫星衍生的土地利用联系起来。四分之三的边际拍卖获胜者不具备额外性。反事实土地利用的异质性引入了逆向选择。我们构建了一个投标与额外性模型，以量化福利影响。替代性拍卖通过采用纳入预期土地利用影响的评分规则来提高效率。
doi:10.1257/aer.20250295.title: Additionality and Asymmetric Information in Environmental Markets: Evidence from Conservation Auctions
doi:10.1257/aer.20250295.title_zh: 环境市场中的额外性与信息不对称：来自保护拍卖的证据

doi:10.1257/aer.20250305.abstract: We study the role of victim reporting in the production of public safety. We examine the Secure Communities program, a crime-reduction policy that involved police in detecting unauthorized immigrants and increased deportation fears in immigrant communities. We find that the policy reduced the likelihood that Hispanic victims report crimes to police and increased offending against Hispanics. The number of reported crimes is unchanged, masking these opposing effects. We show that reduced reporting drives the offending increase and provide the first elasticity of offending to victim reporting in the literature, calculating that a 10% decline in reporting increases offending by 7.9%.
doi:10.1257/aer.20250305.abstract_zh: 本文研究了受害者报案在公共安全产出中的作用。我们考察了“安全社区”计划——一项涉及警方识别非法移民并加剧移民社区驱逐恐惧的犯罪防控政策。研究发现，该政策降低了西班牙裔受害者向警方报案的意愿，并导致针对西班牙裔的犯罪增加。报案犯罪总数未发生变化，掩盖了上述相反效应。我们证明报案减少是犯罪增加的原因，并在文献中首次提供了犯罪对受害者报案的弹性系数，计算得出报案率每下降10%，犯罪率上升7.9%。
doi:10.1257/aer.20250305.title: Community Engagement and Public Safety: Evidence from Crime Enforcement Targeting Immigrants
doi:10.1257/aer.20250305.title_zh: 社区参与与公共安全：针对移民的犯罪执法证据

doi:10.1257/aeri.20240193.abstract: We develop a method for delineating prime locations—ultra-dense clusters of economic activity—within cities and apply it to comprehensive establishment data covering all US metropolitan areas. We further use big data to extend the analysis to a global context where administrative data are sparse. Many cities in the US and around the world are dominated by a small number of prime locations that can concentrate up to one-half of tradable services jobs on tiny shares of land and are dominant centers of economic gravity. In cities with fewer prime locations, a larger tradable services share concentrates in them.
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240193.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种在城市内部划定核心区位（即经济活动超密集集群）的方法，并将其应用于覆盖美国全部大都市区的综合性企业数据。进一步利用大数据将分析扩展至行政数据稀缺的全球范围。美国及全球众多城市的核心区位数量有限，这些区域能以极小比例的土地集中高达一半的可贸易服务业岗位，并成为主导性的经济引力中心。在核心区位较少的城市中，可贸易服务业岗位的集中度更高。
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240193.title: Prime Locations

doi:10.1257/aeri.20240285.abstract: We introduce a model in which a benevolent news outlet decides whether to report the realization of a state to a consumer, who pays a cost to receive it. A simple statistical rule, called a proper scoring rule, describes when the outlet should be more likely to report the realization. Using data from the US television news, we show that a particular scoring rule successfully predicts many salient features of news reporting. We show how to use this rule as a control variable to discipline tests of reporting bias, and we show that controlling for it matters in our applications.
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240285.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，其中一家秉持善意的新闻机构决定是否向消费者报告某一状态的实现情况，而消费者需为此支付接收成本。一种被称为"恰当评分规则"的简单统计准则，描述了新闻机构在何种情况下更可能报告该实现结果。基于美国电视新闻数据，我们证明该特定评分规则能够成功预测新闻报道的诸多显著特征。我们展示了如何将该规则作为控制变量来约束报道偏误检验，并证实了在应用场景中控制该变量的重要性。
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240285.title: What is Newsworthy? Theory and Evidence
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240285.title_zh: 什么是值得报道的新闻？理论与证据

doi:10.1257/aeri.20240391.abstract: The charter school movement encompasses many school models. In Massachusetts in the 2010s, the site of our study, urban charter schools primarily used “No Excuses” practices, whereas nonurban charters had greater model variety. Using randomized admissions lotteries, we estimate the impact of charter schools by locality on college preparation, enrollment, and graduation. Urban charter schools boost all of these outcomes. Nonurban charter schools raise college enrollment and graduation despite reducing state test scores and AP enrollment. Notably, the nonurban charter college graduation edge is more than twice as large as that from urban charter attendance. (JEL H75, I21, I23, I28)
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240391.abstract_zh: 特许学校运动包含多种学校模式。在我们研究的马萨诸塞州，2010年代的城市特许学校主要采用"零容忍"实践，而非城市特许学校的模式则更加多样化。利用随机录取抽签机制，我们估算了不同地区特许学校对大学准备、入学及毕业的影响。城市特许学校提升了所有这些指标。非城市特许学校尽管降低了州统考成绩和AP课程注册率，却提高了大学入学率和毕业率。值得注意的是，非城市特许学校带来的大学毕业生优势是城市特许学校的两倍以上。（JEL H75, I21, I23, I28）
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240391.title: Different Paths to College Success: The Impact of Massachusetts’s Charter Schools on College Trajectories
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240391.title_zh: 通往大学成功的不同路径：马萨诸塞州特许学校对大学轨迹的影响

doi:10.1257/aeri.20240436.abstract: This paper studies Markov perfect equilibria in a repeated duopoly model where sellers choose algorithms. An algorithm is a mapping from the competitor’s price to own price. Once set, the algorithms respond quickly. Customers arrive randomly and sellers can periodically revise their algorithms. The main results are that (i) for the simple two-price model with standard profit functions, monopoly pricing is the unique equilibrium outcome, and (ii) for any general finite price grid, all equilibrium outcomes feature supra-competitive pricing. Sustenance of such collusion seems outside the scope of current antitrust laws for it does not involve any direct communication.
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240436.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个重复双寡头模型中的马尔可夫完美均衡，其中卖方选择算法。算法是从竞争对手价格到自身价格的映射。一旦设定，算法会快速响应。顾客随机到达，卖方可以定期修改其算法。主要结论是：（i）对于具有标准利润函数的简单两价格模型，垄断定价是唯一的均衡结果；（ii）对于任何一般有限价格网格，所有均衡结果均呈现超竞争定价。这种合谋的维持似乎超出了现行反垄断法的适用范围，因为它不涉及任何直接沟通。
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240436.title: Pricing with Algorithms

doi:10.1257/aeri.20240538.abstract: There has been a dramatic rise in disability employment since the pandemic, while work from home (WFH) has risen fourfold. This paper asks whether the two are causally related. Controlling for compositional changes and labor market tightness, a 1 percentage point increase in WFH increases full-time employment by 1.0 percent for individuals with a physical disability. The postpandemic increase in working from home explains 68–85 percent of the rise in full-time employment. Wage data suggest that WFH increased the supply of workers with a physical disability, likely by reducing commuting costs and enabling better control of working conditions. (JEL I12, J14, J22, J28, J81)
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240538.abstract_zh: 自疫情以来，残疾人群体的就业率显著上升，同时居家办公的比例增长了四倍。本文旨在探究两者之间是否存在因果关系。在控制人口结构变化和劳动力市场紧张程度后，居家办公比例每提高1个百分点，身体残疾者的全职就业率将增加1.0%。疫情后居家办公的普及解释了全职就业率增长的68%至85%。工资数据表明，居家办公增加了身体残疾劳动者的供给，这很可能源于通勤成本的降低以及对工作条件掌控能力的提升。（JEL分类号：I12, J14, J22, J28, J81）
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240538.title: Work from Home and Disability Employment
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240538.title_zh: 居家办公与残疾人就业

doi:10.1257/aeri.20240624.abstract: We study whether the Coase conjecture holds for bargaining during war. Two players, A and B, contest a divisible resource until one side collapses or agreement is reached. If player B is militarily strong, then he insists on getting a large share. However, player A only concedes this large share if player B credibly signals his strength by fighting a sufficiently long war. Thus, the Coase conjecture fails, and asymmetric information about military strength explains why long wars may be inevitable. Using a mechanism design approach, we derive a lower bound on the expected duration of war. (JEL C78, D74, D82, F51)
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240624.abstract_zh: 我们研究科斯猜想在战争期间的讨价还价中是否成立。两名参与者A和B争夺一种可分割资源，直至一方崩溃或达成协议。如果参与者B在军事上强大，他会坚持要求获得较大份额。然而，只有当参与者B通过进行足够长时间的战争来可信地传递其军事实力信号时，参与者A才会让出这一较大份额。因此，科斯猜想不成立，关于军事实力的信息不对称解释了为何长期战争可能不可避免。通过机制设计方法，我们推导出战争预期持续时间的下限。（JEL C78, D74, D82, F51）
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240624.title: Long Wars

doi:10.1257/aeri.20240634.abstract: We document strong behavioral responses to an asset test for an old-age support program in Denmark using comprehensive administrative data. We show that the density distribution of the liquid assets targeted by the test exhibits large but diffuse excess mass below the threshold for the treated group relative to control groups of comparable but ineligible individuals. A cohort analysis exploiting the panel structure suggests that the program reduces liquid assets by 20 percent around the threshold. Analyzing high-frequency bank data on assets and cash withdrawals shows that the excess mass around the threshold largely reflects permanent rather than temporary responses. (JEL D91, G51, H24, H55, I32, J14)
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240634.abstract_zh: 我们利用全面的行政数据，记录了丹麦一项老年支持计划中资产测试引发的强烈行为反应。研究表明，该测试所针对的流动资产密度分布在阈值以下呈现出大量但分散的超额聚集，相较于具有可比性但不符合条件的对照组而言。基于面板结构的队列分析表明，该计划使阈值附近的流动资产减少了20%。通过对资产和现金提取的高频银行数据进行分析，发现阈值附近的超额聚集主要反映的是永久性而非暂时性反应。（JEL分类号：D91, G51, H24, H55, I32, J14）
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240634.title: Taxing the Wealth of the Poor:Evidence from the Danish Old-Age Support Asset Test
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240634.title_zh: 对穷人财富征税：来自丹麦老年支持资产审查的证据

doi:10.1257/aeri.20240649.abstract: As urban populations grow, more people face extreme heat, increasing demand for natural cooling. Urban trees offer various amenities, including cooling benefits, yet their economic value is hard to quantify. This paper estimates the implicit value of urban trees by exploiting the Emerald Ash Borer infestation caused by an invasive beetle that kills ash trees in Toronto as an exogenous shock. We find that a onepercentage- point increase in a postcode’s tree cover raises property prices by 1.13% and reduces exposure to extreme heat, pollution, and energy consumption. These findings underscore trees as a cost-effective, practical strategy for mitigating urban warming.
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240649.abstract_zh: 随着城市人口的增长，越来越多的人面临极端高温，对自然降温的需求也随之增加。城市树木提供了多种便利，包括降温效益，但其经济价值难以量化。本文利用一种入侵性甲虫引发的翡翠灰螟虫害（该虫害导致多伦多的白蜡树死亡）作为外生冲击，估算了城市树木的隐性价值。研究发现，邮政编码区域的树木覆盖率每提高一个百分点，房产价格上升1.13%，同时减少极端高温暴露、污染和能源消耗。这些发现凸显了树木作为缓解城市变暖的经济有效且实用的策略。
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240649.title: Cool Cities: The Value of Urban Trees
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240649.title_zh: 凉爽城市：城市树木的价值

doi:10.1257/aeri.20240698.abstract: Using an evolutionary approach, we address the prominent tension in the literature that updating of ambiguity and nonexpected-utility preferences cannot, in general, be both dynamically consistent and consequentialist. Perhaps not surprisingly, evolutionary optimality requires dynamic consistency. The more subtle insight is the evolutionary optimality of systematic violations of consequentialism. We base our investigation on the model of adaptive preferences (Sadowski and Sarver 2024), which generalizes the model of Robson (1996) and nests variants of many well-known models in the literature. (JEL B52, D11, D81, D83)
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240698.abstract_zh: 采用演化方法，我们解决了文献中一个显著矛盾：在一般情况下，模糊性更新与非期望效用偏好无法同时满足动态一致性和后果主义。或许并不令人意外的是，演化最优性要求动态一致性。而更微妙的洞见在于，系统性违反后果主义的行为具有演化最优性。我们的研究基于适应性偏好模型（Sadowski and Sarver 2024），该模型推广了Robson（1996）的模型，并涵盖了文献中许多著名模型的变体。（JEL B52, D11, D81, D83）
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240698.title: An Evolutionary Perspective on Updating Risk and Ambiguity Preferences
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240698.title_zh: 风险与模糊偏好更新的演化视角

doi:10.1257/aeri.20240722.abstract: We estimate the impact of unionization on the wage distribution of Canadian university faculty using longitudinal administrative data on salaries and exploiting the staggered rollout of unionization across institutions. We find that unionization compressed salaries: Wages at the bottom of the unconditional distribution increased by roughly 10 percent, while wages at the top were unaffected. Our evidence suggests that these distributional impacts were driven by the introduction of contractual salary floors. We also estimate little impact of unionization on faculty employment. Instead, our results suggest that the increase in universities’ wage bills was financed by an increase in student enrollment. (JEL I23, J31, J45, J51)
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240722.abstract_zh: 本文利用加拿大高校教职员工薪资的纵向行政数据，并借助各院校工会化进程的阶段性推进，评估了工会化对薪资分布的影响。研究发现，工会化压缩了薪资差距：无条件薪资分布底层的工资水平上升约10%，而顶层的工资未受影响。证据表明，这种分布效应源于合同薪资下限的引入。此外，工会化对教职员工就业的影响微乎其微。相反，研究结果显示，大学薪资支出的增长是通过扩大学生招生规模来弥补的。（JEL分类号：I23, J31, J45, J51）
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240722.title: The Impact of Unions on the Wage Distribution: Evidence from Higher Education
doi:10.1257/aeri.20240722.title_zh: 工会对工资分布的影响：来自高等教育的证据

doi:10.1257/aeri.20250006.abstract: We use administrative records on the universe of Danish households to characterize survivors’ mental health following their spouse’s death. We provide visually clear evidence for the immediate, large, and lingering adverse impacts and focus on studying the role of income security in driving the immediate effects. We find that, for both males and females, a large share of the spike in the take-up of mental health medication upon spousal death can be explained by the income loss imposed by the shock. Our results imply that safety net policies can improve survivors’ mental health via the immediate liquidity they provide. (JEL D12, D91, G51, H55, I12, I38, J16)
doi:10.1257/aeri.20250006.abstract_zh: 我们利用丹麦全部家庭的管理记录，刻画了配偶去世后幸存者的心理健康状况。我们提供了直观清晰的证据，证明其遭受了即时、严重且持续的不利影响，并重点研究了收入保障在驱动即时效应中的作用。研究发现，无论男性还是女性，配偶去世后精神药物使用量的激增，在很大程度上可由这一冲击造成的收入损失来解释。我们的结果表明，安全网政策能够通过提供即时流动性来改善幸存者的心理健康。（JEL D12, D91, G51, H55, I12, I38, J16）
doi:10.1257/aeri.20250006.title: Survivors’ Mental Health and the Protective Role of Income Stability
doi:10.1257/aeri.20250006.title_zh: 幸存者心理健康与收入稳定性的保护作用

doi:10.1257/aeri.20250043.abstract: We study how information disclosure shapes social learning about a potentially harmful product. Increased transparency helps early agents avoid harm, which may undermine learning by later agents. Despite this conflict of interest, we show that full transparency is uniquely optimal for all agents when they learn only by observing neighbors’ harm. We investigate whether full transparency about harm continues to benefit all agents when they also learn from additional, imperfect signals. (JEL D18, D82, D83, L15)
