doi:10.1257/mac.20230033.title_zh: 企业异质性、市场势力与宏观经济脆弱性

doi:10.1257/mac.20230055.abstract: Trade credit is a key source of short-term finance. This paper develops a model where trade credit reduces borrowing from banks. This reduction gives rise to a financing cost advantage of trade credit that increases in the product of markups and borrowing costs. Chilean export data confirm this prediction. A one-standard-deviation rise in upstream markups increases trade credit by 9 days. The intensive margin is responsible for about 60 percent of this effect, which strengthens with destination-country borrowing costs. We estimate that trade credit allows U.S. firms to reduce formal borrowing by $1.4 trillion, generating annual savings of $39 billion.
doi:10.1257/mac.20230055.abstract_zh: 贸易信贷是短期融资的关键来源。本文构建了一个模型，其中贸易信贷减少了企业从银行的借款。这种减少使得贸易信贷产生融资成本优势，该优势随加成率与借款成本的乘积递增。智利出口数据证实了这一预测：上游加成率每上升一个标准差，贸易信贷期限将增加9天。集约边际对此效应的贡献约为60%，且该效应随目的地国借款成本的上升而增强。我们估算，贸易信贷使美国企业减少1.4万亿美元的正规借款，每年节省390亿美元。
doi:10.1257/mac.20230055.title: Diversion Risk, Markups, and the Financing Cost Advantage of Trade Credit
doi:10.1257/mac.20230055.title_zh: 转移风险、加成率与贸易信贷的融资成本优势

doi:10.1257/mac.20230083.abstract: This paper studies the sectoral and macroeconomic consequences of carbon taxes in four Nordic countries using a novel monthly measure of effective carbon tax rates. The suggested measure accounts for the time-varying emission coverage of taxes that are both explicitly and implicitly levied on greenhouse gas-emitting goods, thereby solving several issues of existing carbon tax measures currently used by the literature. Employing the new measure in a local projection setting, I find that carbon taxes reduce emissions as expected but also impair macroeconomic activity—though there is some heterogeneity in the effects across sectors and countries. (JEL H23, O44, Q54, Q58)
doi:10.1257/mac.20230083.abstract_zh: 本文利用一种新颖的月度有效碳税率指标，研究了碳税在四个北欧国家的部门及宏观经济影响。该指标考虑了针对温室气体排放商品征收的显性和隐性税收的时变排放覆盖率，从而解决了现有文献中碳税指标存在的若干问题。在局部投影框架下应用这一新指标，我发现碳税如预期般减少了排放，但也削弱了宏观经济活动——尽管不同部门和国家的效应存在一定异质性。（JEL H23, O44, Q54, Q58）
doi:10.1257/mac.20230083.title: The Economic Consequences of Effective Carbon Taxes

doi:10.1257/mac.20230213.abstract: In trade models with scale economies, import liberalization reduces exports within industries by shrinking real market potential. We find this export destruction mechanism reduced US export growth following the permanent normalization of trade relations with China (PNTR). There was also an offsetting boost to exports from lower input costs. We use our estimates to calibrate a quantitative model and show that scale economies are economically important for trade policy analysis. Although PNTR increased aggregate US exports relative to GDP, exports declined in the most exposed industries. US gains from PNTR are positive but 30 percent smaller than under constant returns. (JEL D24, E23, F13, F14, O19, P33)
doi:10.1257/mac.20230213.abstract_zh: 在具有规模经济的贸易模型中，进口自由化通过缩小实际市场潜力减少了行业内的出口。我们发现，这种出口破坏机制在美国与中国永久正常贸易关系（PNTR）实施后抑制了其出口增长。同时，较低的投入成本对出口产生了抵消性提振。我们利用估计结果校准了一个量化模型，并表明规模经济对贸易政策分析具有重要的经济意义。尽管PNTR增加了美国相对于GDP的总出口，但在受影响最大的行业中，出口出现下降。美国从PNTR中获得的收益为正，但比规模报酬不变情况下低30%。（JEL D24, E23, F13, F14, O19, P33）
doi:10.1257/mac.20230213.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1257/mac.20230213.title: Import Liberalization as Export Destruction? Evidence from the United States
doi:10.1257/mac.20230213.title_zh: 进口自由化是出口破坏吗？来自美国的证据

doi:10.1257/mac.20230241.abstract: Labor productivity growth in the service sector may be mismeasured if workers with heterogeneous skills self-select into sectors. I document with US data that workers reallocated from manufacturing earn more than incumbent workers in professional services but less than incumbent workers in education, health, and public services. A generalized quantitative Roy model predicts a selection effect on labor productivity growth in professional services that is 10 percentage points higher than what a conventional selection model predicts. Overall, the selection effect contributes little to the cost disease of services, which contrasts sharply with the hypothesis in the literature. (JEL E24, J24, J31, J44, J45, L60, L80)
doi:10.1257/mac.20230241.abstract_zh: 若技能异质性的工人自我选择进入不同行业，服务业劳动生产率增长可能被误测。基于美国数据，我发现从制造业重新配置的工人在专业服务业的收入高于该行业原有工人，但在教育、卫生和公共服务业的收入低于原有工人。一个广义定量Roy模型预测，专业服务业中由选择效应导致的劳动生产率增长比传统选择模型高出10个百分点。总体而言，选择效应对服务业成本病的贡献甚微，这与文献中的假设形成鲜明对比。（JEL E24, J24, J31, J44, J45, L60, L80）
doi:10.1257/mac.20230241.title: Selection, Structural Transformation, and the Cost Disease of Services
doi:10.1257/mac.20230241.title_zh: 选择、结构转型与服务业成本病

doi:10.1257/mac.20230278.abstract: We present a model in which efficient long-term employment relationships are sustained by wage adjustments prompted by productivity shocks and outside job offers. These wage adjustments occur only sporadically, due to the presence of renegotiation costs. The model is amenable to analytical solution, yielding new insights for several labor market phenomena, including: (1) key features of empirical distributions of changes in pay among job stayers; (2) a near-“memorylessness” property in wage dynamics whereby hiring wages have only limited influence on later wages and allocation decisions; and (3) a crucial role for recruitment and retention bonuses in sustaining efficient employment relationships.
doi:10.1257/mac.20230278.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，其中高效的长期雇佣关系通过生产率冲击和外部工作机会引发的工资调整得以维持。由于存在重新谈判成本，这些工资调整仅偶尔发生。该模型可进行解析求解，为若干劳动力市场现象提供了新见解，包括：（1）在职者薪酬变动的经验分布的关键特征；（2）工资动态中近乎“无记忆性”的特性，即入职工资对后续工资及配置决策的影响有限；（3）招聘奖金和留任奖金在维持高效雇佣关系中的关键作用。
doi:10.1257/mac.20230278.title: Wage Adjustment in Efficient Long-Term Employment Relationships
doi:10.1257/mac.20230278.title_zh: 高效长期雇佣关系中的工资调整

doi:10.1257/mac.20230299.abstract: This paper examines the behavior of individuals susceptible to a deadly disease in a tractable equilibrium setting. We analytically characterize individually optimal mitigation behavior and the resulting equilibrium trajectory. Analysis is facilitated by a phase diagram. A key insight is that individually optimal behavior of those susceptible to the disease results in excessive caution. This behavior flattens the epidemic curve and prolongs the epidemic. In contrast, socially optimal behavior results in a higher infection rate, with a focus on minimizing cumulative deaths at minimum cost. The paper offers novel technical contributions and an improved understanding of externalities in econ-epi models. (JEL D62, D91, I12, I18)
doi:10.1257/mac.20230299.abstract_zh: 本文在一个可处理的均衡框架下，研究了易感致命疾病的个体行为。我们通过解析方法刻画了个体最优的缓解行为及其导致的均衡轨迹，并借助相图进行分析。核心发现是：易感个体的最优行为会导致过度谨慎，这种平缓了流行病曲线，却延长了疫情持续时间。相比之下，社会最优行为则追求以最小成本最小化累计死亡人数，从而产生更高的感染率。本文在技术层面做出创新贡献，并深化了对经济-流行病模型中外部性的理解。（JEL D62, D91, I12, I18）
doi:10.1257/mac.20230299.title: An Analytical Model of Behavior and Policy in an Epidemic
doi:10.1257/mac.20230299.title_zh: 流行病中行为与政策的分析模型

doi:10.1257/mac.20230301.title: The Long-Term Earnings' Effects of a Credit Market Disruption
doi:10.1257/mac.20230301.title_zh: 信贷市场中断对长期收入的影响

doi:10.1257/mac.20230323.abstract: Cross-country disparities in collateral technologies alone can account for large capital flows among mature economies, and allow the most advanced country to run a permanent trade deficit. When the collateral technology advantage is in creating negative beta (super safe) financial assets backed by positive beta assets, a Global Collateral Cycle emerges, with pro-cyclical gross and net flows and increased global asset price volatility. The supply of super safe assets is necessarily curtailed in downturns, providing a complementary (supply) channel to the flight to safety (demand) channel for explaining why US safe asset prices rise during crises.
doi:10.1257/mac.20230323.abstract_zh: 仅凭抵押品技术的跨国差异，就能解释成熟经济体之间大规模资本流动的原因，并使最先进的国家能够维持永久性贸易逆差。当抵押品技术优势体现在以正贝塔资产为支撑、创造负贝塔（超级安全）金融资产时，全球抵押品周期便会形成，伴随顺周期的总流量与净流量，以及全球资产价格波动性的加剧。在经济下行期，超级安全资产的供给必然收缩，这为解释为何美国安全资产价格在危机期间上涨提供了与"避险"（需求）渠道互补的（供给）渠道。
doi:10.1257/mac.20230323.title: Capital Flows and the Global Collateral Cycle
doi:10.1257/mac.20230323.title_zh: 资本流动与全球抵押品周期

doi:10.1257/mac.20230356.abstract: Using county-level and zip-code-level data from the United States during the period 1998–2018, we document: (i) Increased flood risk has a large negative impact on firm entry, employment, and output in the long run; (ii) Flood events reduce output in the short run while impact on firm entry and employment is limited. We then develop a quantitative spatial model to characterize how flood risk shapes firms’ location choices and employment. We find flood risk reduced US aggregate output by 0.53 percent in 2018, 23 percent of which stemmed from direct damages and 77 percent from long-run adjustments of firms and workers. (JEL D22, E23, E24, L11, Q54, R23, R32)
doi:10.1257/mac.20230356.abstract_zh: 利用1998–2018年美国县级和邮政编码级数据，我们证实：（i）长期来看，洪水风险增加对企业进入、就业和产出具有显著的负面影响；（ii）短期来看，洪水事件会降低产出，但对企业进入和就业的影响有限。随后，我们构建了一个量化空间模型，以刻画洪水风险如何塑造企业的区位选择和就业。研究发现，2018年洪水风险使美国总产出下降0.53%，其中23%源于直接损失，77%源于企业与工人的长期调整。（JEL D22, E23, E24, L11, Q54, R23, R32）
doi:10.1257/mac.20230356.title: Expecting Floods: Firm Entry, Employment, and Aggregate Implications
doi:10.1257/mac.20230356.title_zh: 预期洪水：企业进入、就业与总体影响

doi:10.1257/mac.20230357.abstract: This paper examines the effects of primary budget surpluses, surprise inflation, and pegged interest rates before the Fed-Treasury Accord of 1951 on the US public debt/GDP ratio. We find that with the primary budget balance and without distortions in real interest rates caused by surprise inflation and the pre-Accord peg, debt/GDP would have declined only from 106 percent in 1946 to 74 percent in 1974, not to 23 percent as in actual history. Our findings imply that, over the last 76 years, only a small amount of debt reduction has been achieved through growth rates that exceed undistorted interest rates. (JEL E23, E31, E43, E65, H61, H63, N12)
doi:10.1257/mac.20230357.abstract_zh: 本文研究了1951年《美联储-财政部协议》之前，基本预算盈余、意外通胀及钉住利率对美国公共债务/GDP比率的影响。我们发现，若保持基本预算平衡，且不存在由意外通胀及协议前钉住利率导致的实际利率扭曲，债务/GDP比率仅会从1946年的106%降至1974年的74%，而非实际历史中的23%。我们的研究结果表明，在过去76年间，仅有少量债务削减是通过增长率超过未扭曲利率实现的。(JEL E23, E31, E43, E65, H61, H63, N12)
doi:10.1257/mac.20230357.title: Did the United States Really Grow Out of Its World War II Debt?
doi:10.1257/mac.20230357.title_zh: 美国真的通过经济增长摆脱了二战债务吗？

doi:10.1257/mac.20230376.abstract: Employment protections often create two-tiered labor markets with substantial differences in job security. I estimate the effects of removing these protections using a quantitative life cycle model, where younger workers are more likely to select into precarious jobs. Workers accumulate human capital when employed and face the possibility of human capital losses in unemployment. Because workers with greater job security experience fewer unemployment spells, they tend to accumulate more human capital over their careers. I show that reducing employment protections boosts younger workers’ job-finding rates but lowers human capital, GDP, and employment. Impacts of these policies differ significantly by age. (JEL D15, E23, E24, J22, J24, J41, J42)
doi:10.1257/mac.20230376.abstract_zh: 就业保护往往导致劳动力市场出现两级分化，不同岗位的就业保障程度差异显著。本文通过构建量化生命周期模型，评估了取消这些保护措施的经济效应。在该模型中，年轻劳动者更倾向于选择不稳定的工作岗位。劳动者在职期间积累人力资本，而失业则面临人力资本贬损的风险。由于就业保障程度较高的劳动者经历失业的次数更少，其职业生涯中积累的人力资本往往更多。研究表明：降低就业保护虽能提升年轻劳动者的求职成功率，但会降低人力资本存量、国内生产总值及就业水平。这些政策对不同年龄段劳动者的影响存在显著差异。(JEL D15, E23, E24, J22, J24, J41, J42)
doi:10.1257/mac.20230376.title: The Life Cycle Implications of Temporary Employment Contracts
doi:10.1257/mac.20230376.title_zh: 临时雇佣合同的生命周期影响

doi:10.1257/mac.20240013.abstract: The U.S. health-services sector has grown both in terms of its expenditure share and relative price. Using a two-sector general equilibrium model with monopolistic competition and endogenous population, we find that relative price growth is almost entirely attributable to increasing relative sectoral markups. Demand effects from aging play only a minor role driving up prices and expenditure shares. Controlling for GE effects and rising relative markups, we estimate that health-sector TFP has grown since the 1980s at a rate greater than 1% annually, dampening relative price growth, while leading to higher health-sector output, partially driving up aggregate expenditure shares.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240013.abstract_zh: 美国健康服务部门的支出份额和相对价格均有所增长。通过构建一个包含垄断竞争和内生人口的两部门一般均衡模型，我们发现相对价格增长几乎完全归因于部门间相对加成率的上升。老龄化带来的需求效应对价格上涨和支出份额增加的推动作用微乎其微。在控制一般均衡效应和相对加成率上升的条件下，我们估算自20世纪80年代以来，健康部门的全要素生产率年均增长率超过1%，这抑制了相对价格增长，同时促进了健康部门产出提升，并部分推高了总支出份额。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240013.title: Health Sector Structural Change
doi:10.1257/mac.20240013.title_zh: 卫生部门的结构性变革

doi:10.1257/mac.20240018.abstract: We incorporate banks into a DSGE framework to study how interest rate hikes affect the macroeconomy. The procyclical bank balance sheets and long-term bond prices amplify adverse shocks, which can trigger a bank run. We introduce a macroprudential policy that can mitigate or prevent banking crises: an ex-ante permanent tax on bank holdings of long-term government bonds and reducing the tax rate in response to interest rate hikes. By contrast, subsidizing bank holdings of long-term investment bonds improves welfare when capital producers face loan-in-advance constraints.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240018.abstract_zh: 我们将银行纳入DSGE框架，研究加息如何影响宏观经济。顺周期的银行资产负债表和长期债券价格会放大负面冲击，从而可能引发银行挤兑。我们引入一项宏观审慎政策，该政策能够缓解或预防银行业危机：对银行持有的长期政府债券征收事前永久性税收，并在加息时降低税率。相比之下，当资本生产者面临贷款预付约束时，补贴银行持有的长期投资债券能够提升社会福利。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240018.title: Long-Term Securities and Banking Crises

doi:10.1257/mac.20240025.abstract: How worker productivity evolves with tenure and experience shapes life-cycle earnings and losses from job separation. Yet, worker-level productivity is hard to identify from observational data. This paper introduces a firm survey designed to separate effects of on-the-job tenure from sector-specific experience on the trajectory of on-the-job productivity. Several findings emerge. (i) On-the-job productivity growth initially exceeds wage growth, consistent with wages not being allocative period-by-period. (ii) Previous sector-specific experience reduces on-the-job tenure needed, though not by one-to-one, to reach a maximal productivity. (iii) There is substantial heterogeneity across jobs in the extent that previous sector-specific experience reduces tenure needed.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240025.abstract_zh: 工人生产率随任期与经验的演变，决定了生命周期内的收入水平及失业造成的损失。然而，从观测数据中识别工人层面的生产率存在困难。本文引入一项企业调查，旨在分离在职任期与行业特定经验对在职生产率轨迹的影响。研究得出以下发现：（i）在职生产率的初始增长超过工资增长，这与工资并非逐期配置性调整的结论一致；（ii）先前的行业特定经验可缩短达到最大生产率所需的在职任期，但并非完全替代关系；（iii）不同岗位中，先前行业特定经验对缩短所需任期的影响存在显著异质性。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240025.title: How Worker Productivity and Wages Grow with Tenure and Experience: The Firm Perspective
doi:10.1257/mac.20240025.title_zh: 任期与经验如何促进工人生产率与工资增长：企业视角

doi:10.1257/mac.20240030.abstract: This paper studies entrepreneurship and firm creation through the lens of serial entrepreneurs – entrepreneurs who establish more than one firm. Using data covering the universe of Chinese firms, we document key facts about serial and non-serial entrepreneurs and develop a theory rationalizing how their behavior is shaped by ability, endowments, and capital market frictions. Serial entrepreneurs have higher average productivity and lower return on capital than non-serial entrepreneurs. However, this premium conceals significant heterogeneity, with a majority of serial entrepreneurs underperforming relative to non-serial entrepreneurs. We link these differences to capital market frictions favoring some, but not all, entrepreneurs.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240030.abstract_zh: 本文通过连续创业者——即创立多家企业的创业者——的视角研究创业与企业创建。利用覆盖中国全部企业的数据，我们记录了连续创业者与非连续创业者的关键特征，并构建理论阐释能力、禀赋及资本市场摩擦如何塑造其行为。连续创业者的平均生产率高于非连续创业者，但资本回报率却更低。然而，这一优势掩盖了显著的异质性：多数连续创业者的表现不及非连续创业者。我们将这些差异归因于资本市场摩擦对部分创业者（而非全部）的偏向性影响。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240030.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1257/mac.20240030.title: Serial Entrepreneurship in China
doi:10.1257/mac.20240030.title_zh: 中国连续创业现象研究

doi:10.1257/mac.20240046.abstract: Imperfect competition within the pollution abatement equipment sector may hinder the Paris Agreement’s goals. We show that carbon tax–funded environmental subsidies can stimulate firm entry, enhance competition, and lower abatement costs for businesses. Using a quantitative macro-climate model with an endogenous market structure for abatement equipment, we estimate that optimally allocating subsidies (60% to startups and 40% to existing companies) could enhance efficiency, generating annual global GDP savings of $2.5 to $3.1 trillion by 2060.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240046.abstract_zh: 污染减排设备行业的不完全竞争可能阻碍《巴黎协定》目标的实现。我们证明，由碳税资助的环境补贴能够刺激企业进入、增强竞争并降低企业的减排成本。通过构建一个包含减排设备内生市场结构的定量宏观气候模型，我们估算出最优补贴分配（60%给予初创企业，40%给予现有企业）能够提升效率，到2060年每年可为全球GDP节省2.5至3.1万亿美元。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240046.title: Environmental Subsidies to Mitigate Net-Zero Transition Costs
doi:10.1257/mac.20240046.title_zh: 环境补贴以缓解净零转型成本

doi:10.1257/mac.20240057.abstract: This paper develops a framework in which university research depends endogenously on competition for tuition and talented students in the market for higher education. When students are highly stratified across colleges, or when tuition rises sharply with school rank, universities spend on R&D even if the direct contribution of research to teaching is small. The model is consistent with causal evidence and matches new features of the microdata. It explains why universities internally fund research with tuition, despite negligible returns to patenting. Calibrated simulations suggest that existing tuition policies boost university research while research subsidies crowd it out. (JEL I22, I23, L24, O31, O34)
doi:10.1257/mac.20240057.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个分析框架，其中大学研究内生地取决于高等教育市场中学费与优秀学生的竞争。当学生高度分层于不同院校，或学费随学校排名急剧上升时，即使研究对教学的直接贡献很小，大学也会投入研发。该模型与因果证据一致，并匹配了微观数据的新特征。它解释了为何大学会利用学费内部资助研究，尽管专利化回报微乎其微。校准模拟表明，现行学费政策促进了大学研究，而研究补贴则对其产生挤出效应。（JEL I22, I23, L24, O31, O34）
doi:10.1257/mac.20240057.title: University Research and the Market for Higher Education
doi:10.1257/mac.20240057.title_zh: 大学研究与高等教育市场

doi:10.1257/mac.20240063.abstract: We use the functional autoregressive framework of Chang, Chen, and Schorfheide (2024) to examine the effects of monetary policy shocks on the cross-sectional distributions of U.S. earnings, consumption, and financial income. An expansionary shock reduces earnings inequality, primarily by moving individuals out of unemployment, increases consumption inequality, mainly through spending on durable goods, and raises financial income inequality. We further show how an internal instrument can be used to identify the central bank’s reaction function within a VAR framework.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240063.abstract_zh: 我们采用Chang、Chen与Schorfheide（2024）的函数自回归框架，考察货币政策冲击对美国收入、消费及金融收入截面分布的影响。扩张性冲击通过推动个体脱离失业状态降低收入不平等，主要通过耐用品消费支出加剧消费不平等，并提升金融收入不平等。我们进一步论证了如何在VAR框架内利用内部工具变量识别中央银行的反应函数。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240063.title: On the Effects of Monetary Policy Shocks on Income and Consumption Heterogeneity
doi:10.1257/mac.20240063.title_zh: 货币政策冲击对收入与消费异质性影响的研究

doi:10.1257/mac.20240087.abstract: We study the cost of cartels in an oligopoly model with het- erogeneous firms, endogenous markups, and collusion. Cartels can amplify or dampen misallocation, by charging supracompetitive markups and reallocating demand towards non-colluding firms. Using French micro data, our calibrated model suggests that cartels operating in the most productive industries may decrease aggregate productivity by up to 0.4% and welfare by up to 0.7%. We also find that standard competitive oligopoly models may understate the cost of markups by about 20%.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240087.abstract_zh: 本文研究异质性企业、内生加成率与合谋行为并存寡头模型中的卡特尔成本。卡特尔通过收取超竞争加成率并将需求重新分配给非合谋企业，可能加剧或缓解资源错配。基于法国微观数据的校准模型表明，在最具生产率的行业中运营的卡特尔可能导致全要素生产率下降0.4%，福利损失高达0.7%。我们还发现，标准竞争性寡头模型可能低估加成率成本约20%。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240087.title: How Costly Are Cartels?

doi:10.1257/mac.20240107.abstract: We explore how foreign central banks behave when firms engage in currency mismatch, borrowing heavily in dollars. A central bank can deal with risky private-sector mismatch in two ways: (i) with financial regulation or (ii) by accumulating reserves to better serve as a dollar lender of last resort. We highlight a novel externality: Individual central banks may overaccumulate dollar reserves, as this exacerbates a global scarcity of dollar-denominated assets, lowering dollar interest rates and encouraging firms to further increase their currency mismatch. Relative to the decentralized outcome, a global planner may prefer tighter financial regulation and reduced holdings of dollar reserves. (JEL E43, E44, E58, F31, F41, G21, G28)
doi:10.1257/mac.20240107.abstract_zh: 本文探讨当企业存在货币错配、大量借入美元时，外国中央银行的行为模式。央行应对私营部门风险性货币错配有两种方式：（i）实施金融监管，或（ii）积累外汇储备以更好地充当美元最后贷款人。我们揭示了一种新颖的外部性：单个央行可能过度积累美元储备，因为这会加剧全球美元计价资产的稀缺性，压低美元利率，并鼓励企业进一步扩大其货币错配。相较于分散决策的结果，全球规划者可能更倾向于实施更严格的金融监管并减少美元储备持有量。（JEL E43, E44, E58, F31, F41, G21, G28）
doi:10.1257/mac.20240107.title: Central Banks as Dollar Lenders of Last Resort: Implications for Regulation and Reserve Holdings
doi:10.1257/mac.20240107.title_zh: 中央银行作为美元最后贷款人：对监管与储备持有的影响

doi:10.1257/mac.20240125.abstract: How do sovereign debt restructurings affect debt-to-GDP ratios? We explore this empirically using a comprehensive dataset covering 115 countries over 1950–2021. After addressing selection bias through an Augmented Inverse Probability Weighted estimator, we show that restructurings significantly reduce debt-to-GDP ratios over 1-5 years, with the effects working primarily through debt levels. The effect is larger when restructurings are combined with fiscal consolidation. We find heterogeneity depending on the creditor type, and the type and size of debt relief. In the short run, restructurings with higher creditor coordination, face value reductions, and larger debt reliefs, reduce debt-to-GDP ratios more effectively.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240125.abstract_zh: 主权债务重组如何影响债务与GDP的比率？我们利用涵盖1950-2021年115个国家的综合数据集对此进行了实证研究。通过采用增强逆概率加权估计量解决选择偏差后，我们发现重组在1-5年内显著降低了债务与GDP的比率，其效果主要通过债务水平发挥作用。当重组与财政整顿相结合时，这一效应更为显著。我们还发现，效果因债权人类型、债务减免的类型和规模而异。在短期内，债权人协调程度更高、面值削减幅度更大以及债务减免规模更大的重组，能更有效地降低债务与GDP的比率。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240125.title: Sovereign Debt Restructuring and Reduction in Debt-to-GDP Ratio
doi:10.1257/mac.20240125.title_zh: 主权债务重组与债务-GDP比率降低

doi:10.1257/mac.20240136.abstract: This paper studies the macroeconomic effects of free secondary schooling in the developing world. Our analysis is based on an OLG model of human capital accumulation that we estimate to match experimental evidence on the effects of secondary school scholarships. The model predicts that nationwide free secondary schooling leads to a modest gain in GDP per capita. The human capital gains from expanded education access are offset by lost income during schooling years and dampened by negative selection of new students entering secondary school. An alternative policy that spends the same resources improving school quality has significantly larger effects.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240136.abstract_zh: 本文研究发展中国家免费中等教育的宏观经济效应。我们的分析基于一个世代交叠（OLG）人力资本积累模型，该模型通过匹配中等教育奖学金效果的实验证据进行估计。模型预测，全国范围内的免费中等教育仅能带来人均GDP的适度增长。扩大教育机会带来的人力资本收益，被学生在校期间的收入损失所抵消，并因新入学中等教育学生的负向选择效应而减弱。一项将同等资源用于提升学校质量的替代政策，其效果显著更大。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240136.title: Macroeconomic Effects of ‘Free’ Secondary Schooling in the Developing World
doi:10.1257/mac.20240136.title_zh: 发展中国家"免费"中学教育的宏观经济效应

doi:10.1257/mac.20240137.abstract: We propose a new measure of interbank rate uncertainty, defined as the crosssectional dispersion in interbank market rates for overnight unsecured loans. We show that higher interbank rate uncertainty increases lending rates for firm loans, with larger impacts during financial stress episodes, like the global financial crisis and the European debt crisis. These effects are mitigated for banks with lower credit risk, stronger capital buffers, and greater access to central bank funding. We interpret these findings through a model of bank networks, where interbank rate uncertainty rises with the proportion of thinly connected networks, driving up lending rates to firms.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240137.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新的银行间利率不确定性度量指标，定义为隔夜无担保贷款银行间市场利率的横截面离散度。研究表明，银行间利率不确定性上升会提高企业贷款利率，且在金融压力时期（如全球金融危机和欧洲债务危机）影响更为显著。对于信用风险较低、资本缓冲更强以及获得央行融资渠道更广的银行，这些影响有所缓解。我们通过银行网络模型解释这些发现：当连接稀疏的网络比例上升时，银行间利率不确定性随之增加，进而推高企业贷款利率。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240137.title: Interbank Rate Uncertainty and Bank Lending
doi:10.1257/mac.20240137.title_zh: 银行间利率不确定性与银行贷款

doi:10.1257/mac.20240171.abstract: This paper studies the effects of income taxation on entrepreneurship, empirically and in a structural macro model with entrepreneurial choice. Combining state-level tax data with household and firm data we document that higher and more progressive taxation has a strong negative impact on entrepreneurial activity across time and space. To explain this relationship and to evaluate the impact of taxation on output and welfare, we develop a life cycle, incomplete markets model of the labor market with entrepreneurial choice. The model generates elasticities of entrepreneurship to taxation that are similar to those found in the empirical analysis.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240171.abstract_zh: 本文通过实证研究与包含创业选择的结构性宏观模型，探讨了所得税对创业活动的影响。结合州级税收数据与家庭及企业数据，我们证实：在跨时间与跨空间维度上，更高且更具累进性的税收对创业活动具有显著的负面效应。为解释这一关系并评估税收对产出与福利的影响，我们构建了一个包含创业选择的劳动力市场生命周期不完全市场模型。该模型生成的创业活动对税收的弹性系数与实证分析结果高度吻合。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240171.title: Taxation and Entrepreneurship in the United States

doi:10.1257/mac.20240184.abstract: We develop a novel method for the identification of monetary policy shocks. By applying natural language processing techniques to documents that Federal Reserve staff prepare in advance of policy decisions, we capture the Fed's information set. Using machine learning techniques, we then predict changes in the target interest rate conditional on this information set and obtain a measure of monetary policy shocks as the residual. We show that the documents' text contains essential information about the economy which is not captured by numerical forecasts. The dynamic responses of macro variables to our shocks are consistent with the theoretical consensus.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240184.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种识别货币政策冲击的新方法。通过将自然语言处理技术应用于美联储工作人员在政策决策前准备的文件，我们捕捉了美联储的信息集。随后，利用机器学习技术，我们基于该信息集预测目标利率的变化，并将残差作为货币政策冲击的度量。研究表明，这些文件文本包含了未被数值预测所涵盖的关键经济信息。宏观变量对冲击的动态响应与理论共识一致。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240184.title: Identifying Monetary Policy Shocks: A Natural Language Approach
doi:10.1257/mac.20240184.title_zh: 识别货币政策冲击：一种自然语言方法

doi:10.1257/mac.20240207.abstract: Black workers experience higher, more volatile unemployment than white workers, a racial dis- parity unexplained by observables. A New Keynesian model with a frictional labor market, endogenous separations, and employer discrimination explains these outcomes. We use the model to assess how alternative monetary policy strategies affect labor market outcomes by race. Switching to a monetary policy rule where interest rates respond to shortfalls of employment from its maximum level instead of deviations raises inflation and does not reduce the racial unemployment gap. A monetary policy rule where interest rates respond to the racial unemployment gap also fails to reduce the gap.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240207.abstract_zh: 黑人劳动者相较于白人劳动者面临更高且更不稳定的失业率，这一种族差异无法由可观测因素解释。一个包含摩擦性劳动力市场、内生性离职及雇主歧视的新凯恩斯模型解释了这些现象。我们利用该模型评估了不同货币政策策略如何按种族影响劳动力市场结果。若将货币政策规则调整为利率对就业水平与最大就业水平之间的缺口（而非偏离程度）作出反应，会导致通胀上升且无法缩小种族失业差距。而利率对种族失业缺口作出反应的货币政策规则同样未能缩小这一差距。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240207.title: Labor Market Discrimination and the Racial Unemployment Gap: Can Monetary Policy Make a Difference?
doi:10.1257/mac.20240207.title_zh: 劳动力市场歧视与种族失业差距：货币政策能否有所作为？

doi:10.1257/mac.20240209.abstract: What drives the recent inflation surge? To answer this question, one must decompose inflation fluctuations into the contribution of structural shocks. We document how whimsical an historical shock decomposition can be in standard vector autoregressive (VAR) models. We show that the deterministic component of the VAR is imprecisely estimated, making the shock contributions poorly identified under general conditions. Our preferred approach to solve the problem—the single-unit-root prior—massively shrinks the uncertainty around the estimated deterministic component. Once this uncertainty is taken care of, demand shocks are the main drivers of the inflation surge in the United States, the euro area, and in four small open economies.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240209.abstract_zh: 近期通胀飙升的驱动因素是什么？要回答这一问题，需将通胀波动分解为结构性冲击的贡献。我们揭示了标准向量自回归（VAR）模型中历史冲击分解可能存在的随意性。研究表明，VAR模型中的确定性成分估计精度不足，导致在一般条件下冲击贡献的识别效果较差。我们提出的解决方案——单单位根先验——大幅压缩了估计确定性成分的不确定性。在消除这一不确定性后，需求冲击成为美国、欧元区及四个小型开放经济体通胀飙升的主要驱动因素。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240209.title: What Drives the Recent Surge in Inflation? The Historical Decomposition Roller Coaster
doi:10.1257/mac.20240209.title_zh: 近期通胀飙升的驱动因素是什么？历史分解的过山车效应

doi:10.1257/mac.20240223.abstract: Inventories mitigate the risk of global sourcing. I present new evidence of the rise in U.S. manufacturing inventories after 2005, reversing a declining trend that lasted for decades. I examine this trend in a model of delivery times and inventories. The rise in global sourcing lead to longer and more volatile delivery times, which increase a firm’s exposure to risk. Thus, firms hold more inventories. I find the rise in global sourcing accounts for 86% of the rise in inventories. Further, a globalized economy that uses more foreign inputs trades-off the increase in output at the cost of increased macroeconomic volatility.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240223.abstract_zh: 库存缓解了全球采购的风险。本文提供了2005年后美国制造业库存上升的新证据，这一趋势逆转了持续数十年的下降态势。我通过构建交货时间与库存模型对此趋势展开研究。全球采购的扩张导致交货时间延长且波动加剧，从而增加了企业面临的风险敞口。因此，企业倾向于持有更多库存。研究发现，全球采购的扩张解释了库存上升的86%。此外，使用更多外国投入品的全球化经济在提升产出的同时，也以宏观经济波动加剧为代价。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240223.title: Increasing Inventories: The Role of Delivery Times
doi:10.1257/mac.20240223.title_zh: 库存增加：交货时间的作用

doi:10.1257/mac.20240245.abstract: Adjusting the rate of R&D spending is costly if the probability of converting new hires into productive R&D workers ("onboarding") is decreasing in the number of hires ("congestion"). We show that such congestion induces R&D-producing firms to hire slowly in response to good shocks, and hoard workers in response to bad shocks, providing a microfoundation for the convex adjustment costs widely used to capture the delayed, hump-shaped response of R&D spending to shocks. Using novel, high-frequency productivity data on individual software developers collected from GitHub, we document quantitative evidence suggesting that congestion is an economically-significant feature of R&D investment production.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240245.abstract_zh: 调整研发支出速度的成本高昂，前提是新员工转化为高效研发人员（即“入职适应”）的概率随招聘人数增加而下降（即“拥挤效应”）。我们证明，这种拥挤效应会促使研发型企业面对正向冲击时缓慢招聘，面对负向冲击时囤积员工，从而为广泛用于刻画研发支出对冲击呈现滞后驼峰型响应的凸调整成本提供了微观基础。通过从GitHub收集的个体软件开发者高频生产率数据，我们提供了量化证据，表明拥挤效应是研发投资生产中具有经济显著性的特征。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240245.title: Congestion in Onboarding Workers and Sticky R&D
doi:10.1257/mac.20240245.title_zh: 新员工入职拥堵与粘性研发

doi:10.1257/mac.20240248.abstract: This paper analyzes the effectiveness of a tax on inflation policy (TIP), which would require firms to pay a tax proportional to the increase in their prices or wages, in stabilizing inflation. We show that TIP would effectively correct externalities in firms’ pricing decisions, tackle excessive inflation and reduce output volatility. While proposals from the 1970s saw TIP as a substitute to MP, we find that they are complementary, with TIP addressing cost-push shocks, and MP addressing demand shocks. In sharp contrast with price controls, TIP doesn’t exacerbate relative price distortions.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240248.abstract_zh: 本文分析了通胀税政策（TIP）在稳定通胀方面的有效性，该政策要求企业按其价格或工资上涨比例缴纳税款。研究表明，TIP能够有效纠正企业定价决策中的外部性，应对过度通胀并降低产出波动。尽管20世纪70年代的提案将TIP视为货币政策的替代方案，但我们发现二者具有互补性：TIP应对成本推动冲击，而货币政策应对需求冲击。与价格管制形成鲜明对比的是，TIP不会加剧相对价格扭曲。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240248.title: Optimal Taxation of Inflation

doi:10.1257/mac.20240255.abstract: Unofficial non-tariff barriers were responsible for 50% of the reduction in Chinese imports from the U.S. during the 2018-2019 trade war. We infer NTBs from the change in imports of U.S. products relative to imports from other countries of the same HS6 product, after controlling for the change in the relative price of U.S. imports. NTBs were imposed on a small number of agricultural products, did not apply to state-owned importers, and larger for products with a high share of state importers. NTBs are more costly compared to tariffs because they only apply to some importers do not generate revenues.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240255.abstract_zh: 在2018-2019年贸易战期间，非官方非关税壁垒导致中国从美国进口减少的50%。我们通过控制美国进口相对价格变化后，比较美国产品进口变化与同一HS6产品从其他国家进口变化来推断非关税壁垒的存在。非关税壁垒仅针对少数农产品实施，不适用于国有进口商，且对国有进口商占比较高的产品影响更大。与关税相比，非关税壁垒成本更高，因其仅适用于部分进口商且不产生财政收入。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240255.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1257/mac.20240255.title: Non-Tariff Barriers in the U.S.-China Trade War
doi:10.1257/mac.20240255.title_zh: 中美贸易战中的非关税壁垒

doi:10.1257/mac.20240295.abstract: We develop a simple quantitative New Keynesian model aimed at analyzing how the reaction of monetary policy contributed to the recent rise and fall in inflation. The model includes several shocks but features oil price shocks for two reasons: (i) energy prices have been among the central factors in discussions about the surge; (ii) we can use identified oil shocks along with monetary shocks to estimate and discipline the model. We then employ the estimated framework to recover shocks without targeting inflation. Both the oil shocks and the shocks to policy accommodation played important roles in the inflation rise.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240295.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个简约的定量新凯恩斯模型，旨在分析货币政策反应如何助推近期通胀的涨落。该模型包含多种冲击，但特别引入油价冲击，原因有二：（i）能源价格一直是通胀飙升讨论中的核心因素；（ii）我们可利用已识别的石油冲击与货币冲击对模型进行估计和约束。随后，我们运用该估计框架在不以通胀为目标的情况下反推各类冲击。研究显示，石油冲击与政策宽松冲击均在通胀上升过程中发挥了重要作用。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240295.title: Oil Prices, Monetary Policy and Inflation Surges
doi:10.1257/mac.20240295.title_zh: 油价、货币政策与通胀飙升

doi:10.1257/mac.20240298.abstract: Individuals form inflation expectations based on their demographics and locations. Different demographic groups respond differently to sectoral price changes, which we exploit to identify the inflationary impact of expectations. Our shift-share instrument combines national expectations of demographic groups with these groups’ regional population shares. A one-percentage-point rise in expected inflation increases regional inflation by 60 basis points. Long-run expectations (5–10 years) have negligible effects. The estimates are most robust for younger, married individuals with at least a high school diploma, whose expectations mainly influence non-durable goods prices.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240298.abstract_zh: 个体根据其人口特征和地理位置形成通胀预期。不同人口群体对行业价格变化的反应存在差异，我们利用这一特征来识别预期对通胀的影响。我们的份额转移工具将各人口群体的全国性预期与其区域人口占比相结合。预期通胀率每上升一个百分点，区域通胀率将增加60个基点。长期预期（5-10年）的影响可忽略不计。该估计结果对至少拥有高中学历的年轻已婚个体最为稳健，其预期主要影响非耐用消费品价格。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240298.title: Identifying the Impact of Inflation Expectations

doi:10.1257/mac.20240321.abstract: I construct a novel dataset comprising over 100,000 loan observations from U.S. firms and estimate that renegotiating existing loans —rather than originating new loans —significantly contributes to the corporate investment response to monetary policy shocks, accounting for half of the aggregate effect. Expansionary monetary policy shocks increase bank credit predominantly through renegotiations, and in turn, firms that renegotiate boost investment the most. In contrast, originating new loans is driven by a firm’s investment growth prior to the shocks, consequently contributing to only a tenth of the overall investment response. Notably, renegotiations amplify investment responses for financially constrained firms.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240321.abstract_zh: 我构建了一个包含超过10万笔美国企业贷款观测值的新数据集，并估算出相较于发放新贷款，对现有贷款进行重新谈判显著增强了企业投资对货币政策冲击的反应，占总体效应的一半。扩张性货币政策冲击主要通过重新谈判增加银行信贷，而进行重新谈判的企业投资增幅最大。相比之下，新贷款的发放受冲击前企业投资增长的驱动，因此仅贡献了总体投资反应的十分之一。值得注意的是，重新谈判放大了财务受限企业的投资反应。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240321.title: The Transmission of Monetary Policy to Corporate Investment: the Role of Loan Renegotiation
doi:10.1257/mac.20240321.title_zh: 货币政策传导至企业投资：贷款重新谈判的作用

doi:10.1257/mac.20240341.abstract: Women made up only 15% of U.S. inventors in 2024. Assuming no intrinsic gender differences in inventive potential, the scarcity of women in research reveals that the U.S. is missing out on some of its brightest minds. How costly is this talent misallocation for aggregate productivity? I develop a model of semi-endogenous growth in which individuals with heterogeneous talent choose between research and production careers. However, several barriers deter women from pursuing their comparative advantage. Lifting those barriers would increase U.S. income per person by 14.1% in the long run, compared with just 1.5% from a 30% R&D subsidy alone.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240341.abstract_zh: 2024年，美国发明家中女性仅占15%。假设发明潜力不存在内在性别差异，女性在科研领域的稀缺表明美国正在错失部分最杰出的人才。这种人才错配对总体生产率造成了多大代价？我构建了一个半内生增长模型，在该模型中，具有异质性天赋的个体在科研与生产职业之间进行选择。然而，多重障碍阻碍了女性发挥其比较优势。消除这些障碍将使美国长期人均收入增长14.1%，而仅实施30%的研发补贴仅能带来1.5%的增长。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240341.title: The Lost Marie Curies and Foregone Economic Growth
doi:10.1257/mac.20240341.title_zh: 失落的玛丽·居里们与错失的经济增长

doi:10.1257/mac.20240388.abstract: A slowdown in population growth reduces business dynamism by increasing the share of older firms. We explore how this affects productivity growth using a business dynamics model with endogenous productivity. The growth rate of older firms is a key factor in determining the impact of population growth on productivity. Quantitatively, this effect is substantial for both the U.S. and Japan. In the U.S., slowing population growth reduces TFP growth by 0.3 percentage points from 1970 to 2060, with an even larger effect in Japan. However, TFP growth reacts slowly due to short-run counterbalancing factors.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240388.abstract_zh: 人口增长放缓通过提高老牌企业的占比，削弱了商业活力。我们利用一个包含内生生产率的企业动态模型，探讨了这种变化如何影响生产率增长。老牌企业的增长率是决定人口增长对生产率影响的关键因素。从量化角度看，这一效应在美国和日本均十分显著。在美国，1970年至2060年间，人口增长放缓使全要素生产率（TFP）增长率下降了0.3个百分点，而日本的降幅更大。然而，由于短期内的抵消因素，TFP增长的反应较为缓慢。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240388.title: From Population Growth to TFP Growth
doi:10.1257/mac.20240388.title_zh: 从人口增长到全要素生产率增长

doi:10.1257/mac.20240405.abstract: As climate changes and natural disasters intensify, the threat of human displacement increases. This paper studies carbon taxation in the presence of international climate displacement. After providing evidence on the migration response to disasters, forced climate migration is introduced into a quantitative climatemacroeconomic model to theoretically characterize the global and local social costs of carbon—SCCs, equivalently, optimal carbon taxes. These change substantially when this type of migration is considered. A North-South calibration reveals that, while migration increases the local SCC in host regions—more so if political conflict is considered—the origin region and global SCCs are not much affected.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240405.abstract_zh: 随着气候变化与自然灾害加剧，人类流离失所的威胁日益增加。本文研究了存在国际气候移民情况下的碳税问题。在提供灾害移民响应证据后，将强迫性气候移民引入量化气候宏观经济模型，从理论上刻画全球与地方碳的社会成本（SCCs），即最优碳税。当考虑此类移民时，这些成本发生显著变化。南北校准结果显示，虽然移民提高了接收地区的本地SCC（若考虑政治冲突则影响更大），但来源地区与全球SCC并未受到显著影响。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240405.title: Warming with Borders: Forced Climate Migration and Carbon Pricing
doi:10.1257/mac.20240405.title_zh: 带有边界的变暖：被迫气候迁移与碳定价

doi:10.1257/mac.20240438.abstract: We analyze the impact of reduced financial constraints on innovating firms' performance and access to credit using a reform that allowed firms to use patents as collateral. We develop a theoretical framework to guide the analysis and quantify the aggregate impact of reduced financial constraints on misallocation and productivity by mapping data moments, reduced form results and model counterparts. Our empirical results suggest that reduced financial constraints led to an increase in firms' capital stock and bank debt. Parameterizing the model we find quantitatively large gains in output per worker in the sectors of the economy dominated by constrained firms.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240438.abstract_zh: 我们利用一项允许企业以专利作为抵押品的改革，分析了金融约束缓解对创新企业绩效和信贷获取的影响。我们构建了一个理论框架来指导分析，并通过匹配数据矩、简化形式结果与模型对应项，量化了金融约束缓解对资源错配和生产率的总体影响。实证结果表明，金融约束缓解导致企业资本存量和银行债务增加。通过参数化模型，我们发现，在受约束企业主导的经济部门中，人均产出实现了显著的量化增长。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240438.title: Strapped for Cash: The Role of Financial Constraints for Innovating Firms, Misallocation and Aggregate Productivity Growth
doi:10.1257/mac.20240438.title_zh: 资金紧张：金融约束对创新企业、资源错配及全要素生产率增长的作用

doi:10.1257/mac.20240526.abstract: In less developed economies the allocation of factor inputs to more productive farms is often hindered. To analyze how distortions affect farm dynamics and agricultural productivity, we develop a model of heterogeneous farms investing in productivity improvements. We calibrate the model using detailed farm-level panel data from Vietnam, exploiting regional differences in agricultural institutions. We focus on south Vietnam and quantify the effect of higher measured distortions in the North. We find that the higher distortions in the North reduce agricultural productivity by 38%, accounting for 55% of the observed 2.5-fold difference between regions.
doi:10.1257/mac.20240526.abstract_zh: 在欠发达经济体中，生产要素向高生产率农场的配置往往受到阻碍。为分析扭曲如何影响农场动态与农业生产力，我们构建了一个异质性农场投资于生产率改进的模型。利用越南详细的农场层面面板数据，我们借助农业制度的区域差异对模型进行校准。研究聚焦越南南方，并量化了北方地区较高测量扭曲的影响。结果表明，北方较高的扭曲导致农业生产力下降38%，这解释了观测到的区域间2.5倍生产力差异的55%。
doi:10.1257/mac.20240526.title: Distortions, Producer Dynamics, and Aggregate Productivity: A General Equilibrium Analysis
doi:10.1257/mac.20240526.title_zh: 扭曲、生产者动态与总生产率：一般均衡分析

doi:10.1257/mac.20250109.abstract: This paper investigates declining U.S. labor share by employing a multisector model that incorporates the input-output structure of the economy. Analyzing data from 1957 to 2016, we find that increasing markups account for the majority of the decline. Input-output linkages significantly amplified a modest increase in sectoral markups. Capital deepening had large direct effects in the goods sector but structural change offset this effect by reallocating output from the goods to the services sector. In contrast, markups increased in both sectors so structural change does not have an offsetting effect.
doi:10.1257/mac.20250109.abstract_zh: 本文通过构建一个包含经济投入产出结构的多部门模型，研究美国劳动份额下降的原因。基于1957年至2016年的数据分析，我们发现加价率的上升是劳动份额下降的主要原因。投入产出关联显著放大了部门加价率的温和增长。资本深化在商品部门产生了较大的直接效应，但结构变化通过将产出从商品部门重新配置到服务部门抵消了这一效应。相比之下，加价率在两个部门均有所上升，因此结构变化并未产生抵消作用。
doi:10.1257/mac.20250109.title: Labor Share, Markups, and Input-Output Linkages – Evidence from the U.S. National Accounts
doi:10.1257/mac.20250109.title_zh: 劳动份额、加成率与投入产出关联——来自美国国民账户的证据

doi:10.1257/mac.20250382.abstract: Economic growth is typically measured in per capita terms. A long tradition in philosophy, however, suggests that social welfare may depend on the number of people as well. To illustrate how much this matters quantitatively, we decompose welfare growth — measured in consumption-equivalent (CE) units — into contributions from rising population and rising per capita consumption. Because of diminishing marginal utility from consumption, population growth is scaled up by a value-of-life factor that empirically averages nearly 3 across countries since 1960. Population increases are therefore a major contributor to growth if one takes a total utilitarian perspective.
doi:10.1257/mac.20250382.abstract_zh: 经济增长通常以人均指标衡量。然而，哲学领域的悠久传统表明，社会福利可能同样取决于人口数量。为量化这一影响程度，我们将福利增长（以消费等价单位衡量）分解为人口增长与人均消费增长的贡献。由于消费边际效用递减，人口增长需乘以生命价值因子进行加权——该因子自1960年以来跨国实证均值接近3。因此，若采用总体功利主义视角，人口增长将成为经济增长的主要贡献因素。
doi:10.1257/mac.20250382.title: Population and Welfare: Measuring Growth when Life is Worth Living
doi:10.1257/mac.20250382.title_zh: 人口与福利：当生命值得生活时如何衡量增长

doi:10.1257/mac.20250510.abstract: We study how U.S. monetary policy shocks transmit to cross-border merger and acquisition (M&A) activity. Using country- and firmlevel data, tighter U.S. policy is shown to reduce both the value and the number of cross-border deals. The effects are especially pronounced for acquirer firms with larger foreign-currency liabilities, consistent with a net worth channel. Reflecting agency motives for acquisitions, deals announced under more accommodative U.S. conditions underperform ex post, indicating potential capital misallocation.
doi:10.1257/mac.20250510.abstract_zh: 本文研究美国货币政策冲击如何传导至跨境并购活动。基于国家和企业层面数据，我们发现美国政策收紧会同时降低跨境交易的价值与数量。对于外币负债规模较大的收购方企业，这一效应尤为显著，与净资产渠道的传导机制相吻合。反映并购中的代理动机，在美国政策宽松时期宣布的交易在事后表现欠佳，表明可能存在资本错配现象。
doi:10.1257/mac.20250510.title: Cross-Border Spillovers: How U.S. Monetary Conditions Affect M&As Around the World
doi:10.1257/mac.20250510.title_zh: 跨境溢出效应：美国货币政策如何影响全球并购活动

doi:10.1257/mic.20220226.abstract: Social scientists often consider temporal stability when assessing a construct and its measures, but whether behavioral biases display such stability is relatively unknown. We estimate stability for 17 biases, using lab-style elicitations in online surveys repeated three years apart. Biases are stable in the aggregate and at least moderately stable within-person. Within-person stability estimates tend to meet or exceed those for standard quantitative measures of patience and risk aversion, despite various pieces of evidence suggesting that classical measurement error substantially attenuates them. We consider implications for micro and macro modeling with potentially behavioral agents, and for survey and elicitation design.
doi:10.1257/mic.20220226.abstract_zh: 社会科学家在评估构念及其测量时通常考虑时间稳定性，但行为偏差是否表现出这种稳定性尚不明确。我们利用相隔三年重复进行的在线调查中的实验室式诱发方法，估算了17种偏差的稳定性。这些偏差在总体层面具有稳定性，且在个体内部至少达到中等程度的稳定性。尽管多项证据表明经典测量误差会显著削弱个体内稳定性估计值，但其仍趋向于达到或超过耐心与风险规避的标准量化测量指标。我们探讨了这些发现对潜在行为主体参与的微观与宏观建模，以及调查与诱发设计的启示意义。
doi:10.1257/mic.20220226.title: Behavioral Biases are Temporally Stable
doi:10.1257/mic.20220226.title_zh: 行为偏差具有时间稳定性

doi:10.1257/mic.20220232.abstract: This paper studies the pricing implications of wholesale and agency contracts when input terms are determined through bargaining. We develop a structural Nash-in-Nash bargaining model and show that the distribution of bargaining power determines whether agency contracts raise or lower retail prices relative to wholesale contracts. We apply the model to the e-book market, which transitioned from wholesale to agency contracts after the expiration of a ban on agency contracting. Estimates indicate that the retailers have most of the bargaining power. Counterfactual simulations show that most-favored-nation clauses raise prices but would lower the profits of the publishers and Amazon. (JEL C78, D86, K21, L14, L42, L81, L82)
doi:10.1257/mic.20220232.abstract_zh: 本文研究了当投入条款通过谈判确定时，批发合同与代理合同对定价的影响。我们构建了一个结构化的纳什-纳什谈判模型，并证明谈判力的分布决定了代理合同相对于批发合同是提高还是降低零售价格。我们将该模型应用于电子书市场，该市场在代理合同禁令到期后从批发合同转向代理合同。估计结果表明，零售商拥有大部分谈判力。反事实模拟显示，最惠国待遇条款会提高价格，但会降低出版商和亚马逊的利润。（JEL C78, D86, K21, L14, L42, L81, L82）
doi:10.1257/mic.20220232.title: Agency Pricing and Bargaining: Evidence from the E-Book Market
doi:10.1257/mic.20220232.title_zh: 代理定价与议价：来自电子书市场的证据

doi:10.1257/mic.20230120.abstract: We study the possibility of identifying time-inconsistent preferences in empirical designs where preferences are elicited in advance at time 0 and then again at time 1, after the agent receives additional information. For single-peaked preferences, time consistency is rejected only when the time-1 ranking between a pair of alternatives is always the reverse of the time-0 ranking. We establish variations and generalizations of this result. Since such stark reversals are rarely observed, choice-revision designs require stronger identification assumptions than perhaps previously appreciated. But we show that time inconsistency is identifiable in environments where preferences over alternatives can be “priced out.” (JEL D11, D15, D83, D86)
doi:10.1257/mic.20230120.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在实证设计中识别时间不一致偏好的可能性，其中偏好是在时间0提前引出，并在时间1（代理人获得额外信息后）再次引出。对于单峰偏好，只有当时间1对某对备选方案的排序始终与时间0的排序相反时，时间一致性才被拒绝。我们建立了这一结果的变体与推广形式。由于这种截然相反的逆转现象极少被观察到，选择修正设计所需的识别假设可能比以往所认知的更为严格。但我们证明，在能够对备选方案偏好进行“定价”的环境中，时间不一致性是可识别的。（JEL D11, D15, D83, D86）
doi:10.1257/mic.20230120.title: Dynamic Preference "Reversals" and Time Inconsistency
doi:10.1257/mic.20230120.title_zh: 动态偏好“逆转”与时间不一致性

doi:10.1257/mic.20230224.abstract: We experimentally study how cognitive noise affects behavior in coordination games. Our key testable prediction is that equilibrium behavior depends on context, which we define as the distribution from which games are drawn. This prediction arises from players efficiently using their limited cognitive resources. Furthermore, this prediction distinguishes cognitive noise from a large class of alternative behavioral game theory and learning models. Experimentally, we find that subjects coordinate more frequently when game payoffs are drawn from a narrower distribution. Nearly 50% of the variability in behavior can be attributed to cognitive noise rather than alternative sources of strategic uncertainty.
doi:10.1257/mic.20230224.abstract_zh: 我们通过实验研究了认知噪声如何影响协调博弈中的行为。我们的核心可检验预测是，均衡行为取决于情境，即博弈抽取的分布。这一预测源于参与者高效利用其有限的认知资源。此外，该预测将认知噪声与一大类替代性行为博弈理论和学习模型区分开来。实验发现，当博弈收益从较窄的分布中抽取时，参与者协调的频率更高。行为中近50%的变异性可归因于认知噪声，而非其他战略不确定性来源。
doi:10.1257/mic.20230224.title: Coordination with Cognitive Noise

doi:10.1257/mic.20230265.abstract: We investigate whether an agency can increase employment by strategically coarsening information provided to employers about workers' skills. Theoretically, we find that such an increase is possible under fixed wages, and a range of employment levels can occur in equilibrium. We test this possibility using laboratory experiments under three conditions: full information, coarse and verifiable information, and coarse but not verifiable information. We find that, relative to full information, both coarse-information treatments increase employment at the expense of employers' profits, but not to the highest theoretically achievable levels. We also find that verifiability affects several aspects of behavior.
doi:10.1257/mic.20230265.abstract_zh: 我们研究中介机构是否可以通过策略性地向雇主提供关于工人技能的粗化信息来增加就业。理论上，我们发现，在固定工资条件下，这种就业增长是可能的，且均衡状态下可能出现多种就业水平。我们通过实验室实验在三种条件下检验这一可能性：完全信息、粗化且可验证信息、以及粗化但不可验证信息。研究发现，相较于完全信息，两种粗化信息处理均以牺牲雇主利润为代价提高了就业水平，但未达到理论上的最高水平。此外，可验证性对行为的多个方面产生了影响。
doi:10.1257/mic.20230265.title: Increasing Employment with Coarse Information
doi:10.1257/mic.20230265.title_zh: 利用粗略信息增加就业

doi:10.1257/mic.20230279.abstract: Penny-picking refers to the often-observed phenomenon of repeatedly taking negatively skewed risks and seems directly at odds with evidence on (positive-)skewness-seeking as observed in static settings. We show that penny-picking may not only occur despite skewness-seeking, but—seemingly paradoxically—because of skewness-seeking. With sufficient time available, risks with arbitrary negative skewness can be gambled in such a way that, overall, skewness is positive. Therefore, classical behavioral theories like prospect theory straightforwardly explain penny-picking. More generally, we show that the versatile dynamics of skewness reconcile apparent preference reversals concerning the avoidance and acceptance of (skewed and non-skewed) risks. (JEL D81, D91, G11, G41)
doi:10.1257/mic.20230279.abstract_zh: 捡硬币”现象指反复承担负偏态风险的常见行为，这与静态环境下观察到的（正）偏态偏好证据直接矛盾。我们证明，捡硬币行为不仅可能发生在偏态偏好存在的情况下，而且——看似矛盾地——恰恰源于偏态偏好。当时间足够充裕时，任意负偏态风险可通过特定博弈方式转化为整体正偏态。因此，前景理论等经典行为理论能直接解释捡硬币现象。更一般地，我们揭示了偏态的动态特性如何调和了关于规避与接受（偏态与非偏态）风险的表面偏好反转现象。（JEL D81, D91, G11, G41）
doi:10.1257/mic.20230279.title: On Taking a Skewed Risk More than Once
doi:10.1257/mic.20230279.title_zh: 关于多次承担偏斜风险

doi:10.1257/mic.20230285.abstract: A group of agents with ex ante independent and identically uncertain quality compete for a prize, awarded by a principal. Agents may possess evidence about the quality of those they share a social connection with (neighbors), and themselves. In one equilibrium, adversarial disclosure of evidence leads the principal to statistically discriminate between agents based on their number of neighbors (degree). We identify parameter values for which an agent’s ex ante winning probability is monotone in degree. All equilibria that satisfy some robustness criteria lie between this adversarial disclosure equilibrium and a less informative one that features no snitching and no discrimination. (JEL D82, D83, D85, Z13)
doi:10.1257/mic.20230285.abstract_zh: 一群事前独立且同分布质量不确定的代理人竞争由委托人授予的奖项。代理人可能掌握其社交关系对象（邻居）及自身质量的证据。在某一均衡中，证据的对抗性披露导致委托人根据代理人拥有的邻居数量（度数）进行统计性歧视。我们识别出使代理人事前获胜概率随度数单调变化的参数区间。所有满足某些稳健性标准的均衡均介于该对抗性披露均衡与一个信息量更少（无告密且无歧视）的均衡之间。（JEL D82, D83, D85, Z13）
doi:10.1257/mic.20230285.title: Strategic Evidence Disclosure in Networks and Equilibrium Discrimination
doi:10.1257/mic.20230285.title_zh: 网络中的策略性证据披露与均衡歧视

doi:10.1257/mic.20240014.abstract: This paper develops a search-and-matching model where potential partners can learn about their compatibility as a couple by spending time together (interpreted as dating). We show that a steady-state equilibrium exists and characterize its induced dating patterns. In equilibrium, highly attractive individuals are more selective. We derive conditions under which equilibria induce positive assortative matching, and show that even when these conditions hold, the socially optimal outcome can exhibit negative assortative matching. Finally, the framework is applied to study the effect of recent advances in search technologies on dating patterns and the connection between dating and interracial segregation.
doi:10.1257/mic.20240014.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个搜索匹配模型，其中潜在伴侣可通过共度时光（即约会）来了解彼此作为情侣的兼容性。我们证明了稳态均衡的存在性，并刻画了其诱发的约会模式特征。在均衡状态下，高吸引力个体更具选择性。我们推导出均衡产生正向选型匹配的条件，并证明即使这些条件成立，社会最优结果仍可能呈现负向选型匹配。最后，该框架被应用于研究搜索技术的最新进展对约会模式的影响，以及约会与种族隔离现象之间的关联。
doi:10.1257/mic.20240014.title: Learning in the Marriage Market: The Economics of Dating
doi:10.1257/mic.20240014.title_zh: 婚姻市场中的学习：约会的经济学

doi:10.1257/mic.20240045.abstract: We study quality distortions when firms hold market power. We develop a model allowing for flexible functional forms of demand in order to extend Spence’s (1975) monopoly analysis to imperfect competition. We show that quality distortions are determined by a competition effect that captures the externality a firm exerts on its competitors when raising both its price and its quality, in addition to Spence’s (1975) effect related to the shape of total market demand. Our approach also allows us to analyze the effects of commodity taxation and technology shocks on the equilibrium allocation when firms compete in prices and qualities. (JEL D43, D62, H22, L13, L15, O31)
doi:10.1257/mic.20240045.abstract_zh: 本文研究企业在拥有市场势力时的质量扭曲问题。我们构建了一个允许需求函数具有灵活形式的模型，将斯彭斯（1975）的垄断分析拓展至不完全竞争市场。研究表明，质量扭曲由竞争效应决定——该效应捕捉了企业在同时提高价格与质量时对竞争对手产生的外部性，此外还包含斯彭斯（1975）提出的与总市场需求形态相关的效应。我们的方法还允许分析当企业在价格与质量维度展开竞争时，商品税与技术冲击对均衡配置的影响。（JEL分类号：D43, D62, H22, L13, L15, O31）
doi:10.1257/mic.20240045.title: Quality and Imperfect Competition

doi:10.1257/mic.20240053.abstract: Why do firms outsource research and development (R&D) for some products while conducting R&D in-house for similar ones? An innovating firm risks cannibalizing its existing products. The more profitable these products, the more the firm wants to limit cannibalization. We apply this logic to the organization of R&D by introducing a novel theoretical model in which developing in-house provides the firm more control over the new product’s location in product space. An empirical analysis of our testable predictions using pharmaceutical data concerning patents, patent expiration, and outsourcing at various stages of the R&D process supports our theoretical approach. (JEL D21, D22, L22, L24, L65, O31, O34)
doi:10.1257/mic.20240053.abstract_zh: 为什么企业会对某些产品外包研发，而对类似产品进行内部研发？创新企业面临蚕食现有产品的风险。现有产品利润越高，企业就越想限制这种蚕食。我们将这一逻辑应用于研发组织方式，提出了一个新颖的理论模型：内部研发能让企业更好地控制新产品在产品空间中的定位。我们利用制药行业关于专利、专利到期以及研发各阶段外包的数据，对可检验的预测进行了实证分析，结果支持了我们的理论方法。（JEL D21, D22, L22, L24, L65, O31, O34）
doi:10.1257/mic.20240053.title: The Organization of Innovation: Incomplete Contracts and the Outsourcing Decision
doi:10.1257/mic.20240053.title_zh: 创新的组织：不完全合同与外包决策

doi:10.1257/mic.20240062.abstract: We study the effect of a merger on R&D activity in a dynamic model with uncertainty about the feasibility of innovation. The merger has three effects: It may reduce the number of follow-up innovations (cannibalization effect), increase the probability of the first game-changer innovation (appropriability effect), and bring this innovation forward in time (informational effect). The model suggests mergers are more desirable when R&D outcomes are highly uncertain, but less so when the innovation path is clearer. A surprising policy implication is that the benefit of the merger may be higher if the first and subsequent innovations are closer substitutes. (JEL D21, D83, G34, O31)
doi:10.1257/mic.20240062.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在创新可行性不确定的动态模型中，并购对研发活动的影响。并购具有三种效应：可能减少后续创新的数量（蚕食效应）、提高首个颠覆性创新的概率（占有效应），以及使该创新提前实现（信息效应）。模型表明，当研发结果高度不确定时，并购更可取；而当创新路径较为清晰时，并购的吸引力则较低。一个令人意外的政策启示是：若首次创新与后续创新之间的替代性越强，并购的收益可能越高。（JEL D21, D83, G34, O31）
doi:10.1257/mic.20240062.title: The Effect of Mergers on Innovation

doi:10.1257/mic.20240094.abstract: This paper examines the role of land in wealth dynamics and its consequences on efficiency and inequality. We focus on the interplay among agents’ bidding for location, mortgage market imperfections, and inheritance in a model in which agents leave to their heirs financial bequests and their housing wealth. The borrowing constraint generates a housing return premium and spatial wealth sorting, which translate into persistent wealth inequality. Since altruism and the borrowing constraint distort land price formation, we show that taxing land rent transmitted between generations is optimal. Land taxation cannot be disconnected from taxation on intergenerational wealth transfers.
doi:10.1257/mic.20240094.abstract_zh: 本文探讨土地在财富动态中的作用及其对效率与不平等的影响。我们聚焦于一个模型中代理人区位竞标、抵押市场不完善与遗产继承之间的相互作用，其中代理人向继承人遗赠金融资产及住房财富。借贷约束导致住房回报溢价与空间财富分层，进而转化为持续的财富不平等。由于利他主义与借贷约束扭曲了土地价格形成机制，我们证明对代际传递的土地租金征税是最优选择。土地税制无法脱离代际财富转移税制而独立存在。
doi:10.1257/mic.20240094.title: Land, Wealth, and Taxation

doi:10.1257/mic.20240100.abstract: The multinational wage premium is well documented across countries. Using a new German dataset, we identify two previously overlooked determinants. First, wages paid by foreign multinationals in German plants increase with the distance between headquarters and the plant location. Second, foreign multinationals headquartered near their German plants pay lower wages than domestic multinationals, implying a negative border effect. We develop a model with plant-specific wages and firms choosing between exporting and foreign production. Distance reduces the attractiveness of exporting, making firms more willing to accept higher wages in more distant foreign locations.
doi:10.1257/mic.20240100.abstract_zh: 跨国工资溢价在各国均有充分证据。利用德国新数据集，我们识别出两个此前被忽视的决定因素。其一，在德国工厂中，外国跨国公司支付的工资随总部与工厂所在地距离增加而上升。其二，总部靠近其德国工厂的外国跨国公司支付的工资低于国内跨国公司，这表明存在负向边界效应。我们构建了一个包含工厂特定工资及企业在出口与海外生产之间进行选择的模型。距离降低了出口的吸引力，使企业更愿意在更远的海外地点接受更高工资。
doi:10.1257/mic.20240100.title: How Border and Distance Effects Shape the Multinational Wage Premium
doi:10.1257/mic.20240100.title_zh: 边界与距离效应如何塑造跨国工资溢价

doi:10.1257/mic.20240147.abstract: We study a two-period commodity market with competitive consumers and Cournot sellers. Without speculation, equilibrium is stationary. A storage-capable, strategically large speculator can profitably create deterministic intertemporal price dispersion using standard order types. A period-1 limit buy order flattens residual demand, induces higher output, and yields a low purchase price. With mandatory liquidation, resale remains below the no-speculation price but above the purchase price, so the speculator profits; consumers gain and sellers lose. With free disposal and a stop-loss, the period-2 price can exceed the benchmark, benefiting sellers but harming consumers.
doi:10.1257/mic.20240147.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个包含竞争性消费者和古诺卖方的两期商品市场。在没有投机的情况下，市场均衡是稳定的。一个具备仓储能力且规模较大的策略性投机者，能够利用标准订单类型，有确定性地创造跨期价格差异。第一期的限价买入订单会压低剩余需求，促使产量增加，并形成较低的购买价格。在强制清算条件下，转售价格仍低于无投机时的价格，但高于购买价格，因此投机者获利；消费者受益，而卖方受损。在允许自由处置并设置止损的情况下，第二期价格可能超过基准水平，从而使卖方受益，但损害消费者利益。
doi:10.1257/mic.20240147.title: Strategic Limit Orders and Intertemporal Price Dispersion
doi:10.1257/mic.20240147.title_zh: 战略限价订单与跨期价格离散

doi:10.1257/mic.20240174.abstract: In a novel ‘identify the Expert’ task, participants receive suggested answers by two advisors. They know one is high-accuracy and recommends answers reflecting the academic consensus (‘Expert’). The other is low-accuracy and recommends the modal answer from a sample of laypeople (‘Populist’). Participants are incentivized to identify the Expert. Yet, they overwhelmingly choose the Populist, even when they could always identify the Expert without using Bayesian reasoning. Overconfidence hampers decision making, but does not fully account for the low success rate. Bayesian models fail to explain these choices. These results are relevant for a wide range of expert selection problems.
doi:10.1257/mic.20240174.abstract_zh: 在一项新颖的“识别专家”任务中，参与者会收到两位顾问提供的建议答案。他们知道其中一位准确率较高，且其推荐答案反映了学术共识（“专家”）；另一位准确率较低，推荐的是从普通民众样本中得出的众数答案（“民粹者”）。参与者被激励去识别专家。然而，他们绝大多数选择了民粹者，即便在不使用贝叶斯推理的情况下，他们本可以始终识别出专家。过度自信阻碍了决策，但并不能完全解释这种低成功率。贝叶斯模型无法解释这些选择。这些结果对广泛的专家选择问题具有启示意义。
doi:10.1257/mic.20240174.title: ‘Identify the Expert’: an Experimental Study in Economic Advice
doi:10.1257/mic.20240174.title_zh: 识别专家”：经济建议的实验研究

doi:10.1257/mic.20240188.abstract: This paper examines efficient allocations in economies where consumers exhibit heterogeneous smooth ambiguity preferences and face model uncertainty with a common set of identifiable models. Aggregate endowment is ambiguous. We characterize economies where the representative consumer is of the smooth ambiguity type and derive efficient sharing rules. Heterogeneous ambiguity aversion leads to sharing rules that systematically differ from those in vNM economies. The representative consumer’s ambiguity aversion differs from that of the typical consumer; this leads to more compelling asset-pricing predictions. We focus on point-identified models but show that our insights extend to partially identified models. (JEL D11, D61, D81, E32, G12)
doi:10.1257/mic.20240188.abstract_zh: 本文研究了消费者具有异质性平滑模糊偏好且面临共同可识别模型集下的模型不确定性时的经济有效配置问题。总禀赋具有模糊性。我们刻画了代表性消费者属于平滑模糊类型的经济体特征，并推导出有效的风险分担规则。异质性模糊厌恶导致的风险分担规则与vNM经济体中的规则存在系统性差异。代表性消费者的模糊厌恶程度与典型消费者不同，这产生了更具说服力的资产定价预测。本文重点研究点识别模型，但论证了相关见解可推广至部分识别模型。（JEL分类号：D11, D61, D81, E32, G12）
doi:10.1257/mic.20240188.title: Sharing Model Uncertainty

doi:10.1257/mic.20240239.abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel way to measure behavioral heterogeneity in a population of stochastic individuals. Our measure is choice-based; it evaluates the probability that, over a randomly selected menu, the sampled choices of two sampled individuals differ. We provide axiomatic foundations for this measure and a decomposition result that separates heterogeneity into its intrapersonal and interpersonal components. (JEL D01, D11, D91)
doi:10.1257/mic.20240239.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种衡量随机个体群体中行为异质性的新方法。该度量基于选择行为，评估在随机选取的菜单上，两个随机个体的抽样选择存在差异的概率。我们为这一度量提供了公理化基础，并给出了一个分解结果，将异质性区分为个体内与个体间两个组成部分。（JEL D01, D11, D91）
doi:10.1257/mic.20240239.title: A Measure of Behavioral Heterogeneity

doi:10.1257/mic.20240245.abstract: We introduce a new type of games, called “opportunity-hunting games,” in which two players compete to discover an uncertain event (“opportunity”) that occurs at an unobserved and random point in time. Players can inspect whether the event has already occurred again and again, but each inspection is costly. Varying the parameters of the model spans the range from games where competition between the players to be the first to identify the opportunity is the dominant force, to games in which free riding on the other player’s effort is the dominant force. We characterize the game’s unique symmetric Markov perfect equilibrium. (JEL C72, C73)
doi:10.1257/mic.20240245.abstract_zh: 我们引入了一类新型博弈，称为“机会搜寻博弈”。在该博弈中，两个参与者竞相发现一个在未观测到的随机时间点发生的不确定事件（即“机会”）。参与者可以反复检查该事件是否已经发生，但每次检查都需要付出成本。通过调整模型参数，该博弈涵盖了从“抢先识别机会的竞争”为主导力量，到“搭便车利用对方努力”为主导力量的全范围情形。我们刻画了该博弈唯一的对称马尔可夫完美均衡。（JEL分类号：C72, C73）
doi:10.1257/mic.20240245.title: Opportunity Hunters: A Model of Competitive Sequential Inspections
doi:10.1257/mic.20240245.title_zh: 机会猎手：竞争性序贯检查模型

doi:10.1257/mic.20240258.abstract: This paper measures concentration in narrowly defined product markets for a broad range of consumer goods and services in the United States from 1994 to 2019. We document two main empirical facts. First, concentration levels are high. Of the markets in our sample, 44.4 percent are “highly concentrated” as defined by US regulators. Second, market concentration has been decreasing since 1994. The median HHI falls from 2,362 to 2,045. These findings stand in stark contrast to the prior literature, which uses market definitions that are aggregated to a level that is typically too broad to accurately reflect competition in consumer markets. (JEL D43, L13, M37, R32)
doi:10.1257/mic.20240258.abstract_zh: 本文以1994年至2019年美国广泛消费品与服务市场为对象，在狭义产品市场层面测度市场集中度。我们揭示了两项主要实证发现：第一，市场集中度水平较高。按美国监管机构定义，样本中44.4%的市场属于"高度集中"市场。第二，自1994年以来市场集中度持续下降，赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数中位数从2,362降至2,045。这些发现与既有文献形成鲜明对比——既有研究采用的市场定义通常过于宽泛，难以准确反映消费品市场的竞争状况。(JEL D43, L13, M37, R32)
doi:10.1257/mic.20240258.title: Concentration in Product Markets

doi:10.1257/mic.20240280.abstract: Complementarities and peer effects are common in matching markets, yet incorporating them often leads to nonexistence of stable matchings. We observe that matching is often an ongoing process rather than a static allocation, where long-lived firms interact over time with short-lived workers. We show that when wages are flexible and firms are sufficiently patient, a dynamically stable solution always exists in many-to-one matching markets — even with complementarities and peer effects. Flexible wages are crucial to our result, as they not only facilitate surplus extraction when firms cooperate in no-poaching agreements but also enhance the threat of punishment through bidding wars. (JEL C72, C73, C78, D21, D62, J31, J41)
doi:10.1257/mic.20240280.abstract_zh: 互补性与同伴效应在匹配市场中普遍存在，但将其纳入模型往往导致稳定匹配的缺失。我们观察到，匹配通常是一个持续的过程而非静态配置——长期存续的企业与短期工作的劳动者会随时间推移持续互动。研究表明，在工资具有灵活性且企业具备充分耐心的条件下，多对一匹配市场中始终存在动态稳定解——即便存在互补性与同伴效应。灵活工资机制对结论至关重要：它不仅在企业达成互不挖角协议时促进剩余提取，更能通过竞价战强化惩罚威胁。（JEL分类号：C72, C73, C78, D21, D62, J31, J41）
doi:10.1257/mic.20240280.title: Self-Enforced Job Matching

doi:10.1257/mic.20240293.abstract: We develop a model of competing diffusions of goods on a social network. There are two types of goods and individuals: mass-market and niche-market. We find that there is a unique stable steady state and show that the adoption of a massmarket good is greater than its population share. Furthermore, greater connectivity and homophily in the social network will concurrently increase the prevalence of niche-market goods. If there is a strategic agent who wants to promote a niche good, she will invest more in influencing activities than one promoting mass-market goods. When individuals choose their degree of homophily, we show that niche-market individuals exhibit greater homophily than mass-market ones.
doi:10.1257/mic.20240293.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个社交网络中商品竞争性扩散的模型。模型包含两类商品与两类个体：大众市场型与利基市场型。研究发现存在唯一稳定的稳态，且大众市场型商品的采纳率高于其人口占比。此外，社交网络中的更高连通性与同质性会同时提升利基市场型商品的普及程度。若存在战略代理人试图推广利基商品，其投入的影响活动成本将高于推广大众市场型商品的代理人。当个体自主选择同质性程度时，我们证明利基市场型个体比大众市场型个体表现出更强的同质性。
doi:10.1257/mic.20240293.title: Competing Diffusions in a Social Network
doi:10.1257/mic.20240293.title_zh: 社交网络中的竞争性扩散

doi:10.1257/mic.20240297.abstract: We demonstrate how selection in competitive markets can impede longrun reputational incentives. In our model, competent firms can exert costly effort to improve expected product quality, but inept firms cannot. With low entry barriers, we show competent firms cannot persistently exert effort, despite bounded memory. Such effort would cause consumers to select firms based on reputations for competence, eventually selecting a monopolist with arbitrarily high reputation, which has no incentive for effort. More generally, reputation-based selection rules out long-run effort, which then undermines the basis for such selection. Intermediate entry barriers provide stronger reputational incentives than low or high barriers.
doi:10.1257/mic.20240297.abstract_zh: 我们展示了竞争市场中的选择机制如何阻碍长期声誉激励。在我们的模型中，有能力的企业可以通过付出高昂努力来提升预期产品质量，而无能的企业则无法做到。在低进入壁垒条件下，我们发现即使存在有限记忆，有能力的企业也无法持续付出努力。这种努力会导致消费者基于企业能力声誉进行选择，最终筛选出具有任意高声誉的垄断者，而该垄断者缺乏付出努力的动机。更一般地，基于声誉的选择机制排除了长期努力的可能性，而这反过来又削弱了此类选择机制的基础。中等程度的进入壁垒比低壁垒或高壁垒能提供更强的声誉激励。
doi:10.1257/mic.20240297.title: Reputation and Competitive Selection

doi:10.1257/mic.20240301.abstract: This paper studies a model of heterogeneous importers that incorporates static cross-country interdependence and dynamic dependence in firmlevel decisions. Using data on Chinese importers between 2000–2006, I find that source countries are complementary, i.e., the benefit of importing from one country increases as a firm imports from more countries. Accounting for this complementarity, I estimate the sunk costs of importing, which make establishing relationships with new suppliers costlier than maintaining existing ones. I illustrate how the sunk cost estimates depend on cross-country interdependence and model specifications, such as the inclusion of export decisions.
doi:10.1257/mic.20240301.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个异质性进口商模型，该模型融合了企业层面决策的静态跨国相互依赖性与动态依赖性。基于2000-2006年中国进口商数据，研究发现来源国之间存在互补性，即企业从一国进口的收益会随其进口来源国数量的增加而提升。在考虑这种互补性的基础上，本文估算了进口的沉没成本——建立新供应商关系的成本高于维持现有关系的成本。研究进一步揭示了沉没成本估算如何受跨国相互依赖性与模型设定（如是否纳入出口决策）的影响。
doi:10.1257/mic.20240301.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1257/mic.20240301.title: The Dynamics of Global Sourcing

doi:10.1257/mic.20240303.abstract: In order to study updating rules, we consider the problem of a malevolent principal screening an imperfectly Bayesian agent. We uncover a fundamental dichotomy between underreaction and overreaction to information. If, for some signal realization, the agent’s updating rule produces a posterior that lies outside the convex hull of the Bayesian posteriors induced by the signal structure, then she can be exploited by the principal without bound: her ex ante expected loss can be made arbitrarily large. In contrast, an agent who underreacts–whose posterior after each signal realization lies between the prior and the corresponding Bayesian posterior–cannot be exploited at all.
doi:10.1257/mic.20240303.abstract_zh: 为研究更新规则，我们考察了恶意委托人筛选非完全贝叶斯代理人的问题。研究发现信息反应不足与反应过度之间存在根本性二分：若对于某些信号实现值，代理人的更新规则产生的后验概率落在信号结构所诱导的贝叶斯后验概率凸包之外，则委托人可无上限地利用该代理人——其事前预期损失可被任意放大。反之，采取反应不足策略的代理人（其各信号实现值对应的后验概率始终介于先验概率与相应贝叶斯后验概率之间）则完全不会被利用。
doi:10.1257/mic.20240303.title: The Perils of Overreaction

doi:10.1257/mic.20240326.abstract: Perceived shortcomings in the dominant asset market format, CDA, have provoked reform proposals including Flow, which features gradual trading. We report a laboratory experiment comparing formats in a simple single-asset private values environment. We find that Flow reduces price volatility, enhances liquidity, and encourages traders to send fewer and larger orders, indicating more effective shredding. In our simple environment, both formats deliver comparable trading volume, allocative efficiency and price efficiency.
doi:10.1257/mic.20240326.abstract_zh: 对主流资产市场形式CDA的感知缺陷引发了包括Flow在内的改革提案，其特点是渐进式交易。我们报告了一项实验室实验，在简单的单一资产私人价值环境中比较了不同市场形式。研究发现，Flow降低了价格波动性，增强了流动性，并促使交易者发送更少但更大的订单，表明更有效的订单拆分。在我们的简单环境中，两种形式在交易量、配置效率和价格效率方面表现相当。
doi:10.1257/mic.20240326.title: A Laboratory Test of Flow Trading
doi:10.1257/mic.20240326.title_zh: 流动交易的一项实验室检验

doi:10.1257/mic.20240340.abstract: Does more information benefit voters? I examine this question in a novel setting of distributive politics and electoral accountability. Homogeneously informed electorates can benefit from less information through improvements in the control or screening of politicians. For heterogeneously informed electorates, I show that the distribution of resources and voter welfare is affected by the nature of informational heterogeneity and by voters’ ability to communicate with each other, making less-informed voters better off than their more-informed counterparts in some cases. (JEL D72, D82, D83, H50)
doi:10.1257/mic.20240340.abstract_zh: 更多信息是否有利于选民？我在分配政治与选举问责这一新颖情境中探讨了该问题。信息同质的选民群体可能因信息减少而受益，这源于对政治家控制或筛选机制的改善。对于信息异质的选民群体，研究表明资源分配与选民福利受信息异质性特征及选民间沟通能力的影响，在某些情况下信息较少的选民反而比信息更多的选民处境更优。（JEL D72, D82, D83, H50）
doi:10.1257/mic.20240340.title: Voter Information and Distributive Politics

doi:10.1257/mic.20240428.abstract: Can an educational system without ability tracking and signalling motive generate self-sorting of students by ability? We build a theoretical model to show that when seeking positive peer effects is combined with costly educational choices, even in the absence of exogenous requirements on achievements used in standard tracking systems, high-achieving students self-sort by choosing costly courses, which we refer to as endogenous tracking. We use data from French middle schools, where students were grouped together based on their choices between Spanish and effort-costly German language classes, to show that costly language class choices lead to sorting and to identify peer effects.
doi:10.1257/mic.20240428.abstract_zh: 一个缺乏能力分层和信号动机的教育体系，能否促使学生按能力进行自我分类？我们构建了一个理论模型，表明当追求正向同伴效应与高成本教育选择相结合时，即使没有标准分层体系中对学业成绩的外生要求，高成就学生也会通过选择高成本课程实现自我分类——我们将此称为内生分层。我们利用法国初中数据（学生根据西班牙语与高努力成本的德语课程选择进行分组）证明，高成本语言课程选择会导致分层现象，并识别出同伴效应。
doi:10.1257/mic.20240428.title: Endogenous Tracking: Sorting and Peer Effects
doi:10.1257/mic.20240428.title_zh: 内生追踪：分类与同伴效应

doi:10.1257/mic.20240465.abstract: We develop a dynamic model of narrative-based political competition. Voters recall the frequency of policies and outcomes, but not their correlation. Politicians exploit such coarse memory by crafting plausible narratives that overstate their policy’s effectiveness, reattributing outcomes to steal credit and shift blame. Because plausibility makes narrative optimism fall with policy implementation, incumbency erodes narrative advantage. This force generates endogenous policy cycles and, in the long run, makes tenure independent of true policy effectiveness. Extensions to analogy-based expectations, preferences for truth-telling, and heterogeneous voter feedback show how our mechanisms operate in richer settings that restore a role for policy effectiveness.
doi:10.1257/mic.20240465.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个基于叙事的政治竞争动态模型。选民能够回忆政策与结果的频率，但无法记住两者之间的相关性。政客利用这种粗粒度的记忆，通过编造看似合理的叙事来夸大其政策的有效性，重新归因结果以窃取功劳并推卸责任。由于叙事的合理性会随着政策实施而降低其乐观程度，执政地位会逐渐削弱叙事优势。这一机制催生了内生性政策周期，从长期来看，执政时长将独立于政策的真实有效性。通过拓展至基于类比的预期、偏好诚实陈述以及异质性选民反馈等情境，我们展示了上述机制如何在更丰富的设定中发挥作用，从而恢复政策有效性的作用。
doi:10.1257/mic.20240465.title: Coarse Memory and Plausible Narratives

doi:10.1257/mic.20240475.abstract: In many markets the interaction between individuals and competing firms is mediated by a strategic platform. A defining feature of modern platforms is their extensive ability to control interactions. To understand such markets, I incorporate within-side externalities into a general mechanism-design model of many-to-many matching in two-sided markets. I characterize platform-optimal mechanisms and establish comparative statics. I analyze the implications and welfare effects of changes in market structure, including vertical integration by the platform and changes in the platform's information about firms. I then extend the canonical Dixit-Stiglitz model of monopolistic competition by giving the platform control over consideration sets.
doi:10.1257/mic.20240475.abstract_zh: 在许多市场中，个体与竞争企业之间的互动由战略性平台中介。现代平台的一个显著特征是其对互动的广泛控制能力。为理解此类市场，我将同侧外部性纳入双边市场中多对多匹配的一般机制设计模型。我刻画了平台最优机制并建立了比较静态分析，进而探讨市场结构变化（包括平台纵向整合及平台对企业信息的变化）的影响与福利效应。最后，我通过赋予平台对考虑集合的控制权，扩展了经典的迪克西特-斯蒂格利茨垄断竞争模型。
doi:10.1257/mic.20240475.title: Platform-Mediated Competition

doi:10.1257/mic.20250004.abstract: This study experimentally examines a non-cooperative implementation of the core. The protocol adopts a continuous-time frame, which allows a flexible coalition formation process. In the experiment, the core can be a singleton, a set of points that excludes the equal split, or an expanded set of points that includes the equal split. Meanwhile, predictions of the nucleolus and the Shapley value are also discussed for comparison. Results show that although the grand coalition is not always agreed on, the payoffs averaged across all formed coalitions are consistent with the core’s prediction in each scenario.
doi:10.1257/mic.20250004.abstract_zh: 本研究通过实验考察了核心的非合作实现方式。实验协议采用连续时间框架，允许灵活的联盟形成过程。在实验中，核心可以是单点集、排除均分结果的点集，或包含均分结果的扩展点集。同时，为便于比较，还讨论了核仁解和沙普利值的预测结果。结果表明，尽管大联盟并非总能达成一致，但在每种情境下，所有已形成联盟的平均收益均与核心的预测结果一致。
doi:10.1257/mic.20250004.title: An Experimental Implementation of the Core

doi:10.1257/mic.20250013.abstract: We characterize the symmetric equilibria of a pre-auction game of investment in an internet ad auction environment. For a wide class of auction formats, we show a symmetric equilibrium exists for the pre-auction investment game, is essentially unique, and is the same for all auction formats in the class; we give sufficient conditions for the symmetric equilibrium to be in pure strategies, and to achieve the efficient level of investment. Finally, we show comparative statics results with respect to a variety of parameters.
doi:10.1257/mic.20250013.abstract_zh: 本文刻画了互联网广告拍卖环境中投资前博弈的对称均衡特征。对于一大类拍卖形式，我们证明投资前博弈存在对称均衡，该均衡本质唯一，且对该类所有拍卖形式均相同；我们给出了对称均衡为纯策略均衡并实现有效投资水平的充分条件。最后，我们展示了关于多种参数的比较静态分析结果。
doi:10.1257/mic.20250013.title: Symmetric Equilibrium in Pre-Auction Investment
doi:10.1257/mic.20250013.title_zh: 拍卖前投资中的对称均衡

doi:10.1257/mic.20250032.abstract: We study a behavioral SIR model with time-varying costs of distancing. We explore the consequences of distancing fatigue and public policies. For a second wave to arise, a steep increase in distancing cost is necessary. We introduce prudent distancing fatigue and show that it cannot trigger a second wave. Both prevalence and fatigue are single-peaked, with fatigue peaking after prevalence. However, policy changes that discontinuously increase distancing costs can cause a second wave, and we characterize the largest such change that avoids it. Finally, numerical analysis shows that an early strict lockdown can have unintended adverse effects.
doi:10.1257/mic.20250032.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个具有时变社交距离成本的行为SIR模型，探讨了社交距离疲劳与公共政策的后果。要引发第二波疫情，社交距离成本必须急剧上升。我们引入了审慎的社交距离疲劳概念，并证明其无法触发第二波疫情。患病率与疲劳程度均呈单峰形态，且疲劳峰值晚于患病率峰值。然而，导致社交距离成本不连续增加的政策变化可能引发第二波疫情，我们刻画了避免该情况的最大政策变动幅度。最后，数值分析表明，早期严格封锁可能产生非预期的负面效应。
doi:10.1257/mic.20250032.title: Time-Varying Cost of Distancing: Distancing Fatigue and Lockdowns
doi:10.1257/mic.20250032.title_zh: 时变疏离成本：疏离疲劳与封锁措施

doi:10.1257/mic.20250034.abstract: This paper shows that health insurers’ decisions to include providers in their networks are influenced by a previously underappreciated source of cost savings: network administrative costs. These costs counteract insurers’ incentives to offer narrow networks, which in standard models arise from risk selection and negotiated prices. Using a structural model of insurer competition over network breadth applied to Colombia, I find that insurers engage in risk selection by excluding providers in services used by unprofitable patients, but that heterogeneity in administrative costs leads some insurers to offer broader networks. Results inform the design of risk adjustment and network adequacy policies.
doi:10.1257/mic.20250034.abstract_zh: 本文表明，健康保险公司将医疗服务提供者纳入其网络的决定受到一个此前未被充分认识的成本节约来源的影响：网络行政成本。这些成本抵消了保险公司提供窄网络的激励——在标准模型中，这种激励源于风险选择和协商价格。通过将保险公司在网络广度上的竞争结构模型应用于哥伦比亚，我发现保险公司通过排除不盈利患者所使用服务的提供者来进行风险选择，但行政成本的异质性导致部分保险公司提供更广泛的网络。研究结果为风险调整和网络充分性政策的设计提供了参考。
doi:10.1257/mic.20250034.title: Determinants of Healthcare Provider Networks: Risk Selection vs. Administrative Costs
doi:10.1257/mic.20250034.title_zh: 医疗提供者网络的决定因素：风险选择 vs. 行政成本
