doi:10.1257/mic.20250039.abstract: We study a new market design for K-12 broadband procurement that switched from school-specific bidding to a system that bundled schools into groups. Using an event study approach, we estimate that this program reduced internet prices by $9.17 (55%) per Mbps per month while increasing bandwidth by 380.06 Mbps (136%). These benefits resulted primarily from mitigating exposure risk—the possibility that providers win too few contracts to cover their fixed infrastructure costs. We document participants’ potential savings of $1.61–$3.48 million relative to their $2.47 million E-rate subsidy.
doi:10.1257/mic.20250039.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种面向K-12宽带采购的新市场设计，该设计将原本按学校单独招标的模式转变为将学校捆绑成组的系统。通过事件研究方法，我们估计该计划使每Mbps月均互联网价格降低了9.17美元（降幅55%），同时带宽增加了380.06 Mbps（增幅136%）。这些收益主要源于缓解了暴露风险——即供应商可能因赢得合同数量过少而无法覆盖其固定基础设施成本的可能性。我们记录到，参与者相对于其247万美元的E-rate补贴，潜在节省金额为161万至348万美元。
doi:10.1257/mic.20250039.title: The Benefits from Bundling Demand in K-12 Broadband Procurement
doi:10.1257/mic.20250039.title_zh: K-12宽带采购中捆绑需求带来的收益

doi:10.1257/mic.20250077.abstract: We consider duopoly competition under aggregate demand uncertainty, where firms compete by choosing reserve prices and holding uniform-price auctions. Consumers observe their valuation, but not the demand state, commit to a firm and participate in its auction. Our model captures the features of several important markets involving surge pricing during peak periods. If market demand is sufficiently elastic, then equilibrium reserve prices do not bind. If market demand in the low state is sufficiently inelastic, then at least one firm chooses a binding reserve price. We characterize the linear demand case. We also show that more demand uncertainty softens competition.
doi:10.1257/mic.20250077.abstract_zh: 本文研究总需求不确定下的双寡头竞争，企业通过选择保留价格并举行统一价格拍卖进行竞争。消费者观察到自身估值但无法获知需求状态，承诺选择一家企业并参与其拍卖。我们的模型捕捉了多个重要市场中高峰时段动态定价的特征。若市场需求弹性充足，则均衡保留价格不会产生约束；若低需求状态下的市场缺乏弹性，则至少有一家企业会选择具有约束力的保留价格。我们刻画了线性需求情形，并进一步证明需求不确定性的增加会弱化市场竞争。
doi:10.1257/mic.20250077.title: Reserve Price Competition with Demand Uncertainty
doi:10.1257/mic.20250077.title_zh: 需求不确定下的保留价格竞争

doi:10.1257/mic.20250084.abstract: We develop an organizational governance model with a single buyer and endogenous upstream entry. Investments and control rights over assets and actions are immediately contractable; production is contractable after uncertainty resolves. We show the following: Supplier competition eliminates pre-entry bargaining frictions. To minimize post-entry bargaining frictions, control rights over assets and actions are always bundled. If entry is sufficiently cheap, there is frictionless post-entry competition, sometimes due to buyer sponsorship. Otherwise, only one supplier enters. There is vertical integration if the asset’s expected profitability is highest in the buyer’s favorite use; if not, the buyer contracts with an autonomous supplier.
doi:10.1257/mic.20250084.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含单一买方与内生上游进入的组织治理模型。投资及对资产与行动的控制权可即时签约；生产合约则在不确定性消除后签订。研究结果表明：供应商竞争消除了进入前的议价摩擦。为最小化进入后的议价摩擦，资产与行动的控制权始终捆绑配置。若进入成本足够低，则进入后竞争无摩擦——有时源于买方赞助；反之，仅有一家供应商进入。当资产预期盈利性在买方偏好用途中最高时，企业选择纵向一体化；否则，买方将与独立供应商签订合约。
doi:10.1257/mic.20250084.title: Markets, Contracts, and Hierarchies: How Bargaining Frictions Affect Governance
doi:10.1257/mic.20250084.title_zh: 市场、合同与层级：议价摩擦如何影响治理

doi:10.1257/mic.20250128.abstract: Standard procurement models assume that the buyer knows the quality of the good at the time of procurement; however, in many settings, the quality is learned only long after the transaction. We study procurement problems in which the buyer’s valuation of the supplied good depends directly on its quality, which is unverifiable and unobservable to the buyer. For a broad class of procurement problems, we identify procurement mechanisms maximizing any weighted average of the buyer’s expected payoff and social surplus. The optimal mechanism can be implemented via an auction that restricts sellers to submitting bids within specific intervals.
doi:10.1257/mic.20250128.abstract_zh: 标准采购模型假设买方在采购时已知商品质量；然而在许多情境下，质量需在交易完成很久之后才能获知。本文研究买方对供应商品的估值直接取决于其质量（该质量不可验证且买方无法观测）的采购问题。针对一大类采购问题，我们识别出能最大化买方预期收益与社会剩余加权平均值的采购机制。该最优机制可通过限制卖方在特定区间内提交报价的拍卖方式实施。
doi:10.1257/mic.20250128.title: Optimal Procurement Design: A Reduced-Form Approach
doi:10.1257/mic.20250128.title_zh: 最优采购设计：一种简约形式方法

doi:10.1257/mic.20250153.abstract: Transplant center oversight—conducted through costly flagging based on survival rates—is intended to improve outcomes. However, it has faced challenges because centers strategically select patients (and organs) to improve their reported outcomes. We study the optimal flagging policy using a mechanism-design model in which heterogeneous centers can improve their survival rates by investing, selecting patients, or both. We find that (a) the optimal mechanism never flags intrinsically good-enough center types, and (b) under the optimal mechanism, intrinsically worse centers select patients, while intrinsically better centers underinvest. These results apply to the regulation of charter schools and development banks.
doi:10.1257/mic.20250153.abstract_zh: 移植中心监管——通过基于存活率的成本高昂的标记机制——旨在改善治疗结果。然而，该机制面临挑战，因为中心会策略性地选择患者（及器官）以提升其报告结果。我们采用机制设计模型研究最优标记政策，其中异质性中心可通过投资、患者选择或两者结合来改善存活率。研究发现：(a) 最优机制从不标记内在质量足够好的中心类型；(b) 在最优机制下，内在质量较差的中心会进行患者选择，而内在质量较好的中心则投资不足。这些结论同样适用于特许学校与开发银行的监管。
doi:10.1257/mic.20250153.title: Optimal Costly Oversight with Investment and Cream-Skimming
doi:10.1257/mic.20250153.title_zh: 投资与撇脂行为下的最优高成本监管

doi:10.1257/mic.20250192.abstract: In many environments, agents form agreements that have externalities or are multilateral, and may view some agreements as substitutable and others as complementary. This paper presents an approach that ensures the existence of stable outcomes in any environment, including those with arbitrary externalities, preferences, and market structures. It does so by endogenizing the agents’ choice functions while employing the standard stability concept. Instead of assuming that each agent chooses their favorite set of contracts, we require agents to choose optimally given correct beliefs about the choices of others, and show that stable outcomes are uniquely pinned down by those beliefs.
doi:10.1257/mic.20250192.abstract_zh: 在许多环境中，代理人达成的协议具有外部性或涉及多方，且可能将某些协议视为可替代的，而将其他协议视为互补的。本文提出了一种方法，确保在任何环境中（包括具有任意外部性、偏好和市场结构的环境）都存在稳定结果。该方法通过内生化代理人的选择函数，同时采用标准的稳定性概念来实现。我们并未假设每个代理人会选择其最偏好的合同组合，而是要求代理人在对其他代理人选择持有正确信念的情况下做出最优选择，并证明稳定结果由这些信念唯一确定。
doi:10.1257/mic.20250192.title: Matching with Strategic Consistency

doi:10.1257/mic.20250239.abstract: We study a principal who allocates a good to agents with private, independently distributed values through an optimal mechanism. The principal can strategically shape these value distributions by modifying the good’s features, which affect agents’ valuations. Our analysis reveals that optimal designs are frequently divisive – creating goods that appeal strongly to specific agents or agent types while being less valued by others. These divisive designs reduce information rents and increase total surplus, even though they reduce competition. Even when total surplus is constrained, some divisiveness in designs remains optimal.
doi:10.1257/mic.20250239.abstract_zh: 我们研究一位委托人通过最优机制将商品分配给具有私人且独立分布价值的代理人。委托人可以通过调整商品特性来策略性地塑造这些价值分布，从而影响代理人的估值。分析表明，最优设计往往具有分化性——即创造出的商品对特定代理人或代理人类型具有强烈吸引力，而其他代理人对其评价较低。这种分化设计虽然减少了竞争，但降低了信息租金并增加了总剩余。即使在总剩余受到约束的情况下，设计中保留一定程度的分化性仍是最优选择。
doi:10.1257/mic.20250239.title: Divisive by Design: Shaping Values in Optimal Mechanisms
doi:10.1257/mic.20250239.title_zh: 设计分裂：最优机制中的价值观塑造

doi:10.1257/mic.20250260.abstract: A profit-maximizing monopolist curates a database for users seek- ing to learn a parameter. There are two user types: "Nowcasters" wish to learn the parameter's current value, while "forecasters" target its long-run value. Data storage involves a constant marginal cost. The monopolist designs a menu of contracts described by fees and data-access levels. The profit-maximizing menu o¤ers full access to historical data, while current data is fully provided to nowcasters but may be withheld from forecasters. Compared to the social optimum, the monopolist keeps too much historical data, too little current data, and may store too much data overall.
doi:10.1257/mic.20250260.abstract_zh: 一个追求利润最大化的垄断者为试图学习某个参数的用户构建数据库。用户分为两类："即时预测者"希望了解该参数的当前值，而"长期预测者"则关注其长期值。数据存储涉及恒定的边际成本。垄断者设计了一套由费用和数据访问权限组成的合同菜单。利润最大化的菜单提供对历史数据的完全访问，同时当前数据被完全提供给即时预测者，但可能对长期预测者有所保留。与社会最优相比，垄断者保留了过多的历史数据、过少的当前数据，并且整体上可能存储了过多的数据。
doi:10.1257/mic.20250260.title: Monopolistic Data Dumping

doi:10.1257/mic.20250318.abstract: I study how the ability to erase records affects patient players’ returns from building reputations. In my model, a patient seller interacts with a sequence of myopic consumers. The seller is either an honest type who always exerts effort and never erases any records, or an opportunistic type who may shirk and can also erase his past actions at a low cost. I show that the seller has an incentive to exert effort until he has a long enough good record, after which his continuation value exceeds his commitment payoff. However, once the seller is sufficiently long-lived, his equilibrium payoff must be close to his minmax value.
doi:10.1257/mic.20250318.abstract_zh: 本文研究记录删除能力如何影响耐心玩家通过建立声誉获得的回报。在模型中，一位耐心卖家与一系列短视消费者进行互动。卖家分为两种类型：一种是始终付出努力且从不删除任何记录的诚实型，另一种是可能偷懒且能以低成本删除过往行为的投机型。研究表明，卖家有动力持续付出努力，直至其积累足够长的良好记录，此时其延续价值将超过承诺收益。然而，一旦卖家存续时间足够长，其均衡收益必然趋近于最小最大值。
doi:10.1257/mic.20250318.title: Reputation Effects with Endogenous Records
doi:10.1257/mic.20250318.title_zh: 内生记录下的声誉效应

doi:10.1257/mic.20250372.abstract: We provide an axiomatic foundation for the classical problem of compensating workers when effort is unobserved. The employer holds Bayesian beliefs about workers’ effort, observes output precisely or imprecisely, and seeks fairness. We introduce axioms tailored to this asymmetric-information environment and show that they determine a unique closed-form reward rule, the informational Bayesian value (IBV). The IBV can be interpreted as a contract between an uninformed employer and workers. We then analyze worker disappointment under this rule and show that average disappointment is zero, whether evaluated ex-post, interim, or ex-ante. Consequently, fair compensation prevents worker disappointment in the long run.
doi:10.1257/mic.20250372.abstract_zh: 我们为努力不可观测时工人补偿的经典问题提供了公理化基础。雇主对工人的努力持有贝叶斯信念，能够精确或非精确地观测产出，并追求公平性。我们针对这一信息不对称环境引入了特定公理，并证明这些公理唯一确定了一个闭式奖励规则——信息贝叶斯价值（IBV）。IBV可被解释为不知情雇主与工人之间的契约。随后我们分析了该规则下的工人失望程度，结果表明无论是事后、中期还是事前评估，平均失望度均为零。因此，公平补偿能够在长期中防止工人产生失望情绪。
doi:10.1257/mic.20250372.title: Bayesian Fairness: Reward Rule and Disappointment under Information Asymmetry
doi:10.1257/mic.20250372.title_zh: 贝叶斯公平：信息不对称下的奖励规则与失望

doi:10.1257/pol.20200892.abstract: We examine whether vertical integration of hospitals and skilled nursing facilities (SNFs) could lessen competition by foreclosing rival SNFs’ access to lucrative referrals. We find that it could: Among integrated providers, a 1 percent increase in SNF reimbursement for a given patient discharged from the upstream hospital increases the self-referral rate to the hospital’s downstream SNF(s) by 1.8 percent. We find no evidence of offsetting benefits for patients and payers: These increased self-referrals have an imprecisely estimated zero effect on patient outcomes and Medicare spending. (JEL G34, I11, I13, J14, L14, L22)
doi:10.1257/pol.20200892.abstract_zh: 本文考察了医院与专业护理机构（SNFs）的纵向整合是否可能通过阻断竞争性SNFs获取高利润转诊渠道而削弱市场竞争。研究发现确实存在此效应：在整合型医疗服务提供者中，上游医院出院患者的SNF报销比例每增加1%，该医院向下游自有SNF的自我转诊率将提升1.8%。未发现对患者及支付方存在补偿性收益的证据：这些增加的自我转诊对患者预后及医保支出的影响呈现不精确的零效应。（JEL分类号：G34, I11, I13, J14, L14, L22）
doi:10.1257/pol.20200892.title: Vertical Integration and Cream Skimming of Profitable Referrals: The Case of Hospital-Owned Skilled Nursing Facilities
doi:10.1257/pol.20200892.title_zh: 纵向整合与盈利转诊的“撇脂”行为：以医院自营专业护理机构为例

doi:10.1257/pol.20220332.abstract: I investigate the intrahousehold labor and resource allocation consequences of an employment guarantee targeting rural households in India. The guarantee insures household earnings, replacing women as added workers and shutting down a motive for saving. Despite sizable program-job take-up, the guarantee decreases participation in other working activities and, thus, labor force participation of married women and total time worked by their husbands. The guarantee accounts for up to 30 percent of a recent countrywide decrease in rural female labor force participation. Though it increases household consumption, the guarantee reduces the command of women’s household earnings and, thereby, their well-being. (JEL D13, G51, I32, J16, J22, J68, O12)
doi:10.1257/pol.20220332.abstract_zh: 本文研究了印度农村家庭就业保障计划对家庭内部劳动与资源配置的影响。该保障计划为家庭收入提供保险，替代了女性作为补充劳动力的角色，并消除了储蓄动机。尽管该计划下的项目就业参与率较高，但它减少了其他工作活动的参与，从而降低了已婚女性的劳动参与率及其丈夫的总工作时间。该计划可解释近期全国农村女性劳动参与率下降的30%。虽然该计划增加了家庭消费，但它削弱了女性对家庭收入的支配权，进而降低了其福利水平。（JEL分类号：D13, G51, I32, J16, J22, J68, O12）
doi:10.1257/pol.20220332.title: Guaranteed Employment in Rural India: Intrahousehold Labor and Resource Allocation Consequences
doi:10.1257/pol.20220332.title_zh: 印度农村的就业保障：家庭内劳动力与资源配置效应

doi:10.1257/pol.20220777.abstract: Do informational interventions work because they lead subjects to merely update beliefs in the right direction or, to a large extent, because they increase the salience of the decision they target? We randomly assign parents to either an information group, who receives text messages with weekly data on their child’s attendance and school effort, or a salience group, who receives messages that try to redirect their attention without child-specific information. While information has large impacts on attendance, test scores and grade promotion relative to the control group, outcomes in the salience group improve by at least as much.
doi:10.1257/pol.20220777.abstract_zh: 信息干预之所以有效，是因为它们仅仅引导受试者朝正确方向更新信念，还是很大程度上因为它们提高了所针对决策的显著性？我们将家长随机分为两组：信息组每周收到关于孩子出勤和学习努力程度的短信数据，而显著性组则收到旨在引导其注意力但不包含孩子具体信息的短信。与对照组相比，信息组在出勤率、考试成绩和年级晋升方面产生了显著影响，而显著性组的结果改善幅度至少与之相当。
doi:10.1257/pol.20220777.title: When the Effects of Informational Interventions Are Driven by Salience – Evidence from School Parents in Brazil
doi:10.1257/pol.20220777.title_zh: 当信息干预的效果由显著性驱动——来自巴西学生家长的证据

doi:10.1257/pol.20220801.abstract: We study the role of international financial integration in buffering natural disaster shocks, using a large sample of advanced and emerging economies. Natural disasters are largely unpredictable and unrelated to the state of financial integration. We document that integration improves the absorption of such shocks: Output, consumption, and investment are significantly higher after a natural disaster in states with high than in states with low integration. The benefits are most clear for advanced economies. Emerging markets tend to profit from financial integration, too, but the estimates are less precise unless we condition on institutional quality or consider only debt assets. (JEL E21, E22, E23, F32, F33, F34, Q54)
doi:10.1257/pol.20220801.abstract_zh: 本文利用发达经济体与新兴经济体的广泛样本，研究国际金融一体化在缓冲自然灾害冲击中的作用。自然灾害在很大程度上具有不可预测性，且与金融一体化程度无关。我们证实，金融一体化能够改善此类冲击的吸收效果：在自然灾害发生后，金融一体化程度较高的经济体，其产出、消费和投资水平显著高于一体化程度较低的经济体。这种效益在发达经济体中最为明显。新兴市场同样能从金融一体化中获益，但除非我们以制度质量作为条件或仅考虑债务资产，否则相关估计结果的精确度较低。（JEL分类号：E21, E22, E23, F32, F33, F34, Q54）
doi:10.1257/pol.20220801.title: Integrating Out Natural Disaster Shocks

doi:10.1257/pol.20230070.abstract: This paper studies the conditions under which legislators promote policies that may be unpopular in the short term but yield long-term benefits. Using data on the universe of federal disaster declarations from 1989 to 2020, we document that representatives from congressional districts impacted by hurricanes are more inclined to support environmental legislation addressing climate change. However, this response depends on political circumstances: only those in safe seats can change their political agenda towards policies that involve short-term costs for long-term gains. These results highlight the role of electoral incentives in shaping politicians’ attitudes towards far-sighted policy making.
doi:10.1257/pol.20230070.abstract_zh: 本文研究了立法者在何种条件下会推动短期内可能不受欢迎但能带来长期利益的政策。利用1989年至2020年联邦灾害声明的全样本数据，我们发现，受飓风影响的国会选区代表更倾向于支持应对气候变化的环境立法。然而，这种反应取决于政治环境：只有处于安全席位的代表才能将政治议程转向涉及短期成本但带来长期收益的政策。这些结果凸显了选举激励在塑造政治家对远见政策制定态度中的作用。
doi:10.1257/pol.20230070.title: Hurricanes, Climate Change Policies and Electoral Accountability
doi:10.1257/pol.20230070.title_zh: 飓风、气候变化政策与选举问责

doi:10.1257/pol.20230136.abstract: I study how publicly released school social climate information is capitalized into housing markets and affects household sorting. Using the initial release of school climate ratings in Chicago as a plausibly exogenous information shock, I combine a border discontinuity design with event-study and difference-in-differences analyses. I find that homes assigned to higher climate ratings experience price increases and find suggestive evidence that higher-income families sort into these homes. These effects dissipate within a year as information salience declines. A subsequent ratings release generated muted capitalization, but higher-income households continued to react, consistent with unequal access to information.
doi:10.1257/pol.20230136.abstract_zh: 本文研究公开的学校社会氛围信息如何被资本化至住房市场，并影响家庭分类。利用芝加哥首次发布学校氛围评级作为准外生信息冲击，我将边界断点设计与事件研究法和双重差分分析相结合。研究发现，被分配到较高氛围评级的房屋价格出现上涨，并发现高收入家庭倾向于选择这些房屋的初步证据。随着信息显著性的下降，这些效应在一年内消散。后续评级发布产生的资本化效应减弱，但高收入家庭仍持续反应，这与信息获取不平等的情况一致。
doi:10.1257/pol.20230136.title: The Value of School Social Climate Information: Evidence from Chicago Housing Transactions
doi:10.1257/pol.20230136.title_zh: 学校社会氛围信息的价值：来自芝加哥住房交易的证据

doi:10.1257/pol.20230294.abstract: This paper develops a structural model of endogenous product attribute choice in the presence of indirect network effects to study electric vehicle (EV) subsidies. Using data on the German EV market, I find that a support scheme almost doubled EV sales but substantially affected EVs’ price and driving range. These adjustments create a trade-off between optimizing different policy objectives when designing subsidies. Large purchase subsidies maximize EV sales, whereas large charging station subsidies maximize consumer and total surplus. The results suggest that maximizing EV sales can lead to unintended consequences in the form of price and range adjustments. (JEL D12, D22, D85, H25, L14, L62, R41)
doi:10.1257/pol.20230294.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个存在间接网络效应时内生产品属性选择的结构模型，用以研究电动汽车补贴政策。基于德国电动汽车市场数据，我发现补贴计划使电动汽车销量几乎翻倍，但显著影响了其价格与续航里程。这些调整在设计补贴时形成了不同政策目标之间的权衡：高额购车补贴能最大化电动汽车销量，而高额充电站补贴则能最大化消费者剩余与总剩余。研究结果表明，追求销量最大化可能导致价格与续航里程调整等非预期后果。（JEL分类号：D12, D22, D85, H25, L14, L62, R41）
doi:10.1257/pol.20230294.title: Adjustable Product Attributes, Indirect Network Effects, and Subsidy Design: The Case of Electric Vehicles
doi:10.1257/pol.20230294.title_zh: 可调整产品属性、间接网络效应与补贴设计：以电动汽车为例

doi:10.1257/pol.20230365.abstract: We evaluate a tax reform in Ecuador that introduced generous deductions from personal income taxes (PIT), encouraging consumers to request receipts. The reform addresses tax evasion by targeting small self-employed businesses that mainly sell goods or services not subject to value-added taxes (VAT) but that often evade income taxes. Exploiting plausibly exogenous variation in receipt demand due to the distribution of taxpayers across regions and professions, we find significant increases in reported profits among self-employed businesses exposed to the reform. We document spillover effects on VAT. Our net-revenue impact analysis suggests the additional tax payments outweigh the foregone tax revenue. (JEL H24, H25, H26, J23, K34, O17)
doi:10.1257/pol.20230365.abstract_zh: 我们评估了厄瓜多尔的一项税制改革，该改革引入了慷慨的个人所得税（PIT）扣除项，鼓励消费者索取收据。这项改革通过针对主要销售不征收增值税（VAT）的商品或服务、但常逃避所得税的小型个体经营企业，来应对逃税问题。利用纳税人跨地区和职业分布带来的收据需求外生性变化，我们发现受改革影响的个体经营企业报告利润显著增加。我们记录了改革对增值税的溢出效应。净收入影响分析表明，额外税收收入超过了放弃的税收收入。（JEL H24, H25, H26, J23, K34, O17）
doi:10.1257/pol.20230365.title: Harnessing Deductions to Increase Tax Compliance and Formalization
doi:10.1257/pol.20230365.title_zh: 利用扣除额提高税收合规性与正规化

doi:10.1257/pol.20230414.abstract: We study rental income tax compliance using novel third-party information and a large-scale randomized field experiment. The third-party information combines register data on the ownership and occupancy of apartments. The RCT used this new third-party information in the targeting and design of experimental treatments, and increased the propensity to report rental income and the amount of reported rental income net of expenses. Our research design also allows us to identify members of ownership networks and analyze spillover effects in tax enforcement between them. We find positive reporting spillovers. We do not find evidence of real effects on asset market transactions. (JEL C93, D83, H26, K34, R31)
doi:10.1257/pol.20230414.abstract_zh: 我们利用新颖的第三方信息和大规模随机实地实验，对租金收入纳税遵从度展开研究。该第三方信息整合了公寓所有权与居住情况的登记数据。随机对照实验将这一新型第三方信息应用于实验干预的目标定位与设计，显著提升了租金收入的申报倾向及扣除费用后的申报金额。研究设计还使我们能够识别所有权网络成员，并分析税收执法在成员间的溢出效应。研究发现存在正向的申报溢出效应，但未发现对资产市场交易产生实质性影响的证据。（JEL分类号：C93, D83, H26, K34, R31）
doi:10.1257/pol.20230414.title: Tax Compliance in the Rental Housing Market: Evidence from a Field Experiment
doi:10.1257/pol.20230414.title_zh: 租赁住房市场中的税收遵从：来自实地实验的证据

doi:10.1257/pol.20230447.abstract: We show that exposure to extreme temperatures significantly increases international migration from El Salvador, where nearly a quarter of the population lives in the United States. Extreme temperatures reduce corn yields, leading producers to decrease their use of postharvest inputs and demand for agricultural workers. These income losses, combined with established US migration networks, increase emigration. Our findings highlight how international migration serves as a response to extreme temperatures when destination networks are strong and migration remains financially feasible. This pattern is not unique to El Salvador: Roughly 30 million farms globally are in low-income settings with access to remittances. (JEL F24, J15, J23, J43, O15, Q12, Q54)
doi:10.1257/pol.20230447.abstract_zh: 研究表明，极端气温显著增加了萨尔瓦多的国际移民——该国近四分之一人口居住在美国。极端气温导致玉米减产，促使生产者减少收获后投入品的使用并降低对农业劳动力的需求。这些收入损失，加上已建立的美国移民网络，进一步推动了移民潮。我们的发现凸显了当目的地移民网络强大且移民在经济上仍可行时，国际移民如何成为应对极端气温的一种手段。这一现象并非萨尔瓦多独有：全球约有3000万个农场位于低收入地区，且这些地区能够获得汇款。（JEL分类号：F24, J15, J23, J43, O15, Q12, Q54）
doi:10.1257/pol.20230447.title: Responses to Extreme Temperatures: Migrant Networks and International Migration from El Salvador
doi:10.1257/pol.20230447.title_zh: 极端温度的反应：移民网络与萨尔瓦多的国际移民

doi:10.1257/pol.20230539.abstract: I study the effects of charters on student racial segregation, identifying a novel mechanism: the assignment of White and non-White students to regular classrooms within their school-grade. Exploiting almost 100 entries of elementary charters in North Carolina from 1997 to 2015, I show that the announcement of an opening significantly increases classroom segregation within public schools nearby, relative to schools farther away, especially within non-majority-White schools and for charter openings that enroll a relatively large share of White students. Accounting for classrooms is unlikely to reverse the literature’s conclusion that the charter effects on student segregation are modest in magnitude. (JEL H75, I21, I24, I28, J15)
doi:10.1257/pol.20230539.abstract_zh: 本文研究了特许学校对学生种族隔离的影响，并识别出一种新机制：白人和非白人学生在其所在年级的常规班级中的分配。利用1997年至2015年间北卡罗来纳州近100所小学特许学校的设立数据，我表明，与距离较远的学校相比，特许学校开学的公告显著增加了附近公立学校内部的班级隔离，尤其是在非白人占多数的学校以及招收白人学生比例相对较高的特许学校中。考虑班级层面的因素不太可能推翻文献中关于特许学校对学生隔离影响程度较小的结论。（JEL H75, I21, I24, I28, J15）
doi:10.1257/pol.20230539.title: The Segregative Effects of Charter Schools

doi:10.1257/pol.20230547.abstract: We study the effect of stricter enforcement of the dividend-withholding tax (DWT). We focus on a 2016 Danish enforcement reform and compare Denmark to its Nordic neighbors. Throughout the Nordic stock markets, shares on loan spike sharply around dividend dates. These spikes are consistent with abuse of the DWT system. Postreform, spikes in Denmark disappear, and annual DWT revenue increases by 130 percent. Enforcement does not harm the investment climate as measured by Danish stock returns, investment rate, and dividend yield. (JEL G18, G35, G38, H26, K22, K34)
doi:10.1257/pol.20230547.abstract_zh: 我们研究了股息预扣税（DWT）执行力度加强的影响。重点关注2016年丹麦的一项执法改革，并将丹麦与其北欧邻国进行比较。在整个北欧股票市场中，股票借贷量在股息发放日前后急剧飙升。这些飙升现象与DWT制度的滥用行为相符。改革后，丹麦的此类飙升现象消失，年度DWT收入增长130%。以丹麦股票回报率、投资率和股息收益率衡量，执法并未损害投资环境。（JEL分类号：G18, G35, G38, H26, K22, K34）
doi:10.1257/pol.20230547.title: The Big Short (Interest): Closing the Loopholes in the Dividend-Withholding Tax
doi:10.1257/pol.20230547.title_zh: 大空头（空头利息）：堵塞股息预扣税漏洞

doi:10.1257/pol.20230552.abstract: This paper examines the provision of official flood risk information in the United States and its distributional impacts on residential flood insurance take-up. Assembling all flood maps produced after Hurricane Katrina, I document that updated maps decreased the number of properties zoned in high-risk floodplains and incorrectly omitted five million properties, primarily in neighborhoods with more Black and Hispanic residents. Leveraging the staggered timing of map updates, I estimate that updated maps decreased flood insurance take-up and exacerbated racial disparities in insurance coverage. While past map updates distorted risk and price signals, correcting flood maps would yield substantial welfare gains.
doi:10.1257/pol.20230552.abstract_zh: 本文研究了美国官方洪水风险信息的提供及其对住宅洪水保险参保率的分配效应。通过整合卡特里娜飓风后发布的所有洪水地图，我发现更新后的地图减少了划入高风险洪泛区的房产数量，并错误地遗漏了500万处房产，这些房产主要位于黑人和西班牙裔居民较多的社区。利用地图更新的交错时间安排，我估计更新后的地图降低了洪水保险的参保率，并加剧了保险覆盖中的种族差异。尽管过去的地图更新扭曲了风险与价格信号，但修正洪水地图将带来显著的福利收益。
doi:10.1257/pol.20230552.title: Flood Risk Mapping and the Distributional Impacts of Climate Information
doi:10.1257/pol.20230552.title_zh: 洪水风险图绘制与气候信息的分配效应

doi:10.1257/pol.20230617.abstract: What happens when a country’s electorate suddenly expands by hundreds of thousands of new voters? This study examines the political impact of the mass arrival of repatriates from Algeria to France. Using this quasi-experiment, I demonstrate that their arrival caused significant changes in the French electoral landscape. In areas of exposure to their arrival, they increased the French electorate and reshaped the vote for right-wing parties. Furthermore, their presence influenced candidates’ electoral strategies, causing all candidates to shift their electoral manifestos towards pro-repatriate stances. This significant historical event influenced French political life, reshaping electoral dynamics and political strategies in France.
doi:10.1257/pol.20230617.abstract_zh: 当一个国家的选民突然增加数十万新选民时，会发生什么？本研究考察了阿尔及利亚归国者大规模抵达法国所产生的政治影响。利用这一准实验，我证明他们的到来导致了法国选举格局的重大变化。在受其抵达影响的地区，他们扩大了法国选民规模，并重塑了右翼政党的选票分布。此外，他们的存在影响了候选人的选举策略，促使所有候选人将选举宣言转向支持归国者的立场。这一重大历史事件影响了法国的政治生活，重塑了法国的选举动态和政治策略。
doi:10.1257/pol.20230617.title: The Political Consequences of Mass Repatriation
doi:10.1257/pol.20230617.title_zh: 大规模遣返的政治后果

doi:10.1257/pol.20230668.abstract: A large literature has documented that fiscal policy is procyclical in emerging markets/developing countries and acyclical/countercyclical in advanced economies. This paper analyzes fiscal procyclicality in commodity-exporting countries. The paper makes two novel contributions. First, based on the “when it rains, it pours” phenomenon (that is, contractionary fiscal policy amplifies the business cycle), the paper shows that, on average, government spending magnifies the business cycle by 21 percent of the initial drop in output following a fall in commodity prices. Second, the paper estimates the welfare costs of fiscal procyclicality at 36 percent of the commodity business cycle. (JEL E32, E62, F14, H50, O19, Q02)
doi:10.1257/pol.20230668.abstract_zh: 大量文献表明，财政政策在新兴市场/发展中国家呈现顺周期性，而在发达经济体中则为非周期性/逆周期性。本文分析了大宗商品出口国的财政顺周期性，并做出两项创新性贡献。首先，基于"祸不单行"现象（即紧缩性财政政策放大经济周期），本文证明：在大宗商品价格下跌后，政府支出平均会使初始产出下降的幅度放大21%。其次，本文估算出财政顺周期性的福利成本相当于大宗商品经济周期的36%。（JEL分类号：E32, E62, F14, H50, O19, Q02）
doi:10.1257/pol.20230668.title: Fiscal Procyclicality in Commodity Exporting Countries: How Much Does It Pour and Why?
doi:10.1257/pol.20230668.title_zh: 大宗商品出口国的财政顺周期性：程度与成因

doi:10.1257/pol.20230670.abstract: We estimate the direct and spillover effects of cannabis legalization on longstanding racial disparities in criminal justice outcomes. We find that legalization reduces cannabis possession and sales arrests for White and Black populations, narrowing but not eliminating disparities. We also find spillover increases in hospitalizations involving cannabis and other illegal drugs. However, spillovers on arrests, incarcerations, and crimes involving serious violent or property offenses are insignificant or even decrease. Other illegal drug sales arrests decrease across populations, while illegal drug incarcerations decrease only among White populations. Spillovers on other low-level offenses are insignificant for White but mixed for Black populations. (JEL I12, J15, K14, K41, K42)
doi:10.1257/pol.20230670.abstract_zh: 我们估算了大麻合法化对刑事司法结果中长期存在的种族差异的直接效应与溢出效应。研究发现，合法化减少了白人和黑人群体中因持有和销售大麻而被逮捕的数量，缩小了差异但并未完全消除。同时，溢出效应导致涉及大麻及其他非法药物的住院人数增加。然而，对涉及严重暴力或财产犯罪的逮捕、监禁及犯罪行为的溢出效应并不显著，甚至有所下降。其他非法药物销售逮捕人数在各群体中均减少，但非法药物监禁人数仅在白人群体中下降。对白人群体而言，其他轻微犯罪的溢出效应不显著，而对黑人群体则呈现混合结果。（JEL I12, J15, K14, K41, K42）
doi:10.1257/pol.20230670.title: State Recreational Cannabis Laws and Racial Disparities in the Criminal Legal System
doi:10.1257/pol.20230670.title_zh: 州娱乐性大麻法律与刑事司法系统中的种族差异

doi:10.1257/pol.20230812.abstract: Incarceration is often justified by a defendant’s risk of future crime. To what extent do biased beliefs about predictors of crime distort incarceration decisions? We survey prosecutors about how violent rearrest rates vary by defendant age and criminal history. Surveyed prosecutors make systematic errors: They underestimate the decline in rearrest with age and overestimate the increase with criminal history. By linking prosecutors’ beliefs to their quasi-randomly assigned cases, we show that prosecutors’ beliefs predict incarceration patterns by defendant age and criminal history in their cases. Finally, we find that prosecutors with more accurate beliefs simultaneously reduce violent rearrest and incarceration. (JEL D83, K14, K41, K42)
doi:10.1257/pol.20230812.abstract_zh: 监禁通常以被告未来犯罪风险为正当理由。关于犯罪预测因素的偏见性认知在多大程度上扭曲了监禁判决？我们调查了检察官对暴力犯罪再逮捕率如何随被告年龄和犯罪记录变化的看法。受访检察官存在系统性错误：他们低估了再逮捕率随年龄下降的趋势，高估了其随犯罪记录增加的趋势。通过将检察官的认知与其准随机分配的案件相关联，我们证明检察官的认知能够预测其案件中按被告年龄和犯罪记录划分的监禁模式。最后，我们发现认知更准确的检察官能够同时降低暴力再逮捕率和监禁率。（JEL D83, K14, K41, K42）
doi:10.1257/pol.20230812.title: Prediction Errors, Incarceration, and Violent Crime: Evidence from Linking Prosecutor Surveys to Court Records
doi:10.1257/pol.20230812.title_zh: 预测错误、监禁与暴力犯罪：来自检察官调查与法庭记录匹配的证据

doi:10.1257/pol.20240044.abstract: We estimate the causal impacts of universal preschool by leveraging a quasi-experimental design based on Israel’s implementation of free public preschool for children ages 3 and 4 beginning in September 1999. We focus on the Arab population, who were the main beneficiaries of the first phase of the law’s implementation. Using a difference-in-differences (DID) research design, we find that universal preschool enhanced individuals’ academic performance from elementary school through high school, improved the learning environment, and increased postsecondary enrollment. Additional benefits include reduced juvenile delinquency among males and decreased early marriage among females. (JEL I21, I24, I28, J15, J16)
doi:10.1257/pol.20240044.abstract_zh: 我们利用以色列自1999年9月起对3至4岁儿童实施免费公立学前教育的准实验设计，评估了普及型学前教育的因果影响。研究聚焦于该法律第一阶段的主要受益群体——阿拉伯人口。通过双重差分（DID）研究设计，我们发现普及型学前教育提升了个人从小学到高中的学业表现，改善了学习环境，并提高了高等教育入学率。其他益处包括降低男性青少年犯罪率和减少女性早婚现象。（JEL I21, I24, I28, J15, J16）
doi:10.1257/pol.20240044.title: Short- and Long-Term Effects of Universal Preschool: Evidence from the Arab Population in Israel
doi:10.1257/pol.20240044.title_zh: 以色列阿拉伯人口中普及学前教育的短期与长期效应

doi:10.1257/pol.20240087.abstract: We examine the impact of the free supply of diphtheria antitoxin, the first effective medical treatment for an infectious disease, on the historical health transition in Massachusetts. Using newly collected municipality-level data on the distribution of antitoxin and information from over 1.5 million death certificates from 1880 to 1914, we find that the rapid availability of antitoxin treatment significantly increased life expectancy at young ages. Our findings suggest that medicine, combined with an effective public health policy, played a more important role in improving life expectancy in the early twentieth century than previously thought. (JEL H75, I12, I18, J13, N31)
doi:10.1257/pol.20240087.abstract_zh: 本文考察了白喉抗毒素（第一种针对传染病的有效医疗手段）的免费供应对马萨诸塞州历史健康转型的影响。利用新收集的市级抗毒素分配数据以及1880年至1914年间超过150万份死亡证明信息，我们发现抗毒素治疗的快速普及显著提高了低龄人群的预期寿命。研究结果表明，在20世纪初期，医学与有效的公共卫生政策相结合，对预期寿命提升的作用比以往认知更为重要。（JEL H75, I12, I18, J13, N31）
doi:10.1257/pol.20240087.title: Medical Technology and Life Expectancy: Evidence from the Antitoxin Treatment of Diphtheria
doi:10.1257/pol.20240087.title_zh: 医疗技术与预期寿命：白喉抗毒素治疗的证据

doi:10.1257/pol.20240121.abstract: Financial crimes are costly to society but less severely punished than other nonviolent crimes. We investigate whether prison sentences reduce financial crimes. Using random assignment of judges in Finland to identify causal impacts, we find a prison sentence reduces defendant reoffending by 42.9 percentage points three years postsentencing. Given prior evidence of financial misconduct “contagion,” we also explore spillovers on colleagues. A prison sentence reduces the likelihood that a financial crime defendant’s colleagues commit crimes by 27 percentage points, suggesting broader deterrent effects of harsher punishments, but only for fraud cases. Last, we show financial crimes are not victimless crimes. (JEL K14, K22, K41, K42)
doi:10.1257/pol.20240121.abstract_zh: 金融犯罪对社会造成高昂代价，但相较于其他非暴力犯罪，其惩罚力度较轻。本文探究监禁刑罚能否减少金融犯罪。利用芬兰法官随机分配机制识别因果效应，我们发现，判决监禁使被告在判决后三年内的再犯率降低42.9个百分点。鉴于已有证据表明金融不当行为具有"传染性"，我们进一步考察了对同事的溢出效应。监禁判决使金融犯罪被告同事的犯罪概率降低27个百分点，这表明更严厉的惩罚具有更广泛的威慑效应，但该效应仅存在于欺诈案件中。最后，我们证明金融犯罪并非无受害者的犯罪。（JEL K14, K22, K41, K42）
doi:10.1257/pol.20240121.title: Punishing Financial Crimes: The Impact of Prison Sentences on Defendants and Their Colleagues
doi:10.1257/pol.20240121.title_zh: 惩罚金融犯罪：监禁刑期对被告及其同事的影响

doi:10.1257/pol.20240147.abstract: This paper examines the effects of a corporate tax cut aimed at incentivizing domestic production on the within-firm distribution of worker earnings, firm employment, and firm capital investment. We use employee-employer-matched U.S. tax filings and find that after implementation of the Domestic Production Activities Deduction, earnings increased modestly in the middle of the within-firm earnings distribution, but increased sharply at the 99th percentile, especially for small firms. Firms also increased investment and employment. Our results demonstrate the importance of allowing for worker and firm heterogeneity when estimating the wage incidence of corporate taxes.
doi:10.1257/pol.20240147.abstract_zh: 本文研究了旨在激励国内生产的企业减税政策对企业内部员工收入分布、企业就业及资本投资的影响。我们利用美国员工-雇主匹配的税务申报数据发现，在实施国内生产活动扣除政策后，企业内部收入分布中位水平的收入温和增长，但第99百分位的高收入群体收入显著上升，尤其是小型企业。同时，企业投资和就业也有所增加。研究结果表明，在估算企业所得税的工资归宿时，考虑员工与企业的异质性至关重要。
doi:10.1257/pol.20240147.title: Effects of Domestic Production Tax Incentives on Workers and Firms: Evidence from US Employee-Employer-Matched Tax Filings
doi:10.1257/pol.20240147.title_zh: 国内生产税收激励对工人和企业的影响：来自美国员工-雇主匹配税务申报的证据

doi:10.1257/pol.20240197.abstract: States and localities are relied upon to implement macroeconomic stabilization policies and ensure service delivery in times of crisis. In April 2020, the introduction of the Municipal Liquidity Facility (MLF) added an emergency lending instrument to the policy arsenal guaranteeing liquidity but at a price. Using a regression discontinuity design that exploits MLF lending eligibility population cutoffs, we find that the MLF contributed to the easing of liquidity pressures and reduced perceived credit risk for municipal borrowers. Low-rated issuers experienced yields reductions of at least 26 bps. We also provide suggestive evidence that these liquidity effects translated into employment gains.
doi:10.1257/pol.20240197.abstract_zh: 各州及地方政府被寄予厚望，需在危机时期实施宏观经济稳定政策并确保公共服务供给。2020年4月推出的市政流动性便利（MLF）为政策工具箱新增了一项应急贷款工具，该工具虽能保障流动性，但需付出相应代价。通过利用MLF贷款资格的人口阈值进行断点回归设计，我们发现MLF有助于缓解流动性压力，并降低了市政借款人的感知信用风险。低评级发行人的收益率至少下降了26个基点。我们还提供了初步证据表明，这些流动性效应已转化为就业增长。
doi:10.1257/pol.20240197.title: The Option Value of Municipal Liquidity
doi:10.1257/pol.20240197.title_zh: 市政流动性的期权价值

doi:10.1257/pol.20240290.abstract: Many routine daily activities—such as cooking and commuting—cause large recurring pollution spikes that may impact health without significantly affecting average exposure. We study pollution spikes by combining experimental variation in cooking technology with high-frequency data on individual pollution exposure and time-use in Kenya. Improved cookstoves reduce PM2.5 spikes while cooking by 51.3 μg/m 3 (41 percent) and cause a 0.24 standard deviation reduction in self-reported respiratory symptoms. However, even after more than three years of daily use, we find no clinical health improvements, possibly because we detect no impact on average exposure. Clinical health improvements may require reductions in ambient concentrations. (JEL I12, O12, O13, Q51, Q53)
doi:10.1257/pol.20240290.abstract_zh: 许多日常活动（如烹饪和通勤）会引发频繁且严重的污染峰值，这些峰值可能影响健康，却不会显著改变平均暴露水平。我们通过结合烹饪技术的实验性变化与肯尼亚个体污染暴露及时间利用的高频数据，对污染峰值展开研究。改良炉灶使烹饪期间的PM2.5峰值降低51.3微克/立方米（降幅达41%），并导致自报呼吸道症状减少0.24个标准差。然而，即便经过三年以上的日常使用，我们仍未发现临床健康指标的改善，这可能是因为我们未检测到对平均暴露水平的影响。临床健康的改善或许需要降低环境本底浓度。（JEL I12, O12, O13, Q51, Q53）
doi:10.1257/pol.20240290.title: Cooking, Health, and Daily Exposure to Pollution Spikes
doi:10.1257/pol.20240290.title_zh: 烹饪、健康与日常污染峰值暴露

doi:10.1257/pol.20240356.abstract: Attracting and retaining effective teachers in high-poverty schools remains a persistent challenge. We evaluate the impact of an initiative that offered substantial performance-based compensation to highly effective teachers in the lowest-achieving schools. We find that the program led to dramatic improvements in achievement, nearly closing the gap between the targeted schools and the district average. When the program was later reversed for some campuses, effective teachers departed at high rates, resulting in an immediate decline in student achievement. The results underscore the potential for effectiveness-based compensating differentials to attract and retain effective teachers in disadvantaged schools.
doi:10.1257/pol.20240356.abstract_zh: 在贫困率较高的学校中吸引并留住高效教师仍是一项长期挑战。我们评估了一项针对成绩最差学校中高效教师提供高额绩效薪酬的举措。研究发现，该项目显著提升了学生学业成绩，几乎弥合了目标学校与学区平均水平之间的差距。当该项目后来在部分学校被取消时，高效教师大量流失，导致学生成绩立即下滑。研究结果凸显了基于教学效能的薪酬差异在吸引和留住弱势学校高效教师方面的潜力。
doi:10.1257/pol.20240356.title: Attracting and Retaining Highly Effective Educators in Hard-to-Staff Schools
doi:10.1257/pol.20240356.title_zh: 吸引并留住难以配备师资学校中的高效教育工作者

doi:10.1257/pol.20240393.abstract: This paper examines the impacts of health care provider exits on patient outcomes and displacement. Leveraging data on the universe of long-stay nursing home patients, I estimate the mortality effects of 1,104 nursing home closures using a difference-in-differences approach. Displaced residents face a substantial short-run increase in mortality, with this disruption effect strongest among older and frailer patients. However, surviving patients tend to transfer to higher-quality providers. I find suggestive evidence that for certain subgroups this reallocation may lead to improved long-term survival, net of the initial disruption effect. The findings highlight the immediate health risks of displacement and the potential for quality-driven reallocation to mitigate them. *
doi:10.1257/pol.20240393.abstract_zh: 本文研究了医疗服务提供者退出对患者结局与转移的影响。利用长期护理机构住院患者的全样本数据，我采用双重差分法估算了1104家养老院关闭对死亡率的影响。被转移的居民在短期内面临显著的死亡率上升，这种中断效应在年长及体弱患者中最为强烈。然而，幸存患者倾向于转入更高质量的护理机构。我发现了提示性证据：对于某些亚群体而言，这种重新配置可能带来长期生存率的改善，抵消了初始中断效应的影响。研究结果凸显了患者转移的即时健康风险，以及以质量为导向的重新配置在缓解这些风险方面的潜力。
doi:10.1257/pol.20240393.title: Disruption and Displacement in Health Care: Evidence from Nursing Home Closures
doi:10.1257/pol.20240393.title_zh: 医疗保健中的中断与替代：来自养老院关闭的证据

doi:10.1257/pol.20240403.abstract: This paper studies taxpayer responses to an increase in the top marginal tax rate in South Africa, drawing on rich administrative data and a transparent identification strategy. We show that treated taxpayers strongly reduced their reported taxable income in response to the reform, with adjustments along a broad range of taxable income components. While tax evasion and avoidance explain a sizable share of this response, there is also indication for reduced work effort and business performance of South African corporations led by treated taxpayers—suggesting that raising taxes on top incomes may entail broader economic repercussions.
doi:10.1257/pol.20240403.abstract_zh: 本文利用丰富的行政数据和透明的识别策略，研究了南非最高边际税率上调后纳税人的反应。我们发现，受影响的纳税人显著减少了其申报的应税收入，调整涉及应税收入的多个组成部分。尽管逃税和避税行为在很大程度上解释了这一反应，但也有迹象表明，受影响的纳税人所领导的南非企业的工作努力程度和经营业绩有所下降——这表明对高收入群体增税可能带来更广泛的经济影响。
doi:10.1257/pol.20240403.title: Taxing Top Incomes in the Emerging World—Fiscal and Economic Impact under the Microscope
doi:10.1257/pol.20240403.title_zh: 新兴世界中的高收入征税——财政与经济影响的微观审视

doi:10.1257/pol.20240429.abstract: In 1916, Margaret Sanger established the first birth control clinic in US history. From the mid-1920s, “Sanger clinics” spread over the entire US These clinics advised women on contraception, mainly by fitting diaphragms and explicitly instructing women how to use them effectively. Combining newly digitized data on the roll-out of these clinics, full-count Census data, and historical vital statistics, we find that the clinics accounted for 5.4–6.5 percent of the overall fertility decline across the US until 1940. By increasing the spacing between births and reducing fertility, the clinics generated important health effects and reduced stillbirths and infant mortality.
doi:10.1257/pol.20240429.abstract_zh: 1916年，玛格丽特·桑格在美国历史上建立了第一家节育诊所。自20世纪20年代中期起，“桑格诊所”遍布全美。这些诊所为女性提供避孕指导，主要通过安装子宫托并明确指导女性如何有效使用。结合新近数字化的诊所推广数据、全量人口普查数据及历史生命统计资料，我们发现，截至1940年，这些诊所对美国整体生育率下降的贡献率为5.4%至6.5%。通过延长生育间隔并降低生育率，诊所产生了重要的健康效应，减少了死产和婴儿死亡率。
doi:10.1257/pol.20240429.title: The Impact of Margaret Sanger’s Birth Control Clinics on Early 20th Century US Fertility and Mortality
doi:10.1257/pol.20240429.title_zh: 玛格丽特·桑格避孕诊所在20世纪初美国生育率与死亡率中的影响

doi:10.1257/pol.20240436.abstract: We provide novel evidence on the incidence of business taxes using comprehensive survey and experimental data from German firms. Managers respond asymmetrically to randomized hypothetical tax changes of opposite signs, consistent with asymmetric profit tax incidence. They indicate that tax cuts would be primarily passed on to workers and used for investment projects, while tax increases would be shifted to consumers via higher prices and absorbed by firm owners via lower profit distributions. We further show that the stated incidence on workers rises with the absolute size of the tax change, partially offsetting the burden borne by firm owners.
doi:10.1257/pol.20240436.abstract_zh: 我们利用德国企业的综合调查与实验数据，提供了关于商业税归宿的新证据。管理者对随机设定的正负向税收变化表现出非对称反应，这与利润税的非对称归宿特征一致。他们指出，减税将主要转嫁给劳动者并用于投资项目，而增税则会通过提高价格转嫁给消费者，并通过降低利润分配由企业主承担。我们进一步发现，税收变化绝对规模越大，劳动者承担的税负比例越高，这在一定程度上抵消了企业主所承受的负担。
doi:10.1257/pol.20240436.title: The Asymmetric Incidence of Business Taxes: Survey Evidence from German Firms
doi:10.1257/pol.20240436.title_zh: 企业税负的非对称影响：来自德国企业的调查证据

doi:10.1257/pol.20240478.abstract: Minority workers tend to be disproportionately harmed by negative economic shocks. Indeed, we show that Hispanic populations experienced worse employment losses due to import competition from China, relative to whites, largely due to lower education levels. In contrast, Black-white employment and wage gaps actually narrowed due to relative growth in non-manufacturing sectors. We show that Black workers were less attached to manufacturing by 2000, compared to whites, and were therefore more poised to take advantage of China shock induced reallocation to services. The lasting negative impacts of the China shock on exposed communities were primarily driven by white workers.
doi:10.1257/pol.20240478.abstract_zh: 少数族裔工人往往在经济负面冲击中遭受不成比例的损害。事实上，我们表明，相较于白人，西班牙裔人口因中国进口竞争而面临更严重的就业损失，这主要归因于其较低的教育水平。相比之下，由于非制造业部门的相对增长，黑人与白人之间的就业和工资差距实际上有所缩小。我们指出，到2000年，黑人工人对制造业的依赖程度低于白人，因此他们更有能力利用中国冲击所引发的服务业重新配置。中国冲击对受影响社区造成的持久负面影响主要由白人工人驱动。
doi:10.1257/pol.20240478.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.1257/pol.20240478.title: Racial and Ethnic Inequality and the China Shock
doi:10.1257/pol.20240478.title_zh: 种族与民族不平等及中国冲击

doi:10.1257/pol.20240611.abstract: This paper explores the labor market returns to working for a victorious political campaign. Using unique administrative data from Brazil, we track campaign workers’ employment and earnings before and after close mayoral elections over nearly 20 years. We find sizable returns to working for a winning campaign, especially in areas with large informal sectors and for workers connected to challengers. Returns are concentrated in the public sector, where connected hires are more educationally qualified, including at higher levels of the bureaucracy. Our findings suggest that personal connections, not simply party ties, facilitate the hiring of capable, though inexperienced, civil servants.
doi:10.1257/pol.20240611.abstract_zh: 本文探究了为获胜政治竞选工作所带来的劳动力市场回报。利用巴西独特的行政数据，我们追踪了近20年市长选举前后竞选工作人员的就业与收入情况。研究发现，为获胜竞选工作能带来可观的回报，尤其是在非正规部门规模较大的地区，以及与挑战者存在关联的工人群体中。这些回报主要集中在公共部门，其中通过关系入职的人员在学历资质上更为优秀，甚至包括更高层级的官僚机构。我们的研究结果表明，个人关系（而非单纯的党派联系）促进了有能力但缺乏经验的公务员的聘用。
doi:10.1257/pol.20240611.title: Campaign Connections

doi:10.1257/pol.20240794.abstract: Climate policies often increase electricity prices by more than they increase prices of fossil fuels. Using administrative data on German manufacturing plants from 2009 to 2017, we provide evidence that these price changes induce plants to generate electricity onsite using fossil fuels. Not all manufacturing plants are subject to emissions pricing under the EU’s Emissions Trading System, and we find evidence of emissions leakage: Electricity generation shifts from regulated power plants to unregulated manufacturing plants.
doi:10.1257/pol.20240794.abstract_zh: 气候政策往往导致电价涨幅超过化石燃料价格涨幅。基于2009年至2017年德国制造业工厂的行政数据，我们证实此类价格变化会促使工厂利用化石燃料进行现场发电。并非所有制造业工厂都受欧盟排放交易体系的排放定价约束，我们发现了排放泄漏的证据：发电活动从受监管的发电厂转移至未受监管的制造业工厂。
doi:10.1257/pol.20240794.title: Climate Policies and Electricity Prices: Why Abate When You Can Generate?
doi:10.1257/pol.20240794.title_zh: 气候政策与电价：为何不减排而选择发电？

doi:10.1257/pol.20240808.abstract: What is the impact and value of hurricane forecasts? We study this question using the universe of landfalling US hurricanes between 2005–2022. We find that forecasts drive adaptive protective expenditures, and that erroneous underforecasts result in a significant increase in total hurricane damage. Using a theoreticallygrounded approach for estimating the marginal value of forecast improvements, we find that improvements since 2007, after the implementation of a national policy to improve hurricane forecasts, have reduced total costs by 19%, averaging $2 billion per hurricane. These benefits far exceed the annual budget of the policy and of all federal weather forecasting.
doi:10.1257/pol.20240808.abstract_zh: 飓风预报的影响与价值何在？我们以2005年至2022年间登陆美国的所有飓风为研究对象，发现预报能够驱动适应性防护支出，而错误的低估预报会导致飓风总损失显著增加。通过基于理论的方法估算预报改进的边际价值，我们发现自2007年实施国家飓风预报改进政策以来，预报质量的提升使总成本降低了19%，平均每次飓风减少20亿美元损失。这些收益远超该政策年度预算及联邦所有气象预报的年度总投入。
doi:10.1257/pol.20240808.title: The Social Value of Hurricane Forecasts

doi:10.1257/pol.20240812.abstract: Governments increasingly use changes in tax rules to combat evasion. We develop a general approach to point-identify tax compliance along with supply and demand elasticities. Identification requires data on prices and quantities, variation in tax policy, and a demand or supply shifter. We illustrate our approach using data on Airbnb collection agreements, where taxes are enforced by shifting the statutory burden away from hosts and onto renters via the platform. We find that taxes are paid on roughly zero to 1.6 percent of Airbnb transactions prior to enforcement.
doi:10.1257/pol.20240812.abstract_zh: 政府越来越多地通过调整税收规则来打击逃税行为。我们提出了一种通用方法，用于点识别税收合规性以及供需弹性。识别过程需要价格和数量数据、税收政策的变化以及需求或供给的变动因素。我们利用Airbnb代收协议的数据来展示这一方法，在该协议中，税收通过将法定负担从房东转移至租客（经由平台）得以强制执行。研究发现，在强制执行前，Airbnb交易中约有0%至1.6%的税款被缴纳。
doi:10.1257/pol.20240812.title: Identifying Tax Compliance from Variation in Tax Policy: Theory and Empirics
doi:10.1257/pol.20240812.title_zh: 从税收政策变化中识别税收遵从：理论与实证

doi:10.1257/pol.20240815.abstract: Each year, about a thousand public schools in the US close, displacing hundreds of thousands of students. I examine the impact of public school closures on displaced students using linked schooling and labor market data from Texas. Using within-school acrosstime/ cohort variation in exposure to school closures, I implement difference-in-differences strategies to identify causal effects. I find that school closures decrease test scores, increase absenteeism, and lead to more disciplinary actions. Furthermore, school closures decrease high school completion, college attainment, employment, and earnings at ages 25–27. These impacts are larger for secondary school students and those from economically disadvantaged backgrounds.
doi:10.1257/pol.20240815.abstract_zh: 美国每年约有上千所公立学校关闭，导致数十万学生被迫转学。本文利用德克萨斯州关联的学校教育与劳动力市场数据，考察公立学校关闭对受影响学生的影响。通过利用同一学校内不同时期/年级群体受学校关闭影响程度的差异，我采用双重差分策略识别因果效应。研究发现：学校关闭导致学生考试成绩下降、缺勤率上升，并引发更多纪律处分。此外，学校关闭还降低了学生在25-27岁期间的高中毕业率、大学入学率、就业率及收入水平。这些影响对中学生及经济弱势背景学生更为显著。
doi:10.1257/pol.20240815.title: The Long Shadow of School Closures: Impacts on Students’ Educational and Labor Market Outcomes
doi:10.1257/pol.20240815.title_zh: 学校关闭的长期阴影：对学生教育与劳动力市场结果的影响

doi:10.1257/pol.20240830.abstract: We investigate whether removing a previously-obtained criminal record improves employment outcomes. We estimate the causal impact of criminal record remediation laws that have been widely enacted with the goal of improving employment opportunities for millions of individuals with records. We find consistent evidence that removing an existing record does not improve labor market outcomes, on average. A notable exception is participation in gig work through online platforms, which often screen workers based on their records but not their employment histories. The evidence is consistent with records initially scarring labor market trajectories in a way that is difficult to undo later.
doi:10.1257/pol.20240830.abstract_zh: 我们研究了消除先前犯罪记录是否能改善就业结果。我们评估了旨在改善数百万有犯罪记录者就业机会而广泛实施的犯罪记录补救法的因果影响。研究发现，一致证据表明，消除现有记录平均而言并未改善劳动力市场结果。一个显著的例外是通过在线平台参与零工工作，这些平台通常根据犯罪记录而非就业历史筛选工作者。证据表明，犯罪记录最初会以难以事后弥补的方式损害劳动力市场轨迹。
doi:10.1257/pol.20240830.title: Can You Erase the Mark of a Criminal Record? Labor Market Impacts of Criminal Record Remediation
doi:10.1257/pol.20240830.title_zh: 能否抹去犯罪记录的印记？犯罪记录修复对劳动力市场的影响

doi:10.1257/pol.20240883.abstract: Recent firm-level studies find R&D tax incentives to be much more effective at stimulating firms’ R&D investment than aggregate analyses suggest. Based on a distributed analysis of official R&D survey and administrative tax relief microdata for 19 OECD countries, we show that two factors can reconcile these contrasting results. Firstly, the limited uptake of R&D tax incentives in most countries makes aggregate studies underestimate the effectiveness of R&D tax incentives. Secondly, R&D tax incentives are (much) less effective for large and R&D-intensive firms, which account for a small share of R&D-performing firms but most aggregate R&D tax relief.
doi:10.1257/pol.20240883.abstract_zh: 近期基于企业层面的研究发现，研发税收激励对刺激企业研发投资的效力远高于宏观分析所显示的水平。通过对19个OECD国家官方研发调查数据与行政税收减免微观数据的分布式分析，我们揭示两个因素可调和上述矛盾结论：其一，多数国家研发税收激励的有限采用率导致宏观研究低估其有效性；其二，研发税收激励对大型及高研发密集型企业（虽仅占研发企业的小部分，却集中了大部分宏观研发税收减免）的效力显著偏低。
doi:10.1257/pol.20240883.title: How Effective Are R&D Tax Incentives? Reconciling the Micro and Macro Evidence
doi:10.1257/pol.20240883.title_zh: 研发税收激励的有效性如何？调和微观与宏观证据

doi:10.1257/pol.20240889.abstract: This paper shows that retailers increase prices in response to organized retail crime. We match store-level crime data to scanner data from the universe of transactions for cannabis retailers in Washington state. Using quasi-experimental variation from robberies and burglaries, we find a 1.7-1.8% price increase at victimized stores and nearby competitors. This rise is not driven by short-to-medium-term demand changes but is consistent with crime-related cost shocks. Effects are larger for independent stores and less concentrated markets. We estimate that crime imposes a 1% ‘hidden’ unit tax on affected stores, implying $30.7 million additional social costs, primarily borne by consumers.
doi:10.1257/pol.20240889.abstract_zh: 本文表明，零售商在应对有组织零售犯罪时会提高价格。我们将门店层面的犯罪数据与华盛顿州大麻零售商的全量交易扫描数据相匹配。利用抢劫和入室盗窃带来的准实验性变化，我们发现受害门店及其附近竞争对手的价格上涨了1.7%-1.8%。这一价格上涨并非由短期至中期的需求变化驱动，而是与犯罪相关的成本冲击相一致。独立门店及市场集中度较低的区域受影响更大。我们估算，犯罪对受影响门店施加了1%的“隐性”单位税，这意味着额外社会成本达3070万美元，主要由消费者承担。
doi:10.1257/pol.20240889.title: The Pass-Through of Retail Crime

doi:10.1257/pol.20240899.abstract: This paper investigates how federal oversight not precipitated by a major scandal influences policing behavior and public safety. The high-profile events triggering such scandals can independently affect policing and crime, confounding estimates of oversight effects. I examine a 2011 federal investigation into the Seattle Police Department. In response to the heightened scrutiny from the investigation, officers immediately and significantly reduced stops, particularly suspicious-activity and traffic stops in minority neighborhoods. These reductions had no detectable effect on public safety. I conclude that federal oversight implemented in the absence of scandals may lower the social cost of policing.
doi:10.1257/pol.20240899.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了并非由重大丑闻引发的联邦监督如何影响警务行为与公共安全。触发此类丑闻的高关注度事件可能独立影响警务与犯罪，从而混淆监督效应的估计。我研究了2011年对西雅图警察局的联邦调查。为应对调查带来的高度关注，警员立即显著减少了拦截行为，尤其是在少数族裔社区的嫌疑活动拦截和交通拦截。这些减少对公共安全未产生可察觉的影响。我得出结论：在无丑闻背景下实施的联邦监督可能降低警务的社会成本。
doi:10.1257/pol.20240899.title: What Does Federal Oversight Do to Policing and Public Safety? Evidence from Seattle
doi:10.1257/pol.20240899.title_zh: 联邦监督对警务与公共安全有何影响？来自西雅图的证据

doi:10.1257/pol.20240903.abstract: We study the economic effects of transfers to local governments using a reform of the Finnish municipal grant system as a source of exogenous variation. We find that higher grants lead to lower municipal taxes and fees, higher public spending and improved budget balance. These changes in local fiscal policy lead to an increase in private sector jobs. Our estimates imply a cost per job of e33,000. The increase in jobs is paired with a reduction in commuting to other municipalities. The effect on migration seems small, suggesting grants bring local benefits without drastically affecting where households choose to live.
doi:10.1257/pol.20240903.abstract_zh: 我们利用芬兰市政拨款制度改革作为外生变动的来源，研究了对地方政府转移支付的经济效应。研究发现，更高的拨款导致市政税费降低、公共支出增加以及预算平衡改善。这些地方财政政策的变化带来了私营部门就业岗位的增加。我们的估算显示，每个就业岗位的成本为33,000欧元。就业增长的同时，通勤至其他市镇的人数有所减少。对迁移的影响似乎较小，这表明拨款在带来地方利益的同时，并未显著改变家庭居住地的选择。
doi:10.1257/pol.20240903.title: Fiscal Transfers to Local Governments and the Distribution of Economic Activity
doi:10.1257/pol.20240903.title_zh: 财政转移支付与地方经济活动分布

doi:10.1257/pol.20250007.abstract: To reduce Russia’s funding for its Ukraine invasion, Western governments imposed, after a delay, a price ceiling on Russian seaborne oil exports utilizing Western services. To evade that ceiling, Russia developed a “shadow fleet” using no such services. We simulate a calibrated model driven by this fleet’s expansion to assess various sanctions. Mainly, sanctions—from a price ceiling to its extreme service ban version—significantly reduce the present value of Russia’s profits. However, tighter price caps will not necessarily harm Russia if they raise the world price. Shortening the delay between sanctions announcement and implementation can harm Russia more.
doi:10.1257/pol.20250007.abstract_zh: 为削减俄罗斯对乌克兰战争的资金支持，西方政府经延迟后对依赖西方服务的俄罗斯海运石油出口实施价格上限。为规避该上限，俄罗斯组建了不使用此类服务的"影子船队"。我们通过校准模型模拟该船队扩张情景，评估各类制裁措施的效果。主要发现：从价格上限到其极端版本的服务禁令，各类制裁均显著降低俄罗斯利润现值。然而，若更严格的价格上限推高全球油价，则未必对俄罗斯造成损害。缩短制裁宣布与实施之间的延迟期，可对俄罗斯造成更大打击。
doi:10.1257/pol.20250007.title: The Dynamics of Evasion: The Price Cap on Russian Oil Exports and the Amassing of the Shadow Fleet
doi:10.1257/pol.20250007.title_zh: 逃避的动态：俄罗斯石油出口价格上限与影子舰队扩张

doi:10.1257/pol.20250265.abstract: Public programs that provide benefits through private markets contend with strategic firm behavior. We study this dynamic in Medicare Part D. The Affordable Care Act closed a coverage gap in Part D by mandating drug manufacturers cover 50% of branded drug costs in the gap. Beneficiaries became 5 percentage points less likely to forgo prescriptions upon reaching the gap. However, manufacturers' response led to 21% higher drug prices, partially offsetting the insurance expansion. The closure was intended to be a $100 transfer to beneficiaries financed by manufacturers, but instead resulted in a $55 transfer to beneficiaries financed by the government.
doi:10.1257/pol.20250265.abstract_zh: 通过私人市场提供福利的公共项目需应对企业的策略性行为。我们以联邦医疗保险D部分为研究对象，分析这一动态机制。《平价医疗法案》通过强制要求药品制造商承担覆盖缺口内品牌药50%的成本，填补了D部分的保障缺口。受益人在进入覆盖缺口后放弃处方的概率降低了5个百分点。然而，制造商的应对措施导致药品价格上涨21%，部分抵消了保险覆盖扩大的效果。该缺口填补政策本意是由制造商出资向受益人转移100美元，但最终演变为由政府出资向受益人转移55美元。
doi:10.1257/pol.20250265.title: The Effect of Public Insurance Design on Pharmaceutical Prices: Evidence from Medicare Part D
doi:10.1257/pol.20250265.title_zh: 公共保险设计对药品价格的影响：来自医疗保险D部分的证据

doi:10.1257/pol.20250309.abstract: This paper studies the impacts of administrative burdens across multiple welfare programs and application stages via an increasingly widespread phenomenon: the automation of caseworker assistance. Leveraging a natural experiment phased in across Indiana’s counties and administrative records for 3 million recipients, we find that SNAP, TANF, and Medicaid enrollments fell by 15%, 24%, and 4% after automation. Heterogeneous declines are attributable to cross-program differences in recertification costs. Needier individuals exited while less needy individuals were screened out at entry, potentially reconciling some conflicting results in the literature and best understood through a dynamic selection model of certification and recertification.
doi:10.1257/pol.20250309.abstract_zh: 本文通过日益普遍的行政自动化现象，研究跨多个福利项目及申请阶段的行政负担影响。利用印第安纳州各县分阶段实施的自然实验及300万受助者的行政记录，我们发现自动化后，SNAP、TANF和Medicaid的注册人数分别下降了15%、24%和4%。异质性下降可归因于不同项目在重新认证成本上的差异。需求更迫切的个体退出，而需求较低的个体在进入阶段被筛选排除，这一发现可能调和了文献中部分相互矛盾的结果，并通过认证与重新认证的动态选择模型得以最佳解释。
doi:10.1257/pol.20250309.title: Certification and Recertification in Welfare Programs: What Happens When Automation Goes Wrong?
doi:10.1257/pol.20250309.title_zh: 福利项目中的认证与再认证：自动化出错时会发生什么？

doi:10.1257/pol.20250505.title: Index-Based Price Adjustment in US Strategic Petroleum Reserve Drawdowns
doi:10.1257/pol.20250505.title_zh: 美国战略石油储备释放中基于指数的价格调整

doi:10.1257/pol.20250543.abstract: We evaluate a guaranteed job program in Austria in 2020–2024. Our evaluation is based on three approaches, pairwise matched randomization, a pre-registered synthetic control at the municipality level, and a comparison to individuals in control municipalities. This allows us to estimate direct effects, anticipation effects, and spillover effects. We find positive impacts on economic and non-economic wellbeing. At the municipality level, we find a reduction of long-term unemployment and no negative employment spillovers. There are positive anticipation effects on well-being, status, and social inclusion. We estimate program costs of 237 Euro per participant and month. Participant income increased by 102 Euro.
doi:10.1257/pol.20250543.abstract_zh: 我们评估了奥地利2020-2024年的一项保障就业项目。该评估基于三种方法：配对匹配随机化、预先注册的市级合成控制法，以及与对照市镇个体的比较。这使我们能够估计直接效应、预期效应和溢出效应。研究发现，该项目对经济和非经济福祉均产生了积极影响。在市级层面，长期失业率有所下降，且未发现负面的就业溢出效应。预期效应对福祉、社会地位和社会融入产生了积极影响。我们估算的项目成本为每位参与者每月237欧元，参与者收入增加了102欧元。
doi:10.1257/pol.20250543.title: Employing the Unemployed of Marienthal: Evaluation of a Guaranteed Job Program
doi:10.1257/pol.20250543.title_zh: 利用马里恩塔尔的失业者：一项保障就业计划的评估

doi:10.1257/pol.20250583.abstract: This paper characterizes the optimal taxation of top earners in a world with externalities. It develops a reduced-form approach that allows for a flexible relationship between top earnings and the distribution of earnings capacities in the population. The optimal top tax rate is expressed in terms of simple sufficient statistics formulas that depend on the magnitude and distribution of net externalities. In general, externalities that run from top earners to bottom earners have much stronger policy implications than externalities within top earners. The theory is linked to evidence on the externalities of top entrepreneurs and a calibration analysis is provided.
doi:10.1257/pol.20250583.abstract_zh: 本文刻画了存在外部性时对高收入者的最优税收政策。研究提出了一种简化形式方法，允许高收入群体收入与人群收入能力分布之间存在灵活关系。最优高收入税率通过简单的充分统计量公式表达，该公式取决于净外部性的规模与分布。一般而言，从高收入者流向低收入者的外部性比高收入群体内部的外部性具有更强的政策含义。本文将理论与顶级企业家外部性的实证证据相联系，并提供了校准分析。
doi:10.1257/pol.20250583.title: Externalities and the Taxation of Top Earners
doi:10.1257/pol.20250583.title_zh: 外部性与高收入者税收

doi:10.1257/pol.20250924.abstract: Can African countries deter industrial fishing vessels from near-shore waters reserved for artisanal fishers? Using radar data released in 2024, this paper provides the first causal evaluation of these Inshore Exclusion Zones (IEZs). Regression discontinuity estimates reveal deterrence in 6 of 20 African countries. Next, we apply bunching estimators to obtain counterfactual vessel distributions uncontaminated by spillovers outside IEZ boundaries. We capture extensive-margin effects by calibrating a discrete choice vessel location model to our bunching estimates. Bioeconomic calculations indicate that IEZs increase artisanal fisher catch by enough to meet key micronutrient requirements for 7 million people.
doi:10.1257/pol.20250924.abstract_zh: 非洲国家能否阻止工业渔船进入为手工渔民保留的近岸水域？本文利用2024年发布的雷达数据，首次对这些近岸禁渔区（IEZs）进行了因果效应评估。断点回归估计结果显示，在20个非洲国家中有6个国家产生了威慑效应。随后，我们应用聚束估计量获取了不受禁渔区边界外溢出效应污染的反事实船舶分布。通过将离散选择船舶定位模型校准至聚束估计结果，我们捕捉了集约边际效应。生物经济核算表明，近岸禁渔区使手工渔民的渔获量增加幅度足以满足700万人的关键微量营养素需求。
doi:10.1257/pol.20250924.title: Deterring Industrial Vessels from African Coastal Fisheries
doi:10.1257/pol.20250924.title_zh: 阻止工业渔船进入非洲沿海渔业

doi:10.1596/1813-9450-11385.abstract: This paper studies the interaction of the contribution-benefit link with tax evasion in the context of parental benefits in Hungary and Latvia. Across the two countries, institutional settings, and time periods, earnings and employment patterns suggest substantial pre-pregnancy underreporting, followed by partial formalization during pregnancy to increase benefits. Using policy reforms, the paper shows that the reporting response tracks changing incentives. The results indicate that even with third-party reporting, income underreporting can be common. Linking benefits to contributions when earnings are underreported may reduce evasion temporarily but can impose net fiscal costs depending on program design.
doi:10.1596/1813-9450-11385.abstract_zh: 本文研究了匈牙利和拉脱维亚育儿福利背景下，缴费-福利关联与逃税行为的相互作用。在两国的制度环境与时间跨度中，收入与就业模式显示，孕前存在大量低报收入现象，而孕期则出现部分正规化以增加福利。通过政策改革分析，本文证明申报行为随激励变化而调整。结果表明，即便存在第三方报告机制，收入低报仍可能普遍存在。当收入被低报时，将福利与缴费挂钩虽能暂时减少逃税，但根据项目设计不同，可能产生净财政成本。

doi:10.1596/1813-9450-11408.abstract: This study analyzes the impact of the Romania Secondary Education Project, which was designed to improve student retention, graduation rates and pass rates on a national end-of-high-school exam for low-achievement high schools in Romania. The program was implemented in three waves, September 2017, September 2018, and September 2020, with eligible high schools randomly assigned to each. The study exploits this staggered implementation to measure the project’s causal impacts on students. The estimates indicate that the Romania Secondary Education Project had no significant impact on (i) student preferences for attending a program high school, (ii) student retention rates, (iii) high school graduation rates, (iv) enrollment in the post-high school baccalaureate exam, (v) baccalaureate exam pass rates, or (vi) baccalaureate exam scores. There was a small increase in girls’ passing rates (3 percentage points). However, there was little heterogeneity in the null effects by grant size, urban-rural status, student achievement levels, town income levels, and type of curriculum taught.
doi:10.1596/1813-9450-11408.abstract_zh: 本研究分析了罗马尼亚中等教育项目的影响，该项目旨在提高罗马尼亚低学业表现高中的学生保留率、毕业率及全国高中毕业会考的通过率。该项目分三批实施（2017年9月、2018年9月和2020年9月），符合条件的高中被随机分配到各批次。研究利用这种分阶段实施机制来测量项目对学生的因果效应。估计结果表明，罗马尼亚中等教育项目对以下指标均无显著影响：（i）学生对就读项目高中的偏好，（ii）学生保留率，（iii）高中毕业率，（iv）高中后学士学位考试注册率，（v）学士学位考试通过率，以及（vi）学士学位考试成绩。女生通过率略有提升（3个百分点）。然而，按补助金额、城乡状况、学生学业水平、城镇收入水平及课程类型划分的零效应异质性极小。

doi:10.1596/1813-9450-11409.abstract: This study investigates taxpayer responses to tax compliance interventions undertaken in collaboration with Ethiopia’s revenue authority, focusing on gender differences among business owners. The research targeted a sample of 5,408 business owners, and the interventions—letters highlighting tax obligations and civic responsibilities—were successfully implemented with 3,551 participants. The interventions involved letters emphasizing tax obligations and civic duties and were evaluated through a randomized controlled trial across diverse economic sectors and sub-city locations. Data from quantitative surveys and administrative records provided information about reported tax declarations and compliance behaviors. The findings indicate a balance in key variables before the intervention, with notable impacts of the intervention on reported profit tax declarations. While examining gender differences in tax compliance, the study found no differential effects of the intervention based on business owners’ gender. Specifically, the result shows that the difference in tax compliance between male and female business owners is not statistically significant at both intensive and extensive margins. This indicates that gender did not play a meaningful role in influencing tax compliance as a result of the intervention.
doi:10.1596/1813-9450-11409.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了与埃塞俄比亚税务机关合作实施的税收合规干预措施中纳税人的反应，重点关注企业主的性别差异。研究以5,408名企业主为样本，成功对3,551名参与者实施了干预措施——即强调纳税义务和公民责任的信函。这些干预措施通过随机对照试验在多个经济部门和城区进行效果评估，信函内容着重强调纳税义务与公民责任。定量调查数据与行政记录提供了关于申报纳税额和合规行为的信息。研究结果显示，干预前关键变量保持均衡，且干预措施对申报利润税产生了显著影响。在考察税收合规的性别差异时，研究发现干预措施对企业主性别未产生差异化效应。具体而言，结果显示男性与女性企业主在税收合规方面的差异在集约边际和广延边际上均不具有统计显著性。这表明性别并未因干预措施而对税收合规产生实质性影响。

doi:10.1596/1813-9450-11410.abstract: Climate change is increasing the frequency and intensity of extreme weather events. When these events occur, they threaten lives and livelihoods. This paper estimates the global population at high risk of climate-related hazards by combining household-level vulnerability data with local exposure to four types of events: agricultural droughts in rural areas, floods, heatwaves, and cyclones. Under current climate conditions, 4.5 billion people are expected to experience these hazards at intensities exceeding hazard-specific thresholds chosen to capture the likely occurrence of systemic impacts within a lifetime. One-third of this population is considered highly vulnerable, based on seven dimensions that influence ability to cope and recover: income, education, access to finance, social protection, drinking water, electricity, and access to services and markets. Overall, one in five people globally are considered at high risk, meaning they are both likely to experience at least one of these hazards and face severely limited capacity to recover from their impacts. Although the share of the global population at high risk has nearly halved since 2010 due to decreased vulnerability, the number of people exposed has increased, and progress has been uneven across regions. This study introduces a new global population headcount indicator based on household survey data and high-resolution spatial data to monitor climate risks across countries and over time.
doi:10.1596/1813-9450-11410.abstract_zh: 气候变化正加剧极端天气事件的频率与强度。当这些事件发生时，它们威胁着生命与生计。本文通过将家庭层面的脆弱性数据与四种类型事件（农村地区的农业干旱、洪水、热浪和热带气旋）的局部暴露度相结合，估算了全球面临气候相关灾害高风险的人口规模。在当前气候条件下，预计有45亿人将经历超过特定灾害阈值的极端事件——这些阈值旨在捕捉一生中可能发生的系统性影响。其中三分之一的人口被视为高度脆弱，这一判断基于影响其应对与恢复能力的七个维度：收入、教育、金融可及性、社会保障、饮用水、电力以及服务与市场可及性。总体而言，全球每五人中有一人被认为处于高风险状态，即他们既可能经历至少一种此类灾害，又面临严重受限的灾后恢复能力。尽管自2010年以来，由于脆弱性降低，全球高风险人口比例已近乎减半，但暴露于灾害的人口数量有所增加，且各区域的进展并不均衡。本研究基于家庭调查数据和高分辨率空间数据，引入了一项新的全球人口计数指标，用于跨国家、跨时间地监测气候风险。

doi:10.1596/1813-9450-11411.abstract: This paper examines how federal science and engineering research funding—although intended to advance research—affects degree production and programs offered in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM). Using data from 1971–2016, the study implements a triple-difference design that exploits variation across colleges, time, and fields of study. The findings show that federal grants generate 27.4 percent of doctorates and 14.7 percent of undergraduate science, technology, engineering, and mathematics degrees, as well as 6.3 percent of doctoral programs and 3.7 percent of undergraduate programs in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics annually across 200 U.S. research universities. The impacts are concentrated in biology and engineering, aligning with the priorities of major funders such as the Department of Health and Human Services, the National Science Foundation, and the Department of Defense. These findings suggest that research grants to universities may generate a “double dividend,” simultaneously expanding the supply of skilled labor in targeted fields while also advancing scientific discovery.
doi:10.1596/1813-9450-11411.abstract_zh: 本文考察了联邦科学与工程研究资助——尽管其初衷是推动研究——如何影响科学、技术、工程和数学领域的学位产出与项目设置。基于1971年至2016年的数据，本研究采用三重差分设计，利用学院、时间和学科领域的差异进行分析。结果显示，在美国200所研究型大学中，联邦资助每年贡献了27.4%的博士学位、14.7%的本科STEM学位，以及6.3%的博士项目和3.7%的本科STEM项目。这些影响主要集中在生物学和工程学领域，与卫生与公众服务部、国家科学基金会和国防部等主要资助方的优先方向一致。研究结果表明，对大学的研究资助可能产生“双重红利”，在推动科学发现的同时，也扩大了目标领域熟练劳动力的供给。

doi:10.1596/1813-9450-11412.abstract: This paper reexamines aid effectiveness using ex-post economic rates of return from 2,500 World Bank–financed infrastructure projects over six decades. Three facts emerge. First, average value creation is high: the mean economic rate of return is 24 percent (median 18.5 percent). Second, returns rise over time: after relative stability through the mid‑1980s, economic rates of return increased from the late 1980s onward, consistent with improved selection, design, and delivery. Third, economic rates of return are systematically higher in countries with weak institutions. In such countries, high-quality World Bank performance is associated with about a 12‑point increase in the average economic rate of return. A plausible mechanism is talent deployment. Higher‑quality task team leaders are disproportionately assigned to the most challenging contexts and linked to faster time‑to‑effectiveness and higher economic rates of return, despite longer, more intensive implementation. Overall, alongside country fundamentals, World Bank performance and talent deployment materially raise returns to scarce capital—especially where governance is weak.
doi:10.1596/1813-9450-11412.abstract_zh: 本文利用世界银行60年间2500个基础设施项目的事后经济回报率，重新审视援助有效性。研究发现三个事实：第一，平均价值创造水平较高——经济回报率均值为24%（中位数为18.5%）；第二，回报率随时间递增——在20世纪80年代中期前保持相对稳定后，自80年代末起经济回报率持续上升，这与项目筛选、设计及交付质量的改善相吻合；第三，制度薄弱国家的经济回报率系统性更高。在此类国家中，世界银行的高质量绩效可使平均经济回报率提升约12个百分点。其潜在机制在于人才配置：更优质的项目团队负责人被不成比例地分配到最具挑战性的环境中，尽管面临更长周期、更高强度的实施过程，却能显著缩短项目见效时间并提升经济回报率。总体而言，除国家基本面因素外，世界银行的绩效表现与人才配置能实质性提升稀缺资本的回报率——尤其在治理薄弱地区效果更为显著。
