doi:10.3386/w35288.abstract: Since the 1974 Safe Drinking Water Act, the U.S. has spent $2 trillion to provide safe drinking water, yet drinking water for 10–20 percent of Americans violates standards. We study trends, causes, and consequences of U.S. drinking water pollution, using 266 million readings on 1,250 pollutants over decades that we obtained from 48 states via dozens of Freedom of Information Act and associated requests. We link pollution to administrative Medicare data on older Americans' health outcomes. Three findings emerge. First, U.S. drinking water pollution has declined rapidly; the share of readings exceeding current health standards fell by half from 2003–2019. Unregulated pollutants declined more slowly. Low-income areas have higher pollution; Black and Hispanic communities have more complex patterns. Second, loans provided by the Safe Drinking Water Act to water systems reduce pollution. At the estimated average loan cost-effectiveness, these loans could eliminate pollution above health standards for $46 annually per person. Third, these loans reduce mortality rates of older Americans. Although fiscal federalism cautions against federal funding of local public goods with few inter-jurisdictional externalities like drinking water, we estimate large benefits from Safe Drinking Water Act loans.
doi:10.3386/w35288.abstract_zh: 自1974年《安全饮用水法案》实施以来，美国已投入2万亿美元用于提供安全饮用水，但仍有10%至20%的美国民众的饮用水不符合标准。本研究利用从48个州通过数十次《信息自由法》及相关请求获取的、涵盖数十年间1250种污染物的2.66亿条监测数据，分析了美国饮用水污染的趋势、成因及后果，并将污染数据与老年人医疗保险行政数据中的健康结果进行关联。研究得出三项发现：第一，美国饮用水污染水平快速下降，2003年至2019年间超过现行健康标准的污染物读数比例下降了一半，但未受监管的污染物下降速度较慢。低收入地区污染程度更高，黑人和西班牙裔社区的污染模式更为复杂。第二，《安全饮用水法案》向供水系统提供的贷款有效降低了污染水平。按估算的平均贷款成本效益计算，这些贷款每年仅需人均46美元即可消除超标污染。第三，这些贷款降低了美国老年人的死亡率。尽管财政联邦主义通常反对联邦政府为饮用水这类跨辖区外部性较弱的本地公共品提供资金，但本研究估算显示，《安全饮用水法案》贷款带来了显著的社会效益。
doi:10.3386/w35288.china_relevance_reason: 工作论文摘要包含中国研究常见主题词，需要 AI 确认
doi:10.3386/w35288.title: Water Works: Causes and Consequences of Safe Drinking Water in America
doi:10.3386/w35288.title_zh: 水之功效：美国安全饮用水的成因与影响

doi:10.3386/w35291.abstract: Scaling up effective policies often requires the attention of frontline bureaucrats with many competing responsibilities. Even when policymakers adopt effective programs, implementation may not follow. In a nationwide experiment in the Dominican Republic, we test interventions to increase school principals' implementation of an educational program proven effective in a previous RCT. Only 37% of control schools verifiably implemented the intervention when ordered to by the Ministry of Education, compared with 83% in the original trial. Implementation was no higher among schools that previously implemented the program in the RCT, suggesting that fixed costs of adoption do not explain non-adoption. We find precise null effects of sharing research evidence, providing modest financial incentives, or offering implementation assistance to principals. In contrast, additional reminder calls increased implementation by 20 percentage points. A second experiment targeting a different mandated program yields the same pattern: reminders produce large effects, while monitoring messages have smaller effects. Our findings point to limited attention among bureaucrats as an important barrier to scaling policies.
doi:10.3386/w35291.abstract_zh: 扩大有效政策的实施规模，往往需要一线行政人员投入精力，而他们通常身兼多项职责。即使政策制定者采纳了有效的项目，执行也可能无法跟进。在多米尼加共和国的一项全国性实验中，我们测试了旨在提高校长执行一项经先前随机对照试验（RCT）证明有效的教育项目的干预措施。当教育部下令实施时，对照组学校中仅有37%可验证地执行了该干预措施，而原始试验中这一比例为83%。在先前RCT中已执行该项目的学校中，实施率并未更高，这表明采纳的固定成本并不能解释未采纳现象。我们发现，分享研究证据、提供适度经济激励或向校长提供实施支持均产生精确的零效应。相比之下，额外的提醒电话使实施率提高了20个百分点。针对另一项强制性项目的第二项实验得出了相同模式：提醒产生显著效果，而监控信息的效果较小。我们的研究结果表明，行政人员注意力有限是政策规模化推广的重要障碍。
doi:10.3386/w35291.title: Incentives, Evidence, and Reminders for Bureaucrats: Overcoming Barriers to Policy Scale Up
doi:10.3386/w35291.title_zh: 激励、证据与对官僚的提醒：克服政策推广的障碍

doi:10.3386/w35299.abstract: We conduct a meta-analysis of 82 randomized controlled trials across more than 20 countries to estimate the effects of low-cost, remote parental engagement interventions delivered through text messages, phone calls, and apps. We estimate a joint likelihood function that incorporates both written studies and unwritten studies identified through trial registries, funder records, research labs, evidence clearinghouses, and other sources. By also recording sample sizes for unwritten studies, the model estimates the distribution of standard errors, identifies write-up probabilities conditional on significance, and characterizes the file drawer by estimating effect distributions for written and unwritten studies. Bias-corrected effects are 0.05 SD for test scores, 0.07 SD for grades, 0.05 SD for attendance, and 0.03 SD for enrollment. In the best-identified domain, test scores, statistically insignificant results are still written up at high rates. We also find that larger studies tend to estimate smaller latent effects, which could indicate that true effects are correlated with study precision, violating a common meta-analysis assumption. In smaller-sample domains, our approach helps identify selection probabilities by anchoring the absolute write-up rates. Finally, we estimate the value of additional RCTs to inform adoption decisions. Any single study estimate is unlikely to dissuade adoption because parent interventions have high marginal value of public funds. Instead, future research is most valuable when it can explain heterogeneity across settings.
doi:10.3386/w35299.abstract_zh: 我们对来自20多个国家的82项随机对照试验进行了元分析，以评估通过短信、电话和应用程序实施的低成本、远程家长参与干预措施的效果。我们构建了一个联合似然函数，该函数整合了已发表研究以及通过试验注册库、资助方记录、研究实验室、证据数据库及其他来源识别的未发表研究。通过同时记录未发表研究的样本量，该模型估计了标准误的分布，识别了基于显著性的撰写概率，并通过估计已发表与未发表研究的效果分布来刻画文件抽屉效应。经偏差校正后的效果为：考试成绩0.05个标准差、学业成绩0.07个标准差、出勤率0.05个标准差、入学率0.03个标准差。在识别效果最佳的考试成绩领域，统计不显著的结果仍以较高比例被撰写发表。我们还发现，样本量较大的研究倾向于估计出更小的潜在效应，这可能表明真实效应与研究精度存在相关性，从而违反了元分析中的常见假设。在样本量较小的领域，我们的方法通过锚定绝对撰写率来帮助识别选择概率。最后，我们估算了额外随机对照试验的价值，以指导采纳决策。由于家长干预措施具有较高的公共资金边际价值，任何单一研究估计值都不太可能阻止其被采纳。相反，当未来研究能够解释不同情境下的异质性时，其价值最为显著。
doi:10.3386/w35299.title: Characterizing the File Drawer: Evidence from a Meta-Analysis of Parent-Interventions Around the World
doi:10.3386/w35299.title_zh: 描述文件抽屉：基于全球家长干预元分析的证据

doi:10.3386/w35304.abstract: Solar Radiation Modification (SRM) has been proposed as a potential tool to limit increases in global or regional temperatures caused by anthropogenic greenhouse gas emissions. While previous research has extensively examined the climate system’s response to various SRM strategies, as well as their aggregate economic consequences, the regional distribution of economic impacts has received less attention. In this study, we use NorESM2–DIAM—an Earth System Model coupled to a high-resolution integrated assessment model—to assess the economic impacts, measured in GDP per capita, in an idealised SRM scenario where incoming solar radiation is reduced by 1%. Our results suggest that, relative to a baseline without SRM, most countries experience economic gains under SRM, with only a few countries facing negative impacts. Low-income countries tend to see the largest benefits, reducing global economic inequality relative to the baseline. However, reduced damages and lower inequality are accompanied by higher emissions under SRM, potentially leading to additional adverse effects not captured here. These findings highlight potential trade-offs between economic benefits, reduced inequality, and increased emissions relevant for SRM governance.
doi:10.3386/w35304.abstract_zh: 太阳辐射管理（SRM）已被提出作为限制人为温室气体排放导致全球或区域气温升高的潜在工具。尽管已有研究广泛探讨了气候系统对不同SRM策略的响应及其总体经济后果，但经济影响的区域分布问题受到的关注较少。本研究利用耦合高分辨率综合评估模型的地球系统模型NorESM2–DIAM，评估了在理想化SRM情景（入射太阳辐射减少1%）下以人均GDP衡量的经济影响。结果表明：与未实施SRM的基准情景相比，大多数国家在SRM下获得经济收益，仅少数国家面临负面影响。低收入国家往往获得最大收益，从而降低了相对于基准情景的全球经济不平等。然而，SRM在减少损害和降低不平等的同时，也伴随着更高的排放量，可能引发本研究未涵盖的额外不利影响。这些发现揭示了SRM治理中经济收益、不平等减少与排放增加之间的潜在权衡关系。
doi:10.3386/w35304.title: Regional Economic Impacts and Emission Responses under Solar Radiation Modification
doi:10.3386/w35304.title_zh: 太阳辐射干预下的区域经济影响与排放响应

doi:10.3386/w35305.abstract: This is the first study to estimate the impact of sports gambling legalization on food sufficiency using the staggered implementation of state laws between 2021-2023. By analyzing Google searches for online sportsbooks and legal wagers, we show that interest in sports gambling increases sharply following legalization. Applying an imputation-based difference-in-differences design to biweekly Household Pulse Survey (HPS) data, we find that legalized sports gambling reduces household food sufficiency by 2.1 percent among working-age adults without a college degree, which translates to a 10.5 percent decline among active bettors. This effect is cyclical, persisting for three-to-five months during NFL seasons. Additionally, the declines in food sufficiency are larger among households with adults aged 25-44 and racial/ethnic minorities. Using additional data from the HPS, Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System and Current Population Survey, our exploration of mechanisms suggests that the negative effects on food sufficiency operate through financial distress rather than changes in mental health or labor supply. A back-of-the-envelope calculation indicates that legalization of sports gambling in nine states resulted in an additional 284,000 food-insufficient households and $130.2 million in excess healthcare expenditures annually.
doi:10.3386/w35305.abstract_zh: 本研究首次利用2021至2023年间各州法律分阶段实施的情况，评估体育博彩合法化对食物充足性的影响。通过分析在线体育博彩平台的谷歌搜索量及合法投注数据，我们发现合法化后公众对体育博彩的兴趣急剧上升。采用基于插补的双重差分法对双周家庭脉搏调查数据进行分析，结果显示：体育博彩合法化使未获得大学学位的劳动年龄人口家庭食物充足性下降2.1%，相当于活跃投注者群体中10.5%的降幅。该效应呈现周期性特征，在NFL赛季期间持续三至五个月。此外，在25-44岁成年人家庭及少数族裔群体中，食物充足性下降幅度更为显著。结合家庭脉搏调查、行为风险因素监测系统及当前人口调查的补充数据，机制分析表明：食物充足性受损主要通过财务困境渠道传导，而非心理健康或劳动供给变化所致。粗略估算显示，九个州的体育博彩合法化每年导致新增28.4万个食物不足家庭，并产生1.302亿美元的额外医疗支出。
doi:10.3386/w35305.title: Wagering the Bread Money: Sports Betting Legalization and Food Sufficiency
doi:10.3386/w35305.title_zh: 赌注面包钱：体育博彩合法化与食物充足性

doi:10.3386/w35315.abstract: We study labor-market polarization by developing a framework with heterogeneous consumers, non-homothetic preferences, and endogenous labor supply a la Roy (1951). Because income-elastic sectors are intensive in high- and low-skilled occupations, shocks that raise either the average or the dispersion of income across households shift relative labor demand toward these occupations, generating an income channel to polarization. We quantify this channel by comparing the effect of shocks that affect the distribution of household income in our model and in a version with homothetic preferences in which the income distribution does not affect sectoral composition. The income channel is sizable: it explains 42% and 210% of the increases in the relative wages of high- and low-skill workers observed between 1980 and 2016, and 26% and 51% of the increase in their hours-worked shares. A quarter of its effect operates through income dispersion, highlighting the importance of departing from representative-consumer frameworks in non-homothetic environments.
doi:10.3386/w35315.abstract_zh: 本文通过构建一个包含异质性消费者、非位似偏好以及罗伊（1951）式内生劳动供给的框架，研究劳动力市场的极化现象。由于收入弹性部门密集使用高技能与低技能职业，任何提升家庭平均收入或收入离散度的冲击，都会使相对劳动力需求向这些职业倾斜，从而形成极化的收入渠道。我们通过比较模型中影响家庭收入分布的冲击效应与采用位似偏好（此时收入分布不影响部门构成）版本的效应，对该渠道进行量化分析。研究显示，收入渠道影响显著：它解释了1980年至2016年间高技能与低技能工人相对工资增幅的42%和210%，以及其劳动工时占比增幅的26%和51%。其中四分之一的效应通过收入离散度发挥作用，这凸显了在非位似环境下突破代表性消费者框架的重要性。
doi:10.3386/w35315.title: The Income Channel to Labor-Market Polarization
doi:10.3386/w35315.title_zh: 劳动力市场两极分化的收入渠道

doi:10.3386/w35322.abstract: The consequences of online regulations depend on the extent to which users can circumvent restrictions or substitute toward noncompliant platforms. Since 2023, 25 U.S. states have implemented age verification laws that caused prominent adult websites (including Pornhub) to restrict local access for all users. We study how these restrictions affected browsing activity using individual-level panel data. Access restrictions reduced overall time spent on adult sites by roughly 10%. Specifically, for every 100 hours spent on top adult sites before restrictions, about 50 hours remained accessible at noncompliant sites that never restricted access, 30 hours persisted through VPN-based circumvention, 10 hours were substituted from compliant sites to noncompliant sites, and 10 hours were no longer spent on adult sites.
doi:10.3386/w35322.abstract_zh: 网络监管的效果取决于用户规避限制或转向不合规平台的程度。自2023年以来，美国25个州实施了年龄验证法律，导致知名成人网站（包括Pornhub）对所有用户限制本地访问。我们利用个体层面面板数据研究了这些限制对浏览活动的影响。访问限制使成人网站总浏览时间减少约10%。具体而言，在限制实施前每100小时成人网站浏览时间中，约50小时仍可通过从未限制访问的不合规网站获取，30小时通过VPN规避持续存在，10小时从合规网站转向不合规网站，另有10小时不再用于访问成人网站。
doi:10.3386/w35322.title: Can Online Activity Be Regulated? Evidence from Adult Websites
doi:10.3386/w35322.title_zh: 网络活动能否被监管？来自成人网站的证据

doi:10.3386/w35323.abstract: Deciding whether to use an annuity to draw down accumulated retirement wealth is among the most complex financial decisions individuals face. It requires reasoning about longevity risk, stochastic income streams, and largely irreversible tradeoffs, often at older ages and with limited opportunities to learn from experience. This paper reviews theoretical, empirical, and experimental research to examine how financial literacy and longevity literacy shape annuitization decisions. While some extensions of the standard lifecycle model can rationalize low annuity demand, their explanatory power depends on individuals’ ability to optimize over a set of complex risks and tradeoffs. Evidence shows that, although financial and longevity literacy are only weakly and inconsistently related to annuity take-up, they are strongly associated with retirement planning, the coherence of annuity valuations, and sensitivity to framing and choice architecture. These patterns suggest that literacy should be understood not as a direct determinant of annuity demand, but as a constraint on the extent to which observed annuitization behavior can be interpreted as revealing true preferences.
doi:10.3386/w35323.abstract_zh: 决定是否使用年金来提取积累的退休财富，是个人面临的最复杂的财务决策之一。这需要考量长寿风险、随机收入流以及很大程度上不可逆的权衡取舍，且往往发生在年长阶段，同时从经验中学习的机会有限。本文回顾了理论、实证与实验研究，探讨金融素养和长寿素养如何影响年金化决策。尽管标准生命周期模型的某些扩展可以解释较低的年金需求，但其解释力取决于个人在一系列复杂风险与权衡中优化决策的能力。证据表明，尽管金融素养和长寿素养与年金参与率之间仅存在微弱且不一致的关联，但它们与退休规划、年金估值的连贯性以及对框架和选择架构的敏感性密切相关。这些模式表明，素养不应被理解为年金需求的直接决定因素，而应被视为一种约束条件，制约着观察到的年金化行为在多大程度上可以被解读为揭示真实偏好。
doi:10.3386/w35323.title: How Do Financial and Longevity Literacy Affect Annuity Demand?
doi:10.3386/w35323.title_zh: 金融素养与长寿素养如何影响年金需求？

doi:10.3386/w35324.abstract: We assess the empirical evidence for the hypothesis that women more than men respond to changes in treatment. First, we examine whether the results of over two hundred experimental economics papers support the female sensitivity hypothesis. Second, using data from two studies (DellaVigna and Pope, 2022; Exley et al., 2025), we conduct over two hundred pairwise tests of the hypothesis. Both analyses show that gender is not predictive of responsiveness to treatment. We further examine how the hypothesis has been disseminated in the literature and find that it is referenced predominantly by papers that support it.
doi:10.3386/w35324.abstract_zh: 我们评估了女性比男性更易对处理变化做出反应这一假设的实证证据。首先，我们考察了超过两百篇实验经济学论文的结果是否支持女性敏感性假说。其次，利用两项研究（DellaVigna和Pope，2022；Exley等，2025）的数据，我们对该假说进行了超过两百次成对检验。两项分析均表明，性别并不能预测对处理的反应程度。我们进一步考察了该假说在文献中的传播情况，发现其主要被支持该假说的论文所引用。
doi:10.3386/w35324.title: The Female Sensitivity Hypothesis: Evidence From Experimental Economics
doi:10.3386/w35324.title_zh: 女性敏感性假说：来自实验经济学的证据

doi:10.3386/w35325.abstract: Risk adjustment is a payment mechanism, not only a prediction problem. I extend optimal risk adjustment to dynamic insurance markets in which plans capture future residuals from persistent risk. Under an efficiency criterion, payments should reflect expected profits and losses over the enrollee relationship on margins plans control, not only one-year spending predictions. A finite-cell model separates selection, health production, and manipulable measurement. The framework implies that annual recalculation can tax prevention, high-R² prediction can reduce welfare, and lagged claims anchors are useful only with gaming safeguards.
doi:10.3386/w35325.abstract_zh: 风险调整是一种支付机制，而不仅仅是预测问题。本文将最优风险调整扩展至动态保险市场，在该市场中，保险计划可从持续性风险中获取未来残差收益。基于效率准则，支付应反映保险计划可控边际上参保人关系存续期内预期的利润与损失，而非仅基于单年支出预测。通过有限单元模型，本文分离了选择效应、健康生产效应与可操纵的测量效应。该框架表明：年度重新计算可能对预防行为产生税收效应，高R²预测可能降低社会福利，而滞后理赔锚定仅在存在博弈防范机制时才有用。
doi:10.3386/w35325.title: Dynamic Risk Adjustment in Markets with Persistent Risk and Manipulable Signals: Market Design for Health Insurance
doi:10.3386/w35325.title_zh: 持续风险与可操纵信号市场中的动态风险调整：健康保险的市场设计

doi:10.3386/w35326.abstract: Latin America's momentous fertility transition is now in the domain of history, allowing a cohort perspective on the decline of completed fertility. Using census microdata from 17 Latin American countries, we track female birth cohorts from the 1920s to the 1970s by subnational region to document the extent to which cohort fertility decline coincided with other demographic and socioeconomic processes. Across cohorts within subnational regions, children ever born fell one-for-one with mortality decline. Expansions in urbanization, multigenerational living, women's and husbands' education, women's employment, and the non-agricultural sector all predicted declines in ever-born and surviving fertility, but women's education and sectoral composition were the dominant forces after covariate adjustment. Fertility decline was not systematically linked with improvements in children's outcomes, including school enrollment, literacy, primary completion, and non-employment. These cohort facts challenge theories of fertility decline centered on women's work and children's education but support others emphasizing women's education.
doi:10.3386/w35326.abstract_zh: 拉丁美洲意义深远的生育率转型已成为历史，这使得从队列视角审视终身生育率的下降成为可能。利用17个拉美国家的人口普查微观数据，我们追踪了1920年代至1970年代女性出生队列在次国家区域层面的变化，以揭示队列生育率下降与其他人口及社会经济进程的关联程度。在次国家区域内的队列间，终身生育数与死亡率下降呈一对一关系。城市化扩展、多代同堂居住、女性及配偶教育水平提升、女性就业增长以及非农业部门扩张均能预测终身生育数与存活子女数的下降，但在协变量调整后，女性教育水平与部门结构成为主导因素。生育率下降与儿童教育成果（包括入学率、识字率、小学毕业率及非就业率）的改善并无系统性关联。这些队列事实对以女性劳动参与和儿童教育为核心的生育率下降理论提出挑战，但支持了强调女性教育作用的其他理论。
doi:10.3386/w35326.china_relevance_reason: 工作论文摘要包含中国研究常见主题词，需要 AI 确认
doi:10.3386/w35326.title: A Cohort Perspective on Latin America's Fertility Transition
doi:10.3386/w35326.title_zh: 拉丁美洲生育率转变的队列视角

doi:10.3386/w35327.abstract: Male labor force participation has declined steadily for 50 years in the United States. We show that one cause has been changes in men's beliefs about the returns to work, shaped by lifetime experiences of the aggregate male labor market. We find that experience effects on participation persist for men who move across state lines, are stronger for same-race male experiences, and are driven by formative childhood years. We also document effects of experiences on direct measures of labor market expectations. Our findings suggest that experience effects can turn short-run declines in labor demand into long-run declines in labor supply.
doi:10.3386/w35327.abstract_zh: 美国男性劳动力参与率在过去50年间持续下降。研究表明，其中一个原因是男性对工作回报的信念发生了变化，而这种信念受到其一生中整体男性劳动力市场经历的影响。我们发现，跨州迁移的男性仍会保留经历对参与率的影响，且同种族男性经历的影响更为显著，这种影响主要源于童年关键成长期。我们还证实了经历对劳动力市场预期直接测度指标的作用。研究结果表明，经历效应可能将劳动力需求的短期下降转化为劳动力供给的长期萎缩。
doi:10.3386/w35327.title: 'Nobody Wants to Work Anymore': Lifetime Labor Market Experiences and the Decline of Male LFP in the United States
doi:10.3386/w35327.title_zh: 没人想再工作了”：美国男性终身劳动力市场经历与劳动参与率下降

doi:10.3386/w35328.abstract: We quantify the impact of the loss of reserve currency status in goods and asset markets. In goods markets, the loss of seigniorage (1% of GDP per annum) makes American households spend less, mostly on U.S. goods, leaving an excess supply of U.S. goods to be cleared by a real depreciation of the dollar. The larger the home bias and the lower the elasticity of substitution between home and foreign goods, the larger the required depreciation. Standard parameters imply an 8.8% real depreciation of the dollar. In asset markets, about 50% of GDP in dollar bonds must be reabsorbed by home investors, raising the U.S. real interest rate. Standard parameters imply a 90 basis points rise, leading to an aggregate wealth loss of roughly one year of U.S. GDP.
doi:10.3386/w35328.abstract_zh: 我们量化了失去商品和资产市场储备货币地位的影响。在商品市场中，铸币税收益的丧失（每年占GDP的1%）导致美国家庭减少支出，其中大部分支出削减针对美国商品，从而产生美国商品的超额供给，需通过美元实际贬值来出清。本国偏好越强、本国与外国商品之间的替代弹性越低，所需的贬值幅度就越大。标准参数设定下，美元需实际贬值8.8%。在资产市场中，约50% GDP规模的美元债券必须由国内投资者重新吸收，这将推高美国实际利率。标准参数设定下，利率将上升90个基点，导致总财富损失约为美国一年GDP的规模。
doi:10.3386/w35328.title: Dollar Erosion: Understanding the Loss of Reserve Currency Status
doi:10.3386/w35328.title_zh: 美元侵蚀：理解储备货币地位的丧失

doi:10.3386/w35329.abstract: Micro estimates of the Marshallian elasticity of labor supply are small and typically positive, whereas cross-country and time-series patterns of hours imply a strong negative relationship between wages and hours. I reconcile these two apparently contradictory observations using a single utility specification and taking into account heterogeneity in non-labor income. Micro estimates condition on non-labor income, while macro variation allows capital income to adjust alongside labor income, which strengthens the income effect. A model with heterogeneous households and exogenous capital income yields closed-form expressions in which the distribution of the labor share shapes the gap between the micro and the macro elasticities. A cross-sectional regression of hours on wages that conditions on the labor share recovers the macro elasticity. A dynamic model with heterogeneous households and incomplete asset markets reproduces both elasticities as outcomes when disciplined by joint moments of wages, hours, consumption, and wealth. The income effects that bridge the gap between the two elasticities imply marginal propensities to earn that lie in the range of estimates of micro studies on lottery winners.
doi:10.3386/w35329.abstract_zh: 马歇尔劳动供给弹性的微观估计值较小且通常为正，而跨国与时间序列的工作时长模式则显示工资与工作时长之间存在强烈的负相关关系。本文通过单一效用函数设定并考虑非劳动收入的异质性，调和了这两种看似矛盾的观测结果。微观估计以非劳动收入为条件，而宏观变化则允许资本收入与劳动收入同步调整，从而强化了收入效应。一个包含异质性家庭与外生资本收入的模型可推导出闭式表达式，其中劳动收入份额的分布决定了微观弹性与宏观弹性之间的差距。以劳动收入份额为条件的横截面工作时长-工资回归能够还原宏观弹性。一个包含异质性家庭与不完全资产市场的动态模型，在工资、工作时长、消费与财富的联合矩约束下，可同时再现两种弹性。弥合两种弹性差距的收入效应意味着边际收入倾向处于彩票中奖者微观研究的估计区间内。
doi:10.3386/w35329.title: Reconciling Micro Elasticities with the Macro Decline in Labor Supply
doi:10.3386/w35329.title_zh: 协调微观弹性与宏观劳动供给下降

doi:10.3386/w35330.abstract: Shortly after major policy changes to US science funding began in early 2025, we surveyed 916 young biomedical scientists – PhD students and postdoctoral researchers – about their career intentions and expectations. The results document a dramatic shift in sentiment. Barely half of respondents now say they are likely to remain in academia, down 22 percentage points from how they felt six months earlier. The fraction likely to stay in the United States fell by 21 percentage points. Even satisfaction with having pursued a PhD in science declined by 16 percentage points. These are not the complaints of established scientists defending their budgets, but rather the stated intentions of the next generation – the scientists who would, in ordinary times, become the principal investigators of the future.
doi:10.3386/w35330.abstract_zh: 2025年初美国科研经费重大政策调整后不久，我们针对916名青年生物医学科学家（博士生和博士后研究人员）开展了职业意向与预期调查。结果显示科研人员心态发生显著转变：目前仅半数受访者表示可能留在学术界，较六个月前下降22个百分点；可能留在美国工作的比例下降21个百分点；甚至对攻读科学博士学位的满意度也下降16个百分点。这并非资深科学家为维护预算而发出的抱怨，而是下一代科研工作者——在正常情况下本应成为未来首席研究员的群体——明确表达的职业规划。
doi:10.3386/w35330.title: Before the Exodus? Young Scientists and the Future of US Science
doi:10.3386/w35330.title_zh: 出走之前？青年科学家与美国科学的未来

doi:10.3386/w35331.abstract: Remote work has expanded rapidly, but the value of regular in-person contact remains unclear. We report a randomized controlled trial in which a large multinational randomly assigned 248 customer-service employees to remain fully remote or to work at the office together one day a month. Monthly office days gradually increased productivity, with treated employees handling 7.8% more calls per hour in the post-intervention period. Office days also strengthened workplace communication: treated employees spent 36 additional minutes communicating with colleagues in the week after an office visit, were more likely to report receiving manager feedback, and employee pairs randomly assigned as desk neighbors were 11 percentage points more likely to communicate afterward. In addition, monthly office days reduced attrition by a third. The resulting gains in productivity and retention generated a benefit–cost ratio of about 5:1. These findings show that limited, coordinated in-person contact can improve communication, performance, and retention in remote teams.
doi:10.3386/w35331.abstract_zh: 远程工作迅速普及，但定期面对面接触的价值仍不明确。我们报告了一项随机对照试验，一家大型跨国企业将248名客服员工随机分配为完全远程办公或每月有一天共同到办公室工作。每月办公室工作日逐渐提高了生产率，在干预后阶段，受处理员工每小时处理的电话数量增加了7.8%。办公室工作日还加强了职场沟通：受处理员工在办公室访问后一周内与同事的沟通时间增加了36分钟，更有可能报告收到管理者的反馈，且被随机分配为相邻工位的员工在之后沟通的可能性提高了11个百分点。此外，每月办公室工作日将员工流失率降低了三分之一。由此带来的生产率和留任率提升产生了约5:1的收益成本比。这些发现表明，有限且协调的面对面接触能够改善远程团队的沟通、绩效和留任率。
doi:10.3386/w35331.title: The Value of One Office Day a Month
doi:10.3386/w35331.title_zh: 每月一天办公室办公的价值

doi:10.3386/w35332.abstract: During the Age of Mass Migration, over forty percent of immigrants were women, yet most research focuses on men. Using linked 1900 and 1910 Census records, I show that economic assimilation patterns differed for men and women, and families assimilated at different rates than individuals. Immigrant families improved their relative income scores compared with US-born families, driven by reliance on multiple earners, particularly women’s and children’s labor. At the individual level, gaps between immigrant and US-born income scores were larger for women than men, and the gap for women barely changed even after twenty years of stay.
doi:10.3386/w35332.abstract_zh: 在大规模移民时代，超过40%的移民为女性，但多数研究聚焦于男性。通过关联1900年和1910年的人口普查记录，我发现男性和女性的经济同化模式存在差异，且家庭层面的同化速度与个体层面不同。移民家庭相较于本土出生家庭，其相对收入得分有所提升，这主要得益于对多重收入来源的依赖，尤其是女性和儿童的劳动。在个体层面，移民与本土出生者收入得分的差距在女性中比男性更大，且即使居住二十年后，女性的这一差距也几乎没有变化。
doi:10.3386/w35332.title: Economic Assimilation of Women and Families in the Age of Mass Migration
doi:10.3386/w35332.title_zh: 大规模移民时代女性与家庭的经济同化

doi:10.3386/w35333.abstract: We estimate the effect of total abortion bans enacted after Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health on sexual behavior. Using synthetic and standard difference-in-differences designs, we analyze gonorrhea rates and over-the-counter contraceptive purchases as indicators of sexual activity and contraceptive use. We find that total abortion bans reduced gonorrhea rates by 21% among the population aged 15–44 and increased condom purchases by 5.4%. County-level analyses suggest the response reflects awareness of state policy rather than changes in travel distance to providers. These findings are consistent with a framework in which abortion restrictions increase the perceived cost of unprotected sex, inducing more cautious behavior.
doi:10.3386/w35333.abstract_zh: 我们估算了多布斯诉杰克逊妇女健康组织案后实施全面堕胎禁令对性行为的影响。采用合成双重差分法和标准双重差分法，我们以淋病发病率和非处方避孕药具购买量作为性行为活跃度及避孕措施使用的指标进行分析。研究发现，全面堕胎禁令使15-44岁人群的淋病发病率降低21%，避孕套购买量增加5.4%。县级层面分析表明，这一反应源于对州政策的认知，而非前往医疗服务机构出行距离的变化。这些发现与以下理论框架一致：堕胎限制提高了无保护性行为的感知成本，从而促使人们采取更谨慎的行为。
doi:10.3386/w35333.title: Playing it Safe? The Effect of Abortion Bans on Sexual Behavior
doi:10.3386/w35333.title_zh: 谨慎行事？堕胎禁令对性行为的影响

doi:10.3386/w35334.abstract: We study the optimal design of trade and industrial policy when governments pursue environmental objectives alongside traditional national welfare. Motivated by the global transition to electric vehicles (EVs) and growing concerns about competitiveness, resilience, and the environment, we develop a framework in which policymakers choose tariffs and domestic production subsidies to maximize national welfare, defined as the sum of consumer surplus, domestic profits, environmental benefits, and tariff revenue net of subsidies. We combine a theoretical model of differentiated-product oligopoly with a structural demand model estimated using vehicle-level data from 13 countries during 2004-2023 that together account for the vast majority of global EV sales. Our central finding is that the optimal policy combines a moderate tariff on imported EVs with a subsidy to domestic EV production financed through tariff revenue. This policy substantially outperforms both outright protectionism and laissez-faire. Relative to current policies, it preserves consumer access to affordable EVs, accelerates fleet electrification, supports domestic producers, and remains budget-neutral. For the United States, the optimal policy more than doubles EV market share, generates over $45 billion in annual welfare gains, and avoids approximately 95 million tons of lifetime CO2 emissions. A key mechanism underlying these results is the pass-through of tariffs and subsidies to prices, which depends critically on demand curvature, product substitution, and market structure. More broadly, our results suggest that effective industrial policy requires careful attention to market structure and country-specific conditions, balancing consumer, producer, fiscal, and environmental objectives rather than adhering to ideological prescriptions.
doi:10.3386/w35334.abstract_zh: 本文研究政府在追求环境目标与传统国民福利时，贸易与产业政策的最优设计问题。受全球向电动汽车转型以及对竞争力、韧性和环境日益关注的驱动，我们构建了一个分析框架，其中政策制定者通过选择关税和国内生产补贴，最大化国民福利——该福利定义为消费者剩余、国内利润、环境收益以及扣除补贴后的关税收入之和。我们将差异化产品寡头垄断的理论模型与基于2004-2023年13个国家（占全球电动汽车销量绝大部分）车辆级数据估计的结构性需求模型相结合。核心发现是：最优政策组合为对进口电动汽车征收适度关税，同时用关税收入补贴国内电动汽车生产。该政策显著优于纯粹的保护主义和自由放任政策。与现行政策相比，它既能保障消费者获得可负担的电动汽车，加速车队电气化进程，支持国内生产商，又能保持预算中性。对美国而言，最优政策可使电动汽车市场份额翻倍以上，每年产生超过450亿美元的福利收益，并避免约9500万吨全生命周期二氧化碳排放。这些结果的关键机制在于关税和补贴向价格的传导效应，该效应主要取决于需求曲率、产品替代性和市场结构。更广泛而言，我们的研究表明，有效的产业政策需要审慎关注市场结构和国别特定条件，在消费者、生产者、财政和环境目标之间寻求平衡，而非固守意识形态教条。

doi:10.3386/w35334.title: From Trade War to Green Transition: Optimal Electric Vehicle Tariffs with Revenue-Funded Subsidies
doi:10.3386/w35334.title_zh: 从贸易战到绿色转型：收入补贴下的最优电动汽车关税

doi:10.3386/w35335.abstract: This paper studies how labor market power affects the transmission of monetary policy. Using administrative U.S. Census data, we show that firms with high monopsony power—defined as those accounting for over 10 percent of the local wage bill—respond less to monetary policy in terms of their wage bill and employment. We then develop a New Keynesian model with heterogeneous firms and oligopsonistic competition to interpret these findings. Wage stickiness combined with firms’ labor market power is key to generating the heterogeneous responses that we document. Our model highlights two channels through which oligopsony shapes the aggregate effects of monetary policy: partial passthrough and misallocation. Calibrated to U.S. labor markets, the model implies that the decline in labor market power since the 1980s has increased the output response to monetary policy by about 10 percent and accounts for about 15 percent of the estimated flattening of the Phillips curve.
doi:10.3386/w35335.abstract_zh: 本文研究劳动力市场势力如何影响货币政策的传导机制。基于美国人口普查局的行政数据，我们发现，具有高垄断势力（定义为占当地工资总额10%以上）的企业，其工资总额和就业对货币政策的反应较弱。为解释这一发现，我们构建了一个包含异质性企业和寡头竞争的新凯恩斯模型。工资粘性与企业劳动力市场势力的结合，是产生我们所记录的异质性反应的关键。该模型揭示了寡头垄断影响货币政策总体效应的两个渠道：部分传导效应与资源错配效应。基于美国劳动力市场的校准结果表明，自20世纪80年代以来劳动力市场势力的下降，使货币政策对产出的影响增强了约10%，并解释了菲利普斯曲线估计平坦化现象的约15%。
doi:10.3386/w35335.title: Monopsony Power and the Transmission of Monetary Policy
doi:10.3386/w35335.title_zh: 买方垄断势力与货币政策的传导

doi:10.3386/w35337.abstract: This paper studies the role of foreign exchange and gold reserves in mitigating the US monetary policy spillovers to exchange rates at times of geopolitical fragmentation and de-dollarization. US dollar reserves mitigate depreciation driven by US monetary tightening, while non-dollar reserves do not. Gold reserves are also associated with smaller exchange-rate responses, though less strongly than dollar reserves, suggesting novel complementarity between dollar and gold reserves. Moreover, the estimated effects of dollar and gold reserves are concentrated in countries without swap and repo lines. These findings are consistent with recent large-scale purchases and sales of gold reserves by emerging economies amid sanctions-related restrictions and geopolitical concerns about access to dollar liquidity. Our results suggest that not only the aggregate volume but also the composition of foreign exchange and gold reserves and access to dollar liquidity facilities are empirically relevant for exchange-rate responses to US monetary shocks. Finally, we exploit cross-country heterogeneity and show that countries with large dollar exposure exhibit smaller exchange-rate responses when dollar and gold reserve holdings are larger.
doi:10.3386/w35337.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在地缘政治碎片化和去美元化背景下，外汇储备与黄金储备在缓解美国货币政策对汇率溢出效应中的作用。美元储备能够缓解由美国货币紧缩引发的本币贬值，而非美元储备则不具备这一效果。黄金储备同样与较小的汇率波动幅度相关，但其作用弱于美元储备，这表明美元储备与黄金储备之间存在新颖的互补关系。此外，美元储备与黄金储备的估计效应主要集中在未持有货币互换和回购额度的国家。这些发现与新兴经济体因制裁相关限制及对美元流动性获取的地缘政治担忧而大规模买卖黄金储备的近期实践相一致。我们的结果表明，不仅外汇与黄金储备的总量，其构成以及美元流动性便利的可及性，在实证层面均与汇率对美国货币冲击的反应相关。最后，我们利用跨国异质性分析发现，在美元敞口较大的国家中，当美元储备与黄金储备持有量较高时，其汇率波动幅度更小。
doi:10.3386/w35337.title: US Monetary Spillovers, Foreign Exchange, and Gold Reserves at Times of Geopolitical Fragmentation
doi:10.3386/w35337.title_zh: 地缘政治分裂时期的美国货币溢出效应、外汇与黄金储备

doi:10.3386/w35338.abstract: Recent enthusiasm for field experiments, and especially for natural field experiments (NFEs), in which subjects go about their daily activities unaware that any study is taking place, has sometimes been read as a verdict against the laboratory. I argue that such a verdict is wrong. Through the lens of a simple rational-choice model, I show that the four standard experimental designs (laboratory, artefactual field experiment (AFE), framed field experiment (FFE), and NFE) are comparative-static restrictions of one maximization problem, each identifying a parameter the others cannot. The model reveals that each design type has distinctive strengths and weaknesses across various dimensions of knowledge creation, including the enforcement of the conditions for causal identification, the faithfulness of the experimental environment to the theory being tested, the identification of economic primitives via theoretical structure, and the ethics of studying human subjects. On each of the dimensions, the four design types are complements rather than rivals. Nowhere is this complementarity more evident than between the two extremes. The lab enforces the conditions for causal identification that the NFE must inherit from the market; the NFE recovers the parameter that governs behaviour in the wild, free of the selection, scrutiny, and environmental distortions the lab cannot escape. A research programme using all four designs together demonstrates something no single design can produce. The framework further accommodates the recent rise of online and survey experiments as natural extensions. Our discipline’s recent drift away from laboratory evidence is leaving an important structural gap that natural field experiments, however well conceived, cannot fill.
doi:10.3386/w35338.abstract_zh: 近年来对实地实验，尤其是自然实地实验（NFEs）的热衷——受试者在日常活动中完全不知情自己正参与研究——有时被解读为对实验室实验的否定。本文认为这种否定是错误的。通过一个简单理性选择模型的视角，我证明四种标准实验设计（实验室实验、人工实地实验（AFE）、框架实地实验（FFE）和自然实地实验（NFE））是同一最大化问题的比较静态约束，每种设计都能识别其他设计无法识别的参数。该模型揭示，在知识创造的多个维度上，每种设计类型都具有独特的优势与劣势，包括因果识别条件的执行、实验环境与被检验理论的一致性、通过理论结构识别经济基本要素，以及研究人类受试者的伦理问题。在这每个维度上，四种设计类型是互补而非竞争关系。这种互补性在实验室与自然实地实验这两个极端之间表现得最为显著：实验室强制执行因果识别条件，而自然实地实验必须从市场中继承这些条件；自然实地实验则能恢复支配真实世界行为的参数，不受实验室无法避免的选择、审视和环境扭曲的影响。采用全部四种设计的研究计划能够展现单一设计无法实现的结果。该框架还进一步将近年来兴起的在线实验和调查实验视为自然延伸。我们学科近期对实验室证据的疏离正在留下重要的结构性空白，而自然实地实验无论设计得多么精妙，都无法填补这一空白。
doi:10.3386/w35338.title: Don’t Give Up on Lab Experiments: Why the Field Still Needs the Lab
doi:10.3386/w35338.title_zh: 不要放弃实验室实验：为何田野研究仍需实验室

doi:10.3386/w35339.abstract: The World War II GI Bill was the largest education subsidy in US history and a cornerstone of the postwar US transition to a knowledge economy. Although formally race-blind, the program's decentralized administration left implementation to local officials and segregated institutions, with sharply different consequences for Black and white veterans. This paper quantifies the GI Bill's impact on Black and white Americans' economic outcomes across two generations, using a regression discontinuity around WWII service eligibility cutoffs and a new data linkage from veterans in the 1940 and 1950 censuses to their sons' neighborhood outcomes between 1990 and 2025. The GI Bill widened racial inequality, doubling white veterans' college completion while steering Black veterans into often-fraudulent vocational programs with no earnings returns. The disparities persisted across generations, increasing the white-Black gap in sons' adult-neighborhood outcomes, including a 5-percentage-point (47 percent) widening of the racial college gap. Unequal returns to the same eligibility account for the intergenerational gap, with no contribution from prewar differences in socioeconomic status or geography. In sum, access to the GI Bill was not nearly the same economic opportunity for Black Americans as it was for white Americans, highlighting that race-blind policy does not guarantee racial equality.
doi:10.3386/w35339.abstract_zh: 二战《退伍军人权利法案》是美国历史上规模最大的教育补贴项目，也是战后美国向知识经济转型的基石。尽管该法案在形式上不区分种族，但其分散化的行政管理将实施权下放给地方官员和实行种族隔离的机构，对黑人与白人退伍军人产生了截然不同的影响。本文利用二战服役资格门槛附近的断点回归方法，结合1940年与1950年人口普查中退伍军人数据与其子代在1990年至2025年间居住社区结果的新数据关联，量化了《退伍军人权利法案》对两代美国黑人与白人经济成果的影响。该法案加剧了种族不平等：使白人退伍军人大学完成率翻倍，却引导黑人退伍军人进入常含欺诈性质的职业培训项目，且未带来任何收入回报。这种不平等持续至下一代，导致白人-黑人子代成年社区结果差距扩大，其中种族大学教育差距扩大5个百分点（增幅达47%）。代际差距完全源于相同资格获取权带来的不平等回报，战前社会经济地位或地理分布差异对此并无贡献。总之，《退伍军人权利法案》为美国黑人提供的经济机会远不及白人，这凸显了形式上的种族中立政策并不能保证种族平等。
doi:10.3386/w35339.title: Blindly Discriminating: The GI Bill and Racial Inequality
doi:10.3386/w35339.title_zh: 盲目歧视：退伍军人权利法案与种族不平等

doi:10.3386/w35340.abstract: We study how the opioid epidemic shaped local population dynamics in the United States. Exploiting variation in exposure that stems from Purdue Pharma's targeted marketing of OxyContin to high-cancer-mortality areas, we find that more exposed commuting zones experienced lower population growth. By 2020, a one-standard-deviation increase in exposure reduced population growth among individuals aged 18 to 64 by 2.4 percentage points. Direct mortality from drug-induced deaths made only a limited contribution to these changes. Instead, population losses were primarily driven by migratory responses: exposure increased out-migration rates, especially among college-educated individuals. These responses are consistent with the opioid epidemic operating as a disamenity shock, deteriorating local quality of life. Working in the opposite direction, we also document a rise in fertility rates that, by 2020, partially counteracts these population losses. Our findings show that the opioid epidemic reshaped local demographic composition and contributed to the long-run divergence in population dynamics across U.S. commuting zones.
doi:10.3386/w35340.abstract_zh: 本文研究了阿片类药物危机如何塑造美国地方人口动态。利用普渡制药公司针对高癌症死亡率地区定向营销奥施康定所导致的暴露程度差异，我们发现暴露程度更高的通勤区人口增长率更低。截至2020年，暴露程度每增加一个标准差，18至64岁人群的人口增长率下降2.4个百分点。药物致死导致的直接死亡率对这些变化的贡献有限。相反，人口损失主要由迁移响应驱动：暴露程度提高了迁出率，尤其是在受过大学教育的群体中。这些响应与阿片类药物危机作为负外部性冲击、恶化地方生活质量的机制一致。作为反向作用，我们还发现生育率上升，到2020年部分抵消了这些人口损失。我们的研究结果表明，阿片类药物危机重塑了地方人口结构，并加剧了美国各通勤区人口动态的长期分化。
doi:10.3386/w35340.title: Demographic Divergence: The Legacy of the Opioid Epidemic
doi:10.3386/w35340.title_zh: 人口分化：阿片类药物危机的遗留影响

doi:10.3386/w35341.abstract: We study how debt news shapes firms’ inflation expectations in a monetary union. In an active-control experiment, German firms receive optimistic or pessimistic projections of France, Italy, and Spain’s debt-to-GDP ratios. Pessimistic news raises debt beliefs and increases one- and three-year inflation expectations, with no detectable effect at five years. The response is driven by low-trust firms and by firms expecting relatively low ECB policy rates. A salient German debt-financed fiscal shock generates no comparable response. Within a Fisherian framework, the evidence suggests that debt news becomes inflationary when firms perceive incomplete fiscal backing and expect monetary accommodation.
doi:10.3386/w35341.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在货币联盟中，债务新闻如何影响企业的通胀预期。在一项主动控制实验中，德国企业收到了关于法国、意大利和西班牙债务与GDP比率的乐观或悲观预测。悲观新闻提高了债务信念，并增加了一年期和三年期的通胀预期，但对五年期通胀预期没有显著影响。这种反应主要由低信任度企业以及预期欧洲央行政策利率相对较低的企业驱动。一个显著的德国债务融资财政冲击并未产生类似反应。在费雪框架内，证据表明，当企业认为财政支持不充分并预期货币政策宽松时，债务新闻会引发通胀效应。
doi:10.3386/w35341.title: Lack of Trust and Fiscal Dominance: Evidence from a Firm Survey Experiment
doi:10.3386/w35341.title_zh: 信任缺失与财政主导：来自企业调查实验的证据

doi:10.3386/w35342.abstract: This paper investigates why the widely-used Big Three financial literacy index provides a reliable measure of financial literacy. Using an Item Response Theory framework, we estimate item difficulty and discrimination parameters and conduct a meta analysis to assess the stability of these properties across datasets and countries. Results confirm the scale's validity and reliability, with item characteristics that remain stable across populations and settings. We find no evidence of measurement differences across demographic subgroups or countries. Compared to the longer Big Five scale, the Big Three index performs similarly in measuring financial literacy and predicting financial behaviors.
doi:10.3386/w35342.abstract_zh: 本文探究为何广泛使用的“三大金融素养指数”能可靠衡量金融素养。基于项目反应理论框架，我们估算了项目的难度与区分度参数，并通过元分析评估这些属性在不同数据集与国家间的稳定性。结果证实该量表的效度与信度，其项目特征在不同人群与情境中保持稳定。我们未发现不同人口统计子群体或国家间存在测量差异的证据。相较于更长的“五大金融素养量表”，“三大指数”在衡量金融素养及预测金融行为方面表现相当。
doi:10.3386/w35342.title: Measuring Financial Literacy with the Big Three: Why It Works
doi:10.3386/w35342.title_zh: 用“三大问题”衡量金融素养：为何有效

doi:10.3386/w35343.abstract: Great powers, like the United States and China, use existing trade and financial linkages of their economies to the rest of the world to exert geoeconomic power. The targeted entities include both foreign governments and foreign private firms. We characterize conditions under which a hegemonic country optimally targets private entities or their government in a given targeted foreign country. An advantage of coercing private entities is that they internalize less than their own government the equilibrium consequences of acquiescing to the hegemon's coercion. This allows the hegemon to build its power by exploiting the difference between the private cost to the targeted entity of the costly actions it demands and the social value to the hegemon of those actions. Coercing the government gives up some of this advantage, but offers the ability of having the targeted government potentially influence firms in its domestic economy that the hegemon finds valuable to coerce but for which it had limited direct coercive power. The relative strength of these two channels determines the optimal mix of coercion targeted at private entities and governments.
doi:10.3386/w35343.abstract_zh: 大国（如美国和中国）利用其经济与全球其他地区的既有贸易和金融联系来施加地缘经济影响力。其目标实体既包括外国政府，也包括外国私营企业。我们刻画了霸权国在特定目标外国中，最优选择针对私营实体或该国政府进行胁迫的条件。胁迫私营实体的优势在于：相较于目标国政府，私营实体对屈服于霸权国胁迫所产生的均衡后果内化程度更低。这使得霸权国能够利用其要求目标实体采取的高成本行动所产生的私人成本，与这些行动对霸权国的社会价值之间的差异来构建自身权力。胁迫政府虽会部分丧失这一优势，但能使目标国政府影响其国内经济中那些霸权国认为有价值胁迫、但自身直接胁迫能力有限的企业。这两个渠道的相对强弱决定了针对私营实体与政府的最优胁迫组合。
doi:10.3386/w35343.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.3386/w35343.title: The Targets of Geoeconomic Coercion

doi:10.3386/w35344.abstract: This paper studies market design for generative AI intermediation. AI answer systems can improve user experience while diverting visits that finance publisher content and generate source-level quality signals. I show that an AI platform that underinternalizes future content reproduction retains too little referral traffic and can make costly open-web information subcritical, even with truthful content, accurate answers, and rational users. The mechanism can be self-reinforcing: less source-level measurement weakens conventional search, inducing further AI reliance. Sustainable repair requires replacing displaced revenue and deleted measurement through visitor-replacement royalties, audited provenance, human-information audits, and keystone-topic compensation.
doi:10.3386/w35344.abstract_zh: 本文研究生成式人工智能中介的市场设计。人工智能问答系统在改善用户体验的同时，会分流原本用于资助发布者内容并产生源级质量信号的访问流量。研究表明，若人工智能平台未能充分内化未来内容再生产的影响，其保留的推荐流量将过少，甚至可能使开放网络信息陷入临界不足状态——即便在内容真实、答案准确且用户理性的条件下也是如此。该机制可能形成自我强化：源级测量减少会削弱传统搜索功能，进而促使人工智能进一步被依赖。可持续修复需要借助访客替代版税、审计溯源、人工信息审计及关键主题补偿等手段，来弥补被替代的收入与被删除的测量数据。
doi:10.3386/w35344.title: AI and the Collapse of the www
doi:10.3386/w35344.title_zh: 人工智能与万维网的崩溃

doi:10.3386/w35345.abstract: The emergence of wearable electroencephalography (EEG) technologies presents new opportunities to identify and quantify neural correlates of decision-making in real-time, financially consequential settings. We report a field study in which we use wearable EEG devices to record brainwave activity from professional day traders during real-world, high-stakes trading. Using these signals, we construct an established psychophysiological Engagement Index (EI), which is defined as beta wave power divided by the sum of alpha and theta wave power, and document clear spike-and-decay patterns around trade execution. Linking EI dynamics to trading performance, we find that more successful trades are preceded by larger EI spikes in the 30 seconds before execution, while baseline or background EI levels have no predictive power and, if anything, are negatively associated with performance. We further show that higher EI is associated with attenuated behavioral biases in trading, including the round number heuristic and the disposition effect.
doi:10.3386/w35345.abstract_zh: 可穿戴脑电图（EEG）技术的出现，为在实时且具有重大财务后果的环境中识别和量化决策的神经关联提供了新机遇。我们报告了一项实地研究，利用可穿戴EEG设备记录专业日内交易员在真实高风险交易中的脑电波活动。基于这些信号，我们构建了已确立的心理生理学参与指数（Engagement Index, EI），该指数定义为β波功率除以α波与θ波功率之和，并观察到交易执行前后明显的尖峰-衰减模式。将EI动态与交易绩效关联后，我们发现更成功的交易在执行前30秒内伴随更大的EI尖峰，而基线或背景EI水平则无预测能力，甚至与绩效呈负相关。进一步研究表明，较高的EI与交易中行为偏差的减弱相关，包括整数启发式偏差和处置效应。
doi:10.3386/w35345.title: Beta for Alpha: Neural Engagement in Financial Trading
doi:10.3386/w35345.title_zh: 阿尔法的贝塔：金融交易中的神经参与

doi:10.3386/w35346.abstract: Rising elderly life expectancy is a well-known source of fiscal pressure on Social Security and Medicare – but how have declining mortality and morbidity affected the two programs’ relative finances? Using nearly three decades of Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey data (1992-2019), we estimate that these demographic changes raised expected lifetime Social Security spending by over twice as much as expected lifetime Medicare spending: 14% compared to 6%. The slower growth of elderly lifetime health care spending than annuity spending reflects two features of how longevity has increased: the additional 2.4 years of remaining life expectancy were entirely healthy – free of physical or cognitive limitations – while the expected amount of time spent with severe health limitations fell by about 30%, reducing expected lifetime nursing-home and home-health use. We then write down a stylized life-cycle model of a risk-averse retiree facing stochastic mortality and health to illuminate the key forces that affect the optimal allocation of a fixed amount of public funds across Medicare and Social Security.
doi:10.3386/w35346.abstract_zh: 老年人预期寿命延长是社会保障和医疗保险财政压力的众所周知来源——但死亡率和发病率的下降如何影响这两项计划的相对财务状况？利用近三十年的医疗保险当前受益人调查数据（1992-2019年），我们估算出这些人口结构变化使预期终身社会保障支出增加了14%，而预期终身医疗保险支出仅增加了6%，前者增幅是后者的两倍以上。老年人终身医疗支出增长慢于年金支出增长，这反映了寿命延长的两个特征：新增的2.4年剩余预期寿命完全处于健康状态——无身体或认知障碍——而严重健康受限的预期时间减少了约30%，从而降低了预期终身护理院和居家护理的使用。随后，我们构建了一个面临随机死亡率和健康状况的风险厌恶退休者的简化生命周期模型，以阐明影响医疗保险与社会保障之间固定公共资金最优配置的关键因素。
doi:10.3386/w35346.title: Elderly Health and Longevity in the US: Evidence and Implications
doi:10.3386/w35346.title_zh: 美国老年人健康与长寿：证据与启示

doi:10.3386/w35347.abstract: Although use of generative AI tools has quickly become widespread in education settings, emerging evidence suggests that effects on learning will depend on how that use is supported and guided. This paper reports findings from an original national survey of K-12 school principals designed to measure institutional integration of AI in schools through policies, teacher training, guidance for student use, leadership engagement, and the availability of AI-enabled tools. We find that AI use has spread rapidly across schools, largely as a productivity aid. Students mainly use AI for homework help and writing, while educators primarily use it for lesson planning and administrative tasks. The development of teacher training, guidance, and school policies has lagged adoption. We next document two diffusion gaps across schools: First, lower AI integration is associated with a higher share of disadvantaged students (a one standard deviation increase in disadvantage is associated with a 0.07-0.11 SD lower score on an index of AI integration); Second, private and charter schools score 0.23-0.44 SD lower on the AI integration index than traditional public schools. Although several surveyed school-level factors strongly predict AI integration, they do little to explain these gaps. Differences in district size account for roughly one-third of the disadvantage gap between public schools. These findings suggest that the factors associated with greater AI integration differ from those needed to narrow disparities in how schools support and guide AI use.
doi:10.3386/w35347.abstract_zh: 尽管生成式人工智能工具在教育领域的应用已迅速普及，但新出现的证据表明，其对学习效果的影响将取决于使用方式是否得到有效支持和引导。本文基于一项针对K-12学校校长的全国性原创调查，旨在通过政策制定、教师培训、学生使用指导、领导层参与以及人工智能工具的可及性等维度，衡量学校对人工智能的制度化整合程度。研究发现，人工智能在学校中已快速普及，主要作为生产力辅助工具。学生主要将其用于作业辅助和写作，而教育工作者则主要将其用于课程规划与行政事务。然而，教师培训、使用指导及学校政策的制定却滞后于实际应用。我们进一步发现两类学校间的扩散差距：其一，人工智能整合程度较低与弱势学生比例较高相关（弱势学生比例每增加一个标准差，人工智能整合指数得分降低0.07-0.11个标准差）；其二，私立学校和特许学校的人工智能整合指数得分比传统公立学校低0.23-0.44个标准差。尽管调查中多个学校层面的因素能显著预测人工智能整合程度，但这些因素对上述差距的解释力有限。学区规模差异可解释公立学校间约三分之一的弱势差距。这些发现表明，促进人工智能整合的因素与缩小学校在支持和引导人工智能使用方面差距所需的条件并不相同。
doi:10.3386/w35347.title: AI Diffusion Gaps: Unequal Integration of AI Across K-12 Schools
doi:10.3386/w35347.title_zh: AI扩散鸿沟：K-12学校中人工智能的不均衡整合

doi:10.3386/w35348.abstract: Product and service quality is fundamental to firm value creation, yet it is well recognized as difficult to observe ex ante. Existing quality proxies are limited in coverage, lack cross-firm comparability, and primarily rely on lagging indicators that capture product or service failures only after they materialize. Exploiting employees’ informational advantage as informed insiders and firsthand observers of firms’ internal operations, we develop and validate a novel, forward-looking measure of firm-year-level product and service quality using over 4.3 million employee reviews on Glassdoor. Leveraging machine learning models trained on a subset of firms with third-party customer satisfaction data, we construct quality indices for S&P 1500 firms spanning 2008 to 2023. The resulting quality measures exhibit meaningful variation across firms and within firms over time. In out-of-sample tests, our quality indices demonstrate strong predictive power for future quality provision, emerging as the single most important predictor relative to firm fundamentals and Glassdoor ratings. We validate our measure by examining its association with alternative quality metrics. We show that our quality measures are useful in predicting important quality-related firm outcomes such as product recalls, brand value, and profitability. We also construct an alternative set of quality measures using a zero-shot prompt-based approach and a supervised fine-tuning approach with GPT models to assess the potential of LLMs and generative AI in capturing firm-level quality provision. Our paper shows the value of employee voices as a powerful, forward-looking, and scalable signal of firm quality provision. The paper offers implications for stakeholders seeking to identify quality-related risks and opportunities before they become externally visible.
doi:10.3386/w35348.abstract_zh: 产品和服务质量是企业价值创造的基础，但公认难以事前观察。现有质量代理指标覆盖范围有限、缺乏跨企业可比性，且主要依赖滞后指标——仅在产品或服务失败发生后才能捕捉问题。利用员工作为知情内部人和企业运营一线观察者的信息优势，我们基于Glassdoor平台430余万条员工评价，开发并验证了一种新颖的前瞻性企业年度产品与服务质量衡量指标。通过机器学习模型对部分拥有第三方客户满意度数据的企业进行训练，我们构建了2008年至2023年标普1500指数成分企业的质量指数。由此得出的质量指标在企业间及企业内随时间均呈现显著差异。在样本外测试中，我们的质量指数对未来质量供给展现出强劲预测能力，相较于企业基本面数据和Glassdoor评分，成为最重要的单一预测因子。我们通过检验该指标与其他质量替代指标的相关性进行验证，并证明其能有效预测产品召回、品牌价值及盈利能力等重要质量相关企业结果。我们还采用基于零样本提示的方法和基于GPT模型的监督微调方法构建了替代性质量指标，以评估大语言模型和生成式AI捕捉企业层面质量供给的潜力。本文揭示了员工声音作为企业质量供给的前瞻性、可扩展性强大信号的价值，为利益相关者在质量相关风险与机遇外部显化前进行识别提供了启示。
doi:10.3386/w35348.title: The Informed Insider: A Leading Measure of Quality
doi:10.3386/w35348.title_zh: 知情内幕者：质量的领先指标

doi:10.3386/w35349.abstract: This paper treats frontier investment as staged discovery. Firms invest through sequences of costly inquiry stages before deciding whether and how to realize value. At each stage, a firm may sharpen its diagnostic understanding, choose what question to ask, embody that question in a costly action, and interpret the answer that action produces. The answer changes what the firm knows, what it can do next, and how costly future inquiry will be. Successful histories can also carry over to later related problems, making the firm a better learner beyond the current investment path. The paper calls the resulting asset planning capital in firm form. Planning capital is the accumulated diagnostic understanding a firm has built through costly inquiry and operation: understanding of technologies, processes, customers, tools, partners, failures, constraints, and opportunities, together with the capacity to keep learning. It becomes valuable because it helps the firm choose what to investigate, make the question answerable, interpret what happened, and carry what it learned into later investment stages. Building on classical investment theory, R&D models, real-options theory, venture-capital models, classical learning-by-doing, the paper develops a model of investment as staged discovery. The AI and semiconductor frontier makes this asset visible. Firms are being valued and funded for more than the physical capacity they already own. Chips, fabs, data centers, cloud platforms, power commitments, and model systems matter because they carry traces of accumulated learning and because their use generates more learning. They let firms train models, test demand, expose bottlenecks, improve yields, qualify customers, integrate tools, and discover which complements are missing. The current buildout is therefore investment in capacity and in the institutional learning system that makes capacity more valuable over time. The framework explains why production systems, tool systems, research paths, sovereign capability programs, and infrastructure sponsorship belong in the same analysis. They are different institutional forms through which planning capital is accumulated. The paper treats terminal realization value in reduced form and focuses on the discovery process that precedes it: how institutions build capacity, learn from using it, and turn accumulated diagnostic understanding into an advantage in the next round of investment.
doi:10.3386/w35349.abstract_zh: 本文将前沿投资视为分阶段发现的过程。企业通过一系列成本高昂的探究阶段进行投资，随后再决定是否以及如何实现价值。在每个阶段，企业可以深化其诊断性理解，选择要探究的问题，将该问题体现于一项成本高昂的行动中，并解读该行动所产生的答案。答案会改变企业已知的信息、下一步能做什么以及未来探究的成本。成功的经验还可以延续到后续的相关问题，使企业在当前投资路径之外成为更好的学习者。本文将由此产生的资产称为企业形式的规划资本。规划资本是企业通过成本高昂的探究与运营所积累的诊断性理解：对技术、流程、客户、工具、合作伙伴、失败、约束与机遇的理解，以及持续学习的能力。它之所以有价值，是因为它帮助企业选择要调查什么、使问题可回答、解读所发生之事，并将所学带入后续投资阶段。本文基于经典投资理论、研发模型、实物期权理论、风险投资模型以及经典干中学理论，构建了一个将投资视为分阶段发现的模型。人工智能与半导体前沿使这一资产变得可见。企业的估值与融资依据已超越其已拥有的物理产能。芯片、晶圆厂、数据中心、云平台、电力承诺与模型系统之所以重要，是因为它们承载着积累的学习痕迹，且其使用能产生更多学习。它们让企业能够训练模型、测试需求、暴露瓶颈、提升良率、认证客户、集成工具，并发现哪些互补要素缺失。因此，当前的产能建设既是对产能的投资，也是对制度性学习系统的投资，后者使产能随时间推移更具价值。该框架解释了为何生产系统、工具系统、研究路径、主权能力计划与基础设施资助应被纳入同一分析。它们是规划资本得以积累的不同制度形式。本文以简化形式处理终端实现价值，并聚焦于其前的发现过程：机构如何建设产能、从使用中学习，并将积累的诊断性理解转化为下一轮投资中的优势。
doi:10.3386/w35349.title: Planning Capital and Discovery-Based Learning-by-Doing: Investment as Staged Discovery in the Hyperscale Era
doi:10.3386/w35349.title_zh: 规划资本与基于发现的干中学：超大规模时代的投资作为分阶段发现

doi:10.3386/w35350.abstract: Experimenter demand effects arise when participants in an experiment or survey distort their behavior in a misguided attempt to please the experimenter by confirming their research hypothesis. Experimental economists have taken the threat of demand effects seriously and have developed an array of best practices to mitigate their influence, as well as bounding techniques to assess their potential impact on inference. We provide an overview of these techniques and summarize recent empirical assessments of the potential threat of experimenter demand. Our main message is that good design is normally sufficient to address demand concerns, and that bounding approaches work well when concerns remain. Existing empirical evidence suggests that the potential impact of experimenter demand is limited.
doi:10.3386/w35350.abstract_zh: 实验者需求效应是指实验或调查中的参与者为迎合实验者、证实其研究假设，在误导性动机驱使下扭曲自身行为。实验经济学家高度重视需求效应的威胁，已发展出一系列最佳实践方法以减轻其影响，并建立了边界评估技术以衡量其对推断的潜在影响。本文系统梳理了这些技术方法，并总结了近期关于实验者需求潜在威胁的实证评估。我们的核心观点是：良好的实验设计通常足以应对需求效应问题，而当疑虑依然存在时，边界评估方法能有效发挥作用。现有实证证据表明，实验者需求的潜在影响是有限的。
doi:10.3386/w35350.title: How Serious Are Experimenter Demand Effects? Evidence and Mitigation Strategies
doi:10.3386/w35350.title_zh: 实验者需求效应有多严重？证据与缓解策略

doi:10.3386/w35351.abstract: Consider a society that faces uncertainty about a payoff-relevant state and wants to train students to make correct decisions. In educational institutions, students learn from their teachers, but they also get outside information, and later learn from peers. We show that privately Bayesian actions need not be optimal inputs into social learning: when students' actions reflect teacher-side information that is correlated across peers, observing many such actions can give this information excessive social weight. A social planner may therefore optimally reduce the precision of instruction, inducing students to rely more on outside information before their actions become signals for others, and students can end up better informed despite learning less from their teachers. The case for a precision cap is stronger when peer interaction is homophilous, because same-teacher information is more likely to survive aggregation, and weaker when outside information is itself systematically distorted. This provides an informational rationale for viewpoint neutrality as an institutional policy: it limits the social overrepresentation of correlated teacher-side information when students mostly learn from peers exposed to similar sources.
doi:10.3386/w35351.abstract_zh: 考虑一个面临与收益相关状态不确定性的社会，其目标是培养学生做出正确决策。在教育机构中，学生从教师处学习，同时获取外部信息，并随后向同伴学习。研究表明，贝叶斯私人行动未必是社会学习的最优输入：当学生的行动反映了教师侧信息，且该信息在同伴间存在相关性时，观察大量此类行动可能导致该信息在社会层面被过度加权。因此，社会规划者可能最优地降低教学精度，促使学生在自身行动成为他人信号之前更多地依赖外部信息，最终学生虽从教师处学得更少，却能获得更充分的信息。当同伴互动呈现同质性时，支持精度上限的理由更为充分，因为源自同一教师的信息更易在聚合过程中存续；而当外部信息本身存在系统性偏差时，该理由则相对较弱。这为作为制度政策的观点中立性提供了信息层面的理论依据：当学生主要向接触相似信息来源的同伴学习时，该政策能够限制教师侧相关信息在社会层面的过度表征。
doi:10.3386/w35351.title: An Informational Rationale for Viewpoint Neutrality in Education
doi:10.3386/w35351.title_zh: 教育中观点中立的信息学理据

doi:10.3386/w35352.abstract: We analyze how social-planner insurers split cost-sharing between consumers and firms (e.g. patients and doctors, or drivers and car mechanics). With no contracting frictions, firm cost-sharing can replace consumer cost-sharing other than “visit copays.” Optimal firm contracts depend on the marginal rate of substitution between consumer and firm cost-sharing. For Medicare physician services, paying physicians more up front but less as spending increases reduces risk for both patients and providers; in our calibration, net benefits are twice those from eliminating Medigap externality. For prescription drugs, a dollar of physician paperwork costs is 45–110 times more impactful than a dollar of consumer cost-sharing.
doi:10.3386/w35352.abstract_zh: 我们分析了社会规划型保险公司如何在消费者与企业（例如患者与医生，或驾驶员与汽车修理工）之间分摊成本。在不存在契约摩擦的情况下，除"就诊共付额"外，企业成本分摊可替代消费者成本分摊。最优企业契约取决于消费者与企业成本分摊之间的边际替代率。以医疗保险医生服务为例，提高预付比例但降低随支出递增的支付比例，可同时降低患者与医疗服务提供者的风险；在我们的校准模型中，其净收益是消除医疗补充保险外部性收益的两倍。对于处方药而言，医生每增加一美元文书工作成本的影响，是消费者每增加一美元成本分摊的45至110倍。
doi:10.3386/w35352.title: Insurance with Multiple Actors

doi:10.3386/w35353.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) reshapes workers’ comparative advantage by altering the tasks they perform and the skills those tasks require. We develop a dynamic task-based model to quantify the general-equilibrium effects of task-specific technical change. Workers have multidimensional skills, choose occupations, and accumulate skills on the job; occupations combine tasks, and productivity depends on how workers’ skills match task requirements. We develop a computationally efficient procedure to estimate the model using panel data and a new database of task-level skill requirements. We apply the model to AI, allowing it to augment, automate, and simplify tasks. We find that AI narrows wage inequality and raises average wages across scenarios ranging from slow to rapid AI progress. The key equalizing force is simplification: by lowering tasks’ skill requirements, AI lets lower-skill workers compete for previously inaccessible jobs. Adoption costs, highest for lower-skill workers, dampen but do not eliminate the decline in inequality.
doi:10.3386/w35353.abstract_zh: 人工智能通过改变工人执行的任务及其所需技能，重塑了工人的比较优势。我们构建了一个动态任务模型，以量化任务特定技术变革的一般均衡效应。工人具备多维技能，选择职业并在工作中积累技能；职业由多项任务组合而成，生产率取决于工人技能与任务要求的匹配程度。我们开发了一种计算高效的方法，利用面板数据及全新的任务级技能要求数据库对模型进行估计。我们将该模型应用于人工智能领域，允许其增强、自动化及简化任务。研究发现，在从缓慢到快速的人工智能发展情景中，人工智能均能缩小工资不平等并提高平均工资。关键均衡力量在于简化：通过降低任务的技能要求，人工智能使低技能工人能够竞争此前无法胜任的岗位。采用成本（对低技能工人影响最大）虽会抑制但无法消除不平等程度的下降。
doi:10.3386/w35353.title: Task-Specific Technical Change and Comparative Advantage
doi:10.3386/w35353.title_zh: 任务特定型技术变革与比较优势

doi:10.3386/w35354.abstract: Standard measures of inflation, such as the Consumer Price Index (CPI), are designed to measure changes in the cost of living, not how households perceive price changes under limited attention and imperfect information. This paper introduces Perceived Inflation (PI), an attention-weighted inflation measure derived from a model in which households allocate attention across goods and observe noisy price signals. I construct monthly PI using disaggregated CPI data and attention proxies based on price salience, volatility, media mentions, and search behavior. The resulting PI series is highly correlated with CPI inflation but exhibits greater short-run volatility, especially during the Global Financial Crisis, the COVID-19 recession, and the 2021–22 inflation surge. A state-space version of the index implies a persistent latent attention component and a time-varying PI wedge. Finally, the paper embeds the estimated PI wedge into a heterogeneous-household model to demonstrate how attention-driven distortions in inflation perceptions affect saving and consumption through perceived real returns.
doi:10.3386/w35354.abstract_zh: 标准通胀指标（如消费者价格指数CPI）旨在衡量生活成本的变化，而非家庭在有限注意力和不完美信息条件下对价格变动的感知。本文提出感知通胀（Perceived Inflation, PI）这一概念，它是一种基于注意力加权的通胀衡量指标，源于家庭在不同商品间分配注意力并观测含噪声价格信号的模型。我利用细分CPI数据以及基于价格显著性、波动性、媒体报道和搜索行为的注意力代理变量，构建了月度PI序列。所得PI序列与CPI通胀高度相关，但短期波动性更大，尤其在金融危机、新冠疫情衰退及2021-2022年通胀飙升期间。该指数的状态空间版本揭示了持续存在的潜在注意力成分和时变PI偏差。最后，本文将估计的PI偏差嵌入异质性家庭模型，以论证注意力驱动的通胀感知扭曲如何通过感知实际回报影响储蓄与消费。
doi:10.3386/w35354.title: The Perceived Inflation Wedge

doi:10.3386/w35355.abstract: We examine the implications of panel attrition for the age profile of subjective ill-being in the Global Flourishing Study (GFS). We establish that survey attrition rates are high, and are highest among the young, particularly when interviewed in wave 1 using a computer-assisted web interview (CAWI). We then deploy three methods (inverse probability weighting, multiple imputation chain equations, and last observation carried forward) to estimate the age pattern in subjective ill-being in wave 2 of the survey. All three methods have their strengths and weaknesses, but we demonstrate that such adjustments are merited given the nature of survey attrition in the data. We conclude that subjective ill-being is declining in age in both waves 1 and 2 of the GFS having accounted for sample attrition, something that would not have been apparent if one simply ran wave 2 regressions without accounting for sample attrition.
doi:10.3386/w35355.abstract_zh: 本文考察了全球繁荣研究（GFS）中面板数据流失对主观不幸福感年龄分布的影响。我们证实调查流失率较高，且年轻群体流失率最高，尤其是在第一轮采用计算机辅助网络访谈（CAWI）时。随后，我们运用三种方法（逆概率加权、多重链式方程插补及末次观测值结转法）估计第二轮调查中主观不幸福感的年龄模式。三种方法各有优劣，但研究表明，鉴于数据中调查流失的性质，此类调整是必要的。我们得出结论：在考虑样本流失后，GFS第一轮与第二轮调查中主观不幸福感均随年龄增长而下降——这一结论若仅对第二轮数据进行未考虑样本流失的回归分析将无法显现。
doi:10.3386/w35355.title: Panel Attrition, Data Imputation and Age Patterns in Subjective Ill-being
doi:10.3386/w35355.title_zh: 面板流失、数据插补与主观不良感受的年龄模式

doi:10.3386/w35356.abstract: We develop a dynamic stochastic model of markets with an externality and multiple trading frictions, and cap-and-trade as the leading application. Slow participation, limited intermediation, and heterogeneous information interact in equilibrium: agents choose costly market access, access determines residual compliance demand, intermediary constraints translate residual demand into a surrender-month premium, and the premium feeds back into access incentives. These interactions shape how effectively the market corrects the externality. We characterize access choices in closed form, prove that the equilibrium premium is unique, and show that endogenous access dampens the response to each friction in isolation, while the interaction of multiple frictions is non-additive and can amplify the price response. We quantify the model using 2.7 million EU ETS registry transactions and compliance records from 2005–2021. About 40% of operators do not trade annually, purchases concentrate in April when returns are systematically high, and operator flow predicts future returns.
doi:10.3386/w35356.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含外部性与多重交易摩擦的市场动态随机模型，并以限额与交易制度作为主要应用场景。缓慢参与、有限中介与异质信息在均衡中相互作用：代理人选择成本高昂的市场准入，准入决定剩余合规需求，中介约束将剩余需求转化为交割月溢价，而溢价又反馈至准入激励。这些相互作用塑造了市场纠正外部性的效率。我们以闭式解刻画准入选择，证明均衡溢价的唯一性，并表明内生准入会削弱单一摩擦的价格响应，而多重摩擦的交互作用具有非加总性，可能放大价格效应。基于2005-2021年间270万条欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）登记交易与合规记录进行量化分析发现：约40%的运营商未进行年度交易，购买集中在回报率系统性偏高的四月，且运营商资金流向可预测未来收益。
doi:10.3386/w35356.title: Trading Frictions in Dynamic Cap-and-Trade Markets
doi:10.3386/w35356.title_zh: 动态限额与交易市场中的交易摩擦

doi:10.3386/w35357.abstract: Alternative care delivery models may offer benefits to patients and providers, but adoption often remains low. We study whether brief narrative testimonials shift willingness to attend virtual shared medical appointments (SMAs), a relatively little-used care format in which 5-15 patients with a shared non-urgent health condition meet simultaneously with a clinician. Using a pre-registered field experiment with over 4,000 women aged 45–60 in the UK, we randomly assigned participants to view only standard descriptive information about menopause appointment options (the control group) or to receive testimonials about SMAs from either previous patients or a clinician (treatment groups). Testimonials more than doubled the share of women choosing an SMA: when appointments were offered with a 6-8 week wait, 11% of the control group chose an SMA compared to 26% in the peer testimonials arm and 24% in the clinician testimonials arm. Shorter waiting times further increase uptake. When the SMA wait was reduced to one week, the share of women ever choosing an SMA rose by 14-19 percentage points across arms, reaching nearly 40% in the testimonial groups. Treatment effects are systematically larger among women with greater information-processing capacity: university education, higher baseline menopause knowledge, and broader information-seeking. Our findings suggest that women’s reluctance to choose SMAs is driven primarily by demand-side barriers, including unfamiliarity and uncertainty about their benefits, rather than deep-seated aversion to group-based care. Testimonials appear sufficient to meaningfully reduce these barriers.
doi:10.3386/w35357.abstract_zh: 替代性护理服务模式可能为患者和医疗服务提供者带来益处，但其采用率通常较低。我们研究了简短叙事性推荐能否提升患者参与虚拟共享医疗预约（SMA）的意愿——这是一种较少使用的护理形式，由5至15名患有相同非紧急健康问题的患者同时与临床医生会诊。通过对英国4500余名45至60岁女性进行预注册实地实验，我们随机将参与者分为仅查看更年期预约选项标准描述信息的对照组，以及接收来自既往患者或临床医生关于SMA推荐信息的处理组。推荐信息使选择SMA的女性比例提升一倍以上：当预约需等待6至8周时，对照组中11%的女性选择SMA，而同伴推荐组和临床医生推荐组分别达到26%和24%。缩短等待时间进一步提高了采用率。当SMA等待时间缩短至一周时，各组选择SMA的女性比例上升14至19个百分点，推荐组中该比例接近40%。处理效应在信息处理能力更强的女性中系统性更大：包括大学教育背景、更年期基线知识更丰富以及信息搜索范围更广的群体。我们的研究结果表明，女性不愿选择SMA主要源于需求侧障碍，包括对SMA益处的不熟悉和不确定性，而非对群体护理的深层抵触。推荐信息足以显著降低这些障碍。
doi:10.3386/w35357.title: Information Provision and Demand-Side Barriers to Healthcare Innovation: Experimental Evidence on Shared Medical Appointments in Menopause Care
doi:10.3386/w35357.title_zh: 信息提供与医疗创新的需求侧障碍：更年期护理中共享医疗预约的实验证据

doi:10.3386/w35358.abstract: This paper leverages variation in the access to the Mexican railroad network in the early 1900s to estimate its impact on migration to the United States and evaluate its long-run persistence after passenger rail service became obsolete. Using an IV strategy based on least-cost paths between historical cities, we find that locations with railroad access had migration rates four times higher than those without in the early twentieth century. Sequential migration was the key mechanism: railroads first facilitated internal mobility toward railroad hubs, then onward migration to the US. Railroad access also contributed to structural transformation, raising urbanization and local economic development. In terms of persistence, locations with historical railroad access show weakly lower total migration rates to the US in the early 21st century, consistent with local economic growth reducing the incentive to migrate. Yet destination-specific patterns prove remarkably durable: locations that disproportionately sent migrants to California, Arizona, or Texas in the 1900s continued to do so in the 2000s, reflecting the persistence of migrant networks.
doi:10.3386/w35358.abstract_zh: 本文利用20世纪初墨西哥铁路网通达性的差异，估计其对美国移民的影响，并评估客运铁路服务过时后的长期持续性。基于历史城市间最小成本路径的IV策略，我们发现，20世纪初拥有铁路通达性的地区移民率是未通达地区的四倍。顺序迁移是关键机制：铁路首先促进人口向铁路枢纽的内部流动，进而推动向美国的后续迁移。铁路通达性还促进了结构转型，提高了城市化水平和地方经济发展。在持续性方面，拥有历史铁路通达性的地区在21世纪初对美国的总体移民率略低，这与地方经济增长降低了移民动机相一致。然而，目的地特定模式表现出显著的持久性：20世纪主要向加利福尼亚、亚利桑那或得克萨斯输送移民的地区，在21世纪仍保持这一趋势，反映了移民网络的持续性。

doi:10.3386/w35359.abstract: The literature assessing the effects of transportation infrastructure on how people and economic activity distribute themselves across a system of cities has three main parts. The theoretical literature makes robust predictions about how transportation infrastructure affects the internal structure of cities, but for systems of cities, theory does not let us rule much out. The city-level empirical literature establishes that improved urban transportation infrastructure causes suburban migration, but has only a small impact on city population. This literature is less helpful for understanding the effects of transportation infrastructure on the way people are distributed across a system of cities, but has made some progress. The small empirical literature looking at how transportation infrastructure affects systems of cities using cross-country data remains underdeveloped and is inconclusive.
doi:10.3386/w35359.abstract_zh: 评估交通基础设施如何影响人口和经济活动在城市体系中的分布，相关文献主要包含三个部分。理论文献对交通基础设施如何影响城市内部结构做出了稳健的预测，但对于城市体系而言，理论并未能排除太多可能性。城市层面的实证研究表明，城市交通基础设施的改善会导致郊区迁移，但对城市人口规模的影响较小。这类文献在理解交通基础设施如何影响人口在城市体系中的分布方面帮助有限，但已取得一定进展。利用跨国数据研究交通基础设施如何影响城市体系的少量实证文献仍不成熟，且结论尚无定论。

doi:10.3386/w35360.abstract: Why do climate shocks produce conflict (Hsiang et al., 2013)? We study the 1970 Bhola cyclone in East Pakistan, one of the deadliest natural disasters in recorded history, which killed an estimated 350,000 people. Using satellite imagery, archival records, electoral returns, and insurgent biographies, we show that cyclone exposure amplified pre-existing separatist sentiment at the ballot box and increased citizens’ subsequent participation in guerrilla warfare against the state. Our estimates imply that exposure to the cyclone’s devastation induced an additional 48,613 insurgents to join the guerrilla war effort. Effects are larger in areas with pre-existing political and economic grievances and weaker relief provision. Our analysis reveals the step-by-step mechanisms through which environmental shocks can produce conflict: they shift voting behavior, expose state indifference, and convert grievance into armed mobilization.
doi:10.3386/w35360.abstract_zh: 气候冲击为何会引发冲突（Hsiang等，2013）？我们以1970年东巴基斯坦博拉气旋为研究对象，这是有记录以来最致命的自然灾害之一，造成约35万人死亡。通过卫星影像、档案记录、选举结果和叛乱分子传记资料，我们证明气旋暴露程度放大了选票箱中既有的分离主义情绪，并增加了公民随后参与针对国家的游击战行为。我们的估算表明，遭受气旋破坏的地区额外催生了48,613名叛乱分子加入游击战。在既有政治经济不满情绪更强烈且救济供给更薄弱的地区，影响更为显著。本分析揭示了环境冲击引发冲突的逐步传导机制：改变投票行为、暴露国家冷漠态度、将不满情绪转化为武装动员。
