doi:10.3386/w35398.title: The Pass-through of Tariffs and Exchange Rates
doi:10.3386/w35398.title_zh: 关税与汇率的传导效应

doi:10.3386/w35399.abstract: The implementation and unwinding of the FFCRA's continuous coverage requirement generated historically large changes in Medicaid enrollment during the COVID-19 pandemic. Using a combination of descriptive and causal analyses, we examine the substantial cross-state differences in these changes, which remain little understood. We find that policies designed to ease unwinding frictions, as well as federal fiscal assistance to states, have little predictive power, suggesting limited roles for administrative design or liquidity constraints. Political preferences have modest predictive power during the unwinding period. Pandemic-era Medicaid expansions and more generous baseline eligibility thresholds are strongly associated with larger net enrollment gains.
doi:10.3386/w35399.abstract_zh: FFCRA持续覆盖要求的实施与解除，导致新冠疫情期间医疗补助计划参保人数出现历史性的大幅波动。通过结合描述性分析与因果分析，我们研究了各州在这些变化中存在的显著差异——这些差异至今仍鲜有深入理解。研究发现，旨在缓解解除摩擦的政策以及联邦对各州的财政援助，其预测能力均较弱，表明行政设计或流动性约束的作用有限。政治倾向在解除期间仅具有适度的预测能力。疫情期间医疗补助计划的扩展以及更宽松的基线资格门槛，与更大的净参保人数增长显著相关。
doi:10.3386/w35399.title: Understanding Cross-State Variations in Medicaid Enrollment During and After the COVID-19 Pandemic
doi:10.3386/w35399.title_zh: 新冠疫情期间及之后医疗补助参保率的跨州差异研究

doi:10.3386/w35400.abstract: We build a model that combines (i) heterogeneous households with incomplete markets, and (ii) state-dependent pricing with strategic complementarities by firms, to analyze the effects of large macroeconomic shocks and policy interventions. Both features significantly influence the transmission of fiscal stimulus and monetary policy—heterogeneous households because of failures of Ricardian equivalence, and state-dependent pricing because of its nonlinear effects on inflation. We use our model to quantify how monetary and fiscal policy shaped macroeconomic dynamics in response to the large shocks of 2020, and how alternative policy choices could have led to different aggregate and distributional outcomes. We find large departures from Ricardian equivalence and strong stepping-on-a-rake effects of interest rate changes. The large unfunded fiscal transfer program helped prevent deflation in 2020 and significantly raised output throughout 2021 and 2022, but led to permanently higher prices. The monetary easing through 2020 and 2021 also contributed to preventing deflation, but had a minimal impact on GDP. The monetary tightening from 2022 lowered the maximum inflation rate, but contributed to persistently above-trend inflation. These policies led to net welfare gains for low-wealth households and net welfare losses for high-wealth households, but those welfare effects are due to incomplete markets for idiosyncratic risk not aggregate stabilization. Alternative commitments to funding fiscal stimulus could have achieved similar short-term effects on inflation and output with a much smaller long-term increase in the price level.
doi:10.3386/w35400.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个结合（i）异质性家庭与不完全市场，以及（ii）企业具有战略互补性的状态依存定价的模型，以分析大规模宏观经济冲击与政策干预的影响。这两个特征均显著影响财政刺激与货币政策的传导机制——异质性家庭因李嘉图等价失效，而状态依存定价则因其对通胀的非线性效应。我们利用该模型量化了2020年大规模冲击下货币与财政政策如何塑造宏观经济动态，并探讨了替代性政策选择可能导致的总体与分配结果差异。研究发现，李嘉图等价存在显著偏离，且利率变动具有强烈的“踩耙子效应”。大规模无资金支持的财政转移计划虽有助于防止2020年通缩，并在2021至2022年间显著提升产出，但导致价格永久性上升。2020至2021年的货币宽松政策同样有助于防止通缩，但对GDP影响甚微。2022年起的货币紧缩政策降低了通胀峰值，却导致通胀持续高于趋势水平。这些政策使低财富家庭获得净福利收益，而高财富家庭则承受净福利损失，但此类福利效应源于异质性风险的不完全市场，而非总需求稳定。若采用替代性财政刺激资金承诺，可在实现类似短期通胀与产出效果的同时，大幅降低长期价格水平的上升幅度。
doi:10.3386/w35400.title: How Does Monetary and Fiscal Policy Affect the Economy in the Face of Large Shocks?
doi:10.3386/w35400.title_zh: 货币与财政政策如何应对大规模冲击下的经济影响？

doi:10.3386/w35401.abstract: The secular decline in birth rates across the globe over the past seven decades has slowed population growth, raised average ages, and reshaped labor markets and the macroeconomy. Contrary to the widespread expectation that these trends hamper economic growth, we find lower birth rates are associated with higher growth in GDP per working-age adult across countries and higher wage growth across US commuting zones, with no negative impact on aggregate GDP or earnings. These patterns are not explained by educational upgrading, rising female labor force participation, the declining importance of agriculture, or neoclassical-Solow mechanisms. We argue that they reflect the endogenous, labor-saving response of technology to the scarcity of younger workers. Consistent with this interpretation, countries and regions with lower birth rates exhibit more labor-saving patents and growing high-tech activity. There is also higher TFP growth across countries and industries. Exploiting cross-country variation in WWII military and civilian deaths, we find that declines in younger population, rather than population size per se, drive our results.
doi:10.3386/w35401.abstract_zh: 过去七十年间全球生育率的长期下降，减缓了人口增长，提高了平均年龄，并重塑了劳动力市场与宏观经济。与普遍认为这些趋势会阻碍经济增长的预期相反，我们发现，较低生育率与各国劳动年龄人口人均GDP的更高增长以及美国通勤区工资的更高增长相关，且对总体GDP或收入无负面影响。这些模式无法通过教育升级、女性劳动参与率上升、农业重要性下降或新古典索洛机制来解释。我们认为，这反映了技术对年轻劳动力稀缺的内生性、节约劳动力的响应。与此解释一致的是，生育率较低的国家和地区拥有更多节约劳动力的专利，且高科技活动日益增长。各国及各行业也呈现出更高的全要素生产率增长。利用二战期间各国军事与平民死亡人数的跨国差异，我们发现，年轻人口减少（而非人口规模本身）驱动了我们的研究结果。
doi:10.3386/w35401.title: Baby Busts and Growth Booms: Demographic Change and the Macroeconomy
doi:10.3386/w35401.title_zh: 婴儿潮衰退与增长繁荣：人口变迁与宏观经济

doi:10.3386/w35402.abstract: How exposed are open economies to global demand shocks? In equilibrium, foreign booms can be absorbed either by domestic consumption ("quantities") or by real exchange rate appreciation ("prices"). We show that failures of Ricardian equivalence and global financial market imperfections, two frictions popular in much recent work, have opposite effects on the split: while elevated marginal propensities to consume push towards quantities, financial frictions instead increase price adjustment. As the flexible-price equilibrium generally features a mix of quantity and price responses, policy needs to be contractionary to achieve flexible-price outcomes if the spending effect dominates, and vice-versa if financial frictions are severe. In our quantitative explorations the spending effect tends to win the race, necessitating aggressive domestic policy action.
doi:10.3386/w35402.abstract_zh: 开放经济体对全球需求冲击的暴露程度如何？在均衡状态下，国外经济繁荣可通过国内消费（“数量”）或实际汇率升值（“价格”）两种渠道吸收。本文证明，李嘉图等价失效与全球金融市场不完善——近期研究中常见的两种摩擦——对上述分配机制产生相反影响：边际消费倾向上升会推动数量调整，而金融摩擦则强化价格调整。由于弹性价格均衡通常兼具数量与价格反应特征，当支出效应占主导时，政策需采取紧缩措施以实现弹性价格结果；反之，若金融摩擦严重，则需采取扩张政策。在量化分析中，支出效应往往占据上风，这要求采取积极的国内政策干预。
doi:10.3386/w35402.title: Importing Aggregate Demand

doi:10.3386/w35403.abstract: Consider an analyst interested in predicting the size of an effect. She has identified a set of prior published studies of similar effects. We provide a toolkit for (i) summarizing the prior literature, (ii) making predictions of effects in new contexts, and (iii) correcting for the bias from selectivity in the prior literature. We illustrate these methods with empirical examples from labor, public, behavioral, environmental, and development economics. Some of the tools are relevant even when only three prior studies are available. We show how it is possible to use covariates to transparently make predictions for a new context by reweighting prior estimates. The mean effect—after correcting for selectivity—is between 12% and 21% of the simple mean in our empirical examples. We conclude with a cookbook for practitioners producing meta-analyses.
doi:10.3386/w35403.abstract_zh: 考虑一位分析师，其目标是预测某一效应的大小。她已确定一组关于类似效应的先前已发表研究。我们提供了一套工具包，用于：(i) 总结先前文献，(ii) 预测新情境下的效应，以及 (iii) 纠正先前文献中选择性偏差带来的偏误。我们通过来自劳动经济学、公共经济学、行为经济学、环境经济学和发展经济学的实证案例来展示这些方法。即便仅有三项先前研究可用，部分工具仍具相关性。我们展示了如何通过重新加权先前估计值，利用协变量透明地预测新情境下的效应。在我们的实证案例中，经选择性偏差校正后的平均效应，仅为简单均值的12%至21%。最后，我们为从事元分析的研究者提供了一份实践指南。
doi:10.3386/w35403.title: Literature Review and Evidence Aggregation: a Toolkit for Applied Micro
doi:10.3386/w35403.title_zh: 文献综述与证据汇总：应用微观经济学工具包

doi:10.3386/w35404.abstract: Community colleges are more financially, academically, and geographically accessible than four-year institutions. Yet despite most community college students intending to earn a bachelor’s degree, few successfully transfer and complete one. Community College Baccalaureate (CCB) programs have emerged as an alternative pathway, allowing community colleges to confer bachelor’s degrees directly. However, little is known about how employers value these credentials in the labor market. To address this question, we conduct the first resume audit study of CCB degrees, submitting fictitious applications to real job vacancies while experimentally varying applicants’ educational credentials, degree-granting institutions, and demographic signals. In this pilot study, we focus on the early childhood education (ECE) labor market, a rapidly growing CCB field characterized by labor shortages and increasing educational requirements. We find that employers view CCB degrees similarly to both traditional bachelor’s and associate degrees, with statistically indistinguishable interview-request rates across degree types. A text analysis of employer callback messages reveals little evidence that employers communicate differently with CCB applicants, while a net-price simulation suggests that sticker-price comparisons substantially overstate the affordability advantage of CCB programs. Together, these findings provide new evidence on the labor market value and affordability of CCB degrees and inform an ongoing large-scale audit study across additional fields and labor markets.
doi:10.3386/w35404.abstract_zh: 社区学院在财务、学业和地理可及性方面均优于四年制院校。然而，尽管大多数社区学院学生有意获得学士学位，但成功转学并完成学业者寥寥无几。社区学院学士学位项目作为替代路径应运而生，允许社区学院直接授予学士学位。但鲜有研究探讨雇主在劳动力市场中对这类学历的认可程度。为解答这一问题，我们开展了首项针对社区学院学士学位的简历审计研究，通过向真实职位空缺提交虚构申请，实验性调整申请人的教育背景、学位授予机构及人口统计学信号。在本试点研究中，我们聚焦于早期儿童教育劳动力市场——该领域是社区学院学士学位快速发展的方向，具有劳动力短缺与教育要求持续提升的双重特征。研究发现，雇主对社区学院学士学位的认可度与传统学士学位及副学士学位相当，不同学位类型对应的面试邀请率在统计上无显著差异。对雇主回访信息的文本分析显示，雇主与社区学院学士学位申请者的沟通方式几乎不存在差异；而净价格模拟表明，标价比较会显著高估社区学院学士学位项目的经济可负担性。综合来看，这些发现为社区学院学士学位的劳动力市场价值与可负担性提供了新证据，并为正在开展的跨领域、跨劳动力市场的大规模审计研究奠定基础。
doi:10.3386/w35404.title: The Labor Market Value of Community College Bachelor’s Degrees: Initial Evidence from a Resume Audit Study in Early Childhood Education
doi:10.3386/w35404.title_zh: 社区大学学士学位的劳动力市场价值：基于早期儿童教育简历审计研究的初步证据

doi:10.3386/w35405.abstract: We uncover a new mechanism that links growth and a decline in the energy intensity of production, observed globally since 1990. Using microdata from India and a causal research design, we demonstrate that the expenditure share of energy declines steeply with firm scale, due both to physical scaling laws and technology investment. Given that average firm size increases with growth, this scale dependence implies that production endogenously becomes less energy-intensive along the growth path. We develop a model of this mechanism in general equilibrium, and quantify significant reductions in aggregate energy intensity as low-income countries like India grow. We conclude with a discussion of the future path of emissions in India.
doi:10.3386/w35405.abstract_zh: 我们揭示了一种新机制，该机制将经济增长与1990年以来全球观察到的生产能源强度下降联系起来。利用印度微观数据及因果研究设计，我们证明企业能源支出份额随规模扩大而急剧下降，这既源于物理规模法则，也源于技术投资。鉴于企业平均规模随经济增长而扩大，这种规模依赖性意味着生产在增长路径上会内生地降低能源强度。我们构建了该机制的一般均衡模型，并量化了印度等低收入国家经济增长过程中总体能源强度的显著下降。最后，我们探讨了印度未来排放路径。
doi:10.3386/w35405.title: Growth, Firm Scale, and the Energy Intensity of Production
doi:10.3386/w35405.title_zh: 增长、企业规模与生产的能源强度

doi:10.3386/w35406.abstract: Many governments and institutions use marginal price signals, such as fuel and carbon taxes, to meet emission reduction targets. However, the responses of firms and individuals to these price signals are often calculated using average prices commonly reported in economic data, rather than marginal prices. This paper first documents that the marginal price of electricity paid by U.S. manufacturing plants is 50% lower than the average price. To do so, we construct a novel dataset of both average and marginal electricity prices, and the wedge between these, using plant-level microdata from the U.S. Census and utility-level electricity rate schedules for over two hundred utilities. Second, we provide guidance on when average prices are an appropriate proxy for marginal prices in price elasticities by identifying economic and geographic characteristics that predict variation in this wedge. Overall, the magnitude of this wedge suggests that the standard use of average energy prices to calculate responses to carbon taxes may underestimate the energy price increases needed to meet emissions targets by 50%.
doi:10.3386/w35406.abstract_zh: 许多政府与机构采用边际价格信号（如燃油税与碳税）以实现减排目标。然而，企业与个人对这些价格信号的响应，通常基于经济数据中普遍报告的平均价格而非边际价格进行计算。本文首先发现，美国制造业工厂支付的电价边际价格比平均价格低50%。为此，我们利用美国人口普查局的工厂级微观数据及覆盖两百多家公用事业公司的电价费率表，构建了包含平均电价、边际电价及其差额的新型数据集。其次，通过识别预测该差额变化的经济与地理特征，本文为平均价格在何种情况下可作为边际价格弹性分析的合理代理变量提供了指导。总体而言，这一差额的规模表明：若以标准方式使用平均能源价格计算碳税响应，可能使实现排放目标所需的能源价格涨幅被低估50%。
doi:10.3386/w35406.title: The Use and Misuse of Average and Marginal Energy Prices: Implications for Climate Policy
doi:10.3386/w35406.title_zh: 平均与边际能源价格的使用与误用：对气候政策的启示

doi:10.3386/w35407.abstract: There is a long-running debate over using standardized test scores to inform college and graduate admissions decisions, with some arguing that test scores are an important signal of academic strength and others arguing that they are biased and exclusionary. Here we revisit this issue by analyzing a novel dataset of more than 13,000 applications over roughly a decade to a large public policy master’s program in the United States. Consistent with past work, we find that GRE scores substantially improve predictions of first-year grades relative to predictions based on GPA alone. However, when these predictions are used to inform admissions decisions, we find that test scores only modestly improve the expected academic quality of admitted students. The gap shrinks further when we augment the test-aware and test-blind predictive models with more fine-grained information available in student transcripts and other application materials. Specifically, we estimate that incorporating standardized test scores in our setting would result in admitting students who perform, on average, only 0.03 grade points better. We show—both empirically and theoretically—that this pattern stems from a subtle distinction between predictions and decisions. Even with improved predictions, the downstream admissions decisions are often the same; and where there are differences, they often involve selecting between similarly qualified applicants. Our results indicate that standardized test scores may be less important for university admissions than previously suggested.
doi:10.3386/w35407.abstract_zh: 关于是否应将标准化考试成绩作为大学及研究生招生依据的争论由来已久。一方认为考试成绩是衡量学术能力的重要指标，另一方则指出其存在偏见与排斥性。本研究通过分析美国某大型公共政策硕士项目十余年间逾13,000份申请数据重新审视该问题。与既往研究一致，我们发现相较于仅依据GPA的预测模型，加入GRE成绩能显著提升对一年级学业成绩的预测精度。然而当将这些预测结果用于招生决策时，考试成绩对录取学生预期学术质量的提升作用有限。当我们在考虑/不考虑考试成绩的预测模型中进一步纳入成绩单及其他申请材料中的精细化信息时，这种差距进一步缩小。具体而言，本情境下引入标准化考试成绩仅能使录取学生的平均绩点提升0.03分。我们通过实证与理论分析表明，这一现象源于预测与决策之间的微妙差异：即便预测精度有所提升，下游招生决策往往保持不变；即便存在差异，也通常涉及资质相近的申请者之间的选择。研究结果表明，标准化考试成绩对大学招生的实际影响可能低于此前文献的论断。
doi:10.3386/w35407.title: Reassessing the Role of Standardized Tests in University Admissions
doi:10.3386/w35407.title_zh: 重新评估标准化考试在大学招生中的作用

doi:10.3386/w35408.abstract: Intensifying climate change makes protection against natural disaster risk – either through ex ante insurance or ex post aid – a first-order public policy issue. Flood risk protection in the U.S. traditionally featured ex post aid through FEMA and heavily subsidized insurance through the National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP). In an effort to correct subsidy-induced overbuilding and under-mitigation in flood-prone areas, the NFIP recently moved to actuarially fair insurance premiums. But this change has two unintended consequences: a fiscal spillover onto FEMA disaster aid as insurance coverage declines in flood-prone areas, and household exposure to uninsurable reclassification risk from uncertain climate projections. We develop a model of optimal flood insurance that incorporates the static and dynamic tradeoffs of subsidizing premiums. We then use a variety of identification strategies and data to estimate the five key parameters needed to implement this model. We find that the fiscal spillover and reclassification risk protection benefits significantly outweigh the moral hazard costs, and that the optimal subsidy to flood insurance is 52%, comparable to the level of subsidization before the recent reform.
doi:10.3386/w35408.abstract_zh: 气候变化加剧使得防范自然灾害风险——无论是通过事前保险还是事后援助——成为首要公共政策问题。美国传统的洪水风险防范体系以联邦紧急事务管理局（FEMA）的事后援助和国家洪水保险计划（NFIP）的高额补贴保险为特征。为纠正补贴导致的洪泛区过度建设与减灾不足问题，NFIP近期转向精算公平保费。但这一改革产生了两项非预期后果：一是随着洪泛区保险覆盖率下降，FEMA灾害援助产生财政溢出效应；二是家庭面临因气候预测不确定性导致的不可保重分类风险。我们构建了最优洪水保险模型，将保费补贴的静态与动态权衡纳入分析框架。随后采用多种识别策略与数据，估算实施该模型所需的五个关键参数。研究发现，财政溢出效应与重分类风险保护带来的收益显著超过道德风险成本，最优洪水保险补贴率为52%，与改革前的补贴水平相当。
doi:10.3386/w35408.title: Optimal Flood Insurance in a Second-Best World: Fiscal Spillovers, Reclassification Risk and Moral Hazard
doi:10.3386/w35408.title_zh: 次优世界中的最优洪水保险：财政溢出效应、重分类风险与道德风险

doi:10.3386/w35409.abstract: We examine pandemic related racial and ethnic disparities in test scores, absenteeism, and disciplinary incidents for K-12 students in the State of Connecticut through the 2024-25 school year. Notably, most existing pandemic studies only cover absenteeism through 2022-23, and minimal quantitative evidence exists on the post-pandemic incidence of student discipline related behaviors. Consistent with prior studies, we find persistent negative effects of the pandemic on test scores, as well as substantial disparities in test scores along racial and ethnic lines. For middle school, we also find persistent post-pandemic increases in both severe disciplinary incidents overall and racial and ethnic disparities in severe discipline incidents. However, we document substantial recovery in racial and ethnic disparities in attendance rates and chronic absenteeism by 2024-25. For all outcomes, most of the increases in disparities are associated with Black and Latinx students attending schools that had worse pre-pandemic outcomes and higher pre-pandemic shares of students who are either economically disadvantaged or face learning barriers.
doi:10.3386/w35409.abstract_zh: 我们考察了康涅狄格州K-12学生截至2024-25学年的疫情相关种族与族裔差异，涵盖考试成绩、缺勤率及违纪事件。值得注意的是，现有疫情研究大多仅覆盖至2022-23学年的缺勤数据，且关于疫情后学生违纪行为发生率的量化证据极为有限。与既往研究一致，我们发现疫情对考试成绩存在持续性负面影响，且考试成绩在种族与族裔维度上呈现显著差异。在中学阶段，我们还发现疫情后严重违纪事件总体发生率以及种族与族裔间严重违纪事件差异均持续扩大。然而，到2024-25学年，出勤率与长期缺勤率方面的种族与族裔差异已出现显著恢复。就所有结果而言，差异扩大的主要原因是黑人与拉丁裔学生就读的学校在疫情前已存在更差的表现，且这些学校中经济弱势或面临学习障碍的学生比例在疫情前就更高。
doi:10.3386/w35409.title: Racial Disparities in Education During and Following the Pandemic: Evidence in Connecticut through 2025
doi:10.3386/w35409.title_zh: 疫情期间及之后教育中的种族差异：基于康涅狄格州截至2025年的证据

doi:10.3386/w35410.abstract: How does a person’s own learning experience affect their ability to learn from others? We conduct a field experiment on chlorination in Pakistan, where randomized “learning-arm” households use a tool to track their children’s diarrhea before and after chlorine distribution. Learning-arm households with learning-arm neighbors chlorinate significantly more one year after the withdrawal of the tool, with children’s health improving by 0.08 SD relative to all other households receiving chlorine. Neither learning households without learning-arm neighbors, nor non-learning households with learning-arm neighbors, exhibit sustained behavior change, results which have significant implications for intervention and evaluation design.
doi:10.3386/w35410.abstract_zh: 个人的学习经历如何影响其向他人学习的能力？我们在巴基斯坦开展了一项关于氯消毒的实地实验，随机分配的“学习组”家庭使用工具记录其子女在氯消毒前后的腹泻情况。一年后，当该工具被撤除时，拥有学习组邻居的学习组家庭的氯消毒使用率显著更高，其子女健康状况相较于其他所有接受氯消毒的家庭提升了0.08个标准差。既无学习组邻居的学习组家庭，亦无学习组邻居的非学习组家庭，均未表现出持续的行为改变。这一结果对于干预措施设计与评估方法具有重要启示。
doi:10.3386/w35410.title: Experiential and Social Learning

doi:10.3386/w35411.abstract: With uncertainty about persistence, we show that forecasts necessarily become more persistent and over-react at long horizons. For these reasons, correctly specified and Bayesian forecasts may under-react at short horizons and over-react at long horizons. These results provide a unified explanation for several asset pricing and forecasting puzzles, including: (i) the excess responsiveness of long-horizon rates to short rates, (ii) the dominance of apparent term premia for long-term rates, (iii) the ex post predictability of bond yields, (iv) the excess volatility of long-horizon forward prices, (v) the excess persistence of long-horizon forecasts, and (vi) the over-reaction of long-horizon forecasts.
doi:10.3386/w35411.abstract_zh: 在存在持续性不确定性的情况下，我们证明预测必然变得更加持久，并在长期范围内过度反应。基于这些原因，正确设定的贝叶斯预测可能在短期范围内反应不足，而在长期范围内过度反应。这些结果为多个资产定价与预测谜题提供了统一解释，包括：（i）长期利率对短期利率的过度响应，（ii）长期利率中显性期限溢价的支配地位，（iii）债券收益率的后验可预测性，（iv）长期远期价格的过度波动，（v）长期预测的过度持续性，以及（vi）长期预测的过度反应。
doi:10.3386/w35411.title: Forecasting with Uncertain Persistence
doi:10.3386/w35411.title_zh: 不确定持续性下的预测

doi:10.3386/w35412.abstract: We study the emerging market for tokenized US Treasuries and yield-bearing dollar instruments on public blockchains. Using a comprehensive dataset that combines on-chain transactions, protocol-level total value locked, pool yields, and monetary policy and stress events, we document three core findings. First, yields can be decomposed into distinct components reflecting issuer fees, lending premia, leverage, basis-trade carry, and collateral pledgability, with the latter generating economically large implicit convenience yields. Second, monetary policy transmission into on-chain dollar markets is highly heterogeneous across product designs, with administratively set rates adjusting slowly and basis-trade-backed instruments displaying economically amplified responses to policy shocks. Third, tokenized Treasuries serve as digital safe havens during episodes of cross-asset stress, attracting large inflows during risk-off events while simultaneously exposing new fragilities arising from the interaction between on-chain composability and off-chain reserve structures, particularly through stablecoin balance sheets. Overall, we provide insights into the distinctive dynamics of pricing, transmission, and fragility of digital Treasuries as decentralized and traditional financial infrastructures increasingly integrate.
doi:10.3386/w35412.abstract_zh: 本文研究了新兴的代币化美国国债及公共区块链上生息美元工具市场。通过整合链上交易、协议级锁定总价值、资金池收益率以及货币政策与压力事件的综合数据集，我们得出三项核心发现。第一，收益率可分解为反映发行人费用、贷款溢价、杠杆、基差交易利差及抵押品可质押性的不同组成部分，其中后者产生了经济意义上显著的隐性便利收益率。第二，货币政策向链上美元市场的传导在不同产品设计间呈现高度异质性：行政设定利率调整缓慢，而基差交易支持的工具对政策冲击表现出经济意义上放大的响应。第三，代币化国债在跨资产压力时期充当数字安全港，在风险规避事件期间吸引大量资金流入，同时暴露出链上可组合性与链下储备结构相互作用所产生的新型脆弱性，尤其是通过稳定币资产负债表。总体而言，随着去中心化与传统金融基础设施日益融合，本文为数字国债在定价、传导及脆弱性方面的独特动态提供了洞见。
doi:10.3386/w35412.title: Digital Safe Havens: The Economics of Tokenized Treasuries
doi:10.3386/w35412.title_zh: 数字避风港：代币化国债的经济学

doi:10.3386/w35413.abstract: Portfolio choice involves substituting across many assets at once, complicating inference about asset demand. An elementary condition often captures this behavior in theory and practice: homogeneous substitution conditional on observables (e.g., factor loadings, maturity, credit ratings). We characterize natural experiments identifying demand elasticity and price impact under this condition. Cross-sectional IV and difference-in-differences identify relative elasticity, own- minus cross-price elasticity for assets sharing observables. But a missing-coefficient problem leaves substitution unidentified: the coefficients on observables mechanically absorb it. Identifying substitution requires time-series regressions on portfolios sorted on observables. We apply the framework to corporate bonds, comparing alternative Fed asset-purchase programs.
doi:10.3386/w35413.abstract_zh: 投资组合选择涉及同时跨多种资产进行替代，这使资产需求的推断变得复杂。一个基本条件常在理论和实践中捕捉到这一行为：基于可观测变量（如因子载荷、期限、信用评级）的同质替代。我们刻画了在该条件下识别需求弹性和价格冲击的自然实验。横截面工具变量法和双重差分法可识别相对弹性，即共享可观测变量的资产的自价格弹性减去交叉价格弹性。但缺失系数问题导致替代效应无法识别：可观测变量的系数会机械地吸收替代效应。识别替代效应需要对按可观测变量排序的投资组合进行时间序列回归。我们将该框架应用于公司债券，比较了美联储不同资产购买计划的效果。
doi:10.3386/w35413.title: Causal Inference for Asset Pricing
doi:10.3386/w35413.title_zh: 资产定价中的因果推断

doi:10.3386/w35414.abstract: Large cities worldwide have adopted congestion pricing to reduce urban traffic, with well-documented benefits for travel speeds, accident rates, and air quality. This paper identifies a novel external benefit: faster emergency medical service response times. We provide the first evidence on how the congestion pricing program in New York City – the first comprehensive cordon-based congestion pricing system in the U.S. that was implemented on January 5th 2025 – affects emergency medical service (EMS) response performance. Exploiting the sharp geographic boundary of New York City's congestion relief zone at 60th Street and a difference-in-discontinuities design applied to approximately 1.6 million EMS incidents, we find that the January 2025 implementation of congestion pricing reduced passenger vehicle traffic by roughly 21 percent near the boundary and improved total EMS travel times by 63–70 seconds, approximately 5–6 percent. Effects emerged quickly and show little evidence of displacement to adjacent areas. A concurrent FDNY directive requiring transport to the nearest hospital confounds standard difference-in-differences estimates but not our boundary-based design. These findings suggest that cost-benefit analyses of congestion pricing systematically understate net social benefits by omitting emergency response improvements.
doi:10.3386/w35414.abstract_zh: 全球各大城市已普遍采用拥堵收费政策以减少城市交通拥堵，其在提升通行速度、降低事故率及改善空气质量方面的效益已有充分文献佐证。本文识别出一项新的外部效益：急救医疗服务响应速度的提升。我们首次提供了关于纽约市拥堵收费计划——美国首个于2025年1月5日实施的综合性区域拥堵收费系统——如何影响急救医疗服务响应绩效的证据。利用纽约市拥堵缓解区在第60街的清晰地理边界，并结合对约160万起急救医疗事件的双重断点回归设计，我们发现2025年1月实施的拥堵收费使边界附近乘用车交通量减少约21%，并将急救医疗总行程时间缩短63至70秒，降幅约为5%至6%。该效应迅速显现，且几乎没有证据表明其向邻近区域产生转移效应。纽约消防局同期发布的将患者送往最近医院的指令干扰了标准双重差分估计，但未影响我们基于边界的识别策略。这些发现表明，拥堵收费的成本效益分析因忽略应急响应改善而系统性地低估了净社会效益。
doi:10.3386/w35414.china_relevance_reason: 工作论文摘要包含中国研究常见主题词，需要 AI 确认
doi:10.3386/w35414.title: Congestion Pricing and EMS Response Time: Evidence From New York City
doi:10.3386/w35414.title_zh: 拥堵收费与急救响应时间：来自纽约市的证据

doi:10.3386/w35415.abstract: Growth theory is based on the assumption of exponential total factor productivity (TFP) growth, or that the conditional expectation of the next TFP increment is proportional to the current level of TFP. In the U.S., we find strong evidence that TFP growth is conditionally additive, not exponential. Even starting from low priors, Bayesian estimation selects the additive model over the exponential one. In addition, professional forecasts and international TFP series are consistent with the additive model but not with the exponential one.
doi:10.3386/w35415.abstract_zh: 增长理论建立在全要素生产率（TFP）呈指数增长或下一期TFP增量的条件期望与当前TFP水平成比例的假设之上。在美国，我们发现了强有力的证据表明TFP增长是条件可加的，而非指数形式。即使从较低的先验概率出发，贝叶斯估计也倾向于选择可加模型而非指数模型。此外，专业预测数据与国际TFP序列均与可加模型一致，而与指数模型不符。
doi:10.3386/w35415.title: Is Growth Additive?

doi:10.3386/w35416.abstract: We develop a tractable quantitative model of international trade in which agents make bilateral investments in resilience under general equilibrium uncertainty. Under both complete and incomplete financial markets, we show that these bilateral investments solve a portfolio problem of choosing trade partners. Countries' risk profiles become determinants of trade flows, income and welfare, whose first moments are affected by the second moments of productivity and trade costs. Changes in global economic uncertainty have heterogeneous effects across countries, depending on how they affect real hedging opportunities. The opening of trade can raise or reduce income volatility, but is revealed-preferred to autarky.
doi:10.3386/w35416.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个可量化的国际贸易模型，其中经济主体在一般均衡不确定性下对韧性进行双边投资。在完全金融市场与不完全金融市场两种情形下，我们证明这些双边投资可归结为选择贸易伙伴的投资组合问题。国家的风险特征成为决定贸易流、收入与福利的关键因素，而这些变量的第一矩受生产率与贸易成本第二矩的影响。全球经济不确定性的变化对不同国家产生异质性效应，其影响方向取决于这些变化如何改变实际对冲机会。贸易开放可能提高或降低收入波动性，但通过显示性偏好分析可知，其福利水平优于自给自足状态。
doi:10.3386/w35416.title: International Trade in an Uncertain World
doi:10.3386/w35416.title_zh: 不确定世界中的国际贸易

doi:10.3386/w35417.abstract: Using diaries covering 25-61-year-olds in the American Time Use Survey 2009-24, this study demonstrates that temporal variety—doing more different things in a day—is income superior. Linking these data to underlying Current Population Surveys, propensity-score models show that people stating that they have a mobility/physical disability in each of two consecutive annual surveys undertake almost 4 percent fewer activities per day than other, demographically identical individuals. They also earn about 50 percent less. Combining the estimated impact of income on temporal variety with the implied reductions in variety incurred by those with the disability yields a monetary equivalent of lost variety exceeding that of lost earnings. Measuring disability status only once yields much smaller estimated shortfalls in temporal variety and earnings. That suggests that one-time self-reports of disabilities, which underlie the bulk of studies on the impacts of disabilities on earnings, also underestimate long-term effects.
doi:10.3386/w35417.abstract_zh: 本研究利用2009-2024年美国时间使用调查中25-61岁人群的日记数据，证明时间多样性（即一天内从事更多不同活动）具有收入优越性。通过将这些数据与基础当前人口调查相关联，倾向得分模型显示，在连续两次年度调查中均报告存在行动/身体残疾的个体，其每日活动数量比人口统计学特征相同的其他群体少近4%，收入也低约50%。将收入对时间多样性的估计影响与残疾群体所承受的多样性减少幅度相结合，得出多样性损失的货币等价物超过了收入损失。仅单次测量残疾状态时，时间多样性和收入缺口的估计值显著偏小。这表明，基于单次自我报告残疾状态（多数残疾对收入影响研究的基础）会低估长期效应。
doi:10.3386/w35417.title: Losses from a Disability: Temporal Variety and Earnings in the Long Run
doi:10.3386/w35417.title_zh: 残疾导致的损失：长期中的时间变化与收入

doi:10.3386/w35418.abstract: Do tax subsidies prompt investors to take on risk? We address this question by looking at investors' responses to changes to the Qualified Small Business Stock (QSBS) program, which reduces capital gains taxes on startup investing. We do so under a framework in which some startup investors — venture capitalists (VCs) — combine outside funding with incentive-based compensation, while others invest their own funds. Using bunching, triple-differences, and matching designs that exploit industry eligibility, investment vintage, and holding-period requirements, we analyze data from 158 thousand investor–firm pairings over two decades. We identify strategic investment timing, with subsidies prompting bunching at tax-eligible holding-period thresholds. Most notably, when and where tax subsidies apply, VCs shift their project selection toward riskier ventures: they invest more in pre-commercial stage startups, become more likely to provide startups with their initial capital, and invest more in startups with pre-existing debt, while becoming less likely to co-syndicate their investments. Tax-subsidized VC-backed ventures show higher failure rates, but on the flip side, attain higher valuations at exit and are more likely to reach "unicorn status." None of these patterns are observed for comparable non-VC investors in startups exposed to the same tax subsidies. Our tests further show that tax incentives lead to reallocation toward more innovative industries, yielding more impactful patents. Our study is the first to show that tax policy can shift entrepreneurial financing toward riskier, more innovative, and valuable startups.
doi:10.3386/w35418.abstract_zh: 税收补贴是否会促使投资者承担风险？我们通过考察投资者对合格小型企业股票（QSBS）计划变化的反应来探讨这一问题，该计划降低了初创企业投资的资本利得税。我们在一个框架下进行分析，其中部分初创企业投资者——风险投资家（VC）——将外部资金与基于激励的薪酬相结合，而其他投资者则使用自有资金。利用行业资格、投资年份和持有期要求，我们采用聚束分析、三重差分和匹配设计，对二十年间15.8万个投资者-企业配对数据进行分析。我们识别出策略性投资时机，即补贴促使投资者在符合税收优惠的持有期阈值处出现聚束现象。最值得注意的是，在税收补贴适用时，风险投资家将项目选择转向风险更高的企业：他们更多投资于商业化前阶段的初创企业，更可能为初创企业提供初始资本，并更多投资于已有债务的初创企业，同时减少联合投资。获得税收补贴的风险投资支持企业失败率更高，但另一方面，它们在退出时获得更高估值，且更可能达到"独角兽地位"。在面临相同税收补贴的可比非风险投资投资者中，未观察到这些模式。我们的进一步检验表明，税收激励导致资源向更具创新性的行业重新配置，产生更具影响力的专利。本研究首次证明，税收政策可将创业融资转向风险更高、更具创新性和价值的初创企业。
doi:10.3386/w35418.title: Tax Incentives and Venture Capital Risk-Taking: Evidence from the QSBS Program
doi:10.3386/w35418.title_zh: 税收激励与风险资本风险承担：来自QSBS项目的证据

doi:10.3386/w35419.abstract: Experimental and quasi-experimental studies show that childhood neighborhoods have substantial causal impacts on children’s adult earnings and other long-term socioeconomic outcomes. Several market failures are likely to lead to excessive residential segregation by parental income and to an under-supply of mixed-income neighborhoods. Missing markets for opportunity originate in capital market imperfections for borrowing on children’s future earnings, neighbor spillovers, behavioral biases, and housing search frictions. Customized housing mobility services combined with subsidized housing vouchers can help low-income families move to higher-opportunity areas. Place-based policies that create mixed-income neighborhoods appear to increase long-term outcomes for less-advantaged children.
doi:10.3386/w35419.abstract_zh: 实验与准实验研究表明，童年居住社区对儿童成年后的收入及其他长期社会经济结果具有显著的因果影响。多种市场失灵可能导致按父母收入划分的居住隔离过度，并造成混合收入社区供给不足。机会缺失的市场源于儿童未来收入借贷的资本市场不完善、邻里溢出效应、行为偏差以及住房搜寻摩擦。定制化住房流动服务与补贴性住房券相结合，可帮助低收入家庭迁往机会更多的区域。创建混合收入社区的属地化政策似乎能改善弱势儿童的长期发展结果。
doi:10.3386/w35419.title: Neighborhood Effects and Missing Markets for Opportunity
doi:10.3386/w35419.title_zh: 邻里效应与机会市场的缺失

doi:10.3386/w35420.abstract: Environmental decisions often impact health, yet morbidity valuation remains challenging, with current approaches like cost-of-illness (COI) measures and Quality-Adjusted Life Years failing to reflect individuals’ willingness to pay to avoid adverse health states. This paper introduces a novel framework for valuing morbidity across health conditions, deriving willingness-to-pay (WTP) estimates using widely available preference weights and a baseline condition with known WTP. Our analysis reveals WTP estimates significantly exceeding commonly used COI measures, indicating undervaluation of health states in policy evaluations. Sensitivity analyses highlight variations consistent with those for the value of statistical life, underscoring the method's robustness. This framework offers a practical tool for integrating morbidity into analyses of environmental policy.
doi:10.3386/w35420.abstract_zh: 环境决策常影响健康，但疾病负担的估值仍面临挑战。当前的成本-疾病法（COI）和质量调整生命年等指标未能反映个体为避免不良健康状态而愿意支付的金额。本文提出一种跨健康状况评估疾病负担的新框架，通过广泛可用的偏好权重和已知支付意愿的基准健康状况，推导出支付意愿（WTP）估计值。分析显示，WTP估计值显著高于常用的COI指标，表明政策评估中健康状态被低估。敏感性分析揭示了与统计生命价值一致的变异特征，凸显了该方法的稳健性。该框架为将疾病负担纳入环境政策分析提供了实用工具。
doi:10.3386/w35420.title: From Minor Ailments to Major Illnesses: A Practical Framework for Valuing Morbidity in Environmental Policy Analysis
doi:10.3386/w35420.title_zh: 从轻微不适到重大疾病：环境政策分析中疾病负担评估的实用框架

doi:10.3386/w35421.abstract: We show that quantitative easing (QE) worsens government debt sustainability. In our model, the government has a negative primary balance and downward-sloping debt demand that makes interest rates endogenous. The central bank has long-term capital and remits profits to the fiscal authority. QE depletes this capital stock, reducing future remittances and crisis-fighting reserves. Contrary to Sargent and Wallace (1981), where greater monetary accommodation lowers the steady-state debt level, we show that QE increases the steady-state level of debt and shifts the default boundary inward, thus heightening fragility and reducing debt sustainability. Moreover, while QE can keep interest rates low for extended periods, sustaining a QE-backed rate peg requires a growing central-bank footprint and accelerating capital depletion, until financing costs rise sharply. Under certain parameters, large-scale QE makes previously sustainable debt levels unsustainable, leading ultimately to sovereign default.
doi:10.3386/w35421.abstract_zh: 我们证明，量化宽松（QE）会恶化政府债务可持续性。在我们的模型中，政府存在负的初级财政余额和向下倾斜的债务需求曲线，这使得利率具有内生性。央行持有长期资本，并将利润上缴给财政部门。量化宽松消耗了这部分资本存量，减少了未来的上缴利润和应对危机的储备。与Sargent和Wallace（1981）的结论——即更大的货币宽松程度会降低稳态债务水平——相反，我们证明量化宽松提高了稳态债务水平，并将违约边界向内推移，从而加剧了脆弱性并降低了债务可持续性。此外，尽管量化宽松能在较长时间内维持低利率，但维持量化宽松支撑的利率盯住政策需要央行资产负债表持续扩张和资本加速消耗，直至融资成本急剧上升。在特定参数条件下，大规模量化宽松会使原本可持续的债务水平变得不可持续，最终导致主权违约。
doi:10.3386/w35421.title: Quantitative Easing and Government Debt Sustainability
doi:10.3386/w35421.title_zh: 量化宽松与政府债务可持续性

doi:10.3386/w35422.abstract: Vehicle inspections—commonly known as smog and safety checks—are often delegated to private agents, much like other quality certification markets. When these agents compete, they face incentives to misreport quality—especially when consumers do not internalize the external costs of misreporting. Theory and evidence from Chile’s concentrated vehicle-inspection markets suggest that these incentives are significant: misreporting emerges as soon as competition is introduced. We find that delegating each market to a single agent proves effective in reducing approval rates, without compromising service quality or the ex-ante competition for the market, while delivering substantial and permanent reductions in vehicle emissions.
doi:10.3386/w35422.abstract_zh: 车辆检测——通常称为尾气与安全检查——常被委托给私人代理机构，这与许多质量认证市场类似。当这些代理机构相互竞争时，它们面临虚报质量的动机——尤其是在消费者未将虚报的外部成本内部化的情况下。来自智利集中型车辆检测市场的理论与证据表明，这些动机十分显著：一旦引入竞争，虚报行为便随之出现。研究发现，将每个市场委托给单一代理机构能有效降低通过率，且不会损害服务质量或市场的事前竞争，同时实现车辆排放的显著且持久减少。
doi:10.3386/w35422.title: Competition and Misconduct in Certification Markets with Externalities
doi:10.3386/w35422.title_zh: 外部性下认证市场的竞争与不当行为

doi:10.3386/w35423.abstract: People often make important choices in pursuit of higher income, but do they place too much weight on income when deciding what path to take? We propose a simple model of misspecified learning in which individuals overestimate the marginal satisfaction from income—the expected effect of an income increase on overall life satisfaction—and therefore give income too much importance in their decisions. Guided by this model, we designed a pre-registered experiment that elicits beliefs about the marginal satisfaction from income and randomly assigns scientific evidence about it. Respondents substantially overestimate the marginal satisfaction from income both for themselves and for others, but especially for themselves. These biases shrink when respondents are exposed to scientific evidence, and the effects persist one month later. To study whether these beliefs matter for behavior, we measure income-versus-non-income trade-offs using job-choice scenarios tailored to each respondent and a real-world decision the respondent is facing. To elicit the latter, we make a methodological contribution: an AI-led interview method that moves beyond static, predefined survey instruments by combining the flexibility of qualitative interviewing with the discipline of closed-ended survey measurement. We find that biased beliefs are consequential: after learning that income matters less for life satisfaction than they initially thought, respondents place less weight on income in their decisions.
doi:10.3386/w35423.abstract_zh: 人们常常为了追求更高收入而做出重要选择，但他们在决策时是否过度看重收入？我们提出了一个简单的错误学习模型，其中个体高估了收入的边际满意度——即收入增长对整体生活满意度的预期影响——因此在决策中赋予收入过高的权重。在该模型指导下，我们设计了一项预注册实验，通过诱导被试对收入边际满意度的信念，并随机分配关于该问题的科学证据。被试显著高估了自身及他人的收入边际满意度，尤其对自身的高估更为严重。当被试接触科学证据后，这些偏差有所缩小，且效果在持续一个月后依然存在。为探究这些信念是否影响行为，我们通过针对每位被试定制的职业选择场景以及其面临的实际决策，衡量收入与非收入之间的权衡。为获取后者，我们做出了一项方法论贡献：采用人工智能引导的访谈方法，该方法结合了定性访谈的灵活性与封闭式调查测量的规范性，突破了静态、预定义的调查工具。研究发现，偏差信念具有显著影响：当被试了解到收入对生活满意度的影响低于其最初预期后，他们在决策中对收入的重视程度有所降低。
doi:10.3386/w35423.title: Is Money Overrated? Misperceived Satisfaction from Income
doi:10.3386/w35423.title_zh: 金钱被高估了吗？收入带来的满足感被误解

doi:10.3386/w35424.abstract: Relatively little is known about occupational licensing across nations. Despite a large literature on occupational licensing in the United States, cross-national evidence remains scarce, especially for developing economies. We assemble harmonized estimates of licensing prevalence for 44 countries by combining new nationally representative surveys (including newly conducted nationally representative surveys for a number of previously unstudied countries) for several Latin American, African, Asian, European, and North American estimates. We document substantial cross-country dispersion in occupational licensing prevalence, ranging from roughly 14 percent of workers in Denmark to more than 40 percent in India and South Africa, the two most heavily licensed labor markets in our sample. Across countries, licensed workers generally earn higher wages than comparable unlicensed workers, with pooled Mincerian regressions indicating licensing wage premia ranging from roughly 6 to 19 percent depending on weighting and specification choices. Occupational licensing prevalence is also negatively associated with GDP per capita and governance quality, and positively associated with informal employment. While these relationships are descriptive rather than causal, they suggest that occupational licensing may be intertwined with broader institutional characteristics affecting labor market efficiency, formal-sector participation, and long-run economic development.
doi:10.3386/w35424.abstract_zh: 关于各国职业许可的研究相对较少。尽管美国已有大量关于职业许可的文献，但跨国证据仍然稀缺，尤其是针对发展中经济体。我们通过整合新的全国代表性调查（包括针对多个此前未被研究的国家新开展的全国代表性调查），为拉丁美洲、非洲、亚洲、欧洲和北美的44个国家构建了统一的职业许可普及率估计值。我们记录了各国职业许可普及率的显著差异，从丹麦约14%的工人到印度和南非超过40%——这两个样本中职业许可程度最高的劳动力市场。跨国数据显示，持有职业许可的工人通常比未持许可的同类工人获得更高工资，混合明瑟回归表明，根据权重和模型设定选择的不同，职业许可工资溢价约为6%至19%。职业许可普及率还与人均GDP和治理质量呈负相关，与非正规就业呈正相关。尽管这些关系是描述性而非因果性的，但它们表明职业许可可能与影响劳动力市场效率、正规部门参与度及长期经济发展的更广泛制度特征相互交织。
doi:10.3386/w35424.title: Analyzing Occupational Licensing Across Nations
doi:10.3386/w35424.title_zh: 跨国职业许可制度分析

doi:10.3386/w35425.abstract: The fertility decline is everywhere in the world today and goes back decades for rich countries. Birthrates have been below replacement in the U.S. and Europe since the mid-1970s. Completed cohort fertility in the U.S. was lower for those born in 1955 than for 1975. The reasons for the initial declines involve greater female autonomy and a mismatch between the desires of men and women. Men generally benefit more from maintaining traditions; women often benefit more from eschewing them. When the probability is low that men will abandon traditions, some career women will not have children and others will delay.
doi:10.3386/w35425.abstract_zh: 当今世界普遍存在生育率下降现象，富裕国家的这一趋势已持续数十年。自20世纪70年代中期以来，美国和欧洲的生育率一直低于更替水平。美国1955年出生队列的终身生育率低于1975年出生队列。生育率最初下降的原因涉及女性自主权增强以及男女意愿的错配。男性通常更倾向于维持传统，而女性往往更受益于摒弃传统。当男性放弃传统的可能性较低时，部分职业女性会选择不生育，另一些则会推迟生育。
doi:10.3386/w35425.title: The Rise of Female Autonomy and the Decline of Fertility: The Role of Mismatch
doi:10.3386/w35425.title_zh: 女性自主权的上升与生育率的下降：错配的作用

doi:10.3386/w35426.abstract: We examine the importance of hospital quality, patient selection, and congestion in affecting equilibrium health outcomes, using Covid-19 pandemic data. Our main outcome is mortality, controlling for unobserved selection with distance instruments. Intensive care unit strain increased hospital mortality: without congestion, deaths would fall 9.6%. Patients value hospitals with high baseline quality, but their choices did not reflect capacity strain information. Equilibrium counterfactuals show that if patients were informed about capacity strain and believed quality signals were more precise, deaths would drop 3.8%. However, using more precise information but not accounting for congestion would cause Covid-19 deaths to rise 3.8%.
doi:10.3386/w35426.abstract_zh: 我们利用新冠疫情数据，考察医院质量、患者选择及拥堵状况对均衡健康结果的影响。主要结局指标为死亡率，并通过距离工具变量控制不可观测的选择效应。重症监护病房负荷加剧了医院死亡率：若无拥堵，死亡人数将下降9.6%。患者倾向于选择基线质量较高的医院，但其选择并未反映容量压力信息。均衡反事实分析表明：若患者获知容量压力信息且认为质量信号更精确，死亡率将下降3.8%。然而，若使用更精确的信息却未考虑拥堵因素，新冠死亡人数反而会上升3.8%。
doi:10.3386/w35426.title: Quality, Selection, and Congestion: Equilibrium Hospital Outcomes During Covid-19
doi:10.3386/w35426.title_zh: 质量、选择与拥堵：新冠疫情期间医院均衡结果

doi:10.3386/w35427.abstract: We study the effect of drug decriminalization on overdose mortality using Oregon's Measure 110 and Washington's Blake decision. Synthetic-control estimates show that both decriminalization regimes sharply reduced drug arrests and were followed by sustained increases in overdose mortality relative to matched counterfactuals. The estimates imply approximately 1,186 excess deaths in Oregon and 1,895 in Washington from 2021 through 2023. We also revisit the role of fentanyl supply shocks. A fentanyl-share control may partly capture enforcement-driven declines in non-fentanyl NFLIS reports, while alternative fentanyl measures leave positive overdose effects.
doi:10.3386/w35427.abstract_zh: 我们利用俄勒冈州的110号法案和华盛顿州的布莱克判决，研究毒品非刑事化对过量致死率的影响。合成控制法估计显示，两种非刑事化制度均大幅减少了毒品逮捕，但与匹配的反事实相比，随后出现了过量致死率的持续上升。这些估计表明，从2021年到2023年，俄勒冈州约有1186例超额死亡，华盛顿州约有1895例。我们还重新审视了芬太尼供应冲击的作用。芬太尼份额控制可能部分捕捉到执法驱动的非芬太尼NFLIS报告减少，而替代性芬太尼指标则留下了正向的过量致死效应。
doi:10.3386/w35427.title: Did Drug Decriminalization Increase Overdoses
doi:10.3386/w35427.title_zh: 毒品非刑事化是否增加了药物过量

doi:10.3386/w35428.abstract: Ambient air pollution contributes substantially to premature mortality globally, and the effectiveness of policies addressing it depends critically on the shape of the dose-response relationship, which remains poorly understood. Linking hourly air pollution data with daily vital statistics from 251 Chinese cities over four years, we show this relationship depends not only on the mean, but also on the variance of within-period exposure. At a 7-day mean of 150 μg/m³, predicted mortality varies more across observed hourly PM2.5 distributions than across mean exposure differences of 100 μg/m³. The sign of this variance effect also depends on the mean: at low mean concentrations (a convex region), higher variance is associated with modestly higher mortality. At higher concentrations (a concave region), greater variance is associated with lower mortality – implying constant exposure is more harmful than fluctuating exposure for a given mean. These findings reveal important relationships masked using temporally aggregated air pollution data.
doi:10.3386/w35428.abstract_zh: 环境空气污染是全球过早死亡的重要诱因，而相关政策的有效性关键取决于剂量-反应关系的形态，但目前对此认知仍不充分。通过将中国251个城市四年的逐时空气污染数据与每日生命统计数据相关联，我们发现这种关系不仅取决于时段内暴露的均值，还取决于其方差。在7天均值为150 μg/m³的条件下，基于观测到的逐时PM2.5分布差异所预测的死亡率变化，甚至超过均值暴露差异达100 μg/m³时的影响。这种方差效应的方向也取决于均值：在低均值浓度（凸性区域）下，较高方差与死亡率适度上升相关；而在高浓度（凹性区域）下，较大方差则与死亡率下降相关——这意味着在给定均值条件下，持续暴露比波动暴露更具危害性。这些发现揭示了使用时间聚合空气污染数据时被掩盖的重要关联关系。
doi:10.3386/w35428.china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
doi:10.3386/w35428.title: Beyond Mean Exposure: How Exposure Variance Shapes Air Pollution Mortality Risk
doi:10.3386/w35428.title_zh: 超越均值暴露：暴露方差如何塑造空气污染死亡风险

doi:10.3386/w35429.abstract: Contrary to a long-standing concern, we present evidence that classical benefit-based labor income taxation in the tradition of Smith (1776) is consistent with income redistribution through transfers and negative average tax rates both theoretically and---in plausibly-specified simulations---quantitatively at levels which reflect U.S. policy over the past several decades. As redistribution is widespread in practice, our results remove an obstacle to the benefit principle’s plausibility as a prevailing normative foundation of tax policy.
doi:10.3386/w35429.abstract_zh: 与长期以来的担忧相反，我们提供的证据表明，遵循斯密（1776）传统的经典受益型劳动收入税，在理论上与通过转移支付和负平均税率实现的收入再分配是一致的，并且在合理设定的模拟中，其量化水平也反映了美国过去几十年的政策实践。由于再分配在实践中普遍存在，我们的研究结果消除了受益原则作为税收政策主流规范基础可信性的一大障碍。
doi:10.3386/w35429.title: Benefit-Based Taxation can Include Substantial Redistribution
doi:10.3386/w35429.title_zh: 基于受益的税收可以包含显著的再分配

doi:10.3386/w35430.abstract: Individuals may fail to recall and use information they already know when making decisions. We empirically investigate whether such “retrieval failures” distort consumption smoothing behavior among Zambian farmers, who derive their income from one annual harvest and then spend it down over the course of the year. We document that individuals underestimate upcoming spending by 50%, creating scope for under-saving. In order to improve recall, we randomize an intervention that prompts individuals to think through their future expenses associatively in categories—without providing any external information or guidance. Treated individuals increase “remembered” expenses by 36-60%; as predicted by the memory literature, effects are concentrated among small, irregular, and stochastic items. Immediate spending drops and, six weeks after the intervention, treated households hold 15% higher savings. They subsequently enter the hungry season—the final months of the year when consumption typically declines sharply—with one additional month of savings, leading to a flatter spending profile over the year. Households use the increased savings to self-finance additional farm investment, resulting in a 9% increase in the next year’s crop revenue. We replicate the intervention’s impact on beliefs among low-income Americans, suggesting that retrieval failures generalize across settings and populations.
doi:10.3386/w35430.abstract_zh: 个体在决策时可能无法回忆并使用已知信息。我们通过实证研究考察这种"检索失败"是否会扭曲赞比亚农民的消费平滑行为——这些农民的收入来源于每年一次收获，随后在全年逐步消耗。研究发现，个体对未来支出的低估幅度达50%，这为储蓄不足创造了空间。为改善信息检索能力，我们随机实施了一项干预措施：引导受试者按类别联想未来支出（不提供任何外部信息或指导）。干预后，受试者"回忆"的支出金额增加36%-60%；正如记忆文献所预测，该效应集中于小额、非经常性及随机性支出项目。即时消费支出下降，干预六周后，受试家庭储蓄额提高15%。随后他们进入青黄不接时期（通常消费急剧下降的年末月份）时，额外拥有一个月的储蓄，这使得全年消费曲线更趋平滑。家庭将增加的储蓄用于农业投资自融资，次年作物收入因此提升9%。我们复现了该干预对低收入美国人信念的影响，表明检索失败现象在不同情境和人群中具有普遍性。
doi:10.3386/w35430.title: Retrieval Failures and Consumption Smoothing: A Field Experiment on Seasonal Poverty
doi:10.3386/w35430.title_zh: 检索失败与消费平滑：关于季节性贫困的实地实验

doi:10.3386/w35431.abstract: Evaluating optimized AI systems for asset pricing is fundamentally difficult for two reasons. First, models are trained on all data, implying that any backtest or analysis using historical data suffers from look-ahead bias. In addition, markets are reflexive — as investors adopt AI, prices adjust — which may erode the very patterns the AI system was trained to exploit. We introduce a real-time, out-of-sample benchmark designed to sidestep both problems. The benchmark measures how well AI systems can explain contemporaneous stock returns around earnings announcements using only information available at announcement time, including the text of the announcement itself. Applying this benchmark to a range of agentic AI systems — which extract structured signals from earnings call transcripts and optimize over those signals — we find that the best-optimized systems more than double the explained variation in returns relative to standard benchmarks (R2 increasing from 8% to close to 20%). We show that AI-based optimization can deliver efficiency gains relative to traditional machine learning methods while also improving interpretability as our approach produces human-readable economic mechanisms that explain price movements. These learned rules can be compared to the drivers of realized returns in existing asset pricing models to identify missing sources of variation in a data-driven, self-evolving way that integrates empirical learning with economic structure. We release an SDK for researchers to improve on our results. Saturating this benchmark would represent fundamental progress in understanding how capital markets process firm-level information.
doi:10.3386/w35431.abstract_zh: 评估针对资产定价优化的AI系统存在两个根本性困难。首先，模型基于全部数据训练，这意味着任何使用历史数据的回测或分析都存在前瞻性偏差。其次，市场具有反身性——当投资者采用AI时，价格会随之调整——这可能会削弱AI系统原本训练利用的模式。我们引入了一个实时、样本外的基准测试，旨在规避这两个问题。该基准测试衡量AI系统仅利用公告发布时可获取的信息（包括公告文本本身）来解释盈余公告期间同期股票收益的能力。将该基准应用于一系列智能体AI系统（这些系统从财报电话会议记录中提取结构化信号并对其进行优化），我们发现最优化的系统相比标准基准，对收益变动的解释力提升了一倍以上（R²从8%提升至接近20%）。我们证明，基于AI的优化相比传统机器学习方法能够实现效率提升，同时增强可解释性——因为我们的方法能生成解释价格变动的人类可读经济机制。这些学习到的规则可与现有资产定价模型中已实现收益的驱动因素进行比较，以数据驱动、自我演进的方式识别缺失的变动来源，将经验学习与经济结构相融合。我们发布了SDK供研究者改进我们的结果。饱和该基准测试将标志着在理解资本市场如何处理公司层面信息方面取得根本性进展。
doi:10.3386/w35431.title: Assessing the Benefits of Optimized Agentic AI Systems for Asset Pricing
doi:10.3386/w35431.title_zh: 评估优化智能体AI系统对资产定价的益处

doi:10.3386/w35432.abstract: This study explores the effects of COVID-19 school closures on labor market outcomes of Canadian parents of school-aged children. Using newly collected data on grade-level-specific school closures across 141 Canadian cities along with individual-level panel data from the Labour Force Survey, difference-in-differences estimates provide robust evidence that restrictions on in-person schooling reduced employment among partnered mothers of school-aged children by approximately 2 percentage points. For fathers, labor supply adjustments are much weaker and concentrated on single fathers. Finally, auxiliary analyses using administrative tax records provide suggestive evidence that school closures increased public benefit receipt among single parents.
doi:10.3386/w35432.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了新冠疫情导致的学校关闭对加拿大适龄儿童父母劳动力市场结果的影响。利用新收集的涵盖141个加拿大城市年级层面学校关闭数据，结合劳动力调查中的个体层面面板数据，双重差分估计提供了稳健证据：限制线下教学使有伴侣的学龄儿童母亲就业率下降约2个百分点。对父亲而言，劳动力供给调整幅度显著较弱，且集中于单亲父亲群体。最后，基于行政税务记录的辅助分析提供了提示性证据：学校关闭增加了单亲家庭公共福利领取率。
doi:10.3386/w35432.title: The Effect of School Disruptions on Parental Labor Supply: Evidence from Canadian Panel Data
doi:10.3386/w35432.title_zh: 学校停课对父母劳动供给的影响：基于加拿大面板数据的证据

doi:10.3386/w35433.abstract: This paper examines the labor market effects of overtime coverage in the United States, where salaried workers are covered for overtime if their base pay falls below a legislated salary threshold. Using an event-study design with administrative payroll data and state-level threshold changes from 2014-2021, I find evidence against conventional models of overtime. Contrary to the historical intent of policymakers, firms do not increase employment by substituting more workers for fewer hours. However, contrary to compensating differential models, firms also do not offset the costs of overtime by lowering workers' base pays. Instead, employers raised salaries above the threshold to keep workers exempt from overtime, indicating that monitoring and adjusting workers' hours is costly for firms. Taken together, these results suggest that expanding overtime coverage increases workers' earnings without negatively impacting employment.
doi:10.3386/w35433.abstract_zh: 本文研究了美国加班覆盖政策对劳动力市场的影响。在该政策下，若受薪工人的基本工资低于法定工资门槛，则其享有加班费保障。基于2014-2021年行政工资数据与州级门槛变动，采用事件研究法设计，本文发现了与传统加班理论相悖的证据。与政策制定者的历史意图相反，企业并未通过以更多工人替代更少工时的方式增加就业；同时，与补偿性工资差异模型相反，企业也未通过降低工人基本工资来抵消加班成本。相反，雇主将工资提高至门槛以上以维持工人免于加班覆盖，这表明监控和调整工人工时对企业而言成本高昂。综合来看，这些结果表明扩大加班覆盖范围能提高工人收入，且不会对就业产生负面影响。
doi:10.3386/w35433.title: The Labor Market Effects of Expanding Overtime Coverage
doi:10.3386/w35433.title_zh: 扩大加班覆盖范围对劳动力市场的影响

doi:10.3386/w35434.abstract: Earnings inequality among college graduates has grown, and returns to a bachelor's degree (BA) vary substantially across colleges. We experimentally evaluate a program that shifted high-achieving, low-income students into higher-quality colleges. Students randomly offered a guarantee of four years of tuition and fees at the University of Michigan were 21 percentage points more likely to enroll at a UM campus. The offer shifted students across colleges rather than into college: most compliers would otherwise have attended less-selective four-year colleges. HAIL increased four-year BA completion by 4 percentage points, but had no effect on attainment after six years. It substantially increased degree quality: students offered the scholarship were 12 percentage points more likely to earn a bachelor's degree from a highly or most selective college. IV estimates indicate that students induced to attend a University of Michigan campus were 56 percentage points more likely to earn such a degree. The increase in college quality predicts earnings gains of 18 to 25 percent. Faster degree completion adds about another 1 percent to the present discounted value of lifetime earnings.
doi:10.3386/w35434.abstract_zh: 大学毕业生收入不平等加剧，且不同院校的学士学位回报率差异显著。我们通过实验评估了一项将高成就低收入学生引导至更优质大学的项目。随机获得密歇根大学四年学费及杂费保障的学生，其入读密歇根大学校区的概率提高了21个百分点。该资助促使学生在不同院校间流动而非单纯进入大学：大多数受助者原本会进入选择性较低的四年制大学。HAIL项目使四年制学士学位完成率提升4个百分点，但对六年后的学业成就无显著影响。该项目显著提升了学位质量：获得奖学金的学生从高选择性或最高选择性大学获得学士学位的概率提高12个百分点。工具变量估计表明，被引导入读密歇根大学校区的学生获得此类学位的概率提高56个百分点。大学质量的提升预计可带来18%至25%的收入增长。更快的学位完成速度将使终身收入的现值额外增加约1%。
doi:10.3386/w35434.title: Degrees of Mobility: Shifting Low-Income Students to Higher Quality Colleges
doi:10.3386/w35434.title_zh: 流动性程度：将低收入学生转入更优质高校

doi:10.3386/w35435.abstract: The persistent surge in U.S. inflation that began in 2021 caught forecasters and policymakers by surprise. The 2021 inflation shocks were viewed as transitory, not persistent, leading to large forecast errors in late 2021 and 2022. This paper asks whether time series models – using only data on current and past inflation, but incorporating stochastic volatility and exhibiting time-varying persistence – performed better. Univariate models, using real-time data, did not. Multivariate models, incorporating sectoral inflation measures, did.
doi:10.3386/w35435.abstract_zh: 美国自2021年开始的持续通胀飙升令预测者和政策制定者措手不及。2021年的通胀冲击被视为暂时性而非持续性，导致2021年末和2022年出现较大预测误差。本文探究仅使用当前及历史通胀数据、但纳入随机波动性并呈现时变持续性的时间序列模型是否表现更优。基于实时数据的单变量模型未能改善预测，而纳入行业通胀指标的多变量模型则表现更佳。
doi:10.3386/w35435.title: Forecasting the Covid Surge in Inflation
doi:10.3386/w35435.title_zh: 预测新冠疫情引发的通胀飙升

doi:10.3386/w35436.abstract: We study whether information frictions about the relative effectiveness of study methods distort students’ effort allocation. Standard models treat effort as a single input whose level, rather than composition, determines outcomes. We instead model effort as an allocation across methods with heterogeneous effectiveness. Combining panel surveys, administrative records, digital activity logs, and a randomized information intervention with over 2,000 undergraduates, we test whether imperfect information leads to effort misallocation and quantify consequences for performance. At baseline, students hold divergent beliefs, and many devote time to passive strategies such as rereading, despite evidence that active retrieval is more effective; these choices predict lower performance and larger self-assessment errors. We randomize treated students into general-feedback and personalized-feedback arms, benchmarking habits against peers in the latter. General feedback has little effect. Personalized feedback widens the perceived effectiveness gap between active and passive methods by 42 percent, shifts time toward effective practices, and raises exam scores by 0.05–0.08 standard deviations. A dynamic model with learning-by-doing and convex allocation costs shows that, for students with the weakest baseline beliefs, personalized feedback is equivalent to a 16.5 percent reduction in adoption costs. These results identify information frictions about multidimensional effort as a determinant of academic performance.
doi:10.3386/w35436.abstract_zh: 本文研究关于学习方法相对有效性的信息摩擦是否会扭曲学生的努力分配。标准模型将努力视为单一投入，其水平而非构成决定结果。我们则将努力建模为在不同有效性方法间的分配。结合面板调查、行政记录、数字活动日志以及对2000多名本科生进行的随机信息干预实验，我们检验不完全信息是否导致努力错配，并量化其对学业表现的影响。在基线期，学生持有不同的信念，许多人将时间投入被动策略（如重读），尽管有证据表明主动检索更为有效；这些选择预测了较低的学业表现和更大的自我评估误差。我们将受试学生随机分为一般反馈组和个性化反馈组，后者以同龄人为基准对标学习习惯。一般反馈效果甚微。个性化反馈将主动与被动方法之间的感知有效性差距扩大了42%，促使时间向有效实践转移，并将考试成绩提高了0.05–0.08个标准差。一个包含干中学和凸性分配成本的动态模型表明，对于基线信念最弱的学生而言，个性化反馈相当于降低了16.5%的采纳成本。这些结果揭示了关于多维努力的信息摩擦是学业表现的一个决定因素。
doi:10.3386/w35436.title: The Role of Information Frictions in Study Habit Choice and Academic Performance
doi:10.3386/w35436.title_zh: 信息摩擦在学习习惯选择与学业表现中的作用

doi:10.3386/w35437.abstract: Artificial intelligence will probably generate major changes in the US economy, although the nature, timing, and magnitude of those changes are highly uncertain. We analyze a set of long-term scenarios involving different combinations of faster productivity growth, greater income inequality, job displacement, and a higher capital share of income. For each scenario, we assess the implications for federal debt and potential policy responses related to faster economic growth, the distribution of income, support for workers who are laid off, and taxation and ownership of capital. Given the uncertainty surrounding AI’s economic effects, policies that are robust to different scenarios would be especially valuable.
doi:10.3386/w35437.abstract_zh: 人工智能可能会对美国经济产生重大变革，尽管这些变革的性质、时机和规模存在高度不确定性。我们分析了一系列长期情景，涉及生产率增长加快、收入不平等加剧、岗位替代以及资本收入份额上升等不同组合。针对每种情景，我们评估了其对联邦债务的影响，以及可能采取的政策应对措施，包括加快经济增长、调节收入分配、支持失业工人，以及资本税收与所有权问题。鉴于人工智能经济影响的不确定性，能够适应不同情景的稳健政策将尤为宝贵。
doi:10.3386/w35437.title: How Might Fiscal Policy Respond to the Rise of Artificial Intelligence?
doi:10.3386/w35437.title_zh: 财政政策如何应对人工智能的崛起？

doi:10.3386/w35438.abstract: The central trade-off for designing Disability Insurance (DI) is between providing insurance to those in need while maintaining incentives to work. This paper develops a novel revealed-preference approach to identify the insurance value of DI benefits. We show that comparing the DI take-up response to a change in benefits versus a change in wages identifies the insurance value. Implementing our framework in Canada, we estimate that increasing DI benefits by $1 creates an additional disincentive cost of $0.60 but creates an insurance value of $2.20. Thus, our approach suggests that DI benefits are not overly generous in the Canadian context.
doi:10.3386/w35438.abstract_zh: 设计残疾保险（DI）的核心权衡在于：既要为有需要者提供保障，又要维持工作激励。本文提出一种新颖的显示性偏好方法，用以识别DI福利的保险价值。研究表明，通过比较DI参保率对福利变化与工资变化的反应差异，即可识别其保险价值。在加拿大应用该框架后，我们估算出：每增加1美元DI福利，会产生0.60美元的额外抑制成本，但能创造2.20美元的保险价值。因此，我们的方法表明，在加拿大背景下，DI福利并未过度慷慨。
doi:10.3386/w35438.title: Measuring the Value of Disability Insurance from Take-Up Decisions
doi:10.3386/w35438.title_zh: 从参保决策衡量伤残保险的价值

doi:10.3386/w35439.abstract: We harmonize survey data on interest rates paid by approximately 15,000 small and medium enterprises across 125 firm surveys and 285,000 households across 83 household surveys spanning developing and rich countries to study the relationship between monetary policy rates and borrowing costs faced by SMEs and households. Using within-country variation in policy rates over time, we find that pass-through to firm and household borrowing rates is stronger in richer countries than in poorer ones.
doi:10.3386/w35439.abstract_zh: 我们整合了来自125项企业调查中约15,000家中小企业以及83项家庭调查中285,000户家庭（涵盖发展中国家与富裕国家）的利率调查数据，以研究货币政策利率与中小企业及家庭借贷成本之间的关系。通过利用各国政策利率随时间变化的内部差异，我们发现政策利率向企业和家庭借贷利率的传导效应在富裕国家比在贫困国家更为显著。
doi:10.3386/w35439.title: Do Monetary Policy Rates Reach Borrowers? Evidence from Household and Firm Loans in 96 Countries
doi:10.3386/w35439.title_zh: 货币政策利率能否传导至借款人？来自96个国家家庭与企业贷款的证据

doi:10.3386/w35440.abstract: This paper examines the choice between public and private healthcare systems among elderly veterans, who are dually eligible to obtain care through the publicly operated Veterans Health Administration (VA) and through private providers financed by Medicare. We analyze health system choice among veterans who move across areas with differing rates of VA utilization to quantify the relative importance of individual-specific factors (e.g., preferences, income, health) and place-specific factors (e.g., local access, quality, and convenience). Our estimates indicate that 50–60% of geographic variation in VA use is attributable to demand-side individual factors, with the remainder explained by place-based factors. We also document important heterogeneity across types of care, with place-based factors playing a larger role for inpatient and emergency care than for outpatient and primary care. Additional analysis suggests that the supply-side features emphasized in recent legislation—distance to VA facilities and wait times—explain only a small share of estimated place effects. These findings highlight the importance of individual factors in health system choice and have implications for policies aimed at reducing geographic disparities in VA utilization.
doi:10.3386/w35440.abstract_zh: 本文研究了老年退伍军人在公共与私营医疗体系之间的选择问题。这些退伍军人有资格通过公立的退伍军人健康管理局（VA）以及由医疗保险资助的私营医疗机构获得医疗服务。我们分析了在不同VA使用率地区间迁移的退伍军人的医疗体系选择，以量化个体特定因素（如偏好、收入、健康状况）和地区特定因素（如当地可及性、质量及便利性）的相对重要性。估算结果表明，VA使用的地理差异中50%–60%可归因于需求侧的个体因素，其余部分则由地区因素解释。我们还发现不同医疗类型之间存在显著异质性：地区因素对住院和急诊服务的影响大于对门诊和初级保健服务的影响。进一步分析表明，近期立法强调的供给侧特征——与VA机构的距离及等待时间——仅能解释地区效应的一小部分。这些发现凸显了个体因素在医疗体系选择中的重要性，并对旨在减少VA使用地理差异的政策具有启示意义。
doi:10.3386/w35440.title: Choice Between Public and Private Healthcare Systems: Evidence from Veterans
doi:10.3386/w35440.title_zh: 公共与私人医疗体系的选择：来自退伍军人的证据

doi:10.3386/w35442.abstract: Japan has the world’s oldest population and a universal Long-Term Care Insurance (LTCI) system, yet how care use and costs differ between cognitive and physical impairment remains underexamined. Using the nationally representative Comprehensive Survey of Living Conditions (2016 and 2019 waves; 324,466 adults aged 65 and older), we compare the utilization, intensity, and cost of long-term care across three groups: those with a dementia diagnosis (defined as regularly receiving medical treatment for dementia), those with physical (ADL) limitations but no dementia, and those with neither. A dementia diagnosis is associated with dramatically higher care use—75.3% receive some care, versus 5.3% of the unimpaired reference group. In models adjusting for demographic and socioeconomic characteristics, dementia raises the probability of receiving formal care by 55 percentage points and informal care by 52 percentage points—roughly double the effects of ADL limitations—and, conditional on use, is associated with about 113 additional hours of formal care per month (some 60% more than physical limitations alone). We estimate formal-care costs at 1.07–4.03% of GDP (depending on the valuation method) and co-residing informal-care costs at 0.79% of GDP. Per-capita formal-care costs are substantially higher for those with dementia (about 3.5 versus 2.0 million JPY annually under the self-reported approach), whereas informal-care costs are nearly uniform across impairment types—underscoring the intensive, and largely invisible, contribution of family caregivers. With the dementia and mild-cognitive-impairment population projected to reach roughly 12 million by 2040, these findings point to mounting fiscal and family-care pressures from cognitive impairment in Japan.
doi:10.3386/w35442.abstract_zh: 日本拥有全球最老龄人口及全民长期护理保险（LTCI）体系，但认知障碍与身体功能障碍在护理使用及成本方面的差异尚未得到充分研究。基于全国代表性数据《综合生活状况调查》（2016年与2019年两轮调查；涵盖324,466名65岁及以上老年人），我们比较了三类群体的长期护理使用率、强度及成本：确诊痴呆症群体（定义为定期接受痴呆症医学治疗者）、存在身体活动能力（ADL）限制但无痴呆症群体，以及无上述两类问题的群体。痴呆症诊断与显著更高的护理使用率相关——75.3%的该群体接受某种形式的护理，而参照组（无功能障碍者）仅为5.3%。在调整人口与社会经济特征的模型中，痴呆症使接受正式护理的概率提高55个百分点，接受非正式护理的概率提高52个百分点——约为ADL限制效应的两倍；且在已使用护理的条件下，每月正式护理时长增加约113小时（较单纯身体功能障碍群体高出约60%）。我们估算正式护理成本占GDP的1.07%-4.03%（取决于估值方法），同住非正式护理成本占GDP的0.79%。按人均计算，痴呆症群体的正式护理成本显著更高（自报法下年均约350万日元 vs. 200万日元），而非正式护理成本在不同功能障碍类型间近乎一致——凸显家庭照护者密集且近乎隐形的贡献。鉴于痴呆症及轻度认知障碍人口预计到2040年将达约1200万，这些发现表明日本因认知障碍面临日益加剧的财政与家庭照护压力。
doi:10.3386/w35442.title: Cognitive versus Physical Impairment and the Use and Cost of Long-Term Care in Japan
doi:10.3386/w35442.title_zh: 认知障碍与身体障碍对日本长期护理使用及成本的影响

doi:10.3386/w35443.abstract: We develop a model of aberrant behavior by Bitcoin miners and test it with a new 2017-2025 dataset. Miners’ rewards, comprised partly of user fees, exhibit variability across blocks of transactions. When large reward disparities exist between adjacent blocks, miners have incentives to attempt alternative versions of prior blocks and claim other miners’ rewards for themselves. Regression analysis shows that fee differentials are associated with these attacks and longer waiting times between blocks. These patterns imply potential destabilization of the Bitcoin blockchain as future mining rewards become more volatile due to gradual withdrawal of fixed block subsidies.
doi:10.3386/w35443.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个比特币矿工异常行为模型，并利用2017-2025年的新数据集进行检验。矿工收益部分来源于用户手续费，在不同交易区块间呈现波动性。当相邻区块间存在较大收益差异时，矿工有动机尝试篡改先前区块的替代版本，从而侵占其他矿工的收益。回归分析表明，手续费差异与这类攻击行为及区块间更长的等待时间存在关联。这些模式意味着，随着固定区块补贴逐步退出导致未来挖矿收益波动加剧，比特币区块链可能面临潜在的不稳定性风险。
doi:10.3386/w35443.title: Unruly by Design: Fee Volatility and Strategic Attacks in Bitcoin Mining
doi:10.3386/w35443.title_zh: 设计失序：比特币挖矿中的费用波动与策略性攻击

doi:10.3386/w35444.abstract: I study insurance markets in which scalable prediction, like AI, designs residual risk rather than merely classifies fixed risk. A complete-contracting benchmark shows that if prevention is observable, contractible, competitively supplied, and fully priced, it does not matter whether consumers, insurers, or vendors supply it. Adverse selection breaks such irrelevance. When high-risk consumers are more "AI-treatable," efficient prevention makes low-risk contracts attractive to them. A contract intended for low-risk consumers faces a risk-design trilemma: separate, prevent efficiently, or avoid cross-subsidy, but not all three. The result extends Rothschild-Stiglitz from distorted coverage to distorted risk-control technology and offers market design insights of AI in insurance markets.
doi:10.3386/w35444.abstract_zh: 本文研究保险市场中可扩展预测（如人工智能）如何设计残余风险，而非仅仅对固定风险进行分类。一个完全契约基准表明，若预防行为可观测、可契约化、由竞争性市场提供且完全定价，则无论由消费者、保险公司还是供应商提供预防，其结果均无差异。逆向选择打破了这种无关性。当高风险消费者更具“人工智能可治疗性”时，有效预防会使低风险契约对其产生吸引力。针对低风险消费者的契约面临风险设计的三难困境：分离、有效预防或避免交叉补贴，但三者不可兼得。该结论将罗斯柴尔德-斯蒂格利茨模型从扭曲的保险覆盖范围扩展至扭曲的风险控制技术，并为人工智能在保险市场中的市场设计提供了洞见。
doi:10.3386/w35444.title: Risk Design: AI and Prediction Beyond Screening in Insurance Markets
doi:10.3386/w35444.title_zh: 风险设计：保险市场中超越筛选的人工智能与预测

doi:10.3386/w35445.abstract: Misaligned incentives within organizations may explain why firms fail to adopt or fully benefit from productive technologies. We conducted a randomized controlled trial in Indian garment factories in which units received an anonymous worker-management communication technology, this technology paired with incentives for HR managers to communicate effectively with workers, or neither (control). We find that the technology alone had no impacts relative to control. But pairing the technology with HR incentives increased productivity by 5%, reduced absenteeism by 13%, and raised worker earnings by 3%. Impacts were driven by greater HR responsiveness and increased worker reporting of production-related issues.
doi:10.3386/w35445.abstract_zh: 组织内部的激励错位可能解释了企业为何未能采纳或充分受益于高效技术。我们在印度服装工厂开展了一项随机对照试验，其中部分工厂获得匿名员工-管理层沟通技术，部分工厂在技术基础上附加对人力资源经理有效沟通的激励措施，其余工厂则未获得任何干预（对照组）。研究发现，仅提供技术本身相较于对照组未产生显著影响。但将技术与人力资源激励相结合后，生产率提升5%，缺勤率降低13%，工人收入增加3%。这些影响源于人力资源响应度的提高以及工人对生产相关问题报告频率的增加。
doi:10.3386/w35445.title: Organizational Incentives and the Returns to Technology Adoption
doi:10.3386/w35445.title_zh: 组织激励与技术采纳的回报

doi:10.3386/w35446.abstract: Industrial zones are a widely used industrial policy tool, yet their effects vary enormously. Matching the timing and location of zone establishment to firm-level data in Vietnam, we estimate that a new zone raises formal employment by 2,000 workers within seven years. This average masks extreme skewness: a handful of zones generate the gains while the rest produce almost none. Zones near major trade hubs account for most of the effect, driven by export-oriented foreign manufacturers. Accounting for spillovers, domestic firms face agglomeration shadows nearby but gain farther out, while foreign manufacturers operate as enclaves, generating few local linkages.
doi:10.3386/w35446.abstract_zh: 工业区是一种广泛使用的产业政策工具，但其效果差异巨大。通过将越南工业区设立的时间与地点与企业层面数据进行匹配，我们估算出新建工业区在七年内可使正规就业增加2000人。这一平均值掩盖了极端偏态分布：少数工业区贡献了全部增长，其余工业区几乎毫无成效。靠近主要贸易枢纽的工业区贡献了大部分效应，其驱动力来自出口导向型外资制造商。考虑溢出效应后，国内企业在邻近区域面临集聚阴影，但在更远距离处获益；而外资制造商以飞地模式运营，几乎未产生本地关联。

doi:10.3386/w35446.title_zh: 越南工业区对正规就业创造的不均衡影响

doi:10.3386/w35447.abstract: The federal government appropriated $189.5 billion in pandemic aid to school districts through the Elementary and Secondary School Emergency Relief (ESSER) fund. We evaluate their impact on schools with district poverty shares near 5%, where a threshold-driven increase in funds enables us to implement a difference-in-discontinuities design. Federal funds were passed on to residents through reductions in local revenue collections, including property taxes, and did not result in increased per-pupil expenditures by school districts. We find no evidence that additional funds mitigated the declines in test scores. We provide suggestive evidence that political engagement, especially from parents, increased in districts that qualified for additional funds. This combination of engagement and reduced taxation may explain the greater enrollment and faster reopening we observe in such districts.
doi:10.3386/w35447.abstract_zh: 联邦政府通过《中小学紧急救援基金》（ESSER）拨款1895亿美元用于学区疫情援助。我们利用学区贫困率接近5%的门槛效应，通过断点回归设计评估其影响。联邦资金通过减少地方财政收入（包括财产税）转移给居民，并未导致学区生均支出增加。我们未发现额外资金缓解考试成绩下降的证据。初步证据表明，获得额外资金的学区政治参与度（尤其是家长参与）有所提升。这种参与度提高与税收减少的组合效应，或可解释此类学区入学率上升及复课速度加快的现象。
doi:10.3386/w35447.title: Intergovernmental Grants to School Districts and Educational Outcomes During the COVID-19 Pandemic
doi:10.3386/w35447.title_zh: 新冠疫情期间政府间对学区的拨款与教育成果

doi:10.3386/w35448.abstract: We show that incorporating uninsurable countercyclical income risk into a standard international RBC model can qualitatively and quantitatively account for the quantity puzzles in open-economy macro, namely (i) the Backus-Smith puzzle, (ii) the Backus-Kehoe-Kydland puzzle and (iii) the weak correlation between the trade balance and the exchange rate. We also show that our model can simultaneously account for the Fama puzzle and the evidence that high interest rate countries have stronger currencies—which representative-agents models that rely only on financial or demand shocks cannot jointly account for. Crucially, our model resolves all these puzzles while relying solely on productivity shocks, and thus generates the observed domestic and cross-country macroeconomic comovement.
doi:10.3386/w35448.abstract_zh: 我们证明，将不可保险的反周期收入风险纳入标准国际实际经济周期模型，能够从定性和定量两方面解释开放经济宏观经济学中的数量谜题，即：（i）巴克斯-史密斯谜题、（ii）巴克斯-基欧-基德兰德谜题以及（iii）贸易余额与汇率之间的弱相关性。我们还证明，该模型能同时解释法玛谜题以及高利率国家拥有更强货币的证据——而仅依赖金融或需求冲击的代表性主体模型无法共同解释这些现象。关键在于，我们的模型仅依靠生产率冲击就解决了所有谜题，从而生成了观察到的国内及跨国宏观经济协同波动。
doi:10.3386/w35448.title: The International RBC Model Finally Works!
doi:10.3386/w35448.title_zh: 国际实际经济周期模型终于奏效了！

doi:10.3386/w35449.abstract: Maritime transport remains the backbone of global trade, yet the port and shipping network that carries it has been transformed by containerization and related technological advances. Drawing on newly available granular data---digitized historical shipping records, georeferenced ship movements, and shipment-level routing information---we present five stylized facts on the structure and evolution of the maritime network. Global shipping activity is highly concentrated among a changing lineup of dominant top ports even as lower-ranked ports disperse, while state-owned Chinese port terminal operators increasingly account for these global volumes, boosting overall port operations while delivering efficiency gains mostly to Chinese vessels. We use these facts to organize a synthesis of a fast-growing literature: containerization reshaped which port cities could expand, reinforced hub-and-spoke concentration that yields large but localized welfare gains, embedded ports in multimodal networks that amplify the returns to infrastructure, and generated market power, congestion, and environmental costs. Together, this evidence shows how evolving maritime technologies simultaneously deepen global integration and heighten the economic and geopolitical importance of critical nodes in the transport network---and of who controls them.
doi:10.3386/w35449.abstract_zh: 海上运输仍是全球贸易的支柱，但承载这一运输体系的港口与航运网络已因集装箱化及相关技术进步而发生深刻变革。基于新获取的颗粒化数据——数字化历史航运记录、地理参照船舶轨迹及单次货运路径信息——我们归纳出关于海运网络结构与演变的五个典型事实。全球航运活动高度集中于排名动态变化的头部港口，而低层级港口则呈现分散化趋势；与此同时，中国国有港口码头运营商在全球吞吐量中的占比持续攀升，在提升整体港口运营效率的同时，其效率增益主要惠及中国籍船舶。我们借助这些事实对快速增长的文献进行系统整合：集装箱化重塑了港口城市的扩张空间，强化了枢纽-辐条式集中格局并带来巨大但局部化的福利收益，将港口嵌入多式联运网络从而放大基础设施回报，同时催生了市场势力、拥堵与环境成本。这些证据共同表明，不断演进的海运技术在深化全球一体化的同时，也加剧了运输网络关键节点及其控制者的经济与地缘政治重要性。

doi:10.3386/w35449.title_zh: 港口、技术与城市间贸易：演变中的海上运输网络的经济学与地缘政治

doi:10.3386/w35450.abstract: In the canonical view of over-the-counter markets, dealers intermediate single-asset trades one at a time. We study a complementary role: when investors trade several assets at once, dealers absorb the joint position into inventory, insuring against execution risk. Using data on the near-universe of Canadian fixed-income trades, we find that bundled transactions account for 20 percent of investor volume. We develop a simple model of why, when, where, and at what prices investors bundle, and use it to explain three patterns. Switches—a purchase paired with a sale—transact at a discount, while uni-directional bundles—all buys or sells—transact at a premium, because a switch’s legs hedge within the dealer’s book while a uni-directional bundle’s compound. Bundling rises with volatility, when insurance against execution risk is most valuable, and the two types sort asymmetrically across bilateral and electronic venues. Together, these patterns reveal a dimension of intermediation the single-asset view overlooks, and one likely to grow in importance.
doi:10.3386/w35450.abstract_zh: 在场外交易市场的经典视角中，交易商一次仅中介单一资产交易。我们研究了一个互补性角色：当投资者同时交易多种资产时，交易商将联合头寸纳入库存，以此对冲执行风险。利用加拿大固定收益市场近乎全量交易数据，我们发现捆绑交易占投资者交易量的20%。我们构建了一个简约模型，解释投资者为何、何时、何地以及以何种价格进行捆绑交易，并以此阐明三种模式。配对交易（买入与卖出组合）以折价成交，而单向捆绑（全买或全卖）则以溢价成交，原因在于配对交易的各腿在交易商账簿内对冲风险，而单向捆绑的各腿则叠加风险。当执行风险对冲价值最高时，捆绑交易随波动率上升而增加，且两类交易在双边与电子交易平台间呈现非对称分布。这些模式共同揭示了单一资产视角所忽视的中介维度，且该维度的重要性预计将持续增长。
doi:10.3386/w35450.title: Bundling Trades In Over-The-Counter Markets
doi:10.3386/w35450.title_zh: 场外交易市场中的捆绑交易

doi:10.3386/w35451.abstract: Using 380 trillion tokens of realized AI consumption across more than four hundred large language models from the licensed proprietary OpenRouter dataset covering approximately 2 percent of current global monthly AI token consumption, we analyze how AI affects firms, markets, and workers. Leveraging the unprecedented size, scope and granularity of this data, we construct the AI Factor from growth in tokens, dollars, and users, estimate firm-level AI Betas from stock return comovement, and characterize the AI Premium. First, we build a high-frequency AI factor and decompose it into salient components. Second, we show that firms whose returns covary more positively with the AI factor—high AI beta firms—earn higher subsequent returns, and the AI premium is large and heterogeneous. A value-weighted longshort strategy earns 64.1 basis points per week, and the premium is large for loadings on the intensive, frontier-oriented margin of AI consumption—closed-source models, paying and seasoned users, and long prompts—but not on casual or open-weight use. Third, the premium reaches beyond technology firms into consumer-facing and capital-heavy parts of the economy, but is absent in emerging markets, including China. Fourth, the AI exposure is more positive in nonroutine interactive work and more negative in analytical, scientific, and operations-control skills—an occupation one standard deviation higher in interaction-and-communication content has 0.36-standard-deviation higher market-implied AI exposure. Additionally, we provide early evidence of the rise of the agentic economy.
doi:10.3386/w35451.abstract_zh: 基于来自授权专有OpenRouter数据集的超过四百个大语言模型的380万亿个实际AI消费token（该数据集覆盖当前全球月度AI token消费量的约2%），我们分析了AI如何影响企业、市场与劳动者。借助该数据前所未有的规模、范围与粒度，我们通过token、美元与用户增长构建了AI因子，从股票收益联动中估计了企业层面的AI贝塔系数，并刻画了AI溢价。首先，我们构建了一个高频AI因子并将其分解为显著成分。其次，我们发现收益与AI因子协方差更正向的企业（高AI贝塔企业）获得更高的后续收益，且AI溢价规模较大且具有异质性。市值加权多空策略每周获得64.1个基点的收益，该溢价在集约型、前沿导向的AI消费边际（闭源模型、付费及资深用户、长提示词）上表现显著，但在随意或开源权重使用中不显著。第三，该溢价不仅存在于科技企业，还延伸至面向消费者和资本密集型经济领域，但在包括中国在内的新兴市场中缺失。第四，AI暴露在非常规互动性工作中更为正向，在分析性、科学性和运营控制技能中更为负向——互动与沟通内容高一个标准差职业的市场隐含AI暴露度高0.36个标准差。此外，我们提供了智能体经济崛起的早期证据。
