doi:10.3386/w35452.abstract: This scoping review curates empirical research on economic well-being among Latino households in peer reviewed journals from 1990 to 2025, following PRISMA guidelines and a preregistered search strategy. The search yielded more than 5,000 studies revealing a greater than five-fold increase since the early 2000s. The majority of studies examined Medicaid and health insurance and approximately half examined government benefit programs, particularly with respect to eligibility criteria and benefit receipt. Few studies examined the employment outcomes of Latinos in the context of government benefit availability and even fewer focus on Latinos and income support. A deeper content review revealed that studies examining Hispanics are typically through comparative analyses with other racial and ethnic groups. These studies find higher poverty and material hardship, and lower receipt of government benefits, among Latino families relative to non-Latino White households. Fewer studies consider heterogeneity within Hispanic populations. Research on economic well-being among Latino households, as distinct from more general investigations regarding immigrants, expanded in tandem with growth in the Latino population and shifts in social policy. Key policy-relevant open topics of research that affect Latinos include those related to tax credits, benefit generosity, employment, and considerations of mixed-citizen status households.
doi:10.3386/w35452.abstract_zh: 本范围综述遵循PRISMA指南及预注册搜索策略，梳理了1990年至2025年间同行评审期刊中关于拉美裔家庭经济福祉的实证研究。检索共获得5000余项研究，显示自21世纪初以来相关文献数量增长超过五倍。多数研究聚焦医疗补助与健康保险，约半数研究涉及政府福利项目，尤其关注资格标准与福利领取情况。探讨政府福利可及性背景下拉美裔就业结果的研究较少，聚焦拉美裔与收入支持的研究更为稀缺。深入内容审查表明，针对西班牙裔群体的研究通常采用与其他种族/族裔群体的比较分析。这些研究发现，相较于非拉美裔白人家庭，拉美裔家庭面临更高的贫困率和物质匮乏程度，且政府福利领取率较低。考虑西班牙裔群体内部异质性的研究较少。区别于针对移民的普遍性研究，关于拉美裔家庭经济福祉的研究随拉美裔人口增长及社会政策变迁而同步扩展。影响拉美裔群体的关键政策相关开放研究议题包括：税收抵免、福利慷慨度、就业问题及混合公民身份家庭的考量。
doi:10.3386/w35452.title: Economic Well-Being of Latino Households in the U.S.: a Scoping Review of Research on Poverty, the Safety Net, and Family Supports
doi:10.3386/w35452.title_zh: 美国拉丁裔家庭的经济福祉：贫困、安全网与家庭支持研究的范围综述

doi:10.3386/w35453.abstract: Financial sanctions are widely viewed as a powerful tool of economic statecraft, yet direct evidence on their effects remains limited. We study how sanctions affect access to global payment networks using data on correspondent banking relationships, which link banks across countries and currencies to enable cross-border transactions. We first show that the dollar and euro networks offer the broadest global connectivity, supported by a small number of key hubs in the U.S. and Europe. Sanctions that restrict access to these hubs are therefore potentially powerful. We then show how financial sanctions imposed during 2021-2025 – a period of rapid growth in sanctions – reduced targeted banks' access to major-currency networks by severing correspondent relationships. Sanctioned institutions often retained access but only through longer, indirect, and more fragile chains of intermediaries. Finally, in countries where sanctions expanded sharply, non-sanctioned banks also lost connectivity to Western networks, likely reflecting de-risking. These banks reoriented toward alternatives, particularly the Chinese yuan. Outside these heavily sanctioned economies, shifts away from the dollar and toward the yuan remain minimal on average.
doi:10.3386/w35453.abstract_zh: 金融制裁被广泛视为经济治国方略的有力工具，但其影响的直接证据仍然有限。我们利用代理行关系数据研究制裁如何影响全球支付网络的接入——这些关系将不同国家和货币的银行连接起来，以实现跨境交易。我们首先发现，美元和欧元网络提供了最广泛的全球连通性，这得益于美国和欧洲少数关键枢纽的支持。因此，限制这些枢纽接入的制裁具有潜在强大效力。随后，我们展示了2021-2025年间（制裁快速扩张时期）实施的金融制裁如何通过切断代理行关系，削弱目标银行对主要货币网络的接入。受制裁机构往往仍能保留接入渠道，但只能通过更长、间接且更脆弱的中间链条实现。最后，在制裁急剧扩大的国家，未受制裁的银行也失去了与西方网络的连通性，这很可能反映了去风险化行为。这些银行转向替代方案，尤其是人民币。而在这些受严重制裁的经济体之外，从美元转向人民币的总体变化仍微乎其微。

doi:10.3386/w35453.title: Financial Sanctions and the Global Payments Network
doi:10.3386/w35453.title_zh: 金融制裁与全球支付网络

doi:10.3386/w35454.abstract: We examine a choice between bonus contracts offered to dealers of a U.S. auto manufacturer. In our data, dealers select the non-profit-maximizing option in 20 percent of observations, costing the mistaken dealers $18,453 per year on average. We examine how the propensity to make this mistake varies with competition, identified both cross-sectionally and within dealers over time. Both analyses show that greater competition substantially lowers the rate of mistakes. However, even in the most competitive markets, consequential mistakes persist. Our results suggest that competition disciplines mainly through within-dealer changes in behavior rather than entry and exit.
doi:10.3386/w35454.abstract_zh: 我们研究了美国一家汽车制造商向其经销商提供的奖金合同选择。数据显示，在20%的观测中，经销商选择了非利润最大化的选项，平均每年给犯错的经销商造成18,453美元的损失。我们考察了犯错倾向如何随竞争程度变化，这一关系通过截面数据以及经销商随时间变化的内部数据共同识别。两项分析均表明，更激烈的竞争显著降低了错误率。然而，即使在竞争最激烈的市场中，重大错误依然存在。我们的结果表明，竞争主要通过经销商内部行为变化而非市场进入与退出机制发挥约束作用。
doi:10.3386/w35454.title: Competition and Anomalies Redux: Evidence from U.S. Auto Dealers
doi:10.3386/w35454.title_zh: 竞争与异常再探：来自美国汽车经销商的证据

doi:10.3386/w35455.abstract: We study how residential-commercial zoning affects the allocation of urban space. Using property-level data from Taipei and 34 U.S. metropolitan areas, we infer neighborhood-level zoning wedges from the allocation of residents, workers, and floor space. We find substantially greater dispersion in these wedges in U.S. cities than in Taipei, where mixed-use development is pervasive. The inferred wedges increase neighborhood specialization and reduce welfare. We then evaluate whether zoning is aligned with the neighborhood characteristics that would justify intervention. Although zoning is systematically related to comparative advantage, comparative advantage explains only a small fraction of the variation in zoning. The dominant effect of zoning in American cities is therefore not to promote efficient land use, but to increase the segregation of residential and commercial activity across neighborhoods.
doi:10.3386/w35455.abstract_zh: 本文研究住宅-商业分区如何影响城市空间的配置。利用台北及美国34个大都市区的房产层面数据，我们从居民、劳动者及楼面空间的配置中推断出社区层面的分区楔子。研究发现，美国城市中这些楔子的离散程度显著高于混合用途开发普遍存在的台北。推断出的楔子加剧了社区专业化并降低了社会福利。随后，我们评估分区是否与可证明干预合理性的社区特征相一致。尽管分区与比较优势存在系统性关联，但比较优势仅能解释分区变化的极小部分。因此，美国城市中分区的主导作用并非促进土地高效利用，而是加剧了住宅与商业活动在社区间的隔离。

doi:10.3386/w35455.title: Zoning: Externalities or Misallocation?
doi:10.3386/w35455.title_zh: 分区：外部性还是资源错配？

doi:10.3386/w35456.abstract: Both historically and today, support of aging parents has largely taken the form of in-kind transfers that require physical proximity, such as housing and caregiving. If Social Security substitutes for such support, it can relax constraints on where recipients' children live and work. We investigate the long-run intergenerational effects of the early Social Security program, exploiting within-occupation, cross-industry differences in coverage and a new dataset linking parents to their children's later-life outcomes. We find that sons whose parents had greater predicted coverage moved farther from their childhood homes, earned more, and lived in better neighborhoods late in life. We find no such effects for daughters, who tended to provide forms of support less easily replaced by Social Security. The gains considerably exceeded the associated Social Security benefits for the average family, with migration to better-matched labor markets a likely key driver. We propose that the early program enabled families to realize gains from migration that were back-loaded, uncertain, and difficult to contract on.
doi:10.3386/w35456.abstract_zh: 无论历史上还是当今，赡养年迈父母主要采取需要物理邻近性的实物转移形式，例如提供住房和照料。若社会保障制度替代了此类支持，则可缓解对受赡养者子女居住地和工作地点的约束。我们利用早期社会保障计划在职业内部、行业之间的覆盖差异，并结合将父母与其子女晚年生活状况相关联的新数据集，研究了该计划的长期代际效应。研究发现，父母预期保障覆盖率较高的家庭中，儿子成年后远离童年居住地、收入更高且晚年居住社区条件更优。但此类效应对女儿并不显著——女儿往往提供更难以被社会保障替代的支持形式。对普通家庭而言，这些收益远超其获得的社会保障福利，而迁移至更匹配的劳动力市场很可能是关键驱动因素。我们认为，早期计划使家庭能够实现迁移带来的滞后性、不确定且难以契约化的收益。
doi:10.3386/w35456.title: Long-Run Intergenerational Effects of Social Security
doi:10.3386/w35456.title_zh: 社会保障的长期代际效应

doi:10.3386/w35457.abstract: Discrete choice experiments are widely used to estimate workers’ willingness to pay (WTP) for job amenities under the assumption that varying an attribute does not change workers’ beliefs about other job attributes. We test this assumption by embedding an amenity with a known market price—a popular monthly public transport pass—in a largescale discrete choice experiment with German workers. Many workers, including public transport users, overvalue the ticket by more than 100%, despite WTP for other attributes aligning with the literature. A complementary belief-elicitation experiment shows that advertising an amenity, such as the pass but also common amenities like work from home, causally shifts beliefs about unlisted attributes of the job. Posted wages similarly signal unlisted attributes so that wage variation, the money metric for WTP calculation, is itself contaminated by belief spillovers—such as higher pay signaling heightened stress. These spillovers imply that discrete choice estimates capture perceived bundles rather than isolated attributes, and distort current estimates of non-wage compensation and monopsony power.
doi:10.3386/w35457.abstract_zh: 离散选择实验被广泛用于估算工人对工作福利的支付意愿，其前提假设是改变某一属性不会改变工人对其他工作属性的信念。我们通过将一项具有已知市场价格的福利——德国广受欢迎的月度公共交通通票——嵌入针对德国工人的大规模离散选择实验来检验这一假设。结果显示，许多工人（包括公共交通使用者）对该通票的估值高出实际价值100%以上，尽管对其他属性的支付意愿与现有文献一致。一项补充性的信念诱导实验表明，宣传某项福利（如通票，也包括居家办公等常见福利）会因果性地改变工人对工作未列明属性的信念。同样，公布的工资水平也会传递未列明属性的信号，因此作为支付意愿计算货币尺度的工资变动本身也受到信念溢出效应的影响——例如高薪可能意味着更高的工作压力。这些溢出效应意味着离散选择实验的估计结果捕捉到的是感知到的福利组合而非孤立属性，从而扭曲了当前对非工资补偿和买方垄断势力的估算。
doi:10.3386/w35457.title: Job Ads as Signals: Evidence from a Priced Amenity and Worker Beliefs
doi:10.3386/w35457.title_zh: 职位广告作为信号：来自定价福利与工人信念的证据

doi:10.3386/w35458.abstract: Firms often rebrand to counter negative shocks, but can it work? Using a historical natural experiment, we analyze a large sample of companies from the same industry (banking) that shared very similar names, but overwhelmingly decided to change them in response to a common, negative news shock. U.S. entry into World War I in 1917 created a sudden anti-German backlash against anything that invoked an association with the now enemy. The shock itself was thus orthogonal to bank fundamentals and pre-existing trends, but pushed banks to reconsider their brands. After 1917, the few German-named banks that kept their tainted names saw significant declines in assets, deposits, and market share relative to other banks. However, German-named banks that rebranded mitigated much of the negative shock. Specifically, German-named banks that adopted a new non-ethnic brand name avoided between 75% and 85% of the anti-German effect, and those that adopted a new patriotic brand name were able to neutralize it completely. Overall, we find that “crisis rebranding” paid off in our historical setting regardless of the chosen brand, with patriotic rebranding proving the most effective at offsetting the exogenous shock.
doi:10.3386/w35458.abstract_zh: 企业常通过品牌重塑应对负面冲击，但这一策略是否有效？借助历史自然实验，我们分析了同一行业（银行业）中大量名称高度相似的公司样本，这些公司因共同遭遇负面新闻冲击而普遍决定更名。1917年美国加入第一次世界大战，引发针对一切与敌国关联事物的突发性反德浪潮。该冲击本身与银行基本面及既有趋势正交，却迫使银行重新审视其品牌。1917年后，少数保留污名化德文名称的银行，其资产、存款及市场份额相较于其他银行显著下滑。然而，实施品牌重塑的德文名称银行有效缓解了大部分负面冲击：采用非族裔新品牌的银行规避了75%至85%的反德效应，而采用爱国新品牌的银行则完全抵消了这一冲击。总体而言，无论选择何种品牌，历史情境下的"危机品牌重塑"均取得成效，其中爱国品牌重塑在抵消外生冲击方面效果最为显著。
doi:10.3386/w35458.title: Banking on a Corporate Rebrand

doi:10.3386/w35459.abstract: We revisit fiscal sustainability through the lens of the government’s budget constraint. What constrains fiscal policy is not the stock of outstanding liabilities per se, but the fiscal cost of servicing debt. Using two centuries of U.S. fiscal data (1800–2023) and a long-run panel of advanced economies, we show that primary surpluses are systematically more closely associated with debt-service burdens, while debt ratios lose explanatory power when debt service is taken into account. Fiscal responses intensify when financing conditions deteriorate, specifically when the interest-growth differential is positive. We rationalize these findings using a simple flow-based framework in which debt stabilization depends on the responsiveness of fiscal surpluses to financing pressures. The results suggest that fiscal sustainability depends less on debt thresholds than on financing regimes and governments’ ability to absorb debt-service burdens.
doi:10.3386/w35459.abstract_zh: 我们通过政府预算约束的视角重新审视财政可持续性问题。制约财政政策的并非未偿债务存量本身，而是偿债的财政成本。基于美国两个世纪（1800-2023年）的财政数据以及发达经济体的长期面板数据，我们表明：基本盈余与偿债负担之间存在系统性更强的关联，而当考虑偿债成本时，债务比率对财政行为的解释力显著下降。当融资条件恶化时——特别是当利率-增长率差值为正时——财政响应会显著增强。我们通过一个基于流量分析的简单框架对这些发现进行理论解释：在该框架中，债务稳定取决于财政盈余对融资压力的响应程度。研究结果表明，财政可持续性更多取决于融资机制及政府吸收偿债负担的能力，而非债务阈值本身。
doi:10.3386/w35459.title: From Stocks to Flows: Debt Service and Fiscal Sustainability
doi:10.3386/w35459.title_zh: 从存量到流量：债务服务与财政可持续性

doi:10.3386/w35460.abstract: We analyze collaborative experimentation across multiple independent domains. Each domain contains infinitely many potential projects with asymmetric benefits. In each period and in each domain, two players can idle, jointly explore a new project, or jointly exploit a known one, with voluntary transfers. For intermediate discount factors, treating domains as independent during experimentation is suboptimal. The optimal experimentation policy exhibits common features of collaborative experimentation: lengthy exploration, temporary project exploitation, recall of past projects, and inefficient initial or terminal idling within certain domains. We connect these findings to research on buyer-supplier dynamics and persistent productivity differences.
doi:10.3386/w35460.abstract_zh: 我们分析了跨多个独立领域的协作实验。每个领域包含无限多个具有不对称收益的潜在项目。在每个时期和每个领域，两名参与者可以选择闲置、共同探索新项目或共同利用已知项目，并允许自愿转移。对于中等折现因子，在实验过程中将各领域视为独立是次优的。最优实验策略展现出协作实验的共同特征：长时间的探索、临时性的项目利用、对过往项目的回溯，以及某些领域内低效的初始或终端闲置。我们将这些发现与买方-供应商动态及持续生产率差异的研究联系起来。
doi:10.3386/w35460.title: Multi-Project Collaborations

doi:10.3386/w35461.abstract: We develop a simple and intuitive Pigouvian perspective on optimal trade policy. Our approach unifies a wide range of rationales for taxing trade, from the classical optimal tariff argument to contemporary debates about global carbon emissions and geopolitics. We also clarify when trade policy intervention is warranted and when alternative domestic instruments should be used instead.
doi:10.3386/w35461.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种简单直观的庇古视角下的最优贸易政策。该方法统一了从经典最优关税理论到当代关于全球碳排放与地缘政治辩论的广泛贸易征税理由。同时，我们阐明了何时应实施贸易政策干预，以及何时应改用其他国内政策工具。

doi:10.3386/w35461.title: Should We Tax Trade? A Pigouvian Perspective
doi:10.3386/w35461.title_zh: 我们是否应该对贸易征税？庇古视角

doi:10.3386/w35462.abstract: We investigate the short- and long-run impacts of unexpected mortality on psychosocial health in the context of a large-scale high-mortality natural disaster, the 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami. The effects of the tsunami-related mortality measured at the community level are contrasted with the effects of individual-specific loss of close kin using population-representative longitudinal survey data from the Study of the Tsunami Aftermath and Recovery. In the short-run, two years post-tsunami, both community and individual-level mortality exposures are significant predictors of elevated depression and post-traumatic stress symtoms. In the longer-run, ten years post-tsunami, individual-level exposures are slightly attenuated but remain significant predictors of both psychosocial health measures; in contrast, community-level mortality predicts post-traumatic stress but not depression symptoms. Mortality is linked to smaller household sizes in the short- and long-run and to less social support in the long-run, although the latter effect differs substantially for males and females. The estimates adjust for other tsunami exposure measures and, in the individual-level analyses, we compare people living in the same community at the time of the tsunami who were exposed to the same community-level mortality rate.
doi:10.3386/w35462.abstract_zh: 本文以2004年印度洋地震海啸这一大规模高死亡率自然灾害为背景，考察意外死亡对心理社会健康的短期与长期影响。通过使用"海啸后果与恢复研究"中具有人口代表性的纵向调查数据，我们将社区层面测量的海啸相关死亡率影响与个体层面近亲丧失的影响进行对比。在短期（海啸后两年）内，社区与个体层面的死亡暴露均是抑郁症状与创伤后应激症状加剧的显著预测因子。在长期（海啸后十年）内，个体层面暴露的影响虽略有减弱，但仍对两项心理健康指标具有显著预测作用；相比之下，社区层面死亡率仅能预测创伤后应激症状，而非抑郁症状。死亡率与短期及长期的家庭规模缩小相关，并与长期的社会支持减少相关，但后者在男女性别间存在显著差异。本研究在估计中调整了其他海啸暴露指标，并在个体层面分析中，比较了海啸发生时居住于同一社区且面临相同社区死亡率的居民。
doi:10.3386/w35462.title: Psychosocial Health and Well-Being After A Mortality Shock
doi:10.3386/w35462.title_zh: 死亡率冲击后的社会心理健康与福祉

doi:10.3386/w35463.abstract: Emerging market economies (EMEs) have historically been vulnerable to external shocks. Recently the global economy has experienced several major shocks yet EMEs have been remarkably resilient. Some of this improved performance can be attributed to prudent policies and stronger economic fundamentals, but the existing literature points to an overperformance mystery by some EMEs with weaker fundamentals. We evaluate an alternative measure of vulnerability based on the concept of a natural level of capital flows (KF*). Specifically, we hypothesize that EMEs are more vulnerable when prior to a large global shock capital flows—portfolio inflows, to be specific—exceed KF*. Results indicate that for major global shocks over the past two decades the pre-shock gap between actual portfolio and KF* has substantial predictive power for the post-shock performance of EMEs.
doi:10.3386/w35463.abstract_zh: 新兴市场经济体（EMEs）历来易受外部冲击影响。近年来全球经济经历多次重大冲击，但新兴市场经济体展现出显著韧性。这种表现的改善部分可归因于审慎的政策和更坚实的经济基本面，但现有文献指出，部分基本面较弱的新兴市场经济体存在"表现超常之谜"。我们基于资本流动自然水平（KF*）概念，评估了一种替代性脆弱性指标。具体而言，我们假设当重大全球冲击发生前，资本流动（特别是证券投资流入）超过KF*时，新兴市场经济体将更为脆弱。研究结果表明，过去二十年间的重大全球冲击中，冲击前实际证券投资与KF*之间的缺口，对新兴市场经济体冲击后的表现具有显著预测能力。
doi:10.3386/w35463.title: Mind the KF* Gap: EME Vulnerabilities to Global Shocks
doi:10.3386/w35463.title_zh: 注意KF*缺口：新兴市场经济体对全球冲击的脆弱性

doi:10.3386/w35464.abstract: The growing prevalence of cognitive impairment (CI) is one of the main drivers of age-related demand for health and long-term care (LTC). In Spain, CI is estimated to affect 18.5% of Spaniards over 65, and 45.3% in those aged 85 and above. This paper draws on a pooled pre-COVID data from a longitudinal sample of individuals aged 65+ to examine the effect of CI and physical limitations on health and long-term care utilisation, estimates its costs, and financial burden. We report four sets of findings. First, we find that socioeconomic status at older age to be the strongest predictor of CI. Second, while both CI and physical limitations increase health and care adult care use, physical impairment is a stronger predictor of overall care utilisation (73% versus 55% for CI alone) and nursing home residence (2.0% versus 0.9%). Third, informal caregiving constitutes the overwhelming majority of dementia costs, accounting for 69–81% of the total. Finally, we estimate that the replacement cost of informal care would exhaust the full budget of Spain’s LTC system (SAAD).
doi:10.3386/w35464.abstract_zh: 认知障碍（CI）患病率的持续上升是老龄化相关健康与长期护理（LTC）需求的主要驱动因素之一。在西班牙，65岁以上人群的CI患病率估计为18.5%，85岁以上人群则高达45.3%。本文利用新冠疫情前65岁以上个体纵向追踪样本的合并数据，考察认知障碍与身体机能限制对健康及长期护理服务利用的影响，并估算其成本与经济负担。研究得出四组发现：第一，老年阶段的社会经济地位是认知障碍的最强预测因子；第二，尽管认知障碍与身体机能限制均会增加健康与成人护理服务的使用，但身体机能受损对整体护理服务利用（单纯CI组为55%，身体受损组为73%）及养老院入住率（0.9%对比2.0%）的预测效力更强；第三，非正式照护构成痴呆症护理成本的绝对主体，占总成本的69%-81%；第四，我们估算非正式照护的替代成本将耗尽西班牙长期护理体系（SAAD）的全部预算。
doi:10.3386/w35464.title: Long Term Care and Cognitive Impairment in Spain
doi:10.3386/w35464.title_zh: 西班牙长期护理与认知障碍

doi:10.3386/w35465.abstract: This paper studies social insurance with imperfect eligibility screening, focusing on Unemployment Insurance (UI) during its expansion in 2020 and 2021. We study the extent of imperfect screening by identifying anomalous payments using administrative tax data and UI policies, finding $214 billion in potentially-improper payments—concentrated in the Pandemic Unemployment Assistance (PUA) program—with approximately half detectable ex-ante through improved federal-state data sharing. There is substantial geographic variation, and a border design shows this is partly due to policy decisions made by states. To assess the implications for optimal policy, we first conduct simulations that replace PUA with means-tested, lump-sum transfers, finding that these transfers would have better insured against income losses at lower administrative cost. Second, we develop a model of opt-in versus automatic transfers that shows the targeting advantage of opt-in programs can reverse when ineligible recipients pass the benefit screen. Calibrated to 2020 UI, the model implies that shifting toward automatic transfers would have increased social welfare.
doi:10.3386/w35465.abstract_zh: 本文研究了资格筛查不完善条件下的社会保险问题，重点关注2020至2021年失业保险（UI）扩张期间的情况。我们通过利用行政税务数据和失业保险政策识别异常支付，探究了筛查不完善的程度，发现存在2140亿美元的潜在不当支付——主要集中在疫情失业援助（PUA）项目中——其中约半数可通过改进联邦与州之间的数据共享实现事前检测。这些支付存在显著的地域差异，而边界设计分析表明，这在一定程度上源于各州制定的政策决策。为评估最优政策的影响，我们首先进行模拟，用基于经济状况调查的定额转移支付替代PUA项目，发现这些转移支付能以更低的行政成本更好地保障收入损失。其次，我们构建了一个选择性加入与自动转移支付模型，表明当不合格受助者通过福利筛查时，选择性加入项目的瞄准优势可能发生逆转。基于2020年失业保险数据的校准结果显示，转向自动转移支付本可提升社会福利。
doi:10.3386/w35465.title: Social Insurance with Imperfect Eligibility Screening: Theory and Evidence from Pandemic UI
doi:10.3386/w35465.title_zh: 不完全资格筛查下的社会保险：理论与来自疫情失业救济的证据

doi:10.3386/w35466.abstract: We interpret exchange rate and yield curve responses to the April 2, 2025 U.S. tariff announcement through the lens of an equilibrium model capturing the portfolio balance mechanism. Disciplined by price elasticities from QE announcements, a 3-12% decline in the demand for dollar bonds (relative to annual U.S. GDP) accounts for the dollar depreciation and rise in dollar yields during this episode. News of a gradual rebalancing out of dollar bonds is consistent with immediate price impact since asset prices are forward-looking. Lower dollar bond demand was accompanied by higher risk aversion, which explains the cross-section of responses across currencies.
doi:10.3386/w35466.abstract_zh: 我们通过一个捕捉投资组合平衡机制的均衡模型，解读2025年4月2日美国关税公告对汇率和收益率曲线的影响。基于量化宽松公告中的价格弹性约束，美元债券需求（相对于美国年度GDP）下降3%-12%，解释了这一时期美元贬值和美元收益率上升的现象。由于资产价格具有前瞻性，美元债券逐步再平衡的消息与即期价格冲击效应一致。美元债券需求下降伴随着风险厌恶情绪上升，这解释了不同货币之间反应的截面差异。
doi:10.3386/w35466.china_relevance_reason: 工作论文摘要包含中国研究常见主题词，需要 AI 确认
doi:10.3386/w35466.title: What Do Asset Prices in April 2025 Say About Demand for the Dollar?
doi:10.3386/w35466.title_zh: 2025年4月资产价格对美元需求的启示

doi:10.3386/w35467.abstract: We provide descriptive evidence on women's experiences in platform-based driving and delivery work using survey and administrative data from India and Indonesia. Partnering with major two-wheeler platforms, we study representative samples of drivers, oversampling women to examine gender differences (India: 404 women, 2,153 men; Indonesia: 892 women, 2,114 men). Female participation is extremely low -- 0.8% in India and 1.5% in Indonesia -- consistent with barriers related to safety concerns, cultural norms, and limited access to required assets. Among women who do enter, platform work is used differently than by men: women work fewer hours, are more likely to log in during free time, and place greater value on flexibility and supplemental earnings. Women earn less per hour than men -- by 6-8% in India and 8-22% in Indonesia -- differences that align with gendered choices over working times, locations, and service types, likely shaped by safety and domestic constraints. Women also face distinct challenges: higher reported harassment in both countries and, in Indonesia, widespread customer discrimination and higher accident rates. At the same time, a disproportionate share of women were unemployed before joining the platform, and women are more likely than men to report higher current earnings relative to prior work. Together, the evidence highlights how flexibility coexists with persistent gender-specific risks, constraints, and unequal returns in location-based platform work in low- and middle-income country contexts.
doi:10.3386/w35467.abstract_zh: 我们利用印度和印度尼西亚的调查与行政数据，提供了关于女性在平台化驾驶和配送工作中经历的描述性证据。通过与主要两轮车平台合作，我们研究了具有代表性的司机样本，并超额抽样女性以考察性别差异（印度：404名女性，2,153名男性；印度尼西亚：892名女性，2,114名男性）。女性参与率极低——印度为0.8%，印度尼西亚为1.5%——这与安全顾虑、文化规范以及所需资产获取受限等障碍一致。在已进入该行业的女性中，她们对平台工作的使用方式与男性不同：女性工作时间更短，更倾向于在空闲时间登录，并更重视灵活性和补充性收入。女性每小时收入低于男性——印度低6-8%，印度尼西亚低8-22%——这些差异与性别化的工作时间、地点和服务类型选择相一致，这些选择很可能受到安全和家庭约束的影响。女性还面临独特的挑战：两国均报告了更高的骚扰发生率，而在印度尼西亚，还存在普遍的客户歧视和更高的事故率。与此同时，加入平台前失业的女性比例过高，且与男性相比，女性更倾向于报告当前收入高于先前工作。综合来看，这些证据凸显了在中低收入国家的基于位置的平台工作中，灵活性如何与持续存在的性别特定风险、约束及不平等回报并存。
doi:10.3386/w35467.title: Women in the Platform Economy: Descriptive Evidence from Drivers in India and Indonesia
doi:10.3386/w35467.title_zh: 平台经济中的女性：来自印度和印尼司机的描述性证据

doi:10.3386/w35468.abstract: We revisit the classic identification problem of separating supply and demand for a homogeneous good using data from multiple markets. We allow markets to be heterogeneous according to unobservables, a feature that arises if there are unobservable differences in consumer preferences or firm technology. We develop a new identification analysis based on hypothetical market types. We use this analysis to show how nonparametric, economically motivated assumptions carry empirical restrictions for a wide range of target parameters, including elasticities, but also welfare parameters, such as consumer surplus. Then, we develop computationally tractable methods for implementing partially identified linear random coefficients models in which the slopes of supply and demand are heterogeneous. We apply these methods to estimate the welfare impact and incidence of sales taxes in the United States.
doi:10.3386/w35468.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了利用多市场数据分离同质商品供给与需求的经典识别问题。我们允许市场根据不可观测因素存在异质性——当消费者偏好或企业技术存在不可观测差异时便会产生这一特征。基于假设性市场类型，我们发展出新的识别分析方法。通过该方法，我们展示了非参数化、具有经济学动机的假设如何对包括弹性在内的广泛目标参数，以及消费者剩余等福利参数施加经验约束。随后，我们开发了计算可操作的方法，用于实现供给与需求斜率存在异质性的部分识别线性随机系数模型。我们应用这些方法估算了美国销售税的福利影响与归宿。
doi:10.3386/w35468.title: Supply and Demand with Market Heterogeneity
doi:10.3386/w35468.title_zh: 市场异质性下的供给与需求

doi:10.3982/ecta20506.abstract: Customs data reveal the heterogeneity and granularity of relationships among buyers and sellers, showing how more exports to a destination break down into more firms selling there and more buyers per exporter. We develop a quantitative general equilibrium model of firm‐to‐firm matching that builds on this insight to separate the roles of iceberg costs and matching frictions in gravity. In the cross section, we find matching frictions as important as iceberg costs in impeding trade, and more sensitive to distance. Because domestic and imported intermediates compete directly with labor in performing production tasks, our model also fits the heterogeneity of labor shares across French producers. Applying the framework to the 2004 expansion of the European Union, reduced iceberg costs and reduced matching frictions contributed equally to the increase in French exports to the new members. While workers benefited overall, those competing most directly with imports gained less, even losing in some countries entering the EU.
doi:10.3982/ecta20506.abstract_zh: 海关数据揭示了买卖双方关系的异质性和颗粒度，显示对某一目的地的出口增长如何分解为更多企业在该地销售以及每个出口商拥有更多买家。我们构建了一个企业间匹配的量化一般均衡模型，基于这一洞察，将冰山成本与匹配摩擦在引力模型中的作用分离开来。在横截面分析中，我们发现匹配摩擦在阻碍贸易方面与冰山成本同等重要，且对距离更为敏感。由于国内和进口中间品在生产任务中直接与劳动力竞争，我们的模型也拟合了法国各企业劳动份额的异质性。将该框架应用于2004年欧盟扩张，冰山成本的降低与匹配摩擦的减少对法国向新成员国出口增长的贡献相当。尽管工人整体受益，但与进口竞争最直接的工人获益较少，甚至在部分加入欧盟的国家中遭受损失。
doi:10.3982/ecta20506.title: Firm‐to‐Firm Trade: Imports, Exports, and the Labor Market
doi:10.3982/ecta20506.title_zh: 企业间贸易：进口、出口与劳动力市场

doi:10.3982/ecta21839.abstract: This paper explores the impact of information design on the auctioneer's revenue in the U.S. offshore oil/gas lease auctions where, post‐auction, the winner decides whether to explore the auctioned tract and must pay the government a royalty on its production value. I first document that there is a positive correlation between the exploration rate and publicly observed losing bids. This suggests that the winning bidder uses the rivals' bids to infer their private information about the tract's potential. I then characterize the equilibrium bidding strategy when the auctioneer designs and commits to how to reveal information on losing bids to the winning bidder. Counterfactual exercises reveal that alternative bid disclosure policies significantly improve auctioneer revenue.
doi:10.3982/ecta21839.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了信息设计对美国海上油气租赁拍卖中拍卖方收益的影响。在拍卖结束后，中标者需决定是否对拍卖地块进行勘探，并须按其生产价值向政府支付特许权使用费。我首先发现，勘探率与公开观察到的未中标报价之间存在正相关关系。这表明，中标者利用竞争对手的报价来推断其关于地块潜力的私人信息。随后，我刻画了当拍卖方设计并承诺如何向中标者披露未中标报价信息时的均衡投标策略。反事实分析表明，替代性的报价披露政策能够显著提高拍卖方收益。
doi:10.3982/ecta21839.title: Information Design in Common Value Auction With Moral Hazard: Application to OCS Leasing Auctions
doi:10.3982/ecta21839.title_zh: 道德风险下的共同价值拍卖信息设计：在OCS租赁拍卖中的应用

doi:10.3982/ecta21926.abstract: Personalizing policies can theoretically increase their effectiveness. However, personalization is difficult when individual types are unobservable and the preferences of policymakers and individuals are not aligned, which could cause individuals to misreport their type. Mechanism design offers a strategy to overcome this issue: offer an “incentive‐compatible” menu of policy choices designed to induce participants to select the variant intended for their type. Using a field experiment that personalized incentives for exercise among 6,800 adults with diabetes and hypertension in urban India, we show that personalizing with an incentive‐compatible choice menu substantially improves program performance, increasing the treatment effect of incentives on exercise by 80% without increasing incentive costs relative to a one‐size‐fits‐all benchmark. Offering choice achieves similar performance to personalizing with an extensive set of observable variables, but without the same data requirements.
doi:10.3982/ecta21926.abstract_zh: 个性化政策在理论上可以提升其有效性。然而，当个体类型不可观测，且政策制定者与个体的偏好不一致时，个性化难以实现，因为这可能导致个体虚报其类型。机制设计提供了一种解决该问题的策略：提供一份“激励相容”的政策选择菜单，旨在引导参与者选择针对其类型设计的方案。通过在印度城市地区对6800名患有糖尿病和高血压的成年人进行一项实地实验，我们证明，采用激励相容的选择菜单进行个性化激励，能显著提升项目绩效：与一刀切的基准方案相比，在不增加激励成本的情况下，将激励对锻炼的处理效应提高了80%。提供选择菜单所达到的效果，与利用大量可观测变量进行个性化处理的效果相当，但无需相同的数据要求。
doi:10.3982/ecta21926.title: Mechanism Design for Personalized Policy: A Field Experiment Incentivizing Exercise
doi:10.3982/ecta21926.title_zh: 个性化政策的机制设计：一项激励运动的实地实验

doi:10.3982/ecta22110.abstract: I document that the right tail of the firm size distribution systematically thickens with economic development. To rationalize this fact, I develop a parsimonious idea search model in which both aggregate growth and the firm size distribution are endogenously determined. The model features an asymptotic balanced growth path along which Gibrat's law holds at each date, and the right tail of the firm size distribution thickens monotonically toward Zipf's law. The model also implies that policies favoring large firms can improve welfare by better utilizing the diffusion externalities arising from idea search.
doi:10.3982/ecta22110.abstract_zh: 本文发现，企业规模分布的右尾随经济发展系统性增厚。为解释这一事实，我构建了一个简约的思想搜寻模型，其中总量增长与企业规模分布均为内生决定。该模型具有渐进平衡增长路径特征，在此路径上各期均满足吉布拉定律，且企业规模分布的右尾单调增厚直至趋近齐普夫定律。模型还表明，偏好大企业的政策可通过更充分利用思想搜寻产生的扩散外部性来提升社会福利。
doi:10.3982/ecta22110.title: Economic Growth and the Rise of Large Firms
doi:10.3982/ecta22110.title_zh: 经济增长与大型企业的崛起

doi:10.3982/ecta22451.abstract: We construct a dynamic integrated assessment model of climate and the economy with very high geographic resolution. Migration is free within, but not allowed across, countries. The model parameterization uses a wealth of data, including the distribution of output, population, energy sources and use, and estimates of the local damages from climate change. It implies very large geographic dispersion in damages from warming. We conduct three kinds of policy experiments. In one, we note that a modest, uniform carbon tax limits global warming and damages around the world substantially. In a second experiment, we let the poorest countries not tax carbon, while the rest compensate by setting higher taxes; the efficiency losses are large. In a final experiment, we find that fast green technology growth alone is a poor substitute for carbon taxes, whether globally available or not.
doi:10.3982/ecta22451.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个具有极高地理分辨率的动态气候与经济综合评估模型。模型设定中，人口可在国家内部自由迁移，但禁止跨国流动。模型参数化过程运用了丰富的数据集，包括产出分布、人口分布、能源来源与使用情况，以及气候变化对各地造成的损失估算。该模型揭示了全球变暖损失在地理分布上的巨大差异性。我们开展了三类政策实验：其一，适度的统一碳税能够显著抑制全球变暖并大幅降低全球损失；其二，若允许最贫困国家免征碳税，而其他国家通过提高税率进行补偿，则会产生巨大的效率损失；其三，我们发现，无论绿色技术是否实现全球普及，仅靠其快速增长都无法有效替代碳税政策。
doi:10.3982/ecta22451.title: Walras–Bowley Lecture: Climate Policy in the Wide World
doi:10.3982/ecta22451.title_zh: 瓦尔拉斯-鲍利讲座：广阔世界中的气候政策

doi:10.3982/ecta22542.abstract: This paper develops a macroeconomic model that combines an incomplete‐markets overlapping‐generations economy with a job ladder featuring sequential wage bargaining, endogenous search effort of employed and non‐employed workers, and differences in match quality. With these ingredients, our model provides a joint microfoundation for the three main inputs in aggregate production: capital, employment, and labor efficiency. The calibrated model offers a good fit to the empirical age profiles of search activity, job‐finding rates, wages, and savings. We use the model to analyze the impact of tax and transfer policies for labor market dynamics and aggregate economic activity via capital, employment, and labor efficiency channels. Lower unemployment benefits and a less progressive tax schedule bring about welfare losses for a newborn worker which are mainly driven by higher consumption risk and costlier search effort; both policies have differential effects along the age, income, and wealth dimensions.
doi:10.3982/ecta22542.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个宏观经济学模型，该模型将不完全市场的世代交叠经济与包含序贯工资谈判、就业与非就业工人内生搜寻努力以及匹配质量差异的工作阶梯相结合。基于这些要素，我们的模型为总生产中的三个主要投入——资本、就业和劳动效率——提供了统一的微观基础。校准后的模型较好地拟合了搜寻活动、工作找到率、工资和储蓄的年龄分布经验特征。我们利用该模型分析税收与转移支付政策通过资本、就业和劳动效率渠道对劳动力市场动态及总体经济活动的影响。降低失业救济金和减少税收累进性会给新生工人带来福利损失，这主要源于更高的消费风险和更昂贵的搜寻努力；这两种政策在年龄、收入和财富维度上具有差异化效应。
doi:10.3982/ecta22542.title: Job Ladder and Wealth Dynamics in General Equilibrium
doi:10.3982/ecta22542.title_zh: 一般均衡中的职业阶梯与财富动态

doi:10.3982/ecta22979.abstract: The U.S. Supreme Court's 2010 decision in Citizens United v. Federal Election Commission deregulated campaign finance, enabling the rise of a new political action committee (the Super PAC) with broad freedom to raise and spend money. This led to an unprecedented surge in spending in primary and general elections. To evaluate the impact of Super PACs, I estimate a multistage model of political competition using data from U.S. Congressional elections between 2010 and 2020. I find that Super PAC spending by both sides prompts offsetting responses, resulting in limited net equilibrium effects. However, by amplifying the role of donors, Super PACs still have the potential to reshape the electoral landscape.
doi:10.3982/ecta22979.abstract_zh: 美国最高法院2010年就"联合公民诉联邦选举委员会案"作出的裁决放松了对竞选资金的监管，催生了一种新型政治行动委员会（超级政治行动委员会），使其在筹款和支出方面拥有广泛自由。这导致初选和大选中的支出出现前所未有的激增。为评估超级政治行动委员会的影响，我利用2010年至2020年美国国会选举数据，估计了一个多阶段政治竞争模型。研究发现，双方超级政治行动委员会的支出会引发对冲性反应，导致均衡效应有限。然而，通过放大捐赠者的作用，超级政治行动委员会仍有可能重塑选举格局。
doi:10.3982/ecta22979.title: The Equilibrium Effects of Campaign Finance Deregulation on U.S. Elections
doi:10.3982/ecta22979.title_zh: 竞选财务放松管制对美国选举的均衡效应

doi:10.3982/ecta23049.abstract: We consider a dynamic buyer–seller interaction. Instead of the buyer's valuation, it is the frequency with which he needs to trade that is the buyer's private information. The difference matters. With commitment, full surplus extraction is possible, for instance via limited‐time offers. Without commitment, ratcheting is mitigated, as not buying is not necessarily a sign of strength. Because time is informative, the seller learns and may adjust her behavior over time. When finding a suitable alternative seller is easy, she starts with a pooling offer before permanently switching to a screening offer. When finding a suitable alternative seller takes time, she starts with a pooling offer before occasionally experimenting with separating offers.
doi:10.3982/ecta23049.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种动态的买卖双方互动关系。与买方估值不同，买方需要交易的频率才是其私人信息。这一差异至关重要。在有承诺的情况下，完全剩余提取是可能的，例如通过限时报价。在没有承诺的情况下，棘轮效应得到缓解，因为不购买并不一定意味着买方处于强势地位。由于时间具有信息价值，卖方会随着时间推移学习并可能调整其行为。当寻找合适的替代卖方较为容易时，她会先提出混合报价，然后永久转向筛选报价。当寻找合适的替代卖方需要时间时，她会先提出混合报价，然后偶尔尝试分离报价。
doi:10.3982/ecta23049.title: Dynamic Screening of Buyers With Heterogeneous Purchase Frequency
doi:10.3982/ecta23049.title_zh: 异质性购买频率下买家的动态筛选

doi:10.3982/ecta23174.abstract: We study instrumental variables models characterized by: (i) Unobserved heterogeneity consisting of potential outcomes and response types that describe how the instrument determines treatment choice; (ii) Conditional independence of the instrument and the unobserved heterogeneity; and (iii) Convex restrictions on the distribution of unobserved heterogeneity. We show certain causal parameters are identified in these models if and only if a version of the kappa of Abadie (2003) exists. Our identification results are constructive in yielding estimating moment conditions. Focusing on a leading special case, we develop asymptotically normal estimators based on a doubly robust version of these moment conditions.
doi:10.3982/ecta23174.abstract_zh: 我们研究具有以下特征的工具变量模型：（i）未观测异质性由潜在结果和描述工具如何决定处理选择的响应类型构成；（ii）工具与未观测异质性条件独立；（iii）未观测异质性分布满足凸性约束。我们证明，当且仅当Abadie（2003）的kappa统计量存在时，这些模型中的某些因果参数可被识别。我们的识别结果是建设性的，能够导出估计矩条件。聚焦于一个主要特例，我们基于这些矩条件的双重稳健版本开发了渐近正态估计量。
doi:10.3982/ecta23174.title: Identification in Instrumental Variables Models: The Central Role of Abadie's Kappa
doi:10.3982/ecta23174.title_zh: 工具变量模型中的识别：Abadie's Kappa的核心作用

doi:10.3982/ecta23334.abstract: Evidence from the laboratory and the field has uncovered both underreaction and overreaction to new information. We provide new experimental evidence on the underlying mechanisms of under‐ and overreaction by comparing how people make inferences and revise forecasts in the same information environment. Participants underreact to signals when inferring about underlying states, but overreact to the same signals when revising forecasts about future outcomes—a phenomenon we term “the inference‐forecast gap.” We show that this gap is largely driven by different simplifying heuristics used in the two tasks. Additional treatments suggest that the choice of heuristics is affected by the similarity between statistics in the information environment and the statistic elicited by the belief‐updating problem.
doi:10.3982/ecta23334.abstract_zh: 来自实验室和现场的证据揭示了人们对新信息既存在反应不足也存在反应过度。我们通过比较人们在相同信息环境下如何进行推断和修正预测，提供了关于反应不足与反应过度内在机制的新实验证据。参与者在推断潜在状态时对信号反应不足，但在修正对未来结果的预测时却对相同信号反应过度——我们将这一现象称为“推断-预测差距”。研究表明，这一差距主要由两项任务中使用的不同简化启发式策略驱动。额外实验处理表明，启发式策略的选择受到信息环境中的统计量与信念更新问题所引发的统计量之间相似性的影响。
doi:10.3982/ecta23334.title: The Inference‐Forecast Gap in Belief Updating
doi:10.3982/ecta23334.title_zh: 信念更新中的推断-预测差距

doi:10.3982/ecta23345.abstract: We consider impulse response inference in a locally misspecified vector autoregression (VAR) model. The conventional local projection (LP) confidence interval has correct coverage even when the misspecification is so large that it can be detected with probability approaching 1. This result follows from a “double robustness” property analogous to that of popular partially linear regression estimators. By contrast, the conventional VAR confidence interval with short‐to‐moderate lag length can severely undercover for misspecification that is small, difficult to detect statistically, and cannot be ruled out based on economic theory. The VAR confidence interval has robust coverage if, and only if, the lag length is so large that the interval is as wide as the LP interval.
doi:10.3982/ecta23345.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在局部误设定的向量自回归（VAR）模型中脉冲响应推断的问题。传统的局部投影（LP）置信区间即使在误设定程度大到能以趋近于1的概率被检测到时，仍能保持正确的覆盖率。这一结果源于一种与流行的部分线性回归估计量相似的“双重稳健性”性质。相比之下，采用短至中等滞后长度的传统VAR置信区间，在面对较小、难以从统计上检测且无法基于经济理论排除的误设定时，可能严重低估覆盖率。VAR置信区间只有在滞后长度足够大，使其区间宽度与LP区间相当时，才具有稳健的覆盖率。
doi:10.3982/ecta23345.title: Double Robustness of Local Projections and Some Unpleasant VARithmetic
doi:10.3982/ecta23345.title_zh: 局部投影的双重稳健性与一些令人不快的VAR算术

doi:10.3982/ecta23358.abstract: Unlike gender or race, class background is rarely a focus of research on career progression, or of DEI efforts in elite occupations. Should it be? In this paper, we document a large class gap in career progression in one occupation—U.S. tenure‐track academia—using parental education to proxy for class background. First‐generation college graduates are 10% less likely to be tenured at an R1, are tenured at institutions ranked 11% lower, earn 3% less, and report 5% lower job satisfaction, than their former PhD classmates (from the same institution and field) with a parent with a non‐PhD graduate degree. Neither selection out of academia nor different preferences explain this gap; differential research productivity also plays little role. Instead, likely drivers are differences in cultural and social capital. We also find a class gap in career progression for PhDs who work in industry, suggesting this phenomenon generalizes outside academia.
doi:10.3982/ecta23358.abstract_zh: 与性别或种族不同，阶级背景很少成为职业发展研究或精英职业领域多元化、公平与包容（DEI）举措的关注焦点。那么，它是否应该被重视？本文以美国终身教职制学术界这一职业为例，利用父母教育程度作为阶级背景的代理变量，揭示了职业发展中的显著阶级差距。与父母拥有非博士研究生学位的同届博士同学（来自同一院校和领域）相比，第一代大学毕业生在R1研究型大学获得终身教职的可能性低10%，其任职院校排名低11%，收入少3%，且工作满意度低5%。这一差距既非源于学术界的选择性退出，也非偏好差异所致；研究生产力的差异同样作用甚微。相反，文化资本和社会资本的差异是可能的驱动因素。此外，我们发现在产业界工作的博士群体中也存在职业发展的阶级差距，这表明该现象具有超越学术界的普遍性。
doi:10.3982/ecta23358.title: The Class Gap in Career Progression: Evidence From U.S. Academia
doi:10.3982/ecta23358.title_zh: 职业晋升中的阶级差距：来自美国学术界的证据

doi:10.3982/qe2385.abstract: We study the binary choice problem in a data‐rich environment with asymmetric loss functions. The econometrics literature covers nonparametric binary choice problems but does not offer computationally attractive solutions in data‐rich environments. The machine learning literature has many algorithms but is focused mostly on loss functions that are independent of covariates. We show that theoretically valid decisions on binary outcomes with general loss functions can be achieved via a very simple loss‐based reweighting of logistic regression or state‐of‐the‐art machine learning techniques. We apply our analysis to algorithmic fairness in pretrial detentions.
doi:10.3982/qe2385.abstract_zh: 我们研究在数据丰富环境下具有非对称损失函数的二元选择问题。计量经济学文献涵盖了非参数二元选择问题，但未提供在数据丰富环境中具有计算吸引力的解决方案。机器学习文献包含许多算法，但主要关注与协变量无关的损失函数。我们证明，通过基于损失的简单重新加权逻辑回归或最先进的机器学习技术，可以在一般损失函数下实现对二元结果的理论有效决策。我们将分析应用于审前羁押中的算法公平性。
doi:10.3982/qe2385.title: Binary choice under asymmetric loss in a data‐rich environment: Theory and an application to algorithmic fairness
doi:10.3982/qe2385.title_zh: 数据丰富环境下非对称损失下的二元选择：理论与算法公平性应用

doi:10.3982/qe2442.abstract: Using a heterogeneous agent model calibrated to match spending dynamics over four years following an income shock (Fagereng, Holm, and Natvik (2021)), we assess the effectiveness of three fiscal stimulus policies implemented during recent recessions. Unemployment insurance (UI) extensions are the “bang for the buck” winner when the metric is effectiveness in boosting utility. Stimulus checks are second‐best and have two advantages (over UI): they arrive faster, and are scalable. A temporary (two‐year) cut in wage taxation is considerably less effective than the other policies and has negligible effects in the version of our model without a multiplier.
doi:10.3982/qe2442.abstract_zh: 基于一个异质性主体模型（该模型校准后能复现收入冲击后四年内的支出动态，参见Fagereng, Holm, and Natvik (2021)），我们评估了近期经济衰退期间实施的三项财政刺激政策的有效性。以提升效用的有效性为衡量标准，失业保险（UI）延期是“性价比”最高的政策。刺激性支票次之，并具有两大优势（相对于失业保险）：到账更快且具有可扩展性。临时性（两年期）工资税削减的效果远不及其他政策，且在我们模型的无乘数版本中，其影响微乎其微。
doi:10.3982/qe2442.title: Welfare and spending effects of consumption stimulus policies
doi:10.3982/qe2442.title_zh: 消费刺激政策的福利与支出效应

doi:10.3982/qe2529.abstract: Large VARs are increasingly used in structural analysis as a unified framework to study the impacts of multiple structural shocks simultaneously. However, the concurrent identification of multiple shocks using sign and ranking restrictions poses significant practical challenges to the point where existing algorithms cannot be used with such large VARs. To address this, we introduce a new numerically efficient algorithm that facilitates the estimation of impulse responses and related measures in large structural VARs identified with a large number of structural restrictions on impulse responses. The methodology is illustrated using a 35‐variable VAR with over 100 sign and ranking restrictions to identify 8 structural shocks.
doi:10.3982/qe2529.abstract_zh: 大型VAR模型越来越多地被用于结构分析，作为同时研究多种结构性冲击影响的统一框架。然而，利用符号约束和排序约束同时识别多种冲击，在实际操作中面临重大挑战，以至于现有算法无法应用于此类大型VAR模型。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新的数值高效算法，该算法有助于在大型结构VAR模型中估计脉冲响应及相关指标，这些模型通过大量关于脉冲响应的结构性约束进行识别。该方法通过一个包含35个变量、超过100个符号约束和排序约束的VAR模型进行说明，用于识别8种结构性冲击。
doi:10.3982/qe2529.title: Large structural VARs with multiple sign and ranking restrictions
doi:10.3982/qe2529.title_zh: 具有多重符号与排序约束的大型结构向量自回归模型

doi:10.3982/qe2638.abstract: In density forecasts, respondents are asked to assign probabilities to a response scale with pre‐specified ranges of inflation. In two large‐scale experiments, one conducted in the US and one in Germany, we show how the specifics of the response scale determine the results: Shifting, compressing, or expanding the scale leads to shifted, compressed, and expanded forecasts. Quantifying this effect using the scale most widely used among central banks, we find that mean forecast, uncertainty, and disagreement can vary by several percentage points. Density forecasts may severely misestimate the “true” inflation expectations, and may generate spurious changes in reported inflation uncertainty. The analysis suggests several ways to reduce this bias.
doi:10.3982/qe2638.abstract_zh: 在密度预测中，受访者需将概率分配给具有预设通胀区间的响应量表。通过在美国和德国开展的两项大规模实验，我们展示了响应量表的具体特征如何决定预测结果：移动、压缩或扩展量表会导致预测值相应移动、压缩或扩展。采用央行最广泛使用的量表量化这一效应后，我们发现平均预测值、不确定性和分歧程度可能相差数个百分点。密度预测可能严重误估"真实"通胀预期，并导致报告的通胀不确定性出现虚假变化。分析表明，可通过多种方式减少这一偏差。
doi:10.3982/qe2638.title: Measuring inflation expectations: How the response scale shapes density forecasts
doi:10.3982/qe2638.title_zh: 衡量通胀预期：响应量表如何塑造密度预测

doi:10.3982/qe2674.abstract: Seasonal migration is a common strategy to mitigate rural seasonal deprivation, but migrants need to remit money during the lean season to family members facing food shortages. We observe counterintuitively low remittances in rural Nepal during periods of seasonal hunger, and migrants return with remittances later during harvest when food is relatively abundant. To indirectly overcome this apparent constraint in remittance timing, we provide a $90 consumption loan to randomly selected rural households during the pre‐harvest lean season. Loan‐recipient households increase pre‐harvest investments in fertilizer and time spent working on their own farm, smooth consumption, and save more of their migration income to bring it back home. Food security, subjective well‐being, rice harvest, and revenues improve. Ninety‐eight percent of beneficiaries repay the loan with the increased harvest‐period remittance. In a two‐period model of household decision making, we show that remittance frictions—a market failure—are necessary to qualitatively match our experimental results.
doi:10.3982/qe2674.abstract_zh: 季节性迁移是缓解农村季节性匮乏的常见策略，但迁移者需在食物短缺的淡季向家人汇款。我们在尼泊尔农村观察到，在季节性饥饿期间汇款额异常低，而迁移者往往在收获季节食物相对充裕时才携带汇款返乡。为间接克服这一汇款时间上的明显约束，我们在收获前淡季向随机选取的农村家庭提供90美元消费贷款。获得贷款的家庭增加了淡季的化肥投资和自有农场劳动时间，平滑了消费，并将更多迁移收入储蓄后带回。粮食安全、主观幸福感、稻谷收成和收入均得到改善。98%的受益者用增加的收获期汇款偿还贷款。在家庭决策的两期模型中，我们证明汇款摩擦（一种市场失灵）是定性匹配实验结果所必需的。
doi:10.3982/qe2674.title: Remittance frictions and seasonal poverty
doi:10.3982/qe2674.title_zh: 汇款摩擦与季节性贫困

doi:10.3982/qe2681.abstract: An easy‐to‐interpret rule for the optimal risk‐adjusted social cost of carbon is derived using perturbation analysis. This rule internalizes the adverse effects of global warming on the risk of recurring climate‐related disasters, the risk of irreversible cascading climate tipping points, and the usual effect on total factor productivity. It and its three components approximate the true numerical optimum well, especially if the small parameters (i.e., the share of damages in GDP, the sensitivity of the risk of disasters to temperature and the risk of climate tipping) are small enough and the discount rate is not too small. The rule is also accurate if applied to AK models with a different supply side, for example, with ongoing technical progress in fossil‐fuel production or multiple economic sectors. With a growth‐adjusted discount rate of 2%/year, the SCC is $172/tCO 2 , 70% of which is due to recurring climate disasters and 9% to climate tipping risk.
doi:10.3982/qe2681.abstract_zh: 本文通过扰动分析推导出一个易于解释的最优风险调整社会碳成本规则。该规则内化了全球变暖对气候相关灾害复发风险、不可逆级联气候临界点风险以及对全要素生产率的常规影响。该规则及其三个组成部分能够很好地逼近真实数值最优解，尤其是当小参数（即损害占GDP的比重、灾害风险对温度的敏感度以及气候临界点风险）足够小且贴现率不太低时。该规则同样适用于供给侧不同的AK模型，例如化石燃料生产持续技术进步或多经济部门模型。在增长调整贴现率为每年2%的情况下，社会碳成本为172美元/吨二氧化碳，其中70%源于气候灾害复发风险，9%源于气候临界点风险。
doi:10.3982/qe2681.title: Three reasons to price carbon under uncertainty: Accuracy of simple rules
doi:10.3982/qe2681.title_zh: 不确定性下碳定价的三个理由：简单规则的准确性

doi:10.3982/qe2719.abstract: We provide a complete description of the set of all solutions to a vector autoregressive law of motion. Every solution is shown to be the sum of three components, each corresponding to a directed flow of time. One component flows forward from the arbitrarily distant past, one flows backward from the arbitrarily distant future, and one flows outward from time zero. The three components are obtained by applying three complementary spectral projections to the solution, these corresponding to a separation of the eigenvalues of the autoregressive coefficient matrix according to whether they are inside, outside, or on the unit circle. We establish a one‐to‐one correspondence between the set of all solutions and a finite‐dimensional space of initial conditions.
doi:10.3982/qe2719.abstract_zh: 我们完整描述了向量自回归运动方程所有解集的构成。每个解均可分解为三个分量之和，分别对应三种定向时间流：一个分量从任意遥远的过去向前流动，一个分量从任意遥远的未来向后流动，一个分量从零时刻向外流动。这三个分量通过将三种互补谱投影应用于解而获得，其依据是自回归系数矩阵的特征值是否位于单位圆内、外或圆上。我们建立了所有解集与有限维初始条件空间之间的一一对应关系。
doi:10.3982/qe2719.title: The general solution to an autoregressive law of motion
doi:10.3982/qe2719.title_zh: 自回归运动定律的通解

doi:10.3982/qe2768.abstract: The theory of infinitely repeated games may lack predictive power due to its insensitivity to, for example, changes in some game parameters, the timing of players' moves, and communication possibilities. We propose a new approach by studying an infinitely repeated prisoner's dilemma game and its variants where preferences for cooperation are heterogeneous, and strategic risk arises from incomplete information about opponents' preferences. Our model generates a rich set of comparative static predictions in a variety of settings. We show that, unlike standard theory and other existing models, our approach organizes the findings of a host of experiments including our novel experiments.
doi:10.3982/qe2768.abstract_zh: 无限重复博弈理论可能因对某些博弈参数变化、玩家行动时机及沟通可能性等因素不敏感而缺乏预测力。我们通过研究无限重复囚徒困境博弈及其变体提出新方法，其中合作偏好存在异质性，且战略风险源于对手偏好的不完全信息。我们的模型在多种情境下生成丰富的比较静态预测。研究表明，与标准理论及其他现有模型不同，我们的方法系统性地解释了包括我们新实验在内的一系列实验结果。
doi:10.3982/qe2768.title: A new approach to the analysis of cooperation under the shadow of the future: Theory and experimental evidence
doi:10.3982/qe2768.title_zh: 未来阴影下合作分析的新方法：理论与实验证据

doi:10.3982/te6170.abstract: We study the welfare effects of ambiguous product information for a buyer with α ‐max‐min preferences and a price‐setting seller. The buyer privately receives information about her valuation. We show that both the seller and the buyer can benefit when this information is ambiguous, and we characterize all possible combinations of producer and consumer surplus, as evaluated under ambiguity‐sensitive preferences. Ambiguity concerning the valuation perceived by the buyer when making the purchase decision can induce the seller to change the price. Before receiving information, ambiguity concerning the purchase decision can make the buyer optimistic about buying only for high valuations, which relaxes the participation constraint.
doi:10.3982/te6170.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有α-最大最小偏好的买方与定价卖方之间，模糊产品信息对福利的影响。买方私下获取关于其估值的信号。研究表明，当该信息具有模糊性时，买卖双方均可能获益，并刻画了在模糊敏感偏好下评估的所有可能的生产者剩余与消费者剩余组合。买方在做出购买决策时所感知的估值模糊性，可能促使卖方调整价格。在获取信息之前，购买决策的模糊性可能使买方对仅在高估值时购买持乐观态度，从而放宽了参与约束。
doi:10.3982/te6170.title: Benefits and challenges of ambiguous product information
doi:10.3982/te6170.title_zh: 模糊产品信息的益处与挑战

doi:10.3982/te6187.abstract: In the context of Krugman's (1979) canonical new trade model, we demonstrate that a country is better off in autarky than in free and costless trade when the productivity of its trading partner is sufficiently low.
doi:10.3982/te6187.abstract_zh: 在克鲁格曼（1979）经典新贸易模型的框架下，我们证明：当贸易伙伴的生产率足够低时，一国在自给自足状态下的福利水平优于无成本自由贸易。
doi:10.3982/te6187.title: When autarky trumps free and costless trade
doi:10.3982/te6187.title_zh: 当自给自足胜过自由且零成本的贸易

doi:10.3982/te6224.abstract: Nonpartisan voters can become polarized not because of ideology but because it is optimal for them to remain uninformed and cancel out the votes of uninformed voters on “the other side.” Indeed, when stuck in such a state of polarization, it is socially optimal to do so. Dynamics can lead an otherwise well‐functioning assembly into irreversible polarization. Reputation effects might only make things worse.
doi:10.3982/te6224.abstract_zh: 无党派选民可能走向极化，并非源于意识形态，而是因为保持信息闭塞、抵消“对立阵营”中信息闭塞选民的选票对其而言是最优选择。事实上，当陷入这种极化状态时，从社会整体来看，这样做也是最优的。动态过程可能使原本运作良好的议会陷入不可逆转的极化。声誉效应可能只会让情况雪上加霜。
doi:10.3982/te6224.title: Ruth, Anthony, and Clarence

doi:10.3982/te6338.abstract: I study the impact of consumer reviews on the incentives for firms to participate in the market. I develop a model of endogenous entry in which firms produce goods of heterogeneous, unknown quality. Consumers engage in directed search, and prices are exogenously fixed. A rater uses consumer reviews to construct firm‐specific ratings that are informative of quality and help consumers direct their search. The main insight of the paper is that suppressing the reviews of highly‐rated firms strengthens entry incentives and improves consumer welfare.
doi:10.3982/te6338.abstract_zh: 本文研究了消费者评价对企业参与市场激励的影响。我构建了一个内生进入模型，其中企业生产异质性且质量未知的商品。消费者进行定向搜索，价格外生给定。评分者利用消费者评价构建企业特定评分，这些评分能反映质量信息并帮助消费者引导搜索。本文的主要发现是：抑制高评分企业的评价会增强企业进入市场的激励，并提升消费者福利。
doi:10.3982/te6338.title: Ratings design and barriers to entry

doi:10.3982/te6424.abstract: We present a model in which news media shape beliefs by providing information (signals about an exogenous state) and narratives (models of what determines outcomes). To amplify consumers' engagement, the media maximize their anticipatory utility. We characterize the optimal monopolistic media strategy, highlighting the synergy between false narratives and biased information. Consumer heterogeneity gives rise to a novel menu‐design problem due to an “equilibrium data externality” among consumers. The optimal menu includes false narratives, and can generate polarized beliefs and choices without any information transmission. False narratives and polarization also feature in a competitive version of our model, albeit coupled with complete information. Nevertheless, competition can make some consumers objectively worse off.
doi:10.3982/te6424.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，其中新闻媒体通过提供信息（关于外生状态的信号）和叙事（解释结果决定因素的模型）来塑造信念。为提升消费者参与度，媒体最大化其预期效用。我们刻画了最优垄断媒体策略，揭示了虚假叙事与有偏信息之间的协同效应。消费者异质性引致了一个新颖的菜单设计问题，其根源在于消费者间的“均衡数据外部性”。最优菜单包含虚假叙事，且能在无任何信息传递的情况下催生极化信念与选择。在竞争性版本模型中，尽管伴随完全信息，虚假叙事与极化现象依然存在。然而，竞争可能使部分消费者的客观福利恶化。
doi:10.3982/te6424.title: News media as suppliers of narratives (and information)
doi:10.3982/te6424.title_zh: 新闻媒体作为叙事（及信息）的提供者

doi:10.3982/te6439.abstract: A decision‐maker faces uncertainty governed by a data‐generating process (DGP), which is only known to belong to a set of sequences of independent but possibly non‐identical distributions. A robust decision maximizes the expected payoff against the worst possible DGP in this set. This paper characterizes when and how such robust decisions can be objectively improved with data; that is, can yield higher expected payoffs under the true DGP regardless of which DGP is the truth. It further develops simple and novel inference procedures that achieve such improvement, while common methods (e.g., maximum likelihood) may fail to do so.
doi:10.3982/te6439.abstract_zh: 决策者面临由数据生成过程（DGP）主导的不确定性，该过程仅已知属于一组独立但可能非同分布序列的集合。稳健决策旨在最大化该集合中最差可能DGP下的期望收益。本文刻画了何时以及如何利用数据实现此类稳健决策的**客观**改进——即无论真实DGP为何，均能在真实DGP下获得更高的期望收益。本文进一步开发了实现此类改进的简洁新颖推断程序，而常见方法（如极大似然法）可能无法达成此目标。
doi:10.3982/te6439.title: Improving robust decisions with data
doi:10.3982/te6439.title_zh: 利用数据改进稳健决策

doi:10.3982/te6479.abstract: This paper compares digital and physical currency, focusing on a single intrinsic difference: digital, unlike physical currency, allows the monetary authority to trace the monetary flows in and out of the accounts. We show that this technological advance in recordkeeping can be used by the monetary authority to improve upon physical currency and achieve efficiency in a wide range of circumstances.
doi:10.3982/te6479.abstract_zh: 本文比较了数字货币与实物货币，聚焦于一个本质区别：与实物货币不同，数字货币使货币当局能够追踪账户中的资金流入与流出。我们证明，货币当局可利用这一记账技术的进步，在实物货币基础上实现改进，并在广泛情境下达到效率最优。
doi:10.3982/te6479.title: Physical versus digital currency A difference that makes a difference
doi:10.3982/te6479.title_zh: 实物货币与数字货币：一种产生差异的差异

doi:10.3982/te6567.abstract: We investigate the management of information provision to maximize user engagement. A principal sequentially reveals signals to an agent who has a limited amount of information processing capacity and can choose to exit at any time. We identify a “dilution” strategy—sending rare but highly informative signals—that maximizes user engagement. The platform's engagement metric shapes the direction and magnitude of biases in provided information relative to a user‐optimal benchmark. Even without intertemporal commitment, the platform replicates full‐commitment revenue by inducing the user's belief to remain “as uncertain as” the prior until the rare, decisive signal arrives and induces stopping. We apply our results to two contexts: an ad‐supported internet media platform and a teacher attempting to engage test‐motivated students.
doi:10.3982/te6567.abstract_zh: 我们研究了信息提供管理以最大化用户参与度的问题。一位委托人向具有有限信息处理能力且可随时选择退出的代理人顺序揭示信号。我们识别出一种“稀释”策略——发送罕见但信息量大的信号——以最大化用户参与度。平台的参与度指标决定了所提供信息相对于用户最优基准的偏差方向和幅度。即使没有跨期承诺，平台也能通过使用户信念保持“与先验一样不确定”，直到罕见的关键信号到来并引发停止，从而复制完全承诺下的收益。我们将研究结果应用于两个场景：一个广告支持的互联网媒体平台，以及一位试图吸引考试驱动型学生的教师。
doi:10.3982/te6567.title: Engagement maximization

doi:10.3982/te6575.abstract: This paper develops a general theory to recover the inverse welfare function that rationalizes a given tax schedule as optimal. Our theory allows for complex environments including the presence of multidimensional tax schedules, bunching/jumping behavior, optimization frictions, general equilibrium effects, and externalities. We show that inverse welfare functions can be used to test for Pareto efficiency, construct Pareto improving reforms, and characterize the set of welfare improving local reforms, thereby extending previous results to more general environments. We show numerically that allowing for such generalities can have meaningful impacts on inverse welfare functions.
doi:10.3982/te6575.abstract_zh: 本文发展了一个一般性理论，用于恢复将给定税收计划视为最优的逆福利函数。该理论适用于复杂环境，包括多维税收计划的存在、聚集/跳跃行为、优化摩擦、一般均衡效应以及外部性。我们证明，逆福利函数可用于检验帕累托效率、构建帕累托改进改革，并刻画福利改进局部改革的集合，从而将先前的研究结果扩展到更一般的环境中。数值分析表明，考虑这些一般性因素会对逆福利函数产生显著影响。
doi:10.3982/te6575.title: A general theory of inverse welfare functions
doi:10.3982/te6575.title_zh: 逆福利函数的一般理论

doi:10.3982/te6786.abstract: We study markets where heterogeneous agents first make investment decisions and then engage in a costly search to form productive matches. The trading process is a random search and bargaining with explicit search costs. Despite potential hold‐up and matching problems, we prove that the constrained efficient allocation is an equilibrium: the agents' private incentives to invest and to accept/reject potential partners as they search are perfectly aligned with the social benefit. Furthermore, we establish a new sorting result for two‐sided markets, equilibrium existence, and conditions for uniqueness.
doi:10.3982/te6786.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个市场，其中异质性主体首先进行投资决策，随后通过成本高昂的搜索来形成生产性匹配。交易过程涉及随机搜索和带有明确搜索成本的讨价还价。尽管存在潜在的敲竹杠和匹配问题，我们证明了受约束的有效配置是一种均衡：主体在投资以及搜索过程中接受或拒绝潜在合作伙伴时的私人激励与社会福利完全一致。此外，我们为双边市场建立了一个新的分类结果，证明了均衡的存在性，并给出了唯一性的条件。
doi:10.3982/te6786.title: Efficient investment, search, and sorting in matching markets
doi:10.3982/te6786.title_zh: 匹配市场中的有效投资、搜寻与分类

doi:10.3982/te6816.abstract: We compare the degree of coalitional manipulability across stable school‐choice mechanisms. Although no stable mechanism is group strategy‐proof for all school choice contexts, we show that the student‐optimal stable mechanism is the least manipulable by coalitions, whereas the school‐optimal stable mechanism is the most coalitionally manipulable. These results still hold when students can only report truncated preferences, when the set of coalitions is limited, or when schools cannot be declared unacceptable as long as there are more available seats than students. In contrast, if there is a shortage of seats and students have no outside options, the school‐optimal stable mechanism can be less manipulable by coalitions than the student‐optimal stable mechanism.
doi:10.3982/te6816.abstract_zh: 我们比较了不同稳定择校机制在联盟操纵性上的差异。尽管没有任何稳定机制在所有择校情境下都满足群体策略防操纵性，但我们发现：学生最优稳定机制是联盟操纵性最低的机制，而学校最优稳定机制则是联盟操纵性最高的机制。即使学生只能报告截断偏好、联盟集合受到限制，或当可用学额多于学生数时学校不能被声明为不可接受，这些结论依然成立。相反，若学额短缺且学生没有外部选择，学校最优稳定机制可能比学生最优稳定机制具有更低的联盟操纵性。
doi:10.3982/te6816.title: Coalitional manipulability in school choice
doi:10.3982/te6816.title_zh: 学校选择中的联盟可操纵性

doi:10.56347/jle.v5i1.421.abstract: The global expansion of the halal industry has placed considerable pressure on food supply chains, particularly among small and medium enterprises (SMEs) in West Java's food sector. This research examines the interplay between halal operations management practices and supply chain integration to determine their combined effects on logistics performance, addressing persistent gaps in halal logistics efficiency. A quantitative approach employing partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) analyzes survey responses from 186 food SMEs across West Java, treating halal operations management and supply chain integration as key independent constructs, with logistics performance as the dependent variable; mediation effects were tested through bootstrapping procedures. Halal operations management significantly improves logistics performance, while supply chain integration fully mediates this relationship — West Java SMEs show measurable gains in on-time delivery and inventory efficiency when halal practices are structurally aligned with supply chain coordination. The cross-sectional design limits causal inference, and findings may not generalize beyond food SMEs in West Java; future research should examine longitudinal effects and multi-sector applications across Indonesia. This study is among the first to connect halal operations management with supply chain integration in explaining logistics performance among Indonesian SMEs, addressing theoretical gaps between Islamic business practices and modern supply chain theory while offering a practical framework for West Java's halal sector development.
doi:10.56347/jle.v5i1.421.abstract_zh: 全球清真产业的扩张对食品供应链造成了显著压力，尤其是对西爪哇食品行业的中小企业（SMEs）而言。本研究探讨了清真运营管理实践与供应链整合之间的相互作用，以确定其对物流绩效的综合影响，从而解决清真物流效率中持续存在的空白。采用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）的定量方法，分析了来自西爪哇186家食品中小企业的调查数据，将清真运营管理和供应链整合作为关键自变量，物流绩效作为因变量；通过自助法程序检验中介效应。清真运营管理显著提升了物流绩效，而供应链整合完全中介了这一关系——当清真实践与供应链协调在结构上保持一致时，西爪哇中小企业在准时交付和库存效率方面表现出可衡量的改善。横截面设计限制了因果推断，研究结果可能无法推广至西爪哇以外的食品中小企业；未来研究应考察纵向效应及印度尼西亚多行业应用。本研究首次将清真运营管理与供应链整合联系起来，以解释印度尼西亚中小企业的物流绩效，填补了伊斯兰商业实践与现代供应链理论之间的理论空白，同时为西爪哇清真产业发展提供了实用框架。
authors: Ajeung Syilva Syara Noor Silmi Sudrajat
doi:10.56347/jle.v5i1.421.title: The Interplay of Halal Operations Management and Supply Chain Integration on Logistics Performance in West Java's SMEs
doi:10.56347/jle.v5i1.421.title_zh: 西爪哇中小企业中清真运营管理与供应链整合对物流绩效的交互作用

doi:10.56347/jle.v5i1.424.abstract: E-commerce purchasing behavior among Generation Z warrants serious scholarly attention — this cohort constitutes the largest segment of active digital users whose decision-making processes are shaped in ways older consumer models do not adequately capture. This study examined the influence of social media, marketing communications, and customer reviews on e-commerce purchasing decisions in Medan City, focusing on Generation Z students at several private universities. A quantitative survey design was employed, with data collected via structured questionnaires distributed to 100 respondents and analyzed using SPSS 26, encompassing validity and reliability tests, classical assumption tests, multiple linear regression, t-tests, F-tests, and coefficient of determination. Each independent variable returned a positive and statistically significant effect on purchasing decisions. The simultaneous test confirmed that the three variables together exert a positive and significant influence on e-commerce purchasing decisions in Medan City. The Adjusted R Square of 0.417 indicates that 41.7% of the variance is accounted for by the model; the remaining 58.3% reflects variables outside the model's scope, including on-time delivery and discount practices.
doi:10.56347/jle.v5i1.424.abstract_zh: Z世代群体的电子商务购买行为值得学界严肃关注——这一群体构成活跃数字用户的最大组成部分，其决策过程受到的影响是传统消费者模型无法充分捕捉的。本研究考察了社交媒体、营销传播和客户评价对棉兰市电子商务购买决策的影响，重点关注该市几所私立大学的Z世代学生。采用定量调查设计，通过结构化问卷向100名受访者收集数据，并运用SPSS 26进行分析，包括效度和信度检验、经典假设检验、多元线性回归、t检验、F检验和决定系数检验。每个自变量对购买决策均呈现正向且统计显著的影响。联合检验证实，三个变量共同对棉兰市电子商务购买决策产生正向且显著的影响。调整后的R平方值为0.417，表明模型解释了41.7%的方差；剩余58.3%反映模型范围之外的变量，包括准时配送和折扣实践。
doi:10.56347/jle.v5i1.424.title: The Effect of Social Media, Marketing Communication, and Customer Reviews on Purchasing Decisions in E-Commerce among Generation Z Students in Medan City
doi:10.56347/jle.v5i1.424.title_zh: 社交媒体、营销沟通与顾客评价对棉兰市Z世代学生电子商务购买决策的影响

doi:10.56347/jle.v5i1.426.abstract: This study examines the role of State Administrative Law in promoting efficiency in the economic sector and social welfare through business licensing regulations. This issue is important because business licensing is not only an instrument of government control but also influences business actor behavior, transaction costs, legal certainty, and market competitiveness. The purpose of this study is to analyze government authority in terms of business licensing regulations and assess the extent of its influence on economic efficiency and public welfare. This study uses a normative juridical method with a statutory regulatory approach and a conceptual approach. Data were collected through a literature review of statutory regulations, state administrative law literature, and legal and economic studies. The analysis was conducted qualitatively by examining the relationship between administrative authority, licensing services, business actor compliance, and their impact on economic activity. The results of this study indicate that simple, transparent, and accountable business licensing can reduce bureaucratic barriers, increase compliance, and create certainty for business actors. Thus, State Administrative Law contributes significantly to building efficient, fair, and social welfare-oriented economic governance.
doi:10.56347/jle.v5i1.426.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨国家行政法在通过商业许可法规促进经济部门效率与社会福利中的作用。该议题的重要性在于，商业许可不仅是政府管控的工具，更影响商业行为主体的决策、交易成本、法律确定性及市场竞争力。本研究旨在分析政府在商业许可法规中的行政权限，并评估其对经济效率与公共福利的影响程度。采用规范性法学研究方法，结合成文法路径与概念分析路径。通过文献综述收集成文法规定、国家行政法文献及法律经济学研究资料，运用定性分析方法考察行政权限、许可服务、商业主体合规性及其对经济活动影响的关联性。研究结果表明，简化、透明且可问责的商业许可制度能够降低官僚壁垒、提升合规水平，并为商业主体创造确定性。因此，国家行政法在构建高效、公平且以社会福利为导向的经济治理体系中发挥着关键作用。
doi:10.56347/jle.v5i1.426.title: Perizinan Berusaha dalam Perspektif Hukum Administrasi Negara dan Ekonomi
doi:10.56347/jle.v5i1.426.title_zh: 行政许可在国家行政法与经济学视角下的研究

doi:10.56347/jle.v5i1.427.abstract: This study examined the understanding and compliance of taxpayers with respect to Value Added Tax (VAT) and Income Tax (PPh) Article 21 in West Java Province. Tax revenue constitutes the primary fiscal base of the Indonesian state, and the country's self-assessment system places the full burden of calculation, payment, and reporting on the taxpayer — making their level of understanding a direct determinant of compliance outcomes. A quantitative survey method was employed, with data gathered through structured questionnaires distributed to individual and corporate taxpayers subject to VAT and/or PPh Article 21 obligations. The findings indicate that taxpayer understanding of VAT and PPh Article 21 regulations does not produce a positive effect on compliance levels, whether measured through reporting behavior or payment conduct. Although overall compliance was relatively adequate, gaps in technical knowledge — particularly in tax administration procedures — remained apparent. Sustained investment in tax education and public outreach is therefore necessary to build more durable compliance patterns across West Java.
doi:10.56347/jle.v5i1.427.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了西爪哇省纳税人对增值税（VAT）和第21条所得税（PPh）的理解与遵从情况。税收收入构成印度尼西亚国家的主要财政基础，而该国实行的自我评估制度将计算、缴纳和申报的全部责任置于纳税人身上——因此，纳税人的理解程度直接决定了其遵从结果。本研究采用定量调查方法，通过结构化问卷向负有增值税和/或第21条所得税义务的个人及企业纳税人收集数据。研究结果表明，纳税人对增值税和第21条所得税法规的理解，无论通过申报行为还是缴纳行为来衡量，均未对遵从水平产生正向影响。尽管总体遵从程度相对充足，但技术知识——尤其是税务管理程序方面的知识——仍存在明显缺口。因此，有必要持续投入税收教育和公众宣传，以在西爪哇省建立更持久的遵从模式。
doi:10.56347/jle.v5i1.427.title: Pemahaman dan Kepatuhan Wajib Pajak terhadap PPN dan PPh Pasal 21 di Jawa Barat

url:001af12f98662d7f.abstract: This paper estimates the economic effects of communal riots in India using a new district-year panel for 1994-2013 that combines extended riot data with nightlights, manufacturing outcomes, infrastructure, and district-level credit. To address endogeneity, we use quasi-random variation generated when major Hindu festivals fall on a Friday (Fridays draw large Muslim congregations for weekly prayers) and construct a spatially weighted instrument for local riot risk. Instrumental variable estimates show that higher riot exposure leads to sizable and persistent economic losses. A one-unit increase in distance-weighted exposure reduces nightlights by about 0.105 log points, implying a GDP decline of roughly 0.45%. We trace several channels, including contractions in firm output and employment, fewer bank branches, less agricultural credit, and a thinner market infrastructure. Using the timing of household surveys relative to riots, we also find that trust in state institutions declines. Together, the results quantify the economic costs of communal riots and identify the mechanisms through which social conflict depresses local economic activity.
url:001af12f98662d7f.abstract_zh: 本文利用1994-2013年印度地区-年份面板数据，将扩展的骚乱数据与夜间灯光、制造业产出、基础设施及地区信贷相结合，评估了社区骚乱的经济影响。为解决内生性问题，我们利用印度主要印度教节日恰逢周五（周五吸引大量穆斯林群体参加每周祈祷）所产生的准随机变异，构建了衡量当地骚乱风险的空间加权工具变量。工具变量估计表明，更高的骚乱暴露度会导致显著且持续的经济损失。距离加权暴露度每增加一个单位，夜间灯光指数下降约0.105个对数点，相当于GDP下降约0.45%。我们追溯了若干传导渠道，包括企业产出与就业收缩、银行网点减少、农业信贷萎缩以及市场基础设施薄弱。通过利用家庭调查相对于骚乱发生的时间节点，我们还发现对国家机构的信任度有所下降。综合来看，这些结果量化了社区骚乱的经济成本，并揭示了社会冲突抑制地方经济活动的机制。

url:00e4b50bdedae2d9.abstract: We analyze consumer surplus when a monopolist can adjust both prices and product qualities across segments, engaging in second- and third-degree price discrimination simultaneously. We characterize the consumer-optimal segmentation and show that it has a striking structure: consumers with the same value receive the same quality in every segment, though prices differ. Under mild conditions, any segmentation harms consumers if and only if demand is sufficiently more elastic than supply. Hence, potential benefits for consumers depend critically on demand and supply elasticities. These findings have implications for regulatory policy regarding price discrimination and market segmentation.
url:00e4b50bdedae2d9.abstract_zh: 本文分析了垄断者在不同细分市场中同时调整价格与产品质量、实施二级与三级价格歧视时的消费者剩余。我们刻画了消费者最优细分结构，并揭示其具有显著特征：在每一细分市场中，具有相同价值的消费者获得相同质量，但价格存在差异。在温和条件下，当且仅当需求弹性显著大于供给弹性时，任何细分都会损害消费者利益。因此，消费者潜在收益关键取决于需求与供给弹性。这些发现对价格歧视与市场细分的监管政策具有启示意义。

url:010436e13b945014.abstract: Through a cluster randomised field trial, we evaluate the impact of an evidence-based, soft skills curriculum aimed at adolescents, referred to as Healthy Minds, that ran in 35 high schools in England over four years (2013/14 – 2017/18). We find supportive evidence that Healthy Minds positively augments the primary outcome of self-reported physical health in the treated adolescents. Treated pupils have global health attainment that is 0.235 standard deviations higher than children in the control group, resulting in a 10-percentile increase in their measured health status. We also find evidence of positive impacts on behaviour. There is no evidence of impacts on improved emotional wellbeing. We note significant gender differences in the effects found, strongly favouring boys. Overall, we provide strong evidence that a designed, taught life skills curriculum can improve related outcomes during the adolescent years, and that differential learning styles across visible aspects of diversity are worthy of consideration Healthy Minds.
url:010436e13b945014.abstract_zh: 通过一项整群随机实地试验，我们评估了一项名为“健康心智”的循证软技能课程对青少年的影响。该课程在英国35所高中开展了四年（2013/14至2017/18学年）。研究发现支持性证据表明，“健康心智”课程积极提升了受试青少年自我报告的身体健康这一主要结果。接受干预的学生整体健康水平比对照组儿童高出0.235个标准差，相当于其测量健康状态提升了10个百分点。我们还发现了该课程对行为产生积极影响的证据，但未发现其对情绪健康改善有显著影响。值得注意的是，研究结果存在显著的性别差异，且明显有利于男生。总体而言，我们提供了强有力的证据，表明设计并教授的生活技能课程能够改善青少年时期的相关结果，同时，在可见的多样性维度上，差异化的学习风格值得在“健康心智”课程中加以考虑。

url:015f250f88327352.abstract: This paper examines how global greenfield foreign direct investment (FDI) flows are evolving amid rising geoeconomic fragmentation. We use difference-in-differences and event study approaches to analyze changes in FDI around key bilateral inflection points. We find a decline in FDI from the US and broader Group of Seven Plus (G7+) into the PRC, concentrated in trade-exposed, efficiency-seeking sectors. Investment diversion—particularly from the PRC to Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) members and Latin America—is evident, but this growth was concentrated in less global value chain (GVC)-integrated activities, suggesting that GVC links may act as a constraint on investment relocation. These findings suggest that while tensions may be reshaping global investment, GVC dependencies are likely limiting firms’ ability to reallocate production at scale, making the “great reallocation” least evident where it was most expected.
url:015f250f88327352.abstract_zh: 本文考察了在地缘经济碎片化加剧的背景下，全球绿地外商直接投资（FDI）流动的演变趋势。我们采用双重差分法和事件研究法，分析关键双边关系转折点前后FDI的变化。研究发现，美国及更广泛的七国集团+（G7+）对中国的FDI有所下降，且主要集中在贸易敏感型、效率寻求型行业。投资转移现象明显——尤其是从中国流向东南亚国家联盟（ASEAN）成员国和拉丁美洲——但这种增长集中于全球价值链（GVC）整合程度较低的活动，表明GVC联系可能对投资重新布局构成制约。这些发现表明，尽管地缘紧张局势可能正在重塑全球投资格局，但GVC依赖关系很可能限制了企业大规模重新配置生产能力，使得“大转移”在最被预期发生的领域反而最不明显。

url:0160c10a0c468d64.abstract: As demand for critical minerals accelerates with the energy transition, artisanal and small-scale mining (ASM) has emerged as a key but poorly understood source of supply. We construct the first continental-scale panel of mining activity in Sub-Saharan Africa by applying supervised deep-learning methods to satellite imagery, identifying over 50,000 mining sites across 39 countries and reconstructing monthly activity from 2000 to 2019. We document three main findings. First, mining location follows strong market-access gradients with pronounced non-linearities: proximity to ports raises mining probability within 200 km, but this premium reverses at intermediate distances and re-emerges only in the most remote areas -- consistent with distance from urban centers proxying for weaker state reach and lower monitoring of informal activity. Second, entry responds rapidly to commodity price shocks, indicating that ASM operates as an elastic margin of mineral supply; over time, however, its relationship with industrial mining shifts from complementarity to a reallocation of artisanal activity away from industrial sites. Third, agricultural shocks induce entry into ASM, but spatial labor mobility attenuates local responses, pointing to strong congestion effects. Together, these results position ASM as a central yet spatially constrained adjustment margin in global critical mineral supply.
url:0160c10a0c468d64.abstract_zh: 随着能源转型加速对关键矿产的需求，手工和小规模采矿（ASM）已成为重要但认知不足的供应来源。我们通过将监督式深度学习方法应用于卫星图像，构建了首个撒哈拉以南非洲大陆尺度的采矿活动面板数据，识别出39个国家的5万多个采矿点，并重建了2000年至2019年的月度活动数据。研究得出三项主要发现：第一，采矿选址遵循显著的非线性市场可达性梯度——靠近港口在200公里范围内提高采矿概率，但这一优势在中等距离处逆转，仅在偏远地区重新显现，这与远离城市中心反映国家管控薄弱、非正规活动监管较少的情况一致。第二，采矿进入对大宗商品价格冲击反应迅速，表明ASM作为矿产供应的弹性边际发挥作用；但随时间推移，其与工业采矿的关系从互补转向手工活动从工业场地的重新配置。第三，农业冲击促使劳动力进入ASM，但空间劳动力流动削弱了局部响应，表明存在显著的拥挤效应。综合来看，这些结论将ASM定位为全球关键矿产供应中核心但受空间约束的调整边际。

url:01adcb4eb72ffeb5.abstract: Individuals may fail to recall and use information they already know when making decisions. We empirically investigate whether such "retrieval failures" distort consumption smoothing behavior among Zambian farmers, who derive their income from one annual harvest and then spend it down over the course of the year. We document that individuals underestimate upcoming spending by 50%, creating scope for under-saving. In order to improve recall, we randomize an intervention that prompts individuals to think through their future expenses associatively in categories---without providing any external information or guidance. Treated individuals increase "remembered" expenses by 36-60%; as predicted by the memory literature, effects are concentrated among small, irregular, and stochastic items. Immediate spending drops and, six weeks after the intervention, treated households hold 15% higher savings. They subsequently enter the hungry season---the final months of the year when consumption typically declines sharply---with one additional month of savings, leading to a flatter spending profile over the year. Households use the increased savings to self-finance additional farm investment, resulting in a 9% increase in the next year's crop revenue. We replicate the intervention's impact on beliefs among low-income Americans, suggesting that retrieval failures generalize across settings and populations.
url:01adcb4eb72ffeb5.abstract_zh: 个体在决策时可能无法回忆并使用已知信息。我们通过实证研究考察这种"检索失败"是否扭曲了赞比亚农民的消费平滑行为——这些农民的收入来源于每年一次收获，随后在全年逐步消耗。研究发现，个体对未来支出的低估幅度达50%，这为储蓄不足创造了空间。为改善信息回忆，我们随机实施了一项干预措施：引导个体通过类别联想的方式梳理未来支出（不提供任何外部信息或指导）。受干预群体"被回忆起的"支出增加了36-60%；正如记忆文献所预测，该效应集中于小额、非规律性及随机性支出项目。即时消费有所下降，干预六周后，受干预家庭的储蓄水平高出15%。随后他们进入饥饿季（通常消费急剧下降的年末月份）时，额外拥有一个月的储蓄，使得全年消费曲线更为平缓。家庭将增加的储蓄用于农业投资自融资，使次年作物收入提升9%。我们还在美国低收入群体中复制了该干预对信念的影响，表明检索失败现象具有跨情境和跨人群的普遍性。
