url:01f7664624aac767.abstract: Government securities-backed repo markets constitute a key funding source for market participants in many jurisdictions. A number of recent stress episodes, e.g., in US and UK repo markets, has led to renewed efforts to strengthen the resilience of repo markets. This notably includes a push to increased central clearing via central counterparties (CCPs) which may come via market incentives or in the form of mandatory clearing. Central clearing is commonly considered as a key tool to increase transparency and understanding of markets and improve the risk management practices of market participants. This paper provides a brief overview of post trade-arrangements in select government securities repo markets and offers a structured analysis of potential benefits and risks of bringing repo markets onto centrally cleared platforms from a CCP perspective. The paper lists a set of key considerations that CCPs—and indirectly—policy makers could take into account when exploring the expansion of repo clearing services or opting for a repo clearing mandate. Aside from considerations pertaining to access modalities to repo clearing services, default management and market structure-related aspects are of key importance. Together, these factors ensure that the transition of repo transactions from a decentralized, uncleared set-up to central clearing is conducive to more resilient repo and ultimately government bond markets.
url:01f7664624aac767.abstract_zh: 政府证券回购市场是许多司法管辖区市场参与者的关键融资来源。近期美国及英国回购市场等多起压力事件，促使各方重新致力于增强回购市场的韧性。这尤其体现在通过中央对手方（CCPs）推动中央清算的强化举措——可能通过市场激励或强制清算形式实现。中央清算通常被视为提升市场透明度与认知度、改善市场参与者风险管理实践的关键工具。本文简要概述了特定政府证券回购市场的交易后安排，并从中央对手方视角系统分析了将回购市场纳入中央清算平台带来的潜在收益与风险。文章列出了一系列关键考量因素，供中央对手方（及间接的政策制定者）在探索扩大回购清算服务或选择回购清算强制令时参考。除涉及回购清算服务准入模式外，违约管理与市场结构相关要素同样至关重要。这些因素共同确保回购交易从分散化、非清算模式向中央清算的转型，有助于构建更具韧性的回购市场，并最终强化政府债券市场。

url:0293c30adbc5d382.abstract: Within narrowly defined industries, the most productive firms produce far more than the least productive from the same inputs, and this dispersion widens in downturns. We build a tractable representative-agent model in which financial frictions—adverse selection and moral hazard—make firms sort endogenously into lenders, strategic defaulters, and producers. As credit conditions vary, the resulting misallocation gives aggregate total factor productivity (TFP) an endogenous component that accounts for about 30 percent of the variance of TFP at business-cycle frequencies, a third of it from strategic default. We show that our tractable model can match key features of the observed distribution of productivity across firms and its co-movement with output growth and credit conditions in the data.
url:0293c30adbc5d382.abstract_zh: 在狭义定义的行业中，最具生产力的企业使用相同投入的产出远高于最低生产力企业，且这种差距在经济下行期进一步扩大。我们构建了一个易于处理的代表性主体模型，其中金融摩擦——逆向选择与道德风险——使企业内生地分化为贷款方、策略性违约方与生产方。随着信贷条件变化，由此产生的资源错配使全要素生产率（TFP）具有内生性成分，该成分解释了商业周期频率下约30%的TFP波动，其中三分之一源于策略性违约。研究表明，我们的可处理模型能够匹配观测到的企业间生产率分布的关键特征，及其与产出增长和信贷条件在数据中的协同变动关系。

url:02be07011eb52100.abstract: 理清增值税纳税人身份选择行为的微观形成机理,对于提高税收征管效率、维护企业税负公平以及保障增值税收入稳定增长等具有重要意义。本文采用聚束（bunching）方法研究增值税纳税人身份选择行为对企业增值税实际税负的影响,并对小规模纳税人“拒绝长大”的形成原因及实现路径进行讨论。研究表明,相对于转为一般纳税人的小规模纳税人而言,实施纳税身份筹划的小规模纳税人的增值税实际税负较低。进一步研究发现,小规模纳税人为保持现有纳税身份会对应税销售额进行调整,表现为小规模纳税人的产品平均销售价格显著下降、销售量明显减少、账税差异水平提高,即企业会利用降低销售价格、减少销售量和实施财务筹划等方式使其应税销售额符合小规模纳税人认定标准。本文研究结论表明,政府应优化增值税纳税人身份转换制度设计,提高税收征管的效能和精准性,缩小不同类型企业间税负差异以增强经济发展的内生动力。

url:034a4e14dc793e7e.abstract: Accurate stock price forecasting has consistently remained a pivotal yet challenging FinTech task that underpins quantitative trading and investment decision making. Recent efforts have been dedicated to modeling various complex relationships among stocks in the stock market toward more reliable stock price forecasting.These methods depend heavily on strong static prior assumptions by modeling either temporal dependencies within individual stocks or spatial dependencies across different stocks based on predefined structures, while the complex market dynamics that drive stock price movements remain unexplored. To alleviate this issue, we propose a novel game-theoretic modeling method that captures heterogeneous investor interactions for stock price forecasting. The core idea is to embed game-theoretic mechanisms into the heterogeneous graph structure to finely model the dynamic strategic interactions among heterogeneous investors with respect to target stocks. Additionally, temporal positional encoding is adopted to reflect the differentiated influences of each game event at different time steps within the time window on future stock price movements. Leveraging heterogeneous graph networks, we proxy the intricate dynamics of the stock market through investor games and enable real-time information propagation and node updates among all nodes. Extensive experiments conducted on two real-world benchmark dataset demonstrate that our method effectively outperforms state-of-the-art stock price forecasting methods.
url:034a4e14dc793e7e.abstract_zh: 准确的股票价格预测一直是支撑量化交易与投资决策的关键且具有挑战性的金融科技任务。近期研究致力于建模股票市场中各类复杂关系，以实现更可靠的股价预测。这些方法高度依赖强静态先验假设，要么基于预定义结构建模单只股票的时间依赖性，要么建模不同股票间的空间依赖性，但驱动股价波动的复杂市场动态仍未被充分探索。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种新颖的博弈论建模方法，通过捕捉异质投资者互动进行股价预测。其核心思想是将博弈论机制嵌入异质图结构，精细建模目标股票相关异质投资者间的动态策略互动。此外，采用时间位置编码反映时间窗口内各博弈事件在不同时间步对未来股价波动的差异化影响。借助异质图网络，我们通过投资者博弈代理股票市场的复杂动态，实现所有节点间的实时信息传播与节点更新。在两个真实世界基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法有效超越了现有最优的股价预测方法。

url:03d0ab275153a19c.abstract_zh: 本研究首次利用覆盖18年、与人口普查记录关联的全人口出生登记数据，考察了澳大利亚超过120万儿童出生体重与一系列综合社会经济因素在均值及分布层面的关系。通过采用文献中最严谨的实证方法（包括母亲固定效应模型），研究得出五项主要发现，其中多项为文献提供了新见解。第一，母亲与父亲的教育水平均与儿童出生体重呈正相关。

url:03d1d810c42bf069.abstract: Building on queuing theory, we develop and empirically validate a novel theoretical model of residential mortgage supply. Our model gives insight into how the stochastic arrival and sequential servicing of loan applications affect mortgage origination. The model provides closed-form predictions for lenders’ optimal response to changes in the level and price elasticity of mortgage demand. Using confidential HMDA data, we estimate that a one standard deviation increase in mortgage demand raises mortgage rate spreads by 3 to 8 basis points, loan quantities by 20 to 32 percent, and application processing times by 3 to 5 days. We also provide empirical evidence for the model prediction that a higher elasticity of mortgage demand moderates price increases due to demand shocks, which can limit lenders’ exploitation of their market power.
url:03d1d810c42bf069.abstract_zh: 基于排队理论，我们构建并实证验证了一个关于住宅抵押贷款供给的新型理论模型。该模型揭示了贷款申请的随机到达与顺序处理如何影响抵押贷款发放。模型为贷款机构应对抵押贷款需求水平及价格弹性变化的最优反应提供了闭式解。利用保密的HMDA数据，我们估计抵押贷款需求每增加一个标准差，抵押贷款利率价差将上升3至8个基点，贷款数量增加20%至32%，申请处理时间延长3至5天。我们还为模型预测提供了实证证据：更高的抵押贷款需求弹性会抑制需求冲击导致的价格上涨，从而限制贷款机构对其市场势力的利用。
url:03d1d810c42bf069.title: Queuing, Service Time, and Price Dynamics in Residential Mortgage Lending

url:03e1c431915e39dd.abstract: States are major international financiers, but their role is poorly understood. We study state-driven cross-border lending over two centuries using a new database covering 1.2 million official loans and grants by 134 governments and 70 multilateral institutions since 1790. We document a dual, state-contingent structure of international credit. In normal times, private creditors dominate cross-border lending. In adverse states of the world, such as wars and financial crises, official creditors step in, at times on a massive scale. These official flows are driven by great powers, are highly subsidized, and are largely absent from canonical models in international macroeconomics.
url:03e1c431915e39dd.abstract_zh: 国家是主要的国际融资方，但其作用尚未得到充分理解。我们利用涵盖1790年以来134个政府和70个多边机构120万笔官方贷款与赠款的新数据库，研究两个世纪以来国家驱动的跨境贷款。我们揭示了国际信贷的双重国家依存结构：在正常时期，私人债权人主导跨境贷款；而在战争、金融危机等不利世界状态下，官方债权人会介入，有时规模巨大。这些官方资金流动由大国驱动，享有高额补贴，且在国际宏观经济学的经典模型中基本缺失。

url:03f9c4adf4b43c8d.abstract: This paper studies formal employment dynamics using linked employer-employee data from eight countries spanning a wide income range from Kenya to Chile. First, we show that formality rates increase with development, both between and within countries, because more workers enter the formal sector, not because they spend more time in formal jobs. Second, formal labor market fluidity increases with development, as workers hold more formal jobs, spend less time in each job, and less time between jobs. Third, greater fluidity is associated with higher life-cycle wage growth, which is largely accounted for by within- rather than between-firm wage gains.
url:03f9c4adf4b43c8d.abstract_zh: 本文利用涵盖从肯尼亚到智利等八个收入水平差异显著国家的关联雇主-雇员数据，研究正规就业的动态变化。首先，我们发现正规就业率随经济发展而上升，这一趋势既体现在国家间也体现在国家内部，其原因是更多工人进入正规部门，而非他们在正规岗位上的工作时间延长。其次，正规劳动力市场的流动性随经济发展而增强，表现为工人从事更多正规工作、每份工作持续时间缩短、以及工作间隔时间减少。第三，更高的流动性与更快的生命周期工资增长相关，这种增长主要源于企业内部而非企业间的工资提升。

url:03fc823dca5dc978.abstract: This paper complements and extends Doldi, Frittelli and Maggis, Collective completeness and pricing-hedging duality, Math. Finan. Econ. 19, 757-784 (2025), by studying collective pricing and hedging when admissible risk exchanges form a finitely generated convex cone. The collective First Fundamental Theorem of Asset Pricing and the collective pricing-hedging duality are extended to this setting. A key contribution is a closedness result showing that no collective arbitrage implies the closedness of the aggregate feasibility cone combining infinite-dimensional trading opportunities with finite-dimensional exchanges. The paper also proves that no-collective-arbitrage prices for vectors of contingent claims form a relatively open convex set. Finally, strong collective replicability is introduced and shown to be equivalent to price uniqueness. This leads to an enhanced collective Second Fundamental Theorem of Asset Pricing, providing equivalent characterizations of collective completeness and strong collective completeness in terms of the uniqueness of the collective equivalent martingale measure. We highlight that several core aspects of the theory are substantially altered when exchanges belong to a convex cone rather than a vector space.
url:03fc823dca5dc978.abstract_zh: 本文对Doldi、Frittelli与Maggis的《集体完备性与定价-对冲对偶》（Math. Finan. Econ. 19, 757-784 (2025)）进行了补充与拓展，研究了当可接受风险交换构成有限生成凸锥时的集体定价与对冲问题。本文将集体资产定价第一基本定理及集体定价-对冲对偶推广至该设定。核心贡献在于一项闭性结论：无集体套利意味着聚合可行性锥的闭性，该锥结合了无限维交易机会与有限维交换。本文还证明了无集体套利条件下未定权益向量的价格构成相对开凸集。最后，本文引入强集体可复制性概念，并证明其等价于价格唯一性。由此推导出增强的集体资产定价第二基本定理，以集体等价鞅测度的唯一性为条件，给出了集体完备性与强集体完备性的等价刻画。我们强调，当交换属于凸锥而非向量空间时，该理论的若干核心方面会发生实质性改变。
url:03fc823dca5dc978.title: Collective completeness and pricing-hedging duality II
url:03fc823dca5dc978.title_zh: 集体完备性与定价-对冲对偶性 II

url:03fe0a1a8c482f3e.abstract: This paper provides new micro-level evidence on how labor taxation shapes firm behavior, exploiting an EU-mandated payroll tax reform in Norway. Combining administrative and survey data, we find that firms facing larger tax increases sharply cut employment but also increased R&D spending, implemented labor cost-saving innovations, and adopted more automation. While these responses led to improvements in labor and total factor productivity within the firm, the firm’s labor share fell. These effects persisted even after the tax hike was unexpectedly reversed three years later, suggesting a lasting shift toward more capital-intensive production in response to higher labor costs.
url:03fe0a1a8c482f3e.abstract_zh: 本文利用挪威一项欧盟强制实施的工资税改革，提供了关于劳动税收如何影响企业行为的新微观证据。结合行政与调查数据，我们发现，面临较大税负增加的企业大幅削减了就业，但同时增加了研发支出，实施了节约劳动力成本的创新，并采用了更多自动化措施。尽管这些反应带来了企业内部劳动生产率和全要素生产率的提升，但企业的劳动份额却下降了。这些效应在三年后税负意外逆转时依然持续存在，表明企业为应对更高的劳动力成本，已向更资本密集型生产方式发生了持久性转变。

url:044a38f52dd88ba7.abstract: How harmful is stigma in the “real world”? Answers are elusive because stigma is difficult to measure in observational data, and isolating its effects requires exogenous variation in stigma without variation in the stigmatized trait. This study addresses these challenges by focusing on a widespread form of stigma — weight stigma — in the high-stakes setting of inpatient healthcare. BMI categories are displayed prominently to providers in electronic medical records, and obesity is heavily stigmatized socially. Thus, at the "obese" cutoff, stigma may shift discretely while the underlying trait (BMI) does not. Using a regression discontinuity design that exploits this institutional feature, I find a discontinuous increase in in-hospital mortality at this cutoff, though patient health does not change. Two patterns suggest stigma-based discrimination as the mechanism. First, just-obese patients receive less diagnostic effort than almost-obese patients. Second, a physician-validated LLM identifies at the cutoff a rise in stigmatizing language in clinical notes — specifically, language that imposes moral judgment, undermines patient credibility, and stereotypes patients — among the most stigmatizing providers, who also drive the mortality result. Overall, these results suggest that stigma is a powerful social force with potentially life-or-death consequences.
url:044a38f52dd88ba7.abstract_zh: 污名在“现实世界”中的危害程度究竟如何？答案难以捉摸，因为污名难以通过观测数据衡量，且分离其影响需要污名本身存在外生变异，而污名化特征本身不发生改变。本研究通过聚焦住院医疗这一高风险场景中普遍存在的污名形式——体重污名，来应对上述挑战。电子病历中会显著标注患者的BMI类别，而肥胖在社会中饱受污名化。因此，在“肥胖”临界点处，污名可能发生离散性变化，而潜在特征（BMI）却未改变。利用这一制度特征，我采用断点回归设计，发现该临界点处住院死亡率出现非连续性上升，尽管患者健康状况并未变化。两种模式表明污名化歧视是作用机制：首先，刚达肥胖标准的患者获得的诊断努力少于接近肥胖的患者；其次，经医生验证的大语言模型识别出，在临界点处临床记录中污名化语言有所增加——具体而言，是施加道德评判、削弱患者可信度及对患者进行刻板印象化的语言——这些语言主要来自污名化程度最高的医疗服务提供者，而正是这些提供者推动了死亡率结果。总体而言，这些结果表明污名是一种强大的社会力量，可能带来生死攸关的后果。
url:044a38f52dd88ba7.title: Deadly Stigma

url:0458b3ba923dcaf1.abstract: One way to measure the efficiency of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) is the extent to which gains in publicly supported health insurance reduced uninsured rates. Using data from the 2008–2024 American Community Survey, we examine time trends in rates of uninsured, public insurance coverage, and employer-sponsored insurance (ESI) by groups defined by the ratio of income to the Federal Poverty Line (FPL). We obtain estimates of associations between changes in public coverage and changes in uninsured and ESI exploiting state-by-year variation in ACA implementation. Importantly, we estimate the total effect of the ACA—including both the Medicaid expansion and Marketplace coverage—on uninsured and ESI rates. For adults in households below 150% of the federal poverty level (FPL), increases in public insurance coverage were associated with one-for-one decrease in uninsured and no change in ESI. For adults with incomes between 151%–400% FPL, each percentage point increase in public coverage was associated with about a 0.6 percentage point decrease in uninsured and a 0.4 decrease, or crowd out, in ESI. Crowd-out was larger among groups with higher pre-ACA ESI rates such as parents and married adults. Using variation from the Medicaid expansion alone to evaluate the ACA’s effect on ESI leads to overstating crowd-out among low-income adults (below 150% FPL) and understating crowd-out among higher-income adults (above 250% FPL). Our findings suggest that policies intended to subsidize health insurance of higher income groups, for example, the enhanced premium subsidies, are far less efficient than policies intended to further expand public insurance to low-income groups, for example, in non-expansion states.
url:0458b3ba923dcaf1.abstract_zh: 衡量《平价医疗法案》（ACA）效率的一个指标是公共资助医疗保险的覆盖增长在多大程度上降低了无保险率。利用2008-2024年美国社区调查数据，我们按收入与联邦贫困线（FPL）的比率划分群体，考察了无保险率、公共保险覆盖率以及雇主提供的保险（ESI）的时间趋势。我们利用各州在ACA实施中的逐年差异，估算了公共保险覆盖率变化与无保险率及ESI变化之间的关联。重要的是，我们评估了ACA的总体效应——包括医疗补助扩展和市场覆盖——对无保险率和ESI的影响。对于家庭收入低于联邦贫困线150%的成年人，公共保险覆盖率的增加与无保险率的一对一减少相关，而ESI没有变化。对于收入在联邦贫困线151%-400%之间的成年人，公共保险覆盖率每增加一个百分点，无保险率约下降0.6个百分点，ESI下降0.4个百分点，即存在挤出效应。在ACA实施前ESI率较高的群体中，如父母和已婚成年人，挤出效应更大。仅利用医疗补助扩展的变异来评估ACA对ESI的影响，会导致对低收入成年人（低于150% FPL）的挤出效应高估，而对高收入成年人（高于250% FPL）的挤出效应低估。我们的研究结果表明，旨在补贴高收入群体健康保险的政策（例如增强保费补贴）远不如旨在进一步向低收入群体扩展公共保险的政策（例如在非扩展州）有效。
url:0458b3ba923dcaf1.title: How Efficient was the Affordable Care Act at Reducing Uninsured Rates?
url:0458b3ba923dcaf1.title_zh: 《平价医疗法案在降低未参保率方面的效率如何？》

url:047b6f5b981406e6.abstract: We study the effect of pre-booked COVID-19 vaccination appointments using a nationwide campaign in Austria. Leveraging administrative microdata on more than 450000 initially unvaccinated adults, we exploit cross-state variation in program participation and staggered appointment timing in a difference-in-differences design. Pre-booked appointments increase vaccination on the appointment day by 0.8 percentage points (8 per 1000), with no evidence of intertemporal substitution. Effects are larger for socio-economically disadvantaged individuals and substantially weaker in areas with stronger vaccine skepticism. The findings suggest that behavioral interventions are effective when low uptake reflects frictions, but have limited impact when driven by entrenched skepticism.
url:047b6f5b981406e6.abstract_zh: 我们利用奥地利全国性疫苗接种活动，研究了预先预约新冠疫苗接种的效果。基于超过45万名初始未接种成年人的行政微观数据，我们采用双重差分法，利用各州在项目参与率及预约时间安排上的差异。预先预约使接种当日的疫苗接种率提高了0.8个百分点（每千人增加8人），且未发现跨期替代效应。该效应在社会经济弱势群体中更为显著，而在疫苗怀疑论较强的地区则明显减弱。研究结果表明，当低接种率源于摩擦性障碍时，行为干预措施有效；但当其源于根深蒂固的怀疑态度时，干预效果有限。
url:047b6f5b981406e6.title: Pre-Booked Vaccination Appointments as a Nudge: Evidence from a Nationwide Intervention
url:047b6f5b981406e6.title_zh: 预预约疫苗接种作为助推手段：来自全国性干预的证据

url:04878dc6ec9d2df2.abstract: The effects of the bank levy in Poland on the broadly defined credit market (including on loan rates and volumes) appear to be well documented, with the use of the standard difference-in-differences (DID) method. However, as, for example, Borusyak et al. (2024) note, in a setting with staggered treatment (as in the case of the bank levy in Poland), and different effects of the treatment in time and between cross-sections, the method might provide biased estimates. None of the studies to date used the heterogenous DID method that addresses this drawback. In this research note I use the heterogenous DID method to estimate the consequences of the bank levy. I also discuss other methodological choices. Among other things, I find that the bank levy has lowered deposit rates, raised rates on loans for house purchases, and changed the composition and the level of bank assets. However, I find no longer-term crowding out of credit by government bond securities (while the latter did increase, the former did not increase) or effects on bank profitability. The use of a more advised method did not lead to results in stark contrast with the earlier literature applying methods for causal inference.
url:04878dc6ec9d2df2.abstract_zh: 波兰银行税对广义信贷市场（包括贷款利率和规模）的影响已有充分文献记载，相关研究普遍采用标准双重差分法。然而，正如Borusyak等人（2024）所指出的，在交错处理设定（如波兰银行税案例）下，若处理效应在时间维度和截面维度存在异质性，该方法可能产生有偏估计。现有研究均未采用能解决此缺陷的异质性双重差分法。本研究笔记运用异质性双重差分法评估银行税的经济后果，并探讨其他方法论选择。研究发现：银行税降低了存款利率，提高了购房贷款利率，并改变了银行资产的构成与规模。但未发现政府债券证券对信贷的长期挤出效应（尽管债券规模上升，信贷规模并未下降），也未发现银行税对银行盈利能力的显著影响。采用更优方法所得结论与早期运用因果推断方法的研究并无显著差异。

url:05d7a31929e528a4.abstract: 为加快构建新发展格局，亟须纵深推进全国统一大市场建设，增强省际贸易往来。本文基于2011—2023年全国高速公路货运数据，尤其是2021—2023年约60亿辆次车流信息，构建月度省际货运交流数据及运量、运距加权的跨省货运供需指数，以量化各省份在商品流通层面参与全国统一大市场建设的程度。研究发现：（1）超七成货运量发生在相邻省份间，河北、江苏、广东和四川为各自区域的关键枢纽；仅考虑货运量，中部地区跨省货运占比最高。综合考虑运量与运距后，东部地区指数更高，在长距离商品流通中发挥强辐射作用。（2）经济总量越大、二产占比越高、进出口总额越高的省份通常跨省货运指数越高。（3）结合季度GDP与约3.76亿条招聘数据的实证分析表明，运距加权的跨省货运供需指数与未来1—2个季度经济增长及1—7个月的招聘需求扩张显著正相关，且效应主要来自存量企业的扩产扩招。本文研究揭示了省际货运网络的空间格局与结构特征，表明长距离跨省货运是全国统一大市场建设在商品流通环节的重要表征，并揭示了全国统一大市场建设对稳增长与就业具有重要作用。本文构建的高频指数为动态监测全国统一大市场运行、评估区域协同成效与优化宏观调控提供新的量化工具。

url:060f1b2fcb4fcbc8.abstract: Politische Bemühungen, Unternehmen zu einem sog. De-Risking in Bezug auf chinesische Zulieferungen zu veranlassen, zeigen bisher nur geringen Erfolg. Diese Studie untersucht auf Basis von Verbands- und Unternehmensinterviews mögliche Gründe für ein ausbleibendes De-Risking, insbesondere bei mittelständischen Unternehmen. Es zeigt sich, dass sich die Unternehmen der Risiken einer Abhängigkeit durchaus bewusst sind, dass Maßnahmen zur Abhängigkeitsreduktion aber an konkreten Hindernissen (z. B. regulatorische Hürden, Kosten) scheitern.
url:060f1b2fcb4fcbc8.abstract_zh: 目前，促使企业对中国供应链实施所谓"去风险化"的政治努力成效甚微。本研究基于行业协会与企业访谈，探讨了企业（尤其是中小企业）未能实施去风险化的可能原因。研究发现，企业虽充分认识到依赖风险，但降低依赖度的措施却因具体障碍（如监管壁垒、成本问题）而难以落实。

url:065905ede47cfaeb.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of natural disasters on the domestic sovereign yield curve, shedding light on their distinct transmission channels. Using a sample of 72 developing countries during the period 2000-20, and leveraging a newly compiled dataset on domestic treasury bill and bond yields, the findings from the fixed-effects and the local projection difference in difference estimations point to a disaster premium in the pricing of domestic government securities. While natural disasters significantly steepen the yield curve, their effects are confined to short-term maturity debts. In constrast, a worsening in climate vulnerability shifts upward the entire yield curve. Heightened fiscal stress and monetary policy stance emerge as the main transmission channels. These results underscore the importance of integrating resilience building into debt management and fiscal policy frameworks.
url:065905ede47cfaeb.abstract_zh: 本文研究了自然灾害对国内主权收益率曲线的影响，揭示了其独特的传导渠道。基于2000-20年间72个发展中国家的样本，并利用新编制的国内国库券和债券收益率数据集，固定效应模型与局部投影双重差分估计的结果表明，国内政府证券定价中存在“灾害溢价”。自然灾害显著陡化了收益率曲线，但其影响仅限于短期债务。相比之下，气候脆弱性的恶化则使整条收益率曲线上移。财政压力加剧与货币政策立场成为主要传导渠道。这些结果凸显了将韧性建设纳入债务管理与财政政策框架的重要性。

url:067386a3c139b712.abstract: We provide the first evidence of forward-looking reference points in investor behavior. Combining administrative data on option traders with a stacked difference-in-differences design, we show that investors' propensity to sell options spikes precisely when the underlying asset crosses the strike price, which retail investors frequently select to match their target price. The effect is difficult to explain using the standard disposition effect, nominal returns, salience, option Greeks, or complex option trading strategies. Moreover, the effect is present only for options bought out of the money, for which the strike price acts as a natural target, but absent for options bought in the money, for which it does not. The evidence is most consistent with investors evaluating gains and losses relative to a forward-looking target, in sharp contrast with the backward-looking purchase price widely used in the disposition effect literature. Our findings suggest that standard tests of reference dependence in selling decisions are misspecified when investors evaluate outcomes relative to reference points other than the purchase price.
url:067386a3c139b712.abstract_zh: 我们首次提供了投资者行为中存在前瞻性参考点的证据。通过将期权交易者的行政数据与堆叠双重差分设计相结合，我们发现，当标的资产恰好突破行权价时，投资者出售期权的倾向会急剧上升，而散户投资者经常选择该行权价以匹配其目标价格。这一效应难以用标准的处置效应、名义收益、显著性、期权希腊字母或复杂期权交易策略来解释。此外，该效应仅存在于价外买入的期权中（此时行权价充当自然目标），而在价内买入的期权中则不存在（此时行权价不构成目标）。这一证据最符合投资者基于前瞻性目标评估损益的行为，与处置效应文献中广泛使用的后顾式买入价格形成鲜明对比。我们的发现表明，当投资者以买入价以外的参考点评估结果时，关于卖出决策中参考依赖的标准检验存在设定偏误。

url:0697bd31ca5eb05c.abstract: Insecure land rights and limited access to modern inputs are often seen as key constraints on smallholder investment in Sub-Saharan Africa. This paper studies both in a three-year field experiment with women farmers in Mozambique, cross-randomizing a statutory land registration intervention with a subsidized package of agricultural inputs and climate-smart agriculture training, and eliciting willingness to pay for the package at randomized prices. Demand for registration was high, but its effects were limited: it produced only a temporary gain in perceived tenure security and did not raise willingness to pay for inputs or down-stream investment. Despite gender-targeted titling, it also did not improve women’s intra-household security or decision-making power. The input-and-training package raised input use but reduced harvests, with exploratory evidence of a shift toward a more shock-prone crop; the losses persisted even after households fully reverted to pre-program practices. Consistent with negative social learning, non-recipients with more treated network connections also reduced their adoption of climate-smart practices over time. Relaxing both constraints together produced no effects beyond either intervention alone.
url:0697bd31ca5eb05c.abstract_zh: 不稳定的土地权利和现代投入品的有限获取常被视为撒哈拉以南非洲小农投资的关键制约因素。本文通过对莫桑比克女性农民开展为期三年的实地实验，将法定土地登记干预与补贴性农业投入品及气候智慧型农业培训进行交叉随机化处理，并在随机定价条件下测度农户对投入品组合的支付意愿。土地登记需求虽高，但其效果有限：仅带来感知土地权属保障的暂时性提升，既未提高对投入品的支付意愿，也未促进后续投资。尽管实施性别定向的土地确权，该干预仍未能改善女性在家庭内部的保障状况或决策权。投入品与培训组合虽提高了投入品使用量，却导致收成下降——探索性证据表明农户转向更易受冲击的作物品种；即便家庭完全恢复至项目前耕作模式，损失仍持续存在。与非受益者中拥有更多受干预社交网络联系的农户随时间推移减少气候智慧型实践采用的现象一致，这印证了负面社会学习效应。同时放松两类约束并未产生超越单一干预的叠加效果。

url:07ce0fe74c42942b.abstract: Key Takeaways - A small group of large firms dominates the global petrochemical industry, with ownership heavily concentrated among corporations and geographically in China, the United States, and Saudi Arabia. - Ownership does not equal control. Chinese and other Asian investors exert significant control, while US investors exercise limited control due to reliance on passive investments. Saudi Arabia has full control over its investments. - Europe has weak control and limited presence in the petrochemical industry, with very few major companies, leaving it more dependent on external suppliers. Petrochemicals--used in everything from fertilizers, solar panels, clothing, and cosmetics to electric vehicles, electronics, and medicines--are integral to food security, manufacturing, and clean energy. They are also becoming the fastest-growing source of demand for oil. The 2026 conflict in the Middle East has exposed vulnerabilities in petrochemical supply chains, especially since Middle Eastern producers account for much of the global supply of key petrochemical products, including fertilizers, and one-third of global seaborne fertilizer trade transits the Strait of Hormuz. Understanding the petrochemical industry, including its size, geographical distribution, and ownership and control structure, is essential to reduce risks from geopolitical shocks, hostile takeovers, and fragile supply chains.
url:07ce0fe74c42942b.abstract_zh: 关键要点 - 少数大型企业主导着全球石化行业，所有权高度集中于企业层面，地理上则集中在中国、美国和沙特阿拉伯。 - 所有权不等于控制权。中国及其他亚洲投资者施加显著控制，而美国投资者因依赖被动投资，控制力有限。沙特阿拉伯对其投资拥有完全控制权。 - 欧洲在石化行业中的控制力薄弱且存在感有限，主要企业极少，因此更依赖外部供应商。 石化产品——用于化肥、太阳能板、服装、化妆品、电动汽车、电子产品及药品等——对粮食安全、制造业和清洁能源至关重要。它们也正成为石油需求增长最快的来源。2026年的中东冲突暴露了石化供应链的脆弱性，尤其是中东生产商占全球关键石化产品（包括化肥）供应的大部分，而全球海运化肥贸易的三分之一需通过霍尔木兹海峡。理解石化行业，包括其规模、地理分布以及所有权与控制结构，对于降低地缘政治冲击、恶意收购和脆弱供应链带来的风险至关重要。

url:08510d4a90236da5.abstract: In this paper we survey recent advances in the economic theory of identity formation. We restrict our analysis to models which conceptualize identity formation as embedded into an inter-generational cultural transmission process, and therefore have implications for the dynamics of social identity. Through the lens of a general framework linking identity formation to cultural evolution, we discuss issues related to the dynamics of oppositional, racial, or minority attitudes, cultural polarization, identity switching, and openness to alternative identities. An application of the set-up to multidimensional identities constructed from combinations of characteristics, provides conditions under which societies converge (or not) toward narrow identities centered on salient markers such as religion, ethnicity, or race. We conclude by outlining promising avenues for future research.
url:08510d4a90236da5.abstract_zh: 本文综述了身份认同形成的经济学理论最新进展。我们将分析范围限定于将身份认同形成嵌入代际文化传播过程的模型，这类模型对社会身份认同的动态演变具有重要启示。通过构建连接身份认同形成与文化演化的通用分析框架，我们探讨了对抗性态度、种族或少数群体态度、文化极化、身份转换以及对替代性身份认同的开放性等议题的动态特征。将该框架应用于由多重特征组合构建的多维身份认同，揭示了社会在何种条件下会（或不会）收敛于以宗教、族裔或种族等显著标识为核心的狭隘身份认同。最后，我们指出了未来研究富有前景的方向。

url:0872b52a2be728b2.abstract: After decades in the making, Brazil’s landmark VAT reform was approved in 2023. The primary objective of the reform is to eliminate distortions and reduce the complexity of the current consumption tax system while maintaining revenue neutrality. In addition, specific design features were included to alleviate the VAT’s inherent regressivity and improve the equity of the Brazilian tax system. This paper assesses the reform’s expected equity print leveraging a microstatic model based on household data and simulates policy options to further improve distributional outcomes. While the new VAT achieves a fairly equal distribution of the tax burden across most income groups, the poorest still carry a heavier load in terms of their disposable income. Dissecting the impact by policy instrument, the reform’s approved reduced rates aggravate regressivity, while zero rates and the new cashback lower the tax burden for poorer households, under the revenue neutrality assumption. Overall, the combined use of these measures dampens the reform’s equity outcomes somewhat as a higher VAT reference rate is required on all other items to maintain revenue neutrality. The paper also shows that some equity improvements stem from the reform’s implied pivot towards taxing services. Finally, simulations show that focusing on and expanding the cashback could amplify equity gains by raising the poorest disposable income by 25 percent via reductions in their tax liability.
url:0872b52a2be728b2.abstract_zh: 历经数十年酝酿，巴西里程碑式的增值税改革于2023年获批。此次改革的首要目标是在保持税收中性前提下，消除现行消费税体系的扭曲效应并降低其复杂性。此外，改革还纳入了特定设计特征，以缓解增值税固有的累退性，提升巴西税收体系的公平性。本文基于家庭数据的微观静态模型评估了改革预期的公平性影响，并模拟了进一步改善分配结果的备选政策方案。尽管新增值税制在多数收入群体间实现了较为均衡的税负分配，但最贫困群体在可支配收入层面仍承担着更重的负担。按政策工具分解影响可见：在税收中性假设下，改革批准的优惠税率加剧了累退性，而零税率与新推行的现金返还机制则降低了贫困家庭的税负。总体而言，这些措施的联合使用在一定程度上削弱了改革的公平性效果——为维持税收中性，所有其他商品需适用更高的增值税基准税率。本文还表明，部分公平性改善源于改革隐含的服务业征税重心转移。最后，模拟结果显示，聚焦并扩大现金返还机制可通过减少贫困群体税负使其可支配收入提升25%，从而放大公平性收益。

url:08b07827e1213bef.abstract: How does terrorism affect labor markets in developing countries? We combine georeferenced data on terrorist incidents with nationally representative employment data from Nigeria to examine this question. Exploiting within-location variation in exposure to terrorist attacks over time, we show that terrorism reduces employment. A one standard deviation increase in exposure lowers the probability of employment by 0.7 percentage points, or roughly 1 percent of average employment, with substantially larger effects for women. Beyond reducing employment, terrorism shifts workers away from regular and cash-paying jobs and lowers employment in sales, services, and unskilled manual occupations. The findings identify labor market disruption as an important economic cost of insecurity in developing countries.
url:08b07827e1213bef.abstract_zh: 恐怖主义如何影响发展中国家的劳动力市场？我们结合尼日利亚恐怖袭击事件的地理参照数据与全国代表性就业数据来探究这一问题。通过利用同一地区不同时期遭受恐怖袭击暴露程度的差异，我们发现恐怖主义会降低就业水平。暴露程度每增加一个标准差，就业概率将下降0.7个百分点（约占平均就业率的1%），且对女性的影响显著更大。除减少就业外，恐怖主义还促使劳动者从正规及现金支付岗位转移，并导致销售、服务业及非熟练体力劳动岗位的就业率下降。研究结果表明，劳动力市场紊乱是发展中国家因不安全状况付出的重要经济代价。

url:08dae84490b01235.abstract: We develop a tractable quantitative model of international trade in which agents make bilateral investments in resilience under general equilibrium uncertainty. Under both complete and incomplete financial markets, we show that these bilateral investments solve a portfolio problem of choosing trade partners. Countries’ risk profiles become determinants of trade flows, income and welfare, whose first moments are affected by the second moments of productivity and trade costs. Changes in global economic uncertainty have heterogeneous effects across countries, depending on how they affect real hedging opportunities. The opening of trade can raise or reduce income volatility, but is revealed-preferred to autarky.
url:08dae84490b01235.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个可量化的国际贸易模型，其中经济主体在一般均衡不确定性下对韧性进行双边投资。在完全金融市场与不完全金融市场两种情形下，我们证明这些双边投资可归结为选择贸易伙伴的投资组合问题。国家的风险特征成为贸易流量、收入与福利的决定因素，而这些变量的第一矩受生产率与贸易成本第二矩的影响。全球经济不确定性的变化对不同国家产生异质性影响，其作用方向取决于这些变化如何影响实际对冲机会。贸易开放可能提高或降低收入波动性，但通过显示性偏好优于自给自足状态。

url:090fae4ab7f54eaf.abstract: Assessing the real-world economic value of weather forecasts remains challenging, particularly in the context of high-impact extreme events. Although meteorological skill has improved substantially in recent years—driven by steady advances in physics-based models and impressive breakthroughs in artificial intelligence-based forecasting—operational evaluations still focus primarily on standard skill metrics, with limited consideration of how improvements in meteorological skill translate into economic value. This study proposes a flexible framework to assess the economic value of weather forecasts, with penalty functions that explicitly account for compounding losses as well as declining user trust in cases of repeated false alarms. In addition, the framework allows for varying cost—loss ratios to represent heterogeneous prevention costs and vulnerability structures. The framework is applied to cities exposed to weather-related natural hazards, comparing the relative economic value of leading physics-based and data-driven forecasting systems from the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts. The value of forecasts is highly sensitive to assumptions about compounding losses, penalty structures, and prevention costs, which often substantially alter conclusions drawn from meteorological skill alone. For instance, in some cities in Southern Europe, the higher sensitivity of the physics-based Integrated Forecast System high-resolution model (IFS HRES) makes it better suited when protection costs are small relative to potential losses, while the higher specificity of the data-driven Artificial Intelligence Forecasting System (AIFS) makes it better when protection costs are higher. These findings underscore the importance of evaluating economic value under realistic risk scenarios to ensure that improvements in predictive accuracy translate into meaningful societal and economic benefits.
url:090fae4ab7f54eaf.abstract_zh: 评估天气预报的真实经济价值仍具挑战性，尤其是在高影响极端事件的背景下。尽管近年来气象预报技能显著提升——得益于基于物理模型的稳步改进和基于人工智能预报的突破性进展——但业务评估仍主要聚焦于标准技能指标，对气象技能提升如何转化为经济价值的考量十分有限。本研究提出一个灵活框架来评估天气预报的经济价值，其惩罚函数明确考虑了复合损失以及重复误报情况下用户信任度下降的影响。此外，该框架允许成本-损失比变化，以表征异质性预防成本和脆弱性结构。将该框架应用于面临天气相关自然灾害的城市，比较了欧洲中期天气预报中心领先的基于物理模型和数据驱动预报系统的相对经济价值。预报价值对复合损失、惩罚结构和预防成本的假设高度敏感，这些因素往往显著改变仅基于气象技能得出的结论。例如，在南欧部分城市，当保护成本相对于潜在损失较小时，基于物理模型的综合预报系统高分辨率模式（IFS HRES）因其更高灵敏度而更适用；而当保护成本较高时，数据驱动的人工智能预报系统（AIFS）因其更高特异性而表现更优。这些发现强调了在现实风险情景下评估经济价值的重要性，以确保预报精度的提升转化为有意义的社会经济效益。

url:09b2753420918138.abstract: We study how politically polarized television news shapes household inflation expectations in Turkey. We combine new household panel data with transcript-based measures of channel-level inflation coverage during prime-time news and a large-scale randomized information experiment. Inflation coverage differs sharply across politically aligned channels, and viewers sort into outlets consistent with their political affiliations. Within-person estimates show that greater coverage on a respondent’s initially preferred channel leads to higher inflation expectations, with effects concentrated among viewers of politically neutral channels. Experimental evidence indicates that belief updating depends on prior anchoring as well as on source credibility and reveals the political costs of rising inflation expectations.

Under standard regularity conditions, we establish consistency of the credibility estimator and show that the reaction function coefficients attain the Cramer-Rao bound when the innovation variance is constant; a GLS variant achieves efficiency in the heteroskedastic case. url:0a4ce9b213fb6a6d.abstract: Does fair lending litigation impact mortgage lender decisions? Using a novel dataset of all fair lending legal actions from 1991 to 2023, we find that it does. In the wake of legal settlements for discrimination against Black borrowers, lenders significantly reduced denial rates for Black applicants. The reductions offset pre-litigation racial disparities in denial rates by litigated banks, relative to those banks' competitors. Origination rates for Black applicants also increased post-litigation. We further observe evidence of a spillover effect on the approval decisions of non-litigated banks operating in the same city as a litigated bank. Altogether, the evidence suggests that the enforcement of fair lending laws is an effective tool to reduce racial discrimination in credit markets.
url:0a4ce9b213fb6a6d.abstract_zh: 公平贷款诉讼是否影响抵押贷款机构的决策？利用1991年至2023年所有公平贷款法律诉讼的新数据集，我们发现确实存在影响。在针对黑人借款人的歧视性法律和解后，贷款机构显著降低了黑人申请人的拒绝率。与诉讼银行的竞争对手相比，这些拒绝率的下降抵消了诉讼银行在诉讼前存在的种族差异。诉讼后，黑人申请人的贷款发放率也有所上升。我们进一步观察到，在同一城市运营的非诉讼银行的审批决策存在溢出效应。总体而言，证据表明，公平贷款法律的执行是减少信贷市场种族歧视的有效工具。

url:0ac2fdd7238ffdff.abstract: In 2025, only 60% of Americans believed in human-caused climate change, despite a strong consensus in the scientific community. This paper argues that motivated reasoning contributes to climate-change ignorance. Using a difference-in-differences design we show that layoffs in the coal-mining sector increases the share of believers in climate change. Comparing layoffs in coal mining to manufacturing confirms that the effect is specific to employment in the fossil fuel industry. Finally, we find no comparable shifts in beliefs on unrelated policy issues, suggesting that changes in climate views reflect specific self-image dynamics rather than a broader opinion shifts.
url:0ac2fdd7238ffdff.abstract_zh: 2025年，尽管科学界已形成强烈共识，但仅有60%的美国人相信人类活动导致气候变化。本文论证了动机性推理是造成气候变化认知缺失的原因之一。通过双重差分法设计，我们发现煤炭开采行业的裁员提高了气候变化信仰者的比例。将煤炭开采业裁员与制造业裁员进行对比，证实该效应仅针对化石燃料行业的就业情况。最后，我们在无关政策议题上未发现类似信念转变，这表明气候变化观点的变化反映了特定的自我形象动态，而非更广泛的意见转变。

url:0b11f4a58d393aeb.abstract_zh: 我们研究了中资海外企业所有权的全球足迹及其实际影响。通过整合涵盖159个国家161,773家企业的微观层面综合数据集（2012-2021年），我们独立重构了多层所有权链条，以追溯资本经离岸避税天堂至最终来源的路径。这一方法揭示出的全球足迹远超官方外商直接投资统计数据的范围。截至2021年，中资控制的海外资产以每年20%的速度增长，达到2.1万亿美元，约占全球企业资产的3%。中国投资者——尤其是国有企业——战略性地瞄准研发密集型及供应链关联企业。在收购完成后，目标企业增加了资本存量与研发支出，但这些投入并未带来更高的专利产出，反而伴随盈利能力的显著下降。我们记录了这一新发现。

url:0bdb61f5f7007ae2.abstract: Air pollution from natural sources is often subject to less regulatory oversight, but can still be caused by human activities. Understanding the role for policy requires quantifying the source's pollution contribution, for which there is currently no standard methodological approach. This paper uses the context of the shrinking Great Salt Lake in Utah to model air quality impacts of the highly erodible and growing area of exposed lakebed. Using four common identification strategies in the air pollution literature, and three alternative pollution measurement technologies, we find consistent evidence of meaningful pollution increases attributable to the shrinking lake in non-winter months. Estimates are relatively invariant to measurement technology but vary across identification strategies. Marginal annual costs range from $81 to $175 million per 100 km² of exposed lakebed. Scaling to the area of total exposed lakebed, annual desiccation-related health cost estimates range from $1.1 billion to $2.3 billion. Given the direct relationship between human water use in the basin and exposed lakebed, these results provide evidence for the cost-effectiveness of policies aimed at reducing consumptive water use.
url:0bdb61f5f7007ae2.abstract_zh: 自然来源的空气污染通常受到的监管较少，但仍可能由人类活动引发。理解政策的作用需要量化该来源的污染贡献，而目前尚无标准方法论。本文以美国犹他州大盐湖萎缩为背景，对高度易蚀且不断扩大的裸露湖床区域的空气质量影响进行建模。利用空气污染文献中四种常见的识别策略及三种替代性污染测量技术，我们发现在非冬季月份，湖泊萎缩导致的污染显著增加具有一致性证据。估计值对测量技术相对不敏感，但随识别策略不同而变化。每100平方公里裸露湖床的边际年成本介于8100万至1.75亿美元之间。按总裸露湖床面积推算，与干涸相关的年度健康成本估计值介于11亿至23亿美元之间。鉴于流域内人类用水与裸露湖床之间的直接关系，这些结果为旨在减少消耗性用水的政策提供了成本效益证据。

url:0c32a8c85adccd2a.abstract: This paper explores factors driving the internationalization of Renminbi (RMB) trading, using data from the 2025 BIS Triennial Survey of global foreign exchange turnover. We analyze both short-term (three-year) trading growth and long-term RMB turnover levels across jurisdictions. Unlike recent studies that struggled to identify sizable effects of real or financial links with China, we find that financial factors, especially banking links with China, play a key role, even over short horizons. These financial links reinforce market-driven "convergence" patterns, whereby RMB trading adjusts based on its under- or over-representation in total currency trading in a given location. However, this convergence is slower than previously reported, while financial drivers have grown in importance. For the long-term geographical distribution of RMB trading, financial links with China, including policy-driven variables such as qualified investor licenses, dominate, though trade links also contribute significantly. We also find that bilateral trade effects are stronger for cross-border RMB trading, and we report new insights on the dynamics in Asian financial centers and trading in spot versus derivatives.
url:0c32a8c85adccd2a.abstract_zh: 本文利用2025年国际清算银行三年期全球外汇交易调查数据，探讨推动人民币交易国际化的因素。我们分析了各司法管辖区人民币交易的短期（三年）增长与长期交易规模。与近期难以发现与中国实体或金融联系具有显著影响的研究不同，我们发现金融因素（尤其是与中国的银行联系）即使在短期内也发挥关键作用。这些金融联系强化了市场驱动的“趋同”模式，即人民币交易根据其在特定地区总货币交易中的占比偏低或偏高进行调整。然而，这种趋同速度慢于此前报告，而金融驱动因素的重要性有所上升。就人民币交易的长期地理分布而言，与中国的金融联系（包括合格投资者牌照等政策驱动变量）占据主导地位，但贸易联系也贡献显著。我们还发现，双边贸易效应对跨境人民币交易更为显著，并报告了关于亚洲金融中心动态以及即期与衍生品交易的新见解。

url:0c75d766671b84c4.abstract: Valuation losses can build quickly in response to higher interest rates, as demonstrated by the collapse of Silicon Valley Bank. This column shows that Italian banks do hedge against interest rate risk and, crucially, increase hedging when rates rise. This suggests banks actively adjust hedging intensity through derivatives, consistent with a state-dependent model of risk management. Institutions with lower capital ratios, a larger share of wholesale funding, and a smaller deposit base hedge more aggressively. These findings highlight the importance of considering derivative exposure in stress-testing frameworks, as derivatives are a key channel through which banks absorb shocks.
url:0c75d766671b84c4.abstract_zh: 利率上升可能导致估值损失迅速累积，硅谷银行的倒闭便印证了这一点。本文研究表明，意大利银行确实会对冲利率风险，且关键的是，当利率上升时，它们会加大对冲力度。这表明银行通过衍生品主动调整对冲强度，这与风险管理的状态依存模型相符。资本充足率较低、批发融资占比更高、存款基础较小的机构，其对冲行为更为激进。这些发现凸显了在压力测试框架中考虑衍生品敞口的重要性，因为衍生品是银行吸收冲击的关键渠道。

url:0c85fa0fc45f011a.abstract: This paper proposes a validation framework for LLM-generated measurements when reliable benchmarks are unavailable. Validity is established by testing whether an LLM can reconstruct passages from annotated labels while maintaining semantic consistency with the original text. The framework avoids circular reasoning by establishing testable prerequisite properties that must be met for a validation to be considered successful. Application to news article data demonstrates that the framework serves as a practical alternative to human benchmarking, which offers advantages in objectivity, scalability, and cost-effectiveness while identifying cases where LLMs capture economic meaning that human evaluators miss.

url:0d910368a6b8cd64.abstract: What role do firms play in geographic wage disparities? This paper exploits establishment mobility as a novel source of identification to separate firm sorting from location treatment effects, i.e., the local wage premium for a given worker at a given firm (due to, e.g., geography, infrastructure, amenities). Using data from France and the U.S., we first document key facts about establishment relocation: 4% of establishments move each year, retaining their activity and structure while adjusting their workforce and wages. Combining establishment and worker mobility in France, we estimate a model that decomposes wage variation due to workers, firms, and locations. Spatial wage differences are primarily driven by sorting: worker composition accounts for 30%, firm composition for 17%, and their co-location for 34%. Residual location effects explain only 2–4%. Establishment sorting also accounts for most of the urban wage premium and the higher wage growth in larger cities.
url:0d910368a6b8cd64.abstract_zh: 企业在地区工资差异中扮演何种角色？本文利用企业迁移作为新的识别来源，将企业分类效应与区位处理效应（即给定工人和给定企业在特定地点获得的工资溢价，例如由地理、基础设施、便利设施等因素导致）分离开来。基于法国和美国的数据，我们首先记录了企业迁移的关键事实：每年有4%的企业迁移，它们在保留自身活动和结构的同时调整员工队伍和工资水平。结合法国企业和工人的流动性，我们估计了一个分解工人、企业和地点对工资变化影响的模型。空间工资差异主要由分类效应驱动：工人构成解释30%，企业构成解释17%，两者共同定位解释34%。残余的区位效应仅解释2-4%。企业分类效应还解释了大部分城市工资溢价以及大城市中更高的工资增长。

url:0e57bac241ebf977.abstract: How does terrorism affect labor markets in developing countries? We combine georeferenced data on terrorist incidents with nationally representative employment data from Nigeria to examine this question. Exploiting within-location variation in exposure to terrorist attacks over time, we show that terrorism reduces employment. A one standard deviation increase in exposure lowers the probability of employment by 0.7 percentage points, or roughly 1 percent of average employment, with substantially larger effects for women. Beyond reducing employment, terrorism shifts workers away from regular and cash-paying jobs and lowers employment in sales, services, and unskilled manual occupations. The findings identify labor market disruption as an important economic cost of insecurity in developing countries.
url:0e57bac241ebf977.abstract_zh: 恐怖主义如何影响发展中国家的劳动力市场？我们将恐怖袭击的地理参照数据与尼日利亚具有全国代表性的就业数据相结合来研究这一问题。通过利用同一地区在不同时期遭受恐怖袭击暴露程度的差异，我们发现恐怖主义会降低就业水平。恐怖袭击暴露程度每增加一个标准差，就业概率将下降0.7个百分点（约占平均就业率的1%），且对女性的影响显著更大。除减少就业外，恐怖主义还促使劳动者从正规就业和现金支付岗位转移，并导致销售、服务业及非熟练体力劳动岗位的就业下降。研究结果表明，劳动力市场紊乱是发展中国家不安全局势的重要经济代价。

url:0e5e72595eab5c99.abstract_zh: 本文研究了非正规竞争——即正规企业面临的来自非正规企业的竞争——对正规制造业中小企业提供的员工培训的影响。基于23个撒哈拉以南非洲国家中小型制造企业的代表性数据集，发现非正规竞争对员工培训存在显著的负面影响。非正规竞争每增加一个标准差，企业为员工提供培训的概率将下降8.7至12.9个百分点，而样本中提供培训的企业均值约为25%。员工接受培训的比例也出现了类似的下降。为解决潜在的内生性问题，本文采用了多种互补策略。首先，利用工具变量法，通过每名育龄妇女对应的0-4岁和5-9岁儿童数量的变化，生成非正规竞争的外生变动。其次，基于非正规经济的“合法主义”观点进行异质性检验，该观点预测在法治较弱、商业监管更严格的环境中，非正规竞争的负面影响更大。第三，利用其他地区企业的信息，构建行业层面非正规竞争的样本外预测。研究结果表明，非正规竞争严重制约了正规企业的培训投资，凸显了制定政策以减轻其负面影响的必要性。

url:0e7d4656ac4888ba.abstract: This study analyses weekly port calls from 2019 to 2026 to evaluate the Russia–Ukraine war's impact on maritime trade. The data reveals clear structural shifts that Ukrainian traffic moved from high‐risk areas like Odesa to safer Danube River ports. On the other hand, Russia sustained its maritime activity by navigating sanctions and redirecting exports to Asian markets. The Black Sea Grain Initiative also improved navigation conditions for both countries. Overall, the war caused domestic port substitution within Ukraine and a broader logistical reorganization for Russia.
url:0e7d4656ac4888ba.abstract_zh: 本研究分析了2019年至2026年的周度港口停靠数据，以评估俄乌战争对海上贸易的影响。数据揭示了明显的结构性转变：乌克兰的航运从敖德萨等高危地区转移至更安全的多瑙河港口。另一方面，俄罗斯通过规避制裁并将出口转向亚洲市场，维持了其海上活动。黑海谷物倡议也改善了两国的航行条件。总体而言，战争导致了乌克兰国内港口的替代效应，并引发了俄罗斯更广泛的物流重组。

url:0f3f241a884f0ea3.abstract: This paper examines the drivers of wage growth in Europe and assesses whether the 2022–23 inflation surge has altered wage-setting dynamics, using cross-country macro evidence for 26 European economies, agreement-level collective bargaining data for Spain, and estimates of minimum and public sector wage spillovers. We find that the slope of the wage Phillips curve has not materially changed since the pandemic—labor market slack continues exerting a restraining influence on wage growth. However, postpandemic wage growth was higher than predicted by historical relationships, reflecting the outsized inflation shock and a higher sensitivity of wages to past inflation. Wage-setting is found to differ markedly across regions. In Central, Eastern, and Southeastern European Economies (CESEE), wage formation remains more backward-looking, with past inflation playing a dominant role, whereas in Advanced Economies (AEs) inflation expectations are more important. In AEs, the recent wage response followed a sequential pattern: the wage drift rose early as employers granted ad hoc increases, while negotiated wages adjusted with a lag as collective agreements were renewed and workers recouped accumulated real wage losses. Micro evidence from Spain shows that institutional features of collective bargaining conditionally amplify inflation pass-through: CPI indexation clauses, sector-level bargaining, and shorter contract duration are each associated with stronger wage responses to past inflation. In parallel, minimum wage pass-through has strengthened markedly in CESEE since 2015, while public sector wages dampened aggregate wage growth in AEs but amplified it in CESEE during 2022–24. Taken together, these findings suggest that while the core Phillips curve mechanism remains intact, future inflation shocks could generate more persistent wage pressures where wage-setting is more backward-looking, inflation compensation becomes institutionalized (including through indexation that interacts with downward nominal rigidity), or discretionary minimum and public sector wage policies add impetus.
url:0f3f241a884f0ea3.abstract_zh: 本文利用26个欧洲经济体的跨国宏观数据、西班牙的协议层面集体谈判数据以及最低工资与公共部门工资溢出效应的估算，考察了欧洲工资增长的驱动因素，并评估2022-23年通胀飙升是否改变了工资设定动态。研究发现，自疫情以来，工资菲利普斯曲线的斜率并未发生实质性变化——劳动力市场松弛仍对工资增长产生抑制作用。然而，疫情后工资增长高于历史关系预测水平，这反映了巨大的通胀冲击以及工资对过去通胀的更高敏感性。工资设定在不同地区存在显著差异。在中东欧及东南欧经济体（CESEE）中，工资形成仍更偏向回顾性，过去通胀起主导作用；而在发达经济体（AEs）中，通胀预期更为重要。在发达经济体中，近期的工资反应遵循了顺序模式：工资漂移率先上升，因为雇主提供了临时性加薪，而随着集体协议更新和工人弥补累积的实际工资损失，协商工资则滞后调整。来自西班牙的微观证据表明，集体谈判的制度特征有条件地放大了通胀传导：CPI指数化条款、行业层面谈判以及较短的合同期限均与工资对过去通胀的更强反应相关。与此同时，自2015年以来，最低工资传导在CESEE显著增强，而公共部门工资在2022-24年间抑制了发达经济体的总体工资增长，但在CESEE却放大了工资增长。综合来看，这些发现表明，尽管核心菲利普斯曲线机制保持完整，但未来通胀冲击可能在以下情况下产生更持久的工资压力：工资设定更偏向回顾性、通胀补偿变得制度化（包括通过指数化与名义向下刚性相互作用）、或自由裁量的最低工资和公共部门工资政策增加推动力。
authors: Kareem Ismail & Ana Lariau & Théodore Renault

url:0f62f6ba54cb5b26.abstract: This paper studies the macroeconomic dynamics of climate policy in a multi-sector dynamic general equilibrium model with renewable and non-renewable energy, sector-specific capital adjustment frictions, household energy demand, and endogenous fossil resource dynamics. The central mechanism is that decarbonization requires reallocating energy use and installed capital: fossil energy demand can contract immediately, while renewable capacity and abatement adjust only gradually. The analysis delivers four results. First, gradual policy implementation sharply reduces transition costs: relative to immediate implementation, gradual emissions caps improve welfare by 2.26 percentage points under comprehensive regulation and by 5.06 percentage points under firm-only regulation. Second, renewable energy subsidies and non-renewable energy taxes support renewable capital accumulation and reduce, but do not eliminate, the welfare cost of front-loaded tightening. Third, sectoral coverage changes the welfare ranking across implementation speeds. Firm-only regulation performs better under gradual implementation because it shields utility-relevant household energy services, but becomes nearly as costly as the carbon-price-only transition under immediate implementation. Fourth, endogenous fossil exploration and stock-dependent extraction costs transmit climate policy into lower extraction, fewer discoveries, and a declining shadow value of reserves, providing a structural mechanism for stranded fossil assets. The results show that deep decarbonization can be achieved at substantially lower macroeconomic cost when policy manages the speed and incidence of energy-capital reallocation.
url:0f62f6ba54cb5b26.abstract_zh: 本文在多部门动态一般均衡模型中研究气候政策的宏观经济动态，该模型包含可再生能源与不可再生能源、部门特定的资本调整摩擦、家庭能源需求以及内生的化石资源动态。核心机制在于：脱碳需要重新配置能源使用和已安装资本——化石能源需求可立即收缩，而可再生能源产能与减排措施仅能逐步调整。分析得出四项结论。第一，渐进式政策实施能显著降低转型成本：相较于立即实施，在全面监管下渐进式排放上限可使福利提升2.26个百分点，在企业单独监管下则提升5.06个百分点。第二，可再生能源补贴与不可再生能源税有助于促进可再生能源资本积累，并降低（但无法消除）前置收紧带来的福利成本。第三，部门覆盖范围会改变不同实施速度下的福利排序。渐进式实施中企业单独监管表现更优，因其保护了与效用相关的家庭能源服务，但在立即实施下其成本几乎与仅依赖碳价格的转型相当。第四，内生的化石能源勘探与储量依赖型开采成本使气候政策传导为开采量下降、发现量减少及储量影子价值降低，为化石资产搁浅提供了结构性机制。研究结果表明，当政策能够管理能源-资本重新配置的速度与影响范围时，深度脱碳可在显著降低宏观经济成本的条件下实现。
url:0f62f6ba54cb5b26.title: Climate Policy and The Energy Transition

url:0fa9abe17d89906f.abstract: This paper studies the effects of the Green Revolution, one of the largest development projects in the late 20th-Century, on individualism. We use a difference-in-differences approach to investigate how rapid technological and organizational changes in traditional agriculture reshaped cultural norms in Indonesia, where Green Revolution rollout was largely driven by centralized government interventions. Regions with greater exposure to Green Revolution policies experienced significant and persistent increases in individualism (as measured by a higher prevalence of infrequent names) decades after the end of the program. Results are not driven by pre-trends and hold across a battery of robustness checks. We further document suggestive, correlational evidence of a persistent fall in community funding for public goods, a key measure of collective action. Our findings suggest that technical change can lead to rapid and persistent changes in culture.
url:0fa9abe17d89906f.abstract_zh: 本文研究20世纪末最大规模发展项目之一——绿色革命对个人主义的影响。我们采用双重差分法，探究传统农业中快速的技术与组织变革如何重塑印度尼西亚的文化规范。在该国，绿色革命的推广主要由中央政府干预驱动。研究显示，在项目结束数十年后，受绿色革命政策影响较大的地区，其个人主义（以罕见名字出现频率升高为衡量指标）显著且持续增强。该结果不受事前趋势影响，并通过了一系列稳健性检验。我们进一步发现具有提示性的相关证据：作为集体行动关键指标的公共品社区资金投入持续下降。研究结果表明，技术变革能够引发文化快速且持久的变迁。
url:0fa9abe17d89906f.title: The Green Revolution and individualism: Evidence from Indonesia

url:0fd9f776952ff8d4.abstract: We present a new constraint on the size of the Fed’s balance sheet: repo market capacity. Calibrating a structural model to the recent monetary tightening cycle, we show that repo market capacity—driven by money market fund liquidity supply—is the binding constraint on the Fed’s balance sheet, not bank reserve demand, which was highlighted in the events of September 2019. We also demonstrate a novel complementarity between interest rate and balance sheet policies: higher policy rates expand repo capacity, allowing the central bank to operate with a smaller balance sheet.
url:0fd9f776952ff8d4.abstract_zh: 我们提出了美联储资产负债表规模的新约束条件：回购市场容量。通过将结构性模型校准至近期的货币紧缩周期，我们表明，由货币市场基金流动性供给驱动的回购市场容量才是美联储资产负债表的约束性条件，而非2019年9月事件中凸显的银行准备金需求。我们还揭示了利率政策与资产负债表政策之间一种新颖的互补关系：更高的政策利率会扩大回购市场容量，从而使央行能够以更小的资产负债表规模运作。

url:10206a09b764f828.abstract: This study examines the macroeconomic drivers of corporate investment in the United Kingdom using a multivariate time-series framework. Focusing on five key variables-interest rates, inflation, GDP growth, exchange rates, and corporate profits-the analysis investigates their combined effects on aggregate corporate investment using annual data from 1990 to 2022. By concentrating on macroeconomic determinants rather than firm-level factors, the study provides evidence on how monetary and real-sector conditions shape investment behavior in a mature, market-based economy. The contribution of this study lies in integrating long-run macroeconomic trends within a multivariate econometric framework that captures interactions between corporate profits, inflation, and exchange-rate movements in the UK over three decades of evolving policy regimes. Given the mixed order of integration among the variables, the study employs an Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) bounds testing approach to examine long-run relationships and short-run adjustment dynamics. OLS and Two-Stage Least Squares (2SLS) estimates are retained as benchmark and robustness checks. The results indicate that higher interest rates exert a significant positive effect on corporate investment, consistent with the endogenous and pro-cyclical nature of UK monetary policy. Corporate profits have a strong positive influence, highlighting the importance of internal finance. Inflation exhibits a negative and significant impact, while GDP growth shows a weak accelerator effect and exchange-rate movements are statistically insignificant. These findings underscore the dominance of profitability and policy credibility in driving UK investment and offer relevant insights for sustaining long-term capital formation.
url:10206a09b764f828.abstract_zh: 本研究采用多元时间序列框架，考察英国企业投资的宏观经济驱动因素。聚焦利率、通胀、GDP增长、汇率及企业利润五大关键变量，基于1990年至2022年的年度数据，分析其对总体企业投资的综合影响。通过聚焦宏观层面而非企业层面的决定因素，本研究揭示了货币与实体部门条件如何塑造成熟市场经济体的投资行为。本研究的贡献在于，将长期宏观经济趋势整合至多元计量框架中，捕捉英国三十年间政策体制演变下企业利润、通胀与汇率波动之间的交互作用。鉴于变量间存在混合阶数整合特征，研究采用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）边界检验法，考察长期关系与短期调整动态。同时保留普通最小二乘法（OLS）与两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）的估计结果，作为基准检验与稳健性验证。结果表明：利率上升对企业投资具有显著正向效应，这与英国货币政策的内生性与顺周期性特征一致；企业利润呈现强正向影响，凸显内部融资的重要性；通胀具有显著负向影响，而GDP增长仅呈现微弱加速效应，汇率波动则无统计显著性。这些发现强调了盈利能力与政策可信度对英国投资的主导作用，为维持长期资本形成提供了相关启示。
url:10206a09b764f828.title: Macroeconomic Drivers of Corporate Investment in the United Kingdom: A Multivariate Analysis

url:102dcdb11572cf15.abstract: The effectiveness of many interventions depends on implementer quality; as programs scale and the pool of implementers broadens, average quality falls. Conversation-based interventions, such as counseling or peer mentoring, are particularly sensitive to implementer skill. LLMs offer a natural way out: they can hold personalized exchanges at zero marginal cost and uniform quality. Whether AI can replicate, or even improve on, the human skills thought to make such interventions effective remains an open question. We run a nationwide experiment in Chile (N=41,000) comparing an AI-powered chatbot, Kai, with trained human counselors. Both arms reach high school seniors via WhatsApp and aim to motivate them toward teaching careers, addressing future teacher shortages. Among students with baseline interest in teaching (the main target of the intervention) Kai significantly increases the probability of ranking an education major first as well as the share of education majors in students' choice sets; estimates in the human arm are smaller and not statistically significant. We use text analysis to characterize conversational attributes and test mechanisms. Both arms cover a comparable breadth of topics, but Kai concentrates on factual content while human counselors lean on subjective, socioemotional material. Kai's exchanges are substantially faster and more dynamic, with near-instantaneous responses and shorter student gaps, and more semantically coherent on both sides. Human counselors, in turn, score substantially higher on motivation and empathy. We interpret these results as evidence that AI relaxes the implementer-quality constraint in conversation-based interventions at scale.
url:102dcdb11572cf15.abstract_zh: 许多干预措施的有效性取决于实施者的素质；随着项目规模扩大和实施者群体拓宽，平均素质会下降。基于对话的干预措施（如咨询或同伴指导）对实施者的技能尤为敏感。大语言模型提供了一种自然的解决方案：它们能够以零边际成本和统一质量进行个性化交流。人工智能能否复制甚至提升被认为使此类干预措施有效的人类技能，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们在智利开展了一项全国性实验（样本量N=41,000），将人工智能驱动的聊天机器人Kai与受过培训的人类咨询师进行对比。两组干预均通过WhatsApp联系高中毕业生，旨在激励他们选择教师职业，以应对未来教师短缺问题。在基线阶段对教学职业感兴趣的学生（干预的主要目标群体）中，Kai显著提高了他们将教育专业列为第一志愿的概率，以及教育专业在学生选择组合中的占比；而人类咨询师组的估计值较小且未达到统计显著性。我们通过文本分析来刻画对话特征并检验作用机制。两组干预覆盖的话题广度相当，但Kai侧重于事实性内容，而人类咨询师更依赖主观的社会情感素材。Kai的对话速度更快、互动性更强，表现为近乎即时的回复和更短的学生回应间隔，且双方对话的语义连贯性更高。相比之下，人类咨询师在动机激发和共情能力方面得分显著更高。我们将这些结果解读为：人工智能在规模化实施基于对话的干预措施时，能够缓解实施者素质这一约束条件。

url:1108621b880131f1.abstract: Conventional demographic models systematically overestimate fertility decline in sub-Saharan Africa. This paper proposes a complementary explanation grounded in a prevalent but understudied belief system: ancestors influence the living and seek the continuation of their lineage, into which they may be reincarnated. In this worldview, having children becomes a moral and collective duty, rooted in the spiritual responsibility to ensure the survival of the lineage. Drawing on first-hand data, novel ethnographic information, and historical and contemporary surveys, I document a strong and quantitatively large positive relationship between ancestral beliefs and fertility across contexts and time periods. A simple model in which children are a public good for the lineage rationalizes the patterns observed in the data: the fertility effect of ancestral beliefs is concentrated in patrilineal societies, and a specific form of free-riding emerges among siblings whose children continue the same family line. These findings suggest that high fertility in sub-Saharan Africa rests on moral foundations that standard, externally designed interventions tend to overlook.
url:1108621b880131f1.abstract_zh: 传统人口模型系统性地高估了撒哈拉以南非洲地区的生育率下降趋势。本文提出一种基于普遍存在但研究不足的信仰体系的补充解释：祖先影响生者，并寻求其血脉延续，生者可能转世为后代。在这种世界观中，生育子女成为一项道德与集体义务，根植于确保血脉存续的精神责任。通过利用一手数据、新颖的民族志信息以及历史与当代调查，本文记录了祖先信仰与生育率之间在不同情境与时间跨度中呈现的强烈且数量显著的正向关联。一个将子女视为血脉公共品的简单模型，合理化了数据中观察到的模式：祖先信仰对生育率的影响集中于父系社会，且兄弟姐妹间因子女延续同一家族血脉而出现特定形式的搭便车行为。这些发现表明，撒哈拉以南非洲的高生育率建立在道德基础之上，而标准的外部干预措施往往忽视这一基础。

url:1144b5923afa68db.abstract: Since the 1990s, the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) has reported much more rapid growth in U.S. private sector employer establishments than has the Census Bureau – the gap reached roughly 1.6 million by 2023. Using linked BLS-Census microdata, we document two main drivers. First, a large and growing number of employers providing services to the elderly and persons with disabilities are in scope for the BLS frame but not the Census Bureau’s. Second, many firms appear with substantially more establishments in the BLS frame. These discrepancies substantially affect the measured establishment size distribution and quantitative policy analysis.
url:1144b5923afa68db.abstract_zh: 自20世纪90年代以来，美国劳工统计局（BLS）报告的私营部门雇主机构数量增速远超人口普查局——截至2023年，两者差距已达约160万家。通过关联BLS与人口普查局的微观数据，我们揭示了两大驱动因素：其一，为老年人和残障人士提供服务的雇主机构中，有大量且持续增长的机构属于BLS统计框架范围，但未被纳入人口普查局框架；其二，许多企业在BLS框架中显示的机构数量显著更多。这些差异对测度的机构规模分布及量化政策分析产生了实质性影响。

url:11bfa69a6b2131ba.abstract: Liquidity is central to modern fixed-income markets, yet it is often treated too simply. Bonds are commonly described as liquid or illiquid, as though liquidity were a fixed quality built into the security itself. This book challenges that view. It argues that liquidity is not a permanent feature of a bond, but a fragile condition created by market structure, financing arrangements, collateral rules, dealer capacity, valuation practices, regulation, and investor behaviour. The Endogeneity of Liquidity Risk in Leveraged Fixed-Income Systems develops a clear theory of how liquidity is created inside the financial system and how it can disappear under stress. A bond may appear easy to sell in calm markets, financeable through repo, acceptable as collateral, and stable in daily valuation. Yet those qualities may depend on conditions that change quickly when volatility rises, funding tightens, or many investors try to exit at the same time.
url:11bfa69a6b2131ba.abstract_zh: 流动性是现代固定收益市场的核心，但常被过于简单化地对待。债券通常被描述为具有流动性或缺乏流动性，仿佛流动性是证券本身固有的固定属性。本书挑战了这一观点，认为流动性并非债券的永久特征，而是由市场结构、融资安排、抵押品规则、交易商能力、估值实践、监管及投资者行为共同塑造的脆弱状态。《杠杆固定收益系统中流动性风险的内生性》构建了一套清晰的理论，阐释流动性如何在金融体系内部被创造，又如何在压力下消失。一只债券在平静市场中可能看似易于出售、可通过回购融资、可被接受为抵押品且日常估值稳定，但这些特质可能依赖于某些条件——当波动性上升、资金收紧或大量投资者同时试图退出时，这些条件会迅速改变。

url:1223ef23a75d452b.abstract: The EU’s fiscal governance framework was built to contribute to overall macroeconomic stability through compliance with fiscal rules and the commitment not to bail-out countries in trouble. Yet successive crises have revealed vulnerabilities under systemic stress: countries with a propensity to run deficits push frugal ones into ex-post bail-out arrangements to avert collapse, thus undermining the ex-ante credibility of the framework. The absence of a permanent, preventive instrument forces the Union to oscillate between leniency and emergency intervention. A permanent RRF-like mechanism - linking EU funds to reform and investment projects - offers an incentive compatible solution and a possible bridge to a larger EU budget.
url:1223ef23a75d452b.abstract_zh: 欧盟的财政治理框架旨在通过遵守财政规则以及不救助陷入困境国家的承诺，促进整体宏观经济稳定。然而，接连不断的危机揭示了系统性压力下的脆弱性：倾向于赤字运行的国家迫使节俭国家在事后采取救助安排以避免崩溃，从而削弱了该框架的事前可信度。由于缺乏永久性的预防工具，欧盟不得不在宽松政策与紧急干预之间摇摆。一个类似复苏与韧性基金的永久性机制——将欧盟资金与改革和投资项目挂钩——提供了一种激励相容的解决方案，并可能成为迈向更大规模欧盟预算的桥梁。

url:126068d80c2389c8.abstract: We study the effect of pre-booked COVID-19 vaccination appointments using a nationwide campaign in Austria. Leveraging administrative microdata on more than 450000 initially unvaccinated adults, we exploit cross-state variation in program participation and staggered appointment timing in a difference-in-differences design. Pre-booked appointments increase vaccination on the appointment day by 0.8 percentage points (8 per 1000), with no evidence of intertemporal substitution. Effects are larger for socio-economically disadvantaged individuals and substantially weaker in areas with stronger vaccine skepticism. The findings suggest that behavioral interventions are effective when low uptake reflects frictions, but have limited impact when driven by entrenched skepticism.
url:126068d80c2389c8.abstract_zh: 我们利用奥地利全国性运动的数据，研究了预先预约新冠疫苗接种预约的效果。基于超过45万名初始未接种成年人的行政微观数据，我们采用双重差分法，利用各州在项目参与率及预约时间安排上的差异。预先预约使接种当日的疫苗接种率提高了0.8个百分点（每千人8人），且未发现跨期替代效应。该效应在社会经济弱势群体中更为显著，而在疫苗怀疑论较强的地区则明显减弱。研究结果表明，当低接种率源于摩擦性障碍时，行为干预措施有效；但当其源于根深蒂固的怀疑态度时，干预效果有限。

url:12cccde4382b5a11.abstract: Over the past century, the United States has provided dollar liquidity abroad through both the US Treasury and the Federal Reserve, but the appropriate mode of liquidity injection depends on the economic, financial, and geopolitical contexts. The Treasury is the more appropriate lending conduit when geopolitical concerns dominate, while Fed dollar provision should primarily be targeted toward global stability objectives and be more insulated from short-term foreign policy motives. Up to now, political abuses of these foreign lending channels have been constrained to some degree by laws, norms, and intergovernmental understandings, but adherence can no longer be assumed, so more formal guardrails are needed.
url:12cccde4382b5a11.abstract_zh: 过去一个世纪以来，美国通过财政部和美联储向海外提供美元流动性，但适当的流动性注入模式取决于经济、金融和地缘政治背景。当地缘政治关切占主导地位时，财政部是更合适的贷款渠道，而美联储的美元供给应主要针对全球稳定目标，并更少受短期外交政策动机的影响。迄今为止，法律、规范及政府间谅解在一定程度上约束了这些对外贷款渠道的政治滥用，但已无法假定各方会继续遵守，因此需要更正式的防护措施。

url:13a6edba715350ed.abstract: The rapid expansion of high-speed internet has intensified concerns about how digital technologies affect early childhood. url:13f6f941706fb123.abstract: Increased vertical integration and coordination are defining features of transforming and modernizing agricultural value chains in low- and middle-income countries, with important implications for market efficiency and farm-level transformation. However, research documenting these processes in modernizing domestic value chains is limited, and tends to focus on foreign direct investment and high-value food products. We study the rice value chain – the most important staple in Southeast Asia – in Myanmar and use unique data from domestic rice mills and farmers to analyze millers’ expansion into other businesses and services. We show that both modern and traditional mills serve as key nodes in local rice value chains, fulfilling diverse roles beyond processing at both the farm and post-farm levels and highlighting a co-development of modern processing and vertical integration. Yet, statistical tests that control for mill and farmer characteristics, respectively, show that modern mills are more engaged in vertical integration and coordination, particularly in post-farm value chain segments, highlighting the co-development of modern processing and business expansion. Consistent with this pattern in the miller data, farmers using a modern mill are more likely to receive complementary services – especially post-farm – and to adopt modern production practices more broadly. However, this expansion is uneven, reaching large farms more frequently than small and medium farms.
url:13f6f941706fb123.abstract_zh: 在中低收入国家，农业价值链的转型与现代化进程中，纵向整合与协调的增强是显著特征，这对市场效率和农场层面的转型具有重要影响。然而，记录国内价值链现代化过程中这些进程的研究较为有限，且往往聚焦于外国直接投资和高价值食品产品。我们以缅甸水稻价值链——东南亚最重要的主食——为研究对象，利用国内稻米加工厂和农户的独特数据，分析加工厂向其他业务和服务的扩张。研究表明，现代和传统加工厂均作为当地水稻价值链的关键节点，在农场和农场后层面承担加工以外的多元角色，凸显了现代加工与纵向整合的协同发展。然而，分别控制加工厂和农户特征的统计检验显示，现代加工厂在纵向整合与协调方面参与度更高，尤其在农场后价值链环节，这进一步印证了现代加工与业务扩张的协同发展。与加工厂数据中的这一模式一致，使用现代加工厂的农户更有可能获得补充性服务（尤其是农场后服务），并更广泛地采用现代生产实践。然而，这种扩张并不均衡，大农户比中小农户更频繁地受益。

url:1475186647063c42.abstract: Circulation into and out of the top one percent is pronounced in the U.S. One third exit after a year and two-thirds exit after a decade. This mobility lowers top income shares when shifting from annual to multi-year income measures. Intragenerational mobility over two decades lowers recent top one percent fiscal income shares by over 10 percent. Two-decade mobility reduces top 0.1% shares by over 20 percent, top 0.01% shares by 30 percent, and top 0.001% shares by 40 percent. Effects of variability on wealth inequality are similar in magnitude, although more modest as a share of top wealth inequality.
url:1475186647063c42.abstract_zh: 美国收入前1%群体的流入与流出变动显著：一年后三分之一退出，十年后三分之二退出。这种流动性在将收入衡量周期从年度扩展至多年时，会降低顶层收入份额。二十年的代内流动性使近期前1%的财政总收入份额下降超过10%，前0.1%份额下降超过20%，前0.01%份额下降30%，前0.001%份额下降40%。收入波动对财富不平等的影响幅度与之相似，但就顶层财富不平等占比而言更为温和。

url:14d1cd210b6f6451.abstract: How households behave in an environment with deposit rates below zero is important for monetary transmission, but the literature is scant. This column studies household behaviour in the context of a major episode of negative interest rates in Denmark. This authors find that the negative deposit rates led to a strong decrease in deposits. Households appear to react more sharply when interest rates below zero are cut compared to when rates are positive. As depositors seem to consume more rather than hold more cash, policy rate cuts in negative territory may have particularly strong consumption effects.
url:14d1cd210b6f6451.abstract_zh: 家庭在存款利率为负的环境中的行为对货币传导至关重要，但相关文献较为匮乏。本文以丹麦负利率重大事件为背景，研究家庭行为。作者发现，负存款利率导致存款大幅减少。与正利率时期相比，当利率降至负值区间时，家庭反应更为剧烈。由于储户似乎更倾向于增加消费而非持有更多现金，负利率区间的政策利率下调可能对消费产生尤为显著的影响。

url:14f7e7dc06686611.abstract: The European Union promotes the provision of agri-environment-climate public goods (AECPGs) from agriculture and forestry through dedicated policies. Nevertheless, despite long-term efforts and earmarking of significant financial resources for voluntary agri-environmental schemes, the provision of AECPGs from Europe’s agro-ecosystems is continuing to decline. New governance instruments are urgently required to revert this process. Promising new approaches are seen in novel contract solutions promoting result-based payments, collective implementation, and value-chain-based approaches. However, a deeper understanding of the practical design of these novel schemes is needed to achieve acceptance and successful implementation. We systematically examine real-world examples of contract solutions and their design characteristics by analyzing a dataset of 44 case studies from 13 European countries. Data or information from these case studies was collected using a uniform protocol across countries, and a qualitative content analysis was conducted. Our findings show that result-based approaches differ in their design with regard to measuring environmental performance. Successful result-based approaches enable flexible management, include features for knowledge provision, and are often designed as hybrid solutions to enhance uptake, combining action- and result-based elements. Collective contract solutions are based on a common management agreement of the involved group members, but vary in their degree of formalization, often include a coordinator, and foster meetings and exchanges. Value chain-based solutions differ in terms of the relationship between the production of private goods and the provision of AECPGs, their incentive system, value chain characteristics, and marketing, and often comprise an element of cooperation, also representing a hybrid approach. The findings of this research can help shape the design of such alternative approaches and provide inspiration for promoting the voluntary delivery of AECPGs under the Common Agriculture Policy (CAP) and beyond. url:14f7e7dc06686611.abstract_zh: 欧盟通过专项政策推动农业与林业提供农业-环境-气候公共产品（AECPGs）。然而，尽管长期投入大量财政资源用于自愿性农业环境计划，欧洲农业生态系统提供的AECPGs仍在持续减少。亟需新的治理工具来扭转这一趋势。新型合同方案展现出前景，包括推广基于结果的支付、集体实施以及基于价值链的方法。但为获得认可并成功实施，需深入理解这些新型方案的实际设计。我们通过分析来自13个欧洲国家的44个案例数据集，系统考察了合同方案的真实案例及其设计特征。这些案例的数据或信息采用跨国统一协议收集，并进行了定性内容分析。研究结果表明：基于结果的方法在环境绩效衡量设计上存在差异；成功的基于结果方法允许灵活管理，包含知识供给特征，且常设计为结合行动与结果要素的混合方案以提升采纳率。集体合同方案基于参与群体成员的共同管理协议，但正式化程度各异，通常设有协调人，并促进会议与交流。基于价值链的方案在私人物品生产与AECPGs供给的关系、激励机制、价值链特征及营销方式上存在差异，且常包含合作要素，同样体现混合模式。本研究结果有助于塑造此类替代方案的设计，并为在共同农业政策（CAP）及其他框架下促进AECPGs自愿供给提供启示。

url:1600db9f56ef62ce.abstract: China’s efforts to develop commodity futures markets and enhance its influence over commodity pricing are best understood as part of a broader strategy to reduce financial vulnerabilities and increase strategic autonomy within a hierarchical global financial system. Commodity pricing power – defined as the capacity to shape the infrastructures, regulation, participation and currency denomination of derivative markets through which prices are formed – has become an increasingly important component of geopolitical competition. For China, this is not about economic efficiency, but control over the terms under which strategically important commodities are valued and traded.
url:1600db9f56ef62ce.abstract_zh: 中国发展商品期货市场并增强其对大宗商品定价影响力的努力，应被理解为在层级化全球金融体系中减少金融脆弱性、提升战略自主性的更广泛战略的一部分。大宗商品定价权——即塑造衍生品市场基础设施、监管规则、参与主体及货币计价方式的能力，价格正是通过这一市场形成的——已成为地缘政治竞争日益重要的组成部分。对中国而言，这并非关乎经济效率，而是对战略性大宗商品估值与交易条件的掌控。

url:16631f41370ff489.abstract: Prediction markets offer a new market-based approach to measuring macroeconomic expectations in real-time. We evaluate the accuracy of prediction market-implied forecasts from Kalshi, the largest federally regulated prediction market overseen by the CFTC. We compare Kalshi with more traditional survey and market-implied forecasts, examine how expectations respond to macroeconomic and financial news, and how policy signals are interpreted by market participants. Our results suggest that Kalshi markets provide a high-frequency, continuously updated, distributionally rich benchmark that is valuable to both researchers and policymakers.
url:16631f41370ff489.abstract_zh: 预测市场提供了一种基于市场的新方法，用于实时衡量宏观经济预期。我们评估了由CFTC监管的、美国最大的联邦监管预测市场Kalshi所隐含预测的准确性。我们将Kalshi与传统调查及市场隐含预测进行比较，考察预期如何对宏观经济和金融新闻做出反应，以及市场参与者如何解读政策信号。研究结果表明，Kalshi市场提供了一个高频、持续更新、分布信息丰富的基准，对研究人员和政策制定者均具有重要价值。

url:1669ee60e949db3c.abstract: This paper studies formal employment dynamics using linked employer-employee data from eight countries spanning a wide income range from Kenya to Chile. First, we show that formality rates increase with development, both between and within countries, because more workers enter the formal sector, not because they spend more time in formal jobs. Second, formal labor market fluidity increases with development, as workers hold more formal jobs, spend less time in each job, and less time between jobs. Third, greater fluidity is associated with higher life-cycle wage growth, which is largely accounted for by within- rather than between-firm wage gains.
url:1669ee60e949db3c.abstract_zh: 本文利用涵盖从肯尼亚到智利等八个收入水平差异显著国家的关联雇主-雇员数据，研究正规就业的动态变化。首先，我们发现正规就业率随经济发展而上升，这一趋势既存在于国家之间也存在于国家内部，其原因是更多工人进入正规部门，而非他们在正规岗位上的工作时间延长。其次，正规劳动力市场的流动性随经济发展而增强，表现为工人从事更多正规工作、每份工作持续时间缩短、以及工作间隔时间减少。第三，更高的流动性伴随着更显著的生命周期工资增长，这主要归因于企业内部而非企业间的工资提升。
url:1669ee60e949db3c.title: Formal Labor Market Dynamics and Development

url:166f28b2ae37bbc1.abstract: We study how macroeconomic developments affect asset prices by analyzing the response of equity yields to a well-identified long-run growth shock. Using synthetic equity yield data from Giglio et al. (2024), we show that a positive long-run shock steepens the equity yield curve by increasing expected dividend growth while leaving discount rates largely unchanged. We examine how the investment driving this growth is financed and how yields respond across value and growth firms. Growth-firm yields respond more strongly than value-firm yields, reflecting larger changes in expected dividend growth. Ai et al. (2018)'s model, modified to separate cash dividends from total payout, best matches these responses relative to benchmark equity term structure models.
url:166f28b2ae37bbc1.abstract_zh: 本文通过分析股票收益率对明确识别的长期增长冲击的反应，研究宏观经济变化如何影响资产价格。利用Giglio等人（2024）的合成股票收益率数据，我们发现正向长期冲击通过提高预期股息增长率使股票收益率曲线陡峭化，而贴现率基本保持不变。我们考察了驱动这一增长的投资融资方式，以及价值型与成长型公司收益率的差异化反应。成长型公司收益率对冲击的反应强于价值型公司，这反映了其预期股息增长率的更大变化。相较于基准股票期限结构模型，Ai等人（2018）的模型（经修正以分离现金股息与总派息）最能匹配这些反应特征。
url:166f28b2ae37bbc1.title: The Response of Equity Yields to a Long-Run Shock

url:16761602fd1236ec.abstract: Did globalisation benefit consumers in poor countries? Using data on trade in goods for 138 countries, we measure the welfare gains from wider variety and higher quality of imported goods over the past quarter-century. The variety gains are large, a median 19 percent fall in the cost of living, and strongly pro-poor: poorer countries gained twice as much as richer ones. Because they derive from falling trade costs, variety gains made poor countries richer in real consumption even in the absence of income growth. Quality, by contrast, tracks income, and because income barely converged, neither did quality.
url:16761602fd1236ec.abstract_zh: 全球化是否惠及贫困国家的消费者？基于138个国家的商品贸易数据，我们测算了过去25年间进口商品种类扩大与质量提升所带来的福利收益。种类扩大带来的收益显著，使生活成本中位数下降19%，且具有强烈的亲贫效应：贫困国家的收益是富裕国家的两倍。由于这些收益源于贸易成本下降，即便收入未增长，种类扩大仍使贫困国家的实际消费水平提升。相比之下，质量提升与收入水平挂钩，而由于收入趋同现象微弱，质量趋同亦未实现。

url:17247184469e35ca.abstract: We show that the optimal monetary policy and exchange rate framework depend critically on the economy’s commodity exposure. We develop a flexible but tractable model economy with commodity exports and imports, in which international financial conditions may vary with the commodity cycle, and we compute the welfare-optimal policy in the presence of price and wage rigidities. Stabilizing domestic prices is welfare-optimal for commodity exporters, in line with standard open-economy policy prescriptions. But for economies that use commodities as inputs in production, optimal policy largely ‘looks through’ the direct and indirect effects of commodity shocks on domestic prices; this contrasts with some earlier findings and policy practice (which only ‘looks through’ the direct effect). Exchange-rate pegs increase welfare for commodity importers because they stabilize wages and employment, though it is not a robustly optimal policy. In emerging and developing economies, where financial conditions are more tied to the commodity cycle, trade-offs are starker and implementing the optimal policy may be challenging, since it requires enough credibility to keep inflation expectations anchored amidst greater volatility in some nominal variables.
url:17247184469e35ca.abstract_zh: 我们证明，最优货币政策与汇率框架的关键取决于经济体的商品敞口。我们构建了一个灵活且易于处理的模型经济体，其中包含商品出口与进口，且国际金融状况可能随商品周期而变化，并在存在价格与工资刚性的情况下计算了福利最优政策。对于商品出口国而言，稳定国内价格是福利最优的，这与标准开放经济政策建议一致。但对于将商品作为生产投入的经济体，最优政策在很大程度上会“忽略”商品冲击对国内价格的直接与间接影响——这与早期的一些发现及政策实践（仅“忽略”直接影响）形成对比。对商品进口国而言，汇率盯住制度能提升福利，因其可稳定工资与就业，但这并非稳健的最优政策。在新兴及发展中经济体，金融状况与商品周期的关联更为紧密，政策权衡更为严峻，实施最优政策可能面临挑战，因为这需要足够的公信力，以便在部分名义变量波动加剧时仍能锚定通胀预期。

url:17e8f02258720842.abstract: More frequent large macroeconomic shocks since the global financial crisis have entrenched uncertainty, particularly in Europe. This has increased the premium on central bank communication in guiding expectations and strengthening macroeconomic resilience. European central banks have responded by adapting their communication toolkits and styles. This study provides a systematic assessment of recent central bank communication across advanced and emerging European economies, combining a survey of institutional communication frameworks with novel text-miningbased indicators on monetary policy guidance in these economies over 2009-2025. While communication toolkits are broadly similar, their intensity and transparency differ markedly, with central banks in advanced economies making greater use of forward-looking tools. Central banks in both groups respond primarily to inflation uncertainty. However, communication strategies diverge, as central banks in advanced economies increasingly shift toward forward-looking language, whereas those in emerging markets shift toward more backward-looking communication. These patterns highlight credibility and institutional capacity as key determinants of central bank communication under uncertainty.
url:17e8f02258720842.abstract_zh: 自全球金融危机以来，频繁发生的宏观经济冲击加剧了不确定性，尤其是在欧洲地区。这提升了央行沟通在引导预期和增强宏观经济韧性方面的价值。欧洲各国央行通过调整其沟通工具包和风格予以应对。本研究结合对机构沟通框架的调查，以及基于文本挖掘技术构建的2009-2025年欧洲发达与新兴经济体货币政策指引新指标，系统评估了近期欧洲各国央行的沟通实践。尽管沟通工具包大致相似，但其使用强度和透明度存在显著差异——发达经济体央行更频繁运用前瞻性工具。两组央行均主要对通胀不确定性作出反应，但沟通策略呈现分化：发达经济体央行日益转向前瞻性表述，而新兴市场央行则更多采用后顾式沟通。这些模式凸显了在不确定性环境下，可信度与制度能力是决定央行沟通策略的关键因素。
