url:184352110b1e8216.abstract: This paper develops a framework for identification, estimation, and inference on the causal mechanisms driving endogenous social network formation. Identification is challenging because of unobserved confounders and reverse causality; inference is complicated by questions of equilibrium and sampling. We leverage repeated observations of a network over time and random variation in initial ties to address challenges to causal identification. Our design-based approach sidesteps questions of sampling and asymptotics by treating both the set of nodes (individuals) and potential outcomes as non-random. We apply our approach to data from a large professional services firm, where new hires are randomly assigned to project teams within offices. We estimate the causal effect on tie formation of indirect ties, network degree, and local network density. Indirect ties have a strong and significant positive effect on tie formation, while the effects of degree and density are smaller and less robust.
url:184352110b1e8216.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个用于识别、估计和推断内生社交网络形成因果机制的分析框架。由于存在未观测到的混杂因素和反向因果关系，识别过程面临挑战；而均衡与抽样问题则使推断变得复杂。我们利用网络随时间推移的重复观测数据以及初始联系的随机变异，以应对因果识别中的挑战。这种基于设计的方法将节点（个体）集合与潜在结果均视为非随机变量，从而规避了抽样与渐近性问题。我们将该方法应用于一家大型专业服务公司的数据——该公司新员工被随机分配到办公室内的项目团队中。我们估算了间接联系、网络度数及局部网络密度对联系形成的因果效应。结果表明，间接联系对联系形成具有显著且稳健的正向影响，而网络度数与密度的效应则相对较小且不够稳健。

url:185a9a16cb787648.abstract: This paper estimates the economic effects of communal riots in India using a new district–year panel for 1994–2013 that combines extended riot data with nightlights, manufacturing outcomes, infrastructure, and district-level credit. To address endogeneity, we use quasi-random variation generated when major Hindu festivals fall on a Friday (Fridays draw large Muslim congregations for weekly prayers) and construct a spatially weighted instrument for local riot risk. Instrumental variable estimates show that higher riot exposure leads to sizable and persistent economic losses. A one-unit increase in distance-weighted exposure reduces nightlights by about 0.105 log points, implying a GDP decline of roughly 0.45\%. We trace several channels, including contractions in firm output and employment, fewer bank branches, less agricultural credit, and a thinner market infrastructure. Using the timing of household surveys relative to riots, we also find that trust in state institutions declines. Together, the results quantify the economic costs of communal riots and identify the mechanisms through which social conflict depresses local economic activity.
url:185a9a16cb787648.abstract_zh: 本文利用1994-2013年印度地区-年份面板数据，结合扩展的骚乱数据、夜间灯光、制造业产出、基础设施及地区信贷数据，估算了社区骚乱的经济影响。为处理内生性问题，我们利用印度教主要节日恰逢周五（周五大量穆斯林聚集进行每周祈祷）时产生的准随机变异，构建了本地骚乱风险的空间加权工具变量。工具变量估计表明，骚乱暴露程度越高，经济损失越大且具有持续性。距离加权暴露度每增加一个单位，夜间灯光指数下降约0.105个对数点，相当于GDP下降约0.45%。我们追溯了若干传导渠道，包括企业产出和就业收缩、银行网点减少、农业信贷下降以及市场基础设施薄弱。利用家庭调查相对于骚乱发生的时间节点，我们还发现对国家机构的信任度下降。综合来看，这些结果量化了社区骚乱的经济成本，并揭示了社会冲突抑制地方经济活动的机制。

url:18c21464040f4022.abstract: This article examines how accelerating automation and the adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) in advanced economies reshape labor markets across the Global South through interconnected channels of production, migration, and remittances. Drawing on the theories and practices of economic geography, labor economics, and development studies, the analysis conceptualizes automation as a transnational shock that contracts demand for migrant labor while simultaneously amplifying employment precarity in labor-surplus economies. The article advances a geographically grounded framework linking technology adoption in core industries with labor displacement, youth unemployment, and urban labor saturation in South Asia and North Africa. It further highlights the macroeconomic vulnerabilities in developing countries arising from remittance dependence and the role of digital media in shaping youth mobilization and political unrest in their native countries. By integrating comparative regional field evidence with a technology–labor–space framework, the study contributes to economic geography by demonstrating how digital transformation reconfigures development patterns across regions and countries. The findings underscore the limits of technology-led growth strategies in labor-abundant contexts and call for employment-centered digital policies that are spatially differentiated and institutionally grounded. Keywords: automation, artificial intelligence, labor markets, remittances, youth unemployment, economic geography, Global South.
url:18c21464040f4022.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了发达经济体加速自动化和人工智能应用如何通过生产、移民和汇款等相互关联的渠道重塑全球南方的劳动力市场。基于经济地理学、劳动经济学和发展研究的理论与实践，本文将自动化概念化为一种跨国冲击，它既压缩了对移民劳动力的需求，同时加剧了劳动力过剩经济体的就业不稳定性。文章提出了一个基于地理视角的分析框架，将核心产业的技术采纳与南亚和北非地区的劳动力转移、青年失业及城市劳动力饱和联系起来。文章进一步强调了发展中国家因依赖汇款而产生的宏观经济脆弱性，以及数字媒体在塑造本国青年动员和政治动荡中的作用。通过将区域比较实地证据与技术—劳动力—空间框架相结合，本研究展示了数字化转型如何重构跨区域和国家的发展模式，从而为经济地理学做出贡献。研究结果揭示了在劳动力充裕背景下以技术为主导的增长战略的局限性，并呼吁制定以就业为中心、具有空间差异性和制度基础的数字政策。关键词：自动化，人工智能，劳动力市场，汇款，青年失业，经济地理学，全球南方。

url:19062c8ddded41fa.abstract: 健全与国际规则相衔接的知识产权保护机制是推进高水平制度型开放的重要内容。本文立足于我国《专利法》向TRIPS的三次协调这一规制开放的客观事实,使用广义双重差分模型考察知识产权规制开放对中国国际专利申请的影响。研究发现：《专利法》TRIPS协调通过同族专利挤出、专利意识强化及自主创新激励三条路径影响中国国际专利申请;1992年《专利法》TRIPS协调以同族专利挤出效应为主,整体阻碍国际专利申请,而2000和2008年《专利法》TRIPS协调,专利意识强化与自主创新激励效应显著,整体促进国际专利申请。在技术深度密集、贸易活跃度高、高技术价值以及高联合创新水平的行业和低专利集中度的目的地中,以上政策效果更为突出。此外,仅第三次协调对国际专利释放“提质”效应,但未实现“增效”目标。本文系统评估了我国《专利法》TRIPS协调的政策成效,为深入推进我国高水平制度型开放与实施创新驱动发展战略提供了政策启示。

url:19142e1092ff4356.abstract: Central bank independence is a major area of study, but the economic literature has been characterized by numerous misstatements regarding how U.S. monetary policy independence has operated over time. Against this backdrop, this paper lays out major elements of the practice of central bank independence in the United States in the period from 1951 to 2006—a time span that encompasses the William McChesney Martin, Jr., through Alan Greenspan tenures as the head of the Federal Reserve. Many documentary materials and policymaker quotations not considered in previous research on U.S. monetary policy are highlighted. The analysis covers both institutional aspects (statutory objectives, formalities of Federal Reserve structure, and conventions followed in regularizing the central bank’s interactions with the legislative and executive branches) and the conceptual basis for independence, as expressed by leading Federal Reserve officials, particularly Chairs. It is shown—with heavy reliance on their own words—how Federal Reserve Chairs have characterized the position of the central bank within the governmental structure of the United States and how they have set out the case for monetary policy independence. What emerges is that successive Chairs over the decades made essentially the same, three-part, economic case for independence. This case does not rely on the arguments associated with economic research on time inconsistency.
url:19142e1092ff4356.abstract_zh: 中央银行独立性是一个重要的研究领域，但关于美国货币政策独立性如何随时间运作的经济学文献中，存在诸多不准确表述。在此背景下，本文梳理了1951年至2006年间美国中央银行独立性的实践要素——这一时期涵盖小威廉·麦克切斯尼·马丁至艾伦·格林斯潘担任美联储主席的任期。本文重点引用了此前美国货币政策研究中未涉及的诸多文献资料与政策制定者言论。分析涵盖制度层面（法定目标、美联储组织架构形式、规范央行与立法及行政部门互动的惯例）以及美联储主要官员（尤其是主席）所阐述的独立性概念基础。通过大量引用其原话，本文展示了美联储主席如何界定央行在美国政府架构中的地位，以及如何论证货币政策独立性的必要性。研究表明，数十年来历任主席实质上提出了相同的、由三部分构成的经济独立性论证。这一论证并不依赖于与时间不一致性相关的经济学研究论点。

url:19345e14ebb7585e.abstract: How much fraud is there in Medicare and who commits it? We provide an answer for Medicare home health, a setting widely considered especially rife with fraud. We define a home health agency (HHA) as fraudulent if it was prosecuted by a federal strike force. Combining Medicare claims data on all HHAs with hand-collected prosecution records from the nine federal judicial districts where strike forces operated between 2009 and 2013, we train a machine learning model to predict, out of sample, the probability that each HHA in the remaining 85 districts would have been prosecuted had a strike force been present. We estimate that in 2008, 3.4% of Medicare home health spending — about $520 million — was billed by fraudulent HHAs. The strike forces were well-targeted: their nine districts contained only 40% of home health spending but 65% of fraudulent spending. Fraudulent HHAs display intuitive characteristics: they are more likely to rely on extremely high-volume referring physicians, to exhibit unusually uniform patterns of care, and to serve healthier-than-average patients.
url:19345e14ebb7585e.abstract_zh: 医疗保险欺诈的规模有多大？欺诈者是谁？我们以医疗保险家庭健康服务为研究对象——该领域被普遍认为欺诈现象尤为严重。我们将曾被联邦特别行动组起诉的家庭健康机构定义为欺诈机构。通过整合全美所有家庭健康机构的医疗保险索赔数据，以及手工收集的2009至2013年间九个联邦司法辖区特别行动组的起诉记录，我们训练了一个机器学习模型，用于预测其余85个司法辖区的家庭健康机构在假设存在特别行动组的情况下被起诉的概率。据估算，2008年医疗保险家庭健康支出中有3.4%（约5.2亿美元）由欺诈性家庭健康机构开具账单。特别行动组的打击目标精准：其覆盖的九个司法辖区虽仅占家庭健康总支出的40%，却集中了65%的欺诈性支出。欺诈性家庭健康机构呈现显著特征：更依赖超高转诊量的医师，护理模式异常统一，且服务对象多为健康状况优于平均水平的患者。

url:197cf4ebe7ab5ec4.abstract: We investigate the systemic risk contribution of 3,500 Money Market Funds (MMFs) in normal periods and during asset price bubbles in the US from January 2004 to December 2022. Using state-of-the-art statistical techniques for bubble detection and granular fund-level data, we show that MMF characteristics significantly influence systemic risk. Large MMFs and government MMFs, which invest exclusively in US Treasury securities, are associated with reduced systemic risk, while prime MMFs contribute to higher systemic risk. MMFs denominated in US dollars but domiciled offshore exhibit no significant differences from their US-domiciled counterparts.
url:197cf4ebe7ab5ec4.abstract_zh: 本文研究了2004年1月至2022年12月期间，美国3,500只货币市场基金在正常时期及资产价格泡沫期间的系统性风险贡献。运用前沿的泡沫检测统计技术与精细的基金层面数据，我们发现货币市场基金特征对系统性风险具有显著影响。大型货币市场基金及仅投资于美国国债的政府货币市场基金与系统性风险降低相关，而优质货币市场基金则加剧了系统性风险。以美元计价但注册于离岸的货币市场基金，其系统性风险表现与在美注册基金无显著差异。

url:19c4f70806540c36.abstract: Previous studies have shown that banks avoid passing negative monetary policy rates through to depositors, implying losses in deposit taking that erode equity and eventually have a negative impact on the lending of capital constrained banks. This paper shows that unconstrained banks respond differently, increasing loan supply even more with a deposit zero lower bound (D-ZLB) than without it. As a result, rate cuts below zero can be more stimulative than in positive territory, provided enough banks are unconstrained. A calibrated dynamic model finds this effect substantial, increasing aggregate loan supply by about 9% despite equity erosion pressures.
url:19c4f70806540c36.abstract_zh: 以往研究表明，银行会避免将负利率货币政策传导至储户，这导致存款业务亏损侵蚀银行资本，并最终对资本受限银行的贷款产生负面影响。本文发现，未受资本约束的银行对此表现出不同反应：在存款零下限（D-ZLB）约束下，其贷款供给增幅甚至超过无此约束时的水平。因此，当存在足够多的未受约束银行时，负利率政策下的降息可能比正利率区间更具刺激效应。通过校准动态模型测算，尽管存在资本侵蚀压力，该效应仍使总贷款供给增加约9%。

url:19e5dbe5b66798fe.abstract: This study examines how fluctuations in firm-level uncertainty arise over the business cycle and how they influence aggregate economic activity. To do so, it develops a general equilibrium incomplete-markets model in which heterogeneous, risk-averse firms face idiosyncratic demand uncertainty and aggregate shocks to consumer credit conditions. A change in aggregate credit affects not only the expected level of firm demand, but also the cross-sectional dispersion of sales per worker by shifting the probability that firms operate at capacity. Thus, first-moment shocks give rise to endogenous second-moment effects. The model is disciplined using U.S. Compustat data on firm sales and employment and proprietary customer traffic data. The calibrated economy reproduces key cross-sectional moments and business-cycle comovements, including countercyclical dispersion in firm outcomes. Quantitatively, endogenous uncertainty accounts for roughly one quarter of the output response and one third of the employment response to aggregate credit shocks. The results suggest that uncertainty is not only an independent source of aggregate fluctuations, but also an endogenous propagation mechanism through which changes in demand conditions amplify business cycles.
url:19e5dbe5b66798fe.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨企业层面不确定性如何随经济周期波动，以及这种波动如何影响总体经济活动。为此，构建了一个一般均衡不完全市场模型，其中异质性风险厌恶企业面临异质性需求不确定性和消费者信贷条件的总体冲击。总体信贷变化不仅影响企业需求的预期水平，还通过改变企业产能利用率概率，导致人均销售额的横截面离散度发生变化。因此，一阶矩冲击会引发内生性二阶矩效应。该模型采用美国Compustat数据库的企业销售与就业数据以及专有客流量数据进行校准。校准后的经济模型再现了关键横截面矩特征与经济周期联动性，包括企业绩效的反周期离散度。定量分析表明，内生不确定性解释了总体信贷冲击对产出响应的约四分之一，以及对就业响应的约三分之一。研究结果表明，不确定性不仅是总体经济波动的独立来源，更是需求条件变化放大经济周期的内生传导机制。

url:19fb7ffdb808b25d.abstract: Timely assessment of economic activity is crucial for effective policymaking at the national, regional, and global levels. However, many economies still do not publish GDP data at a quarterly basis, creating persistent information gaps. In 2025, 34% of economies publish only annual GDP statistics. This lack of higher-frequency and timely data is particularly restrictive for emerging market and developing economies, where economic volatility and spillover risks are often highest. The problem is more severe for historical data: only 42% of economies have quarterly GDP estimates for a period longer than 20 years. To address these gaps, this paper develops a model that estimates missing quarterly GDP series by leveraging global and regional economic interconnections. The method transforms sparse annual data into quarterly estimates by exploiting higher-frequency information from the rest of the world, enabling real-time policymaking in both data-scarce economies and in global-level discussions. Moreover, this method ensures internally consistent estimates of regional and global economic activity, allowing both top-down and bottom-up scenario analyses.
url:19fb7ffdb808b25d.abstract_zh: 及时评估经济活动对于国家、区域及全球层面的有效政策制定至关重要。然而，许多经济体仍未按季度发布GDP数据，导致持续存在信息缺口。2025年，34%的经济体仅发布年度GDP统计数据。这种高频及时数据的缺失对新兴市场和发展中经济体尤为不利，这些地区的经济波动和溢出风险往往最高。历史数据问题更为严峻：仅有42%的经济体拥有超过20年的季度GDP估算数据。为弥补这些缺口，本文构建了一个模型，通过利用全球和区域经济相互关联性来估算缺失的季度GDP序列。该方法借助世界其他地区的高频信息，将稀疏的年度数据转化为季度估算值，从而支持数据稀缺经济体及全球层面的实时政策制定。此外，该方法能确保区域和全球经济活动估算的内部一致性，支持自上而下与自下而上的情景分析。

url:1a86208b93671e28.abstract: Does a more persistent demand shock always generate a larger output response? Conventional wisdom says yes: forward-looking agents front-load spending in anticipation of higher lifetime resources, and the more lasting the shock, the stronger the expansion. This paper shows that this logic fails in New Keynesian models with an active monetary policy. The interplay between persistence and monetary policy stance governs a fundamental trade-off between two opposing forces: a permanent income channel that amplifies output, and a real interest rate channel that dampens it. Their balance generates three monetary policy regimes. In the empirically relevant intermediate regime, the output multiplier is hump-shaped in persistence.
url:1a86208b93671e28.abstract_zh: 更持久的需求冲击是否总会带来更大的产出响应？传统观点认为如此：前瞻性主体会因预期到终身资源增加而提前支出，且冲击持续时间越长，扩张效应越强。本文证明，在实施积极货币政策的凯恩斯模型中，这一逻辑并不成立。冲击持久性与货币政策立场之间的相互作用，主导着两种对立力量之间的根本权衡：放大产出的永久收入渠道与抑制产出的实际利率渠道。两者的平衡产生了三种货币政策体制。在具有经验相关性的中间体制中，产出乘数随持久性呈现驼峰形变化。

url:1a86f177418e595c.abstract: Bond yields react to macroeconomic surprises, but the magnitude of this responsiveness depends on macroeconomic forecast disagreement and monetary policy uncertainty. Using intraday responses of US Treasury futures to surprises in macroeconomic data releases, we find that greater forecast disagreement about an economic indicator prior to its release dampens the yield curve response, while higher monetary policy uncertainty amplifies it. An exception is inflation surprises: prior to the post-COVID inflation surge, bond yield reactions to inflation surprises were not amplified by monetary policy uncertainty.
url:1a86f177418e595c.abstract_zh: 债券收益率会对宏观经济意外做出反应，但这种反应的程度取决于宏观经济预测分歧和货币政策不确定性。通过利用美国国债期货对宏观经济数据发布意外的日内反应，我们发现，在某一经济指标发布前，对该指标的预测分歧越大，会抑制收益率曲线的反应，而货币政策不确定性越高则会放大这种反应。一个例外是通胀意外：在新冠疫情后的通胀飙升之前，债券收益率对通胀意外的反应并未因货币政策不确定性而放大。

url:1aad2201cc074b42.abstract: Firm-level geoeconomic risk can affect even broadly diversified mutual fund portfolios. We study U.S. export controls that restrict sales of cutting-edge technology to selected Chinese firms for national security reasons. The stock prices of affected domestic suppliers drop immediately after the policy introduction. Mutual funds holding these stocks experience increased volatility and lower returns. Fund managers respond by selling stocks of exporters to China, buying lottery-like stocks, and increasing portfolio concentration. While stock-picking and market-timing skills do not help, specialist and high-fee funds are better at navigating geoeconomic risk.

url:1cb7228f34e3b319.abstract: This paper examines the environmental consequences of capital goods imports, employing China's subsidy policy as a natural experiment. The policy, which provides reimbursement to firms for the cost of imported capital, has an unintended impact on the environmental outcomes of firms. We employ the difference‐in‐differences methodology to distinguish between firms highly expose to the policy as the treatment group and less exposed ones as the control group. The results indicate that the subsidy policy significantly reduces firms' total chemical oxygen demand emissions by 21.2% and their emission intensity by 21.8%, revealing notable unanticipated environmental benefits of the policy. The reduction in emissions is primarily attributable to improvements in the production process rather than post‐production abatement. State‐owned firms and firms with a higher proportion of skilled workers exhibit more pronounced reductions. Additionally, our findings suggest that the import of capital goods fosters green innovation, a crucial mechanism through which the subsidy policy exerts an influence on emission reductions. This study offers insights into the environmental consequences of trade policies and the combined effects of production and innovation strategies in response to non‐environmental incentives.
url:1cb7228f34e3b319.abstract_zh: 本文考察了资本品进口的环境后果，以中国的补贴政策作为自然实验。该政策为企业进口资本成本提供报销，却意外影响了企业的环境表现。我们采用双重差分法，将受政策影响较大的企业作为处理组，影响较小的企业作为对照组。结果表明，补贴政策显著降低了企业化学需氧量总排放量21.2%，排放强度下降21.8%，揭示了该政策显著且未预期的环境效益。排放减少主要归因于生产过程的改进，而非生产后的末端治理。国有企业及高技能工人比例较高的企业表现出更显著的减排效果。此外，我们的发现表明，资本品进口促进了绿色创新，这是补贴政策影响减排的关键机制。本研究为贸易政策的环境后果以及企业在非环境激励下生产与创新策略的联合效应提供了洞见。

url:1cbd07a43744849d.abstract: Urban overheating is increasingly recognised as a major public health challenge under climate change, yet existing frameworks remain heavily focused on acute medical risk and clinically vulnerable populations. This paper introduces \textit{hidden vulnerability} to describe a broader population who remain socially and economically active under ordinary conditions but experience progressive destabilisation during sustained indoor heat exposure. Drawing on a sensor-enhanced longitudinal housing survey in Southwark, London during the summer of 2023, combining indoor environmental monitoring with weekly health and wellbeing questionnaires, the study examines how overheating affects everyday urban life. The findings reveal that impacts extended well beyond thermal discomfort. Participants described cascading disruptions across physical, functional, and psychological domains, sleep loss, exhaustion, impaired self-care, reduced concentration, emotional strain, and increased caring burdens, that interacted and reinforced one another, progressively eroding the capacity to maintain ordinary routines. Critically, these processes were observed not only among participants with chronic conditions but also among those without formally recognised health vulnerabilities, suggesting that the threshold for destabilisation is lower, and more widely distributed, than existing frameworks assume. The paper argues that hidden vulnerability is an urban condition, produced by the intersection of housing quality, social infrastructure, and accumulated disadvantage. The response calls for a conceptual framework for redefining heat vulnerability beyond demographic and clinical categories, and an empirical foundation for a social cure approach to urban heat governance.
url:1cbd07a43744849d.abstract_zh: 城市过热日益被视为气候变化下的一项重大公共健康挑战，然而现有研究框架仍高度聚焦于急性医疗风险及临床易感人群。本文提出"隐性脆弱性"概念，用以描述在常规条件下保持社会与经济活跃、但在持续室内热暴露中经历渐进式失稳的广泛人群。基于2023年夏季在伦敦南华克区开展的传感器增强型纵向住房调查，结合室内环境监测与每周健康福祉问卷，本研究考察了过热对日常城市生活的影响。研究结果表明，其影响远不止热不适感。参与者描述了贯穿身体、功能及心理层面的级联式干扰——睡眠剥夺、疲惫、自我照护能力受损、注意力下降、情绪压力及照护负担加重——这些因素相互交织、彼此强化，逐步侵蚀维持日常活动的能力。关键的是，这些过程不仅出现在患有慢性疾病的参与者中，也出现在无正式认定的健康脆弱性的参与者中，这表明失稳的阈值比现有框架假设的更低、分布更广。本文认为，隐性脆弱性是一种城市状态，由住房质量、社会基础设施与累积劣势的交织作用所产生。应对措施要求构建一个超越人口统计与临床分类的热脆弱性概念框架，并为城市热治理的社会治愈路径提供实证基础。

url:1d45de7bf6d5ddb7.abstract: We study whether AI methods applied to large-scale portfolio holdings data can improve macroprudential financial regulation. We build a graph-based deep learning model tailored to security-level data on the holdings of financial intermediaries. The architecture incorporates economic priors and learns latent representations of both assets and investors from the network structure of portfolio positions. Applied to the universe of non-bank financial intermediaries, covering nearly $40 trillion in wealth, the model substantially outperforms existing approaches in out-of-sample forecasts of intermediary trading behavior, including in crisis episodes. The model has more than ten times the explanatory power for the cross-sectional variation in asset returns during stress events compared to traditional approaches, and it outperforms existing systemic risk metrics at the institution level. Its learned representations show that the holdings network encodes rich, economically interpretable information about fire- sale vulnerability. The architecture is fully inductive, producing informative estimates even when entire asset classes or investors are withheld from training. We embed our empirical approach into a macroprudential optimal policy framework to formalize why these objects matter for policy and welfare. We show that even in an equilibrium environment subject to the Lucas critique, the predictive information from the model improves welfare by sharpening the cross-sectional targeting of policy interventions, and we demonstrate a complementarity between prediction and structural knowledge.
url:1d45de7bf6d5ddb7.abstract_zh: 本文研究人工智能方法应用于大规模投资组合持仓数据能否改善宏观审慎金融监管。我们构建了一个基于图的深度学习模型，专门针对金融中介机构持有的证券级数据。该架构融合了经济先验知识，通过投资组合持仓的网络结构学习资产与投资者的潜在表征。将该模型应用于覆盖近40万亿美元财富的非银行金融中介机构整体数据时，其在预测中介交易行为（包括危机时期）的样本外表现显著优于现有方法。在压力事件期间，该模型对资产收益截面变异的解释力是传统方法的十倍以上，且在机构层面优于现有系统性风险指标。模型习得的表征表明，持仓网络编码了关于火线抛售脆弱性的丰富且具有经济可解释性的信息。该架构具有完全归纳能力，即使将整个资产类别或投资者排除在训练集之外，仍能产生具有信息量的估计结果。我们将实证方法嵌入宏观审慎最优政策框架，以形式化说明这些变量对政策与福利的重要性。研究表明，即使在面临卢卡斯批判的均衡环境中，该模型的预测信息通过强化政策干预的截面精准度提升了社会福利，并揭示了预测能力与结构性知识之间的互补关系。
url:1d45de7bf6d5ddb7.title: The Optimal Use of AI in Financial Regulation
url:1d45de7bf6d5ddb7.title_zh: 人工智能在金融监管中的最优应用

url:1d7ee391c193c2ea.abstract: Making informed policy decisions is contingent upon the availability of reliable and timely data. The use of non-traditional data has been shown to be a powerful tool for enabling policymakers to conduct robust nowcasting—the practice of estimating the current period’s economic indicator(s), ahead of official releases, using a wide range of macroeconomic and high-frequency data. This paper showcases how different types of non-traditional data, such as indices extracted from satellite imagery, Google Trends, and flight tracking information, can be leveraged to complement official statistics and monitor economic activity, and how these timely signals can be incorporated into nowcasting models to provide early estimates of key macroeconomic variables in Morocco. The approach is applied to agricultural gross value added, tourism revenues, and the unemployment rate. The results demonstrate that non-traditional data substantially improves nowcasting models by enhancing predictive accuracy and enabling the rapid generation of nowcast estimates prior to the release of official data.
url:1d7ee391c193c2ea.abstract_zh: 制定明智的政策决策依赖于可靠且及时的数据。非传统数据的运用已被证明是强有力的工具，能够帮助政策制定者进行稳健的即时预测——即在官方数据发布前，利用广泛的宏观经济和高频数据估算当前时期的经济指标。本文展示了如何利用不同类型的非传统数据（如从卫星图像、谷歌趋势和航班追踪信息中提取的指数）来补充官方统计数据并监测经济活动，以及如何将这些及时信号纳入即时预测模型，为摩洛哥的关键宏观经济变量提供早期估算。该方法应用于农业总增加值、旅游收入和失业率。结果表明，非传统数据通过提高预测准确性，并能够在官方数据发布前快速生成即时预测估算，显著改进了即时预测模型。
url:1d7ee391c193c2ea.title: Leveraging Non-traditional Data for Macroeconomic Nowcasting: The Case of Morocco

url:1de6095a43e31abf.abstract: The U.S. general fertility rate has fallen by 22% since 2007, a sustained decline not readily explained by economic conditions, contraceptive use, housing or childcare costs, or other commonly cited factors. We assess the potential role of a different shock: the diffusion of the smartphone. The U.S. rollout of the iPhone, the first modern smartphone, provides a natural experiment: from June 2007 through February 2011, the device was sold only on AT&T, allowing us to identify its effect from variation in AT&T’s mobile broadband coverage. Entropy-balanced Poisson and synthetic difference-in-differences event studies imply that access to the iPhone reduced births by 4.5–8.0% at ages 15–19 and 3.2–6.6% at ages 20–24, with statistically significant but smaller declines among older cohorts. Placebo analyses applied to Verizon and Sprint’s pre-2011 coverage footprint are null. Taken together, these cohort effects imply that the diffusion of the iPhone deepened the decline in births among women under 30 while suppressing the rise in births among older women. Overall, the diffusion of the iPhone explains 33–52% of the decline in the general fertility rate among women aged 15–44. National-survey evidence on time use and sexual behavior is consistent with the iPhone reducing in-person interactions, increasing pornography use, and reducing sexual frequency.
url:1de6095a43e31abf.abstract_zh: 自2007年以来，美国总和生育率下降了22%，这一持续下降趋势难以用经济状况、避孕措施使用、住房或育儿成本等常见因素解释。我们评估了另一种冲击的潜在作用：智能手机的普及。美国首款现代智能手机iPhone的推广提供了一个自然实验：从2007年6月至2011年2月，该设备仅由AT&T独家销售，这使我们能够通过AT&T移动宽带覆盖范围的差异识别其影响。基于熵平衡泊松模型和合成双重差分事件研究法的分析表明，iPhone的接入使15-19岁年龄段生育率下降4.5%-8.0%，20-24岁年龄段下降3.2%-6.6%，而年长群体的下降幅度较小但具有统计显著性。针对Verizon和Sprint在2011年前覆盖范围的安慰剂分析未发现显著效应。综合来看，这些队列效应表明iPhone的普及加剧了30岁以下女性生育率的下降，同时抑制了年长女性生育率的上升。总体而言，iPhone的普及解释了15-44岁女性总和生育率下降幅度的33%-52%。基于全国调查的时间使用和性行为证据显示，iPhone减少了面对面互动，增加了色情内容使用，并降低了性行为频率。

url:1e33b481c3b4294c.abstract: This study examines how Eco‐industrial Parks (EIPs) in China shape firm green innovation and, furthermore, explores its implications for trade competitiveness. We find that EIPs significantly boost green patent applications, particularly substantive innovations. This effect is stronger in cleaner industries, environmentally stringent cities and firms with high media exposure. Mechanisms include eased financing constraints, and increased R&D investment. Extending the analysis to the trade domain, we further show that EIP‐induced green innovation enhances firms' performance in green exports. Thus, EIPs serve as a pivotal policy that fosters green innovation and cultivates competitive advantages in global green markets.
url:1e33b481c3b4294c.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了中国生态工业园区（EIPs）如何影响企业绿色创新，并进一步探讨其对贸易竞争力的启示。我们发现，生态工业园区显著促进了绿色专利申请，尤其是实质性创新。这一效应在清洁行业、环境规制严格的城市以及媒体曝光度高的企业中更为显著。其作用机制包括缓解融资约束和增加研发投入。将分析拓展至贸易领域后，我们进一步表明，生态工业园区引致的绿色创新提升了企业在绿色出口方面的绩效。因此，生态工业园区作为一项关键政策，能够促进绿色创新，并在全球绿色市场中培育竞争优势。

url:1ebacb4ee704c076.abstract: We study how expatriates cope when conflict breaks out in their homeland. Using Russia’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine as a natural experiment, we identify causal effects using a matched difference-in-differences design, comparing incumbent Ukrainian migrants in Sweden to matched migrants from other countries. We show that Ukrainian expatriates experience immediate and persistent mental health deterioration—a 30 percent increase in psychiatric prescription use that remains elevated three years later—while simultaneously increasing employment and earnings. A simple framework rationalizes this pattern through two channels operating in opposite directions: concern for family safety worsens mental health and raises the disutility of work, while heightened financial responsibilities raise the return to earning income. Consistent with reduced reservation wages, Ukrainians take on secondary jobs, exit unemployment faster into lower-quality jobs, and earn less than comparable coworkers. Earnings effects concentrate among migrants from more war-exposed regions, while mental health effects attenuate in Swedish municipalities with more Ukrainian refugee arrivals. Results replicate in European and US survey data. As global migration and armed conflict both reach historic highs, the findings show that the welfare costs of war extend across borders, shaping the well-being and economic behavior of expatriates worldwide.
url:1ebacb4ee704c076.abstract_zh: 我们研究了外籍人士在祖国爆发冲突时的应对方式。以俄罗斯2022年入侵乌克兰作为自然实验，我们采用匹配双重差分法识别因果效应，将瑞典境内的乌克兰移民与来自其他国家的匹配移民进行比较。研究表明，乌克兰外籍人士的心理健康立即且持续恶化——精神类药物处方量增加30%，三年后仍维持高位——与此同时，其就业率和收入同步上升。一个简单框架通过两个方向相反的渠道解释了这一模式：对家人安全的担忧加剧心理健康问题并提高工作的负效用，而经济责任加重则提升了收入回报。与保留工资下降一致，乌克兰移民从事兼职工作、更快脱离失业状态但进入质量更低的岗位，且收入低于可比同事。收入效应集中于来自战争更激烈地区的移民，而心理健康效应在乌克兰难民抵达人数更多的瑞典市镇有所减弱。研究结果在欧洲及美国调查数据中得到验证。随着全球移民与武装冲突均达到历史高位，这些发现表明战争的福利成本跨越国界，影响着全球外籍人士的福祉与经济行为。

url:1f1022daa4945882.abstract: The use of sanctions has grown steadily over the past seven decades, with well-documented effects on bilateral trade. This column analyses the effects of sanctions on cross-border mergers and acquisitions from sanctioning to target countries over the period 2006-2023. It finds that sanctions reduce the number of deals by around 50%, with stronger effects as time passes. The impact is stronger in the mining, manufacturing, and energy sector than in the services sector. The results reinforce the broad-based potential effects of sanctions on private sector economic activity.
url:1f1022daa4945882.abstract_zh: 过去七十年来，制裁的使用稳步增长，其对双边贸易的影响已有充分文献记载。本文分析了2006年至2023年期间制裁对从制裁国到目标国的跨境并购的影响。研究发现，制裁使交易数量减少约50%，且随着时间的推移，影响更为显著。采矿、制造和能源行业受到的影响比服务业更大。这些结果强化了制裁对私营部门经济活动可能产生的广泛影响。

url:1fcca2c7eec4d2fe.abstract: Urban flooding poses escalating risks under climate change, requiring planning approaches that integrate technological precision with human and ecological values. This study introduces a Human-Centred Artificial Intelligence (HCAI) framework for adaptive and regenerative flood-resilient urban design. Unlike conventional AI approaches focused on optimisation, HCAI embeds ethical, participatory, and context-sensitive principles into land-use governance. The paper develops a four-pillar analytical framework – technical integration, institutional arrangements, stakeholder engagement, and land-use innovation – operationalised through a document-based comparative analysis of nine cities representing diverse flood typologies, governance regimes, and documented AI/digital flood-resilience activity. Documentary evidence suggests that AI tools such as Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Graph Neural Networks are reported to support flood-risk prediction and response coordination in flood-risk applications, while their planning relevance depends on inclusive decision-making and regenerative land-use strategies. Cities with stronger institutional embedding of AI-enabled or digital tools within adaptive regulatory systems and participatory platforms (e.g., Rotterdam, Copenhagen, Bangkok) show clearer planning-policy pathways, whereas those relying on fragmented or project-based deployments (e.g., Venice, Sydney) show limited continuity. Findings suggest that technical capability alone is insufficient: planning relevance depends on governance maturity, ethical safeguards, civic legitimacy, and linkage to spatial planning instruments. By coupling algorithmic intelligence with participatory and regulatory innovation, the study advances a policy-oriented framework for embedding HCAI into spatial governance and identifying conditions that may support a shift from defensive flood control toward regenerative, socially just urbanism. The framework guides AI institutionalisation within land-use systems and contributes to debates on equitable, data-driven climate adaptation.
url:1fcca2c7eec4d2fe.abstract_zh: 气候变化背景下，城市洪涝风险持续加剧，亟需融合技术精度与人文生态价值的规划路径。本研究提出以人为中心的人工智能（HCAI）框架，用于适应性、再生性防洪韧性城市设计。与侧重优化的传统AI方法不同，HCAI将伦理、参与性和情境敏感性原则嵌入土地利用治理体系。本文构建了包含技术整合、制度安排、利益相关方参与和土地利用创新四大支柱的分析框架，通过对九个代表不同洪涝类型、治理体制及AI/数字防洪韧性实践案例的城市进行文献比较分析加以验证。文献证据表明，机器学习、深度学习、图神经网络等AI工具在洪涝风险应用中可支持风险预测与响应协调，但其规划相关性取决于包容性决策与再生性土地利用策略。在适应性监管体系与参与式平台中实现AI或数字工具制度化嵌入的城市（如鹿特丹、哥本哈根、曼谷），展现出更清晰的规划政策路径；而依赖碎片化或项目式部署的城市（如威尼斯、悉尼）则呈现有限连续性。研究结果表明，单纯技术能力不足：规划相关性取决于治理成熟度、伦理保障、公民合法性及与空间规划工具的衔接。通过将算法智能与参与式及监管创新相结合，本研究提出了将HCAI嵌入空间治理的政策导向框架，并识别出可能推动从防御性洪涝控制向再生性、社会公正城市主义转型的条件。该框架为土地利用系统中的AI制度化提供指引，并推动关于公平、数据驱动气候适应的学术讨论。

url:204a6a1cf1a1f83b.abstract: Does an exchange rate depreciation depress trading partners’ output? I address this question through the lens of a classic episode: from 1931 to 1936, the largest economies in the world successively devalued their currency. In theory, the effect is ambiguous for countries that had not devalued: expenditure switching can lower their output, but the monetary stimulus to foreign demand might raise it. Newly constructed high-frequency devaluation shocks and a multi-country model disciplined by cross-sectional evidence concur. Contrary to the popular narrative in modern policy debates, devaluation did not dramatically lower the output of trading partners in this context. Meanwhile, devaluation substantially raised the output of the devaluing country itself: it was a potent stimulus, not a zero-sum game.
url:204a6a1cf1a1f83b.abstract_zh: 汇率贬值是否会抑制贸易伙伴的产出？本文通过一个经典历史案例来探讨这一问题：1931年至1936年间，全球主要经济体相继实施货币贬值。理论上，对于未贬值国家而言，其影响具有不确定性：支出转换效应可能降低其产出，但外国需求受到的货币刺激则可能提升产出。基于新构建的高频贬值冲击数据以及受横截面证据约束的多国模型，研究结果趋于一致。与现代政策辩论中的流行叙事相反，在此背景下，贬值并未显著降低贸易伙伴的产出。与此同时，贬值大幅提升了贬值国自身的产出：这是一剂强有力的经济刺激措施，而非零和博弈。

url:204e600effb4bfa6.abstract: State honours are designed as symbols of merit and public recognition. But they may also convey information with economic value. This column explores the market value of the Légion d’honneur. When corporate directors of French listed firms receive the honour, their companies’ share prices rise. This market reaction is concentrated among directors without a publicly observable educational link to members of the incumbent government before the award. The pattern suggests that state distinctions can provide investors with new information about a director’s potential access to policymakers.
url:204e600effb4bfa6.abstract_zh: 国家荣誉旨在作为功绩和公众认可的象征，但它们也可能传递具有经济价值的信息。本文探讨了荣誉军团勋章的市场价值。当法国上市公司的董事获得该荣誉时，其所在公司的股价会上涨。这种市场反应主要集中在那些在获奖前与现任政府成员没有公开可观察的教育关联的董事身上。这一模式表明，国家荣誉能够为投资者提供关于董事接触政策制定者可能性的新信息。

url:213189c2722807cc.abstract: We study the relationship between health and social status in China using genealogical data from the 14th to 19th centuries. The data covers broad segments of the population linking husbands, wives, and sons, allowing us to examine whether status was associated with survival not only for adult men but also across households and generations. In a sample centered on the early 1700s, the typical lifespan of married men is 52, but varies widely. High-status men have a 22 percent higher probability of living past 50 than low-status men, resulting in a lifespan advantage of seven years. High status is also associated with significant survival advantages for wives and children. The lifespan premium of the wife of a high-status man over the wife of a commoner exceeds 10 years, and the chance that the son of a high-status man dies before reaching 10 years is less than half that of a low-status man’s son. Up to the 17th century the lifespan advantage is largely confined to those with top status, while the healthstatus gradient across all status levels emerges during the 18th century. The findings provide new evidence on health-status inequality in a less-studied setting, and suggest that health-status inequality is usefully analyzed from a family and intergenerational perspective.
url:213189c2722807cc.abstract_zh: 本文利用14至19世纪中国的家谱数据，研究健康与社会地位之间的关系。数据覆盖了广泛的社会阶层，将丈夫、妻子和儿子联系起来，使我们能够考察地位是否不仅与成年男性的生存状况相关，还涉及家庭内部及代际之间的影响。在以18世纪初为中心的样本中，已婚男性的典型寿命为52岁，但个体差异显著。高地位男性活过50岁的概率比低地位男性高22%，寿命优势达七年。高地位还与妻子和子女的显著生存优势相关：高地位男性妻子的寿命比平民妻子长超过10年，而高地位男性之子在10岁前死亡的概率不到低地位男性之子的一半。直至17世纪，寿命优势主要局限于顶级地位群体，而18世纪期间，所有地位层级之间均出现了健康-地位梯度。这些发现为较少被研究的背景下的健康-地位不平等提供了新证据，并表明从家庭和代际视角分析健康-地位不平等具有重要价值。

url:21b04bbf19e1c063.abstract: We study how behavioral economics and machine learning can jointly construct effective treatment-targeting rules. In a large field experiment at an online fashion retailer with approximately 500,000 consumers, we test a loss-framed discount message. We elicit individual loss aversion in a nested incentivized behavioral measurement experiment (N=582) and use machine learning to impute it from digital footprints. Targeting based on scaled behavioral measurement yields statistically significant revenue gains and outperforms causal forests. The results show how scaling behavioral measurement can improve algorithmic treatment assignment relative to purely data-driven approaches, especially when pilot data are unavailable, noisy, or costly.
url:21b04bbf19e1c063.abstract_zh: 我们研究行为经济学与机器学习如何共同构建有效的处理目标规则。在一项涉及约50万名消费者的在线时尚零售商大规模实地实验中，我们测试了一种损失框架折扣信息。我们在嵌套的激励性行为测量实验（N=582）中测量了个体损失厌恶程度，并利用机器学习从数字足迹中对其进行插补。基于规模化行为测量的目标定位带来了统计上显著的收益增长，且表现优于因果森林。研究结果表明，相较于纯粹的数据驱动方法，规模化行为测量能够改进算法处理分配，尤其是在缺乏试点数据、数据存在噪声或成本高昂的情况下。

url:21c04e459a62e7fe.abstract: Previous studies have shown that banks avoid passing negative monetary policy rates through to depositors, implying losses in deposit taking that erode equity and eventually have a negative impact on the lending of capital constrained banks. This paper shows that unconstrained banks respond differently, increasing loan supply even more with a deposit zero lower bound (D-ZLB) than without it. As a result, rate cuts below zero can be more stimulative than in positive territory, provided enough banks are unconstrained. A calibrated dynamic model finds this effect substantial, increasing aggregate loan supply by about 9% despite equity erosion pressures.
url:21c04e459a62e7fe.abstract_zh: 以往研究表明，银行会避免将负利率货币政策传导至存款人，这导致存款业务亏损侵蚀资本，并最终对资本受限银行的贷款产生负面影响。本文发现，不受约束的银行对此反应不同：在存款零下限（D-ZLB）环境下，其贷款供给增幅甚至超过无此约束时的水平。因此，只要存在足够多的不受约束银行，负利率政策下的降息可能比正利率区间更具刺激效应。经校准的动态模型显示，尽管存在资本侵蚀压力，该效应仍使总贷款供给增加约9%。

url:21cbf6cf86189665.abstract: Conventional demographic models systematically overestimate fertility decline in sub-Saharan Africa. This paper proposes a complementary explanation grounded in a prevalent but understudied belief system: ancestors influence the living and seek the continuation of their lineage, into which they may be reincarnated. In this worldview, having children becomes a moral and collective duty, rooted in the spiritual responsibility to ensure the survival of the lineage. Drawing on first-hand data, novel ethnographic information, and historical and contemporary surveys, I document a strong and quantitatively large positive relationship between ancestral beliefs and fertility across contexts and time periods. A simple model in which children are a public good for the lineage rationalizes the patterns observed in the data: the fertility effect of ancestral beliefs is concentrated in patrilineal societies, and a specific form of free-riding emerges among siblings whose children continue the same family line. These findings suggest that high fertility in sub-Saharan Africa rests on moral foundations that standard, externally designed interventions tend to overlook.
url:21cbf6cf86189665.abstract_zh: 传统人口模型系统性地高估了撒哈拉以南非洲地区的生育率下降趋势。本文提出一种基于普遍存在但研究不足的信仰体系的补充性解释：祖先会影响现世生活，并寻求其血脉延续，甚至可能通过转世回归。在这种世界观中，生育子女成为植根于确保血脉存续之精神责任的道德与集体义务。通过利用一手数据、新颖的民族志信息以及历史与当代调查，本文记录了祖先信仰与生育率之间在不同情境与时间维度上均存在的显著正向关系。一个将子女视为血脉公共品的简单模型，能够合理解释数据中呈现的模式：祖先信仰对生育率的影响集中于父系社会，且兄弟姐妹间因子女延续同一家族血脉而出现特定形式的搭便车行为。这些发现表明，撒哈拉以南非洲的高生育率建立在标准外部干预措施往往忽视的道德基础之上。

url:2215e772023b58ad.abstract: Central bank communications frequently contain information about financial-market backstops that affect monetary policy transmission. We identify these transmission protection surprises in the euro area, alongside policy stance and central bank information surprises, by exploiting heteroskedasticity in minute-by-minute asset price movements. Unlike standard factor models, our approach allows active policy dimensions and their impacts to vary across events. Event-specific decompositions quantify the narrative record and reveal substantial heterogeneity of effects across announcements. We show that transmission protection is a distinct dimension of central bank announcements, with financial-market effects separate from both policy stance and information shocks.
url:2215e772023b58ad.abstract_zh: 央行沟通中频繁包含影响货币政策传导的金融市场兜底信息。我们利用欧元区资产价格分钟级波动的异方差性，在识别政策立场与央行信息冲击的同时，识别出这些传导保护意外。与标准因子模型不同，我们的方法允许政策维度及其影响在不同事件中动态变化。基于事件特定分解的量化叙事记录显示，不同公告的影响存在显著异质性。研究表明，传导保护是央行公告的独立维度，其金融市场效应与政策立场冲击及信息冲击均存在差异。

url:22466d410c9258ab.abstract: We study the political economy of carbon taxes when neoclassical consumers take all other agents' emissions as given and socially responsible consumers internalize damages in a group-rule-utilitarian way, taking neoclassical consumers' behavior as given. We characterize political equilibrium taxes with a focus on deviations from first-best Pigouvian taxation. Welfare falls further if arguments on moral obligations to reduce carbon footprints polarize the debate in society. Finally, we present survey evidence that supports our theory: social responsibility correlates with lower consumption of brown goods, higher preferred carbon taxes, and support for moral arguments.
url:22466d410c9258ab.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在两类消费者并存情境下碳税的政治经济学：新古典消费者将其他行为主体的排放视为既定，而具有社会责任感的消费者则以群体规则功利主义方式内化损害，并将新古典消费者的行为视为既定。我们刻画了政治均衡税收的特征，重点关注其与最优庇古税的偏离。若关于减少碳足迹的道德义务论据加剧社会辩论的两极分化，社会福利将进一步下降。最后，我们提供的调查证据支持了理论：社会责任感与棕色商品消费减少、更高碳税偏好及对道德论据的支持呈正相关。

url:22ec02177e268c9d.abstract: The changing global economic landscape is likely to expose the Middle East, North Africa, and Pakistan (MENAP) and Caucasus and Central Asia (CCA) regions to more frequent external shocks, putting a premium on resilient and flexible macroeconomic policy frameworks. By using empirical analysis and model-based scenarios, this paper highlights the important roles of policy frameworks in stabilizing MENAP and CCA economies against adverse global shocks. Two messages stand out from the analysis. First, as countries make progress toward diversifying their exports and deepening domestic financial markets, credible inflation-targeting monetary policy regimes that allow greater exchange rate flexibility could enable faster adjustment to adverse global shocks. Second, adopting strong fiscal rules could help better anchor long-term expectations, reduce risk premiums, and help support countercyclical fiscal responses.
url:22ec02177e268c9d.abstract_zh: 不断变化的全球经济格局可能使中东、北非和巴基斯坦（MENAP）以及高加索和中亚（CCA）地区面临更频繁的外部冲击，从而凸显了具有韧性和灵活性的宏观经济政策框架的重要性。通过实证分析和基于模型的场景模拟，本文强调了政策框架在稳定MENAP和CCA经济体以应对不利全球冲击中的关键作用。分析得出两个核心结论：第一，随着各国在出口多元化和深化国内金融市场方面取得进展，采用可信的通胀目标制货币政策框架并允许更大汇率灵活性，能够加速对不利全球冲击的调整；第二，实施强有力的财政规则有助于更好地锚定长期预期、降低风险溢价，并支持逆周期财政应对措施。

url:23bfcc6cec7217d5.abstract: This paper incorporates realistic demographic structure into macroeconomic policy analysis by examining an overlapping generations model calibrated to match U.S. income data over the lifecycle. We provide explicit conditions for the existence of multiple dynamically efficient steady-state equilibria with positive debt levels for empirically relevant calibrations. Unlike in representative agent frameworks, indeterminacy can arise in our model under passive monetary and active fiscal policy. More surprisingly, one degree of indeterminacy remains even when both policies are active. Following fundamental shocks, the model generates highly persistent swings in real interest rates consistent with evidence on long-horizon trends. Our tractable approach bridges theoretical models relying on infinite horizons and homogeneous agents with finite-lived heterogeneous consumers that populate actual economies.
url:23bfcc6cec7217d5.abstract_zh: 本文将现实的人口结构纳入宏观经济政策分析，通过构建一个校准至匹配美国生命周期收入数据的世代交叠模型展开研究。我们给出了在经验相关校准下，存在多个具有正债务水平的动态有效稳态均衡的显式条件。与代表性主体框架不同，在被动货币政策和主动财政政策组合下，我们的模型可能产生不确定性。更令人意外的是，即使两种政策均为主动型，仍存在一阶不确定性。在基础冲击发生后，该模型能生成与实际长期趋势证据高度一致的、高度持续的实际利率波动。我们提出的易处理分析框架，将依赖无限期界与同质主体的理论模型，与构成现实经济的有限生命异质性消费者群体相衔接。

url:2415ad1dcdac10e1.abstract: As public debt in emerging markets (EMs) and low-income countries (LICs) has surged since the COVID-19 pandemic, so has the exposure of domestic banks to their sovereigns—raising concerns of destabilizing feedback loops if fiscal conditions deteriorate. This paper provides a comprehensive analysis of this sovereign-bank nexus using a new granular dataset covering over 120 EMs and LICs, combined with IMF Financial Soundness Indicators. We document a marked post-pandemic strengthening of the nexus, particularly in Sub-Saharan Africa and the Middle East and Central Asia, and show that public debt levels, deposit rates, and nonperforming loans are its most robust correlates. While we find no broad evidence of financial repression, higher sovereign refinancing needs significantly increase banks
url:2415ad1dcdac10e1.abstract_zh: 自新冠疫情以来，新兴市场与低收入国家的公共债务急剧攀升，其国内银行对主权债务的风险敞口也随之扩大——这引发了市场对财政状况恶化可能形成破坏性反馈循环的担忧。本文利用涵盖120多个新兴市场与低收入国家的新型微观数据集，结合国际货币基金组织金融稳健指标，对主权-银行关联机制进行了全面分析。研究发现，疫情后该关联性显著增强，尤其在撒哈拉以南非洲、中东及中亚地区表现突出；公共债务水平、存款利率与不良贷款是其中最稳健的相关因素。尽管未发现金融抑制的广泛证据，但主权再融资需求的上升显著增加了银行

url:24636856158c97dd.abstract: The ways in which governments legitimize and promote plant-rich eating remain underexplored, particularly in contexts where animal-based foods retain strong cultural and political significance. Focusing primarily on nutritional governance, this study examines the institutional mechanisms through which plant foods and plant-rich practices have been framed as objects of public intervention in Portugal since the inception of the National Program for the Promotion of Healthy Eating in 2012. Adopting a qualitative, discourse-oriented, and semiotically informed approach, the study conceptualizes public intervention as a dispositif that actively shapes meanings and norms around food. Findings show that the legitimization of plant-rich eating relies on strategically cautious discourse emphasizing health, sustainability, and heritage, while avoiding explicit advocacy of vegetarianism. The Mediterranean diet emerges as the primary legitimizing model, enabling plant foods without challenging the centrality of meat and fish. Risk prevention and responsibilization further structure these discourses, framing citizens as self-monitoring consumers. Ultimately, plant-rich eating is cautiously legitimized yet continually negotiated, absorbed into broader narratives of health, sustainability, and national identity. As the first European country to legally require the availability of vegetarian meals in public canteens, Portugal offers insights for other national contexts, particularly regarding discursive strategies, risk-based governance, the symbolic status of animal and plant products, and the role of institutional environments in normalizing plant-rich eating. These findings also resonate with developments elsewhere while highlighting context-specific dynamics.
url:24636856158c97dd.abstract_zh: 政府如何合法化并推广植物性饮食仍是一个研究不足的领域，尤其是在动物性食品仍具有深厚文化及政治意义的背景下。本研究聚焦营养治理，考察自2012年葡萄牙启动《促进健康饮食国家计划》以来，植物性食品及植物性饮食实践被构建为公共干预对象的制度机制。采用定性、话语导向及符号学分析路径，本研究将公共干预概念化为一个积极塑造食品意义与规范的"装置"。研究发现，植物性饮食的合法化依赖于策略性谨慎话语，强调健康、可持续性与传统遗产，同时避免明确倡导素食主义。地中海饮食模式成为主要的合法化模型，既推广植物性食品又不挑战肉类与鱼类的主导地位。风险预防与责任化进一步构建了这些话语，将公民塑造为自我监控的消费者。最终，植物性饮食虽被谨慎合法化，却持续处于协商状态，被吸纳进健康、可持续性与国家认同的宏大叙事中。作为首个通过法律要求公共食堂提供素食的欧洲国家，葡萄牙为其他国家的实践提供了启示，尤其在话语策略、风险治理、动植物产品的象征地位以及制度环境对植物性饮食常态化的作用方面。这些发现亦与其他地区的发展相呼应，同时凸显了特定情境的动态特征。

url:24686315ac987e86.abstract: This paper uses a natural experiment to measure the causal effect of an expected debt-financed fiscal stimulus on interest rates. We find that a 1 percentage point increase in the expected US debt-to-GDP ratio leads to an increase of about 1-2 basis points in the longer-run neutral rate ( r∗ ) and of about 2–3 basis points in the 10-year Treasury term premium. Our results validate estimates from a common time-series approach that regresses long-term forward interest rates on long-term projections of government debt, where the exclusion restriction does not apply.
url:24686315ac987e86.abstract_zh: 本文利用一项自然实验，衡量预期债务融资型财政刺激对利率的因果效应。我们发现，美国预期债务与GDP比率每上升1个百分点，长期中性利率（r∗）将上升约1-2个基点，10年期国债期限溢价将上升约2-3个基点。我们的结果验证了一种常见时间序列方法的估计值，该方法将长期远期利率对政府债务的长期预测进行回归，而排他性约束在此并不适用。

url:24c483c6b977aec2.abstract: Stochastic debt sustainability analysis (SDSA) is a key tool for assessing risks in modern fiscal policymaking. Yet, designing and calibrating these models poses significant challenges. Using a panel of up to 24 OECD countries with data spanning from 1980, this paper argues that pooling data across countries provides a more representative reflection of fiscal risks, effectively extends sample periods, and a trend-cycle approach better accounts for structural changes. The choice of calibration method is policy relevant as it substantially alters the required primary balance adjustments to stabilise the debt ratio implied by the models. Given that real-time macroeconomic risks are skewed to the downside during economic upswings, the paper proposes a state-contingent (SC-SDSA) approach conditioned on contemporaneous output gap estimates. This suggests that risks are greater during economic booms than conventional approaches and that larger structural primary balances are required than in normal times to ensure adequate fiscal buffers.
url:24c483c6b977aec2.abstract_zh: 随机债务可持续性分析（SDSA）是现代财政政策制定中评估风险的关键工具。然而，此类模型的设计与校准面临重大挑战。本文基于24个OECD国家自1980年以来的面板数据，论证了跨国家数据整合能更全面地反映财政风险，有效延长样本周期，且趋势-周期方法能更好地解释结构性变化。校准方法的选择具有政策相关性，因为它会显著改变模型隐含的稳定债务比率所需的基本收支调整幅度。鉴于经济上行期实时宏观经济风险倾向于下行，本文提出一种基于当期产出缺口估计的状态依存（SC-SDSA）方法。这表明经济繁荣期的风险高于传统方法所揭示的水平，且需要比正常时期更大的结构性基本收支盈余，以确保充足的财政缓冲。

url:24f52409cfbf609d.abstract: This paper proposes corrected forecast combinations when the original combined forecast errors are serially dependent. Motivated by the classic Bates and Granger (1969) example, we show that combined forecast errors can be strongly autocorrelated and that a simple correction - adding a fraction of the previous combined error to the next-period combined forecast - can deliver sizable improvements in forecast accuracy, often exceeding the original gains from combining. We formalize the approach within the conditional-risk framework of Gibbs and Vasnev (2024), in which the combined error decomposes into a predictable component (measurable at the forecast origin) and an innovation. We then link this correction to efficient estimation of combination weights under time-series dependence via GLS, allowing joint estimation of weights and an error-covariance structure. Using the U.S. Survey of Professional Forecasters for major macroeconomic indices across various subsamples (including pre/post-2000, GFC, and COVID), we find that a parsimonious correction of the mean forecast with a coefficient around 0.5 is a robust starting point and often yields material improvements in forecast accuracy. For optimal-weight forecasts, the correction substantially mitigates the forecast combination puzzle by turning poorly performing out-of-sample optimal-weight combinations into competitive forecasts.
url:24f52409cfbf609d.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种修正的预测组合方法，以应对原始组合预测误差存在序列依赖性的情况。受经典Bates与Granger（1969）示例的启发，我们证明组合预测误差可能呈现强自相关性，而一种简单的修正——将上一期组合误差的一部分加入下一期组合预测——能够显著提升预测精度，其改进幅度往往超过原始组合本身带来的增益。我们在Gibbs与Vasnev（2024）的条件风险框架内对该方法进行了形式化处理，在该框架中，组合误差可分解为可预测成分（在预测起点可测）与创新成分。随后，我们将该修正与基于广义最小二乘法（GLS）的时间序列依赖下组合权重的有效估计联系起来，从而实现对权重与误差协方差结构的联合估计。基于美国专业预测者调查（SPF）中主要宏观经济指标在不同子样本（包括2000年前后、全球金融危机及新冠疫情期间）的数据，我们发现，对均值预测采用系数约为0.5的简约修正是一个稳健的起点，且通常能带来预测精度的实质性提升。对于最优权重预测而言，该修正通过将表现不佳的样本外最优权重组合转化为具有竞争力的预测，显著缓解了预测组合难题。

url:259b7c57c7c0a295.abstract: We evaluate private equity (PE) performance using investor-specific stochastic discount factors, and examine whether investors could benefit from changing their allocation to PE.Plans invest in PE funds with higher average risk-adjusted performance.This is mainly due to access to successful PE managers, not superior selection skill.Decomposing returns into risk-compensation and "alpha", we find that some plans obtain higher PE returns by taking more risk without earning higher, and in some cases earning lower, risk-adjusted returns, broadly consistent with agency problems within plans.
url:259b7c57c7c0a295.abstract_zh: 我们采用投资者特定的随机贴现因子评估私募股权（PE）业绩，并考察投资者是否能够通过调整PE配置获益。投资计划倾向于选择平均风险调整后业绩更高的PE基金，这主要得益于接触成功的PE管理人，而非卓越的筛选能力。通过将收益分解为风险补偿和“阿尔法”，我们发现部分投资计划通过承担更高风险获取更高PE收益，但并未获得更高（某些情况下甚至更低）的风险调整后收益，这与投资计划内部的代理问题基本一致。

url:2638fbb25aec69dc.abstract: In the context of the growing share of public workers in the Spanish labour force, this paper analyses opportunistic behaviour in sick leave duration and return-to-work probabilities among teachers. We use administrative microdata (2011-2019), transformed into an original monthly spell-level panel. The analysis employs a tailored regression within a difference-in-differences framework exploiting the academic calendar and comparing professional sick leaves among pre-university teachers in public and private schools. Results show that the timing of sick leave endings systematically responds to the school calendar. Public-school teachers display longer sick leave durations and lower return-to-work probabilities than private-school teachers, consistent with ex post moral hazard under more generous employment protection and sick leave coverage. Around the summer break, these differences become more pronounced: public-school teachers extend their leaves further relative to private-school teachers. Simultaneously, the usual gap in return-to-work probabilities temporarily reverses, with public-school teachers becoming more likely to end their leave immediately after summer. These patterns are especially strong among mid-career workers, women, and cases involving more subjective or difficult-to-diagnose injuries.
url:2638fbb25aec69dc.abstract_zh: 在西班牙劳动力中公共部门工作者占比日益增长的背景下，本文分析了教师群体在病假时长与返岗概率中的机会主义行为。我们利用2011-2019年行政微观数据，将其转化为原创的月度个体面板数据。分析采用基于双重差分框架的定制化回归模型，利用学年周期特征，比较公立与私立学校大学预科教师的职业病假情况。结果显示，病假结束时间系统性地响应学年安排。相较于私立学校教师，公立学校教师病假持续时间更长、返岗概率更低，这与更优厚的就业保障和病假覆盖下的事后道德风险一致。在暑假前后，这些差异更为显著：公立学校教师相对于私立学校教师进一步延长病假。与此同时，通常存在的返岗概率差距暂时逆转，公立学校教师在暑假结束后立即结束病假的可能性更高。这些模式在职业生涯中期工作者、女性群体以及涉及主观性强或难以诊断的伤病案例中尤为突出。

url:265115cc7bb350c3.abstract: Climate disasters tend to be associated with increased sovereign default risk. Countries face an “impossible trilemma”: scale up adaptation investment, keep debt sustainable amidst high borrowing costs and avoid the higher risk of default from delayed adaptation. Using a global panel of disaster event-level shocks, we find that a 1pp increase in disaster related losses as a share of GDP raises the odds of sovereign default by approximately 2-3 percent. An additional US$1 billion in cumulative Official Development Assistance (ODA) is associated with a 0.13 point gain in a country’s adaptive capacity. Using average marginal effects and our predicted margins we then map concessional ODA finance to default probability and translate these relationships into a practical budgeting yardstick for calibrating needed ODA to sovereign default risk reduction targets. In a context of declining ODA, our findings highlight the crucial role of well-designed support in climate adaptation policies.
url:265115cc7bb350c3.abstract_zh: 气候灾害往往与主权违约风险上升相关。各国面临一个"不可能三角"：扩大适应投资规模、在高借贷成本下维持债务可持续性、以及避免因延迟适应而导致的更高违约风险。基于全球灾害事件冲击层面的面板数据，我们发现灾害相关损失占GDP比重每增加1个百分点，主权违约概率将上升约2-3%。累计官方发展援助每增加10亿美元，与一国适应能力提升0.13个点相关。通过运用平均边际效应与预测边际值，我们将优惠性官方发展援助资金映射至违约概率，并将这些关系转化为实用的预算标尺，用于校准实现主权违约风险降低目标所需的官方发展援助。在官方发展援助持续缩减的背景下，我们的研究凸显了精心设计的支持在气候适应政策中的关键作用。

url:269f72d8dcece17b.abstract: How do labor demand shocks affect workforce diversity in the absence of targeted diversity policies? A conceptual framework illustrates the potential trade-off between the demographic and quality composition of a workforce when there is a positive labor demand shock. Exploiting the German reunification as a natural experiment, we analyze the academic labor market where nearly all social sciences professors in East Germany were replaced while STEM faculty remained largely unchanged. Using administrative data and a regional difference-in-differences design, we find increased dispersion in the institutional quality of hires, indicating that the new hires came from less select departments. At the same time, female representation did not increase despite qualified women in the pipeline. Instead, East German hiring patterns converged to those in West Germany in terms of gender composition. In simulations, we investigate implied losses: Under conservative assumptions, we show that, considering the pipeline of qualified applicants, the marginal female hire’s quality is approximately half a standard deviation higher than the marginal male hire’s quality.
url:269f72d8dcece17b.abstract_zh: 在缺乏针对性多元化政策的情况下，劳动力需求冲击如何影响劳动力多样性？一个概念框架揭示了正向劳动力需求冲击下，劳动力人口结构与质量构成之间可能存在的权衡关系。以德国统一作为自然实验，我们分析了学术劳动力市场——东德几乎所有社会科学教授均被替换，而STEM领域教职基本保持不变。基于行政数据与区域双重差分设计，我们发现新聘人员的机构质量离散度上升，表明新入职者来自学术选拔性较低的院系。与此同时，尽管具备资质的女性候选人储备充足，女性代表性并未提升。相反，东德在性别构成上的招聘模式逐渐趋同于西德。通过模拟分析，我们探究了隐含损失：在保守假设下，考虑合格申请者储备池时，边际女性新聘人员的质量比边际男性新聘人员高出约半个标准差。

url:26f0024c2bc780b7.abstract: The gender gap in non‐agricultural employment in developing countries is concentrated among rural married workers. Within‐family specialization is central: Married women spend more time on home production, work fewer market hours, and are less likely to incur fixed costs of entering non‐agriculture. We develop a general equilibrium Roy model with joint household decisions, sector‐neutral gender labor wedges, and entry barriers. Calibrated to China in 2010, the model reproduces the observed gender employment gap. Gender labor wedges explain about 80% of it, amplified by within‐family specialization, while changing entry barriers account for its widening from 2000 to 2010.
url:26f0024c2bc780b7.abstract_zh: 摘要 发展中国家非农就业中的性别差距主要集中在农村已婚劳动者群体。家庭内部分工是核心因素：已婚女性在家务劳动上投入更多时间，市场工作时间更少，且更不愿承担进入非农部门所需的固定成本。我们构建了一个包含联合家庭决策、部门中性性别劳动楔子及进入壁垒的一般均衡罗伊模型。基于2010年中国数据的校准结果显示，该模型能够复现观测到的性别就业差距。其中，性别劳动楔子解释了约80%的差距，并通过家庭内部分工机制被放大；而进入壁垒的变化则解释了2000年至2010年间该差距的扩大趋势。

url:2720f5d810ca042e.abstract: This paper provides new evidence on the prevalence and potential effects of non-compete and related clauses in Canada using OECD surveys of workers and firms. It finds that these clauses are widespread, increasingly used, and often applied beyond roles where they are most justified. Many appear overly broad and legally weak, yet a substantial share of workers report having been prevented from changing jobs or starting a business. Their impact is reinforced by behavioural factors, including reputational and ethical concerns. The findings also bring into closer focus the use of (firm-to-firm) no-poaching and wage fixing agreements that restrict labour market competition and, thus, raise broader concerns for the Canadian Competition Bureau.
url:2720f5d810ca042e.abstract_zh: 本文利用经合组织（OECD）对劳动者和企业的调查，为加拿大竞业限制及相关条款的普遍性及其潜在影响提供了新证据。研究发现，这些条款广泛存在、使用日益频繁，且常被应用于最缺乏合理性的岗位。许多条款过于宽泛且法律效力薄弱，但仍有相当比例的劳动者表示，这些条款阻碍了其更换工作或创业。其影响因声誉和道德关切等行为因素而进一步强化。研究结果还更聚焦于（企业间）互不挖角协议和薪资固定协议的使用，这些协议限制了劳动力市场竞争，从而引发了加拿大竞争局的更广泛担忧。

url:2782e1b01ca3386d.abstract: How much fraud is there in Medicare and who commits it? We provide an answer for Medicare home health, a setting widely considered especially rife with fraud. We define a home health agency (HHA) as fraudulent if it was prosecuted by a federal strike force. Combining Medicare claims data on all HHAs with hand-collected prosecution records from the nine federal judicial districts where strike forces operated between 2009 and 2013, we train a machine learning model to predict, out of sample, the probability that each HHA in the remaining 85 districts would have been prosecuted had a strike force been present. We estimate that in 2008, 3.4% of Medicare home health spending — about $520 million — was billed by fraudulent HHAs. The strike forces were well-targeted: their nine districts contained only 40% of home health spending but 65% of fraudulent spending. Fraudulent HHAs display intuitive characteristics: they are more likely to rely on extremely high-volume referring physicians, to exhibit unusually uniform patterns of care, and to serve healthier-than-average patients.
url:2782e1b01ca3386d.abstract_zh: 医疗保险欺诈的规模有多大？欺诈者是谁？我们以医疗保险家庭健康服务（普遍被认为欺诈高发领域）为研究对象，将曾遭联邦特别行动组起诉的家庭健康机构（HHA）定义为欺诈机构。通过整合全美所有HHA的医疗保险索赔数据，以及手工收集的2009至2013年间九个联邦司法辖区特别行动组的起诉记录，我们训练机器学习模型，预测其余85个司法辖区的HHA若遭遇特别行动组调查时被起诉的概率。研究估算，2008年医疗保险家庭健康支出中有3.4%（约5.2亿美元）由欺诈性HHA开具账单。特别行动组的靶向性显著：其覆盖的九个辖区虽仅占家庭健康总支出的40%，却集中了65%的欺诈性支出。欺诈性HHA呈现典型特征：更依赖超高转诊量的医师，护理模式异常趋同，且服务对象健康水平高于平均水平。

url:278d932d6d021a48.abstract: This paper studies how short-term variations in fine particulate matter (PM2.5) pollution affects cognitive performance across tasks of varying complexity. While prior work shows that pollution impairs performance in highly demanding cognitive settings, it remains unclear whether these effects extend to simpler tasks. We examine this question using data from official Rubik's Cube tournaments in the United States and India. Solving different cube sizes provides a natural proxy for task complexity, while solving time measures cognitive performance. To identify causal effects, we exploit exogenous variation in local PM2.5 generated by wind direction. We find that PM2.5 pollution has negligible effects on simple tasks but significantly slows performance on complex ones for tournaments in the United States. In India, where baseline PM2.5 levels are substantially higher, we find similar effect patterns but none of the effects are statistically significant. We show that this pattern is explained by diminishing marginal sensitivity to short-term PM2.5 shocks as baseline PM2.5 pollution levels increase. Our findings provide causal evidence that the cognitive costs of PM2.5 pollution depend critically on task complexity.
url:278d932d6d021a48.abstract_zh: 本文研究了细颗粒物（PM2.5）污染的短期波动如何影响不同复杂度任务的认知表现。尽管已有研究表明污染会损害高认知需求环境下的表现，但尚不清楚这种影响是否延伸至简单任务。我们利用美国和印度官方魔方锦标赛的数据检验这一问题。不同尺寸魔方的求解过程自然反映了任务复杂度，而求解时间则衡量认知表现。为识别因果效应，我们利用风向引起的本地PM2.5外生变化。研究发现，PM2.5污染对美国锦标赛中简单任务的影响微乎其微，但显著降低了复杂任务的表现速度。在基线PM2.5水平显著更高的印度，我们观察到相似的影响模式，但所有效应均未达到统计显著性。我们证明，这一模式可通过短期PM2.5冲击的边际敏感性随基线污染水平升高而递减来解释。研究结果提供了因果证据，表明PM2.5污染的认知成本关键取决于任务复杂度。

url:291c6d2345b14ac7.abstract: As global change accelerates, Payments for Ecosystem Services (PES) programs have become increasingly important tools for addressing the interconnected challenges of land degradation, biodiversity loss, water scarcity, and climate change. PES programs provide incentives to individuals or communities, conditional on people adopting sustainable natural resource management practices to support or increase ecosystem service provisioning. Although conditionality is considered a “PES-defining feature,” little is known about how conditionality is perceived by community members and how such perceptions influence their participation in and experience with PES programs. To address this gap, we conducted an extensive qualitative study of Watershared, a Bolivian PES program, to investigate (1) how community members perceive conditionality in PES and its two components—monitoring and sanction, and (2) how removing conditionality influences PES participants’ perceptions of the program and relationship with the implementing organization. We found that Watershared participants perceived monitoring as more than just a compliance check mechanism; they saw it as a form of technical support and relationship building, which strengthens their relational values toward both nature and the program itself. Participants were generally unconcerned about sanctioning, with many viewing sanctioning as unnecessary or unenforceable, despite the implementing organization having imposed sanctions previously. Watershared participants with unconditional contracts generally noticed the removal of conditionality, with some interpreting it as a lack of care and reciprocity from the implementing organization. These results highlight how relational values were developed and supported through the two components of conditionality in PES. These results suggest that the role of conditionality in PES may be less about surveillance and penalty to ensure conservation, but more about serving as an avenue to activate and strengthen community members’ relational values toward nature and the PES-implementing organization, which may, in turn, improve program effectiveness and future participation. In the face of intensifying global environmental change, such relational values tied to conditionality in PES, as identified in this research, are critical for fostering and sustaining cooperation, trust, and long-term commitment to conservation.
url:291c6d2345b14ac7.abstract_zh: 随着全球变化加速，生态系统服务付费（PES）项目已成为应对土地退化、生物多样性丧失、水资源短缺和气候变化等相互关联挑战的重要工具。PES项目向个人或社区提供激励，条件是他们采取可持续自然资源管理实践，以支持或增加生态系统服务供给。尽管条件性被视为“PES的定义性特征”，但关于社区成员如何感知条件性，以及这种感知如何影响他们参与PES项目并形成相关体验，目前知之甚少。为填补这一空白，我们对玻利维亚的Watershared PES项目进行了广泛的定性研究，旨在探究：（1）社区成员如何感知PES中的条件性及其两个组成部分——监测与制裁；（2）取消条件性如何影响PES参与者对项目的看法及其与实施组织的关系。我们发现，Watershared参与者将监测视为不仅仅是合规检查机制，更将其视为一种技术支持和关系建设形式，这强化了他们对自然和项目本身的关联价值。参与者普遍不关心制裁，许多人认为制裁不必要或无法执行，尽管实施组织此前曾施加过制裁。拥有无条件合同的Watershared参与者通常注意到条件性的取消，其中一些人将其解读为实施组织缺乏关怀和互惠。这些结果凸显了关联价值如何通过PES条件性的两个组成部分得以发展和支持。这些结果表明，PES中条件性的作用可能不在于通过监督和惩罚来确保保护，而更多是作为激活和加强社区成员对自然及PES实施组织的关联价值的途径，这进而可能提升项目有效性和未来参与度。面对日益加剧的全球环境变化，本研究所识别的与PES条件性相关的关联价值，对于培养和维持合作、信任以及对保护的长期承诺至关重要。

url:29831aeff41b4806.abstract: Firms often rebrand to counter negative shocks, but can it work? Using a historical natural experiment, we analyze a large sample of companies from the same industry (banking) that shared very similar names, but overwhelmingly decided to change them in response to a common, negative news shock. U.S. entry into World War I in 1917 created a sudden anti-German backlash against anything that invoked an association with the now enemy. The shock itself was thus orthogonal to bank fundamentals and pre-existing trends, but pushed banks to reconsider their brands. After 1917, the few German-named banks that kept their tainted names saw significant declines in assets, deposits, and market share relative to other banks. However, German-named banks that rebranded mitigated much of the negative shock. Specifically, German-named banks that adopted a new non-ethnic brand name avoided between 75% and 85% of the anti-German effect, and those that adopted a new patriotic brand name were able to neutralize it completely. Overall, we find that "crisis rebranding" paid off in our historical setting regardless of the chosen brand, with patriotic rebranding proving the most effective at offsetting the exogenous shock.
url:29831aeff41b4806.abstract_zh: 企业常通过品牌重塑应对负面冲击，但这一策略是否有效？借助历史自然实验，我们分析了同一行业（银行业）中大量名称高度相似的公司样本，这些公司在面临共同负面新闻冲击时，绝大多数选择更改名称。1917年美国加入第一次世界大战，引发了对任何与敌国（德国）相关事物的突然反德情绪。这一冲击本身与银行基本面及既有趋势正交，却促使银行重新审视其品牌。1917年后，少数保留受污名化德文名称的银行，其资产、存款及市场份额相较于其他银行显著下滑。然而，进行品牌重塑的德文名称银行在很大程度上缓解了负面冲击。具体而言，采用非族裔新品牌名称的德文名称银行避免了75%至85%的反德效应，而采用爱国新品牌名称的银行则完全抵消了这一影响。总体而言，我们发现无论选择何种品牌，历史情境下的“危机品牌重塑”均取得了成效，其中爱国品牌重塑在抵消外生冲击方面最为有效。
authors: Kilian Rieder; Matthew Jaremski; Kris Mitchener

url:2992294f52f471fa.abstract: We use the US Distributional Financial Accounts to assess how wealth across the income distribution responds to uncertainty shocks. Following an uncertainty shock, we find that wealth inequality between those in the top percentile of the income distribution and those in the bottom fortieth percentile of the income distribution declines. We show that the result is driven by systematic differences in portfolio composition between high income and low income individuals, with high income individuals having greater exposure to high risk assets. The response of high risk asset inequality is negative while the response of low risk asset inequality is positive. Therefore, the decline in wealth inequality is due to high income individuals losing more relative to lower income individuals rather than lower income individuals catching up to higher income individuals.
url:2992294f52f471fa.abstract_zh: 我们利用美国分配金融账户数据，评估收入分布各阶层的财富如何响应不确定性冲击。研究发现，在不确定性冲击发生后，收入分布前百分位群体与后四十百分位群体之间的财富不平等程度有所下降。这一结果源于高收入与低收入群体在资产组合构成上的系统性差异——高收入群体对高风险资产的敞口更大。高风险资产不平等呈负向响应，而低风险资产不平等呈正向响应。因此，财富不平等的下降并非低收入群体追赶高收入群体所致，而是高收入群体相对损失更大。

url:29bb043b9e0bf7d8.abstract: Trade networks underpinning the energy transition are endogenous economic objects, and their structure is a source of market power. Using bilateral trade data for thirteen electrification metals over 1995–2023, we show that trade in these materials has reorganised into a hub-and-spoke system centred on China, in sharp contrast to the diffuse, multilateral structure of fossil fuels. This centrality did not follow from resource endowments: China holds few of the underlying reserves. It was built through processing investment, industrial policy, and commodity-targeted development finance—an equilibrium outcome rather than a geographical accident. We formalise this in a stylised model in which a country chooses how central to become, and show that centrality maps into pricing power: the world price response to a strategic supply cut is stronger when the network is more concentrated and downstream demand and fringe supply are more inelastic. Constructing text-based, commodity-specific supply shocks and estimating local projections, we find that supply contractions in critical metals raise US and EU consumer prices by roughly twice as much as comparable fossil-fuel shocks, and more persistently. Centrality is therefore not merely descriptive: it creates leverage over global prices. The green transition reduces strategic dependence on hydrocarbon exporters but reconstitutes it around mineral supply chains. That's 200 words. Main cuts: removed the redundant "response to a strategic supply cut" phrasing fix (corrected the original "price...response" agreement), trimmed the closing "architecture of," and compressed a few connectors without losing any substantive claim.Please provide a short description (less than 180 characters) of the paper's findings. url:29bb043b9e0bf7d8.abstract_zh: 支撑能源转型的贸易网络是内生的经济对象，其结构构成市场势力的来源。利用1995-2023年间十三种电气化金属的双边贸易数据，我们发现这些材料的贸易已重组为以中国为中心的轴辐式体系，与化石燃料分散的多边结构形成鲜明对比。这种中心地位并非源于资源禀赋——中国持有的基础储量很少，而是通过加工投资、产业政策和针对特定商品的发展融资构建而成，是均衡结果而非地理偶然。我们通过一个简约模型将这一过程形式化，其中一国选择其中心化程度，并证明中心度映射为定价权：当网络更集中、下游需求和边缘供给更缺乏弹性时，战略性供给削减对世界价格的冲击更强。通过构建基于文本的特定商品供给冲击并估计局部投影，我们发现关键金属的供给收缩使美国和欧盟消费者价格涨幅约为可比化石燃料冲击的两倍，且持续性更强。因此，中心度不仅是描述性概念，更创造了影响全球价格的杠杆。绿色转型减少了对碳氢化合物出口国的战略依赖，但将其重构于矿产供应链之上。

url:2a3cf0a01e14b207.abstract: We show that the optimal monetary policy and exchange rate framework depend critically on the economy’s commodity exposure. We develop a flexible but tractable model economy with commodity exports and imports, in which international financial conditions may vary with the commodity cycle, and we compute the welfare-optimal policy in the presence of price and wage rigidities. Stabilizing domestic prices is welfare-optimal for commodity exporters, in line with standard open-economy policy prescriptions. But for economies that use commodities as inputs in production, optimal policy largely ‘looks through’ the direct and indirect effects of commodity shocks on domestic prices; this contrasts with some earlier findings and policy practice (which only ‘looks through’ the direct effect). Exchange-rate pegs increase welfare for commodity importers because they stabilize wages and employment, though it is not a robustly optimal policy. In emerging and developing economies, where financial conditions are more tied to the commodity cycle, trade-offs are starker and implementing the optimal policy may be challenging, since it requires enough credibility to keep inflation expectations anchored amidst greater volatility in some nominal variables.
url:2a3cf0a01e14b207.abstract_zh: 我们证明，最优货币政策与汇率框架的关键取决于经济体的商品敞口程度。我们构建了一个兼具灵活性与可操作性的模型经济体，该模型包含商品进出口部门，且国际金融条件可能随商品周期变化，并在存在价格与工资粘性的条件下计算了福利最优政策。对于商品出口国而言，稳定国内价格是福利最优选择，这与标准开放经济政策建议一致。但对于将商品作为生产投入的经济体，最优政策在很大程度上会"忽略"商品冲击对国内价格的直接与间接影响——这与部分早期研究发现及政策实践（仅"忽略"直接影响）形成对比。对商品进口国而言，钉住汇率制度能提升福利水平，因其可稳定工资与就业，但这并非稳健的最优政策。在新兴市场与发展中经济体，金融条件与商品周期的关联更为紧密，政策权衡更为严峻，实施最优政策可能面临挑战——这要求政策具备足够公信力，以便在部分名义变量波动加剧时仍能锚定通胀预期。

url:2a75642e85082b29.abstract: This paper studies the introduction of causal conditional heteroskedasticity in noncausal autoregressive (AR) models. We demonstrate that, in this framework, large shocks to the innovation process driving the GARCH error term of a noncausal AR model result in heightened volatility immediately before and after a bubble crash. The non-coincidence of the σ -fields generated by past observations and past values of the GARCH process makes statistical inference nonstandard. In particular, the full quasi-maximum likelihood estimator (QMLE) is generally inconsistent. We investigate the asymptotic properties of three-step weighted least squares estimators of the AR coefficient and the QMLE of the volatility parameters. Our findings are illustrated by Monte Carlo experiments and an empirical application to financial data.
url:2a75642e85082b29.abstract_zh: 本文研究在非因果自回归（AR）模型中引入因果条件异方差性的方法。我们证明，在该框架下，驱动非因果AR模型GARCH误差项的创新过程中的大幅冲击，会导致泡沫崩溃前后波动性显著加剧。由于过去观测值生成的σ域与GARCH过程过去值生成的σ域不重合，统计推断变得非标准。具体而言，完全拟极大似然估计量（QMLE）通常不一致。我们研究了AR系数的三步加权最小二乘估计量以及波动率参数的QMLE的渐近性质。通过蒙特卡洛实验和对金融数据的实证应用，本文验证了上述发现。

url:2ab79988688ba071.abstract: Using novel data from the Survey of Household Economics and Decisionmaking, we examine how labor market tightness affects workers’ job quality. We estimate that a 10 percent increase in job vacancies not only increases the probability of changing jobs, it yields an 11–18 percent increase in the (unconditional) probability of switching to a better job overall, and one with greater pay and benefits, interest in the work, and advancement opportunities. Because tight labor markets improve both worker pay and job amenities in roughly the same proportion, their benefits to workers are underestimated when based on pay alone.
url:2ab79988688ba071.abstract_zh: 利用来自家庭经济与决策调查的新数据，我们研究了劳动力市场紧张程度如何影响工人的工作质量。我们估计，职位空缺每增加10%，不仅会提高工人更换工作的概率，还会使工人（无条件）转向整体更优工作的概率提升11%至18%，这类工作通常伴随更高的薪酬与福利、更强的工作兴趣以及更多的晋升机会。由于紧张的劳动力市场在提升工人薪酬与工作环境舒适度方面大致保持相同比例，仅基于薪酬评估会低估其对工人的整体益处。

url:2ab85ab9cce0490c.abstract: How do import tariffs affect retail prices? We combine daily product-level posted prices from seven major Canadian retailers with product-level tariff exposure to estimate tariff effects in a difference-in-differences framework. Prices of tariffed goods rose gradually, peaking at 6% after three months, implying pass-through of roughly one quarter of the 25% tariff. We find little spillover to untariffed substitutes and a rapid reversal of price effects after tariff removal. Adjustment occurred mainly through the frequency of price changes. Pass-through shifted with trade-policy news and was larger for products labeled “Tariffed”, showing that tariff-induced inflation depends on policy expectations and tariff salience.
url:2ab85ab9cce0490c.abstract_zh: 进口关税如何影响零售价格？我们整合了加拿大七家主要零售商的每日产品层面标价数据与产品层面的关税暴露程度，在双重差分框架下估算关税效应。受关税影响商品的价格逐步上升，三个月后达到6%的峰值，这意味着约四分之一的25%关税被传导至价格。我们未发现对未征税替代品产生显著溢出效应，且关税取消后价格效应迅速逆转。价格调整主要通过调价频率实现。传导效应随贸易政策新闻动态变化，且对标注"征税"标签的产品更为显著，这表明关税引发的通胀取决于政策预期与关税显著性。

url:2b082036b33c58b6.abstract: Despite unprecedented access to information in the digital age, young citizens face growing challenges related to news consumption and misinformation. This large-scale randomized controlled trial examines the impact of two complementary interventions designed to foster media literacy and the consumption of high-quality news among high-school students, implemented in France over the 2024-25 academic year. The study involves 243 high schools (for a total number of 9,628 students), randomly assigned to a control group or to receive one or both of the following interventions: (i) a one-year free digital subscription to the leading national newspaper, and (ii) media education modules implemented by teachers. Exploiting unique data on students' actual online news consumption, we document a very large uptake of the free subscription, which translates into persistent and large increases in news consumption (+0.49 to 0.60 sd) and demand for future news, including an 8pp increase in paid subscriptions nearly a year after the intervention. We also observe a 0.20 to 0.31 sd increase in news knowledge for students enrolled in deprived schools, reducing baseline information inequality by 45-70%. Finally, we show that both free news access and media education improve media literacy skills (+0.08 to 0.26 sd), with larger effects among students taught by teachers with prior experience in media education.
url:2b082036b33c58b6.abstract_zh: 尽管数字时代信息获取空前便捷，但年轻公民在新闻消费与应对虚假信息方面仍面临日益严峻的挑战。本项大规模随机对照试验考察了两项互补性干预措施的效果——旨在培养高中生媒介素养并促进高质量新闻消费，于2024-25学年在法国实施。研究涵盖243所高中（共计9,628名学生），随机分配至对照组或接受以下一项或两项干预：（i）为期一年的全国性主流报纸免费数字订阅；（ii）由教师实施的媒介教育模块。通过利用学生实际在线新闻消费的独特数据，我们发现免费订阅的采纳率极高，这转化为新闻消费的持续大幅增长（效应量0.49至0.60个标准差）及未来新闻需求的提升，包括干预实施近一年后付费订阅率增加8个百分点。在贫困学校就读的学生中，我们还观察到新闻知识水平提升0.20至0.31个标准差，使基线信息不平等程度降低45-70%。最后，研究表明免费新闻获取与媒介教育均能提升媒介素养技能（效应量0.08至0.26个标准差），且对由具备媒介教育经验的教师授课的学生影响更大。

url:2c3d8e326fef9053.abstract: Labour force participation among prime-aged American men has fallen for over half a century, and standard explanations leave much of the decline unaccounted for. This column combines panel and survey data to show that the labour markets these men experienced while growing up shaped their willingness to work decades later. These effects survive childhood moves across states and likely operate through men’s beliefs about whether work will pay off. If temporary downturns in labour demand can persistently influence labour supply, anchoring expectations about employment, not just inflation, may have a place in macroeconomic policy.
url:2c3d8e326fef9053.abstract_zh: 美国壮年男性劳动力参与率已持续下降逾半个世纪，而标准解释未能完全说明这一下降的原因。本专栏结合面板数据与调查数据表明，这些男性在成长过程中经历的劳动力市场状况，会影响他们数十年后的工作意愿。即便在童年跨州迁移的情况下，这种影响依然存在，且很可能通过男性对工作是否值得付出的信念发挥作用。如果劳动力需求的暂时低迷能够持续影响劳动力供给，那么锚定就业预期（而不仅仅是通胀预期）或许应在宏观经济政策中占有一席之地。

url:2ce494145e0cae43.abstract: Frontier Market (FM) status serves as a steppingstone for Low-Income Countries (LICs) aspiring to become Emerging Markets (EMs). Since the concept first emerged over three decades ago, FMs have gained substantial investment appeal, particularly after the 2008 Global Financial Crisis. At the same time, the recent series of global shocks starting with the COVID-19 pandemic highlighted the countries’ persistent vulnerabilities. This paper seeks to deepen our understanding of FMs by offering new analysis on the determinants of frontier market status and, using a dynamic country sample, examining the factors that help LICs attain and lose FM status. It finds that building robust macroeconomic fundamentals and ensuring good governance are critical for becoming an FM. In addition, the paper identifies flexible exchange rates, substantial official reserve buffers, and relatively low public debt and deficit levels as key contributors to lessening the sensitivity of FMs’ sovereign spreads to changes in global financial conditions.
url:2ce494145e0cae43.abstract_zh: 前沿市场（FM）地位是低收入国家（LICs）迈向新兴市场（EMs）的跳板。自三十多年前这一概念首次提出以来，FM已获得显著的投资吸引力，尤其是在2008年全球金融危机之后。与此同时，从新冠疫情开始的一系列近期全球冲击凸显了这些国家持续存在的脆弱性。本文旨在通过提供关于前沿市场地位决定因素的新分析，并利用动态国家样本，考察帮助低收入国家获得和失去FM地位的因素，从而加深我们对FM的理解。研究发现，构建稳健的宏观经济基本面并确保良好的治理是成为FM的关键。此外，本文指出，灵活的汇率制度、充足的外汇储备缓冲、以及相对较低的公共债务和赤字水平，是降低FM主权利差对全球金融状况变化敏感性的关键因素。
