url:485d0086cbef4117.abstract: The U.S. general fertility rate has fallen by 22% since 2007, a sustained decline not readily explained by economic conditions, contraceptive use, housing or childcare costs, or other commonly cited factors. We assess the potential role of a different shock: the diffusion of the smartphone. The U.S. rollout of the iPhone, the first modern smartphone, provides a natural experiment: from June 2007 through February 2011, the device was sold only on AT&T, allowing us to identify its effect from variation in AT&T’s mobile broadband coverage. Entropy-balanced Poisson and synthetic difference-in-differences event studies imply that access to the iPhone reduced births by 4.5–8.0% at ages 15–19 and 3.2–6.6% at ages 20–24, with statistically significant but smaller declines among older cohorts. Placebo analyses applied to Verizon and Sprint’s pre-2011 coverage footprint are null. Taken together, these cohort effects imply that the diffusion of the iPhone deepened the decline in births among women under 30 while suppressing the rise in births among older women. Overall, the diffusion of the iPhone explains 33–52% of the decline in the general fertility rate among women aged 15–44. National-survey evidence on time use and sexual behavior is consistent with the iPhone reducing in-person interactions, increasing pornography use, and reducing sexual frequency.
url:485d0086cbef4117.abstract_zh: 自2007年以来，美国总和生育率下降了22%，这一持续下降难以用经济状况、避孕措施使用、住房或育儿成本等常见因素解释。我们评估了另一种冲击的潜在作用：智能手机的普及。美国首款现代智能手机iPhone的推广提供了一个自然实验：从2007年6月至2011年2月，该设备仅由AT&T独家销售，这使我们能够通过AT&T移动宽带覆盖范围的差异识别其影响。基于熵平衡泊松模型和合成双重差分事件研究的结果表明，iPhone的接入使15-19岁年龄段的生育率下降4.5%-8.0%，20-24岁年龄段下降3.2%-6.6%，而较高年龄组虽呈现统计显著但降幅较小。针对Verizon和Sprint在2011年前覆盖范围的安慰剂分析未发现显著效应。综合来看，这些队列效应表明iPhone的普及加剧了30岁以下女性生育率的下降，同时抑制了高龄女性生育率的上升。总体而言，iPhone的普及解释了15-44岁女性总和生育率下降幅度的33%-52%。基于全国调查的时间使用与性行为证据显示，iPhone减少了面对面互动，增加了色情内容使用，并降低了性行为频率。

url:48aaf0d8a4d2d978.abstract: This paper estimates the effects of the 2025 U.S. tariffs on household spending using transaction-level data linked to tariff exposure and a tariff sentiment survey. Comparing high versus low tariff-exposed categories, we find 15 to 20 percent price pass-through. At the mean increase in tariff exposure, prices rise by 1 to 2 percent while spending falls by roughly 4 percent. Survey evidence linking stated intentions to revealed behavior identifies a mechanism for the large spending response: reallocation toward essentials and trade-down within categories, concentrated among middle-income households with discretionary slack who express tariff concerns. Low-income households bear a disproportionate welfare burden through regressive pass-through.
url:48aaf0d8a4d2d978.abstract_zh: 本文利用与关税暴露度相关联的交易级数据及关税情绪调查，估算了2025年美国关税对家庭支出的影响。通过比较高关税暴露度与低关税暴露度的商品类别，我们发现价格传导率为15%至20%。在关税暴露度平均增幅下，价格上涨1%至2%，而支出下降约4%。将调查中陈述的意图与揭示的行为相联系的证据，识别出了支出大幅变动的机制：向必需品重新配置以及类别内的降级消费，这一现象集中在拥有可自由支配空间且表达关税担忧的中等收入家庭。低收入家庭则通过累退性传导承担了不成比例的福利负担。

url:48bf1acb10018ffe.abstract: Through a cluster randomised field trial, we evaluate the impact of an evidence-based, soft skills curriculum aimed at adolescents, referred to as Healthy Minds, that ran in 35 high schools in England over four years (2013/14 – 2017/18). We find supportive evidence that Healthy Minds positively augments the primary outcome of self-reported physical health in the treated adolescents. Treated pupils have global health attainment that is 0.235 standard deviations higher than children in the control group, resulting in a 10-percentile increase in their measured health status. We also find evidence of positive impacts on behaviour. There is no evidence of impacts on improved emotional wellbeing. We note significant gender differences in the effects found, strongly favouring boys. Overall, we provide strong evidence that a designed, taught life skills curriculum can improve related outcomes during the adolescent years, and that differential learning styles across visible aspects of diversity are worthy of consideration Healthy Minds.
url:48bf1acb10018ffe.abstract_zh: 通过一项整群随机实地试验，我们评估了一项名为“健康心智”的循证软技能课程对青少年的影响。该课程在英国35所高中开展了四年（2013/14至2017/18学年）。研究发现支持性证据表明，“健康心智”课程对受试青少年的主要结果——自我报告的身体健康——产生了积极提升作用。受试学生的整体健康水平比对照组儿童高出0.235个标准差，相当于其测量健康状态提升了10个百分点。我们还发现了该课程对行为产生积极影响的证据，但未发现其对情绪健康改善有显著影响。我们注意到效应存在显著的性别差异，且明显更有利于男生。总体而言，我们提供了有力证据，表明设计并教授的生活技能课程能够改善青少年时期的相关结果，同时，在可见的多样性维度上，差异化的学习风格值得在“健康心智”课程中加以考虑。

url:4976863c4331deb2.abstract: Focus Historically, banks' holdings of sovereign debt have been key drivers of the co-movement between sovereign and bank risks. Recent years have seen an increase in banks' links with non-bank financial institutions (NBFIs) as well as a greater presence of NBFIs in sovereign debt markets. These developments have the potential to broaden the classical sovereign-bank nexus into a sovereign-bank-NBFI nexus. We examine the degree to which this has taken place, using European bank-level data along with global country-level data.
url:4976863c4331deb2.abstract_zh: 历史上，银行持有的主权债务一直是主权风险与银行风险联动的主要驱动因素。近年来，银行与非银行金融机构（NBFIs）的联系日益紧密，同时NBFIs在主权债务市场中的参与度显著提升。这些发展可能将传统的主权-银行关联扩展为主权-银行-NBFI三重关联。我们利用欧洲银行层面的数据及全球国家层面的数据，考察了这一转变的实现程度。

url:49d3c4e7e45d0b21.abstract: Why might persuaders favor anecdotes over aggregate statistics? We study a policy advocate choosing between them to persuade a diverse, skeptical citizenry with demographically correlated outcomes. Two forces compete: an umbrella effect, by which everyone responds more strongly to the statistic, and a wild-card effect, by which the anecdote's higher variance makes favorable realizations likelier. The anecdote prevails under sufficiently narrow consensus, so its appeal has a rational, informational basis. When breadth of aggregation is flexible, the optimal evidence is a local statistic that aggregates over a broader subpopulation than the minimal winning coalition, though almost anecdotal as consensus narrows.
url:49d3c4e7e45d0b21.abstract_zh: 为何说服者更偏爱轶事而非总体统计数据？我们研究了一位政策倡导者在两者间的选择，其目标是说服一个具有人口统计相关结果的多元化、持怀疑态度的公民群体。两种效应相互竞争：一是“伞效应”，即每个人对统计数据的反应更为强烈；二是“野牌效应”，即轶事的高方差使得有利结果更可能出现。当共识足够狭窄时，轶事占据上风，因此其吸引力具有理性的信息基础。当聚合范围灵活时，最优证据是一种局部统计量，它聚合了比最小获胜联盟更广泛的子群体，但随着共识变窄，这种统计量几乎接近于轶事。

url:4a02df8cf156eb87.abstract: We study the evolution of digital and artificial intelligence (AI) skill demand across six economies in Asia and the Pacific between 2019 and 2024 using millions of online job postings from Indeed and a large language model to classify them by their required level of digital and AI proficiency. Digital skill requirements are widespread across the occupational distribution and have expanded most rapidly in traditionally low and mid digital jobs, pointing to broad technological diffusion. Jobs requiring higher digital proficiency command substantially higher pay, even when comparing job postings within the same job title and controlling for cognitive, interpersonal, organizational, and technical skill requirements. We estimate wage premia of approximately 4%, 11%, and 26% for basic, intermediate, and advanced digital skills, respectively, with intermediate and advanced digital skills commanding larger premia than many other highly rewarded skills. We also document a sharp increase in demand for AI-related competencies, particularly those related to the use of AI tools.
url:4a02df8cf156eb87.abstract_zh: 我们利用Indeed平台数百万条在线招聘信息，结合大语言模型按所需数字与人工智能（AI）技能水平进行分类，研究了2019至2024年间亚太地区六个经济体的数字与AI技能需求的演变。数字技能要求广泛分布于各职业层级，且在传统低数字与中数字岗位中增长最为迅速，表明技术正在广泛扩散。要求较高数字技能水平的岗位薪酬显著更高——即便在控制认知、人际、组织及技术技能要求后，对同一职位名称的招聘信息进行比较时亦是如此。我们估算出基础、中级与高级数字技能的工资溢价分别约为4%、11%和26%，其中中级与高级数字技能的溢价幅度超过许多其他高回报技能。此外，我们还发现对AI相关能力（尤其是AI工具使用能力）的需求急剧增长。

url:4a5977d42c0d0c6f.abstract: High-debt euro area economies face fiscal consolidation in a low-growth environment. We use a Heterogeneous Agent New Keynesian model to assess how consolidation composition shapes aggregate and distributional outcomes in a representative high-debt economy. The status quo is not neutral: delay generates its own costs through lower investment, higher debt service, and damage to constrained households. For a given fiscal effort, expenditure-based consolidation achieves faster debt reduction with lower growth and distributional costs than revenue-based consolidation. As a complementary exercise, pairing the expenditurebased path with growth-enhancing structural reforms further improves outcomes by lifting real wages, a channel that disproportionately benefits hand-to-mouth households. Across both strategies, modest well targeted transfers to low-income households can substantially mitigate distributional costs at minimal fiscal expense while supporting aggregate demand.
url:4a5977d42c0d0c6f.abstract_zh: 高负债欧元区经济体在低增长环境中面临财政整固挑战。我们采用异质性主体新凯恩斯模型，评估不同整固方案对典型高负债经济体的总量与分配效应。现状并非中性：延迟整固将通过抑制投资、增加偿债负担及损害受约束家庭产生额外成本。在既定财政努力下，相较于收入端整固，支出端整固能以更低的经济增长与分配成本实现更快的债务削减。作为补充方案，将支出端路径与促进增长的结构性改革相结合，可通过提升实际工资进一步改善经济表现——这一渠道对月光族家庭的惠及程度尤为显著。两种策略中，针对低收入家庭的适度定向转移支付能以最小财政代价显著缓解分配成本，同时支撑总需求。

url:4ae9a1c9f589e9c6.abstract: Firm heterogeneity in financial constraints is a quantitatively important driver of how monetary policy transmits to inflation. Using detailed microdata on Swedish public and private firms, and high-frequency monetary policy surprises around Riksbank announcements, we document that smaller, financially constrained firms adjust prices significantly less than larger firms in response to changes in monetary policy. This heterogeneous price response materially dampens the aggregate PPI inflation response to monetary policy. Models of customer markets and financial frictions can explain our findings: because the external finance premium rises after a monetary contraction, constrained firms cut prices less to preserve cash flows, sacrificing future market share. Additional evidence on heterogeneous sales, debt, marginal cost, and markup responses further supports this channel. We consider several alternative explanations, including differences in price adjustments, working capital, market share, and export share, but these cannot explain our main heterogeneity result.
url:4ae9a1c9f589e9c6.abstract_zh: 企业融资约束的异质性在货币政策向通胀传导过程中具有重要的定量意义。基于瑞典上市与非上市企业的微观数据，结合瑞典央行公告前后高频货币政策意外冲击，我们发现：相较于大型企业，规模较小且面临融资约束的企业在应对货币政策变化时，其价格调整幅度显著更低。这种异质性价格响应实质上削弱了货币政策对总体生产者价格指数（PPI）通胀的影响。客户市场模型与金融摩擦理论可解释这一发现：由于货币紧缩后外部融资溢价上升，受约束企业为维持现金流而减少降价幅度，从而牺牲未来市场份额。关于销售额、债务、边际成本及加成率异质性的额外证据进一步支持该传导渠道。我们考察了包括价格调整成本、营运资本、市场份额及出口份额在内的多种替代性解释，但这些因素均无法解释核心异质性结论。

url:4aeda219fa8b8282.abstract: This study analyses the creation of La Réunion National Park (2002–2007) as a strategic and competitive political process embedded within a formal conservation planning framework. Drawing on Evolutionary Governance Theory (EGT), it shows how boundary delineation functioned as a governance instrument that reconfigured power relations between the French state and the Regional Council within a post-colonial, multi-level European outermost context marked by socio-environmental vulnerability and claims for regional autonomy. Combining GIS-based spatial analysis, archival research, and semi-structured interviews, the study traces the co-evolution of actors, institutions, discourses, knowledge, and material instruments throughout the park’s spatial planning process. Results, structured along five EGT analytical axes, indicate that boundary delineation constituted a strategic governance process rather than a purely technical exercise. Environmental planning emerged as a political arena in which power relations between the French state and the Regional Council were renegotiated. Scientific expertise and digital tools played a central role in legitimising decisions. Simultaneously, they contributed to filtering and hierarchising competing territorial claims. Participatory processes were formally inclusive but tightly managed, enabling consultation without substantially altering predefined outcomes and resulting in limited boundary changes. Finally, despite stated autonomy-oriented objectives, environmental planning contributed to the production of new social and spatial inequalities, highlighting the ambivalent role of conservation policies in island governance: ensuring both protection and external territorial control. More broadly, the study demonstrates how conservation planning operates as a governance instrument that shapes and reveals land values and power distribution. These findings suggest that boundary delineation should be explicitly treated as a political and governance instrument, requiring greater transparency, stronger accountability, and more substantive inclusion of local actors to avoid reinforcing existing power asymmetries in spatial planning.
url:4aeda219fa8b8282.abstract_zh: 本研究分析了留尼汪国家公园（2002–2007年）的创建过程，将其视为嵌入正式保护规划框架中的战略性与竞争性政治进程。基于演化治理理论（EGT），研究揭示了边界划定如何作为一种治理工具，在面临社会-环境脆弱性与区域自治诉求的后殖民、多层级欧洲最外围地区，重构法国国家与地区议会之间的权力关系。通过结合地理信息系统空间分析、档案研究与半结构化访谈，本研究追溯了公园空间规划过程中行动者、制度、话语、知识与物质工具的协同演化。依据EGT五大分析维度呈现的结果表明，边界划定构成了一种战略性治理过程，而非纯粹的技术性操作。环境规划成为法国国家与地区议会重新协商权力关系的政治场域。科学专业知识与数字工具在决策合法化中发挥核心作用，同时亦对相互竞争的领土诉求进行筛选与等级化。参与过程形式上具有包容性，但受到严格管控，允许协商却未实质性改变预设结果，仅导致有限的边界调整。最终，尽管以自治为导向的目标被明确表述，环境规划却催生了新的社会与空间不平等，凸显了保护政策在岛屿治理中的矛盾角色：既确保保护，又强化外部领土控制。更广泛而言，本研究揭示了保护规划如何作为塑造并反映土地价值与权力分配的治理工具。这些发现表明，边界划定应被明确视为政治与治理工具，需要更高的透明度、更强的问责机制以及更实质性的地方行动者参与，以避免在空间规划中强化既有的权力不对称。
url:4aeda219fa8b8282.title: What boundary delineation reveals about island evolutionary governance: Multi-level power brokerage in Réunion National Park

url:4b1806829f24334a.abstract: A prominent explanation for declining labor shares is automation. We test this mechanism directly at the firm level, drawing on a central prediction of the task-based model of production: firms that automate more should see larger declines in routine employment and labor share. Using administrative data from France between 1994 and 2019, we find no support for this prediction. Changes in routine employment share are either uncorrelated or even negatively correlated with changes in labor share within firms. Our evidence shows that automation is not driving labor share dynamics in France.
url:4b1806829f24334a.abstract_zh: 关于劳动份额下降的一个主要解释是自动化。我们基于任务型生产模型的核心预测，在企业层面直接检验了这一机制：自动化程度更高的企业，其常规就业份额和劳动份额应出现更大幅度的下降。利用1994年至2019年法国的行政数据，我们发现这一预测未得到支持。在企业内部，常规就业份额的变化与劳动份额的变化要么不相关，甚至呈负相关。我们的证据表明，自动化并非法国劳动份额动态变化的驱动因素。
url:4b1806829f24334a.title: Does Automation Lower the Labor Share?

url:4b8e040457711778.abstract: We evaluate whether LLMs have had any discernible impact on the aggregate labor market so far. We focus on occupations that are computer programming-intensive, motivated by data showing that coding is one of the most LLM-exposed tasks. Linking O*NET to CPS we find that aggregate employment of coders has decelerated sharply since the introduction of ChatGPT. Using a novel control variable for industry-level shocks we show that the deceleration is not attributable to the exposure of coders to slowing industries, suggesting instead that coders experienced an occupation-specific shock around the introduction of ChatGPT. Coder employment has continued to grow in recent years, though much more slowly than it did pre-2022. We validate the industry-level control variable by examining historical examples of occupations that experienced either occupation-specific or industry-level shocks. We also provide statistics on the agreement rates between different measures of AI exposure.
url:4b8e040457711778.abstract_zh: 我们评估了大型语言模型（LLMs）是否对当前总体劳动力市场产生了可识别的影响。基于编码是最受LLM影响的任务之一的数据驱动，我们重点关注计算机编程密集型职业。通过将O*NET与当前人口调查（CPS）数据关联，我们发现自ChatGPT推出以来，编程人员的总体就业增速显著放缓。利用行业层面冲击的新型控制变量，我们证明这种放缓并非源于编程人员所在行业的衰退冲击，而是表明编程人员在ChatGPT推出前后经历了职业特异性冲击。近年来编程人员就业虽持续增长，但增速远低于2022年前的水平。我们通过考察历史上经历职业特异性冲击或行业层面冲击的职业案例，验证了行业层面控制变量的有效性，并提供了不同人工智能暴露度测量指标间的一致率统计。
url:4b8e040457711778.title: AI and Coder Employment: Compiling the Evidence
url:4b8e040457711778.title_zh: 人工智能与程序员就业：证据汇编

url:4b96305aa6f85540.abstract: How does terrorism affect labor markets in developing countries? We combine georeferenced data on terrorist incidents with nationally representative employment data from Nigeria to examine this question. Exploiting within-location variation in exposure to terrorist attacks over time, we show that terrorism reduces employment. A one standard deviation increase in exposure lowers the probability of employment by 0.7 percentage points, or roughly 1 percent of average employment, with substantially larger effects for women. Beyond reducing employment, terrorism shifts workers away from regular and cash-paying jobs and lowers employment in sales, services, and unskilled manual occupations. The findings identify labor market disruption as an important economic cost of insecurity in developing countries.
url:4b96305aa6f85540.abstract_zh: 恐怖主义如何影响发展中国家的劳动力市场？我们将恐怖袭击的地理参照数据与尼日利亚具有全国代表性的就业数据相结合来研究这一问题。通过利用同一地区在不同时期遭受恐怖袭击暴露程度的差异，我们发现恐怖主义会降低就业水平。暴露程度每增加一个标准差，就业概率将下降0.7个百分点，约占平均就业率的1%，且对女性的影响显著更大。除减少就业外，恐怖主义还促使劳动者远离正规及现金支付岗位，并导致销售、服务业及非熟练体力劳动职业的就业率下降。研究结果表明，劳动力市场紊乱是发展中国家不安全状况的重要经济成本。

url:4bf45ba612345daf.abstract: Many communities in the U.S. have programs that make financial assistance available to families with low incomes who are struggling to pay rent. In this paper, we examine the average and distributional impacts of reducing wait times for emergency housing assistance on evictions. Taking advantage of administrative data from Franklin County, Ohio and exploiting exogenous changes in application processing times in two complementary empirical approaches, we find that each additional week of delay in receiving assistance increases the probability of an eviction filing within 12 months by 19–29%. A substantial share of the additional filings result in judgments against tenants. Our results have important implications for the design and implementation of emergency rental assistance programs. More broadly, our findings speak to the downstream impacts of passive compliance costs in social safety net programs.
url:4bf45ba612345daf.abstract_zh: 美国许多社区设有项目，为难以支付租金的低收入家庭提供经济援助。本文研究了缩短紧急住房援助等待时间对驱逐事件的平均影响及分布效应。利用俄亥俄州富兰克林县的行政数据，并借助两种互补实证方法中申请处理时间的外生变化，我们发现：援助每延迟一周，12个月内收到驱逐申请的概率将增加19%至29%。这些额外申请中有相当比例最终导致对租户不利的判决。我们的研究结果对紧急租金援助项目的设计与实施具有重要启示。更广泛而言，本研究揭示了社会安全网项目中被动合规成本的后续影响。

url:4bf6f0bee1ebc164.abstract: This paper studies the aggregate implications of the geography of financial frictions faced by firms in Europe. Using proprietary data from the European Central Bank's Survey on the Access to Finance of Enterprises, we document three new facts. First, there is substantial regional heterogeneity in the access to external finance. Second, this heterogeneity is persistent, with only gradual convergence over time. Third, countries with tighter financial frictions are less responsive to monetary shocks. To formalize these empirical findings, we develop and calibrate a tractable New~Keynesian model of a monetary union with 22 countries that are heterogeneous in financial frictions, productivity, and size. High-friction countries are less responsive to monetary shocks because firms face a steeper marginal cost curve and a lower capital elasticity. The heterogeneity in financial frictions also shapes the output-inflation trade-off, as in high-friction countries the same output gain comes at the cost of more inflation. Convergence experiments show that financial market integration in the spirit of a European Savings and Investments Union raises the power of monetary policy, but at a potential cost to financial stability.
url:4bf6f0bee1ebc164.abstract_zh: 本文研究了欧洲企业面临的金融摩擦地理分布对宏观经济的影响。利用欧洲央行《企业融资渠道调查》的专有数据，我们揭示了三个新事实：第一，外部融资渠道存在显著的区域异质性；第二，这种异质性具有持续性，仅随时间呈现渐进式收敛；第三，金融摩擦更严重的国家对货币冲击的反应更弱。为将这些实证发现形式化，我们构建并校准了一个包含22个国家、在金融摩擦、生产率和规模方面存在异质性的可处理新凯恩斯货币联盟模型。高摩擦国家因企业面临更陡峭的边际成本曲线和更低的资本弹性，对货币冲击的反应更弱。金融摩擦的异质性还塑造了产出-通胀权衡关系——在高摩擦国家，同等产出增长需以更高通胀为代价。收敛实验表明，以欧洲储蓄与投资联盟为蓝本的金融市场一体化将增强货币政策效力，但可能以金融稳定为潜在代价。

url:4c75d693fcfc4bd5.abstract: This article revives and enhances the factor-supply approach to estimate the effects of changes in immigrant supply on wages and employment of US natives. We introduce and validate a skill-based shift-share IV for immigrants’ labor supply. We find a positive impact of immigration on natives' employment and significant imperfect substitutability between natives and immigrants. Consistent with these estimates, we find significant task complementarity and occupational upgrading of native workers in response to immigrants. Finally, we calculate that immigration over 2000-2023 increased wages of non-college-educated natives by 2.6 to 3.4%, with small effects on other groups.
url:4c75d693fcfc4bd5.abstract_zh: 本文重新激活并完善了要素供给方法，用以估算移民供给变化对美国本土劳动者工资与就业的影响。我们提出并验证了一种基于技能的偏移份额工具变量，用于衡量移民劳动力供给。研究发现，移民对本土劳动者的就业具有正向影响，且本土劳动者与移民之间存在显著的不完全替代性。与这些估计结果一致，我们还发现本土劳动者在应对移民时表现出显著的任务互补性与职业升级。最后，我们测算得出，2000年至2023年间的移民使未受过大学教育的本土劳动者工资提高了2.6%至3.4%，而对其他群体的影响较小。

url:4c87b527bdb328b5.abstract: Dynamic complementarity is the concept that past investments that lead to higher stocks of skill at an age, promote the growth of skills from investment at that age. We define and produce evidence on dynamic complementarity and its three components using unique Chinese data from a home visiting program for young children targeted to parents in rural China. In addition, we investigate growth in learning due to innate, parental, and environmental factors that occur in the absence of any formal intervention.
url:4c87b527bdb328b5.abstract_zh: 动态互补性是指过去投资在某一年龄阶段形成更高技能存量，从而促进该年龄阶段投资带来的技能增长这一概念。我们利用中国农村地区针对幼儿家长的家访项目所获取的独特数据，对动态互补性及其三个组成部分进行了界定并提供了实证证据。此外，我们还研究了在没有任何正式干预的情况下，由先天因素、父母因素及环境因素所导致的学习增长。

url:4cf951f2f9750333.abstract: Connections appear to be helpful in many contexts such as obtaining a job, a promotion, a grant, a loan, or publishing a paper. This may be due to favoritism or to information conveyed by connections. Building on earlier work on discrimination, we propose a new method that identifies these channels using data observed at the time of promotion. The method exploits distinct implications of the two effects on the relationship between observables and success. We show that extra information on connected candidates generates excess variance in latent errors while favors yield different promotion thresholds. We characterize the conditions under which both effects are identified and operationalize these ideas econometrically within a semiparametric framework. We also derive testable restrictions of the model and show how to account for connection endogeneity. We reanalyze data on academic promotions in Spain and Italy and political promotions in China. We detect evidence of favoritism for all types of candidates and of information effects for candidates applying to junior positions. We find strong support for the model’s testable restrictions.
url:4cf951f2f9750333.abstract_zh: 人脉关系在求职、晋升、获取资助、贷款或发表论文等多种情境中似乎都大有裨益。这既可能源于偏袒行为，也可能归因于人脉所传递的信息。基于早期关于歧视问题的研究，我们提出了一种新方法，利用晋升时观测到的数据来识别上述两种渠道。该方法利用了两种效应在可观测变量与成功结果之间关系上的不同含义。我们证明，关于人脉候选人的额外信息会引发潜在误差的过度方差，而偏袒则会导致不同的晋升门槛。我们刻画了两种效应均能被识别的条件，并在半参数框架内以计量经济学方法实现了这些思想。我们还推导出模型的可检验约束条件，并展示了如何处理人脉关系的内生性问题。我们重新分析了西班牙和意大利的学术晋升数据以及中国的政治晋升数据。研究发现，所有类型的候选人均存在偏袒效应的证据，而申请初级职位的候选人则存在信息效应的证据。模型的可检验约束条件得到了强有力的支持。

url:4e556411fa1b49c9.abstract: Can monetary incentives improve health behaviors in the long run, and do commonly used surrogate outcomes capture these effects? We study these questions in the context of vaccination using a large-scale eld experiment. The experiment combines commonly used surrogates|vaccination intentions, intermediate behavioral proxies, and short-run vaccination|with long-run administrative vaccination records. We first document that incentives increase vaccination rates in the long run: guaranteed $20 incentives raise COVID-19 booster uptake by 9 percentage points. Lottery-based incentives also increase long-run uptake, while prosocial incentives primarily accelerate vaccination. Second, using surrogacy methods, we study whether surrogates can predict long-run impacts. Although the surrogates are strongly correlated with eventual vaccination, the assumptions required for surrogacy methods are often violated, and they do not accurately predict long-run impacts. Our ndings highlight both the ability of incentives to change behavior and the importance of measuring long-run outcomes rather than relying solely on surrogates.
url:4e556411fa1b49c9.abstract_zh: 货币激励能否长期改善健康行为，而常用的替代结果指标能否捕捉这些效应？我们通过一项大规模实地实验，以疫苗接种为背景研究这些问题。该实验将常用替代指标（疫苗接种意愿、中间行为代理变量及短期疫苗接种）与长期行政疫苗接种记录相结合。首先，我们证实激励措施能长期提高疫苗接种率：保证提供20美元激励使新冠加强针接种率提升9个百分点。基于抽奖的激励措施同样能提高长期接种率，而亲社会激励主要加速疫苗接种进程。其次，通过替代指标方法，我们检验替代指标能否预测长期影响。尽管替代指标与最终疫苗接种存在强相关性，但替代指标方法所需假设常被违反，且无法准确预测长期影响。我们的发现既凸显了激励措施改变行为的能力，也揭示了测量长期结果而非仅依赖替代指标的重要性。
url:4e556411fa1b49c9.title: Incentives, Surrogates, and Long-run Vaccination

url:4f0c40eaeea352f6.abstract: Assessing land use and land cover dynamics in protected areas (PA) is fundamental to understanding how different conservation strategies influence outcomes across distinct territorial contexts. The present study provided one of the most comprehensive longitudinal assessments of the PAs under the Brazilian System of Nature Conservation Units, through geospatial statistical analysis of land use and cover variations between 1985 and 2022, drawing on an ad hoc Natural Cover Dynamics Index (NCDI). The results revealed persistent conversion of natural areas within Brazilian PAs, including strictly protected categories, with agricultural expansion emerging as the main driver of natural cover loss. Findings also indicated differences in conservation performance among PA categories, reinforcing broader theoretical and political debates around forest transition theory and land sparing versus land sharing strategies. Beyond providing large-scale empirical evidence on conservation outcomes in Brazil, the analytical framework developed in this study contributes to policy-oriented assessments aimed at improving strategic conservation planning and the effectiveness of protected area system. url:4f0c40eaeea352f6.abstract_zh: 评估保护区（PA）的土地利用与土地覆盖动态变化，对于理解不同保护策略如何在特定地域背景下影响保护成效至关重要。本研究基于1985年至2022年间土地利用与覆盖变化的时空统计分析，并借助特设的自然覆盖动态指数（NCDI），对巴西国家自然保护单位体系下的保护区进行了最为全面的纵向评估之一。结果显示，巴西保护区内（包括严格保护类别）的自然区域持续被转化，农业扩张成为自然覆盖丧失的主要驱动因素。研究还发现不同保护区类别在保护绩效上存在差异，这进一步强化了围绕森林转型理论以及土地节约与土地共享策略的广泛理论与政策辩论。除为巴西保护成效提供大规模实证证据外，本研究构建的分析框架还有助于开展面向政策导向的评估，旨在优化战略性保护规划并提升保护区体系的有效性。

url:4f5fd2d1c5b23c8a.abstract: This paper shows that separating persistent (permanent) temperature changes from transitory weather fluctuations can reshape our understanding of the macroeconomic costs of warming. Using a Kalman filter state-space decomposition, it separates temperature into a permanent component and transitory weather fluctuations, and links the permanent component to trend output using a panel cointegration and error-correction framework. A one-degree Celsius higher permanent temperature is associated with a significant decline in the long-run level of output, with full adjustment unfolding over multiple decades to a century. Decomposing aggregate output into population and output per capita reveals that the long-run output losses operate primarily through demographic adjustment in the full sample, while in advanced economies, both long-run output per capita and population decline as the climate warms. Economies with higher capital intensity and more durable capital stocks experience larger long-run per capita output losses. These findings suggest that long-run economic vulnerability to persistent warming is more broadly distributed across rich and poor countries than the short-run weather literature implies, reflecting differences in capital structure. They complement rather than contradict the well-established finding that developing countries are more exposed to short-run weather shocks.
url:4f5fd2d1c5b23c8a.abstract_zh: 本文表明，将持续性（永久性）气温变化与暂时性天气波动区分开来，可以重塑我们对气候变暖宏观经济成本的理解。通过使用卡尔曼滤波状态空间分解方法，本文将气温分解为永久性成分和暂时性天气波动，并利用面板协整与误差修正框架将永久性成分与趋势产出联系起来。永久性气温每升高1摄氏度，产出的长期水平将显著下降，且完全调整过程需跨越数十年至一个世纪。将总产出分解为人口与人均产出后发现，在全样本中，长期产出损失主要通过人口结构调整实现；而在发达经济体中，随着气候变暖，长期人均产出与人口均出现下降。资本密集度更高、资本存量更耐用的经济体，其长期人均产出损失更大。这些发现表明，相较于短期天气波动文献的结论，持久性气候变暖对长期经济的脆弱性在富国与穷国之间分布更为广泛，这反映了资本结构的差异。该结论并非否定发展中国家更易受短期天气冲击的既有发现，而是对其形成补充。

url:4ff51ea72dff322b.abstract: This study analyzes the fresh produce market in Papua New Guinea (PNG) using unique market flow and price data collected by the Fresh Produce Development Agency (FPDA) over the past 15 years across multiple markets. We document substantial flows of fresh produce from diverse production zones to major urban centers, with Port Moresby emerging as the primary terminal market. Hard fresh produce and sweet potato supplied there largely originate from the Highlands, while other staples and soft fresh produce are mostly sourced from other regions. Price analysis reveals four key patterns: (i) fresh produce prices have risen significantly relative to non-food products, particularly for items less supplied by the Highlands; (ii) prices exhibit strong seasonality—lowest at year-end and highest mid-year (June–August)—reflecting major cultivation periods and possibly seasonality in household labor availability; (iii) marketing margins have increased substantially, especially for soft fresh produce, creating new opportunities for Highland producers to compete in Port Moresby markets; and (iv) in 2023–2025, marketing and wastage costs accounted for the largest share of retail prices in Port Moresby—up to 85 percent for cabbage—while producer shares ranged from 15 percent for cabbage to 61 percent for Irish potatoes. These findings underscore evolving market dynamics and the critical role of supply chain efficiency in PNG’s fresh produce sector.
url:4ff51ea72dff322b.abstract_zh: 本研究利用巴布亚新几内亚（PNG）新鲜农产品发展局（FPDA）过去15年间在多个市场收集的独特市场流量与价格数据，对该国新鲜农产品市场进行了分析。我们记录了从不同生产区域流向主要城市中心的大量新鲜农产品流动，其中莫尔兹比港成为主要的终端市场。该地供应的硬质新鲜农产品和甘薯主要来自高地地区，而其他主食和软质新鲜农产品则大多源自其他区域。价格分析揭示了四个关键特征：（i）新鲜农产品价格相对于非食品类商品显著上涨，尤其是高地地区供应较少的品种；（ii）价格呈现强烈的季节性波动——年末最低，年中（6月至8月）最高——这反映了主要种植周期，并可能与家庭劳动力可用性的季节性变化有关；（iii）营销利润率大幅上升，尤其是软质新鲜农产品，为高地生产者在莫尔兹比港市场竞争创造了新机遇；（iv）在2023至2025年间，营销与损耗成本占莫尔兹比港零售价格的最大份额——卷心菜高达85%——而生产者份额则从卷心菜的15%到爱尔兰土豆的61%不等。这些发现凸显了市场动态的演变以及供应链效率在PNG新鲜农产品行业中的关键作用。

url:50b8124dd6494b5a.abstract: Do central banks decide systematically how much to communicate when explaining their policy decisions? Using all U.S. Federal Open Market Committee policy statements since 1994, we measure communication effort through the change in Shannon entropy and estimate a forward-looking communication rule. We find that communication is systematic: the Federal Reserve communicates more when inflation is expected to exceed target and output is expected to fall below potential. This finding is robust across a variety of sensitivity exercises. We then develop a New Keynesian model with imperfect information showing that systematic communication acts as a second policy instrument, stabilizing expectations and complementing interest-rate policy, especially at the zero lower bound.
url:50b8124dd6494b5a.abstract_zh: 中央银行在解释其政策决策时，是否会系统性地决定沟通程度？我们利用1994年以来美国联邦公开市场委员会的所有政策声明，通过香农熵的变化衡量沟通努力程度，并估算前瞻性沟通规则。研究发现沟通具有系统性：当预期通胀将超过目标值、产出将低于潜在水平时，美联储会加强沟通。这一结论在多种敏感性检验中保持稳健。我们进一步构建包含不完全信息的新凯恩斯模型，证明系统性沟通作为第二政策工具，能够稳定预期并补充利率政策效力，尤其在零利率下限环境下效果显著。

url:51a7ff75295930b9.abstract: Oil is the lifeblood of industry, serving as the core source of power for the operation of industrial machinery. Ensuring its stable supply is crucial for the smooth production process, which in turn is a key determinant in enhancing the quality of export products for enterprises. This study empirically examines the impact of energy supply on the quality of export products and the mechanism of its effect by using a staggered difference‐in‐differences (DID) method with the implementation of China's West‐to‐East Oil Transportation Project as a quasi‐natural experiment. The empirical results show that a dependable energy supply substantially boosts the quality of goods produced for export by various companies. The mechanism analysis shows that energy supply improves export product quality through enterprise performance improvement effects, industry agglomeration effects and supply chain stabilization effects, and it mainly improves export product quality in energy‐importing regions, technology‐intensive industries, private enterprises, and general trade enterprises. Further analysis reveals that a stable supply of energy helps enhance the sustainability of enterprise exports while helping enterprises realize value chain upgrading, helping China get rid of the curse of locking the bottom of the export value chain. The findings of this study help clarify the intrinsic mechanism between energy supply and export product quality and provide an empirical basis for the cross‐regional energy dispatch strategy to help China's export value chain upgrade.
url:51a7ff75295930b9.abstract_zh: 摘要 石油是工业的血液，是工业机械运转的核心动力来源。确保其稳定供应对于生产过程的顺利进行至关重要，而这又是提升企业出口产品质量的关键决定因素。本研究以中国“西油东送”工程实施为准自然实验，采用交错双重差分法实证检验了能源供应对出口产品质量的影响及其作用机制。实证结果表明，可靠的能源供应显著提升了各类企业的出口产品质量。机制分析显示，能源供应通过企业绩效提升效应、产业集聚效应和供应链稳定效应改善了出口产品质量，并且主要提升了能源输入地区、技术密集型行业、民营企业和一般贸易企业的出口产品质量。进一步分析发现，稳定的能源供应有助于增强企业出口的可持续性，同时帮助企业实现价值链升级，助力中国摆脱出口价值链低端锁定的困境。本研究结论有助于厘清能源供应与出口产品质量之间的内在机理，并为跨区域能源调度策略助力中国出口价值链升级提供经验依据。

url:51c4cf01db98e438.abstract: In recent years, the acceleration of de‐globalization has reconfigured global supply chains. Using listed firm‐level global supplier‐customer relationship data from the FactSet Revere database spanning January 2017 to December 2019, this paper examines whether and how firm‐supplier relationships change after the U.S.–China trade tensions. Our findings indicate that the U.S.–China trade tensions are followed by a significant relative decline in U.S. listed firms' reliance on direct Chinese suppliers. This phenomenon is pronounced in the manufacturing and information industries, especially in high‐tech industries. Mechanism analysis suggests that, following the trade frictions, U.S. firms appear to reduce their reliance on direct Chinese suppliers by diversifying and shortening contracts, while also taking adjustment costs into account. The extended analysis explicitly shows that U.S. firms continue to rely on China indirectly—via upstream inputs embedded in domestic suppliers and through third‐country firms closely tied to Chinese production networks. Additionally, U.S. firms tend to increase supplier links with countries that have higher institutional quality, consistent with a search for greater supply chain ‘security’.
url:51c4cf01db98e438.abstract_zh: 近年来，去全球化进程加速，全球供应链格局随之重构。本文利用FactSet Revere数据库2017年1月至2019年12月期间美国上市公司层面的全球供应商-客户关系数据，考察中美贸易摩擦是否以及如何改变企业-供应商关系。研究发现，中美贸易摩擦后，美国上市公司对中国直接供应商的依赖程度出现显著相对下降。这一现象在制造业与信息行业尤为突出，特别是高科技领域。机制分析表明，贸易摩擦发生后，美国企业通过多元化供应商选择与缩短合同期限来降低对中国直接供应商的依赖，同时兼顾调整成本。拓展分析进一步揭示，美国企业仍通过嵌入国内供应商的上游投入品以及与华生产网络紧密关联的第三国企业，间接依赖中国。此外，美国企业倾向于增加与制度质量较高国家的供应商联系，这与寻求更高供应链"安全性"的行为一致。

url:5274f0c447e81a9d.abstract: Using matched employer–employee data on more than 62,000 master’s graduates, this paper examines how gender differences in wage returns to fields of study vary by migration background and how educational specialisation contributes to the gender wage gap. We estimate wage regressions and apply a decomposition approach to separate sorting across fields from differences in pay within fields. Returns vary widely, with law, economics and management, and science yielding the highest returns, and women earning less than men within all fields, especially in high-paying ones. First-generation immigrants from developing countries obtain the lowest returns regardless of field of study, while second-generation immigrants approach but do not fully match natives. Fields of study explain a substantial share of gender wage inequality among natives and second-generation immigrants, whereas among first-generation immigrants broader wage disadvantages dominate. Results further vary with the number of parents originating from developing countries and with age at arrival.
url:5274f0c447e81a9d.abstract_zh: 本文利用超过6.2万名硕士毕业生的匹配雇主-雇员数据，考察了不同学科领域工资回报的性别差异如何随移民背景变化，以及教育专业化如何影响性别工资差距。我们估计了工资回归模型，并采用分解方法将跨领域的选择效应与领域内的工资差异分离开来。研究结果显示，各领域的回报差异显著，其中法律、经济与管理以及科学领域的回报最高，而在所有领域中女性收入均低于男性，尤其是在高薪领域。来自发展中国家的第一代移民无论学习何种领域，其回报均最低，而第二代移民虽接近但未能完全达到本土居民的水平。学科领域解释了本土居民和第二代移民中性别工资不平等的重要部分，但在第一代移民中，更广泛的工资劣势占据主导地位。此外，结果还因父母来自发展中国家的数量以及移民到达年龄的不同而有所差异。

url:52e71b839b416c7e.abstract: Standard macroeconomic data do not cleanly separate the systematic and non-systematic components of monetary policy. We show that incorporating unstructured text data into the structural estimation of a DSGE model can sharpen this distinction. We augment a standard state-space model with a non-core measurement block that links structural shocks to time series derived from FOMC transcripts, using a spike-and-slab prior to let the data select which series are informative. In a medium-scale New Keynesian model for the U.S., incorporating text improves predictive performance and materially alters structural inference: the new model estimates a lower response of the policy rate to inflation, higher price stickiness and lower price indexation, implying a flatter and less backward-looking price Phillips curve.
url:52e71b839b416c7e.abstract_zh: 标准宏观经济数据无法清晰区分货币政策的系统性与非系统性成分。我们证明，将非结构化文本数据纳入DSGE模型的结构估计能够强化这一区分。我们通过一个非核心测量模块对标准状态空间模型进行扩展，该模块将结构性冲击与源自联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）会议记录的时序数据相关联，并采用尖峰-板状先验让数据自行选择具有信息量的序列。在美国中等规模新凯恩斯模型中，引入文本数据不仅提升了预测表现，还显著改变了结构性推断：新模型估计的政策利率对通胀的响应更低，价格粘性更高且价格指数化程度更低，这意味着更平坦且更少后顾性的价格菲利普斯曲线。

url:5384c3f6a9ce816c.abstract: We study the impact of global value chain (GVC) participation on firms' innovation, productivity, and other indicators of technical change. Our dataset encompasses heterogeneous firms from 144 countries at different income levels over the period 2006–2025. Using difference‐in‐differences and matching strategies, we find that GVC participation leads to increased innovation and other technological improvements, with gains driven primarily at the extensive margin and by importing rather than exporting activities. Among innovation types, product innovation responds more strongly than process innovation. Importantly, the nature of innovation differs systematically across development levels: GVC participants in lower‐income countries benefit from access to foreign technology, while those operating in more advanced economies engage more in formal, R&D‐intensive innovation. JEL Classification : C31, F14, F15, O31, O33
url:5384c3f6a9ce816c.abstract_zh: 我们研究了全球价值链（GVC）参与对企业创新、生产率及其他技术变革指标的影响。数据集涵盖2006–2025年间来自144个不同收入水平国家的异质性企业。通过双重差分法和匹配策略，我们发现GVC参与促进了创新及其他技术进步，其收益主要源于集约边际，且进口活动的作用强于出口活动。在创新类型中，产品创新的响应程度强于流程创新。重要的是，创新性质在不同发展水平上呈现系统性差异：低收入国家的GVC参与者受益于外国技术获取，而发达经济体的企业则更多从事正式的、研发密集型创新。 JEL分类：C31, F14, F15, O31, O33

url:538bb47d9592c433.abstract: This paper examines how global greenfield foreign direct investment (FDI) flows are evolving amid rising geoeconomic fragmentation. We use difference-in-differences and event study approaches to analyze changes in FDI around key bilateral inflection points. We find a decline in FDI from the US and broader Group of Seven Plus (G7+) into the PRC, concentrated in trade-exposed, efficiency-seeking sectors. Investment diversion—particularly from the PRC to Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) members and Latin America—is evident, but this growth was concentrated in less global value chain (GVC)-integrated activities, suggesting that GVC links may act as a constraint on investment relocation. These findings suggest that while tensions may be reshaping global investment, GVC dependencies are likely limiting firms’ ability to reallocate production at scale, making the “great reallocation” least evident where it was most expected.
url:538bb47d9592c433.abstract_zh: 本文考察了在地缘经济碎片化加剧的背景下，全球绿地外商直接投资（FDI）流动的演变趋势。我们采用双重差分法和事件研究法，分析关键双边关系转折点前后FDI的变化。研究发现，美国及更广泛的七国集团+（G7+）对中国的FDI出现下降，且主要集中在贸易敏感、效率寻求型行业。投资转移现象明显——尤其是从中国流向东南亚国家联盟（ASEAN）成员国和拉丁美洲——但这种增长集中于全球价值链（GVC）整合程度较低的活动，表明GVC联系可能对投资重新布局构成制约。这些发现表明，尽管地缘紧张局势可能正在重塑全球投资格局，但GVC依赖关系很可能限制了企业大规模重新配置生产能力，使得“大转移”在最被预期发生的领域反而最不明显。

url:54605527f1425eab.abstract_zh: 市场和公共机构必须应对东亚及太平洋地区异常快速的人口转型所驱动的不断变化的照护需求。为此，本文开发了照护模拟模型，这是一种估算儿童照护和老年人照护需求缺口的人口模型。通过整合公开可得的人口数据，该模型捕捉了生命周期和队列中的照护需求及家庭照护者的可得性，从而评估人口结构变化如何改变对家庭照护的依赖。本文量化了未满足的家庭照护需求，并将其转化为潜在市场规模估计，定义为可能需要家庭外照护服务的家庭比例，以及儿童照护和老年人照护中相应的潜在就业创造。到2030年，东盟五国中约25%家庭的儿童照护需求和7%家庭的老年人照护需求可能无法在家庭内部得到满足。在考虑家庭可得性和当前照护就业后，东亚及太平洋地区21个国家的未满足需求转化为儿童照护领域1990万个潜在就业缺口和老年人照护领域3410万个潜在就业缺口。该模型提供了一个透明的跨国框架，为照护政策、劳动力规划和投资策略提供信息。

url:547d3c436a15e4e4.abstract: Forests are central to rural livelihoods in Zambia’s Miombo landscapes, providing energy, food, materials, and income. Yet forest-use restrictions may affect households differently depending on market access, enforcement, and livelihood opportunities. This study examines how restricted and non-restricted forest management regimes shape household livelihood strategies in Copperbelt, Eastern, and North-Western provinces. Using survey data from 1115 households, cluster analysis identified forest livelihood strategies, while multinomial logit models estimated adjusted probabilities of strategy membership and associated household drivers. Four strategies were identified: Low-Monetisation Unprocessed Forest Products Dependents, Unprocessed Forest Products Subsistence Diversifiers, Charcoal-Oriented Mixed households, and Charcoal-Cash Specialists. Regime effects varied strongly by province. In Eastern Province, restricted landscapes increased Low-Monetisation dependence by 43.76 %age points and reduced Charcoal-Cash specialisation by 29.94 points. In North-Western Province, restrictions increased Low-Monetisation dependence by 35.11 points but reduced Charcoal-Oriented Mixed strategies by 31.40 points. In the Copperbelt, the pattern differed: restricted landscapes increased Charcoal-Cash specialisation by 9.80 points and Charcoal-Oriented Mixed strategies by 14.26 points, while reducing subsistence diversification by 26.03 points. Household education, gender, livestock ownership, landholding, residence duration, road access, and regime interactions also shaped strategy membership. The findings show that forest-use restrictions do not produce uniform livelihood outcomes. Instead, they operate as context-dependent filters, reinforcing subsistence dependence in some settings while coexisting with charcoal commercialisation in market-integrated landscapes. Effective governance requires spatially differentiated policy mixes combining conservation, enforcement, energy alternatives, tenure clarity, and livelihood support.
url:547d3c436a15e4e4.abstract_zh: 森林是赞比亚米奥博林地农村生计的核心，提供能源、食物、材料和收入。然而，森林使用限制可能因市场准入、执法力度和生计机会的不同而对家庭产生差异化影响。本研究考察了限制性与非限制性森林管理制度如何塑造铜带省、东部省和西北省的家庭生计策略。基于1115户家庭的调查数据，聚类分析识别出森林生计策略，而多项逻辑模型则估计了策略归属的调整后概率及其相关家庭驱动因素。研究识别出四种策略：低货币化未加工林产品依赖型、未加工林产品生计多样化型、木炭导向混合型以及木炭现金专业化型。制度效应因省份而异。在东部省，限制性景观使低货币化依赖型策略增加43.76个百分点，同时使木炭现金专业化型策略减少29.94个百分点。在西北省，限制性景观使低货币化依赖型策略增加35.11个百分点，但使木炭导向混合型策略减少31.40个百分点。在铜带省，模式有所不同：限制性景观使木炭现金专业化型策略增加9.80个百分点，木炭导向混合型策略增加14.26个百分点，同时使生计多样化型策略减少26.03个百分点。家庭受教育程度、性别、牲畜拥有量、土地持有量、居住时长、道路通达性及制度交互作用也影响策略归属。研究结果表明，森林使用限制并未产生统一的生计结果，而是作为情境依赖的过滤器，在某些环境中强化生计依赖，同时在市场整合的景观中与木炭商业化共存。有效的治理需要结合保护、执法、能源替代、权属明确和生计支持的空间差异化政策组合。

url:5583fbd81d8a1cb8.abstract: The macroeconomic theory that is taught in graduate schools, and used in the conduct of monetary and fiscal policy around the world today, emerged from a revolution in economics that was led by Ned Phelps. This column discusses Phelps’s theoretical contributions and how they created a micro foundation for macroeconomics.
url:5583fbd81d8a1cb8.abstract_zh: 如今研究生院教授并被全球用于货币与财政政策制定的宏观经济理论，源于由内德·菲尔普斯引领的经济学革命。本文探讨了菲尔普斯的理论贡献，以及这些贡献如何为宏观经济学奠定了微观基础。

url:55a5d3028a7d40f5.abstract: This paper examines whether regulatory liquidity buffers enable banks to support corporate borrowers during financial stress. Using confidential bank-firm credit data and handcollected Liquidity Coverage Ratio regulation (LCR) disclosures during COVID-19, we find that banks with higher LCR buffers above the regulatory minimum provided significantly more credit to firms with large undrawn credit lines in March 2020. Critically, only buffers, not overall LCR levels, matter, revealing that the regulatory minimum operates as a binding constraint during stress. The effect is concentrated among high-quality borrowers with clean credit profiles and disappears by mid-2020, confirming that LCR buffers provide selective, temporary liquidity insurance during acute stress.
url:55a5d3028a7d40f5.abstract_zh: 本文考察了监管流动性缓冲是否能使银行在金融压力时期为企业借款人提供支持。利用新冠疫情期间的机密银行-企业信贷数据及手工收集的流动性覆盖率（LCR）监管披露信息，我们发现，在2020年3月，LCR缓冲高于监管最低要求的银行，向拥有大量未提取信贷额度的企业提供了显著更多的信贷。关键在于，只有缓冲水平而非整体LCR水平产生影响，这表明监管最低要求在压力时期构成了具有约束力的限制。这一效应集中于信用记录良好的高质量借款人，并在2020年年中消失，证实了LCR缓冲在严重压力时期提供了选择性、临时性的流动性保险。

url:55c9307c9f7c952c.abstract: Conventional demographic models systematically overestimate fertility decline in sub-Saharan Africa. This paper proposes a complementary explanation grounded in a prevalent but understudied belief system: ancestors influence the living and seek the continuation of their lineage, into which they may be reincarnated. In this worldview, having children becomes a moral and collective duty, rooted in the spiritual responsibility to ensure the survival of the lineage. Drawing on first-hand data, novel ethnographic information, and historical and contemporary surveys, I document a strong and quantitatively large positive relationship between ancestral beliefs and fertility across contexts and time periods. A simple model in which children are a public good for the lineage rationalizes the patterns observed in the data: the fertility effect of ancestral beliefs is concentrated in patrilineal societies, and a specific form of free-riding emerges among siblings whose children continue the same family line. These findings suggest that high fertility in sub-Saharan Africa rests on moral foundations that standard, externally designed interventions tend to overlook.
url:55c9307c9f7c952c.abstract_zh: 传统人口模型系统性地高估了撒哈拉以南非洲地区的生育率下降趋势。本文提出一种基于普遍存在但研究不足的信仰体系的补充性解释：祖先会影响生者，并寻求其血脉的延续，而祖先可能通过转世回归这一血脉。在这种世界观中，生育子女成为一项道德与集体义务，根植于确保血脉存续的精神责任。通过利用一手数据、新颖的民族志信息以及历史与当代调查，我记录了祖先信仰与生育率之间在不同情境与时间跨度中呈现的强烈且数量显著的正向关联。一个将子女视为血脉公共品的简单模型，合理化了数据中观察到的模式：祖先信仰对生育率的影响集中于父系社会，且兄弟姐妹之间出现一种特定形式的搭便车行为——其子女延续同一家族血脉。这些发现表明，撒哈拉以南非洲的高生育率建立在道德基础之上，而标准的外部干预设计往往忽视了这一点。

url:560bf8c5f1b72ed6.abstract: Digital platforms allocate buyer attention across sellers that differ in quality and breadth of appeal. We study a monopoly platform that sets meeting rates between buyers and two seller types --- niche sellers whose high-quality good is valued by a fraction of buyers and mass-market sellers whose good is valued by all. Sellers compete by posting prices à la Burdett and Judd (1983), so buyer surplus requires competition, while platform revenue requires seller rents. This difference creates a systematic distortion: as search capacity grows, the platform keeps high-quality niche attention just past the point where extra exposure stops creating rents and starts eroding them — its saturation point — and diverts the rest to mass-market sellers. The resulting buyer-surplus loss converges to a finite limit proportional to the quality gap between the two goods, split equally between an allocative loss from too little high-quality exposure and excess rent extracted by sellers. Applying the model to Amazon product search and Google passage-ranking data indicates that, for captive buyers, both platforms operate past the saturation point, with buyer-surplus losses of 63 and 44 percent of the planner's benchmark, respectively. Allowing buyer participation to respond to the platform's recommendation strategy disciplines the platform and shrinks this loss.
url:560bf8c5f1b72ed6.abstract_zh: 数字平台在质量与吸引力广度各异的卖家之间分配买家注意力。我们研究了一个垄断平台，该平台设定买家与两类卖家之间的匹配率——利基卖家（其高质量商品仅被部分买家青睐）与大众市场卖家（其商品被所有买家青睐）。卖家按照Burdett和Judd（1983）的模型进行价格竞争，因此买家剩余依赖于竞争，而平台收入则依赖于卖家租金。这一差异造成了系统性扭曲：随着搜索能力的增长，平台将高质量利基卖家的注意力维持在刚好超过额外曝光不再创造租金、反而开始侵蚀租金的临界点——即其饱和点——并将剩余注意力转移给大众市场卖家。由此导致的买家剩余损失收敛于一个有限极限，该极限与两种商品的质量差距成正比，并均分为两部分：高质量曝光不足造成的配置损失，以及卖家攫取的超额租金。将该模型应用于亚马逊产品搜索与谷歌段落排名数据后发现，对于被锁定的买家而言，两个平台的运营均已超过饱和点，买家剩余损失分别达到规划者基准水平的63%和44%。允许买家参与度对平台推荐策略做出反应，能够约束平台行为并缩小这一损失。

url:5617c7fb0be9e0ac.abstract: We study how fatal and nonfatal health shocks affect households’ ability to meet their financial obligations. We find that fatal shocks substantially increase the likelihood of default and that housing wealth plays a key role as a self-insurance mechanism. Surviving spouses who experience the largest income losses are more likely to sell their homes, and those without housing wealth face a sharply higher risk of debt collection. In the most financially vulnerable families, these shocks even generate intergenerational spillovers. In contrast, nonfatal health shocks lead to only modest increases in default risk. Taken together, our findings suggest that strengthening survivors’ benefits for households with limited resources could improve welfare across generations.
url:5617c7fb0be9e0ac.abstract_zh: 我们研究了致命与非致命健康冲击对家庭履行财务义务能力的影响。研究发现，致命冲击显著增加了违约概率，而住房财富作为自我保险机制发挥着关键作用。经历最大收入损失的丧偶者更可能出售房产，缺乏住房财富的家庭面临债务催收的风险急剧上升。在最脆弱的家庭中，这些冲击甚至会产生代际溢出效应。相比之下，非致命健康冲击仅导致违约风险小幅上升。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，为资源有限的家庭加强遗属福利可改善跨代福利水平。

url:563c8ee2762ce798.abstract: Data centers now account for 4.4% of United States electricity demand, yet the grid-level effectiveness of the renewable energy certificates (RECs) and power purchase agreements (PPAs) hyperscalers use to claim carbon neutrality remains unclear. We develop a game-theoretic model in which a data center operator chooses among RECs, PPAs, and behind-the-meter colocation while generators make entry decisions under endogenous financing costs. The model identifies a timing wedge -- the mismatch between consumption and credited renewable generation -- as a central mechanism through which AI demand degrades reliability, raises prices, and increases emissions even when RECs cover 100% of annual consumption. Colocation with storage addresses this wedge directly and induces the greatest renewable entry by eliminating generator revenue risk. We test these predictions by exploiting the staggered release of large language models as a natural experiment, using difference-in-differences on a novel dataset linking AI activity to local grid outcomes. AI demand significantly increases fossil generation, wholesale prices (up to 25% in treated PJM zones), and outage frequency (0.5--1 additional outages per year) near data centers, with impacts scaling in model size. Data centers with on-site generation exhibit a sign reversal in power-quality effects, consistent with the model
url:563c8ee2762ce798.abstract_zh: 数据中心目前占美国电力需求的4.4%，然而，超大规模企业用于宣称碳中和的可再生能源证书（RECs）和购电协议（PPAs）在电网层面的有效性仍不明确。我们构建了一个博弈论模型，其中数据中心运营商在RECs、PPAs和表后托管之间进行选择，而发电商则在内生融资成本下做出进入决策。该模型识别出一个时间错配——即电力消费与可归因的可再生能源发电之间的时间差——作为核心机制，通过这一机制，即使RECs覆盖100%的年消费量，AI需求仍会降低可靠性、推高电价并增加排放。配备储能的表后托管直接解决了这一时间错配，并通过消除发电商的收入风险，最大程度地促进了可再生能源的进入。我们利用大语言模型的分阶段发布作为自然实验，通过双重差分法对连接AI活动与地方电网结果的新数据集进行检验，以验证这些预测。AI需求显著增加了数据中心附近化石燃料发电量、批发电价（在受影响的PJM区域最高上涨25%）以及停电频率（每年额外增加0.5至1次停电），且影响规模随模型大小递增。配备现场发电的数据中心在电能质量效应上表现出符号反转，这与模型预测一致。

url:5644c08f5396f681.abstract: How does informality shape the impact of minimum wage policy? We study this question using evidence from Mexico’s 145% real increase in the minimum wage since 2016, together with a general equilibrium model featuring endogenous informality and household heterogeneity. Reduced-form estimates of the implemented increases indicate limited effects on employment and formalization, alongside modest wage gains at the bottom of the formal wage distribution that arguably reflect incomplete enforcement. The calibrated model reproduces these patterns but predicts that, under full enforcement, higher wage floors generate nonlinear effects: the share of firms reallocating toward informality rises sharply, lowering productivity and aggregate welfare. These losses fall disproportionately on low-skill households, who bear the brunt of the reduction in transfers caused by lower tax revenue yet, as predominantly informal workers, gain little directly from the minimum wage. The minimum wage’s effectiveness as a redistributive tool is therefore limited.
url:5644c08f5396f681.abstract_zh: 非正规性如何影响最低工资政策的效果？我们利用墨西哥自2016年以来最低工资实际增长145%的证据，结合包含内生非正规性与家庭异质性的一般均衡模型来研究这一问题。对已实施最低工资上调的简化形式估计表明，其对就业和正规化的影响有限，同时正规工资分布底端出现温和的工资增长——这在一定程度上反映了执法不完善。校准后的模型复现了这些特征，但预测在完全执法条件下，更高的工资下限会产生非线性效应：转向非正规部门的企业比例急剧上升，从而降低生产率和总体福利。这些损失不成比例地由低技能家庭承担——他们因税收减少导致的转移支付下降而首当其冲，但作为以非正规就业为主的劳动者，却几乎无法直接从最低工资中获益。因此，最低工资作为再分配工具的有效性十分有限。

url:56afb7d190656837.abstract: This paper examines the effects of economic sanctions on the taxation of natural resources in targeted countries, distinguishing between de jure and de facto measures of the average effective tax rate (AETR) on resource rents. The analysis relies on a sample of 20 African countries for the de jure AETR and a global panel of 75 developing and developed countries for the de facto AETR over the period 2000–2020. Using a Spatial Durbin Model that accounts for spatial spillovers in both taxation and sanctions, we document three main results. First, both resource taxation (de jure and de facto) and economic sanctions exhibit significant spatial dependence across neighbouring countries. Second, economic sanctions affect de jure rent capture, while their impact on de facto AETR is limited and operates mainly through indirect and spillover channels rather than through a direct strengthening of effective tax enforcement. Third, the effects vary by the type and origin of sanctions, with financial sanctions exerting stronger effects than trade sanctions, and UN and US sanctions proving more influential than EU sanctions. The results are robust to alternative measures of sanction intensity, proxied by the number of sanctions imposed, as well as to alternative estimation strategies addressing endogeneity, and dynamic treatment effects. These findings suggest that sanctioned countries adjust formal tax policy in response to sanctions, which contribute to limit the adverse effect of sanctions on their de facto taxation of the resource rent.
url:56afb7d190656837.abstract_zh: 本文考察了经济制裁对目标国自然资源税收的影响，区分了资源租金平均有效税率（AETR）的法律规定与实际执行指标。分析基于2000-2020年期间两个样本：20个非洲国家的法律规定AETR，以及75个发达国家与发展中国家组成的全球面板数据的实际执行AETR。采用考虑税收与制裁空间溢出效应的空间杜宾模型，我们得出三项主要结论。第一，资源税收（包括法律规定与实际执行）和经济制裁在邻国间均呈现显著的空间依赖性。第二，经济制裁影响法律规定的租金获取，但对实际执行AETR的影响有限，且主要通过间接和溢出渠道发挥作用，而非直接强化有效税收执法。第三，制裁效果因类型和来源而异：金融制裁的影响强于贸易制裁，联合国和美国制裁的影响力超过欧盟制裁。上述结果在采用制裁数量作为制裁强度替代指标、处理内生性的替代估计策略以及动态处理效应检验中均保持稳健。这些发现表明，受制裁国会根据制裁调整正式税收政策，这有助于限制制裁对其资源租金实际征税的不利影响。

url:56e04a110d3742cd.abstract: This paper examines the credit supply effects of sale-of-business (SoB) bank resolutions under the post-Global Financial Crisis regulatory framework, focusing on the resolution of a major Spanish bank. We provide the first micro-level evidence of how an SoB resolution reshapes credit allocation. The acquiring bank preserved lending relationships, prioritizing support for riskier inherited borrowers most exposed to competing banks' retrenchment. This stabilization was achieved despite tighter capital conditions, as the acquiring bank strategically reallocated credit within its broader portfolio, shifting away from more capital-intensive exposures.
url:56e04a110d3742cd.abstract_zh: 本文研究了后全球金融危机监管框架下业务出售型银行处置的信贷供给效应，重点关注一家西班牙大型银行的处置案例。我们首次提供了微观层面证据，揭示业务出售型处置如何重塑信贷配置。收购方银行保留了借贷关系，优先支持那些面临其他银行收缩信贷时风险敞口最大的继承借款人。尽管资本条件趋紧，收购方银行仍通过在其更广泛的资产组合中战略性重新配置信贷（减少资本密集型敞口）实现了这一稳定效应。

url:56e9c064685ecffc.abstract: 提升创业投资集聚程度是优化科技型中小企业融资环境,推进金融服务科技创新能力建设的关键举措。本文构建一个嵌入创业投资的内生增长模型,利用基金小镇设立的外生冲击分析创业投资集聚对企业创新的影响。研究发现,创业投资集聚能够改善研发资金配置效率,显著提升企业创新产出。机制分析表明,信息搜寻成本和委托代理成本下降是其激励企业创新的主要渠道,具体表现为在基金小镇设立后,被投资企业获取了充足的外部融资,创业投资机构参与企业内部治理的概率提升。进一步研究发现,地区营商环境是决定创业投资集聚外部性强弱的关键因素。本文研究结论为壮大耐心资本和因地制宜培育新质生产力提供了坚实的理论支撑和经验证据。

url:57c744677004c2d9.abstract: We study the evolution of digital and artificial intelligence (AI) skill demand across six economies in Asia and the Pacific between 2019 and 2024 using millions of online job postings from Indeed and a large language model to classify them by their required level of digital and AI proficiency. Digital skill requirements are widespread across the occupational distribution and have expanded most rapidly in traditionally low and mid digital jobs, pointing to broad technological diffusion. Jobs requiring higher digital proficiency command substantially higher pay, even when comparing job postings within the same job title and controlling for cognitive, interpersonal, organizational, and technical skill requirements. We estimate wage premia of approximately 4%, 11%, and 26% for basic, intermediate, and advanced digital skills, respectively, with intermediate and advanced digital skills commanding larger premia than many other highly rewarded skills. We also document a sharp increase in demand for AI-related competencies, particularly those related to the use of AI tools.
url:57c744677004c2d9.abstract_zh: 我们利用Indeed平台数百万条在线招聘信息及大型语言模型，对2019至2024年间亚太地区六个经济体的数字与人工智能（AI）技能需求演变展开研究。数字技能要求广泛分布于各职业层级，且在传统低数字与中数字岗位中增长最为迅速，表明技术扩散具有广泛性。即使在同一职位名称内比较招聘信息，并控制认知、人际、组织及技术技能要求后，需要更高数字能力的岗位仍享有显著更高的薪酬。我们估算基础、中级与高级数字技能的工资溢价分别约为4%、11%和26%，其中中级与高级数字技能的溢价幅度超过许多其他高回报技能。研究还发现，对AI相关能力（尤其是AI工具应用能力）的需求急剧增长。

url:5956ee12f4322842.abstract: How do international investors adjust portfolios in response to biodiversity risk? Using monthly data on investment fund portfolios, we show that the 2021 Kunming Declaration led fund managers to reallocate portfolios from high-biodiversity risk countries to less risky ones, while ultimate fund investors remained unresponsive. Fund managers reduced exposures to extremely high biodiversity risk without seizing low biodiversity risk as an opportunity for profit, characterizing biodiversity as downside risk factor. url:5a36856a1d075019.abstract: Increased vertical integration and coordination are defining features of transforming and modernizing agricultural value chains in low- and middle-income countries, with important implications for market efficiency and farm-level transformation. However, research documenting these processes in modernizing domestic value chains is limited, and tends to focus on foreign direct investment and high-value food products. We study the rice value chain – the most important staple in Southeast Asia – in Myanmar and use unique data from domestic rice mills and farmers to analyze millers’ expansion into other businesses and services. We show that both modern and traditional mills serve as key nodes in local rice value chains, fulfilling diverse roles beyond processing at both the farm and post-farm levels and highlighting a co-development of modern processing and vertical integration. Yet, statistical tests that control for mill and farmer characteristics, respectively, show that modern mills are more engaged in vertical integration and coordination, particularly in post-farm value chain segments, highlighting the co-development of modern processing and business expansion. Consistent with this pattern in the miller data, farmers using a modern mill are more likely to receive complementary services – especially post-farm – and to adopt modern production practices more broadly. However, this expansion is uneven, reaching large farms more frequently than small and medium farms.
url:5a36856a1d075019.abstract_zh: 在中低收入国家，农业价值链的转型与现代化进程中，纵向整合与协调的增强是显著特征，这对市场效率和农场层面转型具有重要影响。然而，关于国内价值链现代化进程中这些过程的文献研究有限，且往往聚焦于外国直接投资和高价值食品。我们以缅甸稻米价值链——东南亚最重要的主食——为研究对象，利用国内稻米加工厂和农户的独特数据，分析加工厂向其他业务和服务的扩张。研究表明，现代和传统加工厂均作为当地稻米价值链的关键节点，在农场和农场后层面发挥超越加工环节的多元作用，凸显了现代加工与纵向整合的协同发展。然而，分别控制加工厂和农户特征的统计检验显示，现代加工厂在纵向整合与协调方面参与度更高，尤其在农场后价值链环节，这进一步印证了现代加工与业务扩张的协同发展。与加工厂数据中的这一模式一致，使用现代加工厂的农户更有可能获得补充性服务（尤其是农场后服务），并更广泛地采用现代生产实践。然而，这种扩张并不均衡，大型农场比中小型农场更频繁地受益。

url:5c268c9b96d623d2.abstract: Evaluating optimized AI systems for asset pricing is fundamentally difficult for two reasons. First, models are trained on all data, implying that any backtest or analysis using historical data suffers from look-ahead bias. In addition, markets are reflexive — as investors adopt AI, prices adjust — which may erode the very patterns the AI system was trained to exploit. We introduce a real-time, out-of-sample benchmark designed to sidestep both problems. The benchmark measures how well AI systems can explain contemporaneous stock returns around earnings announcements using only information available at announcement time, including the text of the announcement itself. Applying this benchmark to a range of agentic AI systems — which extract structured signals from earnings call transcripts and optimize over those signals — we find that the best-optimized systems more than double the explained variation in returns relative to standard benchmarks (R2 increasing from 8% to close to 20%). We show that AI-based optimization can deliver efficiency gains relative to traditional machine learning methods while also improving interpretability as our approach produces human-readable economic mechanisms that explain price movements. These learned rules can be compared to the drivers of realized returns in existing asset pricing models to identify missing sources of variation in a data-driven, self-evolving way that integrates empirical learning with economic structure. We release an SDK for researchers to improve on our results. Saturating this benchmark would represent fundamental progress in understanding how capital markets process firm-level information.
url:5c268c9b96d623d2.abstract_zh: 评估针对资产定价优化的AI系统存在两个根本性困难。首先，模型基于全部数据训练，这意味着任何使用历史数据的回测或分析都存在前瞻性偏差。其次，市场具有反身性——随着投资者采用AI技术，价格会相应调整——这可能导致AI系统原本训练利用的模式逐渐消失。我们引入了一个实时、样本外的基准测试，旨在规避这两个问题。该基准测试衡量AI系统仅利用公告发布时可获取的信息（包括公告文本本身）来解释盈余公告期间同期股票收益的能力。将该基准应用于一系列智能体AI系统（这些系统从财报电话会议记录中提取结构化信号并对其进行优化），我们发现最优化的系统相较于标准基准，其解释的收益变异程度提升了一倍以上（R²从8%提升至接近20%）。研究表明，基于AI的优化相较于传统机器学习方法能带来效率提升，同时增强可解释性——我们的方法可生成解释价格变动的人类可读经济机制。这些学习到的规则可与现有资产定价模型中实际收益的驱动因素进行对比，以数据驱动、自我演进的方式识别缺失的变异来源，实现经验学习与经济结构的融合。我们发布了SDK供研究者改进我们的结果。饱和该基准测试将标志着理解资本市场如何处理公司层面信息的根本性进展。

url:5c3950b814268286.abstract: This paper shows that expected capital gains in several MSAs were higher for relatively lower-priced, rather than higher-priced, houses during the U.S. boom of the 2000s. Because buyers of lower-priced houses tend to be more sensitive to credit conditions than buyers of higher-priced houses, this paper documents patterns that are consistent with an interaction of beliefs and credit conditions in a time period where direct evidence on house price beliefs is scarce. Documenting this interaction is important for unifying beliefs and credit conditions as joint, instead of competing, explanations for the U.S. housing boom of the 2000s.
url:5c3950b814268286.abstract_zh: 本文表明，在2000年代美国房地产繁荣期间，多个大都市统计区（MSAs）中，相对低价房屋的预期资本收益高于高价房屋。由于低价房屋的购房者往往比高价房屋的购房者对信贷条件更为敏感，本文记录的模式与信念和信贷条件在房价信念直接证据稀缺时期的相互作用一致。记录这种相互作用对于将信念和信贷条件作为共同而非竞争性解释因素来统一说明2000年代美国房地产繁荣具有重要意义。

url:5ca575ed0cc6d4ef.abstract: This paper examines the local effects of the 2018–19 U.S.-China trade disruptions on Mexico. Combining detailed municipal-level customs data with U.S. tariff schedules, it estimates that municipalities with greater export concentration in products targeted by U.S. tariffs on China (hereafter, tariff exposure) experienced significantly larger nearshoring dividends. An increase of 1 percent in tariff exposure led to a 4.3 percent increase in municipality-level exports to the United States, with gains concentrated in northern and south-central states. These export gains translated into broad labor market improvements: total labor income rose by 5.6 percent for each 1 percent increase in tariff exposure, driven by job creation rather than wage growth as average earnings remained unchanged. The effects were heterogeneous across skill levels, with the largest employment rate gains among semi-skilled workers. Beyond job quantity, the shock improved job quality: each 1 percent increase in tariff exposure reduced labor informality by 0.25 percentage points, with newly created jobs disproportionately being formal. Effects were driven primarily by manufacturing but extended to services through local spillovers. The findings indicate that trade policy changes between major economies can significantly reshape the spatial distribution of economic activity and the quantity and quality of jobs in third-party countries.
url:5ca575ed0cc6d4ef.abstract_zh: 本文研究了2018-2019年中美贸易摩擦对墨西哥的本地影响。通过将市级海关数据与美国关税清单相结合，本文估算发现，在美国对华加征关税所针对的产品中（以下简称关税暴露度），出口集中度越高的城市，其获得的近岸外包红利显著更大。关税暴露度每增加1%，城市对美出口额增长4.3%，且增长集中在北部和中南部各州。这些出口增长转化为广泛的劳动力市场改善：关税暴露度每增加1%，劳动总收入增长5.6%，这一增长由就业创造驱动而非工资上涨，因为平均收入保持不变。不同技能水平的影响存在异质性，半熟练工人的就业率增幅最大。除就业数量外，冲击还提升了就业质量：关税暴露度每增加1%，非正规就业比例下降0.25个百分点，且新增就业岗位中正规就业占比显著更高。影响主要来自制造业，但通过本地溢出效应延伸至服务业。研究结果表明，主要经济体之间的贸易政策变化能够显著重塑第三方国家的经济活动空间分布以及就业数量与质量。

url:5cc28f4442e6fa98.abstract: Investors reward reform progress. Econometric results suggest that holistic reforms, fiscal spending discipline, and monetary policy credibility are associated with a tightening of Qatar’s external sovereign credit spreads. In particular, investors may view fiscal spending discipline as an integral part of Qatar’s holistic reform and economic diversification. Greater broad-based reform progress also boosts the resilience of sovereign credit spreads to external shocks. The findings support fiscal and monetary policy reforms as part of the broader reform agenda in a holistic manner, as planned under the Third National Development Strategy.

url:5d596bcb0673cda5.abstract: Standard welfare evaluations of means-tested transfers typically treat eligibility enforcement as affecting only households directly exposed to the rule. We show that this direct-only approach is incomplete when enforcement events transmit information through workplace networks, inducing other beneficiaries to adjust formal employment and reported earnings. We study Uruguay's AFAM-PE conditional cash transfer, in which household income eligibility is verified monthly using administrative records of formal earnings and households exceeding the threshold may lose benefits, while most beneficiaries are largely unaware of the income rule. Linking program records, social security employment histories, and firm identifiers, we build workplace networks defined six months before each peer's exposure to enforcement and identify spillovers using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design that exploits quasi-random variation in whether a peer crosses the income threshold. Coworkers of peers just above the cutoff reduce registered labor earnings by 20%, and the corresponding fuzzy-RD estimate implies a decline of about one-third of baseline earnings in response to a peer's suspension. These effects emerge within two months and persist for at least 12 months. The response operates almost entirely on the extensive margin of formal employment, and most of the decline reflects transitions to informal work rather than exit from the labor force. Spillovers are concentrated in small firms and among similar coworkers, are nearly three times larger when the suspended peer actively contacted the program's support service, and are absent among non-beneficiary coworkers. This pattern is consistent with information transmission as the main channel. Incorporating these indirect responses lowers the estimated MVPF of the program as implemented with enforcement from 0.53 to 0.36. Because the same information channel operates wherever means-tested programs are enforced through records of formal earnings, evaluations that count only directly exposed households systematically understate the cost of enforcement.
url:5d596bcb0673cda5.abstract_zh: 对家计调查型转移支付的福利评估通常将资格核查视为仅影响直接受规则约束的家庭。我们证明，当核查事件通过工作场所网络传递信息，促使其他受益人调整正规就业和申报收入时，这种仅关注直接影响的评估方法是不完整的。本研究以乌拉圭AFAM-PE有条件现金转移项目为对象，该项目每月通过行政记录核实家庭收入资格，超出阈值的家庭可能失去福利，但多数受益人对收入规则知之甚少。通过关联项目记录、社保就业历史及企业标识，我们构建了每位同伴接受核查前六个月的工作场所网络，并利用同伴是否跨越收入阈值的准随机变化，采用模糊断点回归设计识别溢出效应。结果显示，略高于收入阈值的同伴的同事，其登记劳动收入下降20%；对应的模糊断点回归估计表明，同伴被暂停资格后，其同事基线收入下降约三分之一。这些影响在两个月内显现并持续至少12个月。反应几乎完全体现在正规就业的集约边际上，收入下降主要源于向非正规工作的转移而非退出劳动力市场。溢出效应集中于小型企业和相似同事群体中；当被暂停资格的同伴主动联系项目支持服务时，溢出效应扩大近三倍，而非受益同事中则无此现象。这一模式与信息传递作为主要渠道的假设一致。将间接反应纳入评估后，该项目在核查机制下的估计边际价值公共资金（MVPF）从0.53降至0.36。由于凡是通过正规收入记录执行家计调查的项目均存在相同的信息传递渠道，仅统计直接受影响家庭的评估方法会系统性低估核查成本。

url:5d895ebee552ed50.abstract: We use Gallup World Poll data from over 150 countries from 2009-2019 at both the individual and country levels to revisit the relationship between income and subjective wellbeing. Our inspiration is the paradox first proposed by Easterlin (1974), where higher incomes are associated with greater happiness in cross-sections, yet rising country GDP per head does not necessarily increase its average wellbeing. In our analysis subjective wellbeing (or happiness) is measured by the Cantril ladder on a 0-10 scale. Across individuals, other things equal, one unit of log income raises subjective wellbeing by 0.4 points. In other words, doubling income raises wellbeing by 0.3 points out of 10. Across countries, a crude regression of wellbeing on log per capita income gives a higher coefficient of 0.6. But, once social variables like health and social support are introduced, the picture changes. In rich countries, income no longer has a significant independent effect, either in country cross-sections or in time series. For low-income countries the result is also clear cut - income raises happiness in both cross-section and time series, whether the social variables are controlled for or not. For middle-income countries the result is mixed.
url:5d895ebee552ed50.abstract_zh: 我们利用2009-2019年间覆盖150多个国家的盖洛普世界民意调查数据，从个体和国家两个层面重新审视收入与主观幸福感之间的关系。本研究的灵感源于伊斯特林（1974）首次提出的悖论：在横截面数据中，较高收入与更高幸福感相关，但国家人均GDP增长未必能提升其平均福祉水平。分析中，主观幸福感（或幸福感）采用坎特里尔阶梯法以0-10分制衡量。在个体层面，其他条件不变时，对数收入每增加一个单位，主观幸福感提升0.4分。换言之，收入翻倍可使幸福感在10分制中提升0.3分。在国家层面，对幸福感与人均对数收入进行简单回归，得到0.6的更高系数。然而，一旦引入健康与社会支持等社会变量，结果便发生改变。在富裕国家，无论是国家横截面数据还是时间序列数据，收入均不再具有显著的独立效应。对于低收入国家，结果同样明确——无论是否控制社会变量，收入在横截面和时间序列中均能提升幸福感。而对于中等收入国家，结果则呈现混合特征。

url:5e50b47c6eebf8d0.abstract: This paper empirically reassesses monetary policy transmission in emerging and frontier market economies in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA EFMs). Using the identification approach of Romer and Romer (2004), we construct measures of monetary policy shocks and provide evidence on transmission mechanisms in the region. We show that monetary policy shocks pass through quickly to short-term market interest rates and lead to persistent increases in bank deposit and lending rates in most economies, indicating an operative bank-based interest rate channel. By contrast, exchange rates generally do not appreciate and, in many cases, depreciate following monetary tightening, consistent with the exchange rate puzzle—suggesting that interest rate hikes alone may be insufficient to systematically influence exchange rate movements. We also find that contractionary monetary policy reduces both output and inflation, with effects that are modest and notably weaker than in more developed economies. In addition, we find that transmission is stronger in economies that have adopted, or are transitioning toward, inflation-targeting regimes. Finally, we show that cross-country heterogeneity in transmission largely reflects differences in monetary policy transparency, financial development, and, to a lesser extent, fiscal dominance.
url:5e50b47c6eebf8d0.abstract_zh: 本文对撒哈拉以南非洲新兴及前沿市场经济体（SSA EFMs）的货币政策传导机制进行了实证再评估。采用Romer与Romer（2004）的识别方法，我们构建了货币政策冲击的度量指标，并提供了该区域传导机制的证据。研究表明，货币政策冲击能迅速传导至短期市场利率，并在多数经济体中导致银行存款利率与贷款利率持续上升，表明银行主导的利率渠道具有有效性。相比之下，汇率在货币紧缩后通常不会升值，反而在多数情况下出现贬值，这与"汇率之谜"现象一致——暗示单纯加息可能不足以系统性影响汇率变动。我们还发现，紧缩性货币政策会同时降低产出与通胀，但其影响幅度温和且显著弱于发达经济体。此外，在已采用或正转向通胀目标制的经济体中，货币政策传导效应更强。最后，研究表明跨国传导异质性主要源于货币政策透明度、金融发展水平的差异，而财政主导地位的影响相对较小。

url:5e79499a6f925eb0.abstract: We use a randomized controlled trial to examine how out-of-pocket costs affect contraceptive method choice, pregnancy, abortion, and childbirth among uninsured U.S. women. The study recruited women seeking care through Title X—a national family planning program subsidizing reproductive health services for low-income Americans—and randomized vouchers, making the full spectrum of contraception highly discounted or free. We find that subsidizing contraception has large and persistent effects on the choice of con- traceptive method, resulting in significantly fewer pregnancies and abortions at 26 months. The effects on births are inconclusive.
url:5e79499a6f925eb0.abstract_zh: 我们通过一项随机对照试验，考察自付费用如何影响美国无保险女性的避孕方法选择、怀孕、堕胎及分娩。研究招募了通过Title X（一项为低收入美国人提供生殖健康服务补贴的国家计划生育项目）寻求医疗服务的女性，并随机发放代金券，使各类避孕措施大幅降价或免费。我们发现，补贴避孕措施对避孕方法的选择产生了显著且持续的影响，在26个月时导致怀孕和堕胎数量显著减少。对分娩的影响尚无定论。

url:5ecbe62a61f91c6c.abstract: When Credit Suisse failed in March 2023, Swiss authorities, against market expectations, set aside the resolution plan and arranged a UBS takeover backed by public guarantees, sparing the bail-in bondholders who were next in line to absorb losses. This column traces how that choice reshaped investor beliefs about bail-in across Europe. Spreads on bail-in debt narrowed, the funding penalty on weaker banks shrank, and yields moved less on earnings news. Each points the same way: investors now see bail-in as less likely, a sign that its credibility has declined.
url:5ecbe62a61f91c6c.abstract_zh: 2023年3月瑞信倒闭时，瑞士当局违背市场预期，搁置处置计划并安排瑞银在公共担保支持下进行收购，使本应承担损失的保释债持有人得以幸免。本专栏追踪了这一选择如何重塑欧洲投资者对保释机制的信念。保释债利差收窄，弱势银行的融资惩罚缩小，收益率对盈利消息的反应减弱。这些现象均指向同一结论：投资者如今认为保释可能性降低，表明其可信度已然下降。

url:5ed862e0d3bed36d.abstract: Labor markets feature large heterogeneity in employment stability: some careers provide lifetime employment, while others involve frequent transitions in and out of work. While this heterogeneity shapes earnings dynamics and labor market risk, its implications for household saving behavior remain poorly understood. We document two new empirical facts. More stable careers (i) exhibit steeper life-cycle earnings growth and (ii) accumulate significantly more wealth per dollar of income, even within narrowly defined worker groups. To interpret these facts, we develop a life-cycle search-and-saving model with heterogeneous employment stability, job-to-job mobility, endogenous human capital accumulation, and incomplete markets. The model matches both life-cycle earnings and wealth dynamics across careers. Our central finding is that heterogeneity in employment stability reshapes the nature of saving. Stable careers generate sustained earnings growth with a focus on life-cycle saving, while unstable careers are characterized by precautionary, buffer-stock behavior that limits long-run wealth accumulation. Quantitatively, differential earnings growth accounts for about 60% of the wealth gap across careers. These microeconomic differences have important macroeconomic implications. We demonstrate that heterogeneity in employment stability amplifies wealth inequality and substantially increases the macroeconomic consumption response to unemployment shocks.
url:5ed862e0d3bed36d.abstract_zh: 劳动力市场在就业稳定性方面存在显著异质性：部分职业提供终身雇佣保障，而另一些职业则频繁经历就业与失业的转换。尽管这种异质性塑造了收入动态与劳动力市场风险，但其对家庭储蓄行为的影响仍鲜有研究。我们揭示了两项新的实证事实：稳定性较高的职业（i）具有更陡峭的生命周期收入增长曲线，且（ii）即使在严格定义的工人群体内部，每单位收入积累的财富也显著更多。为解释这些事实，我们构建了一个包含异质性就业稳定性、岗位间流动、内生人力资本积累及不完全市场的生命周期搜寻-储蓄模型。该模型能够匹配不同职业的生命周期收入与财富动态。核心发现是：就业稳定性异质性重塑了储蓄的本质。稳定职业产生持续的收入增长，聚焦于生命周期储蓄；而不稳定职业则呈现预防性缓冲库存行为，限制了长期财富积累。量化分析表明，收入增长差异解释了约60%的职业间财富差距。这些微观差异具有重要的宏观经济含义：我们证明就业稳定性异质性会加剧财富不平等，并显著放大宏观经济对失业冲击的消费响应。

url:614c30e08d7f2f25.abstract: This paper examines how tokenization and distributed ledger technology may transform Financial Market Infrastructures (FMIs) by enabling smart contracts to perform a growing share of functions traditionally undertaken by central securities depositories, central counterparties, and trade repositories. It argues that while record-keeping, settlement, collateral management, and reporting can increasingly be executed on-chain, key functions requiring legal certainty, governance, accountability, and discretion remain institutional in nature. The analysis assesses which activities across issuance, clearing, settlement, and reporting can migrate to code, where limitations persist, and how risks evolve in tokenized environments. It finds that tokenization is more likely to reconfigure than eliminate FMIs, creating new efficiencies while introducing novel operational and governance risks. The most plausible outcome is a hybrid FMI model in which technology and institutions jointly provide the trust, resilience, and oversight required for financial stability.
url:614c30e08d7f2f25.abstract_zh: 本文探讨代币化与分布式账本技术如何通过使智能合约承担中央证券存管机构、中央对手方及交易数据库等传统金融基础设施（FMIs）中日益增多的职能，从而推动其变革。研究指出，尽管记录保存、结算、抵押品管理及报告等环节可逐步迁移至链上执行，但涉及法律确定性、治理、问责及自由裁量权的关键职能仍具有制度属性。本文系统评估了发行、清算、结算及报告等环节中哪些活动可迁移至代码执行、现存局限性所在，以及代币化环境下风险演变特征。研究发现，代币化更可能重构而非消除金融基础设施，在创造新效率的同时引入新型操作与治理风险。最可能的结果是形成混合型金融基础设施模式——技术与机构共同提供金融稳定所需的信任、韧性及监管能力。

url:616bcfff91cc445a.abstract: Technology adoption is an important farm management decision and is frequently made using information that is unavailable to the researcher. Aside from their own experiences, producers often rely on extension services to inform their adoption decisions. Here, we propose a novel instrumental variable (IV) approach to identify the effect that a new technology, genetically modified (GM) corn, has on farm yield using instruments constructed from extension information. The proposed approach allows us to explore the degree to which endogeneity bias is present in the GM adoption effect on farm productivity. Candidate instruments are constructed from variety trial data to resemble information acquired by producers from university extension variety trial reports and are spatially merged with on-farm production data. We find that failure to account for the endogeneity of the adoption decision does indeed result in an upward bias in the estimated productivity gains. After correcting for this bias through our IV approach, GM corn results in large on-farm yield gains of 19.6 bushels per acre. We demonstrate that variety trial data can be used to estimate the on-farm impact of new technology, and this approach is general enough to be applied to additional contexts (i.e., technologies, crops, and/or locations).
url:616bcfff91cc445a.abstract_zh: 技术采纳是农场管理中的一项重要决策，且通常基于研究者无法获取的信息进行。除自身经验外，生产者常依赖推广服务来指导其采纳决策。本文提出一种新的工具变量（IV）方法，利用推广信息构建的工具变量，识别转基因玉米这一新技术对农场产量的影响。该方法使我们能够探究转基因采纳效应中内生性偏差对农场生产率影响的程度。候选工具变量基于品种试验数据构建，以模拟生产者从大学推广品种试验报告中获取的信息，并与农场生产数据进行空间匹配。研究发现，若未考虑采纳决策的内生性，确实会导致估计的生产率提升出现向上偏差。通过IV方法纠正这一偏差后，转基因玉米使农场产量实现每英亩19.6蒲式耳的大幅提升。我们证明，品种试验数据可用于估算新技术对农场的影响，且该方法具有足够普适性，可应用于其他情境（如不同技术、作物或地区）。

url:63377656575a5fe8.abstract: A longstanding puzzle in monetary economics is that policy tightening has stronger effects than easing. This column shows that the multiplicity of financing constraints notably dampens the transmission of expansionary monetary policy to firm borrowing and investment, while amplifying the transmission of policy tightening. This asymmetry arises because, when policy tightens, the most responsive constraint binds; whereas, when policy eases, the least responsive constraint limits the expansion of borrowing. A standard New Keynesian framework incorporating this mechanism shows that the decline in aggregate investment following contractionary monetary shocks is twice as large as the increase following equally sized expansionary shocks.
url:63377656575a5fe8.abstract_zh: 货币经济学中一个长期存在的谜题是，政策紧缩的效果强于政策宽松。本文表明，多重融资约束显著削弱了扩张性货币政策向企业借贷和投资的传导，同时放大了政策紧缩的传导效果。这种非对称性产生的原因是：当政策收紧时，最敏感的约束条件生效；而当政策宽松时，最不敏感的约束条件限制了借贷扩张。一个纳入这一机制的标准新凯恩斯框架显示，紧缩性货币冲击后总投资的下降幅度，是同等规模扩张性冲击后上升幅度的两倍。
