url:c8e888d6e9cfc3ed.abstract: Explaining why some countries grow rich while others remain poor requires knowing how --- and when --- institutions change. A large body of research argues that institutional change often occurs at critical junctures: moments when multiple institutional futures are possible, including a return to the status quo. Yet most empirical work examines critical junctures only in retrospect, risking the omission of pivotal moments when institutions were in flux but ultimately remained unchanged. We develop a new empirical approach to detect critical junctures as they unfold. Our key insight is to understand critical junctures as moments of uncertainty about institutions, which provides a text classifier with a theoretically motivated object to detect in contemporaneous discourse. In this chapter, we apply this idea to the study of historical critical junctures using newspaper text as a rich source of information regarding contemporary beliefs about institutional uncertainty. We translate this insight into a measurement strategy by training a large language model-based classifier, which we apply to the Times of London archive--11.95 million articles spanning 1800 to 2019--while focusing our main empirical analysis on 120 years of reporting from 1900 to 2019. This produces the first long-run, text-based measure of institutional uncertainty grounded in the concept of critical junctures. Compared to established indices of geopolitical and economic risk, our measure innovates on several fronts: (i) it captures high uncertainty even in periods without formal institutional change, consistent with ex-ante definitions of critical junctures; (ii) it provides earlier signals of major global convulsions, such as World War I; (iii) it evaluates candidate critical junctures using a common ex ante measure; and (iv) it opens new avenues for studying how critical junctures shape institutions and long-run development. Today, our Times-based index suggests that institutional uncertainty in the US and UK is as elevated as it was in the early 1940s--a signal missed by other leading measures of risk.
url:c8e888d6e9cfc3ed.abstract_zh: 解释为何一些国家走向富裕而另一些国家却陷入贫困，需要理解制度如何——以及何时——发生变迁。大量研究认为，制度变迁往往发生在关键节点：即多种制度未来可能并存（包括回归现状）的时刻。然而，多数实证研究仅以回溯方式考察关键节点，这可能导致遗漏制度处于变动中却最终未发生改变的关键时刻。我们开发了一种新的实证方法，用于实时检测正在展开的关键节点。核心洞见在于将关键节点理解为制度不确定性时期——这为文本分类器提供了具有理论依据的检测对象，使其能在同期话语中识别此类时刻。本章中，我们运用这一理念研究历史关键节点，以报纸文本作为反映当时制度不确定性认知的丰富信息源。通过训练基于大语言模型的分类器，我们将这一洞见转化为测量策略，并将其应用于《泰晤士报》档案库（涵盖1800年至2019年的1195万篇文章），同时将主要实证分析聚焦于1900年至2019年间的120年报道。由此产生了首个基于关键节点概念、以文本为基础的长期制度不确定性度量指标。相较于既有的地缘政治与经济风险指数，本指标在多个方面实现创新：（i）即便在未发生正式制度变迁的时期，也能捕捉到高度不确定性，这与关键节点的事前定义一致；（ii）能更早预警重大全球动荡（如第一次世界大战）；（iii）采用统一的事前度量标准评估候选关键节点；（iv）为研究关键节点如何塑造制度与长期发展开辟新路径。当前，基于《泰晤士报》的指数显示，美英两国的制度不确定性已升至与20世纪40年代初相当的水平——这一信号被其他主流风险指标所遗漏。
authors: Michael Callen; Gregory Levy; Saipremnath Muthukumaran; Jonathan Weigel; Noam Yuchtman

url:c938e13647bf5ebf.abstract: We employ machine learning methods to identify skill among active bond mutual fund managers. Using a comprehensive dataset of 3,021 unique U.S. bond funds from May 1995 to November 2024, we demonstrate that fund-level and family-level characteristics, particularly past performance metrics, reliably predict future bond fund performance. A prediction-weighted portfolio strategy that goes long the best-10% of funds and short the worst-10% of funds generates monthly abnormal returns of 33 basis points with an information ratio of 27.6%. The outperformance persists for up to 36 months. Holdings-based characteristics do not help to separate good from bad managers. The predictive signal is strongest for corporate and municipal bond funds, while Treasury bond funds exhibit weak performance differentiation. Incorporating equity-side information for corporate bond fund families that also offer equity mutual funds does not enhance predictive performance.
url:c938e13647bf5ebf.abstract_zh: 我们采用机器学习方法识别主动型债券共同基金经理的选股能力。基于1995年5月至2024年11月期间涵盖3021只美国债券基金的全面数据集，研究表明基金层面与家族层面的特征（尤其是历史业绩指标）能够可靠预测债券基金的未来表现。采用预测加权组合策略（做多表现最佳的前10%基金，做空表现最差的后10%基金），每月可获得33个基点的异常收益，信息比率达27.6%。这种超额收益可持续长达36个月。基于持仓的特征无法有效区分优秀与平庸的基金经理。预测信号在公司和市政债券基金中最为显著，而国债基金的业绩分化较弱。对于同时提供股票型共同基金的企业债券基金家族，纳入股票端信息并未提升预测效果。

url:c9a891200eb357e1.abstract: We study the rise of nonbank financial intermediation and its implications for systemic risk. We develop a structural network model of banks and nonbank financial institutions (NBFIs) that decomposes intermediation into a capacity channel, driven by bank balance-sheet constraints, and a reliance channel, reflecting NBFI funding reliance. Using U.S. banking confidential supervisory data, we estimate key structural parameters and quantify both channels. We find that fluctuations in bank-NBFI intermediation are primarily explained by the reliance channel, with variation in NBFI fragility emerging as the dominant driver. We show that NBFI intermediation can amplify shocks through funding interconnectedness.
url:c9a891200eb357e1.abstract_zh: 我们研究了非银行金融中介的兴起及其对系统性风险的影响。我们构建了一个包含银行与非银行金融机构的结构性网络模型，将金融中介分解为两个渠道：由银行资产负债表约束驱动的“能力渠道”，以及反映非银行金融机构融资依赖性的“依赖渠道”。利用美国银行保密监管数据，我们估算了关键结构性参数，并对两个渠道进行了量化分析。研究发现，银行与非银行金融机构之间中介活动的波动主要由依赖渠道解释，其中非银行金融机构脆弱性的变化成为主导驱动因素。我们证明，非银行金融中介可能通过融资互联性放大冲击。

url:c9ac0d50d09846b7.abstract: 实现企业与员工利益协同增长是促进共同富裕的必要途径。工资刚性历来被视为阻碍劳动力市场出清的摩擦,本文则将其视作降低员工收入风险的有效机制,认为工资刚性能够提高企业生产效率。本文采用分位数回归森林模型测度企业层面的工资刚性,计量分析表明,工资刚性通过节约劳动力成本、减少员工流失和降低融资成本显著提高生产效率。异质性分析表明,工资刚性究竟提高还是降低生产效率取决于企业面临的风险环境,在非极端负面冲击下保障员工收入稳定能够为企业带来积极回报,在极端负面冲击下企业需要通过及时削减工资转嫁经营风险。此外,劳动力流动性越强、信息不对称程度越强,工资刚性的积极影响越显著。

url:caeef9f21f80359e.abstract: This paper presents an updated version of the Laeven and Valencia (2013, 2020) database on systemic banking crises, extending the coverage through 2025. The update incorporates new episodes, while maintaining the definition established in previous editions, which emphasizes both significant signs of financial distress and substantial policy interventions. The update integrates textual tools to screen potential candidates that are then further scrutinized to confirm if our definition is met. The database includes information on banking crises episodes during 1970-2025, including starting dates, policy responses, fiscal costs, and output losses. It offers a comprehensive tool for assessing cross-country vulnerabilities and policies to resolve banking crises.
url:caeef9f21f80359e.abstract_zh: 本文呈现了Laeven与Valencia（2013, 2020）系统性银行危机数据库的更新版本，将覆盖范围扩展至2025年。此次更新纳入了新危机事件，同时沿用先前版本确立的定义标准，该定义强调显著的金融困境迹象与大规模政策干预。更新过程整合了文本分析工具以筛选潜在候选事件，随后对这些候选事件进行深入审查，以确认是否符合定义标准。该数据库涵盖1970-2025年间的银行危机事件信息，包括起始日期、政策应对措施、财政成本及产出损失。它为评估跨国脆弱性及化解银行危机的政策提供了综合性工具。

url:cb74d4c845866085.abstract: Focus In standard models of monetary policy, public debt is assumed to have no role. Policy rate changes affect output and inflation through conventional channels, and any fiscal consequences of interest rate changes are assumed to be offset by corresponding adjustments in fiscal policy. However, with public debt high in many economies, this assumption may no longer be innocuous. Changes in monetary policy affect not only private borrowing costs but also government interest payments, the income earned by government bondholders and the market value of outstanding public debt. The impact depends on the size of the debt stock, which magnifies these effects, and the maturity profile, which determines how quickly higher policy rates pass through to debt service costs and interest income. It also depends on the sensitivity of bond values to changes in yields.
url:cb74d4c845866085.abstract_zh: 在标准货币政策模型中，公共债务通常被假定为不发挥作用。政策利率变动通过传统渠道影响产出和通胀，而利率变动的任何财政后果均被假定可通过财政政策的相应调整予以抵消。然而，鉴于许多经济体的公共债务水平高企，这一假设可能不再无关紧要。货币政策变动不仅影响私人借贷成本，还会影响政府利息支出、国债持有人获得的收入以及未偿公共债务的市场价值。其影响程度取决于债务存量规模（该规模会放大这些效应）以及期限结构（该结构决定政策利率上升在多大程度上传导至偿债成本和利息收入），同时还取决于债券价值对收益率变动的敏感度。

url:cc16768c2ab6e307.abstract: Policy debates about ageing and shrinking populations often treat the problem as a national one. This column presents evidence from Japan showing that it is also profoundly spatial: ageing and depopulation hit rural regions first. Outmigration from shrinking regions today reduces births tomorrow, which makes the origin region older still. However, policies that reduce spatial inequality also reduce aggregate efficiency, presenting a trade-off that leaves policymakers with the challenge of choosing among different goals.
url:cc16768c2ab6e307.abstract_zh: 关于人口老龄化与萎缩的政策辩论常将其视为国家性问题。本文基于日本证据表明，该问题同样具有深刻的空间维度：老龄化和人口减少首先冲击农村地区。当前萎缩地区的人口外流将导致未来出生率下降，进一步加剧原籍地区的老龄化程度。然而，缩小空间不平等的政策会降低总体效率，这种权衡使政策制定者面临多重目标抉择的挑战。

url:cc7c495535bc3181.abstract: How large is the labor cost saved by AI, and how is it distributed across occupations? Using five waves of the Anthropic Economic Index (January 2025 to February 2026), we construct two novel measures from observed AI usage across countries over the world. The AI concentration index (ACI) shows that in developing economies, virtually all AI usage-based value is generated in a small professional enclave (ACI near 1.0); high-income economies average 0.4 to 0.5, with concentration declining in many countries. The labor cost equivalent (LCE) values the time currently saved by AI at $2.7 trillion annually (3.4% of GDP), an indicative measure of the labor cost of that time. Income and regulatory readiness predict concentration; lacking an official English language slows broadening, a barrier for developing countries.
url:cc7c495535bc3181.abstract_zh: 人工智能节省的劳动力成本规模有多大？这些成本在不同职业间如何分布？基于五轮Anthropic经济指数（2025年1月至2026年2月），我们利用全球各国观测到的AI使用情况构建了两个新颖的度量指标。AI集中度指数（ACI）显示，在发展中经济体，几乎所有基于AI使用的价值都产生于一个狭小的专业飞地（ACI接近1.0）；高收入经济体的ACI均值在0.4至0.5之间，且许多国家的集中度呈下降趋势。劳动力成本当量（LCE）将当前AI节省的时间价值评估为每年2.7万亿美元（占GDP的3.4%），这是对该时间所对应劳动力成本的一个指示性度量。收入水平与监管准备度可预测集中度；缺乏官方英语语言能力会阻碍AI应用的拓展，这对发展中国家构成了一道障碍。

url:cc833d6f1c180fbe.abstract: This paper studies how dollar stablecoins affect parallel foreign-exchange markets in economies with fixed or heavily managed exchange rates. When foreign currency is rationed, the true degree of exchange-rate misalignment is not directly observed. Traditional parallel markets reveal it only imperfectly because information is dispersed across bilateral and often private trading opportunities. Stablecoins make dollar-like claims easier to access outside the official allocation system, but they also create a visible, high-frequency price that aggregates order flow in a common venue. I develop a global-games model in which households observe dispersed private signals about misalignment, while stablecoin market depth determines the precision of a common public signal. Stablecoins generate a state-dependent welfare effect. They expand access to foreign-currency and can improve allocation by making beliefs about misalignment more informative, but the same public price can also coordinate runs by making beliefs and actions more synchronized. When misalignment is low, access and allocation gains dominate, so stablecoins raise welfare. When misalignment is high, the coordination externality becomes more costly: a more precise public signal compresses belief dispersion, strengthens coordinated exit incentives, and can overturn the access benefit. This points to a state-contingent approach that preserves low-cost access in normal states while using temporary, targeted measures to manage large or run-like flows when misalignment is high.
url:cc833d6f1c180fbe.abstract_zh: 本文研究美元稳定币如何影响固定或严格管理汇率经济体中的平行外汇市场。当外币被配给时，汇率失衡的真实程度无法直接观测。传统平行市场仅能不完全揭示这一信息，因为信息分散于双边且往往私密的交易机会中。稳定币使得美元类债权更易在官方分配体系之外获取，但同时也创造了可见的高频价格，该价格在共同交易平台上汇聚订单流。我构建了一个全局博弈模型，其中家庭观测到关于汇率失衡的分散私人信号，而稳定币市场深度决定了共同公共信号的精确度。稳定币产生状态依赖的福利效应：它们扩大了外币获取渠道，并通过使关于失衡的信念更具信息量来改善资源配置，但同一公共价格也可能通过使信念与行动更趋同步而协调挤兑行为。当失衡程度较低时，获取渠道与资源配置的收益占主导地位，因此稳定币提升福利；当失衡程度较高时，协调外部性成本上升——更精确的公共信号压缩信念离散度，强化协调性退出激励，并可能抵消获取收益。这指向一种状态依存的应对方案：在正常状态下保留低成本获取渠道，同时在失衡严重时采用临时性、针对性的措施管理大规模或挤兑式资金流动。

url:ccb861a48b43688e.abstract: We document the state-dependence of monetary policy transmission to output and core consumer prices in a sample of eleven large inflation-targeting emerging markets along three cyclical dimensions: the business cycle position, the monetary policy stance, and the level of trend inflation. We show that monetary policy has strong effects on output during recessions and after a period of loose monetary policy, but little to no impact during expansions or when monetary policy has been tight. In contrast, the response of prices is muted regardless of business cycle position or monetary policy stance. Transmission also depends on trend inflation: when trend inflation is low, monetary policy has a stronger impact on output and a weaker effect on prices, whereas a high-inflation environment dampens the output response and amplifies price adjustments. These findings are broadly consistent with the presence of financial frictions in the form of occasionally binding borrowing constraints, endogenous frequency of price adjustments, loss aversion preferences, and a convex Phillips Curve.
url:ccb861a48b43688e.abstract_zh: 本文基于11个大型通胀目标制新兴市场国家的样本，从三个周期性维度——经济周期位置、货币政策立场及趋势通胀水平——系统论证了货币政策向产出与核心消费价格传导的状态依赖性。研究表明：在经济衰退期及宽松货币政策实施后，货币政策对产出具有显著影响；但在经济扩张期或紧缩货币政策环境下，其影响微乎其微。相比之下，无论经济周期位置或货币政策立场如何，价格对货币政策的反应均较为平缓。传导效应还取决于趋势通胀水平：当趋势通胀较低时，货币政策对产出的影响更强，对价格的影响更弱；而高通胀环境则会抑制产出反应并放大价格调整幅度。这些发现与以下理论机制高度吻合：偶发性的借贷约束、价格调整的内生频率、损失厌恶偏好以及凸性菲利普斯曲线所体现的金融摩擦特征。

url:cd4f801f49c9a35e.abstract: Multidimensional poverty metrics offer a more complete picture of poverty than monetary poverty, yet their adoption has been limited by data constraints. Often not all dimensions in a multidimensional measure are observed in the same survey, leading to countries being excluded from global measures. This study introduces a novel data fusion approach to estimate multidimensional poverty metrics by combining summary statistics from multiple data sources. The proposed method is validated by simulating typical missing data scenarios using 571 household surveys from 112 countries (1989–2024) to estimate the World Bank’s Multidimensional Poverty Measure. The fusion method accurately predicts various multidimensional poverty metrics across these scenarios, even in the presence of simulated sample bias reflecting differences in survey design. It enables estimates of multidimensional poverty for a greater number of countries, gap-filling in time series, and the inclusion of previously unavailable indicators and dimensions in global multidimensional poverty measures.
url:cd4f801f49c9a35e.abstract_zh: 多维贫困指标相比货币贫困能更全面地反映贫困状况，但其应用受限于数据约束。由于多维贫困指标中的各个维度往往无法在同一项调查中完整观测，导致许多国家被排除在全球性贫困测度之外。本研究提出一种创新的数据融合方法，通过整合多个数据源的汇总统计量来估算多维贫困指标。该方法利用112个国家（1989-2024年）的571项家庭调查数据，通过模拟典型数据缺失场景对世界银行多维贫困测度进行验证。结果表明，即便在存在反映调查设计差异的模拟样本偏差时，该融合方法仍能准确预测各类多维贫困指标。该方法不仅能够为更多国家提供多维贫困估算，填补时间序列数据缺口，还能将此前无法获取的指标和维度纳入全球多维贫困测度体系。

url:cdc0a5b6b8f2cfea.abstract_zh: 本文首次从企业层面评估蒙古国的集聚经济效应，重点关注该国主导城市中心乌兰巴托。利用2021年企业普查数据，本文估算了大量样本企业的全要素生产率，并考察其与本地化经济、城市多样性及同行生产率之间的关系。结果表明，存在稳健的正向集聚效应，同时有迹象显示本地化经济存在递减收益，符合倒U型模式。这些非线性特征在乌兰巴托及制造业中最为显著，但对替代性集聚指标与生产率指标的敏感性较高。尽管数据的横截面性质限制了因果推断，但分析为空间集中如何与拥挤效应、基础设施压力及潜在的空间错配相互作用提供了新的微观证据。研究结果凸显了城市规划、基础设施投资及区域中心建设对维持蒙古国高度集中城市体系中生产率增长的重要性，并对资源依赖型经济体实现矿业以外的多元化发展具有启示意义。

url:d047d24f4be6aa10.abstract: Employing large language models to analyze official documents, we construct a comprehensive record of daily changes in de jure restrictions on cross-border flows worldwide since the 1950s. Our analysis uncovers the wide array of instruments used to regulate cross-border financial flows over the past seven decades, leveraging the fine granularity of the new measures to characterize cross-country and time-series variation across eight categories of restrictions —- distinguishing by flow, direction, instrument type, intensity, and overall policy stance. We exploit the high frequency nature of the new data to document novel patterns in the use of these restrictions, as well as their relationship to crises and political economy determinants.
url:d047d24f4be6aa10.abstract_zh: 利用大语言模型分析官方文件，我们构建了自20世纪50年代以来全球跨境流动法律限制每日变化的综合记录。通过新措施的高粒度特性，我们揭示了过去七十年间用于监管跨境资金流动的广泛工具组合，从八个限制类别（按流动类型、方向、工具种类、强度及整体政策立场区分）刻画了跨国与时间序列的差异。借助新数据的高频特征，我们记录了这些限制使用的新模式，及其与危机和政治经济决定因素之间的关联。

url:d057a29df50c8229.abstract: Authoritarian regimes shape citizens’ knowledge and beliefs through censorship and propaganda. We study which narratives they suppress and promote using a rare natural experiment: Ruwiki, created in 2023 by cloning Russian-language Wikipedia and selectively rewriting its 1.9 million articles under regime-aligned editorial control. We compare the two platforms twenty months after the fork, using within-Wikipedia changes as a placebo benchmark. We find that Ruwiki’s editing patterns resemble professional rather than volunteer-driven content production. An LLM-based comparison and machine-learning analyses of text deletions and insertions reveal a coherent ideology organized around three pillars: Russia’s image vis-àvis the rest of the world, domestic politics, and culture. The resulting narratives legitimize Russia’s past and present acts of aggression, suppress accounts of domestic opposition and human-rights violations, and promote traditional values. Culture’s centrality reveals how authoritarian information control penetrates domains far beyond formal politics, including morality, gender, family life, law, and psychology. Article deletions are rare and confined to topics that are difficult to reframe, while editing is broad, consistent with a preference for reframing existing content rather than leaving unanswered queries: 27% of articles undergo at least some change, 2.8% are heavily edited, and only 0.14% are deleted. Rewriting sensitive topics reduces readability, suggesting that ideological control is costly. An external benchmark using official high-school history textbooks confirms that Ruwiki’s revisions move articles on modern history toward state-sanctioned narratives. The results show how authoritarian information control constructs a regime-aligned account of the world and Russia’s place in it.
url:d057a29df50c8229.abstract_zh: 威权政权通过审查和宣传塑造公民的知识与信念。我们利用一项罕见的自然实验——Ruwiki（2023年通过克隆俄语维基百科并在亲政权编辑控制下选择性重写其190万篇文章创建而成）——研究其压制和推广的叙事。在分叉二十个月后，我们以维基百科内部变化作为安慰剂基准，对两个平台进行比较。研究发现，Ruwiki的编辑模式更接近专业内容生产而非志愿者驱动。基于大语言模型的比较以及对文本删除和插入的机器学习分析揭示了一套围绕三大支柱构建的连贯意识形态：俄罗斯相对于世界其他地区的形象、国内政治以及文化。由此产生的叙事将俄罗斯过去和现在的侵略行为合法化，压制国内反对派和人权侵犯的报道，并推广传统价值观。文化的核心地位揭示了威权信息控制如何渗透到远超正式政治领域的范畴，包括道德、性别、家庭生活、法律和心理学。文章删除极为罕见，仅限于难以重新框架化的主题；而编辑则广泛存在，这与偏好重新框架现有内容而非留下未解答疑问的倾向一致：27%的文章经历了至少某种程度的修改，2.8%被大幅编辑，仅0.14%被删除。对敏感话题的重写降低了可读性，表明意识形态控制代价高昂。使用官方高中历史教科书作为外部基准证实，Ruwiki的修订将现代史相关文章推向国家认可的叙事。研究结果展示了威权信息控制如何构建一套符合政权立场的世界叙事及俄罗斯在其中地位的图景。

url:d2a344f4e4d777f5.abstract: Maladaptive land use change at forest margins presents a persistent governance challenge under climate and policy pressures. This paper introduces the concept of rule erosion to explain how the gradual and uneven weakening of institutional rules drives land use change. While institutional analyses have treated rule change as adaptive flexibility or as macro-level drift, the cumulative weakening of operational rules-in-use at the community level remains under-theorised. Drawing on the Upland Saddang watershed, Indonesia, we examine how the weakening of boundary, scope and payoff rules within multi-level governance has shaped farmers' decisions and narrowed adaptation pathways. The two study villages were selected from those in the watershed that were identified as experiencing persistent drought. In the two villages data was gathered from 35 farmer interviews covering 129 land plots, 10 stakeholder interviews, focus group discussions and participatory GIS. Using the Institutional Analysis and Development (IAD) framework, these findings show that maize cultivation (62.6% of plots) has become the dominant outcome across a wide range of former land uses—converting from paddy, cocoa, forest and grasslands—a pattern closely linked to repeated cycles of maize seed assistance rather than autonomous adaptation. Weakened boundary rules made maize seed assistance effectively open-access; loose scope rules have pushed it onto steep slopes and forest margins; and payoff rules have favoured short-cycle returns, narrowing available options and creating the conditions for what we term assistance-led maladaptation. The analysis extends the concept of erosion from constitutional and international-norms scholarship to community-level resource governance and calls for graduated multi-level safeguards that preserve local adaptive flexibility.
url:d2a344f4e4d777f5.abstract_zh: 森林边缘的适应性不良土地利用变化在气候与政策压力下构成了持续性的治理挑战。本文引入规则侵蚀概念，阐释制度规则渐进且不均衡的弱化如何驱动土地利用变化。尽管制度分析将规则变化视为适应性弹性或宏观层面的漂移，但社区层面操作性使用规则的累积性弱化仍缺乏理论化探讨。以印度尼西亚高地萨达河流域为案例，我们考察了多层级治理中边界规则、范围规则与收益规则的弱化如何影响农户决策并收窄适应路径。两个研究村庄选自流域内持续干旱区域，通过35份农户访谈（覆盖129块土地）、10份利益相关者访谈、焦点小组讨论及参与式地理信息系统收集数据。运用制度分析与发展（IAD）框架的研究表明，玉米种植（占土地样本62.6%）已成为各类前土地利用类型（包括稻田、可可林、森林与草地）转型后的主导结果——这一模式与玉米种子援助的周期性循环密切相关，而非自主适应行为。弱化的边界规则使玉米种子援助实质上成为开放获取资源；松散的范畴规则将其推向陡坡与森林边缘；收益规则则偏向短周期回报，收窄了可用选择空间，形成了我们称之为援助导向型适应不良的条件。该分析将规则侵蚀概念从宪法与国际规范研究领域拓展至社区层面资源治理，并呼吁建立保留地方适应灵活性的渐进式多层保障机制。

url:d2a721f5b93ad5e6.abstract: This study uses whole-of-population linked census-administrative data to examine gender gaps in educational outcomes from early primary school through early adulthood in Australia and to assess the contribution of socioeconomic factors to these gaps either at the mean and along the distribution of educational outcomes. Leveraging the richness and large size of the linked data and employing some of the most rigorous empirical approaches in the literature, including mother and twin fixed-effects models, we find that females outperform males as early as ages 5–6 across multiple developmental domains, and that this advantage persists through university. The gender gap in favour of females is larger among lower-performing students. We also find that boys benefit more than girls from growing up in more advantaged families, particularly among academically lower-performing boys. However, this advantage is observed only for outcomes measured in the early years of primary school. By contrast, for outcomes measured at the tertiary level, most indicators of socioeconomic advantage confer stronger benefits to females, especially among individuals at the lower end of the educational attainment distribution. Finally, having ruled out gender differences in birth weight—which favour males—we identify gender differences across siblings in school sector choice and early childhood health conditions, both favouring females, as potential mechanisms underlying these patterns.
url:d2a721f5b93ad5e6.abstract_zh: 本研究利用全人口关联普查与行政数据，考察澳大利亚从小学早期至成年早期的教育成果性别差距，并评估社会经济因素在均值及教育成果分布上对这些差距的贡献。借助关联数据的丰富性与大规模特征，并采用文献中最严谨的实证方法（包括母亲固定效应模型和双胞胎固定效应模型），我们发现：早在5-6岁阶段，女性在多个发展领域已优于男性，且这一优势持续至大学阶段。在学业表现较低的学生群体中，女性优势更为显著。同时，成长于更优越家庭环境的男性获益程度高于女性，尤其在学业表现较差的男性群体中更为明显。然而，这一优势仅体现在小学早期阶段的教育成果指标上。相比之下，在高等教育阶段，大多数社会经济优势指标对女性更为有利，尤其对教育成就分布底端的个体而言。最后，在排除出生体重（男性占优）的性别差异后，我们识别出兄弟姐妹间在学校类型选择及儿童早期健康状况上的性别差异（两者均有利于女性），这些差异构成了上述模式的潜在机制。

url:d37eac95e2809af8.abstract: We document the effects of electronic invoicing (eInvoicing) on credit markets. By making invoices more standardized, verifiable, and harder to falsify, eInvoicing changes lenders’ information sets, facilitating invoice-based financing and credit risk assessment. We exploit a regional eInvoicing mandate and administrative credit data using a difference-in-differences design to provide three main insights. First, credit reallocates toward firms already relying on invoice-based credit (“invoice firms”) and away from non-invoice firms. Second, the cost of (non-)invoice credit falls (rises) for (non-)invoice firms, consistent with a supply-driven mechanism. Third, banks’ information production changes: eInvoicing widens (reduces) the dispersion of rates and banks’ risk assessments and improves (worsens) their predictive accuracy for (non-)invoice firms. Overall, eInvoicing reshapes credit market outcomes, with uneven effects across borrowers.
url:d37eac95e2809af8.abstract_zh: 本文研究了电子发票对信贷市场的影响。通过使发票更加标准化、可验证且难以伪造，电子发票改变了贷款人的信息集，促进了基于发票的融资和信用风险评估。我们利用地区性电子发票强制政策及行政信贷数据，采用双重差分法得出三项主要发现。第一，信贷资源向已依赖发票信贷的企业（"发票企业"）重新配置，同时从非发票企业流出。第二，发票企业（非发票企业）的（非）发票信贷成本下降（上升），这与供给驱动机制一致。第三，银行的信息生产发生变化：电子发票扩大了（缩小了）利率和银行风险评估的离散程度，并改善（恶化）了对发票企业（非发票企业）的预测准确性。总体而言，电子发票重塑了信贷市场格局，但对不同借款人的影响存在差异。

url:d382ef37a58cc13b.abstract: In an ample-reserves framework, administered rates anchor money markets but suppress information from unsecured interbank trading. We recover that information by isolating the small interbank segment of the federal funds market. Using high-frequency bank-level data, we employ deposit shocks as an instrument for bank borrowing demand. Our analysis reveals that non-bank lenders, such as Federal Home Loan Banks, supply funds elastically, whereas bank lenders exhibit price inelasticity, which intensifies as their reserve balances decline, particularly for bankers’ banks. This interbank segment highlights distributional frictions in the federal funds market that emerge well before aggregate reserves become scarce and provides new evidence on monetary policy transmission in an ample-reserves regime.
url:d382ef37a58cc13b.abstract_zh: 在充足准备金框架下，管理利率锚定货币市场，但抑制了无担保银行间交易的信息。我们通过分离联邦基金市场中规模较小的银行间板块来恢复这些信息。利用高频银行层面数据，我们将存款冲击作为银行借款需求的工具变量。分析表明，非银行贷方（如联邦住房贷款银行）具有弹性资金供给，而银行贷方则表现出价格缺乏弹性，且随着其准备金余额下降（尤其是对银行家银行而言）这种缺乏弹性会加剧。这一银行间板块凸显了在总准备金变得稀缺之前就已出现的联邦基金市场分配摩擦，并为充足准备金制度下的货币政策传导提供了新证据。

url:d3bf2bc0afaa8ee1.abstract: Does Generative AI displace early-career workers? We provide population-wide evidence from Norwegian administrative registers, 2015 through March 2025, exploiting the November 2022 release of ChatGPT as an availability shock. Using the within-firm composition difference-in-differences employed in recent work, supplemented with a synthetic difference-in-differences at the occupation level and a firm-level shift-share design, we find no robust evidence of employment displacement among young workers in highly AI-exposed occupations, nor any robust response across other age cohorts or on incumbent labor-market outcomes. While estimated coefficients for young workers are negative, in line with the existing literature, they are small and statistically insignificant. A backdating exercise on the synthetic difference-in-differences yields larger absolute estimates than the actual treatment date across most age bands. This suggests the apparent post-2022 decline reflects, at least in part, pre-existing secular trends rather than a clean AI-period break.
url:d3bf2bc0afaa8ee1.abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能是否取代了早期职业工作者？我们利用挪威行政登记数据（2015年至2025年3月）提供全人口层面的证据，以2022年11月ChatGPT的发布作为可得性冲击。采用近期研究中使用的企业内构成双重差分法，辅以职业层面的合成双重差分法和企业层面的份额转移设计，我们未发现年轻工作者在高人工智能暴露职业中存在就业替代的稳健证据，也未发现其他年龄群体或现有劳动力市场结果存在稳健反应。尽管年轻工作者的估计系数为负，与现有文献一致，但系数较小且统计上不显著。对合成双重差分法进行回溯检验发现，在大多数年龄段中，实际处理日期之前的绝对估计值大于实际处理日期之后的估计值。这表明2022年后的表面下降至少部分反映了既有的长期趋势，而非人工智能时期的明确结构性断裂。

url:d4aea1f8e4d087bc.abstract: We develop a general equilibrium model of firm dynamics with multiple labour skills to analyse the productivity implications of skill shortages. Firms employ cognitive, interpersonal, and manual skills in both operational and overhead tasks, with sectoral variation in skill intensities, and within sector firm size heterogeneity due to idiosyncratic technology draws. Calibrated to UK data, the model reveals that cognitive skills are a binding constraint on productivity. A reduction in the supply of cognitive skills lowers labour productivity at all levels -- firms, sectors, and in the aggregate. About half of the sectoral effects are due to changes in the within-sector distribution, whereby larger firms grow in relative size but become less productive. Sectoral heterogeneity in skill intensities amplifies these effects.
url:d4aea1f8e4d087bc.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含多种劳动技能的企业动态一般均衡模型，以分析技能短缺对生产率的影响。企业在运营任务和管理任务中同时使用认知技能、人际交往技能和操作技能，不同行业的技能密集度存在差异，且由于企业特有的技术冲击，同一行业内企业规模呈现异质性。基于英国数据校准的模型表明，认知技能是制约生产率的关键因素。认知技能供给的减少会降低企业、行业及总体层面的劳动生产率。行业层面约一半的影响源于行业内分布的变化——大型企业相对规模扩大，但生产率反而下降。行业间技能密集度的异质性进一步放大了这些效应。

url:d64face8f7a3f90b.abstract: We investigate the systemic risk contribution of 3,500 Money Market Funds (MMFs) in normal periods and during asset price bubbles in the US from January 2004 to December 2022. Using state-of-the-art statistical techniques for bubble detection and granular fund-level data, we show that MMF characteristics significantly influence systemic risk. Large MMFs and government MMFs, which invest exclusively in US Treasury securities, are associated with reduced systemic risk, while prime MMFs contribute to higher systemic risk. MMFs denominated in US dollars but domiciled offshore exhibit no significant differences from their US-domiciled counterparts.
url:d64face8f7a3f90b.abstract_zh: 本文研究了2004年1月至2022年12月期间，美国3500只货币市场基金在正常时期及资产价格泡沫期间的系统性风险贡献。运用前沿的泡沫检测统计技术与精细的基金层面数据，我们发现货币市场基金特征对系统性风险具有显著影响。大型货币市场基金及仅投资于美国国债的政府货币市场基金与较低的系统性风险相关，而优质货币市场基金则加剧了系统性风险。以美元计价但注册于离岸市场的货币市场基金，其表现与美国本土注册的同类基金无显著差异。

url:d6502647b39d8988.abstract: The link between environment and trade has long been the subject of intense policy debate. This study reviews the existing literature and addresses key gaps. We develop a unified framework that incorporates environmental externalities (local versus global), abatement, political competition, and trade. The model shows how producer and consumer/environmentalist lobbying incentives over pollution stringency interact, and how these incentives vary with the nature and magnitude of environmental externalities, the structure of environmental agreements (unilateral versus multilateral), and trade regimes. It also highlights the roles of abatement and terms‐of‐trade effects in shaping the equilibrium outcomes. In a large open economy, cooperative policy internalises the costs of emission leakage induced by lobbying, making it more welfare‐improving than noncooperative policy. Producer and consumer lobbying generally exert countervailing pressures, with their relative influence determined by the weights the government assigns to each group.
url:d6502647b39d8988.abstract_zh: 环境与贸易之间的联系长期以来一直是政策辩论的焦点。本研究回顾了现有文献，并填补了关键空白。我们构建了一个统一的分析框架，将环境外部性（本地与全球）、减排措施、政治竞争和贸易纳入其中。该模型揭示了生产者和消费者/环保主义者围绕污染严格程度的游说激励如何相互作用，以及这些激励如何随环境外部性的性质与规模、环境协议的结构（单边与多边）以及贸易体制而变化。模型还强调了减排效应和贸易条件效应在塑造均衡结果中的作用。在大型开放经济体中，合作性政策内化了游说引发的排放泄漏成本，因此比非合作性政策更能提升福利。生产者和消费者的游说通常产生相互抵消的压力，其相对影响力取决于政府赋予各群体的权重。

url:d69e7d975d212dad.abstract: Central banks are rethinking reserve portfolios as geopolitical fragmentation raises concerns about the accessibility of foreign-held assets, while dollar-funding stress keeps the US dollar at the centre of global financial stability. Using high-frequency US monetary policy surprises and minute-level exchange rates for 18 economies, this column shows that dollar and gold reserves are associated with smaller currency depreciations, especially where official dollar-liquidity backstops are absent and dollar liabilities are large. The findings highlight the importance of maintaining liquidity in the currencies where stress is likely, alongside sound domestic funding structures, credible policy frameworks, and prudent limits on unhedged foreign currency debt.
url:d69e7d975d212dad.abstract_zh: 随着地缘政治碎片化加剧，各国央行对境外持有资产的可及性产生担忧，而美元融资压力则使美元始终处于全球金融稳定的核心位置。本文利用高频美国货币政策冲击数据及18个经济体的分钟级汇率数据，发现美元与黄金储备与较小的货币贬值幅度相关，尤其在缺乏官方美元流动性支持且美元负债规模较大的经济体中更为显著。研究结果强调，在维持可能承压货币流动性的同时，还需构建稳健的国内融资结构、可信的政策框架，并对未对冲外币债务设置审慎限额。

url:d6fb91b798aceb73.abstract: This paper examines the employment effects of multinational enterprises (MNEs) in Mexico, focusing on the labor market impacts of foreign tariff increases during 2018-2019. Using data from Mexicos National Survey of Occupations and Employment (ENOE) for 2014-2023 combined with sector-level tariff exposure measures based on Fajgelbaum et al. (2024), we construct a quarterly city-sector panel distinguishing employment in MNEs and domestic firms. We analyze employment outcomes across worker characteristics (education, age, gender) and firm attributes (size and location). Results indicate a positive employment effect in MNEs within the sectors most affected by the tariff increases, particularly for highly educated workers and small establishments. In contrast, there is no clear evidence of significant effects on wages.
url:d6fb91b798aceb73.abstract_zh: 本文考察了墨西哥跨国企业的就业效应，重点关注2018-2019年外国关税上调对劳动力市场的影响。基于2014-2023年墨西哥国家职业与就业调查（ENOE）数据，结合Fajgelbaum等人（2024）提出的行业层面关税暴露指标，我们构建了区分跨国企业与本土企业就业的季度城市-行业面板数据。通过分析不同劳动者特征（教育程度、年龄、性别）及企业属性（规模与区位）的就业结果，研究发现：在受关税上调影响最严重的行业中，跨国企业呈现正向就业效应，尤其体现在高学历劳动者和小规模企业中。相比之下，工资水平未出现显著变化的明确证据。

url:d75fd97853e101e5.abstract: In a series of declarations throughout 2025 and into 2026, the United States announced higher tariffs on nearly all imports from most countries. The countries that make up the CAPDR region (Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, Panama and El Salvador) are affected through sizeable direct trade linkages with the United States, and through indirect trade linkages with third countries. This paper explores the potential long-term economic effects of these tariff increases on CAPDR using a multi-region multi-industry model of the global economy. The modelling exercises suggest that CAPDR member countries will experience falls in real GDP to varying degrees, with the severity of the effect closely linked to direct export exposure to the United States. The most vulnerable industries are heavily trade-exposed manufactures, although exemptions – most importantly for textiles & apparel – may provide some scope for trade diversion to offset some of the GDP losses. Although ongoing legal challenges have introduced additional uncertainty regarding the ultimate extent of tariff changes, the results in this paper will remain broadly valid providing the tariffs remain in place.
url:d75fd97853e101e5.abstract_zh: 在2025年至2026年的一系列声明中，美国宣布对来自大多数国家的几乎所有进口商品加征更高关税。中美洲-多米尼加共和国地区（CAPDR）成员国（哥斯达黎加、多米尼加共和国、危地马拉、洪都拉斯、尼加拉瓜、巴拿马和萨尔瓦多）通过与美国直接且规模可观的贸易联系，以及与第三国的间接贸易联系而受到影响。本文运用全球经济多区域多产业模型，探讨了这些关税上调对CAPDR的潜在长期经济影响。模型测算表明，CAPDR成员国实际GDP将出现不同程度的下降，其影响严重程度与对美国的直接出口敞口密切相关。最脆弱的行业是高度依赖贸易的制造业，尽管豁免条款——最重要的是纺织品与服装——可能通过贸易转移在一定程度上抵消部分GDP损失。尽管持续的法律挑战为关税变动的最终幅度增添了额外不确定性，但只要关税措施持续实施，本文的研究结果将基本保持有效。

url:d7761e9bf66bace3.abstract: Exchange rate movements have implications for the purchasing power of residents or voters. Given that the exchange rate is often seen as a barometer of government performance, there could be strong incentives to influence exchange rate valuation during elections. This paper investigates whether political economy factors affect Foreign Exchange Intervention (FXI) policy across countries. It investigates whether central banks tend to implement FX sales, leaning against depreciations, during electoral periods in a sample of 28 countries including both advanced (AEs) and emerging (EMs) economies over the period 2000-2019. The results show that EMs with competitive elections tend to implement more and larger FX sales in pre-electoral period, compared to post-election period, given their political popularity. Further, this result is driven by countries where political pressures on central bank governors are more prevalent. Furthermore, the paper also finds that monetary policy transparency has the potential to mitigate this politically driven FXI during electoral period. Finally, the paper discusses policy implications given that politically motivated FX sales could hamper the ability of central banks to effectively respond to large shocks.
url:d7761e9bf66bace3.abstract_zh: 汇率变动对居民或选民的购买力具有重要影响。鉴于汇率常被视为政府绩效的晴雨表，选举期间可能存在强烈动机干预汇率估值。本文研究政治经济因素是否会影响各国的外汇干预政策，基于2000-2019年涵盖28个经济体（包括发达经济体和新兴经济体）的样本，考察央行是否倾向于在选举期间实施外汇抛售以应对本币贬值压力。结果表明，具有竞争性选举的新兴经济体在选举前阶段，出于政治声望考量，会实施更多且规模更大的外汇抛售。进一步分析显示，这一结果在央行行长面临更普遍政治压力的国家尤为显著。此外，本文还发现货币政策透明度具有缓解选举期间政治驱动型外汇干预的潜力。最后，本文讨论了政策启示：出于政治动机的外汇抛售可能削弱央行有效应对重大冲击的能力。

url:d85759453616c147.abstract: Residential land prices are highly sensitive to new information, particularly when pollution disclosures highlight potential health risks. Following the 2020 disclosure of nationwide government survey results, extensive contamination from per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances, or PFAS, commonly known as “forever chemicals,” was revealed, leading to intensified media coverage and heightened public awareness. This study applies a staggered difference-in-differences approach to quantify the impact of PFAS pollution disclosures on Japanese residential land prices. Using property-level panel data from the Land Market Value Publication, we compare treated properties to control properties within varying distance radii. In the 5 km radius analysis, statistically significant average post-treatment declines range from approximately 1.3% when Tokyo is excluded to 2.4% when Osaka and Okinawa, which had received PFAS-related disclosures earlier, are also excluded. Across the distance-buffer specifications, dynamic event-study effects reach approximately 4.4–6.4% by the fourth year after disclosure. Notably, significant price declines emerged only after media coverage intensified around 2023, highlighting the critical role of information salience in translating environmental disclosures into market responses. A heterogeneity analysis suggests that high-value properties tend to exhibit larger and earlier price responses, consistent with buyers in higher-value market segments being more sensitive to environmental risk information. These findings indicate that pollution disclosures can reduce residential asset values, underscoring the economic costs of environmental information disclosure and the need for complementary policy measures to mitigate capitalized losses borne by affected property owners.
url:d85759453616c147.abstract_zh: 住宅用地价格对新信息高度敏感，尤其是当污染披露揭示潜在健康风险时。2020年全国政府调查结果公布后，全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS，俗称“永久化学品”）的广泛污染被曝光，导致媒体报道加剧和公众意识提升。本研究采用交错双重差分法，量化PFAS污染披露对日本住宅用地价格的影响。利用《地价公示》中的物业层面面板数据，我们在不同距离半径内将受处理物业与对照物业进行比较。在5公里半径分析中，统计上显著的平均处理后降幅约为1.3%（排除东京时）至2.4%（进一步排除此前已收到PFAS相关披露的大阪和冲绳时）。在不同距离缓冲区的设定下，动态事件研究效应在披露后第四年达到约4.4%至6.4%。值得注意的是，显著的价格下降仅在2023年左右媒体报道加剧后才出现，凸显了信息显著性在将环境披露转化为市场反应中的关键作用。异质性分析表明，高价值物业往往表现出更大且更早的价格反应，这与高价值市场细分中的买家对环境风险信息更为敏感一致。这些发现表明，污染披露可能降低住宅资产价值，凸显了环境信息披露的经济成本，以及需要采取补充政策措施来减轻受影响物业所有者承担的资本化损失。

url:d876a7ada352a4cd.abstract: The regulatory cycles view, according to which periods of deregulation encourage greater risk-taking and credit booms, which culminate in financial crises and are followed by renewed regulation, rests largely on case studies of individual countries or particular crises. This column uses a new dataset covering 14 countries over the past century to show that the pattern observed after the Great Depression has been much weaker since the Global Financial Crisis. The authors argue that the reason is not simply a change in political priorities or regulatory philosophy. Increasing financial integration has made effective banking regulation at the national level progressively more difficult, shifting regulatory authority from national governments towards international coordination.
url:d876a7ada352a4cd.abstract_zh: 监管周期理论认为，放松管制时期会鼓励更大的风险承担和信贷繁荣，最终导致金融危机，随后迎来新一轮监管强化。这一观点主要基于对单个国家或特定危机的案例研究。本文利用覆盖14个国家过去一个世纪的新数据集，表明大萧条后观察到的这一模式自全球金融危机以来已显著弱化。作者认为，其原因并非仅仅是政治优先事项或监管理念的转变。日益加深的金融一体化使得国家层面的有效银行监管愈发困难，监管权力正从各国政府向国际协调机制转移。

url:d9690315f6865288.abstract: We examine how reminders for self-set goals influence productivity by analyzing data from 10,187 volunteer agricultural extension workers in Rwanda. We elicited workers’ goals and experimentally varied their salience through text reminders. Due to unforeseen logistical delays, approximately half of the treatment group received reminders after completing their tasks. We find that goal reminders received during the regular working period increased a productivity index by 0.08 standard deviations, while reminders sent late had no effect. Further analysis of heterogeneity by goal ambition quartiles reveals an inverted U-shaped relationship: reminders are effective for goals in the second and third quartiles, but ineffective for low or excessively high goals. These results suggest that workers who set ambitious yet realistic goals are more likely to respond to reminders and increase productivity, consistent with prior evidence on externally set goals.
url:d9690315f6865288.abstract_zh: 我们通过分析卢旺达10,187名农业推广志愿者的数据，考察了自我设定目标的提醒如何影响生产率。我们收集了志愿者的目标，并通过短信提醒实验性地改变其显著性。由于不可预见的物流延误，约一半的干预组在完成任务后才收到提醒。研究发现，在正常工作期间收到的目标提醒使生产率指数提高了0.08个标准差，而延迟发送的提醒则无效果。进一步按目标抱负四分位数进行的异质性分析揭示了倒U型关系：提醒对第二和第三四分位数的目标有效，但对低目标或过高目标无效。这些结果表明，设定既有抱负又现实的目标的工人更可能对提醒做出反应并提高生产率，这与先前关于外部设定目标的证据一致。

url:d981d10ff1c57598.abstract: We study situations in which players shape their own understanding of the game, as well as others’, through information acquisition, communication, and other forms of strategic cognition. We introduce the concept of expectation conformity: incentives to change cognition are stronger when others expect such changes and/or make similar changes themselves. Expectation conformity provides a revealed-preference characterization of equilibrium determinacy in cognitive games. When it fails, equilibrium cognition is unique, independently of cognitive costs. When it holds, suitable costs generate multiple equilibria. We illustrate the implications in two-player constant-sum and linear-quadratic-Gaussian games. The online supplement considers other forms of cognition.
url:d981d10ff1c57598.abstract_zh: 我们研究玩家通过信息获取、沟通及其他形式的策略认知来塑造自身及他人对博弈理解的情境。我们引入预期一致性概念：当他人预期此类认知变化或自身做出类似改变时，改变认知的激励会更强。预期一致性为认知博弈中的均衡确定性提供了显示偏好特征。当预期一致性不成立时，均衡认知具有唯一性，且独立于认知成本；当预期一致性成立时，适当的成本会产生多重均衡。我们通过两人常和博弈与线性二次高斯博弈阐释其含义。在线附录则探讨其他形式的认知。

url:dac9f1f99f096758.abstract: Public-health interventions often aspire to generate spillovers beyond the households they directly reach, but identifying who is exposed to whom within communities is challenging. Researchers frequently approximate social exposure using geographic proximity, even though the individuals who transmit health advice need not be nearby. We study this issue by conducting secondary analysis of a randomized maternal and child health counseling intervention in rural Honduras with geocoded households and mapped social networks. At our main 50-meter radius, geographic proximity captures only 30.8% of health-advice ties, while only 3.7% of geographically proximate household pairs are connected by advice-giving. The choice of exposure mapping matters for what the analysis detects. Exposure mappings based solely on geographic proximity yield a precise zero effect on diarrhea knowledge. By contrast, exposure through advice ties beyond 50 meters increases diarrhea knowledge, and the effect is statistically distinguishable from exposure through nearby non-advice contacts. The evidence suggests that simple, actionable illness-management knowledge diffuses through advice relationships that geographic proximity alone fails to capture. Reported diarrhea, indicating whether the respondent or any child had diarrhea in the previous four weeks, also increases with advice exposure outside 50m, consistent with greater recognition, recall, or reporting rather than higher underlying morbidity. We find no corresponding effects for respiratory knowledge or reported respiratory illness. Our results show that using geographic proximity as a proxy for social exposure can mask important channels of information transmission and could lead researchers to miss meaningful spillover effects.
url:dac9f1f99f096758.abstract_zh: 公共卫生干预措施往往期望在直接覆盖的家庭之外产生溢出效应，但识别社区内谁与谁接触具有挑战性。研究人员常以地理邻近性近似衡量社会接触，尽管传播健康建议的个体未必相邻。我们通过对洪都拉斯农村地区一项随机母婴健康咨询干预进行二次分析来研究这一问题，该干预包含地理编码家庭和映射社会网络数据。在主要50米半径范围内，地理邻近性仅捕捉到30.8%的健康建议联系，而仅有3.7%的地理邻近家庭对存在建议传递关系。暴露映射的选择会影响分析结果。仅基于地理邻近性的暴露映射显示对腹泻知识的影响精确为零。相反，通过50米外建议联系产生的暴露能提升腹泻知识，其效应在统计上显著区别于邻近非建议接触的暴露。证据表明，简单可行的疾病管理知识通过建议关系传播，而单纯地理邻近性无法捕捉这种关系。报告腹泻（反映受访者或任何儿童在过去四周内是否出现腹泻）也随50米外建议暴露增加而增加，这与更高的认知、回忆或报告率一致，而非潜在发病率上升。我们未发现呼吸系统知识或报告呼吸系统疾病存在相应效应。研究结果表明，将地理邻近性作为社会接触的代理变量可能掩盖重要的信息传播渠道，并导致研究者遗漏有意义的溢出效应。

url:dd6fd901f9334ff2.abstract: The literature assessing the effects of transportation infrastructure on how people and economic activity distribute themselves across a system of cities has three main parts. The theoretical literature makes robust predictions about how transportation infrastructure affects the internal structure of cities, but for systems of cities, theory does not let us rule much out. The city-level empirical literature establishes that improved urban transportation infrastructure causes suburban migration, but has only a small impact on city population. This literature is less helpful for understanding the effects of transportation infrastructure on the way people are distributed across a system of cities, but has made some progress. The small empirical literature looking at how transportation infrastructure affects systems of cities using cross-country data remains underdeveloped and is inconclusive.
url:dd6fd901f9334ff2.abstract_zh: 评估交通基础设施如何影响人口与经济活动在城市体系中的分布，相关文献主要包含三个部分。理论文献对交通基础设施如何影响城市内部结构做出了稳健的预测，但对于城市体系而言，理论并未能排除太多可能性。城市层面的实证研究表明，城市交通基础设施的改善会导致郊区迁移，但对城市人口规模的影响较小。这类文献在理解交通基础设施如何影响人口在城市体系中的分布方面帮助有限，但已取得一定进展。利用跨国数据研究交通基础设施如何影响城市体系的少量实证文献仍不成熟，且结论尚无定论。

url:ddcaee6d4a8b7f17.abstract: This paper examines the employment effects of multinational enterprises (MNEs) in Mexico, focusing on the labor market impacts of foreign tariff increases during 2018-2019. Using data from Mexicos National Survey of Occupations and Employment (ENOE) for 2014-2023 combined with sector-level tariff exposure measures based on Fajgelbaum et al. (2024), we construct a quarterly city-sector panel distinguishing employment in MNEs and domestic firms. We analyze employment outcomes across worker characteristics (education, age, gender) and firm attributes (size and location). Results indicate a positive employment effect in MNEs within the sectors most affected by the tariff increases, particularly for highly educated workers and small establishments. In contrast, there is no clear evidence of significant effects on wages.
url:ddcaee6d4a8b7f17.abstract_zh: 本文研究了墨西哥跨国企业的就业效应，重点关注2018-2019年外国关税上调对劳动力市场的影响。利用2014-2023年墨西哥国家职业与就业调查（ENOE）数据，结合基于Fajgelbaum等人（2024）构建的行业层面关税暴露指标，我们构建了一个区分跨国企业与国内企业就业的季度城市-行业面板数据。我们分析了不同工人特征（教育程度、年龄、性别）和企业属性（规模与区位）下的就业结果。结果表明，在受关税上调影响最大的行业中，跨国企业呈现出正向就业效应，尤其体现在高学历工人和小型企业中。相比之下，工资方面未发现显著影响的明确证据。

url:de21d098d5b027f0.abstract: Rising deglobalization has increased external uncertainty for the global economy. This paper develops a China–US Trade Equilibrium (CUTE) model that integrates monetary mechanisms and Hicksian welfare decomposition to examine the effects of U.S. tariff hikes on China and the U.S., as well as China's policy responses. A key contribution is the comparison of policy responses under identical policy costs. The results show that the direct macroeconomic impact of U.S. tariffs on China is modest, reflecting limited trade exposure and strong substitution effects, while broad tariffs generate larger welfare losses for the America through price increases and real income erosion. The reaction directly supporting household income and consumption yield substantially higher welfare returns than trade retaliation, government spending or monetary easing, as tariffs reduce real purchasing power. We suggest within the institutional settings considered, prioritizing household‐based demand support is a more effective response to external tariff shocks than retaliatory trade measures.
url:de21d098d5b027f0.abstract_zh: 去全球化趋势加剧了全球经济的外部不确定性。本文构建了一个整合货币机制与希克斯福利分解的中美贸易均衡（CUTE）模型，用以考察美国加征关税对中国和美国的影响，以及中国的政策应对。本文的关键贡献在于，在相同政策成本条件下比较了不同政策应对的效果。研究结果表明，美国关税对中国的直接宏观经济影响较为温和，这反映了有限的贸易敞口和较强的替代效应；而广泛性关税则通过价格上涨和实际收入侵蚀，给美国带来更大的福利损失。相较于贸易报复、政府支出或货币宽松政策，直接支持家庭收入和消费的应对措施能产生显著更高的福利回报，原因在于关税削弱了实际购买力。我们建议，在所考虑的体制环境下，优先采取基于家庭的需求支持政策，是应对外部关税冲击比报复性贸易措施更为有效的策略。

url:e0390822c17abccd.abstract: At the COVID-19 pandemic's onset, the federal government enacted substantial changes impacting both the revenues and expenditures connected to states' Medicaid programs through a pair of provisions in the March 2020 Families First Coronavirus Response Act. These included a 6.2 percentage point increase in states' Federal Medical Assistance Percentages (FMAP), which raised states' revenues, contingent on adherence to a continuous coverage requirement. The latter provision raised expenditures by preventing the disenrollment of individuals whose eligibility would otherwise have lapsed due to changes in income or other eligibility-relevant circumstances. While these provisions were ex-ante expected to result in expenditures and costs of similar magnitudes, the ex-post realizations remain unquantified. Nationwide, we estimate that states’ share of the continuous coverage provision's costs was $139.2 billion, which is roughly $11.0 billion less than the revenues states received, in aggregate, through increased FMAPs. Revenues and costs varied substantially across states, however, with costs exceeding revenues by as much as $594 per capita, and revenues exceeding costs by as much as $838 per capita. The baseline parameters governing the federal government's share of states' Medicaid expenditures emerge as a key driver of the extent to which the continuous coverage requirement can be viewed as an unfunded federal mandate.
url:e0390822c17abccd.abstract_zh: 在新冠疫情初期，联邦政府通过2020年3月《家庭优先新冠病毒应对法案》中的两项条款，对各州医疗补助计划的收入和支出实施了重大调整。其中一项条款将各州的联邦医疗援助比例（FMAP）提高了6.2个百分点，从而增加了各州收入，但前提是必须遵守持续参保要求。后一项条款则通过阻止因收入或其他资格相关条件变化而本应失去参保资格的个人退出计划，推高了支出。尽管这些条款在事前预期将产生规模相近的支出与成本，但事后实际结果尚未量化。在全美范围内，我们估算各州承担的持续参保条款成本为1392亿美元，这比各州通过提高FMAP获得的收入总额少约110亿美元。然而，各州的收入和成本差异显著：成本超过收入的部分最高达人均594美元，而收入超过成本的部分最高达人均838美元。决定联邦政府承担各州医疗补助支出份额的基准参数，是衡量持续参保要求能否被视为无资金支持的联邦指令的关键因素。

url:e05ab584482f9ec9.abstract: This paper examines macrofinancial linkages between property developers, financial institutions, and macroeconomic outcomes in China. Using a parsimonious vector autoregressive (VAR) model enabled by a machine learning algorithm, it quantifies how idiosyncratic shocks can propagate and be amplified across sectors, with potential implications for financial stability. Stress originating from privately owned developers and regionally focused financial institutions—though relatively limited in scale—can generate persistent spillovers through lending relationships, common exposures, shared markets, and changes in market sentiment. A decline in property prices may undermine investment, weaken consumer confidence, and adversely affect the health of both the property and financial sectors, thereby disrupting financial intermediation and weighing on broader economic growth. Policy considerations should take into account these feedback loops. Market- and exposure-based tools can be helpful for monitoring macrofinancial linkages and assessing the transmission of shocks.
url:e05ab584482f9ec9.abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国房地产开发商、金融机构与宏观经济结果之间的宏观金融关联。借助机器学习算法构建的简约向量自回归（VAR）模型，本文量化了异质性冲击如何通过部门间传导与放大，并对金融稳定产生潜在影响。源自私营开发商及区域性金融机构的压力——尽管规模相对有限——可通过信贷关系、共同风险敞口、共享市场及市场情绪变化，产生持续性的溢出效应。房价下跌可能削弱投资、打击消费者信心，并对房地产与金融部门的健康状况造成不利影响，进而扰乱金融中介功能，拖累整体经济增长。政策制定需充分考虑这些反馈循环。基于市场与风险敞口的工具，有助于监测宏观金融关联并评估冲击传导机制。

url:e1019e8effc8c280.abstract: Local communities are widely blamed for the increasing deforestation in Malawi, primarily due to agricultural expansion and the increased use of biomass energy. Yet, there is limited evidence to understand systemic trade-offs that communities face in their land-use decisions. This study examines the drivers of deforestation in Southern Malawi, focusing on community perceptions and the resource Nexus outcomes related to deforestation. We conducted 25 focus group discussions, 22 key informant interviews, and 271 household interviews across Chikwawa, Blantyre, Mwanza, Mulanje, and Thyolo districts. We also conducted seven expert interviews, facilitated five participatory workshops, and employed ethnographic techniques to gather the lived experiences of community members. The study reveals that (1) socio-economic needs for food, energy and income create a vicious cycle of cropland expansion at the direct expense of forest conservation. (2) Community perceptions identify biomass energy production (index=0.0788) as the main driver of deforestation, followed by cropland expansion (0.0769) and energy poverty (0.0746). (3) The dominance of negative ecological outcomes, followed by economic and political outcomes. The socio-cultural dimension reports the least negative outcomes. Nonetheless, positive outcomes are highest in the socio-cultural dimension, followed by the economic and political dimensions. The least positive outcomes are reported in the ecological dimension. The study empirically shows how community perceptions reshape the Resource Nexus and offers geographically specific policy recommendations. It treats deforestation as both socioeconomic and ecological problem, calling for integrated policies that address livelihood needs and structural drivers in Southern Malawi and similar areas in Sub-Saharan Africa.
url:e1019e8effc8c280.abstract_zh: 当地社区被广泛指责为马拉维森林砍伐加剧的主要原因，这主要源于农业扩张和生物质能源使用的增加。然而，关于社区在土地利用决策中面临的系统性权衡，现有证据十分有限。本研究聚焦马拉维南部森林砍伐的驱动因素，重点关注社区认知及与森林砍伐相关的资源纽带结果。我们在奇夸瓦、布兰太尔、姆万扎、穆兰杰和蒂约洛地区开展了25场焦点小组讨论、22次关键知情人访谈和271户家庭访谈。此外，我们还进行了7次专家访谈、组织了5场参与式研讨会，并运用民族志方法收集社区成员的生活经验。研究表明：（1）对食物、能源和收入的社会经济需求形成了耕地扩张的恶性循环，直接牺牲了森林保护；（2）社区认知将生物质能源生产（指数=0.0788）视为森林砍伐的首要驱动因素，其次是耕地扩张（0.0769）和能源贫困（0.0746）；（3）负面生态结果占主导地位，其次是经济和政治结果，而社会文化维度报告的负面结果最少。尽管如此，正面结果在社会文化维度最高，其次是经济和政治维度，生态维度报告的正面结果最少。本研究实证展示了社区认知如何重塑资源纽带，并提出了具有地理针对性的政策建议。它将森林砍伐视为社会经济与生态的双重问题，呼吁采取综合政策应对马拉维南部及撒哈拉以南非洲类似地区的生计需求和结构性驱动因素。

url:e1a5d99993e2d07b.abstract: There is growing evidence that place-based industrial policies lead to positive economic effects. This column analyses the “Million-Rouble Plants” programme of the 1950s when the Soviet Union helped China build state-of-the-art industrial facilities. By tracking the locations that benefitted, it finds positive economic spillovers in the short and medium run. Although the Million-Rouble Plants themselves continued to thrive, the performance of other local establishments eventually declined, as increasing specialisation weakened knowledge spillovers and constrained local entrepreneurship. Policymakers may achieve more durable gains by fostering diversified local production structures that encourage knowledge spillovers, labour market resilience, and adaptation to technological and market shocks.
url:e1a5d99993e2d07b.abstract_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，地方性产业政策能够带来积极的经济效应。本文分析了20世纪50年代苏联帮助中国建设先进工业设施的“百万卢布工厂”计划。通过追踪受益地区，研究发现该计划在短期和中期内产生了正向经济溢出效应。尽管“百万卢布工厂”本身持续繁荣，但其他本地企业的绩效最终出现下滑，原因在于日益增强的专业化削弱了知识溢出效应，并限制了本地创业活力。政策制定者若想实现更持久的收益，应培育多元化的地方生产结构，以促进知识溢出、增强劳动力市场韧性，并提升应对技术与市场冲击的适应能力。

url:e1abaa1fcc614f86.abstract: This study aims to explore the relationship between trade sophistication and economic development stages, including in the context of digitalization. We employ nonparametric, semiparametric, and parametric methods, covering the period from 2003 to 2024 across 119 countries, categorized into three income groups. Our findings show that GDP per capita has a positive but diminishing relationship with export and import sophistication, suggesting that trade sophistication grows rapidly at lower levels of economic development but slows down as economies become more economically advanced. The evolution patterns of export and import sophistication are relatively similar throughout the stages of economic development; however, the level of export sophistication consistently exceeds that of import sophistication across all income groups. In the context of digital transformation, digitalization is found to positively affect trade sophistication in high and middle‐income countries, while GDP per capita remains positively associated with trade sophistication, but with diminishing marginal effects. For low‐income countries, GDP per capita is the primary driver of increased trade sophistication, while in high‐income countries, digitalization stands out as the dominant factor. These findings remain robust after controlling for human capital, FDI, and institutional quality, highlighting the importance of formulating stage‐specific economic policies to enhance trade sophistication in the rapidly evolving digital era.
url:e1abaa1fcc614f86.abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究旨在探讨贸易复杂度与经济发展阶段之间的关系，并纳入数字化背景进行分析。我们采用非参数、半参数及参数方法，覆盖2003年至2024年间119个国家，并将其划分为三个收入组别。研究结果表明，人均GDP与出口及进口复杂度呈正向但边际递减的关系，即贸易复杂度在经济发展水平较低阶段增长较快，但随着经济体日趋成熟而增速放缓。出口与进口复杂度的演变模式在经济发展各阶段相对相似；然而，在所有收入组别中，出口复杂度水平始终高于进口复杂度。在数字化转型背景下，数字化对高收入及中等收入国家的贸易复杂度具有正向影响，而人均GDP仍与贸易复杂度保持正向关联，但边际效应递减。对于低收入国家，人均GDP是提升贸易复杂度的主要驱动力；而在高收入国家，数字化则成为主导因素。在控制人力资本、外商直接投资及制度质量后，上述结论依然稳健，凸显了在快速演变的数字时代制定分阶段经济政策以提升贸易复杂度的重要性。

url:e1c4aec8f21ef1a2.abstract: US labour productivity has accelerated since 2022. Output per hour grew around 2.5% per year from the end of 2022 to the start of 2026, exceeding its pre-pandemic pace by 1 percentage point. A natural conjecture is that artificial intelligence has raised production efficiency. This column argues that the data suggest otherwise. Higher utilisation – that is, more intense use of labour and capital already in place – accounts for much of the recent acceleration. AI may have contributed to the higher utilisation rate, but through strong demand and heightened uncertainty rather than through efficiency.
url:e1c4aec8f21ef1a2.abstract_zh: 自2022年以来，美国劳动生产率加速增长。从2022年底到2026年初，每小时产出年均增长约2.5%，较疫情前增速高出1个百分点。一个自然的猜想是人工智能提升了生产效率。但本专栏认为，数据表明情况并非如此。更高的利用率——即对现有劳动力和资本的更密集使用——是近期生产率加速的主要原因。人工智能可能对利用率提升有所贡献，但这是通过强劲需求和不确定性加剧实现的，而非通过效率提升。

url:e24bfe5bc4f68500.abstract: The erosion of the postwar international order has exposed a growing gap between the scale of contemporary global challenges and the capacity of existing governance arrangements to address them. This paper argues that the central challenge of global policymaking is no longer how to secure universal agreement among all major powers, but how to organize effective cooperation under conditions of fragmentation and partial non-cooperation. It proposes The New Alignment, a framework for “state-enabled polycentric governance” based on goal alignment, capacity alignment, and policy alignment. By orienting cooperation toward human flourishing through Solidarity, Agency, material Gain, and Environmental sustainability (SAGE), the framework provides a practical foundation for coalition-based collective action. The paper argues that future global governance will increasingly depend on Pivotal Power Coalitions operating within a broader polycentric system, enabling governments, businesses, international organizations, and civil society to coordinate around shared challenges. The New Alignment offers a pathway for transforming fragmented interdependence into cooperative pluralism and thereby provides a framework for effective global policymaking in the twenty-first century.
url:e24bfe5bc4f68500.abstract_zh: 战后国际秩序的侵蚀，暴露出当代全球挑战的规模与现有治理安排应对能力之间日益扩大的差距。本文认为，全球政策制定的核心挑战已不再是如何确保所有主要大国达成普遍共识，而是如何在碎片化与部分不合作的条件下组织有效合作。本文提出"新联盟"框架，这是一种基于目标对齐、能力对齐与政策对齐的"国家赋能的多中心治理"模式。该框架以团结、自主、物质增益与环境可持续性（SAGE）为导向，将合作聚焦于人类繁荣，为基于联盟的集体行动提供了实践基础。本文认为，未来全球治理将日益依赖在更广泛的多中心体系中运作的关键力量联盟，使政府、企业、国际组织与公民社会能够围绕共同挑战进行协调。"新联盟"为将碎片化的相互依存转化为合作多元主义提供了路径，从而为二十一世纪有效的全球政策制定提供了框架。

url:e2724d7c32ad3501.abstract: The central trade-off for designing Disability Insurance (DI) is between providing insurance to those in need while maintaining incentives to work. This paper develops a novel revealed-preference approach to identify the insurance value of DI benefits. We show that comparing the DI take-up response to a change in benefits versus a change in wages identifies the insurance value. Implementing our framework in Canada, we estimate that increasing DI benefits by $1 creates an additional disincentive cost of $0.60 but creates an insurance value of $2.20. Thus, our approach suggests that DI benefits are not overly generous in the Canadian context.
url:e2724d7c32ad3501.abstract_zh: 设计残疾保险（DI）的核心权衡在于：既要为有需要者提供保障，又要维持工作激励。本文提出一种新颖的显示性偏好方法，用以识别DI福利的保险价值。研究表明，通过比较福利变化与工资变化对DI参保率的影响，即可识别其保险价值。在加拿大应用该框架后，我们估算出：每增加1美元DI福利，会产生0.60美元的额外抑制成本，但能创造2.20美元的保险价值。因此，我们的方法表明，在加拿大背景下，DI福利并未过度慷慨。

url:e2de4425e1c5cb66.abstract_zh: 发展中国家多数学生虽缺乏必要先修技能，却仍接受年级水平教学，这种不匹配随着学业推进加剧了学习差距。本文基于多米尼加共和国38个班级、1333名九年级学生的随机对照试验证据，将班级随机分配至三组：每周七小时数学课时中两小时替换为计算机自适应学习（CAL）软件、CAL结合小组辅导、或常规教学对照组。六个月后，CAL使测试成绩提升0.29–0.31个标准差，这一效果在发展中国家教育技术干预研究中属于较大效应。相较于单独使用CAL，增加小组辅导未带来可检测的改善；相反，接受双重干预的班级成绩提升幅度甚至低于仅使用CAL的班级，尽管该差异未达统计显著性。机制证据表明，辅导班级学生对CAL平台的参与度有所降低。这些结果表明，计算机自适应学习软件可有效融入课堂教学以实现规模化学习改善，但多重干预的组合未必产生叠加效益，反而可能引发非预期的行为反应，抵消其有效性。

url:e35a8dc216a7fbaf.abstract: Climate-driven displacement is widely expected to push millions across international borders. Drawing on monthly bilateral flows for 127 developing-country origins, this column finds the reverse: a temperature shock reduces emigration rather than raising it, because climate stress cuts origin incomes and poor households cannot finance a costly international move. On this evidence, the ‘climate refugee’ is the exception, and hardship more often traps poor populations in place than sets them moving.
url:e35a8dc216a7fbaf.abstract_zh: 气候驱动的流离失所现象被广泛预期将推动数百万人跨越国际边界。本文基于127个发展中国家来源地的月度双边人口流动数据，发现了相反的结果：温度冲击反而减少了移民数量，而非增加移民数量，原因是气候压力降低了来源地收入，贫困家庭无力承担高昂的国际迁移成本。基于这一证据，"气候难民"属于例外情况，而困境更常使贫困人口困在原地，而非促使他们迁移。

url:e43e2822dcbbd9a8.abstract: We study the effect of commitment on threats in adversarial bargaining—situations in which a proposer (prosecutor) demands payment from a responder (defendant) under the threat of conflict if the demand is rejected. We focus on plea bargaining, where a prosecutor files charges against a defendant before a round of plea bargaining. The charges affect payoffs if an agreement is not reached, and the case proceeds to trial. The expected benefit for the prosecutor at trial is maximized at a lower charge than that which maximizes the defendant’s loss. Just before the trial starts, the prosecutor can reduce the charges up to a certain point depending on their level of commitment power. The experimental data show that participants with sufficient commitment power used it to gain bargaining power by overcharging the defendant. However, they do so more conservatively than the theory predicts.
url:e43e2822dcbbd9a8.abstract_zh: 本文研究承诺能力如何影响对抗性谈判中的威胁。在此类情境中，提议方（检察官）向回应方（被告）提出要求，并以要求遭拒后发生冲突作为威胁。本文聚焦辩诉交易：检察官在谈判前先对被告提出指控；若双方未达成协议，案件进入审判，指控将影响双方收益。检察官在审判中的预期收益在较低指控水平达到最大，而使被告损失最大化的指控水平更高。审判开始前，检察官可依据其承诺能力，在一定范围内降低指控。实验数据显示，具备足够承诺能力的参与者会通过提出过高指控来增强谈判能力，但其行为比理论预测更为保守。

url:e5264736d1b0406b.abstract: This paper investigates the transmission of oil price shocks to the banking sector in oil-dependent economies, using Oman as a case study. We develop a DSGE model featuring an integrated banking block with endogenous credit rationing and a sovereign wealth fund stabilization rule, calibrated to Omani institutional targets and disciplined by Bayesian methods. Our structural approach disentangles two primary transmission channels: the solvency channel, driven by credit risk and non-performing loans (NPLs), and the liquidity channel, driven by pro-cyclical government deposit withdrawals and sovereign debt issuance. The structural variance decomposition attributes over 54% of non-oil GDP variance and 53% of credit variance to oil price shocks, while bank capital shocks account for less than 0.1%, confirming the quantitative dominance of the liquidity channel. We identify a precautionary liquidity motive—a “liquidity buffer trap”—where banks maintain excess liquidity during booms to hedge against hydrocarbon volatility, structurally suppressing credit to the productive sector. Our counterfactual regime analysis reveals the stabilizing power of credit depth: banking conservatism protects long-term physical capital formation, and the ongoing financialization of the corporate sector— including the rapid growth of Islamic banking and sukuk markets—under Vision 2040 further amplifies this structural resilience. We acknowledge identification challenges inherent in small-sample structural estimation and discuss the sensitivity of results to key modeling assumptions.
url:e5264736d1b0406b.abstract_zh: 本文以阿曼为案例，研究石油价格冲击对石油依赖型经济体银行部门的传导机制。我们构建了一个包含内生信贷配给与主权财富基金稳定规则的银行模块的DSGE模型，该模型根据阿曼制度目标进行校准，并采用贝叶斯方法进行约束。我们的结构方法区分了两种主要传导渠道：由信用风险与不良贷款驱动的偿付能力渠道，以及由顺周期的政府存款提取与主权债券发行驱动的流动性渠道。结构方差分解显示，石油价格冲击解释了非石油GDP方差的54%以上及信贷方差的53%，而银行资本冲击的贡献率不足0.1%，证实了流动性渠道在数量上的主导地位。我们识别出一种预防性流动性动机——即"流动性缓冲陷阱"——银行在经济繁荣期持有超额流动性以对冲碳氢化合物波动，从而结构性抑制了对生产性部门的信贷供给。反事实制度分析揭示了信贷深度的稳定效应：银行保守主义保护了长期实物资本形成，而"2040愿景"下企业部门持续金融化——包括伊斯兰银行与苏库克市场的快速增长——进一步放大了这种结构性韧性。我们承认小样本结构估计中固有的识别挑战，并讨论了关键建模假设对结果的敏感性。

url:e8070473db0abfc8.abstract: We study how global oil price shocks affect the spatial distribution of violent conflict. Combining monthly georeferenced data on oil infrastructure with conflict events worldwide over 1989-2021, we exploit exogenous variation in world crude oil prices within countries using grid-cell and country*month fixed effects. Oil price increases raise organized conflict in oil-bearing cells but reduce it in nearby non-oil areas, indicating a spatial reallocation of territorial violence toward economically valuable locations rather than a uniform increase in conflict. By contrast, lower-intensity unrest spreads across neighboring cells, consistent with diffuse grievance and mobilization channels. The effect is strongest for petroleum fields and driven by state-based conflict, consistent with intensified contestation over oil rents, while downstream infrastructure is associated with protests and localized violence. The magnitude of the response varies with ethnic exclusion, institutions, geography, and ownership, pointing to rent-contestation mechanisms shaped by local conditions.
url:e8070473db0abfc8.abstract_zh: 本文研究全球油价冲击如何影响暴力冲突的空间分布。结合1989-2021年间全球石油基础设施的月度地理参考数据与冲突事件，我们利用国家内网格单元和国家*月份的固定效应，捕捉世界原油价格的外生变化。油价上涨会加剧含油网格中的有组织冲突，但减少附近非油区域的冲突，表明领土暴力向经济价值更高的地点发生空间再分配，而非冲突的普遍增加。相比之下，强度较低的骚乱会扩散至邻近网格单元，这与广泛的怨恨情绪和动员渠道机制一致。该效应在油田区域最为显著，且主要由国家间冲突驱动，符合围绕石油租金的争夺加剧现象；而下游基础设施则与抗议和局部暴力相关。响应强度因族群排斥、制度、地理和所有权而异，表明租金争夺机制受地方条件塑造。

url:e8ee0f090e436663.abstract: The pension sector is an important investor group in global financial markets and a key holder of government and corporate debt. This article examines the evolution of pension fund asset allocations around the globe and documents two important structural changes. First, pension investors have shifted portfolio share allocations away from fixed income securities. This trend is robust across Defined Contribution (DC) and Defined Benefit (DB) programs as well as country groups. Second, pensions have instead shifted allocations into riskier investments within mutual funds as well as alternative investments. We hypothesize that a global decline in interest rates is one potential driver of this change. Using a global sample, we show that declining local currency government bond yields are associated with lower bond pension portfolio shares and higher holdings shares of mutual funds and foreign assets. We discuss the potential implications of these trends for borrowing costs. The declining holding share of pensions as a long-term investor group implies financing costs are less sensitive to new debt issues, but more sensitive to global uncertainty.
url:e8ee0f090e436663.abstract_zh: 养老金部门是全球金融市场中的重要投资者群体，也是政府和公司债务的主要持有者。本文研究了全球范围内养老基金资产配置的演变，并记录了两个重要的结构性变化。首先，养老金投资者已将投资组合份额从固定收益证券中转移出来。这一趋势在固定缴款（DC）和固定收益（DB）计划以及不同国家组中均表现稳健。其次，养老金转而将资金配置到共同基金中风险更高的投资以及另类投资中。我们假设全球利率下降是这一变化的潜在驱动因素之一。利用全球样本，我们表明本币政府债券收益率的下降与养老金投资组合中债券份额的降低以及共同基金和外国资产持有份额的增加相关。我们讨论了这些趋势对借贷成本的潜在影响。作为长期投资者群体，养老金持有份额的下降意味着融资成本对新债务发行的敏感度降低，但对全球不确定性的敏感度增加。

url:ea27b1d472b74dff.abstract_zh: 认识到宏观经济状况决定总体贸易失衡，关税能否消除双边贸易逆差？本文提出平衡贸易关税指数（BTTI），将其定义为在保持宏观经济条件不变的前提下消除双边逆差的统一关税。该指数依赖于基于超越对数GDP函数估算的双边产品层面进口需求弹性，数据涵盖七大主要经济体。新型弹性估计值在进口国、出口国、产品及贸易方向上呈现显著异质性。相较于同质性弹性基准，这种异质性降低了平均隐含关税水平，但意味着对非弹性产品出口国需征收更高关税，凸显了关税在平衡贸易方面的局限性。

url:eaa4c1ab2ea9c57c.abstract: “房票”安置作为地方政府探索的创新性拆迁补偿模式,近年来应用范围持续扩大。本文基于罗伊选择模型和微观数据,系统分析了“房票”安置模式在存量住房去库存和优化财政支出方面的作用,并探讨了“房票”安置中最优补贴率的确定及其福利效应。研究表明,“房票”安置平均带来了28 199元的家庭福利改进,等价于样本家庭年平均收入的37.38%;同时,“房票”政策通过引导拆迁居民购房选择,使存量住房库存下降,节约了政府的拆迁建设成本。测算结果显示,当前补贴率下公共资金边际绩效在0.99~4.58范围内,表明房票安置补贴有显著的社会净收益。最后,本文对最优“房票”补贴率的分析显示,在综合考虑拆迁家庭福利改进和财政补贴成本的情况下,“房票”补贴率还有进一步提升空间。

url:eaa734929ba69bc9.abstract: For the avoidance of doubt: 1) This catalog presents and analyzes a variety of options for reducing the Federal Reserve's balance sheet. Nothing here is an endorsement of any specific policy option; this is a menu of options. Combined, we estimate these options open the door to balance sheet reduction of $1.2 to $2.1 trillion within the Fed's current ample reserves framework. While we do not advocate for or against a return to a scarce reserves regime, further reductions would be possible with a return to scarce reserves. 2) The process of materially shrinking the balance sheet would require a great deal of implementation and rulemaking work in advance and would take time, at least a year and quite possibly several, before the Fed can begin shrinking its balance sheet. If undertaken, there are good reasons for moving slowly and gingerly, and to take steps to ensure financial markets are able to absorb the reissue of securities that roll off the Federal Reserve's balance sheet.
url:eaa734929ba69bc9.abstract_zh: 为免疑义：1）本目录介绍并分析了缩减美联储资产负债表的多种方案。此处不构成对任何特定政策选项的背书，仅作为选项清单。综合估算，这些选项为美联储在当前充足准备金框架下缩减1.2至2.1万亿美元资产负债表规模提供了可能。虽然我们既不主张也不反对回归稀缺准备金制度，但若回归该制度，则可实现进一步缩减。2）实质性缩表过程需要提前开展大量实施与规则制定工作，且需耗时至少一年甚至数年，美联储方能启动缩表。若付诸实施，有充分理由采取审慎渐进的方式，并采取措施确保金融市场能够吸收美联储资产负债表到期证券的再发行。

url:eb2486f8bbd1a46d.abstract: By mid-century, climate change is expected to push millions of migrants across borders, yet direct empirical evidence is limited. Using recent monthly bilateral flow data for 127 developing-country origins and 180 destinations, we estimate migration responses to weather shocks. High-dimensional fixed-effects absorb all origin-, destination-, and migration corridor-by-year confounders, seasonality, and global shocks; identification exploits residual within-corridor weather anomalies. We find no evidence that climate stress raises emigration: higher origin temperatures reduce outflows, while precipitation has no effect. Complementary analysis pinpoints depressed origin income as an underlying mechanism: climate stress tightens household budgets, decreasing the financial viability of international movement.
url:eb2486f8bbd1a46d.abstract_zh: 到本世纪中叶，气候变化预计将推动数百万移民跨越国界，然而直接的实证证据仍然有限。利用近期127个发展中国家来源地和180个目的地的月度双边流动数据，我们估算了移民对天气冲击的反应。高维固定效应吸收了所有来源地、目的地及迁移走廊-年份的混杂因素、季节性和全球冲击；识别依赖于残差走廊内的天气异常。我们没有发现气候压力增加移民外流的证据：来源地温度升高反而减少了流出量，而降水则无影响。补充分析指出，来源地收入下降是潜在机制：气候压力收紧家庭预算，降低了国际迁移的经济可行性。

url:ec8c67f15d66f49c.abstract: The paper develops a new monetarist DSGE model to examine the macroeconomic implications of fiat-money-backed stablecoins and the effectiveness of prudential policies in mitigating associated risks. The model features two segmented sectors: a centralized real economy where fiat money facilitates consumption and investment, and a decentralized virtual economy characterized by anonymous bilateral search and matching, in which transactions are exclusively conducted using stablecoins. Calibrated to the U.S. economy, the simulation results reveal that stablecoins amplify the propagation of exogenous shocks to key macroeconomic variables by weakening the effectiveness of monetary policy. However, prudential regulations—specifically those governing the backing ratio of stablecoins to fiat-denominated reserve assets, analogous to banking liquidity requirements—can serve as stabilizing instruments, dampening volatility and enhancing macroeconomic resilience in the presence of stablecoins.
url:ec8c67f15d66f49c.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个新型货币主义DSGE模型，以研究由法定货币支持的稳定币的宏观经济影响，以及审慎政策在缓解相关风险方面的有效性。该模型包含两个分割的部门：一个集中的实体经济部门，其中法定货币促进消费和投资；一个去中心化的虚拟经济部门，其特征是匿名双边搜索与匹配，交易仅使用稳定币进行。基于美国经济数据的校准模拟结果显示，稳定币通过削弱货币政策的有效性，放大了外生冲击对关键宏观经济变量的传导效应。然而，审慎监管——特别是针对稳定币与法定计价储备资产支持比率的监管（类似于银行流动性要求）——可作为稳定工具，在存在稳定币的情况下抑制波动性并增强宏观经济韧性。
authors: Hui He & Yao Zhao & Dayong Zhou

url:eca156b9e86ee69a.abstract: 大数据管理局作为政府数据治理机制改革的一项制度安排,承担着打破数据孤岛,促进地区数据资源开发、整合与流通的重要职能。本文以各城市设立大数据管理局为准自然实验,从企业异地投资的微观视角考察政府数据治理对资本跨区域流动的影响。本文以2010-2022年沪深A股上市企业为样本,以各城市逐步设立的大数据管理局作为外生事件,采用多时点双重差分方法展开检验。研究发现,目的地城市设立大数据管理局后,异地企业在该地设立的子公司数量显著上升。这一结果在一系列稳健性检验后仍然成立。深入探究其成因,发现其主要源于两项机制的合力：一是缓解信息不对称、降低制度性交易成本;二是提高区域竞争力、优化营商环境。进一步检验发现,对异地资本流入,大数据管理局在区域数据要素基础、跨域数据流通效能、企业数据利用能力以及企业资源约束缓解等四个维度上表现出异质性影响。本文研究表明,大数据管理局的设立有利于吸引异地资本流入,促进数据与资本要素深度融合,为破除制度性障碍、推动区域经济一体化、加快建设全国统一大市场提供了决策参考。

url:ed6fc8c3a8370812.abstract: In recent decades, an empirically estimated double-inertial rule fits the path of changes in the federal funds rate better than a standard inertial Taylor rule. Inertial Taylor rules aim to capture monetary policy gradualism via slow adjustments in the level of the policy rate. Double-inertial rules build on this specification by also gradually adjusting the pace of change in the policy rate. Because a double-inertial rule explains more than twice the variation of changes in the policy rate than its standard inertial counterpart, we argue that practitioners should consider a double-inertial rule when characterizing U.S. monetary policy.
url:ed6fc8c3a8370812.abstract_zh: 近几十年来，实证估计的双惯性规则比标准惯性泰勒规则更能拟合联邦基金利率的变化路径。惯性泰勒规则旨在通过政策利率水平的缓慢调整来捕捉货币政策的渐进性特征。双惯性规则在此基础上进一步对政策利率变化速度进行渐进调整。由于双惯性规则对政策利率变化方差的解释力是标准惯性规则的两倍以上，我们认为实践者在描述美国货币政策时应考虑采用双惯性规则。

url:edc5e144dc4ce4ec.abstract: We argue that in market democracies firms can wield political power through a mechanism that does not rely on lobbying, campaign contributions, or persuasion. When voters cannot commit to future regulation, firms can use irreversible technological investments to reshape ex-post political incentives. We call this mechanism the political hold-up problem. We show that, in equilibrium, a firm's de facto power to avoid regulation coincides with standard measures of market power. This form of power is robust to a wide range of regulatory instruments, including bans, taxes, self-regulation, and delegation to technocrats, and limits the effectiveness of reforms targeting political influence. The political hold-up problem distorts the direction of technological progress and may increase political demand for populism and nationalization. Institutional remedies instead require commitment: supermajoritarian institutions and independent oversight of industry standards.
url:edc5e144dc4ce4ec.abstract_zh: 本文论证，在市场民主国家中，企业可通过一种不依赖游说、政治献金或说服的机制行使政治权力。当选民无法对未来监管做出承诺时，企业能够利用不可逆的技术投资重塑事后政治激励。我们将此机制称为"政治套牢问题"。研究表明，在均衡状态下，企业规避监管的事实权力与市场势力的标准度量指标相吻合。这种权力形式对包括禁令、税收、自我监管及技术官僚授权在内的广泛监管工具具有稳健性，并会限制针对政治影响力的改革效力。政治套牢问题会扭曲技术进步方向，并可能加剧对民粹主义与国有化的政治需求。制度性补救措施则需要承诺机制：超级多数制度与行业标准的独立监督。
url:edc5e144dc4ce4ec.title: Market Power Is Power

url:edcec3d872fecc0e.abstract: Global imbalances are back in the policy debate. This column examines 70 current account adjustment episodes across 51 economies from 1980 to 2024 to discover how large imbalances have unwound in the past. Three lessons stand out: adjustments are fairly common but slow; deficit and surplus narrowing work through different channels; and larger imbalances – especially deficits – are significantly more likely to correct.
url:edcec3d872fecc0e.abstract_zh: 全球失衡问题重新成为政策辩论的焦点。本文考察了1980年至2024年间51个经济体的70次经常账户调整事件，以探究过去大规模失衡是如何化解的。三个关键启示值得关注：调整虽较为常见但进程缓慢；赤字与盈余的收窄通过不同渠道实现；规模较大的失衡——尤其是赤字——更有可能得到纠正。

url:f1252103075f7004.abstract: New importers increase their conditional survival rate and import share over time. However, a model of multi-input firms with an import entry cost and stochastic import costs cannot replicate these dynamics. I show that an extended model can be reconciled with the data. I calibrate both models and use them to identify the effects of trade shocks. The simulations show that a decrease in import prices with the new importer dynamics generates lower productivity gains, but these gains are more widespread across firms.

url:f189673814648cd2.abstract: U.S. overseas military deployments, as a strategic instrument for maintaining hegemony, structurally reconfigure international capital flows through a security‐economy nexus. While prior studies focus on host‐country perspectives, the third‐party economic spillovers of such deployments remain underexplored. This study investigates how they affect Chinese multinationals' foreign direct investment. The findings reveal a significant negative impact of U.S. military presence on Chinese FDI in host countries. Mechanism tests identify two channels: (1) institutional erosion—U.S. security patronage undermines host‐state governance, elevating political risk premiums that deter Chinese investment; (2) strategic anchoring—military presence strains host countries' relations with China, coupled with deep U.S. economic entrenchment, crowds out Chinese capital through both political and market channels. Heterogeneity analysis reinforces this logic. At the micro level, U.S. deployments heighten Chinese managers' perception of geopolitical risk, reshaping their attention allocation and subsequent investment decisions. These findings suggest that U.S. military retrenchment may reshape the strategic calculus of China's outward investment. By extending traditional FDI risk theory, this paper contributes to a nuanced understanding of the spillover effects of U.S. foreign military strategy amid great‐power competition, offering critical insights into the strategic value of the Belt and Road Initiative and guidance for Chinese firms seeking to reposition their global investment footprint.
url:f189673814648cd2.abstract_zh: 美国海外军事部署作为维护霸权的战略工具，通过安全-经济联动机制结构性重塑国际资本流动。现有研究多聚焦东道国视角，但此类部署的第三方经济溢出效应仍待深入探究。本文考察美国军事部署如何影响中国跨国企业对外直接投资，发现美国军事存在显著抑制中国对东道国的直接投资。机制检验识别出两条传导路径：（1）制度侵蚀效应——美国安全庇护削弱东道国治理能力，抬升政治风险溢价，抑制中国投资；（2）战略锚定效应——军事部署加剧东道国对华关系紧张，叠加美国深度经济嵌入，通过政治与市场双重渠道挤出中国资本。异质性分析进一步印证该逻辑。微观层面，美国军事部署强化中国管理者对地缘政治风险的感知，重塑其注意力配置与后续投资决策。研究表明，美国军事收缩可能重构中国对外投资的战略考量。本文通过拓展传统FDI风险理论，为理解大国竞争背景下美国海外军事战略的溢出效应提供新视角，同时揭示"一带一路"倡议的战略价值，为中国企业优化全球投资布局提供决策参考。
